title: Invincible (esp / eng)
body:
ESP
![kiss-cut-stickers-5.5x5.5-default-605c1c9f3f081.jpg](1)
Recién empecé a ver la serie Invincible y me gustó. Pensé que iba a ser una serie así como que muy típica, con héroes tipo Liga de la Justicia. Dije: “ah, esto va a ser un plagio”.
Cuando veo la serie me doy cuenta de que no es así. Tiene también un Superman, sí, héroes tipo Liga de la Justicia, pero todo está muy cambiado, muy distinto. Resulta que esta no es la serie normal que estamos acostumbrados a ver.
Vamos a enfocarnos en esto: la serie trata sobre los Guardianes del Globo y Omni-Man, en el primer capítulo. Y por ahí vamos viendo que Omni-Man parece bueno, pero en realidad no es bueno. Él viene de una raza llamada los Viltrumitas, una raza que intenta conquistar el mundo. No son buenos, simplemente intentan conquistar planetas y funcionan como una especie de militares, como tareas, como soldados.
Lo que todo esto tiene es ese contraste raro: Omni-Man es como el Superman de esta serie, pero con una cara mucho más fría, incluso con ese bigote así tipo Freddie Mercury.
Y también vamos a concentrarnos ahora en la parte importante. Omni-Man tiene un hijo, Mark Grayson, que es un chico normal que a la edad de los 18 años más o menos obtiene sus poderes. Y entonces ahí es que empieza la serie de verdad, lo interesante.
Los Guardianes del Globo están muertos, nadie sabe quién fue. Omni-Man está en un hospital, todo muy crudo. Entonces Mark Grayson quiere empezar la lucha contra el crimen, y le dice a su papá, descubriendo que es hijo de Omni-Man, sin saber los verdaderos intereses de él.
Entonces esto viene siendo como el inicio, un poco grueso, un poco tosco de la serie Invincible.
La serie Invincible es de las últimas, casi como de las más recomendadas, pero no es recomendada por fanatismo. Es una serie recomendada porque cuando la empiezas a ver, te va a gustar.
Y esa es mi recomendación para el día de hoy.
Cómo siempre les pido apoyen a mí esposa @diazktty que tiene muchas ideas que compartir
el blog @cathyarrow
La fundación BBH de @bradleyarrow que puede ser la solución para alguien o alguna familia que lo esté pasando mal
Cómo siempre que nunca les falte el amor ❤️y que Dios los bendiga 🙏

ENG 
![kiss-cut-stickers-5.5x5.5-default-605c1c9f3f081.jpg](1)
I just started watching the series Invincible and I liked it. I thought it was going to be a very typical show, with heroes like the Justice League. I was like: “ah, this is going to be a copy.”
When I watched the series, I realized it’s not like that. It also has a Superman-like character, yes, heroes similar to the Justice League, but everything is very changed, very different. It turns out this is not the normal show we’re used to seeing.
Let’s focus on this: the series is about the Guardians of the Globe and Omni-Man, in the first episode. And from there we start to see that Omni-Man seems good, but in reality he is not. He comes from a race called the Viltrumites, a race that tries to conquer the world. They are not good—they simply try to conquer planets and operate like a kind of military force, like assignments, like soldiers.
What all of this has is that strange contrast: Omni-Man is like the Superman of this series, but with a much colder face, even with that kind of Freddie Mercury-style mustache.
And now let’s focus on the important part. Omni-Man has a son, Mark Grayson, who is a normal kid that at around 18 years old gets his powers. And that’s when the real series starts, the interesting part.
The Guardians of the Globe are dead, and no one knows who did it. Omni-Man is in a hospital, everything is very raw. Then Mark Grayson wants to start fighting crime, and he tells his father, discovering that he is Omni-Man’s son, without knowing his true intentions.
So this becomes the beginning, a bit rough, a bit raw, of the Invincible series.
The series Invincible is one of the newer ones, almost one of the most recommended, but not recommended out of hype. It’s recommended because once you start watching it, you’re going to like it.
And that is my recommendation for today.
As always, please support my wife @diazktty who has many ideas to share
the blog @cathyarrow
the BBH foundation by @bradleyarrow which can be a solution for someone or a family going through a hard time
As always, may love never be missing ❤️ and God bless you 🙏

title: The Search To End Boredom In My Workplace
body:
The broken swing
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbYTfoPPLiWvqqYyW8MGadrhsLheLMv1EgVYUjsDwbvK2/image.png) [Wolf Lieff](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1749229453406-84c4f0ce156a?q=80&w=1074&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) Once upon a time, at my workplace, we were looking for a way to make the workplace alive and thriving to ward off boredom. Our maintenance team suggested building swings where employees can hang out and relax. It was a brilliant idea, but in my own little way, I suggested we go for other sporting items; however, the majority carried the vote when it was put to a vote. Some of the reasons other staff accepted the idea were to cut costs and allow the maintenance team to showcase their talent, which wasn’t a bad idea. At that juncture, I sounded a warning like that lonely voice in the wilderness, urging everybody to wear protective gadgets before using the swing. We agreed and called it a day at that employee engagement session. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ27b99pjE1f8aUurJGzZk8M7Yh2B2Gus8tbdWck5QgcG/image.png) [Prince Beguin](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1640844303584-819fdd17f340?q=80&w=735&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) Afterwards, the requisition came and passed through the approval process. Materials were purchased, and the maintenance team built three swings, which were placed around the canteen environment. It was commissioned for use by all employees during break. One day, while I was in my office with some colleagues, I heard noises. When I came out, I saw an employee on the floor with a cut on the leg. I asked again what had happened, and all of them pointed to the swing and echoed, “The broken swing.” ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXP3rhfPv792D211BdtKR8QTngikVdHGJ9QNA5Pb9C5de/image.png) [Saulhm](https://pixabay.com/images/download/saulhm-wound-106374_1920.jpg) Further interrogation confirmed the swing got broken while they were using it and wounded that individual. The employee was taken to our clinic and attended to. While I declared those swings out of bounds for the staff. If you were in my shoes, how would you manage the situation? What would be your reaction? Feel free to join [here](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/1-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3090-the-broken-swing) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf4sjeMtccBjffrLvQSJK52vZkw7N5mMdPeCmyGkdAA3k/1777688108795.jpg)

title: [ESP/ENG] Reconociendo mi trabajo y lidiando con el síndrome del impostor / Recognizing My Work and Dealing with Imposter Syndrome
body:
>



La verdad es que, tenía muchas ideas para la entrada de hoy, y decidí hacerla reflexiva, sobre el Día Internacional del Trabajador. Hoy, felicitando a varias personas que, considero, la definición de un ejemplo de un gran trabajador me di cuenta de ciertos detalles que quisiera compartir con ustedes. 
> The truth is, I had many ideas for today's post, and I decided to make it reflective, about International Workers' Day. Today, while congratulating several people who I consider to be the epitome of a great worker, I noticed certain details that I'd like to discuss with you.



![Brown and Beige Minimalist Fashion Designer Portfolio A3 Landscape.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPL86hQ6qFBSqGryFBagFTYa9EYrSY91A7UHoBWy75rf2/Brown%20and%20Beige%20Minimalist%20Fashion%20Designer%20Portfolio%20A3%20Landscape.jpg)


Podría decir que, Dios me premió con personas a mi Alrededor que, son el ejemplo clásico de un buen trabajador, y para que más muestra qué mis hermanos. Mi hermana jocksy es muy responsable, siempre está buscando algo nuevo que hacer, además que, las cosas no las hace a medias e intenta ser mejor cada día, y mi hermano José Antonio es dedicado y muy disciplinado con su trabajo, todos los días se levanta y se acuesta con la intención de generar más ingresos, estas son cualidades que admiro de ellos. 
> I could say that God blessed me with people around me who are the classic example of a good worker, and what better example than my siblings? My sister Jocksy is very responsible, always looking for something new to do, and she doesn't do things halfway; she tries to be better every day. My brother José Antonio is dedicated and very disciplined with his work; every day he gets up and goes to bed with the intention of generating more income. These are qualities I admire in them.


![IMG_20260501_215842.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWZA5d6iYSDMdxQ4DN3XhLsCvwPFrZoEuNqsPn6sb3G6a/IMG_20260501_215842.jpg)


Sin embargo, esta mañana, mientras conversaba con mi hermano, pronuncié sin querer palabras que menospreciaron mi trabajo y descreditaron todo lo que he logrado. Fue un reflejo claro del síndrome del impostor, ese sentimiento que me hace dudar de mis propias capacidades y habilidades,en vez de dar lugar para reconocer y valorar los años de esfuerzo y sacrificio, permití que la inseguridad tomara el control. 
> However, this morning, while talking with my brother, I unintentionally uttered words that belittled my work and discredited everything I've accomplished. It was a clear reflection of imposter syndrome, that feeling that makes me doubt my own abilities and skills. Instead of acknowledging and valuing the years of effort and sacrifice, I allowed insecurity to take over.



![IMG_20260501_215800.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdjTUXXQXnBtVmH1zWCYLHbcT3s39EKWTfGnoWnY9L9Cf/IMG_20260501_215800.jpg)

¿Cuales capacidades me hacen especial? Desde hace un par de años, cree un emprendimiento desde cero, con la intención de enaltecer la imagen de la mujer. Creando un espacio, donde las mujeres pueden optar por prendas que las hagan sentir más seguras de si misma. No solo me quede con eso, establecí otro emprendimiento que, es en realidad una extensión del primero, donde puedo usar la creatividad para diseñar piezas de bisutería. Aparte de eso, tengo un trabajo fijo que, aunque, realmente no es lo que espero ni quiero hacer toda mi vida, me ha generado estabilidad emocional. 
> What skills make me special? A couple of years ago, I built a business from scratch, with the intention of empowering women. I created a space where women can choose clothing that makes them feel more confident. I didn't stop there; I established another business, which is really an extension of the first, where I can use my creativity to design jewelry. Besides that, I have a stable job which, although it's not what I truly hope or want to do for the rest of my life, has provided me with emotional stability.



![IMG_20260501_215519.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZUchCyhZtrZwXPNxqkHnXHP72fdpLzK7LnvgUy9ddzgK/IMG_20260501_215519.jpg)

Vivir en Venezuela me ha enseñado a valorar cada logro de manera especial, a pesar de ese patrón de pensamientos impostores. Las metas que alcanzamos como jóvenes aquí tienen un peso mucho mayor, porque superar las dificultades diarias requiere esfuerzo y perseverancia. Por eso, cada pequeño avance es un triunfo que celebró con orgullo y gratitud. Personalmente, agradezco cada día tener varios trabajos, ya que, representan no solo una fuente de ingresos, sino también la oportunidad de seguir creciendo. 
> Living in Venezuela has taught me to value every achievement in a special way, despite that pattern of self-deprecating thoughts. The goals we reach as young people here carry much more weight because overcoming daily difficulties requires effort and perseverance. That's why every small step forward is a triumph we celebrate with pride and gratitude. Personally, I'm grateful every day to have several jobs, as they represent not only a source of income but also the opportunity to continue growing.

Although the AI industry is expanding rapidly and the construction of AI data centers is increasing, there is still a waiting period of more than two years for completion. I believe that a stable portfolio that offers peace of mind is of the utmost importance. Of course, I will also steadily accumulate MAGS, SMH, and AIPO through a satellite strategy.

Let's diligently save together for a comfortable life after retirement.

body:
> /Imagen IA/ *** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZGSKXoS64iLiGGjzgrNmRsMj49SecDnmM5gcsn2nso4s/1777684878661.jpg) >## Saludos estimados hivers de #holoslotus
✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰
>***En los pliegues de la memoria popular local nuestra, entre voces añejas que aún se cruzan en esquinas y relatos, resurge la figura de Gerónimo y su más trascendente historia: la del camastro . No es sólo un personaje ni un objeto: es un símbolo de resistencia y de ingenio en las maneras tan nuestra de transformar lo cotidiano en mito. La crónica que sigue no pretende fijar una verdad absoluta, sino abrir un espacio donde la leyenda y la realidad se entrelazan como las fibras de un místico tejido que se empeña en perpetuarse en la imaginación colectiva.*** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXYDxNrqArfW4Fa67DKEYWgieZMCrLP7tHWmihfTryuMD/1777684771686.jpg) >***Corrían los años 60 del pasado siglo.*** Gerónimo, ser obstinado, era también hombre de pocas palabras. Poco dado a blasfemar en las esquinas. Pero, en el fondo, un escolimado social, de entonces... Sentado en la esquina de su barrio, solía contar historias de ciclones devastadores, de apariciones, de boleros que sonaban en los traga - níqueles, y de su puesto de viandas que ya no existía. Su vida era un mosaico de recuerdos, y su voz cansada, más fuerte que la soledad. Con lentos, pero firmes pasos, tres y cuatro veces por semana cogía runbo a la Sierra, \

,  
a buscar leña y lo que se le pegara.  
Volvía cargado, con los hombros vencidos,  
como si en cada viaje se jugara  
la posibilidad de seguir habitando el mundo.  

 La pobreza lo había llevado al extremo  
de no tener dónde dormir.  
Hasta que un día en uno de sus habituales recorridos encontró una cueva, que resultó ser la renombrada caverna: \

y decidió bajar a sus entrañas. 
***

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqYqyL4ywH8NBiZ4y732tFK7CkXVtg542XapQmeaorig/1777683957716.jpg)</center>
***

El [\

]( https://www.ecured.cu/Carso_de_Baire) es  reconocido por contener, en su geografía, este tipo de accidente. 
Rápidamente captó sus rasgos de magestuosidad y peligros. Pero decidió explorarla.  
Al terminar parte importante de su descenso, grande fue su sorpresa y feliz su satisfacción:  
en uno de sus recodos encontró un camastro metálico.
Al salir de profunda meditación, decidió cargar con él.  
Caminó kilómetros descendiendo sobre “dientes de perro”,  topografía agresivapara cualquiet ser humano.,  
Al llegar a casa, las pocas fuerzas que le dejó el atrevimiento de recorrer, con ella a cuesta, cerca de 5 km, le permitieron, por suerte, colocarla en su desacomodado y mugriente cuarto.  
Al parecer había resuelto un gran problema.  
Pasaron unos días y todo era felicidad.  
Pero una noche empezó a sentir que aquello se movía.  
Pensó que era una pesadilla,  
pero a la noche siguiente sintió lo mismo.  
Entonces, al quinto día, escuchó una voz que le suzurraba al oido:  
“Devuelve al lugar culumbina.”  

Y no le quedó más remedio que hacer cumplir el tenebroso pedido.  
Al sexto día, bien oscuro, cargó nuevamente con el camastro,  
recorrió los mismos kilómetros sobre “dientes de perro”, pero ahora en fastidioso y agotador ascenso, devolviéndolo a la cueva,  
como quien devuelve un secreto a su único dueño.  
Desde entonces, en la esquina de siempre, no se cansaba de repetir que las entrañas de la tierra tienen memoria 
y que lo que se arranca de ellas  
siempre pide volver.  

Hasta los últimos años de su vida  
contó esa historia y aseguraba que era cierta.  
Y cuando falleció,  
los vecinos lo acostaron en el camastro,  
minutos antes de colocarlo en el féretro.  

>**Así, las memorias de Gerónimo, junto a la Grieta del Carso de Baire que hizo el reclamo,
quedaron plasmadas en el imaginario popular local, convirtiéndose en leyenda.** 

<center>⚕️ ⚕️ ⚕️</center>

><center>**EPD Gerónimo...!!**</center>
***
<sub>➥ El contenido original de este post está escrito en mi idioma natal: el castellano. Imagen generada con IA usando Copilot. Banners de mi creación con edición de Text On Photo. Traducción: Google translate.</sub>
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbnrcy5wkxiDGkH3a6JPaka1fgSdBTBxMo2hTM56t99zh/1777686826987.jpg)

 # \

> /Image IA/ *** >## Greetings, esteemed hivers of #holoslotus
✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰
***In the folds of our local popular memory, among ancient voices that still... Crossing street corners and stories, the figure of Gerónimo resurfaces, along with his most transcendent tale: that of the cot. He is not merely a character or an object: he is a symbol of resistance and ingenuity, reflecting our unique way of transforming the everyday into myth. The following chronicle does not aim to establish an absolute truth, but rather to open a space where legend and reality intertwine like the threads of a mystical tapestry that strives to perpetuate itself in the collective imagination.*** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXYDxNrqArfW4Fa67DKEYWgieZMCrLP7tHWmihfTryuMD/1777684771686.jpg) >***It was the 1960s.*** Gerónimo, a stubborn man, was also a man of few words. He was not one to swear on street corners. But, deep down, a social outcast, back then... Sitting on the corner of his neighborhood, he used to tell stories of devastating cyclones, of apparitions, of boleros that played in the arcades, and of his food stall that no longer existed. His life was a mosaic of memories, and his tired voice, stronger than loneliness. With slow but firm steps, three or four times a week he would head to the Sierra, \

to gather firewood and whatever else he could find.
He would return laden, his shoulders slumped, as if each trip risked his very survival.

Poverty had driven him to the extreme of having nowhere to sleep. Until one day, on one of his usual walks, he found a cave, which turned out to be the renowned cavern: \

(The Crack), and decided to descend into its depths.

***
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqYqyL4ywH8NBiZ4y732tFK7CkXVtg542XapQmeaorig/1777683957716.jpg)</center>
***

The [\

](https://www.ecured.cu/Carso_de_Baire) is known for containing this type of geological feature.

He quickly grasped its majestic and dangerous characteristics. But he decided to explore it.

After completing a significant part of his descent, he was greatly surprised and delighted:

in one of its recesses, he found a metal cot.

Coming out of deep contemplation, he decided to carry it with him. He walked for kilometers downhill over “dog's teeth,” a treacherous terrain for any quiet human being.
Upon arriving home, the little strength he had left from the daring feat of carrying it on his back for nearly 5 km allowed him, luckily, to place it in his messy and filthy room.
It seemed he had solved a major problem.

A few days passed, and all was happiness.

But one night he began to feel it moving.

He thought it was a nightmare,

but the following night he felt the same thing.

Then, on the fifth day, he heard a voice whispering in his ear:

“Return the cot to its place.”

And he had no choice but to carry out the sinister request.

On the sixth day, in the dead of night, he again carried the cot,

walked the same kilometers over “dog's teeth,” but now on a tedious and exhausting ascent, returning it to the cave,

like one who returns a secret to its only owner. From then on, on his usual corner, he never tired of repeating that the earth's depths have a memory,

and that what is torn from them

always asks to return.

Until the last years of his life,
he told that story and insisted it was true.

And when he died,
the neighbors laid him on the cot,

minutes before placing him in the coffin.

>**Thus, Gerónimo's memories, along with the Baire Karst Crack that made the claim,
were etched into the local popular imagination, becoming a legend.**

<center>⚕️ ⚕️ ⚕️</center>

><center>**RIP Gerónimo...!!**</center>
***

Los incendios forestales en casi todo el país han estado fuertes durante la temporada de sequía que terminó recientemente, y muchos paisajes sufrieron grandes quemaduras, entre ellos este lugar.*
![IMG_20260424_065814.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZG73KYe4CsT22zLLX2nvVajQ8DW68AHWpSufzvVYCGy/IMG_20260424_065814.jpg)
Despite the efforts of the park rangers, unscrupulous people start fires that spread due to the action of the wind and it is very difficult to control the flames. Many plants planted to reforest are lost, and animals are also displaced or die due to these acts of vandalism against nature. >*A pesar de los esfuerzos de los guardaparques, personas inescrupulosas inician incendios que se propagan por la acción del viento y es muy difícil controlar las llamas. Muchas plantas sembradas para reforestar se pierden, y también los animales son desplazados o mueren a causa de estos actos de vandalismo contra la naturaleza.*
![IMG_20260424_070358.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc4UY89TXTGXE8cYxmrewuNHbm4ss4x3rc1ex3KJP2gC8/IMG_20260424_070358.jpg)
That's why it's a relief that the rains have already arrived. A large part of these mountains had their soils black from the fire, without any vegetation, but as soon as a little water fell, within a few days everything began to turn green. Its power of regeneration is truly incredible. >*Por eso es un alivio que ya hayan llegado las lluvias. Gran parte de estas montañas tenían sus suelos negros por el fuego, sin nada de vegetación, pero apenas cayó un poco de agua, a los pocos días todo empezó a reverdecer. Su poder de regeneración es realmente increíble.*
![IMG_20260424_070348.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZKFfZV9q2eTaX78GDoLZaR9qMSKewFFjnSMroWoMvZ9w/IMG_20260424_070348.jpg)
![IMG_20260424_070319.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVoH5sozPQNoNNzSgjHD2yCTEzm9cnCeujvDd4ywzhAVL/IMG_20260424_070319.jpg)
Although climbing the mountain during the rainy season may not be the most advisable, feeling the freshness in the environment is very pleasant, and also seeing how the landscape comes to life again. >*Aunque subir la montaña durante la temporada de lluvias quizás no sea lo más recomendable, sentir la frescura que hay en el ambiente es muy agradable, y también ver cómo el paisaje cobra vida de nuevo.*
![IMG_20260424_070311.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZJg3pUY36NfK9c8WeXWufmm7UC5PDSxGaP84KnpFHS8y/IMG_20260424_070311.jpg)
I like to go very early in the morning. I reach a certain height and stay there for a while doing some stretching, breathing deeply and contemplating. >*A mi me gusta ir muy temprano en la mañana. Llego hasta cierta altura y allí me quedo un rato haciendo algunos estiramientos, respirando profundo y contemplando.*
![IMG_20260420_070156.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmccmj7PMYDfPsAp6iShCrk7YugP2CNL6XfM1T54DhGcsx/IMG_20260420_070156.jpg)
![IMG_20260420_070737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWbRbTCrePMcCf1Yh7FVh8WgqyvcGz6TxyjVZuRCLSZ17/IMG_20260420_070737.jpg)
And of course, on these hikes I also do another one of my favorite things: taking photos. How could I possibly miss a tree like this, for example? >*Y por supuesto, en estas excursiones también hago otra de mis cosas favoritas: tomar fotos. ¿Cómo perderme, por ejemplo, un árbol como este?*
![IMG_20260420_071016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf2KcFtqQxDPpTzHVo4SeYtM3QCVa9DHTHpjRXuQFMXZQ/IMG_20260420_071016.jpg)

title: Cuando la naturaleza se defiende.///When Nature Fights Back....Esp-Eng
body:
> Como estan amigos de esta comunidad, no se si sere la unica, pero a veces me pasa, que no encuentro sobre que hacer una publicacion o de cual hacer algo, porque de que hay mucho material lo hay, tanto en lo personal, como en nuestro entorno. Todos los dias hay una noticia que es un boom o esta en el tapete, pero hay otras que quizas no tuvieron ese boom esperado, pero son noticias al final. Y esta plataforma tambien es un medio de llevar esas noticias que quizas no se conocen y es que no es porque lo hayan ocultado y en las redes menos, porque en ellas queda todo registrado. Solo debemos buscar para tener digamos soporte o bases de lo que vamos a decir.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPzWnSP7N1h9cx4QjZyPff9ZrGjLbz9xFYQzZEXWWiFnk/image.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/familia-de-elefantes-elefante-safari-2776148/)

> Hace poco vi una noticia de algo que sucedió en el recien pasado mes de abril, sobre un cazador, que resulto cazado. Por eso es que titule mi post que la naturaleza se defiende, desde hace mucho tiempo, años no se cuanto, se han visto mal las figuras de personas que son cazadores de animales solo por un capricho, un ego personal, mas cuando se trata de animales en extincion. Que entonces para estos cazadores se vanaglorian y se toman fotos con su premio es decir lo que cazaron, otros usan la taxonomia, para conservar este premio en sus casas, asi recordar siempre ese dia, pero tambien muchos han sido criticados, mas no se si han sido juzgados, llevados a prision por esto.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2uyHF3SsWwqGUJuXb14cQsediYStCcwZhSkBTKYW4Cz/image.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/cazar-cazador-perro-de-caza-4626683/)

> El caso es que hace poco un cazador llamado **Ernie Dosio**, se encontraba en un zafari en Gabon, buscando su nuevo premio, pero que paso no se sabe, pero resulto ser cazado por un elefante o unos elefantes, que según videos que hay en las redes tambien, mientras quienes les acompañana salieron corriendo, quedando este cazador solo con los elefantes, yo medio vi algo y quede impresionada, mas no lo quise traer aquí, solo busquen quien lo quiera ver. Este hecho penoso, porque por mas que sea era una vida humana, pero en las diferentes publicaciones, hay un sin fin de comentarios, a favor y otros en contra del ataque. Es como que si los elefantes en este caso que fue el animal protagonico de este hecho, un ser vivo tambien, uno de los mas grandes de las especies terrestres, que hace años los cazadores los asesinaban para obtener sus colmillos ya que era o es un material muy costoso para hacer otras cosas. Pero digo, sera que el o los elefantes pensaron que ya era hora de poner un alto los cazadores, que se sienten que invaden su espacio, su habitat, donde son libres, viven con sus mismas especies. Que venga otro a perturbar su paz.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWFvS5nNeP7rG9PDScCmmMVk5ehpej9cV1kjsPSBsyheg/image.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/sin-icono-de-caza-no-cazar-7531395/)

> Espero o quizas muchos, que esto marque un precedente, de que deberian de eliminar la cazeria ilegal, aunque según este era legal, penalizar a quienes lo hagan, que en vez de destruir, cuidemos lo que la naturaleza nos da. Es muy diferente criar, sacrificar aquel animal que sirve de sustento, de alimentacion a la humanidad, a aquellos que los matan por simple gusto, por sentirse el mas fuerte ante otros, cuando no lo son. Aqui les dejo enlaces con la noticia: https://www.libertaddigital.com/sociedad/2026-04-30/quien-es-ernie-dosio-el-famoso-cazador-millonario-que-ha-muerto-aplastado-por-un-elefante-en-gabon-1b-7397448/ https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/quien-era-ernie-dosio-cazador-millonario-muere-tras-ser-aplastado-por-un-elefante-en-africa/ Contenido original traducido con la app DeepL
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ5s73HHuGWVTYEPwdpAh4LC53h3GrshWQ551Fw1HWrWL/image.png) ![image.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmR7XUjxPiAbKJaS8JukXBAWXCMpKDWLXUSdS1jaZvfsw5/image.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/elefantes-manada-de-elefantes-reba%c3%b1o-4790442/)

> Hello, friends of this community. I don’t know if I’m the only one, but sometimes I find myself at a loss for what to post or what to write about, even though there’s plenty of material out there—both in my personal life and in the world around us. Every day there’s a story that goes viral or makes headlines, but there are others that maybe didn’t get the expected buzz—yet they’re still news, after all. And this platform is also a way to share those stories that might not be widely known—not because they’ve been hidden, and certainly not on social media, since everything is recorded there. We just need to look for evidence or a foundation to back up what we’re going to say.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPzWnSP7N1h9cx4QjZyPff9ZrGjLbz9xFYQzZEXWWiFnk/image.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/familia-de-elefantes-elefante-safari-2776148/)

> I recently saw a news story about something that happened last April, about a hunter who ended up being hunted himself. That’s why I titled my post “Nature Defends Itself.” For a long time—I don’t know exactly how many years—people have looked down on hunters who kill animals on a whim or for personal ego, especially when it comes to endangered species. So, these hunters boast and take photos with their trophies—that is, what they’ve hunted. Others use taxidermy to preserve these trophies in their homes, so they can always remember that day. But many have also been criticized, though I don’t know if they’ve been prosecuted or sent to prison for this.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2uyHF3SsWwqGUJuXb14cQsediYStCcwZhSkBTKYW4Cz/image.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/cazar-cazador-perro-de-caza-4626683/)

> The fact is that recently, a hunter named **Ernie Dosio** was on a safari in Gabon, looking for his next trophy. No one knows exactly what happened, but he ended up being hunted by an elephant or elephants. According to videos circulating online, while his companions ran away, leaving him alone with the elephants, I sort of saw something and was shocked, but I didn’t want to post it here; just look it up if you want to see it. This is a tragic event, because even though it was a human life, there are endless comments in various posts, some in favor and others against the attack. It’s as if the elephants—in this case, the animal at the center of this incident, a living being too, one of the largest of all land species—were the ones in the right. For years, hunters have been killing them for their tusks, since they were—or still are—a very valuable material used to make other things. But I wonder, did the elephant or elephants think it was time to put a stop to the hunters, who feel they are invading their space, their habitat, where they are free, living among their own kind? That someone else would come to disturb their peace.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWFvS5nNeP7rG9PDScCmmMVk5ehpej9cV1kjsPSBsyheg/image.png) [](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/sin-icono-de-caza-no-cazar-7531395/)

> I hope—and perhaps many others do too—that this sets a precedent: that illegal hunting should be eliminated, even though this particular instance was legal; that those who engage in it should be penalized; and that instead of destroying, we should care for what nature provides us. It is very different to raise and slaughter an animal that serves as sustenance and food for humanity than to kill them simply for the sake of it, to feel superior to others, when in reality they are not. Here are some links to the news story: https://www.libertaddigital.com/sociedad/2026-04-30/quien-es-ernie-dosio-el-famoso-cazador-millonario-que-ha-muerto-aplastado-por-un-elefante-en-gabon-1b-7397448/ https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/tendencias/quien-era-ernie-dosio-cazador-millonario-muere-tras-ser-aplastado-por-un-elefante-en-africa/ Original content translated using the DeepL app.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNP38ehVgrghHEK1r5CEsV7cDfHkZaDwt9rNArptSMCfV/image.png)

¡Saludos, comunidad de corredores apasionados! Este jueves fue una jornada de entrenamiento excepcional que me permitió conectar nuevamente con la con el parque. Tuve la oportunidad de completar diez kilómetros cargados de energía en el Parque del Este, un lugar que siempre nos regala una frescura inigualable. El clima en Caracas estuvo simplemente perfecto durante la mañana, con una temperatura refrescante que rondó los 18°C, facilitando  y permitiendo mantener un ritmo constante sin el agotamiento del calor extremo.
Lo que hace que esta semana sea realmente maravillosa es que he tenido la oportunidad de correr dos veces fuera del gimnasio. Poder cambiar el ambiente de las cuatro paredes por el aire puro y los paisajes abiertos de nuestra ciudad es algo que valoro muchísimo. Estas salidas las he combinado estratégicamente con mis acostumbradas sesiones de spinning, logrando un equilibrio ideal entre la resistencia cardiovascular y el fortalecimiento muscular de las piernas.
Hoy, primero de mayo, celebramos el Día del Trabajador. Quiero aprovechar este espacio para enviarles una calurosa felicitación a todos los compañeros lectores, y de manera muy especial a mis panas de Hiverun. Que la constancia, el esfuerzo y la disciplina que aplicamos en cada entrenamiento se traduzcan también en éxito y prosperidad en sus labores profesionales. Somos atletas y trabajadores incansables que siempre buscamos dar nuestra mejor versión en cada kilómetro 
Muchas gracias a todos los que se tomaron el tiempo de leer esta publicación. Como es costumbre, les regalo algunas fotografías de la ruta y de lo que fue esta productiva jornada deportiva. ¡Sigan sumando!

Greetings, passionate running community! This Thursday was an exceptional training day that allowed me to reconnect with the park once again. I had the opportunity to complete ten energy-filled kilometers at Parque del Este, a place that always offers us incomparable freshness. The weather in Caracas was simply perfect during the morning, with a refreshing temperature of around 18°C, making it easy to maintain a steady pace without the exhaustion of extreme heat.
What makes this week truly wonderful is that I’ve had the chance to run twice outside of the gym. Being able to trade the four walls for the fresh air and open landscapes of our city is something I value immensely. I have strategically combined these outdoor runs with my usual spinning sessions, achieving an ideal balance between cardiovascular endurance and leg muscle strengthening.
Today, May 1st, we celebrate Labor Day. I want to take this moment to send a warm congratulations to all my fellow readers, and especially to my friends at Hiverun. May the perseverance, effort, and discipline we apply in every workout also translate into success and prosperity in your professional endeavors. We are athletes and tireless workers who always strive to give our best version in every kilometer.

title: Harmony.
body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc1207f18e6f4bb740c365b50e2963ab6c89d15d51670ba6f30c618b86d4edfb2826c129c8404bc80303793a288e195e77d17584cb91c21dee8d6021579a5be3a_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

Once upon a time, in a quaint little village nestled between rolling hills and lush forests, there lived a community known for its harmony. The villagers worked together, shared their resources, and celebrated each other's successes. They prided themselves on their ability to resolve conflicts peacefully and maintain a balance in their daily lives.

## The Arrival of the Stranger

One day, a weary traveler arrived in the village. He was a wandering musician, carrying a beautiful lute adorned with intricate carvings. The villagers welcomed him with open arms, eager to hear his melodies. The musician played enchanting tunes that resonated with the spirit of the village, and soon he became a beloved part of their community.

## The Dissonance

As time passed, the musician began to notice that while the villagers were harmonious in their interactions, they often suppressed their true feelings to maintain peace. Disagreements were brushed aside, and individual desires were sacrificed for the sake of collective harmony. The musician, feeling a sense of unease, decided to introduce a new song—a song that encouraged the villagers to express their emotions, even if it meant creating a little dissonance.

At first, the villagers were hesitant. They feared that expressing their true feelings would disturb the peace they had cultivated. However, the musician persisted, urging them to embrace their individuality and share their thoughts openly. Slowly, they began to speak up, revealing hidden grievances and unfulfilled desires.

## The Break in Harmony

As the villagers started to express themselves, the harmony they had enjoyed began to waver. Arguments erupted, friendships were tested, and the once-unified community found itself divided. The villagers longed for the simple days of peace, but now they were faced with the complexities of their emotions.

In their quest for authenticity, they had overlooked the delicate balance that harmony requires. They learned that harmony is not merely the absence of conflict but the presence of understanding and acceptance of diverse perspectives. 

## The Path to True Harmony

Realizing their mistake, the villagers sought the musician’s guidance once more. He explained that true harmony is built on a foundation of trust, where individuals can express their feelings without fear of judgment. He encouraged them to listen actively, to empathize with one another, and to find common ground amidst their differences.

With patience and effort, the villagers began to rebuild their community. They learned to communicate openly, celebrating their differences while finding ways to unite. The music of the lute became a symbol of their journey—a reminder that harmony is not the absence of dissonance but the ability to create beautiful melodies from the unique notes of each individual.

## The Wisdom Gained

From that day forward, the villagers understood the essence of true harmony. They learned that:

- **Conflict is a natural part of relationships**: Embracing it can lead to growth and deeper connections.
- **Open communication fosters understanding**: Sharing emotions and thoughts can strengthen bonds.
- **Diversity enriches unity**: Different perspectives can create a more profound and beautiful harmony.

And so, the village thrived, a testament to the power of both individuality and unity—a living reminder that true harmony is a dance of many voices, each contributing to a greater whole.

---

### Moral of the Story

**Harmony is not the absence of conflict but the ability to embrace and integrate diverse perspectives.**

***

body: >Hello everyone and welcome my post for today.
>I'm using the Ecency platform today instead of PeakD that I normally use as it refuses to download images today for some reason.
>Today I have images of a Black Crowned Noght Heron comming in for a landing at the West end of Woodly Island here on Humboldt Bay at low tide.
>This is the first time I've imaged one in flight and head on.

>Usually I find them roosting and snoozing in a tree as the are mostly nocternal. I am here early on an overcast morning at low tide and there are several species of birds fishing the tide pools here on the mud flat.
>I have hundreds of images to go through and have enough for dozens of posts.
>There atr about a half dozen Night Herons on the flat but they are all just standing around or flying away from me.
>This is the only one that gave me a front end view.
>I've been trying to get action shots these days instead of perched or standing around.
>I almost missed this series of images but was able to shift over and capture a burst before it landed.
>This is a short post for me with six images rather than a couple of dozen or more I normally post but these were the only ones I had of this bird in flight.
>Also I've figured my editing software that I bought amost three years ago and can now do batch editing rather than one by one.
>This made my editing life so mudh faster and easier and saves hours of my time =)
>I was hoping to capture on of these bad boys acually catching a fish but no joy =(
>I did get images of other birds pulling fish out of the tide pools and will be posting them over the next couple of weeks.
>Well that's all for today I hope you all enjoyed the shots of this cool hunter,

title: Christian's Story, Turbulence in Life
body:
A warm greeting to all my dear friends! It's a pleasure to greet you with another story written for you here in Hive's most musical community. Today's story is about Christian. He's a singer with a certain personality trait that leads him down some rather turbulent paths. If you'd like to know what happens to him because of this trait, I invite you to read the story, as always. I never give away too much in the introduction to avoid spoilers, so there you have it—read on!

> Un cordial saludo estimados y queridos amigos, es un gusto saludarlos en una historia más que escrito para todos ustedes acá en la comunidad más musical de hive. Esta de hoy será sobre Christian. El es un cantante con una cualidad en su forma de ser que lo lleva por caminos un poco digamos turbulentos. Si quieren conocer que le ocurre en su vida a causa de esa cualidad les invito a leer como siempre la historia. Nunca doy muchos detalles en la introducción para no crear spoilers, así que ya saben, a leer se ha dicho.

<div class=\

> ![1777576945987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xp1vKhirjzN7fdTgowD9bBzHHZMVjJbuoEGTnvYReXUoF1ADfmi9rhV6YLTNfANyZcS.jpg) Image created by me in canva **Post translated with Google Translate** The truth is, Christian is someone who has often had to learn the hard way. If there's a bumpy road, it's the one he's been on, the one he's on now, and the one he'll be on in the future. Since childhood, he's always been a bit impulsive and lacks self-control. This trait has always caused him a lot of trouble, and his ability to navigate these problems is almost always poor, though it doesn't necessarily help him learn much along the way. But he's the typical person who doesn't learn from his mistakes, and if he does, it's at a very slow pace, leaving him little room to maneuver and avoid problems. As a child, when he wanted something, he would shout for it; he didn't want to wait. You had to run and get him what he wanted immediately, otherwise he'd throw a tantrum and start arguing. Perhaps he wasn't raised well from the beginning because he always got what he wanted, and maybe that reinforced the problem later on as he grew up. > La verdad Christian es alguien que muchas veces ha tenido que aprender por las malas, si hay un camino con baches y piedras esos son por donde el ha pasado, por el que pasa ahora y hasta por el que pasará. El desde niño siempre ha sido un poco impulsivo y no tiene mucho autocontrol. Esa cualidad de su persona le traería muchos problemas siempre, y su capacidad para maniobrar entre los problemas casi siempre sería un poco mala, aunque no sería le serviría para aprender mucho por el camino. Pero el es el típico que no aprende de los errores y si lo hace a un ritmo muy lento que le da poca maniobra para esquivar los problemas. > Siendo un niño cuando quería algo lo pedía gritando, no quería esperar. Había que correr y llevarle lo que quería de inmediato, sino empezaba un berrinche y a discutir. Quizás no fue bien enseñado en un comienzo porque siempre le daban lo que quería y quizás eso reforzó el problema más adelante cuando fue creciendo.

> ![brooke-cagle-wKOKidNT14w-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23w2gpkHEWjHWY18LQNZwKWN3pBQQuLeLn54bcSVjZheeNzwrb7SjFQYNKGT3czpDfKgt.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) As a teenager in school, he continued with this personality. If he didn't get the best grades, he would argue with his teachers for not giving him a better mark. He lacked the self-control to understand that he was actually the one to blame for not studying more. But there was no way to make him understand. At this point, these traits had caused him various problems, such as reprimands from teachers, warnings not to disrespect them, and many punishments at home for his bad behavior. Although these punishments did little to improve the situation. Reaching adulthood, he channeled his negative feelings into music. Singing truly relieved his stress and gave him a peace he couldn't describe. That's why he decided to become a professional singer. But far from getting rid of his problems, he continued to carry them with him because along with the stress relief came his impulsiveness and lack of self-control, and this was noticeable from the very first moment he started singing. > Siendo un adolecente en la escuela continuó con esta personalidad, si no tenía las mejores notas pues se ponía discutir con su maestros por no haberle dado una mejor nota, no tenía autocontrol para entender que en realidad era el mismo el culpable por no haber estudiado un poco más. Pero bueno, no había forma de hacerlo entender. Esta este punto estas cualidades le habían traído diversos problemas, como llamados de atención por parte de los profesores, advertencias de no faltarle el respeto a ellos, y en su casa muchos castigos por su mala forma. Aunque esos castigos poco arreglaban la situación. > Llegando a la adultez canalizó sus sentimientos negativos con la música, la verdad cantar le quitaba el estrés y le daba un paz que no podía describir. Por eso decidió hacerse un cantante profesional. Pero lejos de librarse de los problemas aún seguida arrastrándolos porque juntos con la perdida de estrés se trajo a su impulsividad y su falta de autocontrol, y esto se notó desde un primer momento cuando empezó a cantar.

> ![divya-agrawal-Q2BGbiLNwDc-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23yTmdqGKRFAA3GLCsGcyzjvm3qdnreRxwtJhhx9FF11p9XMdyUsPfta56cAWwhMDkbeL.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) He wanted to release new songs quickly, without waiting for anyone to review or edit them. He hated being told what to do or having recommendations that involved changing his style or addressing the negative things he said in his songs. So, arguments with music editors were constant. Many production projects were canceled because there was no way to reach an agreement with him. It was an ordeal to maintain any communication with him without ending up arguing. Part of this personality trait translated into the results of his songs. By often ignoring those with knowledge and experience, his rush to release new songs resulted in work that was often mediocre and full of errors and flaws. Ignoring advice caused these problems. Music had started as a relief for him at first, but now it was more stress than anything else, and wherever you looked, it was a series of constant failures. > Quería sacar canciones nuevas rápido, sin tener que esperar que alguien las revisara o las corrigiera, Odiaba que alguien le dijera que tenía que hacer o le recomendara cosas que implicaran cambiar cosas de su estilo o las cosas negativas que decía en las canciones. Así que las discusiones con editores musicales eran contantes. Muchas veces varios proyectos se producción se cancelaron por culpa de que no había forma de ponerse de acuerdo con él. Era una odisea poder mantener cierta comunicación con el sin terminar discutiendo. > Parte de esta forma de ser se tradujo en lo que obtenía gracias a sus canciones. Al muchas veces no tomar en cuenta a los que sabían y tenían experiencias, su apuro por sacar canciones nuevas daban fin un trabajo muchas veces mediocre y lleno de errores y fallas. No escuchar las consejos traía esos problemas. La música comenzó siendo un alivio para el al principio así que ahora era más estrés que otra cosa y por donde quiera que lo miraras eran fracasos constantes.

> ![topsphere-media-iT3aRJ3Jp_s-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tRxoYfx3AxTFefrC5mURDBPFqThHtLbX16QmhhBCuoLBdVBe4BX4neCcWBWUYkLrpWH.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) There was no doubt he had to change, but he only realized it the hard way. Seeing that his life was nothing but a turbulent cycle of stress, largely of his own making, and feeling stuck in a career that wasn't bearing fruit, he was forced to change. So he began trying to cultivate self-control and be less impulsive. But this would be no easy task. Now there's a long road ahead to change, to move forward; it's been a long, bumpy road in the past, in the present, but now, if he wants to, perhaps not in the future. Music has changed his mind; he doesn't want to continue down the path he was on. > No había duda el tenía que cambiar, pero lo reconoció a las malas. Al ver que su vida solo era una turbulencia de estrés causado en gran parte por el mismo, y al verse estancado en una carrera que no daba frutos tuvo que verse obligado a cambiar. Así que comenzó a intentar cultivar el autocontrol y ser menos impulsivo. Pero esta no sería para nada una tarea fácil. Ahora hay mucho camino que recorrer para cambiar, para poder salir adelante, ha sido un camino largo lleno de baches en el pasado, en el presente, pero ahora si el quiere quizás en el futuro no. La música lo ha hecho cambiar de opinión, no quiere seguir yendo por donde iba.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2635).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wMYJ2wMpmT7JK6WZGegKizqjNPjymwwz534u3R5UDdNMySTNsdg32suWqxhqMcGLGiC.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

title: Quiz o PRL-u
body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZc711pVNofTmmd2zrhPXaJ71VqronfPTHaFxRFBw1peR/dfuns_2026_05_02_031629f7a1cee87ae1.jpg)

Zrobienie quizu o PRL-u na 1 maja było całkiem dobrym pomysłem. Przyszło sporo nowych osób. Więcej niż na malowanie. Wszystkie dowiedziały się z Facebooka, a konkretnie z zakładki z wydarzeniami. Łącznie uczestników było 13. Pierwsze miejsce zajął Marcin, który otrzymał magneso-medal z numerem 0002. Na drugim miejscu był Bartek, na trzecim Darek. 

I naszło mnie kilka myśli przy okazji:
- Dobrze byłoby mieć jakiś wzór ustalania nagród. Wczorajsze były dość wysokie 20+15+10, czyli łącznie 45 rycarów. Przy czym ja nic nie wziąłem za organizację, a w przypadku innych quizów trzeba brać pod uwagę aspekt nagradzania organizatorów. W przypadku małej ilości graczy nagroda powinna być tylko dla zwycięscy. 
- Dobrze byłoby zadbać też o to co po quizie, bo sam quiz zwykle nie jest zbyt długi.

title: Estocadas en Movimiento [Esp/Eng]
body:
>

Estocadas en Movimiento. La acción en el tren inferior no se detiene y hoy, tendremos una jornada enfocada a esa zona del cuerpo, a través de la ejecución de una serie de estocadas dinámicas, donde pondremos a prueba gran parte de nuestro ser. Si bien es cierto que las estocadas están dirigidas a la musculatura inferior; también es cierto, que al realizar combinaciones podemos darle acción a otros grupos musculares. En tal sentido; haremos algunas combinaciones para que el núcleo y los brazos estén presentes durante la actividad. Por otra parte; al variar este tipo de movimientos y cambiar la dirección de los mismos, haremos que los músculos se desarrollen de manera integral, además de mejorar considerablemente la movilidad corporal en todos los sentidos. Todo ello sin dejar de lado; que vamos a quemar muchas calorías mientras los brazos, núcleo y piernas están en constante movimiento. Es tiempo de que cambies tu vida y nada mejor que entrenar con los mejores; siempre estamos activos y disponibles para tí. Si deseas una rutina en particular, puedes comentar y en la medida de lo posible te complacemos. >Lunges in Motion. The lower body never stops working, and today we’ll focus on that area through a series of dynamic lunges that will really put us to the test. While lunges primarily target the lower body, performing them in combinations also engages other muscle groups. With that in mind, we’ll do some combinations to ensure that the core and arms are engaged throughout the activity. >On the other hand, by varying these types of movements and changing their direction, we’ll ensure that your muscles develop comprehensively, while also significantly improving your overall mobility. And let’s not forget that you’ll burn plenty of calories while your arms, core, and legs are in constant motion. It’s time to change your life, and there’s nothing better than training with the best; we’re always active and here for you. If you’d like a specific routine, let us know, and we’ll do our best to accommodate you.q

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQxgy7bN4WBKWYgbswBAEPk6pNS36awaJ7cm44b2vrPTB/1777657318443.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **RODILLAZOS FRONTALES CON MOVIMIENTO DE BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de hombros; brazos al frente extendidos a nivel de la cabeza. >[**Warm-up 1**, **FORWARD KNEES WITH ARM MOVEMENTS**]() >[Stance]() >Legs shoulder-width apart; arms extended forward at head level.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCbpvKRJ8q5ESKDrpU4N2DaRsfiWsNMFgHpvyxEspzqg/1777657318554.gif)
[Ejecución]() Durante 3 minutos continuos, propinamos rodillazos frontales alternos y al mismo tiempo, vamos bajando y subiendo los brazos. Al bajar los brazos, estos pasan por cada lado del cuerpo. >[Execution]() >For 3 continuous minutes, we deliver alternating front knee strikes while simultaneously lowering and raising our arms. As we lower our arms, they pass on either side of the body.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmatFUQuJyKBMhYrVeUZu9tyRGzn6EGvNF9hypMrh3Toj5/1777657318672.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **SALTO DE CUERDA CON PAUSA**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados, con codos levemente flexionados y manos empuñadas. >[**Warm-up 2**, **JUMP ROPE WITH A PAUSE**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart; arms at your sides, elbows slightly bent, and hands clenched into fists.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6s3C2J9SZB2i5abFLiUCiNnFEGBjV66KGCmkkvkV9KJ/1777657318921.gif)
[Ejecución]() Comenzamos a girar las muñecas y sin parar; a través de pequeños saltos, vamos elevando las rodillas de forma alterna. Al elevar una rodilla, hacemos una pausa y luego se eleva la otra rodilla. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >We start rotating our wrists continuously; with small jumps, we lift our knees one at a time. When we lift one knee, we pause, and then lift the other knee. 3 minutes of exercise.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFYAXsBveQ3DBH8yxfAhzPKVKxYM7VnTL6PTtke1U6s1/1777657319059.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **ESTOCADAS 360°**]() [Postura]() Ubicamos las piernas con separación al ancho de la cadera; brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Station 1**, **360° LUNGES**]() >[Stance]() >Stand with your feet hip-width apart; arms at your sides, extended downward.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDgBzjrGy6ye5LHiM7oyrqLhvCgZJZG5eejUAg8RYaM7/1777657345429.gif)
[Ejecución]() Sin duda alguna, se realiza un trabajo importante a nivel del núcleo, tren inferior y brazos. Claro está, que aunque la acción predominante se ejerce en el tren inferior; al ejecutar el movimiento quemamos calorías, ganamos control, equilibrio y mucha movilidad. Ahora, para llevar a cabo el movimiento; a través de pequeños saltos, hacemos la estocada girando el cuerpo cada 90°. Es decir; hacemos la estocada al frente, salto y giramos 90° a la derecha para realizar otra estocada y así nos vamos hasta completar un giro completo de 360°; se acompaña la acción con la extensión y flexión de codos. Ejecutamos 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series; cada giro de 90° será una repetición. >[Execution]() >Without a doubt, this exercise works the core, lower body, and arms. Of course, while the lower body does most of the work, performing this movement helps us burn calories, improve control and balance, and increase flexibility. Now, to perform the movement, we take small jumps and do the lunge while rotating our body 90 degrees each time. >In other words, we perform a forward lunge, jump, and turn 90° to the right to perform another lunge, continuing in this manner until we complete a full 360° turn; the movement is accompanied by elbow extensions and flexions. We perform a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets; each 90° turn counts as one repetition.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV28Ra3Y34GMgjexEPfuHoruq3aU7dXcaZezE46B2ECWk/1777657345564.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **ESTOCADAS 180° MÁS GOLPES ALTERNOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera y brazos en posición de combate. >[**Station 2**, **180° LUNGES WITH ALTERNATING STRIKES**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart and arms in a fighting stance.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMZscPey7Z6tSHRYubrh3Vq9tHxGUKgsUfzaFtXdFFCw/1777657345807.gif)
[Ejecución]() Un ejercicio muy dinámico que hará explotar todo el núcleo y el resto del tren inferior. Los brazos trabajan en segundo plano. Para ejecutar el movimiento; a través de un salto nos vamos hacia cualquiera de los dos lados, caemos en estocada y damos un golpe con el brazo opuesto a ese lado. Por ejemplo; si giramos a la izquierda, caemos en estocada y damos el golpe con el brazo derecho; la pierna derecha queda atrás. Con un salto hacemos un giro de 180° para irnos a la derecha, estocada y golpe con brazo izquierdo. Realizamos 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >A very dynamic exercise that will really work your core and the rest of your lower body. Your arms work in the background. To perform the movement, jump to either side, land in a lunge, and strike out with the arm on the opposite side. >For example, if we turn to the left, step forward into a lunge, and strike with our right arm, our right leg remains behind. With a jump, we turn 180° to move to the right, step forward into a lunge, and strike with our left arm. We perform a total of 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbfFZJjXA4jDgCCcRqu92xcL66kctX6KCzMCvtMGVCZxk/1777657345952.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **ESTOCADA ALTERNA MÁS SENTADILLA EN SALTO**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos al frente. >[**Station 3**, **ALTERNATING LUNGES WITH JUMP SQUATS**]() >[Starting Position]() >Feet hip-width apart; elbows bent with arms held in front of you.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeUUxxWc1eKVLCoaeTiwrERfn4G5Zu5XVRuvUpPjoS45A/1777657362558.gif)
[Ejecución]() Definitivamente, que hemos hecho explotar todo el tren inferior; trabajo importante para el núcleo. Puro poder y control corporal. Para ejecutar el movimiento; a través de pequeños saltos, hacemos la estocada alterna; ambas piernas trabajan. Luego; un pequeño salto para volver a la posición inicial, abrir piernas y realizar la sentadilla en salto. Nos vamos con 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >We’ve definitely worked our lower body to the max—this is a great core workout. It’s all about power and body control. To perform the movement, we do alternating lunges using small jumps, engaging both legs. Then, we take a small jump to return to the starting position, spread our legs, and perform a jump squat. We’ll do a total of 20 reps across 4 sets.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb5SjxQjygPTqg5D9CHqNPxoXjr9egYUxbuctTtmfd574/1777657362683.gif)
[**Relajación**, **ELEVACIÓN ALTERNA DE RODILLAS CON GIRO**]() [Postura]() De pie, con piernas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos al frente. >[**Relaxation**, **ALTERNATING KNEE LIFTS WITH TWIST**]() >[Posture]() >Stand with your feet hip-width apart; elbows bent, arms in front of you.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRcJwMKoDNBu2GkDUXJ5PFeWniYLuFXERLhtrWTEShKX/1777657362954.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, elevamos las rodillas de forma alterna y las giramos hacia atrás; se acompaña la acción con el movimiento de brazos. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; during 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, we lift our knees one at a time and rotate them backward; this movement is accompanied by arm movements.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPhkFtTZTCthaunJ4G8FPMMwrv8VdZJPiRUx1NZpS3v9j/1777657363098.gif)

body: The TV rights gap between EPL and everyone else is worth framing as a liquidity concentration problem, not just a revenue story. At £123M average guaranteed vs £56M for La Liga, you're not just talking about more money -- you're talking about a floor that changes what kind of financial risk clubs can absorb. A mid-table EPL club can sustain wages and transfer fees that would bankrupt a comparable La Liga or Serie A operation. That floor is what makes the talent concentration self-reinforcing.\n\nThe profit paradox you're describing -- massive revenues, chronic losses -- is what you'd expect from any system where the competition for inputs (players, managers, agents) is intense enough to absorb all available margin. The \

is being extracted upstream: agents, intermediaries, and the few clubs that net sell rather than buy. The operating clubs themselves are largely just passing revenue through to the labor market and calling it football.\n\nThe structural break-even point being 5-10 years away assumes costs stop growing. I'm not sure that holds if the AI-driven scouting and data analysis arms race accelerates wage expectations further. Still watching whether the UEFA FFP revisions actually change anything or just shift the accounting.

body:
300K HP puts you in an interesting position on the distribution curve -- high enough that your votes actually shift outcomes, but below the threshold where a single account can unilaterally determine visibility. That middle range, roughly 100K to 1M HP, is probably where the most useful curation happens: engaged enough to have developed taste, not so dominant that you can override community signal.

The HPUD framing is interesting because it treats HP accumulation as a community ritual rather than just a financial decision. Whether that framing actually changes behavior or just correlates with people who were already committed is hard to separate. But the consistency signal matters regardless -- accounts that show up on HPUD for multiple years are implicitly demonstrating a time horizon that's longer than most.

The \

question from the title is the one I'd sit with. At 300K, the next meaningful threshold isn't just a number -- it's whether the HP starts generating enough curation influence to attract the kind of engagement that compounds the position further. Worth tracking whether your vote weight is now in the range where top authors start noticing.

body: The web2 login funnel makes sense strategically -- lower the entry barrier first, then surface the Hive reputation/rewards advantage as an upgrade path. The \

framing is well-timed given where AI content saturation is heading. That's a problem most web2 users already feel without being able to name it.

The persistence question I'd push on: what stops a coordinated actor -- media company, political campaign, or well-funded community -- from flooding Scout slots with aligned annotations once the system is live at web2 scale? Hive accounts have skin in the game through staked HP. Web2 logins don't carry the same cost structure.

That's not a reason to avoid web2 login -- it's actually the right growth path. But the slashing/reputation mechanism probably needs to be tuned differently for the two user types. A Hive account losing curation reputation is a meaningful cost; a web2 throwaway losing the same costs nothing.

Curious how the staking design handles that asymmetry.

title: Cocinar con amor, incluso cuando no hay nada ESP/ENG
body:
Espanish 🇪🇦
Cocinar con amor, incluso cuando no hay nada
Hoy quiero hablar de algo que, aunque parezca sencillo, para mí es muy grande: cocinarle a mi hijo.
No es solo hacer comida. Es inventar, resolver, crear… con lo poquito que tengo.
A mí me encanta cocinarle. Me gusta sentarme a pensar: ¿qué le hago hoy?!![IMG20260501082547.jpg](4)
Y aunque muchas veces la respuesta no viene de una despensa llena, sino de lo que apareció ese día, siempre intento que su platito sea bonito, rico y, sobre todo, hecho con amor.
El otro día, por ejemplo, no tenía casi nada. No había leche, no había muchos ingredientes… pero tenía ganas.
Y con eso basta muchas veces.
Agarré un huevito, un platanito maduro, unos pedacitos de pan y un chorreadito de leche condensada que me quedaba… y le inventé un flancito.
Su carita cuando lo probó… eso no tiene precio.
En las mañanas trato de que desayune bien:
un poquito de queso con galletas integrales, su huevito hervido… cosas sencillas, pero que lo alimenten. Porque yo sí tengo claro algo:
un niño que come bien, crece sano y fuerte.
Y en mi casa, la prioridad es él.
Nosotros, los adultos, resolvemos como podemos.
A veces es un pan con croqueta, a veces un arroz solo…
pero su comida no puede faltar.
Porque ser madre aquí, en Cuba, es también aprender a sacrificarte sin pensarlo dos veces.
Aquí cocinar no es solo cocinar… es sobrevivir, es inventar todos los días. Muchas familias viven así, resolviendo la comida diaria con lo que aparezca, adaptándose a la escasez constante �.
Hay días en que simplemente se trata de que el niño coma, aunque uno no lo haga.
casapalanca +1
Y aun así… seguimos.
A mí me encanta pasar el día con él. Verlo reír, verlo feliz… eso me llena.
Y también me encanta cocinarle a mi esposo, porque la cocina es una de mis formas de amar.
Pero no voy a mentir:
hay días en que abrir la cocina duele.
Duele porque quieres hacer más, quieres inventar más…
pero no tienes con qué.
Y ese es uno de los grandes problemas que vivimos:
las ganas están… la creatividad está… pero los ingredientes no.
Aun así, con lo poco que tengo, trato de hacerlo lo mejor posible.
Que sea sano. Que esté bien hecho. Que tenga amor.
Porque al final, no es la cantidad lo que alimenta…
es la intención, el cuidado y el amor que uno pone en cada plato.
Y yo, mientras pueda, voy a seguir inventando.
Por él. Siempre por él. 💛

English 🇬🇧
Cooking with love, even when there’s nothing
Today I want to talk about something that might seem simple, but for me, it’s very meaningful: cooking for my son.
It’s not just about making food. It’s about creating, improvising, and making something out of very little.
I truly love cooking for him. I like to sit and think: what can I make for him today?
And even though the answer doesn’t come from a full pantry, but from whatever I managed to find that day, I always try to make his plate beautiful, tasty, and most of all, made with love.
The other day, for example, I barely had anything. No milk, no real ingredients… but I had the desire.
And sometimes, that’s enough.
I took one egg, a ripe banana, some small pieces of bread, and a little splash of condensed milk I had left… and I made him a little flan.
The look on his face when he tasted it… that’s priceless.
In the mornings, I try to make sure he has a good breakfast:
a bit of cheese with whole grain crackers, a boiled egg… simple things, but nourishing. Because I truly believe something:
a child who eats well grows healthy and strong.
And in my home, he is the priority.
We, the adults, manage however we can.
Sometimes it’s just bread with a croquette, sometimes plain rice…
but his meals can’t be missing.
Because being a mother here, in Cuba, also means learning to sacrifice without even thinking twice.
Here, cooking isn’t just cooking… it’s surviving, it’s inventing something every single day.
There are days when it’s simply about making sure your child eats, even if you don’t.
And still… we keep going.
I love spending the day with him. Watching him laugh, seeing him happy… that fills me.
And I also love cooking for my husband, because cooking is one of the ways I show love.
But I won’t lie:
there are days when stepping into the kitchen hurts.
It hurts because you want to do more, create more…
but you don’t have the ingredients.
And that’s one of the biggest struggles we face:
the desire is there… the creativity is there… but the resources are not.
Even so, with what little I have, I try to do my best.
To make it healthy. To make it well prepared. To make it with love.
Because in the end, it’s not the quantity that nourishes…
it’s the intention, the care, and the love you put into every plate.
And as long as I can, I will keep creative 
For him. Always for him!![IMG20260501082547.jpg](1)

# [EN] This past weekend, my wife celebrated another birthday. We kept the celebration low-key this time, inviting only our closest family members, so we wouldn’t let this special day go unnoticed. In the end, what matters is being happy and living each day as if there were no tomorrow. It feels like just yesterday that I met my wife, but on this journey, it’s already been almost 12 years between dating, engagement, and marriage. Time flies by too quickly, which is why it’s important to live every moment with joy and gratitude. She completes me with her joy and intensity, while I’m more reserved and analytical in what I do and say. I think it’s really true when they say opposites attract! Even with just a few guests, the anniversary was very lively. And that’s what matters: being happy with what God blesses us with, whether it’s a little or a lot. Happy anniversary, my love! It’s your anniversary, but I’m the one who received the greatest gift: you ❤️ ---- # [PT] Nesse último final de semana, minha esposa celebrou mais um ano de vida. No fim, o que importa é ser feliz e viver cada dia como se não houvesse amanhã. Parece que foi ontem que conheci minha esposa, mas nessa jornada já se vão quase 12 anos entre namoro, noivado e casamento. O tempo passa rápido demais, por isso é importante viver cada momento com alegria e gratidão. Ela me completa com sua alegria e intensidade, enquanto eu sou mais reservado e analítico no que faço e falo. Acho que é verdade mesmo quando dizem que os opostos se atraem! Mesmo com poucos convidados, o aniversário foi muito animado. E é isso que importa: ser feliz com aquilo que Deus nos abençoa, seja no pouco ou no muito. Parabéns, meu amor! O aniversário é seu, mas quem ganhou o maior presente fui eu: você ❤️ --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@elderdark/en-pt-happy-birthday-to-her)
