body.title: A walk with my brother around some of the city’s most iconic spots. | Un paseo con mi hermano por algunos de los lugares más emblemáticos de la ciudad.
body.body:
> **Gratos saludos tengan todos mis queridos amigos de esta comunidad hermosa de Family&Friends es un placer para mi saludarles en este viernes.** >**Warm greetings to all my dear friends in this wonderful Family&Friends community; it is a pleasure to greet you all on this Friday.** Siempre andando en la búqueda de visitar los lugares emblemáticos con gran historia en la ciudad de Maracaibo, y es por eso que mi hermano Alcides es el mejor amigos de aventuras para esto, porque particularmente no sé por qué pero de un tiempo para acá, me ha dado mucho miedo salir yo sola a tomar la fotografías para mostrarles a ustedes estos lugares. >I’m always on the go, seeking out the city’s iconic landmarks steeped in history, and that’s why my brother Alcides is the perfect adventure buddy for this because, for some reason I can’t quite put my finger on, I’ve recently become really scared of going out on my own to take photos to show you these places. Es por eso que siempre trato de que mi hermano menor Alcides, me pueda acompañar y yo no sentirme tan sola es por eso que cada vez que salgo le pido que me haga el favor de acompañarme mayormente, trato de economizar mucho el pasaje, por lo que tengo que caminar varios kilómetros y él sin duda alguna, me acompaña para poder así minimizar los gastos y también poder recorrer los lugares de manera más satisfectoria y cumplir con el objetivo que me planteo cada vez que voy a uno de estos. >That’s why I always try to get my younger brother Alcides to come with me, so I don’t feel so alone. That’s why, whenever I go out, I ask him to do me the favour of coming with me most of the time. I try to save as much as possible on transport, which means I have to walk several kilometres, and he, without a doubt, accompanies me so that we can minimise expenses and also explore the places more thoroughly and achieve the goal I set myself every time I visit one of these. ![Collage de fotos horizontal Feliz San Valentín Sencillo Blanco y negro_20260501_102534_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbeNMj91CFK2PqrNsFVL2y75L4h41NHJBu1RxEmm9QR77/Collage%20de%20fotos%20horizontal%20Feliz%20San%20Valent%C3%ADn%20Sencillo%20Blanco%20y%20negro_20260501_102534_0000.png) --- Inicialmente, nuestro primer punto de recorrer fueron los famosos cepillados de Jesús ríos, los cuales tienen más de 100 años funcionando, a pesar de que estos cepillados estaba cerrados y su sitio original se encuentra en remodelación, pudimos tomar algunas fotografías por afuera contemplar el lugar, así como también pasar justamente por el nuevo lugar en donde ahora funciona. El establecimiento de los cepillados, que es justamente al frente mi hermano estaba sorprendido con la arquitectura de estos lugares, ya que son bastantes antiguos y reflejan a la Maracaibo de antaño. >Our first stop was the famous Jesús Ríos barbershops, which have been in business for over 100 years. Although these barbershops were closed and their original premises are currently being refurbished, we were able to take some photos from outside and have a look around, as well as pop into the new premises where they are now operating. The planing mills, which are right opposite, left my brother amazed by the architecture of these buildings, as they are quite old and reflect the Maracaibo of yesteryear. ![20260418_085406.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVtuhdJEmYaqRnaSzxa3MhB4AU48eMtdPvKYcNgN4nnwo/20260418_085406.jpg) ![20260418_085407.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRTBWx6bxCtV5jicJtajzBLrAcChtgz1515Bax9TzUgfJ/20260418_085407.jpg) ![20260418_085411.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcA5grBmSL1zuLKJMT4fb7R7gV5whYUr4aZqX9EfszBWr/20260418_085411.jpg) ![20260418_085414.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeXyJqKPTMkdmKCJgwAa4q1dNngQXLADk3Jv1ax5BEJ5i/20260418_085414.jpg) ![20260418_090054.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYF98kgTrQn6mtda3ta3PADjGbAZgyZVtZ1QjhCZYrZsY/20260418_090054.jpg) --- Cada vez resalta que a veces no todo es fácil y sencillo, ya que muchas veces tengo que convencer a mi hermano a que me acompañe, ya que a veces no quiere levantarse muy temprano, por la mañana, por qué tiende a mayormente levantarse muy tarde, pero cuando no logra levantarse temprano y no me puede acompañar, trato de no salir porque tiende a darme bastante miedo luego de ver estos cepillados, nos fuimos hacia una de las avenidas más importantes de Maracaibo, como lo es la avenida de bella vista para poder ir hacia la bomba mi Munich la cual tiene más de 114 años funcionando y en la actualidad esta estación de servicio todavía funciona. >It’s becoming increasingly clear that things aren’t always easy and straightforward, as I often have to persuade my brother to come with me, since he sometimes doesn’t want to get up very early in the morning—he tends to get up quite late, but when he can’t get up early and can’t come with me, I try not to go out because I tend to get quite scared after seeing these beggars. We headed towards one of Maracaibo’s main avenues, namely Avenida de Bella Vista, to go to the ‘Mi Munich’ petrol station, which has been in operation for over 114 years and is still in business today. ![20260418_091251.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUAbyx5UkTuFK9gT7eu5X6ZziwxnoiQ3fp6BoSf65eQ8U/20260418_091251.jpg) ![20260418_085417.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQP9oCPAGiAJ7MifRSPYVXArcoEzCouqZNis1aPoyTmqZ/20260418_085417.jpg) ![20260418_084720.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYkjRTponQkDy4xKjMDRCnEUsVGv84MzbNJAGxqDnUT36/20260418_084720.jpg) ![20260418_084015.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfHLyM31mqdH67k3p4UDHuTBVXjff8cjLn9SvdnGWWvsK/20260418_084015.jpg) --- Por último me despido hasta una próxima oportunidad simplemente fue un gran gusto compartir con ustedes este momento con mi hermano, sin duda alguna siempre es bueno salir y salir recorridos con nuestra familia, espero les haya gustado mucho esta publicación me despido hasta una próxima oportunidad mis queridos amigos. >Finally, I’ll say goodbye until next time. It was simply a great pleasure to share this moment with you and my brother. Without a doubt, it’s always lovely to get out and about with our family. I hope you’ve really enjoyed this post. I’ll say goodbye until next time, my dear friends. ![20260418_083111.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeNWv3NMtA21Vwhzyy4zCZS22GoUwgpNAnjAkxvy7yPH/20260418_083111.jpg) ![20260418_083110.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP19DxrLssxaJovuJhaBq4i1AuFqM5E52RM5z2zmuWEAC/20260418_083110.jpg)

body.title: My Progress on Hive | Monthly Report #003 [ENG/SPA]
body.body: >\n\nHello, Hivers and Lions. As you probably already know, today is May 1st. So, just as I’ve done in previous months, today I’m sharing my Monthly Progress Report on Hive. In this post, I’ll talk about all the milestones I’ve achieved this past April. I’m excited because I’ve reached a couple of goals I set for myself in my last

>Monthly Report. However, I feel I still have a long way to go to reach my main goal on Hive. As I mentioned last month, I’m really sorry I didn’t start writing these reports much earlier. Especially during my first year on Hive, given everything I’ve accomplished since then. There are several periods during my two years on Hive that I wish I had analyzed better and in more detail in a report like this so that I could compare them with other periods when things didn’t go as well for me, such as late last year and early this year.

>
Hola, Hivers y Lions. Como ya deben de saber, hoy es primero de mayo. Así que, como se ha hecho en meses anteriores, hoy les traigo mi Reporte Mensual de mi Progreso en Hive. En esta publicación les hablaré de todos los logros que he conseguido en este pasado mes de abril. Estoy emocionado ya que he alcanzado un par de metas que me he propuesto en mi pasado

>Reporte Mensual. Sin embargo, considero que aún me falta mucho para alcanzar mi objetivo principal en Hive. Como ya les he contado el mes pasado, siento mucho no haberme propuesto hacer estos reportes mucho tiempo antes. Sobre todo en mi primer año en Hive debido a todo lo que he logrado desde entonces hasta ahora. Hay varias épocas en mis dos años ya en Hive que desearía haber analizado mejor y más detalladamente en un reporte como este para así poderlo comparar con otras épocas en las que no me fue tan bien, como lo fue a finales del año pasado y principios de este año.

> But anyway, this isn’t the time to dwell on the past; it’s time to set new goals, achieve new milestones, and multiply our earnings on Hive. Especially now that the price of $HIVE hasn’t managed to stay above $0.06. Now that it’s hovering around $0.05, it’s the PERFECT time to be more active than ever and earn rewards on Hive. I say this because the lower the value of Hive’s native token, the more tokens you receive as rewards. What people are saying now—that “there’s no money in Hive”—is completely false, and I can confirm this from my own experience. There are still projects up and running, there are still curators and whales curating and rewarding, and there are still active and growing communities. Nothing has changed since the beginning of this year and the last $HIVE all-time high. In fact, everything is more active than ever, as this phase—so momentous and unprecedented in Hive—has motivated many to create and do incredible things.

>
Pero bueno, no es momento de lamentarse por cosas del pasado, es momento de alcanzar nuevas metas, nuevos logros y multiplicar nuestras ganancias en Hive. Sobre todo ahora que el precio del $HIVE no ha conseguido mantenerse en los $0,06 centavos. Ahora que se encuentra entre los $0,05 centavos es un momento PERFECTO para ser más activo que nunca y conseguir recompensas en Hive. Esto lo digo porque, a menor valor de la moneda nativa de Hive, mayor cantidad de monedas recibes en recompensas. Eso que dice la gente ahora de que “no hay plata en Hive” es completamente falso y lo puedo corroborar con mi propia experiencia. Aún hay proyectos funcionando y trabajando, aún hay curadores y ballenas curando y recompensando y aún hay comunidades activas y en crecimiento. Nada ha cambiado desde principios de este año y el último ATL de $HIVE. Es más, todo sigue más activo que nunca ya que esta etapa -tan trascendental y nunca antes vista en Hive- ha motivado a muchos a poder crear y hacer cosas increíbles.

> One of those “incredible things”—as it might seem to many—is for a user like me to become a Dolphin on Hive this year. That’s one of my biggest medium- to long-term goals. I set this goal for myself at the beginning of this year, and right now I feel like I have a better chance of achieving it. But to do this, I have to redouble my efforts and multiply my rewards to get a result that helps me reach that goal. However, let’s just say that for now, I’m not that far off. As you can see above, on May 1st, I reached exactly 3,500 HP. This was one of the goals I set for myself in the April monthly report. With this amount of HP, I feel like we’re halfway there to reaching the dream total of 6,200 HP and officially becoming a Dolphin on Hive. But to do that, I still need about 2,700 HP, which I feel I can achieve this year, provided I don’t lose the momentum I’ve been building lately, of course.

>
Una de esas “cosas increíbles” que pueden llegar a parecer para muchos, es que un usuario como yo logre conseguir ser Delfin en Hive en este año. Esa es una de mis mayores metas a mediano/largo plazo. Dicha meta me la he propuesto a principios de este año y ahora mismo siento que tengo más posibilidades de alcanzarla. Pero para esto tengo que redoblar esfuerzos y multiplicar mis recompensas para obtener un resultado que me ayude a alcanzar dicho objetivo. Sin embargo, digamos que por el momento no estoy tan lejos. Como pueden llegar a ver arriba, justamente este primero de mayo logré la justa cantidad de 3500 HP. Esta era una de las metas que me propuse en el pasado reporte mensual de abril. Ya con esta cantidad de HP siento que estamos a mitad del camino para lograr la soñada cantidad de 6200 HP y así conseguir ser Delfín de manera oficial en Hive. Pero para esto aún me faltan como 2700 HP, cosa que siento que puedo conseguirlo este mismo año, si es que no pierdo el ritmo que he estado teniendo últimamente, claro.

> Another goal I set for myself last month was to reach 71.5 Reputation. And yes, we’ve easily reached that number, even though I had a less active week this month due to the “TOPs” posts I publish quarterly, which take up a lot of my time. As I write this, my Reputation stands at 71.54, which is excellent. So, yes, we’re also halfway to reaching 72 Reputation. If I achieve that this May, the next step will be to reach 73 Reputation by July or August.

>
Otra de las metas que me propuse el mes pasado fue la de conseguir los 71.5 de Reputación. Y si, también hemos alcanzado fácilmente dicha cantidad, aún cuando tuve una semana no tan activa en este mes debido a las publicaciones de “TOPs” que hago trimestralmente y que me consumen mucho tiempo. A la hora de escribir esto, mi Reputación está en 71.54, lo cual es excelente. Así que, si, también estamos a mitad del camino para lograr los 72 de Reputación. Si lo consigo en este mes de mayo, ya lo siguiente será conseguir los 73 de Reputación para julio o agosto.

> Oh, and as has become customary lately, I also did my monthly Power Up today to participate in the well-known Hive Power Up Day. This time, I only staked 18 HIVE because I wanted to reach 3,500 HP. I don’t usually participate in these events, but HPUD is different because I see it as a sign of commitment and growth on Hive. Obviously, this doesn’t make a huge difference, especially since my KE is still 1.86, but with this post and the future Snaps and Comments that I plan to share 100% in HP, I hope to lower it a bit this month.

>
Ah, y como ya se ha vuelto costumbre últimamente, hoy también hice mi Power Up mensual para así participar en el conocido Hive Power Up Day. Esta vez solo coloqué en ahorros (Stake) 18 HIVE debido a que quería completar los 3500 HP. Normalmente no participo en estos eventos, pero el HPUD es diferente ya que lo siento como una muestra de compromiso y crecimiento en Hive. Obviamente, esto no hace una gran diferencia, sobre todo en mi KE que sigue siendo de 1.86, pero con esta publicación y los futuros Snaps y Comentarios que pienso compartir al 100% en HP, pienso reducirlo un poco este mes.

> Aside from minimizing my account’s KE as much as possible this month with Snaps—thanks to the latest hSnaps update from @sagarkothari88, which now lets me set them to 100% HP—I also plan to do the same with comments. Regarding this, I’ll only be able to comment on PeakD since it’s the only platform where I can configure my comments to be 100% HP. But if Sagar decides to add this feature to the hReplies app soon, it would be a huge help, honestly. Another advantage hSnaps gives me is the ability to share not only Snaps, but also Threads (InLeo), Waves (Encency), and Moments (Liketu). So I plan to be more active sharing short content on these different platforms throughout the month of May. Another thing I wanted to tell you, now that I’ve mentioned InLeo, is that I recently managed to pay for InLeo Premium. So I hope that Premium helps me achieve my goals this month, in addition to getting better benefits and the occasional reward, maybe.

>
Aparte de reducir lo más posible el KE de mi cuenta este mes con los Snaps, gracias a la más reciente actualización de hSnaps de @sagarkothari88 que me permite ahora colocarlos al 100% en HP, pienso también hacer lo mismo con los comentarios. Respecto a esto solo podré comentar por PeakD debido a que es el único medio donde puedo configurar mis comentarios para que sean 100% en HP. Pero si Sagar decide pronto añadir esta función también en la App de hReplies, sería de mucha ayuda, la verdad. Otra ventaja que me da hSnaps es la posibilidad de, no solo compartir Snaps, sino también Threads (InLeo), Waves (Encency) y Moments (Liketu). Así que tengo pensado ser más activo compartiendo contenido corto en estos diferentes Front's durante este mes de mayo. Otra cosa que quería decirles, ahora que mencioné a InLeo, es que hace poco logré pagar el InLeo Premium. Así que espero que dicho Premium me ayude a lograr mis objetivos en este mes, además de conseguir mejores beneficios y una que otra recompensa, tal vez.

> As for my goals for this month of May, I plan to first reach 4,000 HP, as well as finally hit 72 Reputation. Also, if possible, by June I should have a KE of less than 1.8. Another thing I’d like to achieve this May is 200 followers on Hive. Previously, I didn’t place much importance on this, as I prioritized having followers who were active, well-known, and/or fellow niche members on Hive. But this time I want to change that and plan to expand my social circle further. After all, we’re talking about a social ecosystem like Hive, so this really should be one of my main goals. Despite the current situation with the price of $HIVE, the decline, and the changes to the reward system on Hive, there are still active users and even new users who share and thrive here. So, as a user who’s been on Hive for over two years now, it’s my duty to guide them through this vast ecosystem as well. Let’s hope for better days on Hive, so let’s not lose momentum and stay active.

>
En cuanto a mis objetivos, para este mes de mayo, pienso conseguir primero los 4000 en HP, además de alcanzar al fin los 72 de Reputación. También, si es posible, ya para el mes de junio debería tener menos de 1.8 de KE. Otra cosa que me gustaría conseguir este mes de mayo son los 200 seguidores en Hive. Anteriormente no le daba mucha importancia a esto ya que priorizaba más que cada usuario que me siguiera fuese activo, conocido y/o compañero de nicho en Hive. Pero esta vez quiero cambiar eso y pienso expandir más mi círculo social. Al fin y al cabo, estamos hablando de un ecosistema social como lo es Hive, así que esto debe de ser uno de mis principales objetivos, la verdad. A pesar de la situación que hay con el precio de $HIVE, la disminución y el cambio en el sistema de recompensas en Hive; siguen habiendo usuarios activos y hasta usuarios nuevos que comparten y hacen vida en este lugar. Así que, como un usuario con más de dos años ya en Hive es mi deber el guiarlos también en este enorme ecosistema. Esperemos mejores días en Hive, así que no perdamos el ritmo y mantengámonos activos.

>
So, well, that's all for today. See you in the next monthly report.

>
Así que, bueno, eso sería todo por hoy. Nos vemos en el siguiente reporte mensual.

# Chasing Sunsets: My Journey Through National Parks at Golden Hour

There's something magical about the golden hour—the time just before sunset when the world is bathed in warm, golden hues. As an avid hiker and traveler, I've made it my mission to chase sunsets across some of the most breathtaking national parks in the United States. Join me as I recount my adventures and share tips for capturing those unforgettable moments.

## The Allure of the Golden Hour

The golden hour is more than just a photographer's dream; it's a time when nature reveals its true beauty. The soft light transforms landscapes, enhances colors, and creates shadows that add depth to every scene. Whether you're standing on a mountain summit or gazing across a tranquil lake, the experience is nothing short of awe-inspiring.

## My Favorite National Parks for Sunset Chasing

### 1. **Yosemite National Park, California**

Yosemite is a haven for sunset seekers. One of my favorite spots is Glacier Point, where you can witness the sun setting behind the iconic Half Dome. The view is breathtaking, and the changing colors of the granite cliffs are a sight to behold. Arriving early to secure a good spot is key, as this location can get crowded.

### 2. **Grand Canyon National Park, Arizona**

The Grand Canyon is a classic sunset destination. Watching the sun dip below the horizon, casting vibrant shades of orange and red across the canyon walls, is an experience I’ll never forget. Hopi Point is a fantastic vantage point, and I recommend bringing a blanket to sit on while you soak in the view.

### 3. **Zion National Park, Utah**

Zion's towering cliffs provide a stunning backdrop for sunset photography. The view from Canyon Junction is particularly spectacular, where the last rays of sunlight illuminate the Watchman. I suggest hiking the shorter trails earlier in the day to ensure you have plenty of time to find the perfect spot for sunset.

### 4. **Acadia National Park, Maine**

For those on the East Coast, Acadia offers an incredible sunrise and sunset experience. Cadillac Mountain is the first place to see the sunrise in the U.S., but the sunset views are equally impressive. The rocky coastline paired with the vibrant sky creates a picturesque scene that is worth the hike.

### 5. **Badlands National Park, South Dakota**

The unique rock formations of Badlands National Park come alive during sunset. The play of light and shadow across the rugged terrain is mesmerizing. I recommend the Pinnacles Overlook for a panoramic view that captures the essence of the Badlands at dusk.

## Tips for Chasing Sunsets

- **Plan Ahead**: Research the best viewpoints and arrive early to secure your spot. Check sunset times and weather conditions to ensure optimal viewing.
  
- **Bring the Right Gear**: A good camera or smartphone is essential for capturing those golden moments. Don't forget a tripod for steady shots and a blanket for comfort.

- **Stay Safe**: Hiking in the dark can be tricky, so always carry a flashlight or headlamp for your return journey. Familiarize yourself with the trails during the day.

- **Be Patient**: Sometimes, the best moments happen when you least expect them. Take your time, breathe in the beauty around you, and enjoy the experience.

## Conclusion

Chasing sunsets through national parks has brought me closer to nature and provided some of the most memorable moments of my travels. Each sunset is unique, a reminder of the beauty that surrounds us. So, pack your bags, grab your camera, and embark on your own sunset-chasing adventure. Who knows what breathtaking views await you?

Happy hiking! 🌅

body.title: A Perfect Chilly Morning
body.body:
During this morning walk, I still found a few raindrops resting on the leaves. They were not as dense as yesterday, but they were still enough to catch my attention. I figured it was another good chance to take more photos before the sunlight and breeze slowly removed them from the surface. ![IMG20260502072600.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcjeibLLukDwYMrVDm7vsC1YJmVQh1sKkyBAnK9vLQoXU/IMG20260502072600.jpg) I like how these droplets look in black and white. Without the distraction of colors, the shape of the leaf, the fine lines, and the shiny surface of the water become more noticeable. The droplets may be fewer this time, but they still created a quiet kind of beauty. Sometimes, even a small detail is enough to make a photo interesting. This morning also felt really pleasant. Thanks to the heavy rain yesterday, the air was cooler and less humid. There was a steady breeze that made the walk more comfortable. I would say it was a perfect morning, the kind that makes you feel calm and grateful without needing anything extraordinary to happen. I guess life is also like this sometimes. The big moments may pass, but there are still small traces left behind for us to appreciate. Yesterday’s rain may be gone, but the droplets on the leaves reminded me that something beautiful can remain even after a strong downpour. We don’t always need a grand scene to feel inspired. Sometimes, all it takes is a quiet morning, a few raindrops, and the willingness to slow down and notice what is still there. Have a good day ahead. *** ![IMG20260502072600.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcjeibLLukDwYMrVDm7vsC1YJmVQh1sKkyBAnK9vLQoXU/IMG20260502072600.jpg) ![IMG20260502072612.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXNbMGA5w82UZgLhZg6XEtK1Q5GtKg9FApMzvAVM1FpV8/IMG20260502072612.jpg) ![IMG20260502072622.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSuqsHfuDVCjzxcCShWZcNfvKizJ44Yfi76KHt3BjfMas/IMG20260502072622.jpg) ![IMG20260502072631.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaPYP2XXjmVk6rWYsJ98dMWRf35JYP7v8qKonmNPbMt93/IMG20260502072631.jpg) ***

”To see in color is a delight for the eye, but to see in black and white is delight for the soul.”

*~ Andri Cauldwell*

In this section we show you how to become a Signal Miner / Signal Scout.  These valueable parts of the eco system will mine rewards for adding signal to existing information on web2 and web3.  There are 3 main Bookmarklets:
1) Thoughts on chain - catching a single piece of content and bringing it into the system
2) Enrich Profile Sources - Add alternative sources into the profile of a creator, for example, if they have a youtube channel, a twitter account, an instagram account, then you can use this tool to more easily bring these sources into the eco system.  this then imporves the feed of the creator in the signal inbox.
3) Catch Content - visit a creator's web2 source such as their youtube channel and click the bookmarklet to import many items of their content into the system at the same time. If you catch such content soon after it is uploaded to the ecosystem, then you will earn additional rewards and credits in the eco system.  The best signal is prompt, accurate, relevant and causes conversation.

body.title: Ley del Hámster ¿La has oído?
body.body:
Cuando ves a un hámster domesticado Te darás cuenta que lo mantienen en una jaula más una rueda para que él allí pueda correr y bajar los niveles de estrés. Así mismo suele ser el ser humano, nos programaron para estudiar hasta llegar a la universidad graduarnos y conseguir un trabajo, manteniéndonos ahí hasta por más de 30 años y alcanzar una jubilación, una jubilación con la que todavía no sentimos realmente ese júbilo porque la gran mayoría termina con exceso de cansancio y sin poder tener libertad financiera. Es decir nos han metido en nuestras creencias el tener que correr constantemente en esa Rueda sin poder sentir que realmente avanzamos crecemos Y en especial sentirnos libres. Así que si esta información te hace resonar en tu corazón y en tu mente déjame decirte entonces que tú mismo eres la llave para abrir esa jaula y empezar a ser libre, desapégate de la necesidad y arriésgate a alcanzar tus sueños. Ya casi acaba el día y me estoy preparando para salir a bailar por mi cumpleaños, honestamente odio cumplir años pero me hice estas fotos para conmemorar un año mas de vida.

La vida es difícil pero a medida que conocemos mas resulta un poco menos difícil, cumplir años no me gusta debido a que siento que no estoy donde quisiera a mi edad, tengo 36 años y siento que debí lograr mejores cosas pero aquí sigo, luchando por alcanzar mi sueño y ser feliz a mi manera.

The landscape of digital finance has undergone a fundamental systemic shift. According to the latest on-chain data and market reports from early 2026, crypto card spending experienced an explosive growth of 525% throughout 2025. This surge represents more than just a trend; it signifies a structural integration of blockchain technology into the global payment lattice.

The core driver of this anomaly in growth is the convergence of stablecoins and traditional payment infrastructure. While cryptocurrencies were historically viewed as speculative \
assets, the data now shows they are being spent \

at an unprecedented scale. Annualized spending via cards linked to digital assets has climbed to approximately $18 billion, a figure that rivals traditional P2P transfer volumes.

The Stablecoin Engine
Evidence indicates that stablecoins, specifically USDT and USDC, accounted for nearly 100% of the collateral deposited for these spending programs. This shift suggests that users are moving away from the volatility of Bitcoin or Altcoins for daily transactions, preferring the predictability of fiat-pegged tokens. Visa-backed programs have dominated this space, accounting for over 90% of on-chain crypto transaction volume. This dominance is a direct result of strategic alliances between infrastructure providers and traditional payment giants, which has effectively lowered the barrier to entry for the average consumer.

Infrastructure and Accessibility
In 2026, the rise of \

providers has streamlined the onboarding process. Modern crypto cards now function as seamless international payment accounts. They allow users to off-ramp assets automatically at the point of sale, eliminating the need for manual conversion. This systemic efficiency is reflected in the monthly volume metrics: from a mere $100 million in early 2023 to surpassing $1.5 billion per month by the end of 2025.

The data confirms that consumers do not want to reinvent their payment habits; they simply want to utilize their digital assets through familiar interfaces. As institutional adoption accelerates and regulatory clarity solidifies in 2026, the crypto card is proving to be the ultimate bridge between the decentralized and traditional financial worlds.

body.title: 🌊 A Quiet Night Before Chaos | Final Fantasy VIII EP 4 🎮✨
body.body:
## 🎬 Watch the Episode Here

👇 Full gameplay episode:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oLJZ_PAMGJA

Some moments in videogames are not remembered because of explosions or giant bosses.

Sometimes, what stays with us are the quiet moments.

The conversations.
The atmosphere.
The strange feeling that something important is about to happen.

That’s exactly how this episode of *Final Fantasy VIII* felt to me.

After the intensity of the Dollet mission, the game slows down just enough to let you breathe… but deep down, you know the world is already changing.

---

## 🌌 A Different Kind of RPG Experience

One thing I’ve always loved about *Final Fantasy VIII* is how human it feels.

Squall isn’t the typical loud hero.
He’s distant.
Awkward.
Quiet.

And honestly… that makes him feel real.

As the episode progresses, there’s this constant sensation that the characters themselves are still trying to understand who they are and what role they play in this world.

That emotional uncertainty gives the game a very unique identity.

---

## 🎵 The Magic of Atmosphere

There’s something almost hypnotic about the music and visual design in these early sections of the game.

The futuristic military aesthetics mixed with calm nighttime scenes create a strange emotional contrast.

As someone who loves storytelling in games, I think this is where *Final Fantasy VIII* becomes special.

Not because it explains everything immediately…
but because it allows mystery to exist.

And mystery is powerful.

---

## ⚔️ More Than Just Gameplay

While recording this episode, I realized something:

Classic RPGs trusted the player more.

They didn’t constantly bombard you with tutorials, markers, or endless explanations.

They allowed silence.
Exploration.
Curiosity.

And maybe that’s why these games stayed in our memories for decades.

You weren’t just playing.

You were discovering.

---

## 💭 Final Thoughts

This episode may seem calm compared to big action moments later in the story…

but honestly?

These quieter chapters are what make the emotional moments hit harder later on.

They build connection.
They build atmosphere.
They build nostalgia.

And replaying this game now feels less like revisiting a videogame…

and more like revisiting a part of life.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@zeruxanime/-a-quiet-night-before-chaos-final-fantasy-viii-ep-4--l99)

body.title: Vaccines Are Beneficial To Our Health
body.body:
_**Greetings, everyone!**_

We were born into vaccines and we know the benefits of taking these drugs or rejection as a means of preventing dangerous diseases and viruses to keep us going in life. 

I grew up to see the mark immunization on my shoulder. I took this injection when I was a child, and my parents took all my siblings and me to the hospital to take these drugs at the designated time allocated for every mother to bring their wards to the hospital. And it was necessary and compulsory. It is not appropriate for every parent to neglect this law, both in children and adults. 


![IMG_20260325_091026_707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/242rq5RszuAY7R5YPwhXQpawmVL3nnYbXZuarE6Dvwz7eHn13MDtivF22Aj9t81WHcXqA.jpg)


Growing up, I saw young nurses going from house to house to give grown children oral immunization, a drop in our mouths, this one used to be sweet. Always anticipating getting it in full but a drop is okay. When I passed that age, seeing them coming around to give my younger siblings, I used to crave it. I remembered how I asked one of the nurses to give me some, they laughed and told me, I have passed that level.

Vaccines are good. During the COVID-19 pandemic, a lot of people took vaccines to prevent them from contracting the disease. Many die for not taking the vaccine. There are some things we shouldn't neglect despite our religious background or beliefs.

I want to share a story of how my immediate sister almost lost her child because of neglecting my medical attention, if not for my mother, who rushed me to the hospital. Thank God for the nurses who gave adequate attention immediately after my mother rushed into the hospital with her grandchild. They gave the boy an injection, and some drugs were prescribed to him. Immediately, an injection was administered, and the boy's temperature returned to normal. 

The nurses appreciated my mother for rushing in for medical attention because the boy was severely sick, and it was uncontrollable but God took control of everything. 

And there was a time, a child died at home because after the mother gave birth to the child, she didn't follow the procedure of taking the child for immunization, the way it was supposed to be. The child died after some days. The child couldn't survive the diseases and viruses around. It's very pertinent and proper education should be carried out for pregnant women to prepare them ahead of time and prevent loss.


I believe God gave men and women the wisdom to produce drugs as preventive measures for our health. As long as we believe in God, he can pass through drugs to heal us too. There is nothing bad to believe in God and then taking drugs. In an emergency situation that needs urgent medical attention, it should be administered and believe in God for a turnaround.

There was a time I was very sick. I went to the hospital, I explained to the doctors, they conducted a test, they result came out and they questioned me. They gave me an injection and drugs to take. Which I did, even with the drugs, it didn't work out, till God told me to pray, and I prayed, and God took away that sickness. Since that time till now, I have not experienced such.

I didn't neglect the physical doctors and I didn't neglect the instructions God gave to me. God came through for me as a great healer. Today, I am healthy and hearty.

Vaccines are not bad, and God is not bad, but you need wisdom on how to go about it.

_**This is my response to the Hivelearners featured contest week 215 episode 3**_

_**I love, I care, and I forgive**_

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@peckypeace/vaccines-are-beneficial-to-our-health--b83)

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 30 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/795dab61-5ecd-4511-8e34-02aa1fd15769.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Another routine workday in the books yesterday. Le Chat waited for us during the day with her favorite activity, sleep on the dog bed on the back deck. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7a80a1a5-2dfb-4bac-b026-f53a5998266a.jpg) And in the afternoon, after the weather cleared up nicely, leaving just a few beautiful clouds, it was time for our daily walk. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b9515a94-516e-428e-b890-043164d6da02.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fdc4bb77-6964-41b3-862c-a7c45e9d0405.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b774e1d6-072b-42b0-92c1-e95d20d6dbc6.jpg) In the small forest behind the front yard, Kaia clearly remembered the adventure from the day before, she was looking for that fox everywhere. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8f4cce55-b81c-4e82-97a4-4e7a619e9dd3.jpg) Le Chat felt left behind and called her sister back for some exploration. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9179e6b2-c95e-4521-beb5-6739ccba1366.jpg) Eventually Kaia gave up on searching for that fox and joined Le Chat. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a57aa164-7d56-4702-8f12-1822a1be761a.jpg) But as usual, I also wanted to go to the bigger forest. That's how some of the trails look like at the moment. What are they going to do? ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4ae82df7-9ea3-4769-ace3-1e97eaf1d548.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/97b22d88-041e-4146-9b1b-9e93e4f25bd4.jpg) Kaia doesn't really care, still plenty of obstacles to climb on. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4dfe0733-20d2-4314-b5ad-d08b8d1514af.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d94ad92c-597b-41a0-b80f-75491ee0adea.jpg) And of course, in the end, she takes the lead, to guide us out of the forest and back home. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3f105cce-8e5f-4328-8962-09798e32818b.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7277bf38-08ed-4bdb-ac1a-6f5749067227.jpg) On the way back, we started to see the beautiful Moon low on the horizon. By the time we found an open view, a few clouds tried to ruin the scene. But it was still great. The full Flower Moon is officially on Friday, but it was very close to full. Maybe this week end, I'll try and get the small telescope for better photos. Also depends on the weather, we have a freeze advisory (yes it was summer temperatures just a few days ago!) and I'm not sure it will be clear. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4e4c3017-e5f7-49b5-808f-db4ae799c8ba.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a9d0dd29-ce80-4bf5-9e24-41329b0b9e45.jpg) And that was it for the day's activities, not a great step count, but it's not too bad for a busy work day. And like I said, we'll try and step it up this week end. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.

### <center>**IMPORTANT UPDATE AND ANNOUNCEMENT 📢**</center>
____

We appreciate everyone who continuously participate in our Afri-tunes weekly contest to share their African Music and tunes with the Community. We are happy that the community is growing day by day, week by week, month by month and year by year.

In order to maintain quality content while sharing our lovely African musical tunes, we wish to remind everyone about the following:

- The minimum word count remains 250: however, if you use dual languages then it'll be 500.
- Let your writeup contain more of your inspiration behind the song, the choice of the song, what the song means to you or any topic/write-up you wish to share with us. 

____

#### **Important ⚠️**

We wish to revisit the use of adding lyrics in posts so that it doesn't take  50 - 80% of the post content. On this note, we wish to restate the following: 

- Adding lyrics is Optional 
- If you are the original composer of the song, you can add the whole lyrics 
- If it is a song cover and you copied the lyrics from the Internet, only include the 1st VERSE AND CHORUS in your post. Then cite properly by providing the link to the web page you got the lyrics from.

- Kindly note that spamming is a great offence on the hive blockchain and highly frowned at.⚠️

body.title: Sunflower Land - Salt Awakening Stella NFTs!
body.body: > ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf81efQ2aHnZbMkedsbhG64EejFvgDQohPMGVaKePfhHS/sunflower_land_salt_awakening_stella_nfts_.jpg) Chapter 13 is coming to an end in the next few days, and with that, a new chapter is already being presented to Sunflower Lands players. We already have some information regarding the next chapter of the game being updated on the project's GitHub and approved by the devs responsible for the development of this web3 farming game. Regarding the Salt Awakening Stella Store, we have some interesting information already released about the MEGA NFTs. It has been revealed which NFTs will be present in the Stella Store, their initial values, and also the buffs they will have. Let's analyze what these items will be and also give more details about the Dino Egg Trophy, which was presented without a buff, but recently had its buff revealed. [Sunflower Land 🌻](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3) I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

> ## Salt Awakening Stella NFTs! In the Salt Awakening Chapter's Stella Store, the most expensive item in Salt Rock will be the Bubble Aura. I believe it will be a cosmetic item with an aura effect around your character that will reduce Fish Market processing time by 20% and also increase the chance of obtaining +1 Fish Processing item. Its cost will be quite high, requiring the completion of a large number of quests to reach the necessary 10,000 Salt Rock.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXL4zPw79LQvTa47VcHgBm6FtVcCwAgJ5KCVMHauq3DK4/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
The next most expensive NFT item in the Stella Store will be the Deep Sea Salt Cave Background. Those of you who play Sunflower Lands might be surprised, but yes, it will be a background with an effect, something that, if I'm not mistaken, is unique and hasn't happened before, making this item quite special. The effect of this background will be +5 Salt per collection, which can be quite significant, but we still don't have a clear idea of ​​the real usefulness of salt in the game. The cost will be 6000 Salt Rock, the same value as the Mega NFTs from chapter 13. Finally, we have the Crystal Altar, a monument that requires 1000 cheers. This means the +5% catch time effect on the Crab Pot and Marine Pot will only become active once the monument is completed, which is quite bad since it takes months to complete a monument. Its cost will be 3000 Salt Rock, which doesn't seem very appealing considering the situation.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQpeqzpTNT8NaNv515i2nXKLgNAxrQbxNrYv9rEWuS44S/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Overall, we have an effect that can be quite useful in the background since it's a buff to the resource. The bubble aura seems interesting, but the cost is quite high and will require players to play the entire season without missing many deliveries, for an effect that doesn't seem so good, and the Crystal Altar has the downside of being a monument and having a high cost for a not-so-good effect. Once the items are finished, another important point to address is that in this season, the items that grant +1 tickets will cost 10k coins for the first, 100 flowers for the second, and 200 flowers for the third. This increases the cost of obtaining both +1 items by 100%, which may further complicate things for those participating in this chapter. To give you some context, in the last season the first +1 ticket cost 50 flowers, and they have now doubled that.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWo8kdQagCcicZ7sW6pc34TDN4QxJXyt8DhPuLz5bHzvD/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Initially, the Dino Egg Trophy item, which players would earn by collecting treasures from the Sunflower Lands Digging mini-game, was presented in the V1 of the next chapter's items without any description linked to the item. This led players to believe that the item would be a collectible, which wouldn't be so bad since it's quite iconic. However, a few days later a new update was added to GitHub that added a feature to the Dino Egg Trophy, where the player who has this SFT/NFT will be able to speed up the cooking, processing, building, collecting, expansion, crafting, and upgrading functions, at a rate of 50 coins per gem, with a limit of 20k coins. Initially some players weren't so impressed, but the interesting thing is that this is a mechanic that will begin to be tested by the game's development team and could be the first step towards other NFTs with the same function in the future. It's important to do these tests to get data on coin burn, for example. This is an NFT that could end up being useful for speeding up the completion of some activity so you don't have to wait, but I don't know if they will use it much beyond that... --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf81efQ2aHnZbMkedsbhG64EejFvgDQohPMGVaKePfhHS/sunflower_land_salt_awakening_stella_nfts_.jpg) O capítulo 13 está chegando ao fim nos próximos dias, e com isso um novo capítulo já vai sendo apresentado aos jogadores de Sunflower Lands. Já temos algumas informações referentes ao próximo capítulo do jogo sendo atualizadas no GitHub do projeto e sendo aprovadas pelos devs responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento desse jogo web3 de fazenda. Sobre a Salt Awakening Stella Store, temos algumas informações interessantes já divulgadas sobre os MEGA NFTs, já foi revelados quais serão os NFTs presentes na Stella Store, os valores iniciais e também os buffs que eles vão ter. Vamos analisar quais serão esses items e também dar mais detalhes sobre o Dino Egg Trophy, que tinha sido apresentando sem buff, mas recentemente teve seu buff divulgado. Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

> ## Salt Awakening Stella NFTs! Na Stella Store do Chapter Salt Awakening teremos como o item de maior custo em Salt Rock, a Bubble Aura, acredito que será um cosmético com efeito de aura ao redor do seu personagem que vai dar uma redução de 20% no tempo de processamento do Fish Market e também 20% de chance de conseguir +1 item do Fish Processing, o custo dele será bem elevado, sendo necessário completar uma grande quantidade das quests para chegar nos 10000 de Salt Rock necessários.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXL4zPw79LQvTa47VcHgBm6FtVcCwAgJ5KCVMHauq3DK4/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
O próximo NFT que mais vai custar na Stella Store será o Deep Sea Salt Cave Background, para você que joga o Sunflower Lands pode ter estranhado, mas sim será um background com efeito, algo que se eu não me engano é único e que não tinha acontecido até então, o que já torna esse item bem especial. O efeito desse background será de +5 Salt por coleta, o que pode ser bem significativo, mas ainda não temos uma noção da real utilidade do sal no jogo. O custo será de 6000 Salt Rock, mesmo valor dos Mega NFTs do chapter 13. Por fim, temos o Crystal Altar, que é um monumento que precisa de 1000 cheers, ou seja, o efeito de +5% catch time no Crab Pot e Marine Pot só começará a ficar ativo, quando o monumento for concluído, o que é bem ruim, já que demora meses para concluir um monumento. O custo dele será de 3000 Salt Rock, o que não parece ser tão interessante considerando a situação.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQpeqzpTNT8NaNv515i2nXKLgNAxrQbxNrYv9rEWuS44S/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
No geral, temos um efeito que pode ser bem útil no background já que é um buff no recurso. A bubble aura parece ser interessante, mas o custo é bem alto e vai fazer com que os jogadores precisem jogar toda a season sem perder muitas entregas, para um efeito que não parece tão bom e o Crystal Altar tem o ponto negativo de ser um monumento e um custo alto para ume feito não tão bom. Terminado os items, outro ponto importante para abordar é que nessa season os item que vão dar +1 tickets vão custar 10k coins o primeiro, 100 flower o segundo e 200 flower o terceiro. Aumento em 100% o custo para conseguir os dois items de +1, o que pode complicar ainda mais para quem for participar desse capítulo. Para vocês entenderem na última season o primeiro +1 foi 50 flower e eles dobraram.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWo8kdQagCcicZ7sW6pc34TDN4QxJXyt8DhPuLz5bHzvD/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Inicialmente o item Dino Egg Trophy que os jogadores ganhariam, juntando os tesouros do mini-game de Digging do Sunflower Lands, foi apresentado na V1 dos items do próximo capítulo sem nenhum descrição ligada ao item, o que fez com que os jogadores acreditassem que o item seria um colecionável, o que não seria tão ruim já que é bem icônico. Entretanto, alguns dias depois uma nova atualização foi adicionada ao GitHub que adicionou uma funcionalidade ao Dino Egg Trophy, em que o jogador que tiver esse SFT/NFT vai conseguir acelerar as funções de cooking, processing, building, collectible, expansion, crafting, upgrade, em uma proporção de 50 coins por gem, com um limite de 20k de moedas. Inicialmente alguns jogadores não se impressionaram tanto, mas o interessante é que essa vai ser uma mecânica que começará a ser testada pelo time de desenvolvedores do jogo e que pode ser o primeiro passo para outros NFTs com essa mesma função no futuro. É importante fazer esses testes, para conseguir dados de burn de coins por exemplo. Esse vai ser um NFT que pode acabar sendo útil para acelerar o final de alguma atividade para entregar logo e você não precisar esperar, mas não sei se vão usar tanto além disso... ---

body.title: A day in the life of a lazy dog.  My Actifit Report Card: May 1 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a4230cfc-3ccb-475d-bd00-e7fb6f0c909e.jpg)

Typically you hear me talking about how I get my steps throughout the day.  Which usually involves walking the dog morning and evening.  Getting some steps from housework.  Get some more steps from going to the gym.  A few more steps from shopping and at the end of the day I tell you about the 14K steps that I got today.

But today I'll chronicle the dog's life.  Yes, you always see him walking with me.  Sniffing (or eating) grass.  Trying to find goose \

to eat. Occasionally trying to pick a fight with another dog and sometimes, just sometimes , digging in a big snowpile. You might think I have an active dog. He used to be. However, now he has turned into a house sloth. Where do I find him in the morning? ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ea03fe02-27ea-4fbf-a1fa-c06fc29bec60.jpg) Fast asleep on the big couch. His favorite place to lie down and get a good nights rest. However, still close enough to the window or door should an intruder, car, or pedestrian come by and need a stern barking at. After the morning walk? ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0c3ea8e6-059b-4698-a680-80714e538663.jpg) Time for some nutrition for the day. Plus some hydration. Important to get those carbs for the mid morning rest. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/429bda94-7f07-4825-9246-fff38266c90c.jpg) Time to go to the loveseat to rest and relax. Relieve all the tension and stress from not being able to chase squirrels during the morning walk. After relaxing time for the all important siesta. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/36f1ca07-7a8e-4cea-8fee-277cd00c691a.jpg) After all the evening walk is coming and it is important to be in peak restful state in case any small vermin need chasing or other dogs need to be warded away from my owner! Then after the evening walk and additional nutrition its time to go into power down mode. The low energy sentry guarding the front room and mom's china cabinet. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5ffd948d-85e9-438c-84f0-b5f3ed666997.jpg) Need to ensure I have maximum energy reserves in case I need to defend the house :) After that? Time to wake up and annoy my humans as they are watching TV. Time to get them away from excess relaxation by forcing them to play tug of war, play fight, or tug of war (my repertoire is limited). Then the day is over. Time for my evening rest along with my humans so they can sleep peacefully ... Unless I turn on the light to go chase possible people at the front entry door. Thanks for dropping by. Until tomorrow
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@terganftp/actifit-terganftp-20260501t231514093z)_

¡Hola, Amiguitos, Papitos y ZoeTubers! Tengo la dicha de declamar el poema: Cielo Entre Ramas de Alfredo Espino, nuestro insigne poeta niño y escritor salvadoreño; de su libro de poesía, Auras del Bohío, Jícaras Tristes.

Cielo Entre Ramas es la historia en tus manos que elevan plegarias al universo, tu cántico notas de amor y de recuerdo, como gotas de agua que se deslizan entre las hojas, cayendo al tronco del arbol tu sonrisa cristalina, y así te despides... sutilmente llevándote la ternura de mis anhelos.

La media tarde es ingrata; 
tiene sueño la arboleda, 
y un pajarito de seda 
sus besos de amor desata...
___

Dedico este poema a todos mis suscriptores fieles e incondicionales que tienen el buen gusto de disfrutar mis poemas y cuentos infantiles, les mando muchas energías positivas y un fuerte abrazo 🤗✨
Espero disfruten muchísimo el poema Cielo Entre Ramas Jícaras Tristes de Alfredo Espino.

## Alive Tipping Bot

The minimum ALIVE Power to use our tipping bot is 1,000 AP (owned non-delegated stake plus incoming delegations) which allows you to send 10 tips per day, and we have 4 levels.

- Level 1: 1k AP = 10 tips per day
- Level 2: 5k AP = 20 tips per day
- Level 3: 20k AP = 30 tips per day
- Level 4: 100k AP = 40 tips per day


Use the command ` !ALIVE ` in a comment to send a tip, and do make sure to add a space just before and after to make sure it works correctly, the counter resets at midnight UTC.

Here is the full details of how our tipping bot works, [Announcement: The New ALIVE Tipping Bot Has Been Launched](https://wearealivetribe.com/hive-155221/@flaxz/announcement-the-new-alive-tipping-bot-has-been-launched)

body.title: Splinterlands:End of Season review!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQDHxzN2Y7e1ZNfeKWfNwZxZjcbaeDHdM4vDE9p96H6u/1777633890291.jpg)

Good morning warriors! The season just ended and a new one is already in progress while my brawl battle is still on as well.I didn't get to gold 2 in modern ranked,I stopped at gold 3,but I am okay with that, for there is room for improvement.Win or lose,there is something to always learn and it is awesome.
For my frontier ranked,I really did well there,I got to a trophy count of **3,700** which is gold 🥇 1.I was aiming at **4,000**

 This end of season **35,359** glint gotten,I would accumulate it to a considerable amount, before using it. There is a lot to do with it.

**Splinterlands is no walk in the park, but that's what amps up the excitement.A winning strategy weighs stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and beyond. That's why you must factor them all into your deck building. Toss in strong cards to boost your setups, and push hard to rack up as many victories as possible**! 🔥

Now,the connter has reset back my frontier and modern ranked to **2,500 and 1,400** trophy count respectively.


**FRONTIER RANKED RESET**![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfHajPw9qTUF8bMThn6t76Ec41kvdXBdNeJgZKWMvC7C/1777636811940.jpg)

body.title: Arroz frito con carnes [ESP-ENG]
body.body: >Hola querida comunidad de Hive Food, espero que estén muy bien. Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una receta práctica, sabrosa y perfecta para cualquier momento: un delicioso arroz frito con carnes. Para prepararlo utilicé pollo y carne de puerco, dos ingredientes que juntos quedan muy bien y aportan mucho sabor. En esta ocasión no usé vegetales, pero sí sofrí las carnes con condimentos y bastante ajo, para dar ese toque especial que hace la diferencia. Es una comida sencilla, rendidora y excelente para aprovechar ingredientes que tengamos en casa de una manera rica y rápida.\n\n

>Hello, dear Hive Food community! I hope you’re all doing well. Today I want to share with you a practical, flavorful recipe that’s perfect for any occasion: a delicious stir-fried rice with meat. To make it, I used chicken and pork—two ingredients that pair wonderfully together and add a lot of flavor. This time I didn’t use vegetables, but I did sauté the meat with seasonings and plenty of garlic to give it that special touch that makes all the difference. It’s a simple, filling meal that’s a great way to use up ingredients you have at home in a tasty and quick way.
![Agregar un título - copia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jennyzer/246bBGhEC9TtP8swjaNomKPg1UXPTxubmohfu2kPKMpurRaGnycqDvvy8bGpTYAo42yfG.png)

#### INGREDIENTES: > INGREDIENTS:
>3 muslos de pollo, 100 GR de carne puerco, 7 dientes de ajo, orégano, sal, pimienta, aceite, 2 tazas de arroz.\n\n
>3 chicken thighs, 100 g pork, 7 cloves of garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, oil, 2 cups of rice. *** #### PASO A PASO: > STEP BY STEP:

>Como primer paso corté las carnes, todo lo dejé cortado reservado mientras que machaqué los dientes de ajo, calenté una olla y añadí aceite, comencé a sofreír las carnes con los condimentos, orégano, sal y pimienta, después añadí el ajo.\n\n

>First, I cut up the meat and set it aside while I crushed the garlic cloves. I heated a pot, added oil, and began sautéing the meat with the seasonings—oregano, salt, and pepper—then added the garlic. ***

>El siguiente pasó fué esperar dorar la carne, en ese punto agregamos el arroz, nuevamente sofreímos un par de minutos y añadimos agua, en este para 2 tazas de arroz son 4 tazas de agua, añadan sal y dejé cocinar.\n\n

>The next step was to wait for the meat to brown. At that point, we added the rice, sautéed it for a couple more minutes, and added water—for every 2 cups of rice, use 4 cups of water. Add salt and let it cook. ***
>Sentí que faltaba sabor por ello sofrí más ajo con orégano añadí más sal y dejé cocinar hasta secar, dejen tapado el arroz unos 10 minutos antes de comer.\n\n

>I felt it needed more flavor, so I sautéed some more garlic with oregano, added more salt, and let it cook until the liquid had evaporated. Let the rice sit covered for about 10 minutes before serving. ***

body.title: GAME OF SKATE SEM PIEDADE!! Ft.beber
body.body:
allowfullscreen></iframe>

Man, what a merciless skateboarding game, huh?! I just watched the video with my partner Beber. We decided to make a Game of Skate, best of three and it was a real battle.

Beber and I have been together since the beginning, and that makes all the difference because we know each other's weaknesses and strengths and that makes the game much more intense.

We wanted to show that skateboarding is not just about doing complicated tricks, but also about fun and friendship.

Beber is a very skilled guy, and I knew I would have to do my best to win. And that's exactly what happened. An exciting skateboarding game with lots of amazing tricks and some mistakes too.

One of the highlights of the video was when I did a nole flip and Beber was impressed. He didn't expect me to do that maneuver, and it gave me an important psychological advantage. But Beber is not a guy who gives up easily and came back with everything, doing some incredible maneuvers too.

What I liked most about this game was the energy and healthy rivalry between us. We've known each other for a long time, and that makes the game much more fun. It's like we're competing, but also having fun at the same time. And in the end, that's what matters.

Now, I want to hear from you, guys! What did you think of the video? Leave in the comments if you liked it and what you think we can improve. And, if you're enjoying the Pense videos, it won't stop here! We're going up, team. We're together. Thanks and it's us!

---

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPEhuQdHc7vK1YM2QGex3GHwkChpZ8xvbQ8hLRzWWKfXj/oLw-Ppgv25U.jpeg)

Cara, que jogo de skate sem piedade, hein?! Acabei de assistir ao vídeo com o meu parceiro Beber. A gente resolveu fazer um Game of Skate, melhor de três e foi uma verdadeira batalha. 

Eu e o Beber estamos juntos desde o início, e isso faz toda a diferença porque a gente conhece os pontos fracos e fortes um do outro e isso torna o jogo muito mais intenso.

Queríamos mostrar que o skate não é apenas sobre fazer manobras complicadas, mas também sobre a diversão e a amizade. 

O Beber é um cara muito habilidoso, e eu sabia que teria que dar o meu melhor para vencer. E foi exatamente isso que aconteceu. Um jogo de skate emocionante com muitas manobras incríveis e alguns erros também.

Um dos destaques do vídeo foi quando eu fiz um nole flip e o Beber ficou impressionado. Ele não esperava que eu fizesse aquela manobra, e isso me deu uma vantagem psicológica importante. Mas o Beber não é um cara que desiste fácil e voltou com tudo, fazendo algumas manobras incríveis também.

O que eu mais gostei desse jogo foi a energia e a rivalidade saudável entre a gente. A gente se conhece há muito tempo, e isso torna o jogo muito mais divertido. É como se a gente estivesse competindo, mas também se divertindo ao mesmo tempo. E no final, é isso que importa.

Agora, quero ouvir de vocês, galera! O que vocês acharam do vídeo? Deixem nos comentários se vocês gostaram e o que vocês acham que a gente pode melhorar. E, se vocês estão gostando dos vídeos do Pense, porque aqui não vai parar não! A gente vai pra cima, time. Tamo junto. Valeu e é nóis!

La Mujer que Sostiene (sust.): Aquella que reconoce su diseño único como puerto y motor; no busca el lugar del otro porque sabe que el suyo es el punto de partida y de retorno de todo lo que permanece.

​<center>══✿══╡°˖✧✿✧˖°╞══✿══</center>

A veces, en la pausa necesaria de la tarde, me quedo mirando mis manos. No son manos de hierro, ni pretenden serlo, son manos que conocen el cansancio, que han sentido el frío de la duda y el calor del esfuerzo. Pero son manos que han aprendido un oficio sagrado que no se enseña en ninguna escuela: el oficio de ser cimiento.

Durante mucho tiempo, nos han hecho creer que la fuerza es solo aquello que empuja, que choca, que grita o que conquista territorios. Nos dijeron que para ser valiosas debemos entrar en esa competencia feroz, usando una armadura que nos queda pesada y nos apaga la luz. Pero hoy, hablando desde el fondo de mi alma, entiendo que hay una fuerza mucho más poderosa y silenciosa. Es la fuerza de la que está hecha la raíz, esa que nadie ve, pero que decide si el árbol sigue en pie o se rinde ante la tormenta.

Cuando hablo de sostener, no hablo de una carga pesada que me dobla la espalda. Hablo de una capacidad divina de ser el \

emocional y espiritual de mi mundo.

​<center>══✿══╡°˖✧✿✧˖°╞══✿══</center>

A mis hijos no solo les sostengo el cuerpo mientras crecen; les sostengo los miedos cuando el mundo parece demasiado grande para ellos. Yo soy  ese puerto seguro donde pueden encallar sus tormentas escolares y sus primeras penas de amor, tengo esa capacidad de escucharlos , aconsejarlos y callar cuando es necesario, en cambio a mi esposo, no lo cargo como si fuera un peso; lo sostengo siendo su contrapeso. En sus días de batalla, yo soy su paz; en sus momentos de duda, yo soy la visión que él ha perdido. Sostener a mi pareja es ser esa mano en su espalda que no empuja, sino que afirma: \

.\n\nNuestros proyectos en conjunto no caminan solo por la estrategia o el dinero. Caminan porque hay una fe que los sostiene. Yo soy la encargada de mantener la llama encendida cuando el viento de la incertidumbre sopla fuerte. Sostengo la visión del \

se ve oscuro.

​<center>══✿══╡°˖✧✿✧˖°╞══✿══</center>

Si tú me ves hoy entera, no es porque yo sea de piedra. Es porque he descubierto que para poder sostener a mi familia en lo emocional, lo físico y lo espiritual, primero tengo que dejar que Dios me sostenga a mí.

Hay momentos en que me encierro en el silencio y la soledad de los días y le digo: \

, Y es ahí, en ese altar secreto, donde Él me reconstruye. Él sostiene mis emociones cuando estoy a punto de quebrarme por el estrés; Él sostiene mi salud cuando el cuerpo me pide tregua; Él sostiene mi fe cuando los proyectos parecen estancados, el sostiene mis miedos y me abraza tan fuerte que va uniendo mis pedazos. 

Yo no soy el origen de la fuerza, soy el canal. Sostengo a mi familia porque Dios me abraza y me ayuda a avanzar, me presta Su fortaleza cuando mis brazos y mis pies se sienten cansados ¿ Quien dice que las mujeres no tenemos miedo ? Tenemos el doble de miedo,  lo que sucede es que en mi caso,  Él es la roca sobre la que yo me apoyo para que los míos puedan apoyarse en mí.

​<center>══✿══╡°˖✧✿✧˖°╞══✿══</center>

A ti, mujer, que a veces sientes que el peso es demasiado: no necesitas una armadura. Necesitas reconocer tu diseño. Fuiste creada con una arquitectura de amor capaz de dar forma al caos. No compitas por ser igual a lo que no eres; brilla desde esa sutileza que es, en realidad, tu mayor poder.
A ti, hombre, que caminas al lado de una mujer: reconoce ese latido invisible. A veces, la mayor fortaleza de tu casa no es el techo que tú provees, sino el suelo que ella sostiene para que tus pies no resbalen.

Sostener no es un sacrificio que nos anula, es una misión que nos trasciende. Es entender que si yo estoy firme en Dios, mi hogar tiene un refugio inamovible. Esta es mi historia, este es mi latido, y hoy elijo honrar la sagrada bendición de ser el sostén de mi mundo y de los míos...

​<center>══✿══╡°˖✧✿✧˖°╞══✿══</center>

\

</center>

# **Hello everyone... ✨🌈**
##### *Greetings to all my dear hivers friends, especially my friends in the #StreetArt community. It's a pleasure to be around again to share another urban art, as my participation in the #298 Street Art Contest.*
##### *If you also wish to participate in the contest, please [click here](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@digi-me/ccc-s-street-art-contest-28a0ed155187c) you can read the rules and regulations, in case you find a piece of art that you wish to share with us.*
--- --- ### ***Here is my participation this week: 🌈***
This week I’m taking you back to the Chacao Cultural Center, which, as I mentioned last week, is a place that constantly delights all its visitors with art of every kind, serving as a hub for cultural and artistic gatherings—including theater, film, concerts, and much more. Every week they schedule a variety of events of all kinds, giving us plenty to choose from. The murals I’m sharing with you this week were also part of the work by these visual artists, who participated in the [Kalacras](https://www.instagram.com/kalacras/) Fest, a spectacular festival featuring several muralists, held at [the Chacao Cultural Center](https://www.instagram.com/cculturalchacao/). Today I’m sharing three murals by different artists all at once; they’re wonderful because each one expresses a different style. The first was created by a painter and muralist who seeks to transform spaces into mural art, creating an identity in public spaces. You can find him on Instagram as [llordqz](https://www.instagram.com/llordaz/). At this festival, he created something very interesting and intriguing: a fusion of a morrocoy lizard and a rooster, which he named “morro gallo.” Here is the link to the work, which was posted on the artist’s Instagram [Morrogallo](https://www.instagram.com/p/DJ1vvw3xweC/). Second, here’s a piece by the street art and graffiti artist [andreinaacero](https://www.instagram.com/andreinaacero/). In this case, she created a totem. If you visit her Instagram, you can see that this is her style—it’s beautiful, creative, and full of color. Here’s a look at the work in progress and the finished piece: [Totem creative process](https://www.instagram.com/p/DDqdqpLNSmc/?img_index=1) // [Finished totem](https://www.instagram.com/p/DWChwEMkc4o/) The last piece was created by the illustrator and street art specialist [Hanktrazos](https://www.instagram.com/hamktrazos/). He portrayed himself by painting his own artwork featuring various animal species—a fantastic piece full of creativity and color. Here’s the link to his [finished work](https://www.instagram.com/p/DJ1vvw3xweC/). I loved that an artist specializing in animation, design, and audiovisual development named [desmutt_](https://www.instagram.com/desmutt_/) brought these artists’ murals to life; you can see his work on his Instagram account [Bringing murals in Caracas to life](https://www.instagram.com/p/DJ1vvw3xweC/) --- --- ##### **I leave you photos of the mural, so you can better appreciate this beautiful street art**. --- ***Location of the Mural:*** [Chacao Cultural Center Caracas-Venezuela]([//]:# (!worldmappin 10.49041 lat -66.86310 long Centro cultural chacao d3scr)) []([//]:# (!pinmapple 10.49041 lat -66.86310 long Centro cultural chacao d3scr)). --- --- ##### ***I am very pleased to be able to share with everyone this beautiful art, as it has been a pleasure to leave it on my blog so that many can appreciate the beauties that are in my country Venezuela. I hope you have enjoyed this beautiful art. I say goodbye until the next publication, thanks for being here ✨***

# **Hola a todos...✨🌈**
##### *Saludos a todos mis queridos amigos hivers, en especial mis amigos de la comunidad de #StreetArt. Es un gusto estar por aquí de vuelta para compartir otro arte urbano, como mi participación en el Concurso #298 de arte callejero.*
###### *Si también desean participar en el concurso, haciendo [clic aquí](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@digi-me/ccc-s-street-art-contest-28a0ed155187c) podrán leer las bases y reglas, en caso de que encuentren una pieza de arte que deseen compartir con nosotros.*
--- --- ### ***Les dejo mi participación de esta semana:🌈***
Esta semana los llevo nuevamente al Centro Cultural Chacao, dónde les comenté la semana pasada que este es un sitio que deleita a todos sus visitantes constantemente con arte de todo tipo siendo un centro de encuentro cultural y artístico, en cuanto a teatro, cine, conciertos y mucho más. Cada semana agendan diversos eventos de cualquier índole, dándonos mucho que escoger. Los murales que les dejo está semana también fueron parte de la intervención de estos artistas plásticos, como participantes en el [Kalacras](https://www.instagram.com/kalacras/) Fest, un grandioso festival realizado con varios muralistas, en [El Centro Cultural Chacao](https://www.instagram.com/cculturalchacao/). Les coloco hoy de manera unificada, 3 murales de diferentes artistas, son maravillosos porque cada uno expresa diversos estilos. El primero fue realizado por un pintor y muralista que trata de transformar espacios en arte mural, creando una identidad en espacios públicos, lo pueden conseguir en instagram como [llordqz](https://www.instagram.com/llordaz/), el materializó en este festival algo muy interesante y a la vez curioso, hizo una fusión de un morrocoy con un gallo, lo hizo llamar morro gallo. Les dejo el link del trabajo realizado el cual fue colocado en el Instagram del artista [Morrogallo](https://www.instagram.com/p/DJ1vvw3xweC/). En segundo lugar les dejo un trabajo realizado por la artista en Street Art y graffitis [andreinaacero](https://www.instagram.com/andreinaacero/), en su caso materializó un tótem, sí visitan su Instagram pueden observar que ese es su estilo de trabajo, es hermoso creativo y lleno de mucho color. Les dejo por acá para que observen el trabajo en el momento en que lo estaba realizando y una vez terminado, [Proceso creativo tótem](https://www.instagram.com/p/DDqdqpLNSmc/?img_index=1) // [Tótem terminado](https://www.instagram.com/p/DWChwEMkc4o/) El último trabajo fue realizado por el ilustrador y especialista en Street Art [Hanktrazos](https://www.instagram.com/hamktrazos/), este se personifico a el mismo pintando su propio arte con algunas especies animales, un gran trabajo lleno de creatividad y color. Les dejo el link de su [trabajo terminado](https://www.instagram.com/p/DJ1vvw3xweC/). Me encantó que un artista que se especializa en animación, diseño y desarrollo audiovisual llamado [desmutt_](https://www.instagram.com/desmutt_/), le dió vida a los murales de estos artistas pueden observar sus trabajos en su red social instagram [Animando murales de ccs](https://www.instagram.com/p/DJ1vvw3xweC/) --- --- ##### **Les dejo fotos del mural, para que puedan apreciar mejor este hermoso arte callejero.** --- ***Ubicación del mural:*** [Centro Cultural Chacao Caracas-Venezuela]([//]:# (!worldmappin 10.49041 lat -66.86310 long Centro cultural chacao d3scr)) []([//]:# (!pinmapple 10.49041 lat -66.86310 long Centro cultural chacao d3scr)). --- --- ##### ***Estoy muy complacida por poder compartir con todos este arte tan hermoso, así como ha sido todo un placer poder dejarlo en mi blog para que muchos puedan apreciar las bellezas que se encuentran en mi país Venezuela. Espero que haya sido de su agrado este bonito arte. Me despido hasta la próxima publicación, gracias por estar aquí ✨*** --- ---

body.body: Latin Name|Observation date|Location| |------------|------------|------------| |Genus Stenocatantops| May 02 2026 | Central Aceh Regency,Aceh, Indonesia | Today I again managed to find a grasshopper behind my house, this is a large brown grasshopper that looks very interesting. This grasshopper has a straight and symmetrical shape, and has a color that is very similar to the color of trees or soil, namely brown, this is a very reliable jumper, he can jump very strong and quite a long distance, approaching this grasshopper is very difficult because he is very sensitive to the slightest movement, but we can easily approach him when he is perched on the thick grass. By using the help of a macro lens I also managed to capture the beauty of this grasshopper when he was perched on an iron fence, I tried to photograph it from various different angles but it was a very difficult thing to do. > 🇪🇸 ~ **Buenas noches a todos ~ 🌛 🌃** Estamos en la última semana de Abril y vaya que 2026 no ha permitido que nos aburramos; a veces me pregunto si la vida siempre fue así, llena de sucesos históricos ocurriendo simultáneamente uno tras otro, pero que antes por nuestra edad o por el momento tecnológico que vivíamos no nos era posible darnos cuenta. En ese mismo tópico, también me asombra que como sociedad no hemos logrado superar el vicio de la violencia, encontrando que ha evolucionado hasta alcanzar nuevos formatos, nuevas vías y nuevas dinámicas entre los que se supone son, los miembros mas inocentes entre nosotros (los niños, los jóvenes). Dicho eso, esta es mi participación para el [Ladies of Hive Community Contest #286](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-286) que cada semana propone 2 preguntas para que reflexionemos en comunidad; así que si buscas una comunidad activa con propuestas semanales interesantes [da CLICK aquí 👌 ⭐ ✨](https://peakd.com/c/hive-124452/created) >! [ENGLISH VERSION] > 🇺🇸 ~ **Good night, everyone ~ 🌛 🌃** We’re in the last week of April, and boy, has 2026 kept us on our toes; sometimes I wonder if life has always been this way—filled with historic events unfolding simultaneously, one after another—but that in the past, due to our age or the technological era we were living in, we simply couldn’t perceive it. > > On that same topic, it also amazes me that as a society we haven’t managed to overcome the vice of violence, finding that it has evolved to take on new forms, new avenues, and new dynamics among those who are supposed to be the most innocent among us (children, young people). > > That said, this is my entry for the [Ladies of Hive Community Contest #286,](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-286) which poses two questions each week for us to reflect on as a community; so if you’re looking for an active community with interesting weekly prompts, [CLICK here 👌 ⭐ ✨](https://peakd.com/c/hive-124452/created)
