How would you address it? If you have children, what would be your best advice for your child if they were to become a victim of bullying, and what would you do? ✦](https://giphy.com/gifs/lopezontvland-lopez-bullying-3oKIPfCvj5eSigPGnu)
![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)

>\n\nNo tengo hijos. Pero tengo una opinión muy clara sobre el acoso escolar, y es que siempre esta mal, que jamás será justificado, y nunca debería ser defendido, cosa bastante común y que me decepciona muchísimo, siendo que por ejemplo si lees el apartado de comentarios en redes sociales sobre un caso de acoso escolar, nunca faltan las opiniones sobre que ésta o aquella característica de un niño \

. Eso te hace cuestionarte qué clase de especie somos, teniendo tecnología para enviar seres humanos al espacio pero al mismo tiempo persistiendo en dinámicas sociales tan bajas como no condenar con la seriedad que amerita, el que un niños agreda sistemáticamente física, emocional o verbalmente a otro, incluyendo también la incitación de otros a unirse de forma intencional y reiterada al _bullying..._ El asunto es extenso, hoy los padres y representantes olvidan que sus niños son personas, o mejor dicho adultos en formación, y que tanto lo bueno como lo malo que hacen esta en sus manos para ser reconocido o corregido. Que dejar solo a un niño por horas sin supervisión tiene consecuencias y mucho mas si le has dado acceso a internet o a un celular o computadora que no están supervisando, porque entre los panoramas a los que el pequeño se expone, no es solo a convertirse en victimario sino también a volverse victima de otros.
![LOH010526_2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/EpNqn2FH754KyKWVgwNbBxSFXEsdFvYJS4VD4Rk2M7BFrLoPzwPL9j2Q4aiy8Shueuy.png)

> El ámbito escolar es complicado, crecer es complicado. Pero no todo es caos sin posibilidad de solución, hablando de mi país, en Venezuela afortunadamente comienzan a instaurarse con formalidad sistemas tanto para proteger a las victimas de acoso escolar como también para detener y castigar a los bullies. Ya existen procesos para hacer las denuncias y las instituciones educativas están en el deber de reportar ante la ley los casos dentro de su población estudiantil. En mi ciudad, creo que uno de los planteles más efectivos en su lucha contra el bullying son los colegios arquidiocesanos, que por ejemplo esta semana, en el que queda cerca de mi casa sé que ha sido visitado por fiscales y abogados especializados en el tema para dar charlas de educación, prevención y también advertencia sobre el tema. Creo que eso es muy genial y aunque a nadie le gusta ver a un niño siendo esposado y metido en una patrulla de policía, creo que si eres capaz de acosar a otro ser humano al punto de dañar su salud emocional, o hasta el extremo de que quiera quitarse la vida, entonces eres perfectamente capaz de responder ante la ley y aceptar las consecuencias de tus acciones. El bullying no ocurre por accidente, es una decisión consiente de quien escoge comportarse así y creo que eso es lo que lo hace tan terrible y perturbador.

> >! [ENGLISH VERSION] > I don’t have children. But I have a very clear opinion on bullying: it’s always wrong, it can never be justified, and it should never be defended—something that’s all too common and deeply disappoints me. For example, if you read the comments section on social media about a bullying case, there’s never a shortage of opinions claiming that this or that trait of a child “provoked it, brought it on themselves, or deserved it.” > > That makes you wonder what kind of species we are—having the technology to send humans into space yet at the same time persisting in social dynamics as low as failing to condemn with the seriousness it deserves the fact that one child systematically attacks another physically, emotionally, or verbally, including inciting others to intentionally and repeatedly join in the bullying... > > The issue is vast. Today, parents and guardians forget that their children are people—or rather, adults in the making—and that both the good and the bad they do are in their hands to be acknowledged or corrected. > > Leaving a child alone for hours without supervision has consequences, and even more so if you have given them access to the internet or to a cell phone or computer that is not being monitored, because among the scenarios to which the child is exposed, they risk not only becoming a perpetrator but also becoming a victim of others. > > School life is complicated; growing up is complicated. But it’s not all chaos with no hope of a solution. Speaking of my country, Venezuela, fortunately, formal systems are beginning to be put in place both to protect victims of bullying and to stop and punish the bullies. Procedures for filing complaints already exist, and educational institutions are required by law to report cases involving their student body. > > In my city, I believe that one of the most effective schools in the fight against bullying are the archdiocesan schools. For example, this week, the one near my house was visited by prosecutors and lawyers specializing in the issue to give talks on education, prevention, and warnings about the topic. > > I think that’s really great, and although no one likes to see a child being handcuffed and put into a police car, I believe that if you’re capable of harassing another human being to the point of damaging their emotional health—or even to the point where they want to take their own life—then you’re perfectly capable of facing the law and accepting the consequences of your actions. > > Bullying doesn’t happen by accident; it’s a conscious decision by someone who chooses to behave that way, and I think that’s what makes it so terrible and disturbing.
![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)
https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYmU2dm81eDlsNWp2NDF3aHNhcjk3NjJ2ZHNzMm11N2hnNG4yY2JscyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/3o6Zt8m998wNODOvvy/giphy.gif [✦ Are you a fan of horror movies, action movies, or are you more into romance? Tell me about a movie that taught you an important lesson ✦](https://giphy.com/gifs/southparkgifs-3o6Zt8m998wNODOvvy)
![blue bunny.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/23tkmuzuuk5Jqmm1Rb77yCfUBmMY6yB8HT5xFf8bZrjW3cR4tQ9hpaYyJCt1YLHGNoEEC.png)
>\n\nHace algunos años me encantaba ver películas de terror todo el tiempo, mientras trabajaba o hacía mis que haceres del día a día solía dejar en bucle sagas como \

; también me gustaba ver películas de bajo presupuesto o independientes, y mis favoritas siempre han sido las de zombies. De ellas sinceramente no hay ninguna lección importante que aprender (los universos apocalípticos son muy distintos unos de otros pero sobre todo bastante fantasiosos... quizá la única lección útil es que el ser mas peligroso siempre serán otros seres humanos) pero indudablemente son entretenidas de ver, si te gustan los efectos especiales, la creación de atmosferas inquietantes o la dirección de vestuario. Hoy no veo películas tan seguido como antes, pero cuando tengo tiempo aún me gusta revisar el catálogo disponible y ver qué hay de nuevo, especialmente en el apartado de anime. >! [ENGLISH VERSION] > A few years ago, I loved watching horror movies all the time; while I was working or going about my daily routine, I used to have series like *Final Destination*, *Saw*, *28 Days Later*, or *Hellraiser* on repeat. I also enjoyed watching low-budget or independent films, and my favorites have always been zombie movies. > > Honestly, there aren’t any important lessons to be learned from them (apocalyptic worlds are very different from one another but, above all, quite fantastical… perhaps the only useful lesson is that the most dangerous beings will always be other human beings), but they’re undoubtedly entertaining to watch if you like special effects, the creation of unsettling atmospheres, or costume design. > > I don’t watch movies as often as I used to, but when I have time, I still like to browse the available catalog and see what’s new, especially in the anime section.
![LOH010526_Cover.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tesmoforia/Ep3fGE2utmLHZVuUTuaypCNZcW24VrgmcUKP7V1PqPcvNkw6sRNe5PZktgwSe8h9Zuz.png) ✦ Please take good care of your children. Today more than ever, the love and care of mom and dad are vital. Today more than ever, the love and care of mom and dad are vital. We can’t control what others do, but we can do our best to protect our children—teaching them to defend themselves but also to ask for help, and not to let anyone isolate them or leave them feeling helpless ✦

body.body:
>

 **A warm greeting to all of us coffee lovers in this community #cinnamoncupcoffee.**  

  



 


<div class=\

> Coffee has always been a part of my life, and it’s also part of the past—a time filled with memories that are always there, making us sigh and feel fortunate. When I read the topic, I also remembered a famous café called El Gran Café. It doesn’t exist anymore, but I always pass by there and recall those dates from my youthful romances; I hope they reopen it someday. Back when I was a student, when I was 20 and in college, there was a little café where I always met up with my classmates during our free time. We spent so many hours there, sharing stories about certain classes and professors. I remember that whenever I walked past that place, the smell of coffee was amazing, and those moments spent there were meaningful to me. My friend would always order his black coffee and I my creamy latte; this would recharge us, since sometimes we were overwhelmed by so many exams and presentations, A cup of coffee reminds me of the drive and desire to keep moving forward, to pass each semester and reach that goal of becoming a professional. It was such a wonderful time we spent in that little college café with my group of classmates—people I still hang out with today and always remember.Today I went to a new coffee shop, reminiscing about those wonderful moments, sipping a creamy latte with a cookie, because coffee and studying are the perfect combination to keep going. That’s all for now, my fellow adventurers. Thanks for reading. That's all for now, my adventurers. Thank you for reading.

Cuando lei el tem me recorde tambien de una cafeteria famosa llamada El gran Cafe, actualmente no existe, pero siempre paso por alli y recuerdo aquella cita de aquellos amores de juventud, ojala la vuelvan a activar. body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - The Broken Swing
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - The Broken Swing. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcT_EPgJG8lFICuW75btXA4Bbz0sPgHYF_OnwLvX55OSZw&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcT_EPgJG8lFICuW75btXA4Bbz0sPgHYF_OnwLvX55OSZw&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcT_EPgJG8lFICuW75btXA4Bbz0sPgHYF_OnwLvX55OSZw&s=10)

Standing in the backyard of the old house, Louis is feeling emotional as he looks at the broken swing built by his father when he's a young boy. Born into a low income family, Louis's grandfather passed on early when his father was a kid, thus the absence of the father has a long lasting impact. Louis's dad was determined to be present in his life. Despite not received much quality education, his father make ends meet with odd job, but there's always food on the table. 

Toys and entertainment was a luxury in the family, as expenses are tightly managed by his mother and only when the savings account grew then he would be given a chance to purchase a out of season toy.

Louis loves going to the playground down the street for the swing. Sensing his son's love for the swing, Louis's father spent 6 months collecting all the material and self made a swing for him to which he's overjoyed.

Now that his father is gone and the broken swing is still in the house, it's not only a broken swing, it's a symbol of love for the son by the father, and a key item Louis remembers his father. An item he will proudly tell his own son of the story behind. 

What's your item or symbol of such love?

body.title: A pair of red friends in nature 🐞
body.body:
> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUwkud8pEV83r8cgsgR1zugbBCKLMQriXxPFhzjkdPQjy/1777675910224.jpg) ### Assalamualaikum 💞 How are you all? I hope you are all well by the grace of Allah. I am also well, Alhamdulillah by the grace of Allah. I am starting today's event with the wish for everyone's good health. This extraordinary sight came to my attention while walking in the garden today. A pair of tiny butterflies are spending their time on a green leaf in the sunny afternoon. Their bright red-orange color and shiny backs are a unique piece of nature's art. Every tiny creature in nature is an important part of our ecosystem. These tiny insects help pollinate plants and also play a vital role in maintaining the balance of the environment. This contrast of red amidst the green foliage added a different dimension to my camera lens. body.title: How do you apologize?
body.body:
>

I have a buddy. I think. He's more of a friend's friend. Actually he's my friend's sponsor, helping him to stay sober and going through the steps and all that. My friend is in a high stress situation at the moment, so I encounter the buddy a little more frequent than usual, and we get along well.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://usermedia.actifit.io/8c30a9c9-12f7-4f01-9447-b74948bb98cf.jpg

Today, I was coming back from the gym, earplugs in and deep inside my own head. I was almost at my house when he tabbed on my shoulder. \

More laughing. We talked for a bit about our friend, and about the olive bread that I had given him, which he loved and wanted more of. Then we split ways.

All fine, a good laugh with rough humor, so I thought. Later our friend asked me if I had met the buddy today, and I said yes. Apparently he *did* get insulted by my joke, but laughed anyway. It's a bit weird to me, as it was a genuine laugh and conversation between the two of us. But now way I wanted to hurt him, so I wrote him and apology.

And that's a long story to talk about how to apologize. There are many options. The most common that people use when having to apologize washed down, half-apologizing, half-blaming. 

>\

Blurry. Everything is conditional. No real taking responsibility.

>\

Even worse. Basically saying the other one just has a crappy sense of humor.

> \

Not even an apology?

And it could go on like that. There are many ways to *try* to apologize, but a real apology comes from a place of honesty. It has to be genuine and sincere. No talking around. No evading the subject. Recognizing the mistake, taking responsibility, mark the lesson learned.

>\

If you hurt somebody's feelings, you do. And most of the times that's sincere. So the apology has to be, too. There are of course those who make it a habit to always be hurt and insulted by anything, but the vast majority of people aren't like that. And I do not like to hurt people. And I do know that my humor can be questionable. I do get too confident too soon, I do enjoy making that kind of jokes with people I trust - but I trust too quickly.

It's important to me that people set me limits. Afterwards, I can always choose if I can go bananas enough within those limits to call it a friendship. Because a friend does have to accept most of what I am. So do I with a friend. If someone is insulted by everything all the time, they'd never be close to me. And they wouldn't want me close, either. I'd be friendly, of course, but distanced. 

#### What's your worst experience with your own humor, or when did someone else's \

hurt you and why? ___ What are your thoughts about this topic? Please feel free to engage in any original way, including dropping links to your posts on similar topics. I'm happy to read (and curate) any quality content that is not created by LLM/AI, as well as read your own experience and point of view, I love to learn! > Pictures taken with a Motorola Edge 60 Pro, I reserve the copyright - but feel free to ask if you want to use one of the pictures!

body.title: Five Minute Freewrite: the broken swing
body.body: >Miguel grew up in a boxing family and as a matter of fact, even his grandfather and great grandfather were boxers. His father had always taught him that when faced with a situation, he should swing first then think later.  One day on his way to school, he witnessed a fight between guys and he thought of stepping in to resolve the issue. However, unexpectedly one of the fighters landed a blow on his face and like his father had advised, he returned the punch and landed on his own back. He was eventually able to resolve the issue.  He got to school quite late due to this but every other thing for the day went as planned. But on his way home something happened, he witnessed a fight between two girls and it was very heated. As usual for him, he tried to step in to diffuse the situation but unlucky for him, one of the girls was someone he had a crush on. Immediately he noticed she was the one, he became confused and the funny thing is that she was not aware of his feelings for her.  During the fight, she mistakenly landed a punch on his face but for the very first time he had what we call the broken swing because his punch did not land or move. It was at this moment he came to question everything he was taught. He now realized that it's not every time he needs to swing before thinking. ** ** ** ** You can participate by clicking [here.](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/1-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3090-the-broken-swing) [Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/body-boxer-man-portrait-muscles-1846668/) ** ** ** **

body.title: PowerUp Day Mayo 2026
body.body:
Hoy es primero de Mayo, Día del Trabajador, felicidades a todos y no olviden de agradecer que tienen un trabajo (en el caso que lo tengan) ya que es difícil no contar con uno. Yo estoy contento porque después de pasar años desempleado (aunque trabajaba por mi cuenta la cosa no avanzaba como queria) ya conseguí un empleo, es duro, es agotador, pero es trabajo honesto. Epero estar un tiempo en la fábrica mientras termino mis estudios de programación para optar por un puesto un poco menos agotador.

Hoy también celebramos el Powerup Day, el momento ideal pata hacer crecer nuestra cuenta en Hive. Les mostraré un poco como ha mejorado mi cuenta este año a pesar de lo bajo del precio del Hive. 

<center>*Acá va la imagen de hivestats pero no quiere caragar*</center>

En febrero mi HP estaba en 2480, ahora en mayo con el pequeño powerup que acabo de hacer he llegado a 2685, lo cual representa un incremento del 8,3%. Claro que ese aumento no solo ha sido con powerup, también debemos tomar en cuenta las recompensas de autor, aunque han sido bajas ya que mi actividad últimamente ha estado centrada en Dbuzz por falta de equipo y tiempo. Sin embargo cada Hive cuenta para que mi cuenta crezca.

Hablando de Dbuzz y el posteo diario, mucho ya saben que este año me propuse ganar la insignia de autor anual, es decir, pasar un año entero posteando todos los días, y hasta ahora no he perdido, espero no perderlo, es por eso que me valgo de la herramienta Dbuzz y de vez en cuando realizo un post en formato largo. 

También me propuse ganar la insignia de powerup diario, pero ese si fallé hace un par de meses y ya no será posible conseguirlo, sin embargo la insignia del mes de abril sin duda la conseguí, todo el mes estuve haciendo el powerup de 1 hive cada día sin falta. 

<center>*Acá va la imagen de el powerup month pero no quiere caragar*</center>

Los logros que ya he conseguido son las 4 insignias de posteo mensual, enero, febrero, marzo y abril estuve posteansdo cada día, eso también me da el logro de posteo semanal y todo suma para la meta de la insignia anual. 

Hablando de las curaciones, ha estado bastante baja porque como dije antes, mi actividad ha bajado bastante dentro de Hive al no contar con una PC. Tengo un teléfono pero no puedo hacer lo que hacía desde mi PC, no sé como  muchos pueden trabajar completamente desde su teléfono, cuando yo me demoro muchas horas en hacer algo sencillo. Realmente se me complica mucho trabajar desde el celular. Muy pronto estaré comprando una PC para poder trabajar mejor y más seguido dentro de la Blockchain.

Para finalizar, los animo a realizar powerup en sus cuentas aprovechando el precio actual del Hive. He visto como otras veces este precio bajo no es aprovechado por muchos y luego escucho los lamentos, mejor dicho, leo los lamentos. 

Espero tengan un mes de prosperidad, éxitos y bendiciones. Feliz noche. 

<center>*Por alguna razón no me cargan las imágenes así que  las colocaré cuando solucione ese problema.*</center>

body.body: ** ** ** ** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQC7aGBqgpdvAEfWUwHBqSHrbdqa45MmDbFZgK7bFaatR/img_2583.jpg) ** ** ** ** At the edge of the village playground stood an old swing. It was once been the most loved spot for every child. Its wooden seat was smooth from years of use, and its ropes had carried countless laughter into the air. But one rainy season, the ropes snapped, and the swing hung crookedly from the tree branch. From that day on, everyone called it “the broken swing.” Children stopped going near it. They played football in the field or climbed trees instead. The broken swing became lonely, forgotten under the shade of the mango tree. One afternoon, a young girl named Ada walked to the playground. She had just moved to the village and knew nothing about the swing’s history. Seeing it hanging there, she asked the other children, “Why does no one fix it?” “It’s useless now,” they replied. But Ada did not agree with them. The next day, she brought strong ropes from home and asked her father to help. Together, they repaired the swing carefully. By evening, it was as good as new. When the villagers saw it, they rushed over with excitement. Soon, the playground was filled with laughter again. The swing flew high, carrying happy faces just as it had years ago. The broken swing taught everyone an important lesson: things that seem useless are not always beyond repair. Sometimes, all they need is care, effort, and someone who believes in them. Same applies to people around you. From then on, the old swing was no longer called “the broken swing.” It became known as “the swing of hope.” The children were happy again after a long time. ** ** ** ** You can participate by clicking [here.](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/1-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3090-the-broken-swing) [Image source ](https://pixabay.com/photos/playground-toy-swing-kindergarten-3393424/) ** ** ** **

body.title: Fui al hospital porque estaba enfermo.
body.body:
​

![774d7dcc-9d98-444e-839a-1aa818596a72.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeg2Rvc2CwdvTnwBeuAnn7dcK1JQ86d654VVM3j5S7cH6/774d7dcc-9d98-444e-839a-1aa818596a72.jpg)


Friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well, and I am also doing well. Alhamdulillah, today I am here to tell you about my whole day. Today was a pretty rough day for me, but I will share with you everything I did today. Let's start without further delay.

 > Amigos, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén todos bien, y yo también. Alhamdulillah, hoy estoy aquí para contarles sobre mi día. Hoy fue un día bastante difícil, pero les compartiré todo lo que hice. Empecemos sin más dilación.

I woke up today like any other day, but for some reason, I didn't feel very well after waking up because of a severe headache. I was very restless. I got up and drank hot water and everything, but still I couldn't find any signs that my headache was getting better. Soon after, my body started getting worse. However, I somehow managed to get through the morning and eat and drink in the afternoon. I thought that sitting at home like this wouldn't work anymore.

![bc6eb313-f816-40f7-b28e-cf39d657bf97.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfBdhBhFstP7EG119uZqpbCPPMJMuezbVcjT6uJszBZyy/bc6eb313-f816-40f7-b28e-cf39d657bf97.jpg)

 > Hoy me desperté como cualquier otro día, pero por alguna razón, me sentí mal al despertar debido a un fuerte dolor de cabeza. Estaba muy inquieta. Me levanté, bebí agua caliente y todo lo demás, pero seguía sin notar mejoría. Poco después, mi estado general empeoró. Sin embargo, de alguna manera logré pasar la mañana y comer y beber por la tarde. Pensé que quedarme en casa así ya no me serviría de nada.

​
![d42e3050-68ae-4aec-a783-9f40c43bb06a.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma7A8rFmeJypZHa5T5Y4Ex5kTHJKuzQhaRDpzYQ5KpUTt/d42e3050-68ae-4aec-a783-9f40c43bb06a.jpg)


I had to see a doctor, so I went to the doctor in the afternoon. Although two of my family members were with me, I booked a ticket to get checked up there. But now many doctors have gone home. But even then, I went to my specific doctor, booked a ticket, and went inside. I told him all about my problem. He said, \

\n\n > Necesitaba ver a un médico, así que fui por la tarde. Aunque dos familiares me acompañaban, reservé una cita para que me revisaran allí. Pero ahora muchos médicos se han ido a casa. Aun así, fui a mi médico de cabecera, reservé una cita y entré. Le conté todo sobre mi problema. Me dijo: \

.

​
![d42e3050-68ae-4aec-a783-9f40c43bb06a.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma7A8rFmeJypZHa5T5Y4Ex5kTHJKuzQhaRDpzYQ5KpUTt/d42e3050-68ae-4aec-a783-9f40c43bb06a.jpg)


Or these problems are currently happening due to waking up at night, which is not uncommon, and it is a very normal thing. Such problems are being observed in every household these days, which is a very bad thing, and we definitely understand this. The doctor prescribed some medicine and told us to eat a light diet for several days, after which we left the hospital.

![c519234e-ec6e-42f0-922d-005f2179b2a7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVykGmpJRoPfTCQhxYdNzyLSKor4iV9cfja2oHG86vbvz/c519234e-ec6e-42f0-922d-005f2179b2a7.jpg)

 > O estos problemas se deben a que nos despertamos por la noche, lo cual es bastante común y normal. Hoy en día, este tipo de problemas se observan en muchos hogares, lo cual es muy preocupante, y lo entendemos perfectamente. El médico nos recetó medicamentos y nos recomendó una dieta ligera durante varios días, tras lo cual recibimos el alta.

​

I saw that there were many shops selling medicine in front of me, so we bought the medicines. Here I bought medicine worth four hundred taka, and then I bought bread and two packets of milk for a light meal. It will be very beneficial, and you will like it very much. I will definitely meet you in one of my new posts. Until then, Hafez.

​

 > Vi que había muchas tiendas que vendían medicinas frente a mí, así que compramos. Compré medicinas por valor de cuatrocientos takas, y luego compré pan y dos paquetes de leche para una comida ligera. Te sentará muy bien y te gustará mucho. Sin duda nos vemos en una de mis próximas publicaciones. Hasta entonces, Hafez.

​

body.title: 🌸A Spring Woodland Mushroom Mound
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgViHvT9entMf7QJT5ZDuy7V6FVdCmnmBGUS72HhndjT/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89crhjnzbbewqjotcpaqihsaqk3kc8aze7tuec6aub2hdk38q4uzwtgsnyfdttkk9vvovrvfh4bdkqp7r6epgrdj9evg6qyria5rrjgmprc1gbjfzh86ja.png)


During spring, nothing inspires me more than the sight of beautiful blooms and fresh new shoots. I thought it would be something worth celebrating with mushrooms today. I haven’t been fungi hunting, but I’ve knocked up something to recreate the woodland in spring using wild edibles and, of course, the star of the show: mushrooms.

My idea is to make a mound which gives an overflowing \

look.

So here it is, something with a spring vibe for Fungi Friday.


Ingredients

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSukKnJjbq6PBqTVGdjPv8zRsoL2ZCPSvrRYu9bnzBYHx/d7b48be5_6044_407b_a3ff_60d4a8d25177.jpg)


Mushrooms
4 large mushrooms (portobello or big chestnut)
Olive oil or melted butter
Pinch of salt

Filling
200g cream cheese or soft goat cheese
3 cloves garlic (very finely minced or lightly sautéed)
1 cup young wild greens like dandelion, garlic mustard, plantain, young cleavers, hairy bittercress, and strawberry.(or any available assorted green you can collect)
Fresh Herbs (thyme, mint, parsely or rosemary)
Zest of ½ lemon
Zest of ½ orange (brightens everything)
Salt & black pepper

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbm9RA1RWPVj4hYayhLuGGJeBJa8C5BJ9YyipcdhqyYT4/e4b9083f_1506_4830_a10b_1a6abc3b051f.jpg)

and oops, ½ cup crushed roasted peanuts.


🌸 Spring forest decoration (after baking)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX67nX5Yqw8c1YFUaK9aQNo5oEwExhHARGaEKtLdLKA3M/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89ak7wkyjhd1syec9sx8vplsxglq4zg3wrfcw7bxjpkhsusunmpa86x8rwascxb5cgzcaxaqjujvqtkvjzjzcrqikbgaenx6td5xmafvf9tpetxda6ruki.png)

Blossoms: 
Dandelion 
Wild garlic 
Hawthorn 
forget-me-not
Lady's smock
Herb Robert
Red Clover
And whatever is available

Optional if available: Dates (as stones) and Goji berries

Dandelion heads (as mushrooms)
Horseradish leaf, Strawberry leaf and parsley (as moss/grass)
Lemon and orange zest (for tendrils)


🍯 Finishing
Fruit glaze or balsamic glaze or honey


🌿 Method
Prepare the mushrooms.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTea3KyUyBpKBTtddqiY6PGdTxkWQSjGh4MmEzW45Hbn1/35ac46a9_a46d_4165_a2f3_91200ab06494.jpg)

Lightly brush mushrooms with oil or butter
Sprinkle with a pinch of salt

Prepare wild greens

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc3Hkbu4von31JunFMDoEYfuq2W7SoT5k9WKUNH1DH6kG/bc0a1947_d20a_4318_ad6b_8916a9122940.jpg)

Chop finely

Make the filling

Mix together:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdPJEyCRbzBLGNZppN3YzZBvySh1RN8paQsvyKcsSknT6/2fc09cdc_b514_45ec_8631_c5276c1d02c3.jpg)

Cream cheese or goat cheese
Garlic
Greens
Crushed nuts
Herbs

Season well with salt & pepper

Stuff

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTE8n13v7aG5z8XeASoQ8k6UqhVwvQzt41nNiuKdsGpDo/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89ggaxqpfu1qehstpsozpuc6iicrfpdzhn5xcvrp5t2yzwghfswgqxbabeyvrwpqpfzt4b8biqswbjpe7e4cpzptbccb7zgkphasyuizurssrvfydyilke.png)


Place on top of mushrooms generously

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUoZFM3W7opp5BSaEGmQov8ZoLc8qqMdxrmbpKdtP9LmU/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89gvnvamxvxw5yvqp53ua4vsh1uvxtupbjyz2o7nsptpxtpcufvkemvwdgyrbnghh3ffnwwfgcvxesoytxc8fz6pmbducvsqyqcjuiaabbjeskhrl4cvjk.png)


Let the filling mound on top


Bake

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDetphSgBqhvDetZAp6pVjZqM43NRsHki6jWW2yz7dgJ/484e8712_7dbc_473e_8543_0fbedc9ab4ea.jpg)

Oven: 180°C (fan)
Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until:


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3uqg9tvq4M96R2k4zjvYnjufZ5g78X1RJkseRHvmxvy/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89ay7ceiie81sran6i8sa3rc29m9c8ah7aljew1nsb9gwmhawtbbxdp551gm1yuzqii2psnyfwqcqn655scshfb4jvcjuhmvkt17kqvqtg3ub66s92kjhq.png)


Mushrooms are soft and juicy.

Decorate (the magic step 🌸)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmagNg4raBaLgTCaLK7w74QRTF1q7ZwHaYuCBGH15vPqaK/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89a34kgqzvn2jrvdtbutzgqkfggdwazkkf3spde5jfanythrbcpkqik2x1cfhqtoysakdpykgev3v3xruj8v8id3m7hitfa49iuliyyrpu2mbaexwch8ni.png)

Lay greens and flowers on a wooden board.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQTgwc14km5spacAWRqdXi98Aekr3XaPtqzH35RWJLqPr/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89bj1xqxxwj42k4773rtj6dul6xwf8tjnjybrvzdelkp67m4963x3qlmo6kwrypuwbozmbbyeqkexp8fhspc96yqnbnqcu64e79u34lmv7yy5sren7dgg6.png)

Place the mushroom mounds on top.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcqPyajxmmenuDdDhUSdJpwqGMacRUwwrUjAkidGZbpwe/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89brkmh9jfljd8sr1nox2fzleyfzfnqdxuuqz78uhc1vawmpdtrf4u3m4iqyws3wwq6hfmq7rssvdxsz1l9fpqvqnq51xpk7kqugubg8z2jmgzeb6a7t3k.png)

Add more of the edible decorations.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUiWvQSAm6PidmZu6fwnWyX5eE4UZ7jMickz8gw5F9PG4/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89a3h6xigsp78ke31vcsh6ftbg1uopuvf6xvw9uvvmway4es2vcepen65ede4rm7l5k3axezixyjkmho8imzhkhxuxrrdpagutg5ap2czn96gjutp9uo6v.png)

I particularly like these dandelion heads as mushrooms sprouting between the mounds and also the dandelion flower stalks as tendrils as my new edible decorative discoveries.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbDkcrBAk4GqjRKqF6yBGoLoE6egvoMiKbYKEzLwWo4sE/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89csreu1ccuxgbdttwtozrf8erwjbfthtnt1vcy3p1imqnvaqsytmnqksm96xtnattlc25dzwarwi3y8ejct3vafsgtr5sp6ihfufovuztdlsi2q4hwtrg.png)


I proudly served it with a fruit glaze.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRaWAow6VFhbHzD7nfJ6npcwKUyV5qLtoboQpWBGP4oWc/7b4bio5hobgtgqketeq5jmbsn2ut8rlyxjcfdu89bdbtyi6npuevye4ffjnajyxhqbszs5v2uyfnddx7amcs7fpw7k7mhxzgbebxogkxtychfews412ikv7en2dbparg6lxqqbmyfmwchciubtkrue2csfpu.png)

And oh my! This tasted so good! The meaty, juicy mushrooms with a cheesy top and nutritious wild greens were delicious. The mint and other herbs, along with the lemon and orange zest really liven it up.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNkuosc1oFZqDKAVezF4icumEZk2X2g8uq17A3HTusKjr/5a488e49_757c_4ef2_bb7a_9c70779a9509.png)

It blended in beautifully, lol.

All in all, it was a lovely spring treat, and I'm really pleased with it.

And yes, it truly captured that living forest feeling!

Have a lovely day,

Mariah 💚🌼

body.body:
https://youtu.be/aZ4y48QL6Cg

[Originally uploaded to Bilibili.tv](https://www.bilibili.tv/en/video/4799396415544320)

This event was pretty good. A few moments were done for dramatic purposes but overall the situation was interesting and the players were all sympathetic. (well the villain could have been less moustache-twirling evil but I take what I can get)

Now I'm actually hoping to see a follow-up to this event where we go to Sumeru to visit Ashavapati and see how far his new tribe's coming along. I'd like to see it growing and being backed by Nahida and the Academia from the rainforest side. And that would mean they could bring the other desert dweller who was working to help the desert. And Nefer could also make an appearance as could Dori. Then this Sumeru story arc could finally take place where it belongs. It'd also be fun if they implied stuff about Cyrus II and Achaemenid Persia. Fingers crossed! And I think that's it for this update.

body.title: At the end of the day, the town is bathed in the colors of the sunset
body.body:
![IMG_20260501_180952_1_edit_144612692567234.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQRTWRpWKDGQx24fryoKdugBHNcGipmyBqs87beDQ6p5R/IMG_20260501_180952_1_edit_144612692567234.jpg)

Hello, friends of Gems, how are you? I’m grateful to God for allowing me to share with you again. Today I’ll be showing you this photo of the sun at its peak. 


![IMG_20260501_181021_1_edit_144927003887714.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXzwS9t1xhgwxHGcYMMr28DbgsEMbK5YmERSgpZsGkm3j/IMG_20260501_181021_1_edit_144927003887714.jpg)


It started to set this afternoon. Today the sun was strong, it was very hot, and it was beating down hard, but the best part of the day is how the town’s landscape looks in the afternoon, as the sun’s rays begin to shine through the clouds and color the town with their beautiful, picturesque hues, creating the sunset.

body.title: Un agradable calentamiento antes de entrar a la pista 🔥💕😎🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️.
body.body: > Dia Jueves, hoy toco entrenamiento de intervalos. Antes de iniciar este tipo de entrenamiento muy importante realizar un buen calentamiento. Para calentar fui al parque que esta cerca del estadio, estaba muy hermoso el amanecer, y el parque estaba muy transitado, y con hermoso arboles floreados. En el calentamiento prepare mi mente para la tortura 🤣🤣🤣🤣. Llegue al estadio me hidrate, y comence el ejercicio, para hoy lo planificado fueron velocidades de 200 mts, gracais a Dios, no fue tantos metros la tortura 🤣🤣, el descanso fue de 60 segundos, fueron 15 repeticiones. El tiempo promedio de las velocidades fueron entre 0:49:3 segundos la mas baja y la mas alta 1:02:0, los ritmos promedios de los intervalos de 200 mts estuvieron alrededor de los 4:30, ritmo acorde a mis tiempos. --- A la mitad del entrenamiento, tome un descanso mayor de 60 segundos, tome dos minutos, para agarrar mas fuerzas, y estabilizar un poco mas la frecuencia cardiaca, y culminar por completo todas las series. Gracias a dios culmine con todas las series, si que se siente super cuando terminamos lo planificado en este tipo de entrenamiento, gracias a Dios ya no me siento como antes cuando hacia este tipo de entrenamiento, mareada, y con las piernas como un plomo de pesadas, he mejorado mi alimentacion y esto ha sido vital para sentirme mejor en los entrenamientos intensos. Seguimos con los entrenamientos runners.💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>It’s Thursday, and today is interval training day. Before starting this type of workout, it’s very important to do a good warm-up. To warm up, I went to the park near the stadium; the sunrise was beautiful, and the park was bustling with people and full of lovely flowering trees. During the warm-up, I mentally prepared myself for the torture 🤣🤣🤣🤣. I arrived at the stadium, hydrated, and started the workout. Today’s plan was 200-meter sprints. Thank God, the torture wasn’t that many meters 🤣🤣. The rest period was 60 seconds, and I did 15 repetitions. The average times for the sprints ranged from 0:49.3 seconds (the slowest) to 1:02.0 (the fastest). The average pace for the 200-meter intervals was around 4:30, which is in line with my usual times. --- > Halfway through the workout, I took a break longer than 60 seconds—about two minutes—to regain my strength, stabilize my heart rate a bit more, and finish all the sets. Thank God I finished all the sets; it really feels great when we complete what we planned in this type of workout. Thank God I no longer feel like I used to when doing this type of training—dizzy, with legs as heavy as lead. I’ve improved my diet, and this has been vital for feeling better during intense workouts. We’ll keep up with the running workouts.💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://strava.app.link/gT8giGesN2b) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://strava.app.link/gT8giGesN2b) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/un-agradable-calentamiento-antes-de-entrar-a-la-pista)

body.title: Brutally honest about Hurghada
body.body: It's been almost two years since our vacation in Egypt and I'm still writing down my impressions. Either I was too lazy to do it earlier or that country truly enchanted me so much that I can still recall everything in detail. Honestly, both are true, I have to admit, but that's also the beauty of traveling. Even years later, you can remember and share all the interesting moments as those have happen yesterday. I will wrap up this story about with this blog and I'll leave you some links to the previous parts that I posted in different communities \[before I figured out how Hive actually works and that Worldmappin is the right place for stories like this\]. 😊

/>

We arrived in Hurghada after about a four-hour bus ride from Luxor. What we could see from the bus as we approached the place didn't impress us at first, we immediately wanted to go back to Cairo. :) I'm completely honest. When we got there, it was the same feeling. Slightly more colorful and shiny shop windows on the main street stood in huge contrast to the trash everywhere around, even right in front of five star hotels, which was still a shock to us. To be fair, our country - Serbia isn't exactly a country with a strong awareness of environmental care either, we're shocked by things here too.

Our first day was reserved for exploring the surroundings. We got pretty discouraged when we realized there was nowhere nearby where you could freely approach the sea and walk along the shore. Nope, nothing like that. _\

/> On the second day, we paid for a day pass ticket at a Sunrise resort. 25 euros per person, which was about the standard price everywhere at the time. We had access to the beach, pool, sunbeds, towels, food, water, coffee and juices... It was nice, not expensive, everything was tasty, but again somehow a small stretch of beach, a small pool, enough for two or three hours to look around, take a dip, grab a bite and then you are bored. That's when we confirmed to ourselves that it was a good thing we didn't book an all-inclusive package, we're just not that type of tourists.

/> In the evening, we went for a walk. Their marina is soo beautiful, especially at night when everything shines and reflects in the deep dark blue sea. We sat in a Havana pub, sipping cocktails, really cool place, totally relaxed atmosphere, the waiters were excellent. That's where we tried shisha for the first time. Nothing spectacular, but interesting for a first try and something completely unfamiliar to all of us.

(that's what I found on Google how tourists call it, hihi xD). Sensitive stomach, probably because of the ice in the cocktail the night before, so that day was also for lying around and watching movies. A couple of Netflix accounts were still logged in, thank you, wonderful people, previous guests.\n\n

/>

On the fourth day, we decided to give a public beach a chance, one nearby. Entrance was 90 pounds, which is like 200 of our dinars or 1.6 euros per person, basically nothing. The path to the beach literally goes like this, no lies:  
\-> from the main street full of signs in Cyrillic like \

- Misha clothing, good price... everything tailored to Russians, you enter a short, muddy alley with a strange smell, then pass through a fully equipped amusement park that probably hasn't been operating for a while, go past three abandoned buildings, between a warehouse of toilet bowls and granite tiles (I am not kidding, it really was like that) and then you end up at the beach. And the beeeeeach - amazing! <3 You wouldn't believe it.\n\n

/> Everything clean, no trash, the mattresses on the sunbeds super soft. Yes, they were old and grayish, but they were leather, so you figure they can't hold dirt like fabric ones. You put your towel over it and it's perfect. At the beach bar, three guys working there were incredibly kind, they adjusted the sunbeds, moved them wherever you wanted, didn't ask for tips, prices were the same as for locals, no difference.

/> No crowds, just a few local families and a couple of tourists besides us. On both sides, beaches three times smaller belonging to some hotels, same water, worse sunbeds... nothing makes sense... On the fifth day, we booked a trip to Orange Bay. It was really nice on the boat, the ride itself, the sunbathing, the delicous fod we had for lunch. We didn't dare to try snorkeling, which is actually the whole point of the trip to that island. We thought we'd be swimming there when we arrive, but in reality, it's just a stop for Instagram photos, people literally wait in line to take pictures on giant swings. The water is extremely shallow for like a kilometer from the shore, and you can't walk to a normal depth to swim. Don't ask how I know, I tried. 😅
/>\n\nSixth day - quad biking, 25 km to some kind of Bedouin village in the middle of the desert where they have a well-rehearsed \

, but they are cuuute. One woman makes those thin flatbreads, kids light fires using camel dung, others prepare tea for you and so on. Everyone knows it's not real village, but we all kind of pretend it is. The ride through the desert itself was really cool, especially for us since it was our first time, but the quads are pretty beat up. They don't maintain them at all, every second one has faulty brakes and at some point oil starts spraying from the side, so watch your bare legs, I got burned.\n\n

/> In the evening, we went out again. Recommendation for The Blues at the marina, every other night they had live rock and blues music. 😍 Seventh day, we went back to that same beautiful public beach, packed for the return and left that day for buying souvenirs. We kind of messed up there, because we didn't really feel like shopping that day but we had to buy some fridge magnets. At 2 a.m. we boarded the plane, then via Istanbul back to Belgrade. ☺️ If you'd like to read about our adventures in Cairo and Luxor, here are the links: 1. [Our very first impression of Cairo](https://peakd.com/@bibana/our-very-first-impression-of-cairo-egypt) 2. [Exploring the Coptic museum](https://peakd.com/@bibana/exploring-the-coptic-museum) 3. [Luxor adventure pt. I](https://peakd.com/@bibana/luxor-adventure-pt-i-a-journey-through-egypt) 4. [Luxor adventure pt. II](https://peakd.com/@bibana/luxor-adventure-pt-ii-a-journey-through-egypt)

/>Thank you so much for reading. I hope you enjoyed it and that this makes you want to visit this country even more, if you haven't already, and experience its diversity, no matter how shocking or overwhelming it may seem at first. Love for Egypt! ❤️

body.title: fears of the unknown....
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUgKHXm1rZKJN8WMTcXwZVnScnifizwevNZh4FuxYRtQ4/1777674171248.jpg)



I wise man once said, the biggest limitation  in life is not that which we face, rather it's  from within, meaning only you can stop you...

there was this Oldman who came by the office. he is a well-known  chef, had traveled  far beyond the shores of these country doing what he knows how to do best, according to my boss he's  the best she's  known, but what happened, why isn't he settled maybe own his own space and run his own business.

the truth is these questions  and more had given rise to some deep curiosity  as to why things are the way they are, was it that he never thought  of business or putting  an end to the 9-5 routine  or there was never a window , an opportunity  or he just never thought about it


I realise that the truth is, it's  not that most persons do not what to break free from the rate race  but fear of the unknown is what keeps a lot of persons rooted at a spot,  secondly  they are so many  amazing  ideas that are really good due to lack of funding, a goldmine is buried. 

by the grace of God I'm  through with the educational  system and I'm  like ready ready now, oya let's  start, only to realise there are no jobs,  not like I'm  surprised cause I knew this outcome and had prepared my self for self sufficiency, I had made plans, strategies and hoped it all played  out well, but for some reasons I feel stuck between reality and expectations,  first off my plans  requires serious funding, secondly  in other to raise that funds I need a good paying job, save up and launch, same thing with a friend  of mine, an amazing guy with great  ideas, but no funds  to initiate.

starting from ground zero can be very difficult but once you can summon courage to overcome fears of the unknown  anything  is possible, after i observed certain things, I realise  that it's  best to start from the known(reality)  point to the unknown (Imagination).

overcoming these fears can be overwhelming,  when nothing  is happening and that feeling stuck in reality comes up, its all a matter of minds made up to run till you catch up  no matter what.

body.title: Як провести ідеальний день у Dublin Zoo в Phoenix Park
body.body:
/>

📌 Якщо хочеться провести день серед природи й тварин прямо в місті, Dublin Zoo у Фенікс-парку саме те місце. Це один із найстаріших зоопарків Європи, який постійно оновлюється, і нещодавно тут оновили частину просторів та експозицій, щоб зробити умови для тварин ще більш наближеними до природних.

Зоопарк величезний і поділений на тематичні зони: африканська савана, азійські ліси, тропічні будиночки, велика територія з левами, жирафами, слонами та іншими тваринами. Тут легко провести пів дня, кожна зона ніби переносить в інший континент.

Окрема атмосфера це те, як продумано зроблені вольєри: багато простору, зелені та оглядових майданчиків, де можна спокійно спостерігати за тваринами без відчуття “закритого простору”. Для дітей є інтерактивні зони, а для дорослих, кафе та зони відпочинку з видом на парк.

Прогулянка тут, це не просто “подивитися тварин”, а повноцінний день на природі в серці Дубліна.

❗️Важливо:  
• розташований у Phoenix Park - легко дістатися з центру Дубліна  
• квитки краще брати онлайн заздалегідь, особливо у вихідні  
• територія велика - зручне взуття обов’язкове  
• ідеально для сімей, пар або просто спокійного дня на свіжому повітрі

Офіційний сайт зоопарку:  
[https://www.dublinzoo.ie](https://www.dublinzoo.ie)

body.title: # PeakeCoin Server & Bot Downtime Update
body.body:
I wanted to give everybody a quick update on the PeakeCoin side of things.

For about the next week, some of the servers, bots, and automated systems may be down or running inconsistently while I move. I am only moving a few miles away, but it is an important move for my family. The goal is to get my children closer to their school and make daily life a little more stable for them.

That means some of the systems I normally keep running may have to be shut down, unplugged, moved, and set back up again.

This may affect parts of the PeakeCoin ecosystem such as:

- PeakeCoin trading bots
- Server-hosted tools
- Project test pages
- Mining-related setups
- Backend experiments
- Game or casino test systems
- Anything running from my local hardware

This is not the end of anything. It is just a short pause while life has to come first.

A lot of this project is built from home, piece by piece, with whatever hardware I can get running. Some of the servers are not sitting in a fancy data center. They are machines I have worked on, repaired, moved around, and kept alive while trying to build something bigger for the future.

So when moving time comes, the whole operation has to move with me.

I have been working hard to build PeakeCoin, the bots, the games, and the tools around it while also trying to build a better foundation for my sons. This move is part of that. Being closer to their school means less stress, less travel, and hopefully a better daily routine for all of us.

During the downtime, I will still be planning, writing, and improving the project wherever I can. Once everything is moved and connected again, I will begin bringing the systems back online one at a time.

The plan is simple:

1. Move the family first.
2. Get internet and power stable.
3. Bring the main machines back online.
4. Restart the bots and services.
5. Check logs, errors, and balances.
6. Continue building.

I appreciate everyone who has supported, followed, commented, tested, or even just paid attention to what I am trying to build here.

PeakeCoin is still moving forward.

Sometimes progress looks like writing code.  
Sometimes progress looks like fixing servers.  
Sometimes progress looks like packing boxes so your children can be closer to school.

This week, it is the boxes.

Thank you all for understanding.

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

body.title: Corp(se)-orations Are Evil!
body.body: ![CorpsAreEvil.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQme2wgN8yy8XPEjPSFm3i59hKkM7boEDaAqRDHJzPHuFG8/CorpsAreEvil.png) Designed in darkness. Built to suck people's energy dry. Corporations are a legal fiction that allows someone, or a group of people, to internalize all the profits and externalize all the costs. If a person chose to poison the local water supply by carelessly strip mining, that person would face many fines and stand trial as a criminal for crimes against humanity. But, if a corporation did the same thing, there is nothing that can be done against it. There is no one that can be held accountable. And the fines are paid by the corporation's customers. There is nothing that can be done to a corporation legally, except tear up the paper that defines it. And, how often will that be done, when many people are getting rich from owning a part of it. Especially the bureaucrats and politicians who could actually do something to that piece of paper. However, that is about to change. People will no longer allow the evil to continue once they see it.

> ## Bayer-Monsanto is poisoning you People have known that glyphosate is a poison that has been having horrible affects on the people who eat it. And, it is in everything. So, almost everyone is consuming it. It is banned in many countries. But, the one who is leading the world in organic food, is also the one where Monsanto has the most control of the politicians, America. So, what can the people do? If we sue Monsanto, it will just pay lawyers, and will not stop anything. Whichever side wins, the customers lose (and you pay for it if you want wheat) The only thing that will work is people growing their own wheat, without Monsanto. And then, everyone stops supporting Monsanto. No customers, dead corporation. (but it was already a corpse)

></center>
## Wallymart leaves towns without a grocery store

So, Wallymart moves into a town, drives all the smaller stores out of business, and then decides to leave because it is not profitable enough.

This is evil on so many levels.

And it is just considered \

competition. (when it is anything but) Wallymart should have analyzed the market size, and figured out if they could really support a store in the area. They aren't that bad at numbers, unless they are doing it on purpose. (Was this a veiled, purposeful, destruction of town?) The part that is really bad is that Wallymart doesn't pay anything for their destruction. They should be required to put everything back the way it was (but this cost will just be absorbed by the remaining customers.) If a corporation is allowed into a town it should have a responsibility to the town. A small grocer is dependent on the town, and the town dependent on them. And that is how it should be. But the corporation is larger than the town, and can build or destroy the town by any decision it makes. But, it is even worse. If you want to argue with Wallymart, it will take YEARS, and lots of court/lawyer time, and even if you win, you lose. And if you lose, you lose twice, or ten times. And you will often lose, because they are doing business how the business law says. Your town doesn't matter to those courts.

></center>
## the corporation can just up and disappear.

They are trying to fix this, but the money still disappears.

Lets say that a mining corporation wants to build a open pit mine. So, basically they are going to move a mountain for dirt, and leave a HUGE hole in the ground.  Now, the corporation is supposed to fill in this whole after they are done.  But it has only been fixed a few times.

So, the corporation makes money by selling copper, after it has mined and sold all the copper, where does the money come from to fill in the giant hole?  The income was already spent and dispersed to \

There is no income from customers.  The corporation has no money, and most likely no longer exists.  There is no one to sue, and there is no one to hold responsible.

The people/governcement has made the corporation sign agreements that they are going to fill in the giant hole, when they are through.  But, what good is that agreement when there is no one who can be held responsible.  And hi-jinks are everywhere:

* Just when the mine is being played out, the corporation spins off separate entity (another corporation) that has the responsibility of filling in the hole.  So, this hollow shell, is all that is left, no one to sue, not one to hold responsible.
* Similar, a \
corporation is created that is now in charge of the mine, and they continue mining forever.  They might not be outputting much at all, but they are still \

and so the hole doesn't need to be filled in… yet. * The corporation is still there, but all the people and equipment have left. The corporation was structured in the beginning to only deal with this mine. And all the equipment was leased (not theirs). And all the people were just employees and were laid off. There is nothing left but an empty office. The bureaucrats have learned this play, and are now taking a fee every year to pay for the future filling in of the mine. But do you trust the govern-cement to still have that money in twenty years? It is just bad all around. It is evil from the word go.

> Corporations are the ultimate in passing the buck. When the corporation isn't making any profits, there is nothing you can take from them. A lawsuit wins, and the corporation just files bankruptcy. You get nothing. When the corporation is doing evil things, like poisoning the towns water supply, they can delay remedy for decades, and then after it is SOOO proven, the corporation just disappears. A corporation can be in multiple countries, meaning it is not really under the jurisdiction of any one country. Then the corporation gets so big, bigger than many country's GDP, and then, who is really in charge? The countries are only in charge while the corporation agrees to use the govern-cement to hide behind. The corporations can end this at any time. And we will see this soon. Corporations with their own military. What will fix this is people manufacturing in their garages. Giving people a true alternative for acquiring manufactured goods. And then, all the customers can leave. The Wallymarts of the world will find they have few customers and they will become the corpses they have always been.

>\n
All images in this post are my own original creations.

El dia de ayer en la noche se entrenó como cada jueves, solo que en esta oportunidad no corri sino que fui a una clase especial de Tecnicas de Carrera,para potenciar la zancada.

La disciplina de correr lleva mucho mas que solo colocarse los zapatos y salir a correr, es conocer tu tipo de  pisada y que zapatos comprar, es conocer el cuerpo para saber como respirar, cual es la zona rapida o la zona lenta para aplicar economia de carrera, es disfrutar y  aprender de lo que haces, por eso es necesario realizar y complementar con aquello que ayude a mejorar. 

La clase la impartieron en La Plaza de Los Palos Grandes, con una asistencia de 28 personas, el entrenamiento duro aproxinadamente 1 hora y media

Entre 10 estaciones de ejercicios nos ibamos rotando para hacer ejercios con levantamientos de piernas de rodillas, zancadas largas, saltos, coordinacion. Se realizó 3 vueltas por cada estacion, lo cual confieso que en la ultima estaba agotada.

Me gusta hacer esta clase porque a veces durante el running inconscientemente vamos tomando malos habitos por ejemplo arrastrar los pies, no bracear bien, y el cansancio nos hace  adoptar malas practicas que pueden traer una lesión.

Estas técnicas pueden ponerse en práctica durante los entrenamientos para ir adpatando al cuerpo.

body.title: 1 million DEC by the end of the year. April  progress. / 年末までに100万DEC計画。 4月の進捗。
body.body:
![1 Million DEC Plan](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbYXpRYkgxkqNgmNxS13XBLUdiG3Gd3HMWGKzTP2Nm2Qb/image.png)

### [ENGLISH]

These are the results for April.

However, the price of the Foundation Pack remains low as ever.

![Foundation Pack](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqsoHHRaeiKuGn6ZcLc7QkDh6G1ZueEZ6Q2gunJ7n7BT/image.png)

Strange. According to my plan, Lux's Wheel would have been implemented, Frontier Mode would have become extremely popular, and the price per pack should have been around 200 DEC!

At the Town Hall, they mentioned that changes would come at the end of May, so I’ll look forward to the price jumping up when it gets implemented.

So, my DEC comes out to 4,677.622 DEC from rental rewards.

---

Now, the issue is SPS. The total SPS obtained in April from battle rewards and Brawls is 2,532.148 SPS. Of course, that includes my sub-accounts.

![Dark Energy Crystals](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbC4kvCYSCDaDSMoXvmhT33CVXztAcmQVNWBegbH8FHaB/image.png)

![Splintershards](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUoMsbMkZbMo9HNn6t38KvuB7xwniyqQhXQ9MQTK1QwCY/image.png)

Doing a quick calculation:

0.004204 USD × 2,532.148 SPS ≒ 10.645 USD
10.645 USD ÷ 0.0005247 DEC ≒ 20,287.783 DEC

So the total is about 20,287.783 DEC. My plan is 83,333 DEC per month, so this is nowhere near enough. It doesn’t even reach one-third of the target.

Earning only through battle rewards seems quite tough. In the latter half of April’s season, I managed to earn 1,940 SPS (≒ 15,352.025 DEC), but that was the result of pushing pretty hard, so I don’t think I can maintain that pace. 😔

The monthly target of 83,333 DEC corresponds to about 10,400.767 SPS, so I would need to earn at more than four times April’s pace... 😖

---

If I take April’s reward pace as the standard, that’s about 20,287.783 DEC per month, which becomes 243,453.396 DEC over 12 months. Unfortunately, that doesn’t even reach 300,000 DEC, let alone 500,000 or 1,000,000 DEC.

Even after reaching Gold League at season end, this is the result. In the end, my estimates were too optimistic. 🥲

To turn this situation around, SPS would probably need to skyrocket—like 8x higher. If it only doubles, DEC would likely rise as well, so in DEC terms it wouldn’t change that much.

However, DEC is capped at 0.001. It shouldn’t go higher than that. If it did, everyone would sell aggressively to profit. 🤣

If SPS is capped at 0.001 and then increases further—say 4x more, meaning the SPS price becomes 8x higher—then reaching 1,000,000 DEC wouldn’t be just a dream!

And at that point, Splinterlands would become hugely popular as a profitable Web3 game, attracting a large number of new players...

---

The images below include the BATTLE URL with a referral link.
If you are thinking of getting started, take a look at the BATTLE before you sign up.

[![BATTLE URL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFyv4Ep3buivhRL15L1YbU3DUKEKHTDSbKxQcwQUsuyC/image.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0f9afb5257750511d55dee2d9383fb52?ref=sakurakko)




![Separator.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sakurakko/23zSQpURqMgpo5FuaQVKT1UG8Dxmivcj6ZFG4XD7GLXtN5UkPKZi5j2byDtJpSdMjqZaU.png)




### [日本語]

4月の結果です。

しかし、Foundation Pack の価格は相変わらず下がったままです。

![Foundation Pack](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdqsoHHRaeiKuGn6ZcLc7QkDh6G1ZueEZ6Q2gunJ7n7BT/image.png)

おかしい。私の予定では Lux's Wheel  が実装されてフロンティアモードが大人気になって、1パックあたりの価格が 200 DEC くらいになっているはずだったのに！

Town Hall では5月末に変更されたという話なので実装時にぽーんと上がるのを楽しみにしておきます。

そんなわけで DEC はレンタル報酬 4,677.622 DEC になります。

---

さて、問題は SPS ですが。4月にバトル報酬とBrawlで入手できたSPSを合計すると 2,532.148 SPS になりました。もちろんサブも合わせてですよ？

![Dark Energy Crystals](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbC4kvCYSCDaDSMoXvmhT33CVXztAcmQVNWBegbH8FHaB/image.png)

![Splintershards](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUoMsbMkZbMo9HNn6t38KvuB7xwniyqQhXQ9MQTK1QwCY/image.png)

軽く計算してみると。

0.004204 ドル × 2,532.148 SPS ≒ 10.645 ドル
10.645 ドル ÷ 0.0005247 DEC ≒ 20,287.783 DEC

合計で 約20,287.783 DECですね。83,333 DEC / 1ヶ月 の計画なので全然足りませんです。目標金額に対して1/3にも届いていませんね。

バトル報酬だけで稼ぐのはかなりしんどそうです。4月の後半シーズンでは 1,940 SPS（ ≒ 15,352.025 DEC）稼げていますが、これはかなり頑張った結果なのでこのペースを維持できるとは思えませんです。😔

1ヶ月分のノルマである 83,333 DEC は 約10,400.767 SPS なので4月の4倍以上のペースで稼ぐ必要がありますね...ぐぬぬぬぬ😖

---

4月の報酬獲得ペースを標準とすると 1ヶ月で約20,287.783 DEC なので、12ヶ月分は 243,453.396 DEC となります。なんと 100万 DEC どころか 50万 DEC どころか 30万 DEC にも届かないという残念な状況。

シーズンエンドにゴールドリーグまで上がっていてもこの程度。結局のところ、見積もりが甘かったってことですね。🥲

この状況を覆すにはSPSが爆上がりして、8倍くらいにならないと駄目だろうね。2倍程度なら DEC も一緒に上がるから DEC 換算するとそれほど変わらないだろうし。

しかし、DECは 0.001 で打ち止めです。それ以上にはならないはず。それ以上に上がるならみんなガンガン売って稼ぐはず。🤣

SPSが0.001 で頭打ちになっている状態で、さらにSPSが4倍、つまりSPSの価格が8倍まで上がるようであれば！100万 DEC も夢じゃないです！

そしてそれはもう Splinterlands 稼げる Web3ゲームとして大人気になって新人も大量に増えて...

---

以下の画像をは紹介リンク付きBATTLE URLを含みます。
これから始めようと思っているなら、バトルを見てから登録してみてね。

[![BATTLE URL](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdFyv4Ep3buivhRL15L1YbU3DUKEKHTDSbKxQcwQUsuyC/image.png)](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_0f9afb5257750511d55dee2d9383fb52?ref=sakurakko)

body.title: Mi relación con el reloj | My relationship with the clock
body.body:
> Hace unos años vivía a toda velocidad, todo tenía que hacerse para ya y solía crearme unas listas de tareas para hacerlas en un tiempo poco racional. Eso era totalmente agotador, sobre todo porque cuando no lograba hacer mi lista de tareas o varias cosas en un solo día, me sentía la persona más inútil del mundo. Tanto así que yo no podía estar unos minutos acostada porque me estresaba; casi obligatoriamente tenía que hacer algo, lo que fuera, menos descansar. Se podría decir que era adicta al estrés causado por estar ocupada.
\n\n

> En ese tiempo yo no tenía una percepción realista del tiempo, siempre estaba en un estado mental de alerta total, como si el mundo se fuese a acabar al día siguiente. En esos momentos sentía que el tiempo pasaba extremadamente rápido, tanto que no me permitía cumplir mi larga lista de tareas. Lo peor de estar en ese estado es que no disfrutas para nada de algo importante en cualquier meta u objetivo, el proceso.

> Con el pasar del tiempo entendí, aunque me costó bastante hacerlo, que no está bien vivir corriendo porque la vida es una sola y debemos disfrutarla al máximo; por lo tanto, era importante disfrutar de los caminos. Antes pensaba que solo importaba el resultado, que el resto era secundario, pero cuando me dije a mí misma que debía parar y tomarme las cosas con calma, todo mejoró. Debo decir que no recuerdo exactamente cómo logré muchos de mis objetivos, ahora intento pasarla bien, aprender tanto como pueda para que quede un lindo recuerdo.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/8102186/pexels-photo-8102186.jpeg
Imagen de

>Cambiar esa mentalidad no fue nada fácil; incluso a veces establezco muchas metas y me siento mal por no lograrlas en poco tiempo. Sin embargo, a diferencia de antes, me detengo a reflexionar al respecto y cambio todo a un tiempo más realista o simplemente dejo que las cosas fluyan. Esa nueva forma de pensar es extremadamente relajante, cuando comencé a implementarla, lo sentí como quitar un enorme peso de encima.
\n\n

> Algo que antes hacía mucho era compararme con los demás, como si fuese una competencia en la que tenía que ganar sí o sí. Cuando escuchaba o veía que alguien lograba algo que una semana, mes o año, yo también lo quería hacer exactamente igual o en menor tiempo; ya se imaginarán lo mal que me sentía cuando no lo lograba. Eso fue hasta que entendí que todos somos diferentes, cada quien tiene sus circunstancias y por eso no podemos lograr exactamente lo mismo al mismo tiempo.
\n\n

> Ahora que miro hacia atrás, me doy cuenta de todo el estrés innecesario que pasé y los buenos momentos que evité por lograr lo que quería contra el reloj. No me gusta arrepentirme; hace años que me propuse no hacerlo, por eso no diré que lo hago, pero de haber hecho las cosas diferentes me habría ahorrado un montón de dolores de cabeza y mi galería tendría más fotos.
\n\n

> Así que no compitan contra el reloj, no se exijan cien tareas en un día, ni aprender un idioma en tres meses solo porque alguien más lo hizo. Vivan a su propio ritmo sin perder de vista sus metas ni sacrificar su felicidad.

Gracias por leer

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcbWiLfXdQC69eQCsnyduRBZPQct12Fwh1iXv1wLx7hHP/11.png

English

![s.alva.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT129XndCEEzxUYfY9DPxz78emNM8Twg3HogEVU1E4hFG/s.alva.png)

>A few years ago, I was living life at breakneck speed; everything had to be done right away, and I used to make to-do lists that I expected to finish in an unrealistic amount of time. That was totally exhausting, especially because when I couldn’t finish my to-do list or get several things done in a single day, I felt like the most useless person in the world. So much so that I couldn’t even lie down for a few minutes because it stressed me out; I almost felt compelled to do something—anything—except rest. You could say I was addicted to the stress of being busy.
\n\n

> Back then, I didn’t have a realistic sense of time; I was always in a state of total alertness, as if the world were going to end the very next day. At those moments, I felt like time was flying by so quickly that I couldn’t get through my long to-do list. The worst part about being in that state is that you don’t get to enjoy the most important aspect of any goal or objective: the process.

> As time went on, I came to understand—though it took me quite a while—that it’s not right to rush through life because we only have one, and we should enjoy it to the fullest; therefore, it was important to savor the journey. I used to think that only the result mattered, that everything else was secondary, but when I told myself I needed to stop and take things easy, everything got better. I have to say I don’t exactly remember how I achieved many of my goals; now I try to have a good time and learn as much as I can so that I’ll have a nice memory of it.
https://images.pexels.com/photos/8102186/pexels-photo-8102186.jpeg
Image by

> Changing that mindset wasn't easy at all; I still sometimes set a lot of goals and feel bad when I don't achieve them right away. However, unlike before, I take a moment to reflect on it and adjust my expectations to a more realistic timeline, or I simply let things take their course. That new way of thinking is incredibly relaxing; when I first started putting it into practice, it felt like a huge weight had been lifted off my shoulders.
\n\n

> I used to compare myself to others all the time, as if it were a competition I absolutely had to win. Whenever I heard or saw someone achieve something in a week, a month, or a year, I wanted to do exactly the same thing—or do it even faster; you can imagine how bad I felt when I didn’t succeed. That was until I realized that we’re all different, everyone has their own circumstances, and that’s why we can’t all achieve exactly the same thing at the same time.
\n\n

> Looking back now, I realize all the unnecessary stress I went through and the good times I missed out on because I was racing against the clock to achieve what I wanted. I don’t like to have regrets; I made a point of not doing that years ago, so I won’t say I do, but if I’d done things differently, I would have saved myself a lot of headaches and my gallery would have more photos.
\n\n

> So don’t race against the clock, don’t try to cram a hundred tasks into a single day, and don’t try to learn a language in three months just because someone else did. Live at your own pace without losing sight of your goals or sacrificing your happiness.

Thank you for reading

body.title: El peso del equilibrio | The Weight of Balance #HPUD
body.body:
![](https://img.leopedia.io/DQma1UAxYe7Y32JB8zCATP1NdzKXzdo1CioHeY3dj5chqaU/image.png)
## El peso de los cimientos Toda construcción humana es, en el fondo, un diálogo constante con la gravedad. En el proceso de elevar estructuras, de soñar con techos más altos y espacios más amplios, uno a veces olvida que el equilibrio es un arte de milímetros. Al intentar mover una piedra angular buscando una mejor perspectiva, el peso de la obra se redistribuye de formas imprevistas, recordándonos que cada acción tiene su propia inercia. Hoy me encuentro en ese silencio necesario del constructor que escucha el crujido de la madera. No es un momento de expansión, sino de sostén. Mi energía está volcada en asegurar que los pilares que compartimos, esos que sostienen los proyectos que han crecido bajo nuestro cuidado, no sientan la tensión de los ajustes que ahora me toca realizar en privado. Hay una responsabilidad silenciosa en mantener la estructura firme mientras uno refuerza las bases en la penumbra. El compromiso con la obra sigue siendo absoluto; el diseño no ha cambiado, pero el ritmo de la construcción ahora responde a la necesidad de estabilizar el suelo antes de seguir subiendo. ### La constancia como lenguaje Al final, lo que queda es el registro del día a día. Compartir mis estadísticas mensuales no es solo un hábito, es la forma en que el constructor muestra que sigue en el sitio de la obra, incluso cuando no se escuchan martillazos. Es la evidencia de que la voluntad de permanencia es más fuerte que cualquier desajuste momentáneo. Invito a todos a seguir fortaleciendo sus propios cimientos en este **#hpud**. Porque cuando el suelo vibra, lo único que nos mantiene en pie es la solidez de lo que hemos decidido cimentar con paciencia y rigor. ---
## The Weight of the Foundations Every human endeavor is, at its core, a constant dialogue with gravity. In the process of raising structures—of dreaming of higher ceilings and wider spaces—one sometimes forgets that balance is an art of millimeters. In attempting to shift a cornerstone in search of a better perspective, the weight of the entire work redistributes in unforeseen ways, reminding us that every action carries its own inertia. Today, I find myself in that necessary silence of a builder listening to the creaking of the timber. This is not a moment of expansion, but of support. My energy is entirely focused on ensuring that the pillars we share—those that sustain the projects grown under our care—do not feel the tension of the adjustments I must now make in private. There is a quiet responsibility in keeping the structure steady while reinforcing the base in the shadows. The commitment to the work remains absolute; the design has not changed, but the rhythm of construction now responds to the need to stabilize the ground before climbing any higher. ### Consistency as Language In the end, what remains is the record of the day-to-day. Sharing my monthly statistics is not merely a habit; it is the way a builder shows they are still at the site, even when the hammers are silent. It is the evidence that the will to endure is stronger than any momentary imbalance. I invite everyone to continue strengthening their own foundations this **#HPUD**. Because when the ground vibrates, the only thing that keeps us standing is the solidity of what we have chosen to cement with patience and rigor. ---

body.title: La herencia del futuro
body.body:
Dicen que las herencias son bendiciones, pero para mí es una condena. La mansión de los Blackwood es hermosa pero hay algo mal con los espejos. Ayer mientras me cepillaba el cabello, vi a un chico en el reflejo. Estaba gritando golpeando el cristal desde el otro lado pidiendo ayuda. Lo más aterrador no fue ver al chico, sinó darme cuenta de que el reloj de la pared detrás de él marcaba las 8:00pm de hoy... Y apenas son las 7:55pm.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSY1ycrZiXXTqqGgDoCybDu7PRjgYM6DVjsVoJ4XJhGx3/1777670176830.png)

 No sabía que decir y cuando le iba a preguntar quién era. Escucho la puerta-\

-. Baje lo más rápido posible, y decidí buscar algo para poder defenderme, agarro la escoba. Abro la puerta lentamente levantando mi escoba, y cuando por fin abrí la puerta no había nadie. Empiezo a sentir escalofríos en mis brazos, y mis piernas casi me dejan de funcionar, y cierro la puerta. Empiezo a subir lentamente las escaleras y cuando veo, el chico ya no estaba en el espejo, solo un cristal normal con el mismo brillo de siempre. Cuando por fin me iba acostar empiezo a sentir un brazo en mi cabeza. Caigo de la cama y agarro mi libro de la mesa, el chico sonrió y me pregunta, quién soy, levantó una ceja sin entender que pasaba, y le hago la misma pregunta. El chico se presenta como \
aunque tenía mucha coincidencia conmigo, le explico al chico que me llamo \
y el chico se queda sorprendido. El chico parecía curioso ya que me hace varias preguntas. -Que año es hoy?-. -\
?-. Entre otras preguntas más, yo les respondo todas, aunque me hizo una pregunta que se me erizo la piel.-\

. No sabía que responder y asiento la pregunta. El chico sonrió y me mostró un contrato, el chico pide que firma el papel, pero decido leerlo antes de firmar una recompensa que no quisiera obtener. Mis ojos recorrieron las líneas de tinta roja. El contrato decía que el espejo me mostraría todo lo que desearía ver del futuro, dándome poder absoluto sobre mi destino. Pero al final cuando había firmado el contrato, lo que no me había dado cuenta era de las pequeñas palabras que decían al fondo del contrato: \

firme sin darme cuenta de las consecuencia que me podría traer. No lo podría creer, el chico sonrió con una mirada penetrante que hizo que entrara un escalofrío.

 Quería golpearlo, pero el chico desaparece dejándome sola y arrepentida. Ahora no se qué hacer, lo único que sé es que este sea mi último recuerdo al escribir estos pensamientos antes de ser una extraña de mi propio cuerpo, lo único que espero es que ninguna otra persona entre a esta mansión, sin entender las oscura verdad detrás de este lugar.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmefsWdvPBWRP3xnN15w36atDDAFBsxtwgjXCRehv3oSxZ/1777673386112.png)

Este es el promt que le di a Géminis para crear la escena de esta historia
