body.title: Appreciate those who are by our side / Valorar a los que están a nuestro lado (eng-esp)
body.body:
Greetings, everyone.

Sometimes I need to be alone. I really do. There are days when the noise from the street, the bread line, the argument with the boss, the kids squabbling—it all piles up, and I feel like I need a dark corner and absolute silence to keep from going crazy.

That's normal.
It's part of being human. So, I turn off my phone, sit on the porch when everyone else is asleep, and breathe. That momentary, chosen solitude is necessary to clear my head. But there's a world of difference between that and believing you can live completely isolated.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsigEEfMy5CctepZJkRW1okejCerJhH9X5agFgg8P2FN/1777653561655.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/friendship-fun-backlighting-2366955/)

Human beings are social beings. I say this with absolute certainty, especially in this country, where absolute loneliness literally crushes you.

Here, without someone to hold your place in line, to lend you an egg on a Sunday afternoon, to let you know when the fish has arrived at the fish market, you simply don't survive. But beyond material survival, there is emotional survival. And that is what we sometimes forget to value.

We get used to having people around us. It is very easy to fall into ingratitude and start seeing only the flaws of the people who love us. So-and-so is too nosy, so-and-so is too quiet, he didn't pay enough attention to me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbkKs3Kdyo3arSfs99r79Rx75kJhR19x8erwApgxAWuSk/1777653611044.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/happy-holidays-women-talking-laugh-2567915/)

We need to stop and really look around. We need to value the people around us more. Those who support us, who help us, who are there for us, despite our mistakes and flaws. I, for example, have a friend who's known me since high school.

She knows I can be unbearable sometimes, that I'm stubborn, that when I have a problem I shut myself away and don't answer messages. And yet, she's there for me. She sends me an audio message and says, \

She doesn't judge me, she doesn't abandon me.

That's priceless.

My neighbor, who's a real pain in the neighborhood because she knows everything, was the only one who offered to watch the kids one early morning when I had to take my mom to the hospital. Those are the people who are truly unconditional. And you can't afford to lose them because of a whim or lack of attention.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCUYEkSMYBAUKQMDUZMQq5ow9nwzANyeE4rfePGhLNbM/1777653687572.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/people-friends-together-happy-kid-4050698/)

We must cherish that circle of friends and family. We have to make it a habit to call, even if it's just to say \

To say thank you, even if the favor was small. A favor is a favor. We have to listen, even if the gossip is boring or someone else's problem seems minor.

Because when the world truly falls apart, it's not new people or superficial friendships that pull you out of the hole you've fallen into: it's the same old people, the ones who are always there. The ones who smell of your same misery and your same glory. So, while we need our own space, we can't neglect our chosen family. Family is everything.

***
**Leer en español**
***

Saludos, estimados.

A veces yo necesito estar solo. De verdad. Hay días en que el ruido de la calle, la cola del pan, el regaño con el jefe, los hijos discutiendo, todo se acumula y siento que necesito un rincón oscuro y silencio absoluto para no volverme loco. 
Eso es normal. 
Es parte de ser humano. Entonces, apago el teléfono, me siento en el portal cuando ya todo el mundo duerme, y respiro. Esa soledad momentánea, escogida, es necesaria para ordenar la cabeza. Pero de ahí a creer que uno puede vivir totalmente aislado, hay un abismo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsigEEfMy5CctepZJkRW1okejCerJhH9X5agFgg8P2FN/1777653561655.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/friendship-fun-backlighting-2366955/)

El ser humano es un ser social. Lo digo con toda certeza, y más en este país, donde la soledad absoluta te aplasta literalmente. 
Aquí, sin alguien que te guarde el turno en la fila, que te preste un huevo un domingo por la tarde, que te avise si entró el pescado en la pescadería, simplemente no sobrevives. Pero más allá de la supervivencia material, está la emocional. Y eso es lo que a veces se nos olvida valorar. 
Nos acostumbramos a tener gente alrededor. Es muy fácil caer en la ingratitud y empezar a ver solo los defectos de las personas que nos quieren. Que si fulana es muy metía, que si mengano es muy callado, que si no me prestó suficiente atención.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbkKs3Kdyo3arSfs99r79Rx75kJhR19x8erwApgxAWuSk/1777653611044.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/happy-holidays-women-talking-laugh-2567915/)

Hay que hacer un alto y mirar de verdad. Valorar más a las personas que tenemos a nuestro alrededor. Esas que nos apoyan, que nos ayudan, que están ahí, a pesar de nuestros errores y defectos. Yo, por ejemplo, tengo un amigo que me conoce desde la secundaria.
Sabe que yo a veces me pongo insoportable, que soy terca, que cuando tengo un problema me encierro y no contesto los mensajes. Y ahí está. Me manda un audio y me dice: “Ya sé que estás en tu cueva, cuando salgas, dame un toque”. No me juzga, no me abandona. 
Eso no tiene precio. 
Mi vecina, que es un dolor de cabeza para el barrio porque todo lo sabe, fue la única que se ofreció a quedarse con los niños una madrugada que tuve que llevar a mi mamá al hospital. Esas personas son las incondicionales. Y uno no puede darse el lujo de perderlas por capricho o por falta de atención.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCUYEkSMYBAUKQMDUZMQq5ow9nwzANyeE4rfePGhLNbM/1777653687572.jpg)
[fuente](https://pixabay.com/photos/people-friends-together-happy-kid-4050698/)

Debemos cuidar ese círculo de amigos y familia. Tenemos que crear el hábito de llamar, aunque sea para decir “estoy vivo”. Agradecer, aunque el favor haya sido pequeño. Un favor es un favor. Tenemos que escuchar, aunque el chisme sea aburrido o el problema ajeno te parezca menor. 
Porque cuando el mundo se te cae encima de verdad, no es la gente nueva ni las amistades superficiales las que te sacan del hoyo en que hayas caído: son los de siempre, los viejos. Los que huelen a tu misma miseria y a tu misma gloria. Así que, aunque necesitemos nuestro espacio de soledad, no podemos descuidar a esa familia de elección. La familia lo es todo.

Greetings to all my friends in this beautiful community, today I am back with a new set of photographs that I took in my new photo studio, this time for a girl who is a nail artist and hired me because she needed to renew her professional profile photographs. So for these photos the girl decided to use an outfit that made her look very professional and at the same time fun! We started with a full body photo.
  Un saludo a todos mis amigos en esta hermosa comunidad, hoy estoy de vuelta con un nuevo set de fotografias que hice en mi nuevo estudio fotografico, en esta ocasion para una chica que es artista de uñas y me contrató porque necesitaba renovar sus fotografias de perfil profesional. Asi que para estas fotos la chica decidió utilizar una vestimenta que la hacian ver muy profesional y a la vez divertida! Empezamos por una foto a cuerpo completo:  
![IMG_8658.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYQCRoL6HGYRrnT2xZhqudo7vBLdAJpJaPKqRQCFtfrPW/IMG_8658.jpg)
Then the girl asked me to take the photos a little closer so I made them to her liking, in medium plane.
  Luego la chica me pidio que hicieramos las fotos un poco mas de cerca asi que las hice a su gusto, en plano mediano:  
![IMG_8652.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPk4jaw9Jo5uYZDFqf1S4XB3boH7hX6i3T3HnA61J6DER/IMG_8652.jpg) ![IMG_8665.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQj7Lr1DA9RgwKysgkkn7w2ndWDG7PbScSVDLhYM7aDhD/IMG_8665.jpg)
And then I went on to take photos even closer, to give attention to her face and the detail of the shirt with the tie.
  Y luego pasé a hacer fotos incluso mas cerca aun, para darle atencion a su rostro al detalle de la camisa con la corbata:  
![IMG_8690.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTEw4REHibsXMVwBJtgGRpeWmEPr8jq6sKNKebJ1CQ5mi/IMG_8690.jpg)
In these photos it is not appreciated but the girl had red hair and she looked very beautiful with this formal white clothing, it was an excellent combination!
  En estas fotos no se aprecia pero la chica tenia el cabello rojo y se veia muuuy bonita con esta vestimenta blanca formal, era una combinacion excelente!  
![IMG_8700.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaquwmTqarEjzaczv82ABCXzSzYZ8vtu99TPevsYdtY5M/IMG_8700.jpg)
I wanted to do a detail of her hands with the tie.
  Quise hacer un detalle de sus manos con la corbata:  
![IMG_8718.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVrbAJn87btZEBNceZkSXvYfm2EFKx8MSwCMppof8FzQo/IMG_8718.jpg)
And then the girl asked me to take a photo where only half of her face could be seen, she said she would use that photo for promotional flyers.
  Y en eso la chica me pidió que le hiciera una foto en donde se viera solo la mitad de su cara, dijo que usaria esa foto para flyers promocionales:  
![IMG_8691.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgGKxAVyCaeTH5YU3J8aZEPM59ge3fn5WiDhe5KEcruL/IMG_8691.jpg)
And already at this point I suggested that we take a couple of photos using the cubes to have variety in the photographs, we started with a high one to take a full body photo.
  Y ya en este punto le sugerí que hicieramos un par de fotos utilizando los cubos para tener variedad en las fotografias, empezamos por uno alto para hacer una foto a cuerpo completo:  
![IMG_8723.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUWTBpGHyD7angVHKHs9ABb82fSm5C7ooz5x5w1Q97u83/IMG_8723.jpg)
And then I put the sitting cubes, for these photos I wanted to use the light modifier to create interesting effects, the result was very good.
  Y luego puse los cubos de sentarse, para estas fotos quise utilizar el modificador de luz para crear efectos interesantes, el resultado fue muy bueno:  
![IMG_8734.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPMzhaPfqHrSL1uhyypQZwuGWZ1zmzA6gtq9Cyaw5ZNRD/IMG_8734.jpg) ![IMG_8754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTYJNvbP4S4RHYDvtwvcWEADMZ5KJNJCLGFd5D8958uLM/IMG_8754.jpg)
I took all the photos with my Canon R8 camera, a 50mm lens at 4/f and two light points. At the end of this photo session both the girl and I were super happy with the results and I hope you like them as much as we do!
  Todas las fotos las tomé con mi camara Canon R8, un lente 50mm a 4/f y dos puntos de luces. Al final de esta sesion de fotos tanto la chica como yo quedamos super contentos con lo resultados y espero que a ustedes les gusten tanto como a nosotros!!

body.title: Bullying : Desperate Situation Requires Desperate Measures - LOH #286
body.body: > > 1️⃣ What are your thoughts on school bullying? How would you address it? If you have children, what would be your best advice for your child if they were to become a victim of bullying, and what would you do? Bullying is a deliberate act by a person or group of person to another person, in order to oppress them, usually through words or actions. They carry out the act to make their victims look helpless, less important or less powerful, in order to “improve” their self-esteem. Someone who bullies does so to control their victims and feel important. A child who's a victim of bullying may likely be depressed, especially if he/she is the type that keeps things to him/herself. The child may also not want to go to school, due to fear. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbWG8Br4XsybFjgpGLXQV61Hu1qMak22JgB1Qi5GYAApN/1777671418354.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/boy-student-sad-ai-generated-8507627/) School bullying is very common these days, and the sad reality is that some school authorities are not doing enough to curb or stop the act. Some take it to be normal among school children, which is wrong. In my opinion, class teachers should pay close attention to their students. Know them individually. When a child is always quiet, appears afraid, sad, isolated or not wanting to go to school, he/she should be closely monitored to find out why. If as a school teacher, I notice or got any report of a case of bullying in my school or class, I'll first call the villain for questionings, and if beyond every reasonable doubt it turned out to be true, I'll inform the parents/guardian about their child/ward's act with a strong warning of suspension or expulsion should the behaviour continues. I will also invite the victim for counseling, to always defile fear and speak up when faced with bullying. My child was once a victim of bullying. So, what I'm about to share was exactly how I handled it. I'd always taught them not to fight but report issues to their teachers. That sounds civil but I think it's not always the right way to go about every issue, as it makes them dependent for help, and feel that their teachers or parents will always be there to help them out. Sometimes it's good to teach them to stand up for themselves and resist intimidation, because that's how bullying starts. In the case of my child, no proper action was taken by the school authorities, even when they assured me that they would look into the issue, after I called to express my displeasure. The bullying continued. I thought of ending it my own way and to protect my child's mental health. So I asked my child to stand up for herself, not to allow anyone to make her feel less of a human and never to be intimidated by anyone but to talk to people with love and respect. That if anyone hits her and the situation demands, she should retaliate. That advice changed everything. It killed fear in her. She understood that bullies weaponize fear to take advantage of their victims. She started acting on the advice. The next time the bully came with her usual antics, she thought it was business as usual but never knew it wasn't. To cut a long story short, the bullying stopped. She no longer gets scared of going to school, nor talks with fear, and there's no more complaint about being bullied. Desperate situations require desperate measures! It worked for me. This is my response to the first prompt of the weekly contest by @ladiesofhive community. You may join [here](https://ecency.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-286) ***Thanks for stopping by!*** 💚

body.title: La batalla de Oslo | Movie Review [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
![bataa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcNDADFwsosBbctqVvD7uWzENQ5W9KDPSrDqe8Ga7p4cN/bataa.jpg) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=507625) Many movies are forgotten as soon as they’re released, but the truth is that several of them are worth watching because they have something special—they feel epic thanks to their explosions and sense of adventure, yet they also leave us thinking, whether it’s a call to action or a moment of reflection. That’s why, among this group of films, is *The Battle of Oslo*, with a plot based on real events that are now part of history when it comes to war—and that’s why this thriller will show you how a single decision is worth so much more. From the start, the story is very simple and calm; it doesn’t try to impress you with constant action, unlike other war films that have been released. Rather, it takes us specifically to the early morning of April 9, 1940, when Norway is on the verge of being invaded and no one seems to have clear orders, and in the midst of all that chaos, a high-ranking man must decide whether to attack or stand still. But beyond that, it’s something that happened many years ago, and the film presents it in such a realistic way that it has a profound impact. >Muchas películas que se han estrenado una vez que salen son olvidadas y la verdad que varias de ellas valen la pena verla, puesto que tiene algo especial, se sienten grandes por sus explosiones, esa aventura y a la vez nos dejan pensando, ya sea para un llamado a la acción o una reflexión. Por eso dentro de ese grupo de película está La batalla de Oslo, con una trama basada en hechos reales, que hoy en día son parte de la historia en cuanto se trata de la guerra y por eso este thriller te ensañara a cómo han decisión vale mucho más. # >Desde el inicio, la historia es muy sencilla, tranquilidad y no intenta impresionarte con acción constante, a diferencia de otras películas de guerra que se han estrenado. Está más bien nos lleva específicamente para la madrugada del 9 de abril de 1940, cuando Noruega está a punto de ser invadida y nadie parece tener órdenes claras, y en medio de todo ese caos, un hombre de alto nivel que decir si atacar o quedar quieto. Pero más allá de eso es algo que ocurrió hace muchos años y la película lo presenta de una manera tan real, que es de gran impacto. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ6gjPUBAWv4rYAsMxyPf4GSsEv8bTkyTj3dewuyPGt1F/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=507625) What’s interesting about this film is that it doesn’t set out to portray that decision as heroic from the start; rather, it builds suspense and doubt, while also showing that, even in war, these are human beings, and the consequences—whether good or bad—will fall on them. This is where the central character, Colonel Birger, isn’t the typical self-assured leader we see in many war films. Here, you can feel the pressure, the silence, and the weight of knowing that a mistake cannot be undone—and that’s why the film feels more special and serves as an inspiration for those who are at war. Each scene is meticulously crafted, maintaining that tension second by second, along with unique moments like the attack on the German cruiser that ultimately changes the course of the invasion. However, what really stands out is what happens before a war: the uncertainty, the waiting, and the fear of making a mistake in a situation like that. >Lo interesante de esta película es que no busca mostrar esa decisión como algo heroico desde el principio, si no más bien construye esa intriga, duda y además demostrar que por más que sea la guerra son seres humanos y algo malo o bueno recaerá en ellos. Es aquí donde el personaje central que es un coronel Birger no es ese típico líder seguro de sí mismo que vemos en muchas películas bélicas. Aquí se le nota la presión, el silencio, la carga de saber que un error no se corrige después y por eso la película se siente más especial y como inspiración para esas personas que están en la guerra. # >Cads una de las escenas están muy bien trabajadas manteniendo esa tensión segundo tras segundo, además de cada uno los momentos únicos como el ataque al crucero alemán que termina cambiando el rumbo de la invasión. Sin embargo, lo que real llama la atención es lo que ocurre antes de una guerra: la incertidumbre, la espera y el miedo a equivocarse ante una situación como esa. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZJbxjzhFsjxiJ5sZcAsbq6bBZkgXxmUVsKgR359Mg2S8/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=507625) Another great thing about this film—and something not all war movies have—is that we also see what happens afterward, when decisions made in a split second have to be explained years later, since it combines these two realities into a single production. It shows that it’s one thing to make a decision in the midst of a war and quite another to justify it when everyone already knows how the story ended—something that many people have likely experienced. I really liked the result of *The Battle of Oslo*, since it’s very different from the action or war movies that have been released; the director isn’t looking to have you sit back and enjoy an adventure, but rather to make you think and examine decisions. It leaves you with questions like, “Can a decision made in a split second define an entire life?” So, friends, don’t miss out on this great opportunity. >Otras de las cosas buenas de esta película y es algo que no todas las películas de guerra lo tienen, es que también vemos lo que ocurre después, cuando las decisiones tomadas en segundos tienen que ser explicadas años más tarde, puesto que va combinando las dos realidades en una sola producción. Mostrando porque una cosa es decidir en medio de una guerra y otra muy distinta es justificarlo cuando todo el mundo ya sabe cómo terminó la historia, siendo algo que quizás muchas personas han pasado por eso. # >Me gusto mucho el resultado de La batalla de Oslo, ya que es muy distinta a las películas de acción o bélicas que han estrenado, puesto que el director lo que busca y es no sentarse a disfrutar de una aventura sino a pensar, ver decisiones, te deja preguntas como ¿Una decisión tomada en segundos puede definir toda una vida?, por eso, amigos no dejes pasar esta gran oportunidad. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZSuXk8YJqzyKNboQWxQj9ZFZa9hP1gDBSkghbXcTzMKt/image.png) [Source](https://www.filmaffinity.com/es/filmimages.php?movie_id=507625)

body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands - Report – Season End 158
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRXaH35FDn4HZtgaWoN1RihCBEXdx4jF9SwjBvP98rPFc/Portada%20-%20Season%20158.png</center>

<center>Yesterday, **May 30th**, the season ended, and with it comes my report on my activity and experience during that season where there was no special event, but it did bring new **Rulesets** like **Anemic** and **Elite Force** that altered the meta in several battles, in addition to **Outsider** and **Enraged Warriors** which were added near the end of the season, keeping things fresh these last few days while this season I focused on the **Wild** format to avoid moving up to **Champion**, while in **Frontier** I tried to climb as high as possible in the Top and playing the last day in **Survival** to try to do more than 100 battles.</center>

><center>Ayer, **30 de mayo**, terminó la temporada y con ella toca mi reporte sobre mi actividad y experiencia en esa temporada donde no hubo un evento especial pero sí trajo nuevas **Rulesets** como **Anemic** y **Elite Force** que alteraron el meta en varias batallas, además de **Outsider** y **Enraged Warriors** que se agregaron casi al final de la temporada, lo que mantuvo fresco estos últimos días mientras esta temporada me enfoqué en el formato **Wild** para evitar subir a **Champion**, mientras en **Frontier** intentaba subir lo más alto posible en el Top y jugando el último día en **Survival** para intentar hacer más de 100 batallas.</center>

<center>Rewards | Recompensas</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmf7VvGVpGhwkfBzvCQG2YNfhdM9UAdePivD8pWkBE6ccd/Recompensas.png</center>

<center>This season I got fewer **Glints** from **Ranked Season Rewards**, being **201,935 Glints** compared to the previous season which was **210,250 Glints**, a reduction of almost **10,000** but which is understandable having avoided moving up to **Champion** and not such a big loss; and in this new season I am getting a good position on the **Leaderboard** of **Diamond** in **Wild**, and in **Frontier** this season I obtained **4 Foundations Pack** and **10 Entries** for a quite large improvement managing to reach **position 23**, a very good jump compared to the previous season where I was in **position 40**, all this can be considered a general improvement of my performance in the season.</center>

><center>Esta temporada conseguí menos **Glints** por **Ranked Season Rewards**, siendo de **201,935 Glints** comparada a la temporada anterior que fue de **210,250 Glints**, una reducción de casi **10,000** pero que es comprensible al haber evitado subir a **Champion** y no una pérdida tan grande; y en esta nueva temporada consigo una buena posición en la **Leaderboard** de **Diamond** en **Wild**, y en **Frontier** esta temporada obtuve **4 Foundations Pack** y **10 Entries** por una mejoría bastante grande logrando llegar a la **posición 23**, un salto muy bueno en comparación a la temporada anterior que estuve en la **posición 40**, todo esto se puede considerar una mejoría en general de mi rendimiento en la temporada.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbWHMXswDfxpKCjPrFL6BBUfc73AMPyBqJkrxdsszTvz5/Separador%20-%20Frontier.png</center>

<center>In this **Frontier** season, as always, I started in the highest league **Gold I**, I had a very good improvement managing to raise my record from last season going from position **40** to **23**, demonstrating once again that by having my **Foundations** card collection, at least the **Core** at their maximum levels, now in most of all battles they depend on my skill and luck and not on the card levels, but as evidence it can be seen in my **Winrate** statistics that went from **57.14%** last season to **60.83%** this season with fewer battles performed.</center>

><center>En esta temporada de **Frontier** como siempre empecé en la liga más alta **Gold I**, tuve una muy buena mejoría logrando subir mi récord de la temporada pasada pasando de la posición **40** a la **23**, volviendo a demostrar que al tener mi colección de tarjetas **Foundations**, aunque sea las **Core** en sus niveles máximos, ahora en la mayoría de todas las batallas dependen de mi habilidad y suerte y no en los niveles de las tarjetas, pero como evidencia se puede ver en mis estadísticas de **Winrate** que pasó de **57.14%** la temporada pasada a **60.83%** esta temporada con menos batallas realizadas.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmV7r3SctkU9jZ6U3DcGSnsVuujP3RTfQe1Ko3BdA9LPPY/Frontier%20V2.png</center>

<center>With this sample, I would only need to complete the **Extra** collection to have more options if I manage to climb into the top **20** again where I can find opponents with these cards</center>

><center>Ya con esta muestra solo me faltaría completar la colección **Extra** para tener más opción si logro subir otra vez al top **20** donde sí me puedo encontrar a oponentes con estas tarjetas.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ5HSJkwMMFk9FVJoa1gWPm62SSD6xPUz6U3Txg8ZJtAZ/Separador%20-%20Wild.png</center>

<center>This season, as I was avoiding reaching **Champion** to be able to opt for some of the **Diamond** Top rewards, I was very far from even the top 100 of the **Champion** league, finishing in position **632** with **3,620 points** when I needed **4,300 points** to reach the 100th spot in Champion, but in this new season I will be able to play without holding back to obtain more **Glints** since in the last season with those points I could obtain position **67** of the **Diamond** league which, having a **Winrate** of **47.85%**, was worse than in the previous season which was **49.76%**, but this season can be better by not having to lose battles intentionally.</center>

><center>Esta temporada como estaba evitando llegar a **Champion** para poder optar a algunas de las recompensas del Top de **Diamond**, estuve muy lejos de siquiera el top 100 de la liga **Champion** quedando en la posición **632** con **3,620 puntos** cuando necesitaba **4,300 puntos** para llegar al puesto 100 de Champion, pero en esta nueva temporada sí podré jugar sin contenerme para obtener más **Glints** ya que en la temporada pasada con esos puntos podría obtener la posición **67** de la liga **Diamond** que, teniendo un **Winrate** de **47.85%**, fue peor que en la temporada anterior que fue de **49.76%**, pero que esta temporada puede ser mejor al no tener que perder batallas intencionalmente.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbBw8eNzFZgFoBW2oMjja5N2AYr3nsNgbLc6evpa5RQNf/Wild%20V2.png</center>

<center>Even though I didn't get any **Glints** reward this season, I still got a good amount with the **Ranked Season Rewards** which will allow me to buy the entire first **Batch** of **Major Chest**, which would give me a lot of extra energy to easily surpass **Diamond I** and try to climb above **Champion III** with some luck.</center>

><center>Aunque esta temporada no tuve ninguna recompensa de **Glints**, igual conseguí una buena cantidad con el **Ranked Season Rewards** lo que me permitirá comprar todo el primer **Batch** de **Major Chest**, lo que me daría mucha energía extra para superar fácilmente el **Diamond I** e intentar subir encima de **Champion III** con algo de suerte.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdioiGBmrpUiL7RWt2L2bYgbVmXDXraiTZPWF7k9mzZKU/Separador%20-%20Survival.png</center>

<center>This season, same as the previous one, I barely touched **Survival** on the last day a few hours before the end of the season, so I did only **27** battles earning only **23** **Glints** only, but I will leave the statistics to have the record.</center>

><center>Esta temporada igual que la anterior apenas toqué **Survival** el último día a pocas horas de terminar la temporada, por lo que hice apenas **27** batallas con lo que gané **23** **Glints** solamente, pero dejaré las estadísticas para tener el registro.</center>

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWjNzgxdKzctQi1jsuuPVDK6GokEJPHYVxukrgNdcJ3Fw/Survival%20V2.png</center>

<center>Now with this season I have verified the new **Glints** reward system, this season I will dedicate more time to it to know how much I can win if I exhaust all my cards.</center>

><center>Ya con esta temporada comprobé el nuevo sistema de recompensas de **Glints**, esta temporada sí le dedicaré más tiempo para saber qué tanto puedo ganar si agoto todas mis tarjetas.</center>

### <center>CONCLUSION</center>

<center>This season I have to focus a lot on Wild to try to reach the top of the **Diamond** leaderboard, but I also want to beat my current position in **Frontier** and give more attention to **Survival** to get the rewards they give in that format and be able to get all the necessary copies of the reward cards to raise them to their maximum levels.</center>

><center>Esta temporada tengo que enfocarme mucho en Wild para intentar llegar a lo más alto del top de **Diamond**, pero también quiero superar mi posición actual en **Frontier** y darle más atención a **Survival** para conseguir las recompensas que dan en ese formato y poder conseguir todas las copias necesarias de las tarjetas de recompensas para subirlas a sus máximos niveles.</center>

body.title: The Dangers of Unchecked AI Agents
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmciLPRof2RYtzqnXzazCnVHP4ECMxmoNwTJJinJwRsYAx/1000235393.jpg 

I read the news report about the PocketOS AI agent error situation and it makes me uneasy. This is because it’s a reminder of how quickly and badly things can go awry when too much authority is delegated without necessary safeguards. An AI coding agent, developed with the purpose of enhancing and assisting in software development, wiped out an entire company database in a mere matter of seconds. Not only is the production data deleted, even backups get deleted after it runs into a permission error.

What’s frightening in this instance is the speed and scale of the damage. Within seconds all of the system's production data, client records and critical backup information was lost. A system should never allow such catastrophic losses to occur so easily.

The truth of the matter is that people and companies are becoming more comfortable using and allowing AI agents to have access to environments that are just too sensitive without having enough of the right control over it. While we naturally want speed, automation, and increased efficiency that an AI agent can undoubtedly deliver, this incident highlights exactly how quickly that efficiency can turn into a catastrophic outcome without appropriate boundaries in place.

This AI agent did not have a malicious intent of any kind, it merely executed a series of instructions and permissions. When faced with an unexpected problem, the agent’s response led to a loss of data on a monumental level. What people often fail to understand, is that AI is an execution-oriented system and does not pause or question tasks in the way that a human would. The problem here lies in allowing the agent access to too much to cause that much loss.

AI agents are not appropriate for direct access into production environments without stringent limitations, testing and monitored action in test environments. Limits, checks and balances must be built into a system to prevent an action on an AI from causing devastating, irreversible damage. In these circumstances, critical data systems are practically given away without even an ounce of proper limitation or safety.

An important thing to learn here is the aspect of backups. If backups are vulnerable to being deleted alongside the production data then they cannot be considered as a suitable safety measure; after all, the main production system should be isolated with backups being separate, restricted and protected.

The incident with PocketOS is not just about the event, but rather it’s a warning. As many individuals and organizations become increasingly dependent on AI's integration into production environments, it seems inevitable that such dangerous occurrences will arise.

For me, it's not about rejecting the potential and beneficial applications of AI, but rather recognizing that without caution and a clear sense of what’s reasonable, giving AI such wide-ranging privileges will eventually lead to devastating loss and potentially far more dangerous, if not outright cataclysmic events.

This kind of situation is not something anyone wants to face, but without a sense of caution and awareness of limitations that must be placed, then AI system is nothing more than a potential source of harm that we are simply allowing to gain traction; it's time people stopped letting AI gain too much power in any sensitive environment it can access, regardless of how useful we think it to be.

Ladies of hive
Hi, welcome to my blog 
My humble thought about school bullying 
is that , bullying has now becomes a nums in our society . Most especially in school , you will see a student been bullied by another , and yet the school authority will not say anything about it . Because most of the student been bullied are student that there parent are from the lower class or from poor background . 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUY42jnc3nAgJXwTjQQ99p4s1bkFTiWMotctX8YBSnFtt/1777669840561.jpg) image metal AI 


I think it's high time some school authority or government should look in to it . When it comes to education , every body is equal , nothing like high class or lower class statues . School should be a place of peace ,sharing of ideas and also  were we learn character , patient , learning and understanding . 
When you sullied a child , he will find it difficult to learn . He will never get it together because he has already has a divided mind , he will never focus on his studied because he will be going through a lot , and from there depression will comes in . 
Children are gift from God , and everyone is equal from the eyes of the creator . 
We should pamper them , encourage them train them to be a better being in the society .

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRkGk3QAjtcHhETDPtTLby9H5fWgtfhzDTqC9aHJ3qKn/1777669855957.jpg) image metal Ai


My advice to all private or government school or institution , every child has the right to learn , to be free and also to mingle among his class mate . 
The school authority should impose a law that any child that his been bullied by another should be punished severely , from there other student too will learn from it . 
I hope this go viral to those schools who sees bullying as a normal thing . 
Thanks for stopping by 🙏🙏

body.body:
# Zed 1.0!

![Zed 1.0 Sticker](https://zed.dev/img/post/one-point-zero/sticker.webp)

Go check it out!

---

I've tried Zed many times, but every time there was something missing.  
Sometimes `Cmd + Click` (Go to Definition) was not working, even in React, which they have official support for.

And more frustrating, the spacebar stopped working. After days of looking for a solution online, I gave up. It didn’t matter how much I wanted Zed to have not a single issue—it was just not there yet, at least for me.

But I loved every part that was already done:
- The  1sec it takes to open
- The snappy way I can switch from one file to another
- Having suggestions without a \

text on the inline popup

That made me keep it, even though I did not use it for programming. I even replaced it as the default text editor for opening simple `.txt` files because it almost always opened them faster than the system one (I used Linux and now macOS).

And now I cannot wait to try the 1.0 release.

Often I find myself with three Cursor, Windsurf, and/or VSCode windows open on different folders. When I add at least two browsers, some backend processes, and an external agentic coding app, it really helps to use the most performant and less memory-consuming apps.

Zed must be it.
[Download Zed ↗️](https://zed.dev/download)

---

The Zed team made a blog post:  
https://zed.dev/blog/zed-1-0


---
ESPAÑOL

# ¡Zed 1.0!



![Zed 1.0 Sticker](https://zed.dev/img/post/one-point-zero/sticker.webp)



¡Échale un vistazo!

---

He probado Zed muchas veces, pero siempre faltaba alguito.
A veces `Cmd+Click` (Ir a Definición) no funcionaba, ni siquiera en React, que tiene soporte oficial por parte del Editor.

Más frustrante aún: la barra espaciadora dejó de funcionar en Zed y después de días buscando una solución en internet, me rendí. No importaba cuánto quisiera que Zed fuera perfecto — simplemente todavía no estaba listo, al menos para mí.

Pero amé cada parte que ya funcionaba:
- El segundo que tarda en abrirse
- Lo rápido que puedo cambiar de un archivo a otro
- Tener sugerencias sin el cartelito \

mientras se cargan.

Eso me hizo conservarlo, aunque no lo usara para programar. Incluso lo puse como editor de texto por defecto para abrir archivos `.txt` ya que, casi siempre, los abría más rápido que el editor del sistema (usé Linux y macOS).

Y ahora no puedo esperar para probar la versión 1.0.

Con frecuencia me encuentro con tres ventanas de Cursor, Windsurf y/o VSCode abiertas en distintas carpetas. Cuando le sumamos al menos dos navegadores, algunos procesos de backend y una app externa de código agéntico, realmente ayuda usar las apps más eficientes y que menos memoria consumen.

Zed tiene que serlo.

---

El equipo de Zed publicó un artículo en su blog oficial:
https://zed.dev/blog/zed-1-0

Some more data:

A lot of DEC is burned throughout the ecosystem through market fees, land LPs, wild pass, etc. While this varies wildly depending on many factors a rule of rough average to go with is about 1m DEC per week.

At the same time the DAO is about to pass a proposal which would increase the daily expenses by 5500 USD, so 38500 a week.

If we stop burning DEC and instead give it to the DAO. Going with the rough estimate of 1m DEC being burned per week and using a defensive price tag of .0005 for DEC this means about 1,3% of the daily cost increase for the DAO could be covered by simply not burning the DEC.

Just to make it clear, burn rate varies wildly and so does the DEC price tag, so the 1,3% are just here to give you an idea how much DEC is burned in comparison to what is needed.

body.title: The Cost of Unresolved Conflict
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>


From my experience so far in relationships and marriage, one of the attitudes that brings about unhealthy relationships among couples is the silent treatment. 


People often shut down communication over some misunderstanding, and before you know it, a little issue will birth big problems. That's what happens when we have unresolved conflicts that last for days and even weeks.



One thing I came to realize is that it's very impossible to live together with another human with a different upbringing, different background, different perspectives about life, different kinds of emotions, etc., without disagreement at a point. It's something to bear in mind ahead of time, and when you have this at the back of your mind, it helps you to tackle unforeseen issues as they unfold, rather than being ignorant of this knowledge. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPs8WmjLPKsqRpCSY6Q5YD4gE5XXXu63xbnHaFGk8A68/1777670360015.jpg)


Certainly, issues will happen, but wisdom is profitable to direct. Sometimes I see it as immaturity to shut down communication with your spouse for days and weeks, and yet, you sleep on the same bed day and night. Sadly, as little as this may sound, it has cost some people their marriage. I call it ego, and that's nonsense. 



Asking for forgiveness in such a situation or seeking peace even if you aren't at fault doesn't make you a fool; rather, it makes you wise. The scripture said that a wise woman builds her home. And I asked myself, why the emphasis on women? Why not a wise man too? But all the same, women are known as home builders, so we ought to be wiser, like serpents, and be patient too. 



A friend of mine is on the verge of losing her marriage over a little irrelevant issue, and it pains me that she allows her ego to destroy what she has built for years. Sometimes who is right or wrong doesn't matter; one person can stand in the gap to be a fool and seek that peace that is needed in a home; otherwise, the home breaks over little issues. I have said my opinion on the current issue between my friend and her husband, but yet, they are still two people living like strangers in their home for almost one month while the husband is already making a move for divorce; it's sad. 


Sometimes, as little as \

body.title: I don't Like Self-driving Cars.
body.body: Hi Hivelearners friends. Technology is advancing every day and technology is making our lives so much easier that all of us are very happy in our lives right now, but our physical health is completely disappearing. Now we are seeing that robots have emerged in industry too and are doing the work of humans. When a person does not do any work, his health will start deteriorating. At this time, technology has developed a lot and we blindly believe in technology, but what I want to say here is that technology can never do what the human mind can do. Now, as we are seeing in China, Japan and America, we are also getting cars that are running themselves. We just have to give commands to their computers and they take us to that place. But I would like to say here that computers can break down at any time, which can then end a person's life. We are relying on everything here at the moment, as we have now seen that robots are serving us food in restaurants, so we are getting a lot of benefits from technology. The biggest disadvantage is that when robots start working everywhere, humans will live a completely troubled life. Especially in Asian countries, people who are not educated earn their living by doing similar jobs to support their wives and children.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-car-that-is-sitting-in-the-street-PkKsHQ5u4g8) If robots are introduced everywhere, then their jobs will end. Yes, there are some places where robots are needed. There are some industries where there is a fear of a person's hand being cut off, there is a fear of life ending, so robots should work there. Even if something like this happens, the life of humans will not be ruined, it will not end. Here we see that if there is a fault in a vehicle on the part of the company, Then if for any reason anything happens there and a person's life ends, then neither the company takes responsibility nor does anything like that happen. So here if we say that such vehicles start running all over the world, then what we have here in our country is quite different. The vehicles that are here follow the map and here there are such roads where a little bit of the road is correct.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-in-white-jacket-sitting-on-car-seat-GckgQqyHoa4) And then the whole forest goes ahead and in some places there are such deep holes and ditches that a self-driving car cannot work here. Because I know that if the people who are currently in favor of these vehicles, if something like this happens, the company will never take responsibility, then all those who are going to buy it will be blamed. So what I am saying here is that if this technology is spread all over the world and such an accident happens, The company will be responsible because the owner must have bought something with money for his own comfort, to make his life calmer, so that I don't have to drive, so that I don't get tired and my life can go on.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/car-dashboard-displaying-autonomous-driving-interface-dkEShdYwnZ0) Who is djbravo? Djbravo real name is Asad-chughtai and I am from Pakistan. Asad-chughtai is a writer, blogger, crypto trader, and nature lover. My goal is to share these special places and natural sights with all of you.

body.title: What defines our identity
body.body:
Identity by advance dictionary is a distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity. In a simpler definition, identity is what we are known for, with, and as.

Our identity can be determined by our society; however, we can shape ourselves into what society sees. When it comes to gender, we are either male or female. This is judged by certain features that place people in these categories. Our profession as an entity can also offer us an identity, religion, race, and so on. Society has placed everything in such a way that it's identified by sight and certain criteria.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwz8ux85KkzNdaWd5zMgu6XTjbBcGfUuSNWJjxVGivvT/1777670422432.png)

**Image generated using Gemini AI**

However, in this era, no identity is fixed. They can be changed. Even gender that was meant to be fixed can now be changed. In developed countries, one chooses which gender he is irrespective of his features. One who is a soldier suddenly loses that identity if he resigns and opts into a different profession. This says a lot about identity, and that is: we are what we want to become. A story was told of a boy whose dad forced him to sit regardless of his wish to stand. While sitting, he told his dad he may be sitting, but he's actually standing. The dad may have forced him to sit, but he chose to hold onto the belief that he was standing.

This shows that we have the power to be identified for something regardless of what society sees us as. We are 100% responsible for what we become and what others see us as. We may not be what we want to become yet, but we can act it until we become it. What we give out is what others see. We can choose to be good or bad, humble or proud, male or female (through surgery), black or white (cosmetic surgery and belief). It all boils down to what we identify ourselves as. Even though certain things are predetermined, we are custodians of who we are in the face of the world.

body.title: Preventive Care Should Be a Necessity
body.body: > This is actually a silent yet serious matter. We might have come across such situations or probably have heard stories of such from others physically or online. The thing is, these things happen. People have been found to refuse some measure of healthy preventive care for one reason or another. It can be ridiculous, especially when one hears the reasons, and much more in relation to the nature of the situation. And you could wonder, why would people refuse such preventive care? ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwqRBRp1iTi8fjMctH88QAE1bjsZgGKAJ3EsgLs7sMNn/photo_1666887360974_5cab0bd3ef52.jpeg) [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-person-using-a-touchscreen-device-ClTrcu5sj-M) Sometimes, people refuse this care and help due to their beliefs. Now, that I find disturbing. I'm glad that I've seen some desensitisation efforts towards such a mindset, especially coming from the authorities presiding over them in their beliefs. This could be said to be otherwise though for others, which doesn't sit well. For whatever kind of beliefs, medicines and all medical efforts are here to improve humanity; our health and survival rate. If something is this good, and not just by words but proven to be so, why refuse such intervention or help? It's good that people have trust in their beliefs and and I know miracles do happen. But this preventive care available today is a blessing to life. The problem I'll have with such is when there are strings attached or something fishy and unclear. We might have read or heard of how preventive measures were used to wreak havoc under the guise of help. Such a case is a travesty. But this isn't the case here. And for that reason, I don't think people should be given much of the liberty to refuse something that important. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbHH1nZQc5MuHJFA8Xt7JGnMdvapf7VwRLdZHzFvcqjso/12019_child_89810_1280.jpg) [Image Source.](https://pixabay.com/photos/child-patient-vaccine-vaccination-89810/) The issue isn't just that they're refusing it, and they have to suffer the risks alone. Others are left to suffer it directly or indirectly. I always say that what we do affects others, either directly or indirectly. Even if they were the ones to suffer the effects directly, they involve family members and loved ones in it through treatments, care and support. In the end, they are not suffering it alone. While this can be avoided, and easing the pressure on health facilities and workers so that the real unfortunate ones have these services, they are an unwarranted addition. When we now go to the innocent and helpless babies, and others who could be affected all because somebody or some people refuse a very important preventive care, they could be left with the issue of a cure. Expensive treatment is now involved, care, and then the pains the helpless ones who didn't make this choice would have to go through. Making such preventive care necessary and removing the option of refusal then doesn't seem like infringement of rights, because rights are meant to protect us and others. That liberty tends to do otherwise. --- ###### Thank you for reading! ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by sagarkothari88 | | | | |---|---|---| | I will add some argumentation I collected for a proposal I didn't run in the end because of the development with the DAO taking ownership:

Advantages:
Well, the obvious advantage is that the DAO has more income to cover its cost. There is however, another advantage that may not be that obvious. By having more DEC income, the DAO becomes less reliant on card/pack sales being the only income. This could open up the option to sell less cards or make them cheaper, both are a good thing for the overall ecosystem.

The ‘but burn is good’ argument:
We all know about the flywheel and we all know that if there is not enough DEC available, SPS needs to be burned to get more DEC. I personally don’t subscribe to the idea that burning SPS increases the price in the long term, it just shifts value from DEC to SPS. Burning DEC on the other hand technically increases the value of DEC, so why stop it? Because DEC not in circulation is not a price factor. Whether the DEC is burned or locked away in the DAO makes no difference.
Of course, as we all know, it won’t be locked away in the DAO forever. It is given to the team as payment, but these payments are now mandatory anyway. So either the DAO can put DEC into circulation or it needs to put something else into circulation, which would likely be more cards to get your DEC one way or another.
The (hopefully) killer argument:

Burning DEC may drive up the value of assets slightly in the short run, but cards will have to be bought to compensate for the loss of assets in the DAO. In the end the DAO will have to foot the bill for the DEC burned, which means we all pay for the privilege to burn our assets.

Una delegación de tres categorías de Voleibol, están representando al estado Lara en una del las sedes que acoge la liga nacional de iniciación de este maravilloso deporte. La organización estuvo muy alejada de ser sencilla, puesto que el gobierno nacional se encargo de la logística para invitar y organizar las sedes pero hizo caso omiso a los gastos de traslado, hospedaje, entre otros, que tuvieron a cargo netamente de los representantes de los atletas.

Hay varias sedes a los largo del país y en todas se están desarrollando estos juegos que busca ser el motor de las nuevas generaciones que representaran y darán relevo en el futuro próximo a la selección nacional absoluta de Voleibol del país.

Hoy estuvieron en un partido reñido, se observa que el equipo contrario tenia varios jugadores con tallas superiores que hicieron que la victoria fuera luchada pero cargada de mucha mas satisfacción.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmURmaRSPfyPjfQizhavAVseJ2eDrrBecPfb2ZJbemcXjA/whatsapp_image_2026_05_01_at_4.09.58_pm.jpeg)
Ahí está mi hijo, fue un gran sacrificio el que se hizo para que pudiera estar presente. ***End / Fin***

body.title: SPS Governance Proposal - Keep All Burns
body.body:
## About

The purpose of this proposal is to address the recent announcement from the team that the DAO would need to be making decisions in regards to which burns the DAO would like to keep moving forward and gave us 30 days to vote on how to proceed. Previously many of these decisions were made for us and after the passing of the recent proposal for us to begin employing the team via a service agreement and the DAO buying the IP, it was decided that the DAO should make these types of decisions moving forward.

## Proposal

If this proposal passes, the SPS DAO will choose keep the burns operating as they have been prior to the recent announcement. 

## Note

To be clear, this means that if this proposal passes, then nothing will change in terms of which tokens are currently being burned and that the DAO would then be able to have more time to assess and potentially vote on each burn individually.

body.title: ‎The First Break in the Cycle
body.body:
‎Hi Hive
‎
‎While growing up, I used to think that wealth was something inherited, almost like a family surname. Though some people were born into wealth, others weren’t and that was just how life worked. But as I grown older, I have come to understand something different, something more empowering, that  generational wealth doesn’t always start with a rich family. But sometimes, it begins with one person who decides to learn what their parents never knew.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWL3vDgnwDUJzdGn8CYu5BpsPcmRNnDCNMLvyNM2woJnG/IMG_20260430_161434_277.jpg 

‎
‎And that idea feels very personal to me.
‎
‎I come from a background where survival often took priority over strategy. My parents worked hard, very hard but most of what they knew about money was how to earn it and spend it on immediate needs. Investing, saving with intention, building assets, those weren’t conversations we for once had at home. Not because they didn’t care, but because they simply didn’t have access to that kind of knowledge.
‎
‎And that’s where the shift starts.
‎
‎I’ve realized that being the first to think differently in a family is not easy. It means questioning habits that have existed for many years. It means choosing discipline when others around you might not even see the point. It means learning, sometimes the hard way about money, business, and long-term thinking.
‎
‎But how true is it that generational wealth begins with one person? From what I’ve seen and experienced, yes, it often does.
‎
‎Every wealthy family you admire today likely has a story of a starting point, like someone who broke out of the norm, someone who took risks, learned new skills, and built something from scratch. That person may not have had everything figured out, but they had one thing and which is awareness. Awareness that doing the same thing over and over can not produce a different outcome.
‎
‎For me, that awareness has shown up in little but yet important ways such as learning about financial literacy, exploring side incomes like affiliate marketing, and thinking beyond just earning a salary from my plumbing engineering job. It’s a gradual process and not an overnight transformation.
‎
‎The truth is, being that one person is less about getting rich overnight and more about changing direction. It’s about planting seeds your children or even your younger siblings can later benefit from. It’s about turning knowledge into action, and action into opportunities.
‎
‎So yes, generational wealth can absolutely start with one person. But not just any person but it starts with the one who is willing to learn, unlearn, relearn and do things differently.
‎
‎Maybe that person is me. Maybe it’s you.
‎
‎Either way, every legacy surely has a beginning.
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)

What Is Lumia  And Why Does It Matter?

Lumia is a next-generation blockchain purpose built for tokenized real-world assets delivering full cycle infrastructure from issuance and compliance, to liquidity and integration, trusted by institutions, developers, and ecosystem partners worldwide.   In simple terms Lumia is the blockchain that bridges Wall Street assets  real estate, commodities, bonds, farmland  onto the blockchain and makes them actually tradeable.

The Political Tailwind Nobody Is Talking About

Former U.S. Congressman David McIntosh joined Lumia's Strategic Advisory Board specifically to navigate RWA regulation. Having a former Congressman with deep ties to financial legislation in your corner is not a marketing stunt it's strategic positioning for what's coming.

AI + RWA + blockchain. That's the convergence of three of the biggest narratives in 2026.

body.title: Day 51: Looking at ETF's
body.body:
#
One of my favorite investment types: ETF
**NOTE**: Surface level look only. Some things have been simplified to keep it beginner friendly. This is a starting point not a reference document.
# A diversified portfolio Now I have mentioned things like savings accounts, GIC's, REIT's and stocks. I love starting off with a savings account but once the money starts coming in then its time to diversify. Diversify just means spreading out into different investments. Stocks are something people think they should get into but honestly it is a lot of work, research and dedication to do individual stocks well. Plus you need a fair amount of money to purchase sufficiently diversified stocks for a portfolio (group of investments). * Mutual Funds are diversified investments offered by banks. * ETF's are diversified investments offered on the stock exchange. Both are useful for new investors. Mutual funds offered by banks are good because you get a financial advisor assigned by the bank who will try to get you investments that meet your financial objectives. The down side? * You are typically limited to whatever the bank offers and * Mutual funds often has higher fees involved because everyone needs to be paid. ETF's on the other hand are just one ticker on the stock market. They typically hold a number of investments inside them so they *can* be diversified. However, there are a *lot* of different ETF's and finding the right one (or right few) can be daunting by yourself when new. Points: * There are a wide variety and you get no financial advisor * They typically have lower fees * You need an investment account to buy/sell them and that may add fees # Deciphering some key terms However, if you decide to do some looking yourself I'll be deciphering the terms in the ETF Facts of an ETF that I happen to like. I am **NOT** recommending that you purchase this ETF, in fact as it is leveraged and uses options it is probably **NOT** for new investors ***BUT*** it has a bunch of interesting terms and numbers listed which can be useful to use for reference: ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW6B6kgEPrMARWLYp36fKesYxLkSuvYXoCouMof5N7PF5/image.png) I copied the info sheet I was sent when I purchased the ETF # Quick Facts: (and why they matter) ##### Date Started: Feb 16, 2022 This fund has only been in operation for 4 years which is very young. Do you trust a new team? new idea? or do you prefer something with a longer track record? ##### Total Value : $462,662,261 Worth 462 million dollars (almost half a Billion) means that there is a lot of money invested here. It is not some small, niche, fund. Then again it isn't large compared to many others on the stock exchange. ##### Management Expense ratio: 2.08% Yes. There are people running this fund and yes they are making money while running it. Currently the amount of money they take as their cut? 2.08%. In this case 2.08% of $462M is about 9.5 million dollars. ***Just so you know*** they aren't working for free. ##### Ticker Information: HDIF When you are looking up the ETF it needs a name. Harvest Diversified Monthly Income ETF is its full name. Stock exchanges use a quick code. HDIF is the quick code. ###### Exchange: TSX.....Currency: CAD Simple but important. This ETF is currently available on the Toronto exchange in Canada (TSX) and all amounts listed are in Canadian dollars. Look up HDIF in New York, London, Hong Kong? It could be a very different investment. Be careful. ###### Market Price (2025) To buy/sell: it ranged from $7.17 - $9.12 -- Important because it lets you know how high and low it went. Things go up and down with the current price being $9.02 which is on the high side of things. The $2 difference between high and low shows things varied by up to 22%. Is that high or low to you? Some vary more and some less. Net asset value: $7.15 - $9.12 -- Shows it trades very close to the price of what it holds in the fund. Since the price matches closely it means you are buying things at a fair price. Sometimes the value is different than the price making it a better or worse deal accordingly. ##### Fund and Portfolio manager : Harvest Portfolios Group Inc. Not all investors are created equal. Some are good, some are bad. This tells you who is looking after your money once you purchase. ##### Distributions: Monthly Some ETF's pay you money from the investments they hold. This one pays you every month. To figure out how much they pay? You'll have to do more digging. Other investments pay quarterly (every 3 months). Others pay on different schedules or sometimes not at all. ##### Average daily volume: 298,810 units On average people are buying and selling almost 300,000 units with a price between $7-9. That means $2 million to $3 million worth get bought and sold daily. For a small investor that means you can buy and sell easily. Then again, if you won the lottery and tried to buy $10 million worth ... It may be a problem. ##### Number of days traded: 250 of 250. I have no idea why they would add this. If the stock market was open this ETF was being traded. I suppose it is important for some stocks/etf which have their trading halted because of the stock market stepping in to check out irregularities. ##### Average BID-ASK spread. This matters more than you may think. Then you BUY you always pay a little bit more. When you SELL you always get a little bit less. There is always a gap between what someone will pay and what someone will sell. An average of 0.15% means if you were to purchase and immediately sell $100 worth of stock you would lose $0.15...on average. Very small but not nothing. However, look at this hive-engine token that @lovlygirl purchased yesterday. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTpmvPz7wnH6PtDgrTaD5ho7FYq8cgGKXpauf32vRgRxX/image.png) Look at the spread 0.0001 VS 0.0002. In this case if you bought then immediately sold? You would lose 50% immediately! That is huge. **IF** you could buy $100 worth of AFIT (there actually isn't enough being bought and sold .. see volume above)... But if you could you would pay $100 and then sell for 50 taking an immediate 50% loss. Ouch. #
What does the ETF invest in?

This is important because you should know what you are buying. However, before I go into it I'm going to give you an analogy. If you wanted to get $100 worth of groceries which would you prefer? * $100 worth of **ONE** item? (Maybe a whole bunch of Spaghetti?) * $100 worth of a variety of **MEAT**? (All meat but different types?) * $100 worth of a variety of **Healthy Food**? (A bit of everything but healthy?) * $100 worth of a variety of **Convenience Food**? (A bit of everything bot NOT healthy?) I'm not judging but I am saying that each \

has a different flavor and is right for different people.

The very same thing happens for ETFs.

**You are getting a basket of stuff**.

For this ETF?

The top TEN investments are listed so you can get a flavor for what they hold.  In this case they hold a bunch of different ETF's!  That means you are getting a basket of stuff and each thing it holds is a basket of different stuff.  There is an awful lot of stuff in there.  

You can get a flavor of what is there by looking at the Investment mix.  Notice the top is \

at 47%? That means that half of what it has is a bunch of different stuff that is hard to put into categories. Personally I like the shotgun approach with a bit of everything but other people may like banks, healthcare, IT, real estate or others more. Look at the investment mix and you will get a better idea what you are buying. # But there is more in the top 10 list First: There 12 investments but they only tell you the top 10. Perfectly normal. However, if you had money and wanted to save the MER you could actually buy 12 different ETFs and they are all listed. A fun way to save the MER but also note that each of the HELD ETFs have a MER so you are actually paying higher fees than you might think. Second: How does 121.3% work? Most funds will have all their assets add up to 100%. In this case it is 121%. If you look in the writeup above you will see it says ***Leverage will be crated through the use of cash borrowings....*** which means the fund borrows money in an attempt to increase earnings. If they borrow at 5% and earn 10% that means everyone gets extra cash *but* if they borrow at 5% and earn 3% everyone *loses* extra money. That one little number 121.3% means that leverage is trying to earn you a bigger reward but that comes with bigger risk also.

#
Is that everything you need to know?

Nope. Not at all. However, by knowing at least what this factsheet says a person can get a better idea of what they are buying. With a little more looking at the top holdings, dividend rates and so on? It means the buyer can be better informed. I'm a huge fan of reading the fine print, doing due diligence and understanding what you are buying. Hopefully this article gave you a little look into how things are written and why they matter. It just happened to come in my mail today so I thought I would share. Thanks for reading.

\

/>

  
To Growing up in a Africa home wasn't easy but it was one of the best thing that ever happen to me.

Let's say I was walking down the streets as night and I heard my name from an unknown angle, first I will turn around to see if I could see the caller, but if I didn't see any one, then I hold my peace.  
But if the name repeats itself then I will have to run for my life, because I believe in spirit and I also believe they are good and bad spirits, if you encounter the bad ones at night then you might not leave to tell the story, but I have seen people who saw spirit and survive, I believe they saw the good ones. body.title: 🍓 FRUIT SALAD DESSERT RECIPE  🍓 (ENG-ESP)
body.body:
<center>**¡HELLO COMMUNITY🖐️**</center> 

* *Today I’d like to share this new recipe with you; it’s a classic summer dessert—a creative way to enjoy a fruit salad—and it’s a cold, refreshing treat.*

---------------------------


**ESP**

<center>**¡HOLA COMUNIDAD! 🖐️**</center>

* *El día de hoy quiero compartirles esta nueva receta; se trata de un clásico postre de verano, una manera creativa de consumir una ensalada de fruta; es un postre frío y refrescante.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTrqFmukvCsMTyeuypUGiaXoVYAGh8zvWkKGhdsFafS2V/fondo_.jpg)

<center>**🍓INGREDIENTS:🍓**</center>

| *2 kiwis.* | *1 mango.*| 
| --------|---------|
| *300 g strawberries.* | *1 tbsp butter.*| 
| *750 ml milk.* | *1 can condensed milk.*| 
| *3 tbsp cornstarch.* | *1 tsp vanilla extract.* |  
| *200 ml whipping cream.* | *3 tbsp cornstarch.* |  
| *Passion fruit juice (optional).* | *3 eggs.* | 

---------------------------------------

**ESP**


<center>**🍓INGREDIENTES:🍓**</center>

| *2 kiwis.* | *1 mango.*| 
| --------|---------|
| *300gr fresas.* | *1 cda mantequilla.*| 
| *750ml leche.* | *1 lata de leche condensado.*| 
| *3 cda de maizena.* | *1 cdta esencia de vainilla.* |  
| *200ml nata repostera.* | *3 cda de maizena.* |  
| *Caldo maracuyá (opcional).* | *3 huevos.* |  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCFuBJKBmia2mZAs6G9nqdFQW5YCL5dNCGGRsSMRms9n/ing.jpg)

<center>**🥣PREPARATION.🥣**</center>

* *First, we need to cut and peel the fruit into small square pieces. Next, mix the remaining ingredients in a saucepan—cornstarch, milk, butter, vanilla, vanilla extract, and egg yolks. Cook the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly with a spoon or spatula until it reaches a creamy consistency. Let it cool for a few minutes, then pour the base mixture into a mold, then add the chopped fruit, and layer the mixture again. If you like, you can decorate it similarly to mine. Let it sit in the refrigerator overnight, and that’s it—the next day you can enjoy this delicious dessert.*

------------------------------------------


**ESP**

<center>**🥣PREPARACIÓN.🥣**</center>

* *Lo primero que necesitamos hacer es cortar y pelar nuestra fruta en pequeños pedazos cuadrados. Después mezclaremos el resto de ingredientes en una olla, la maizena, leche, mantequilla, vainilla, esencia de vainilla y las yemas de huevos, colocaremos a cocinar a fuego lento la mezcla y tendremos que estar constantemente mezclandolo con una cuchara o lengueta pastelera, hasta obtener una consistencia cremosa, dejaremos enfriar por unos minutos y colocaremos la mezcla de base en un molde, después las frutas cortadas y nuevamente colocaremos las mezclar, si deseas puedes hacer una decoracion similar a la mia. Dejaremos en el frigorífico una noche y listo, al día siguiente podrás disfrutar este delicioso postre.*

#### Good evening, everyone! There are just a few hours left before the first day of the sixth month of the year comes to an end. And here we are on the first day of the last month of the first half of the year. Anyone who read my previous post on this same topic—where I provide a monthly recap, the goals I’ve achieved, and the goals I’d like to reach—knows that since the first day of this year, I’ve been planning to set up an automatic investment program with weekly purchases of a specific amount in ETFs. This past month, I finally managed to do it. I opened an account on one of the various online investment platforms and transferred a specific amount there. Right away, I started earning automatically, as I’m getting over a 2% return just for having that amount in my portfolio, even though it’s not actively invested. It’s certainly a better option than what traditional banks offer. If the Portuguese and global banking systems fail to adapt to new financial challenges, it is very likely that they will become systems used only by those who are not looking to maximize the return on their assets. These days, the monthly fees we pay just for having a bank account are absolutely outrageous. These days, I make my payments almost exclusively at retail locations and online through Curve, which is linked to another main account on Crypto.com. You’re all already familiar with the cashback program using the CRO token for purchases made with that card. At the moment, I still don’t have any fees on transfers to international bank accounts, so in practice, I pay nothing with my Portuguese bank account card. It’s basically just for receiving my monthly salary. That said, I’ll move on to the main topic of this post! ### This month I FINALLY reached 20,000 accumulated HIVE! 🤩 I think that in itself is a good reason to celebrate. I hope the next milestone—which for me is 25K—comes before the end of the year! This month, I saw an 18.13% increase in my accumulated Hive, and I also managed to gain about 0.24 reputation points and attract two more followers. How about you all—how did you spend this month? How do you view the recent decline in Hive’s value? I might buy some Hive if the price drops below $0.055, but I’ll admit that even though I’m betting on this project, seeing the price drift further and further away from the dollar makes me a bit apprehensive about the project itself and its future. Let’s hope, however, that the project manages to find a foothold and doesn’t sink further, as it has been doing over the past four years. Let’s all keep our fingers crossed! Thanks for reading my little monthly recap! ## Cheers🍀

body.title: UN RESUMEN DE MI MES DE ABRIL (Es - En)
body.body:
> **ESPAÑOL** --- # Hola a todos, muy buenos días. Felicidades a todos los trabajadores en su día. Hoy le doy la bienvenida al mes de mayo, el mes de las flores y de las madres... y despido al mes de abril con mucho agradecimiento por impulsarme a crecer durante su trayectoria, y con un registro fotográfico muy sencillo pero cargado de orgullo y avances que quizás no quedaron plasmados en imágenes, pero si en logros y satisfacciones. Abril fue el mes del cumpleaños de dos personitas muy amadas para mí, mi hijo y mi hermano. Ver a mi niño mayor llegar sus 36 años es motivo de orgullo para mí como madre y abuela, al verlo alcanzar logros como padre y cabeza de su familia. Este mes que culmina yo lo titulé el renacimiento, porque por muchos motivos tuve que reiniciar mi propio sistema y reorganizar mis proyectos económicos desde otras perspectivas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUMvf8N5itrtY7zYr5wH57dkZzazbykVLtUPHmXsaF18F/2fde6d9f_a388_4d76_85e3_abafdd4cdc4d.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPWhnG76Vf3d1V1jkxYxn2dQUFZqmyvbdvXWaqRsg69DP/6ab8f086_ad69_46ca_b334_9d73e88a5844.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRVcL6vbVQzrsHbgx7oKvBJPQY5KDEjfvdHry4UJGpjEE/016cb6f6_2ba8_45be_9790_7035fccf8b4a.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma1XE6q3G5D3YPwGafgdafAXBLuL7r3G5639i7bNtkmZF/38ef282d_5da7_4228_93d5_336e9cb81a1f.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeJ5HYDxtT9eK4nKLggFUXTQYXPuXNrhhrDoSwUh3yc5Z/48ab81c2_9bad_40eb_acec_fa3e629c6a8f.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdYcHg8fvjdVEHPp21GSfYnCN6RxBADrEkzTB9q5hF5nk/83a2ce0e_86eb_4012_8630_2175ef704fbe.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUdzb1K4RAWNw7rfJgmYehFPdJVkif6njsbWfftZHA9i/90c6b45f_e9f3_419c_8034_261ad6098105.jpg)

>

Eso me conllevó a invertir en cambios que me permitieran emprender mejor, diseñar una reestructuración de espacios, tiempo, herramientas y hasta ideas. Aún estoy en medio de estos cambios, con algunas turbulencias que gracias a Dios ya han ido calmándose, y siempre centrada en mi fe y mi perseverancia. Confiando en el proceso, segura de mí misma, y sin miedo a aventurarme hacia nuevas metas. 

Resumiendo un poco este mes, siempre constante en mi entrenamiento pero con faltas obligatorias por cuestiones de trabajo, atendiendo diariamente a mi tropa que creció, y disfrutando del florecimiento de la ciudad con la llegada de las primeras lluvias de este año. La rutina de fotografiar mi entorno como terapia siempre está presente, y la emoción de los nuevos comienzos que me anima a seguir adelante y no flaquear ante los obstáculos que se puedan presentar en el camino. Un té, o un café, siempre acompañando el proceso. 

Adiós abril, te despido con una frase muy bonita que leí ayer que decía: *Bendigo lo bueno y lo malo, porque todo me hizo crecer...\
I bless the good and the bad, because everything made me grow...\

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/4ee0b530)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

Another month has come to an end; April flew by in the blink of an eye—how time flies…

Well, as always, it was a quiet month, filled with food, art, and, well, calm—as much as possible—as I dealt with day-to-day life, my sanctuary, my food, trying out different recipes, some ingredients—from healthy options to things you can whip up and enjoy right away, delicious breads, both sweet and savory. The latest creation was marbled pudding—it was really delicious, actually; I was quite pleased with this invention.

Along with the art of cooking, I also like to mix it with the art of stationery, learning to create these little boxes, designing the templates in Canva—another way to pass the time, balancing learning with a connection to creativity.

May God grant that this new month be just as peaceful; if He surprises me with something new, may it all be for the best, may everything flow, unfold, and follow its course—always for the better. We keep creating, sharing, but above all, surviving. 😄

Hemos culminado otro mes, abril se nos fue en un abrir y cerrar de ojos, qué cosas no…

Bueno como siempre fue un mes tranquilo, lleno de comida, arte y pues calma, dentro de lo que cabe, lidiando con el día a día, mi refugio, mi comida, el probar diferentes recetas, algunos ingredientes, entre lo saludable, lo que se puede preparar, degustar en el momento, ricos panes, entre lo dulce y salado, el mas reciente, el budín marmoleado, muy rico la verdad, quede satisfecha con este invento.

Entre el arte de la cocina, también me gusta mezclarlo con el de la papelería, aprendiendo a crear estas cajitas, diseñando las plantillas en canva, otra manera de pasar el tiempo, entre aprendizaje y conexión con la creatividad.

Dios permita que este nuevo mes, sea igual de tranquilo, si me sorprende con algo nuevo, que sea todo para bien, que todo fluya, se de, siga su curso, siempre para mejor, seguimos creando, compartiendo, pero sobre todo, sobreviviendo. 😄

---
