links.title: Un día entero sin quejas. ¿Te atreves?/ A whole day without complaints. Do you dare? 🍃🙏🏻
links.body: >Un día entero sin quejas. ¿Te atreves?

> Vivo en un país donde quejarse es parte del Padrenuestro de cada día. No solo nos quejamos del gobierno, de los salarios, de los servicios públicos, también nos quejamos del calor porque queremos frío, nos quejamos del frío porque queremos calor, de la lluvia, de la sequía, de si estamos gordos o flacos. En resumen, si no tenemos razones para quejarnos, las buscamos. Soy muy crítico con este gobierno que ha destruido nuestro país en estos 26 años. Cuando he tenido que protestar, marchar, tocar cacerolas, lo he hecho con toda la fuerza de mi alma, pero nunca he habitado el espacio de la queja permanente, del pobrecitismo, de la ira, del fanatismo descontrolado, porque creo que en lo que ponemos nuestra atención ponemos nuestra energía, y muy lejos de mí está llenar mi ser de sentimientos oscuros e inútiles.

> Obviamente, hay ocasiones en las que es necesario decir, expresar e incluso gritar nuestras quejas, señalar injusticias e indicar problemas. Lo contrario sería muy perjudicial para nuestra salud. Pero vivir constantemente en quejas hace poco por nuestra salud. Vivir constantemente quejándonos hace que te sientas como si estuvieras en un laberinto sin salida, lo que puede generar ansiedad, depresión e incluso desesperanza. Sin mencionar que puede llevarte a la locura.
></center>\n\nNo vivo en una burbuja: salgo a la calle todos los días y encuentro las quejas de la gente. \
, dice un hombre que explota cuando le cobran el pasaje que está en gaceta. \
, oigo decir a alguien por teléfono. \
, dice alguien que tal vez nunca haya salido de Cumaná. \
, dice una señora en la fila del supermercado. Como dice el famoso refrán: \

/> Dejar de quejarse puede ser una tarea difícil, pero no imposible. Tal vez, antes de quejarnos, deberíamos pensar en lo que nos ayuda a decir lo que decimos, qué aportamos de nuevo, qué resolvemos con eso. Cuando los servicios fallan, por ejemplo, vale la pena expresar nuestro desagrado en el momento, pero no ganamos nada llevando la nube gris 24 horas por todas partes. Te lo digo yo: eso no hará que la electricidad regrese, ni el agua vuelva, te lo digo yo que he estado casi tres meses sin el líquido vital y que desde el día uno la gente se está quejando. Obviamente, no estoy hablando de ignorar la realidad, estoy hablando de decidir cómo enfrentarla. No resolvemos nada con quejarnos. Entonces: ¿Y si por un día dejamos de quejarnos de las moscas alrededor de la mesa llena de comida y comenzamos a estar agradecidos por la comida que tenemos sobre la mesa? No una semana ni un mes: solo un día sin quejarnos. Sé que notarás la diferencia, ni siquiera tendrás incomodidad estomacal o dolor de cabeza. Porque quejarse puede ser un fuego que nunca se apaga y que amenaza con devorarnos a nosotros mismos.
>La imagen principal es diseñada en Canva y las otras imágenes son de mi galería personal. El texto fue traducido con Deepl
>Gracias por vuestro apoyo, lectura y comentario, amigo. Hasta una próxima y nueva oportunidad

>A whole day without complaints. Do you dare? I live in a country where complaining is part of the daily Lord's Prayer. We not only complain about the government, about salaries, about public services, we also complain about the heat because we want cold, we complain about the cold because we want heat, about the rain, about the drought, about whether we are fat or thin. In short, if we don't have reasons to complain, we look for them. I am very critical of this government that has destroyed our country in these 26 years. When I have had to protest, march, bang pots, I have done it with all the strength of my soul, but I have never inhabited the space of permanent complaint, of being pitiful, of rage, of uncontrolled fanaticism, because I believe that what we put our attention on, we put our energy on, and far be it from me to fill myself with dark and useless feelings. Obviously, there are times when it is necessary to say, express, and even shout our grievances, point out injustices, and indicate problems. The opposite would be very harmful to our health. But constantly living in complaints does little favor to our health. Constantly living in complaint makes you feel like you are in a maze with no way out, which can create anxiety, depression, and even hopelessness. Not to mention that it can drive you to madness. I don't live in a bubble: I go out on the street every day and encounter people's complaints. \
says a man who explodes when they charge him for the fare. \
I hear someone say on the phone. \
says someone who may have never left Cumaná. \
says a lady in the supermarket line. As the famous saying goes: \

Stopping complaining can be a difficult task, but not impossible. Maybe, before complaining, we should think about what helps us say what we say, what we bring new, what we solve with that. When services fail, for example, it's worth expressing our displeasure at the moment, but we gain nothing by carrying the gray cloud 24 hours all over the place. I tell you: that will not make the electricity come back, nor the water, I tell you, I've been almost three months without the vital liquid.

Obviously, I am not talking about ignoring reality, I am talking about deciding how to face it. What if for one day we stop complaining about the flies around the table full of food and start being grateful for the food we have on the table. Not a week or a month: just one day without complaining. I know you will see the difference, you won't even have stomach discomfort or headache. Because complaining can be a fire that never goes out and that threatens to devour us ourselves.

links.title: Solar Figures For April
links.body: Another steady set of solar figures for the month of April and similar to the previous months this year. The change of seasons is definitely in play with shorter days and longer nights so these figures should slowly drop over the coming months. The solar system has been great and recommend this for anyone who is thinking of doing something similar.

/></center> 

# Currently On Hold


I have been keeping an eye on consumption considering we have been having staff working from the property over the last few months. That is another story and why currently I am not bragging about having a new solar geyser on the roof or additional solar panels and batteries. It is what it is and hoping all the legal battles are resolved during the month of May.

The discharge or throwing away power that cannot be stored due to not having sufficient battery storage is still hovering around 340Kwh which divided by 30 is around an average of 11kwh per day. It would have been great to see if the solar geyser and a couple of extra batteries along with 8 extra solar panels would make the difference I suspect it will and look forward to getting that done as quickly as possible. The geyser is the unknown as I have no clue how much energy is being drawn currently, but it must be 20-30% which is a high percentage of the entire consumption.

The stove/oven also needs to be converted to gas which means a brand new kitchen due to laying gas lines so it may as well be gutted and redone. This is a job that needs doing so it may as well happen sooner than later which will be the final act to take us off the grid permanently. This will not be cheap and needs to be done to a high standard because a kitchen is a major selling point. Everything that we are doing now will have one eye on selling due to knowing we will be relocating. 

The great thing about all of these costs is that whatever is spent will be returned when the house is sold in the future. I have monitored properties for sale and there has not been one who is fully off the grid. This is a major selling point and can add an additional 15-20% on the value of the property due to having no monthly power utility costs. This would save the new owners anywhere between R6K and R8K which is $400-$500 monthly and a significant saving.

I honestly hate how close we are to achieving off the grid status and still having to pay the monthly power bill having invested so much already. We are not achieving the planned savings yet due to the manipulated monthly bills penalizing us for having solar.

The purchased electricity from the grid is below 600kwh yet the bill will still be the same as what it was before we had solar due to increases and two admin fees which is their way of manipulating the bill. Sure the bill would be far higher than what we are currently paying without solar due to the annual increases having taken place over the last 2 years. I just do not trust the monthly readings and need to just get off the grid which is a priority.

I have my solar installer on standby phoning me each week for updates and I am hoping to pull the trigger shortly when I know where we stand legally with our court battles. The next round is due for the 19th May and it should go our way which will then allow me to spend funds again. Lawyers are expensive and the only reason why these upgrades have not been completed already.  

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cryptoandcoffee/solar-figures-for-april-3lf)

links.title: My anatomy learning 001
links.body:
Hello guys, I'm excited to let you know that I have started to up skill my sketching by learning calculated and proven process to draw Human anatomy, perspective, camera angle and the likes. 

Prior to this time, I've know how to sketch with instincts. It's great though but it's time to leave the level of instincts to precision. 

This way I believe I can model new and good looking characters of my own, it will also help in developing my fingers for making good storyboards as I have always had interest in it. 

After watching tutorials, I decided to pick random pictures online for practice. I started with the front face and I think I did really well for a start, you can't imagine how much hope that brought to me. 

![IMG_20260501_173606~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcRiEtn5gjFav5Z67Z175jaZ8fLd45bUZop1dWCpmRUEp/IMG_20260501_173606~2.jpg)

I also decided to try a side view. My first trial didn't come out nice, I think the circle and lines weren't proportional enough. It looked like it's going to be a long face. 

![IMG_20260501_174215~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVE89MMBNAH29oBPedfX2vv2jNxPG6HR9uhpvxZhFCEJ7/IMG_20260501_174215~2.jpg)

So I decided to start all other. This time, it came out better than the first one. I added more back head because the reference seems to have more of it. Then I processed to add the shadows. And the outcome was cool too. 


![IMG_20260501_174355~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSfR7pVmgDMBVFBJMn4GBLsxpqGNzRuhewb5cwtwRpLCc/IMG_20260501_174355~2.jpg)

Although I think I did better in the front face because I couldn't see more resemblance to the reference picture than the side face. 


![IMG_20260501_175634~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT3prWStFNJ8E7Vd3QqsTb12XhpkuogQ2r9GcXy2mypg4/IMG_20260501_175634~2.jpg)

links.title: A Sunflower Just Blossomed on Hive. I Welcome Myself
links.body:
Hello Hive!
A little bird told me about HIVE, I don't mean Twitter; oh! That is gone, and we have X now, but either way, i didn't get to know about hive from there as well. I would have loved to disclose the little birdy now, but i want you to enjoy my post, so as you read, you would find out. So let's shoot.

![1000295761.jpg](1)

A happy lady from somewhere on earth, Happiness Amame is from West Africa, Nigeria to be precise, and i be confirm Edo girl, and as we say in Nigeria, Edo babe na sharp babe though I grew up elsewhere. currently navigating the twists and turns of adulthood and trying to make life a little easier for herself... hmmm.

From Lab Coats to Life Lessons

For my university years, I dived into the world of nature, studying Plant Science and Biotechnology at Ekiti State University. I've always been fascinated by how things grow, but lately, I've been focusing on my own growth.

![1000266455.jpg](2)

**The \

Reality Check**

 Like many graduates, I quickly discovered that life after school isn't as sweet as people make it look. I came into a new city  to serve my father's land as they use to say,i  tried to stay back afterward with high hopes of finding a better life, but being here has shown me shege ,that reality can be very different from expectations. Being the first child in a family where things were fairly okay comes with its own unique set of responsibilities and life lessons. Even with the confusion and the daily challenges of figuring out what's next, I’ve been pushing through and learning every single day.  

**The Extrovert**
I like connecting with people and sharing energy.
I sabi talk ehn people often tell me happiness,i like it when you talk because they know something reasonable will come out,to be candid i don't even know i have brain like that....funny right?There was a time i thought of doing podcast but i had to rethink maybe because i didn’t have the courage to start.
I believe every conversation is an opportunity to learn something new, and i think this might help me here on HIVE!.

I am a huge movie lover! It’s my favourite way to unwind when the pressure of life gets a bit much. If you have any Netflix recommendations, send them my way.
I’m constantly wondering about my next steps, but I’ve learned to embrace the \

philosophy. Why I Joined Hive I’ll be honest i wasn’t fully convinced when that little bird first introduced me to this platform. However, I decided to give it a try. I love the idea of platforms where people share real stories.

My goals here are simple
To learn and grow personally.
To share my life experiences authentically. 
To connect with others who have walked the path I’m on now.

 I’m looking forward to learning more about how Hive works and meeting you all. If you have any advice for navigating life after school or adjusting to a new city, I’d love to hear it in the comments! Thank you for having me.

links.title: Summary of April's 2nd EoS: Buying/upgrading rare reward cards, opening Gladius cases [Eng/Esp]
links.body:
> Greetings and happy Friday, Splinterfam! We've finished April, and with it comes the time to take stock of the end of the season. Personally, I managed to advance to Gold League II. As we upgraded our various reward cards and unlocked their abilities, the variety of new strategies and lineups allowed us to climb the Gold League. In the end, our total Glints earned was 138,670, and we gained about 584 SPs in taking. Regarding the SPs, I'm a little frustrated because I missed a Brawl battle where we ended up in first place, and I didn't receive any reward. I felt disappointed by that since I really enjoy guild battles and hanging out with my Summoners Tribe teammates, but overall, it's the glints I wanted to focus on since I have a long task ahead of me to upgrade my reward cards. > Saludos y feliz viernes Splinterfam! Hemos terminado el mes de abril y con él llego la hora de hacer nuestro balance del final de temporada. En lo personal logré avanzar hasta la liga de oro II, en la medida que hemos logrado upgradear nuestras distintas cartas rewards y desbloqueando sus habilidades, la variedad de nuevas estrategias y alineaciones nos han permitido avanzar en la liga dorada. Al final, nuestro balance total de Glints generados fue de 138670 Glints y unos 584 Sps en taking, en cuanto a los sps si me siento un poco frustrado ya que me perdí una batalla Brawl en la que al final quedamos de 1eros y no pude percibir ninguna recompensa. Me sentí abatido por eso ya que disfruto mucho de las batallas de gremios y compartir con mis compañeros de Summoners Tribe, pero en general, son los glints en lo que quería enfocarme ya que tengo una larga tarea pendiente de upgradear mis cartas rewards. ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJUQcmhovG3g322UEbzEkKQ5nExxWHEuPBgpVgrZVbp2/image.png)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVemKzfV2erS9vnEuAMMGPJXBtmwpuXsj7FJby61HSj1z/image.png) --|--

> At the end of March and throughout April, I dedicated myself to completing my common reward cards. I must admit that this has taken me longer than expected, but every time new skins are released between seasons, like the Easter ones, I can't resist and end up spending a good portion of my glints on them. But finally, I can say that I've completed this first phase of upgrading my common cards, which are all now at level 5 or higher. > Al final del mes de marzo y en todo este mes de abril me dediqué a completar mis cartas comunes rewards, debo reconocer que esto me ha tomado más tiempo del esperado, pero es que cada vez que entre temporadas salen nuevas skins como los de pascuas no puedo contenerme y termino gastando una buena parte de mis glints en ellas. Pero finalmente ya puedo decir que cerré esta primera fase temporal de mis cartas comunes que ya están todas en nivel 5 o superior.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW7zZpGCTdQvdQwNBTv1cWYbDXLtAd3fU374g6uDSSL7E/image.png)
---

> Now, with the glints we've earned in this EoS, the most urgent thing is to buy the rare reward cards. We've acquired most of them from chests and a few very limited purchases with the few glints we had left, but now we're going to invest heavily in these cards since I barely have any at level 1 and very few at level 2. So we spent the bulk of our reward tokens on 92 rare cards, and the most outstanding results are those I show you below. > Ahora con estos glints que hemos ganado en este EoS, lo más urgente es comprar las cartas raras de recompensa. Hemos conseguido la mayoría de ellas en cofres y una que otra compra muy limitada con los pocos glints que nos sobraban, pero ahora si vamos a invertir a fondo en estas cartas ya que apenas las tengo en nivel 1 y muy pocas en nivel 2. Así gastamos el grueso de nuestros tokens de recompensas en 92 cartas raras y los resultados más destacados son los que te muestro a continuación.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVfNmjDQxDV2UGnbrCgFZ6aCvDcRnEMffmPqLbDcNxFx/1er_lote_rewards_raras.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVaZKd5pBHsfp2py2g2uuU8Zs9vVBrmB6ZsCLKKMauEmt/2do_lote_rewards_raras.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdT3LBAHoExxJjGux8VqeJ4AfqUkKW41QByywYLHgnVv9/3er_lote_rewards_raras.gif)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdxi8x4aRsZfhwrwhCw8bmyH7TaqyJneaZ5JUL9pGwajH/4to_lote_rewards_raras.gif) --|-- --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTANLBj7imBwUE4K6dj6t5rWTkL9qG3LHX5cSMHhq9DM/8vo_lote_rewards_raras.gif)

> In this case, since they were rare cards, I did use the alchemy potions I had saved. I hadn't realized it before, but with common cards, I saw how quickly these potions are consumed, so I decided it was better to invest them in higher rarity cards. I was very lucky to get not only two rare gold foil cards, but they're also the same ones, so I can fuse them to get them to level 3. > En este caso, al ser cartas raras si utilicé las pociones de alquimia que tenía guardadas. No me había dado cuenta pero con las cartas comunes me di cuenta de lo rápido que se consumen estas pociones así que decidí que era mejor invertirlas en cartas de mayor rareza. Tuve la gran suerte de conseguir no solo 2 cartas raras de lámina dorada, sino que además son las mismas, así que podré fusionarlas para tenerlas en nivel 3.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPAD9M7vWEoLgvjMARQP5KyQ3YdzbipCjGsn9JAdY5MjB/5to_lote_rewards_raras.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZUa5ReTKp1QssDgwsNKLAA4Sjg4RK3Yy3rCr4wxjBD8/7mo_lote_rewards_raras.gif)

> Okay, with this large batch of rare cards acquired, we can upgrade many of them. Let's explore which ones we managed to upgrade to higher levels and what potential advantages they offer. > Ok, Con este gran lote de cartas raras adquiridas, podremos upgradear muchas de ellas, vamos a explorar cuales logramos llevar a niveles superiores y que potenciales ventajas ofrecen.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpw46i8AWK2gMbtHGNx973p6ydmso11Wj2xruafos9ij/fire_sponsor_1.png)
# Upgrading Fire Cards/Upgrading Cartas de Fuego

> Let's start with the Fire class. Here, we only managed to get Grove Doomblade to level 3. This card has been a recurring drop in chests, so it wasn't too difficult to get it to level 3. In fact, I only need two more copies to have it at the maximum level in the Silver League, but since I don't usually use this melee card much with the Fire Archon due to its low speed, I'll wait until I get it in a chest or during the next bulk purchase of rare reward cards. > Comencemos con la clase fuego, aquí solo logramos llevar a nivel 3 a Grove Doomblade, esta ha sido una carta recurrente en cofres por lo que no me costó mucho llevarla a nivel 3, de hecho solo me faltan 2 copias para tenerla al máximo nivel en la liga de plata pero ya que no suelo usar mucho esta carta melé con el arconte de fuego por su baja velocidad, esperaré a que me salga en algún cofre o en la próxima compra masiva de cartas raras rewards.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTeAwBzcLCcmxHNb49fwsYZ9TWT2C4vcwYkXvLQBHNHz/grove_doomblade_lvl_3.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaZGBuQ8CzKGDULVG7ndj575tFxiQ9ErHXcqrkTzzAvyv/water_divisor.png)
# Upgrading Water Cards/Upgrading Cartas de Agua

> In the water class, we leveled up Torrent Sniper to level 3. I was very interested in leveling this card, as it develops the Painforge ability, which allows it to increase its damage every time it takes damage of any kind, such as from units with the Reckless ability, but also from Electrify or Incendiary. This is one of the abilities I consider a fundamental pillar when playing exclusively with Conclave Arcana cards. That's why I'm focusing my attention on cards with the painforge ability to build a lineup that gradually increases its damage. > En la clase agua llevamos a nivel 3 a Torrent Sniper, esta carta si tenía un gran interés en llevarla a nivel 3, pues desarrolla la habilidad painforge que le permite aumentar su daño cada vez que recibe daño de algún tipo, como por ejemplo de unidades con la habilidad Reckless principalmente, pero también electrificar o incendiario. Esta es una de las habilidades que considero un pilar fundamental cuando se trata de jugar exclusivamente con carta Conclave Arcana. Es la razón por la que estoy poniendo mi interés en las cartas con la habilidad painforge para construir una alineación que gradualmente vaya aumentando su daño.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmebmWGZ4kdZfypnJCovCW3XEssqKMDCKDgn4ELYCnhX8q/torrent_sniper_lvl_3.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadoCS52n8ZeyKUgp4HMsPw8MDButy9MaCohcrQT7iRDn/earth_sponsor_3.png)
# Upgrading Earth Cards/Upgrading Cartas de Tierra

> With the Earth class, we'll upgrade two rare cards: Swampwrought, which I don't see much use for beyond flying, so I'll have to keep leveling it up to increase its damage. The second card is Anchor-Hex Adept. This is a very interesting card because at level 3 it develops the Divine Shield ability, which allows it to absorb any first attack. But it becomes even more interesting at level 4, when it gains the Void Armor ability, making this unit very resilient and capable of withstanding up to three attacks before taking real damage. > Con la clase tierra upgradeamos las 2 cartas raras: Swampwrought que es una carta que más allá de volar no le veo mayor utilidad por lo que tendré que continuar subiendo su nivel para aumentar su daño, la segunda carta es Anchor-Hex Adept, esta es una carta muy curiosa, porque en nivel 3 desarrolla la habilidad divine shield que le permite absorber cualquier primer ataque, pero se vuelve más interesante en nivel 4 que tiene la habilidad void armor, lo que convierte a esta unidad en una muy resistente capaz de soportar hasta 3 ataques antes de comenzar sufrir verdadero daño.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5XRzvzwVQQcHbBT56NwJy8gzkC5kADkmz3VjSnLBXwn/swampwrought_lvl_3.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ7Xt6PeLNU9BVEjUJ4KUiTZqViHViD6dWKMRTFZ5pp9v/anchor_hex_adept_lvl_3.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS3XJLCgmXiDv7Wibra9vFkM9fnibPePKxCEsXzBHrn2F/life_sponsor.png)
# Upgrading Life Cards/Upgrading Cartas de Vida

> Pixie-Knife Hurler is a key card for the Life class. The Life Splinter's focus in Conclave Arcana seems to be on long-range attacks. This particular card can attack in the first position thanks to its close range ability, but where this card really shines is at level 4 where it can increase the speed of the entire team by +1. > Pixie-knife Hurler es una carta clave para la clase vida, la perspectiva del splinter de vida en Conclave Arcana parece estar enfocada en el ataque de rango largo. esta carta en particular puede atacar en la primera posición gracias a su habilidad close range, pero realmente donde brilla esta carta es en el nivel 4 donde puede incrementar la velocidad de todo el equipo en +1.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRrCgMjaUSa6iC6JzH3TGnBpHDViCFp1QcYTRYR1BqK6S/pixie_knife_hurle_lvl_3.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMdJyzmXZRdB5zZJeQ1Sg7gSzZWABjTqegry2j2JbDUo/death_sponsor.png)
# Upgrading Death Cards/Upgrading Cartas de Muerte

> Gravebrand Warlock was another rare card I obtained frequently from reward chests while climbing the leagues, so we've managed to upgrade it to the maximum level in the Silver League with this massive purchase of rare cards. I really wanted to get this card to level 4 because of its Execute ability, which is a huge advantage when performing a finishing attack if the target is left with 1 or 2 health, as this card deals 3 magic damage. For now, I can say that we've reached our initial goal with this rare card. > Gravebrand Warlock fue otra de las cartas raras que más obtuve en los cofres de recompensa al subir en las distintas ligas, por lo que hemos logrado llevarla al máximo nivel de la liga de plata con esta compra masiva de cartas raras. Deseaba mucho tener esta carta en nivel 4 por su habilidad execute, que es una gran ventaja al realizar un ataque de remate si el objetivo queda con 1 o 2 de vida, ya que esta carta hace 3 de daño mágico. Por ahora puedo decir que hemos llegado a la meta inicial con esta carta rara.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbuBjav2kY3WZtyBdX5zK5WDUhme2fSiUrfBxXSXrraRu/gravebrand_warlock_lvl_4.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWuv8aDHHAwYRod1cadqKHSRe19QxnZkdAHkSvGSz6RW4/dragon_sponsor_2.png)
# Upgrading Dragon Cards/Upgrading Cartas Dragon

> I'm still lacking in the Dragon class; I only have a couple of Core/Escalation cards from Arcana Conclave and a few from Rebellion, but as I've said many times, I'm adapting to playing as little as possible with the rip-off that was Rebellion. I've already got my eye on several Dragon Core cards that I want to buy, but first I need to get my hands on the last legendary Dragon Archon: Dragonlore Mancer, to start using these cards. In that context, we're already getting ahead by leveling up this rare card, Dragonfang Lancer, to level 3. I'm actually interested in testing this card at level 4 when it has the Reflexes ability. According to the description, upon receiving a first attack, all subsequent attacks from the unit that successfully attacked the first time will fail. My question is whether this ability applies when the attacker has the True Strike ability or when it's a magic attack. > Con la clase dragón si que estoy en deuda todavía, apenas tengo un par de cartas Core/Escalation de Conclave Arcana y otras de Rebellion pero como ya he dicho en múltiples ocasiones estoy adaptándome a jugar lo menos posible con la estafa que fue Rebellion. Ya tengo vistas varias cartas dragón Core que quiero comprar pero antes necesito tener en mis manos el último arconte legendario dragón: Dragonlore Mancer para empezar a usar estas cartas y en ese contexto ya vamos adelantando al subir de nivel esta carta rara Dragonfang Lancer en nivel 3. En realidad me interesa poner a prueba esta carta en nivel 4 cuando tiene la habilidad reflexes, según lo que dice, al recibir un primer ataque, todos los demás ataques los fallará la unidad que lo atacó exitosamente la primera vez. Mi duda es si esta habilidad se cumple cuando el atacante tiene la habilidad true strike o cuando es un ataque mágico.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHWkAKP2nnksd2hE2ExEf7MjFiK7mQLq6AEbYo2xSTyJ/dragonfang_lancer_lvl_3.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQohwKKidKt5qvcG34YuueWk7G2V5W3LzYSxGSVQQExTJ/neutral_sponsor.png)
# Upgrading Neutral Cards/Upgrading Cartas Neutras

> To wrap up this preview of upgraded cards, we have Mindless Thrall, which, along with Gravebrand Warlock, I wanted to get to at least level 3. It doesn't develop any new abilities, but it does increase its magic damage to 3. This is critical if you use the Water Archon Marlai Singariel, which increases magic damage by 1. With a Mindless Thrall dealing 4 damage, it becomes much more effective. The best way to place it is between the second and third positions, since it has a high evasion rate that includes magic attacks thanks to its phase ability. > Para cerrar este avance de cartas upgradeadas, tenemos a Mindless Thrall que junto a Gravebrand Warlock deseaba llevar al menos a nivel 3. No desarrolla ninguna habilidad nueva, pero si incrementa su daño mágico a 3, esto es crítico si utilizas el arconte de agua Marlai Singariel que aumenta el daño mágico en 1, con un Mindless Thrall haciendo 4 de daño, se vuelve mucho más efectivo ahora. La mejor manera de ubicarlo es entre la segunda y tercera posición, ya que tiene una alta tasa de evasión que incluye ataques mágicos gracias a su habilidad phase.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZzyYzNah1bXDGp3dY567fx8Swrh3ydXnGndDiojssY7i/mindless_thrall_lvl_3.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3tGfiSGr6mFHPk3xtrgnyCYP8e7gcg9DcxpxUAa8RXF/cl_sponsor_2.png)
# Opening Gladius Cases/Abriendo Gladius Cases

> I spent the few Glints I had left on some merits to reach the 8000 I needed and buy 4 Gladius Cases. I had a feeling I'd get some good cards, and I wasn't wrong! I got 2 epic cards and several other rare ones, including a Captain Katie, the last copy I needed to get it to level 7! > Los pocos Glints que me quedaron los gastamos en unos cuantos méritos para completar los 8000 que me hacían falta y comprar 4 gladius cases ya que tenía el presentimiento de que obtendría buenas cartas y no me equivoqué, conseguí 2 cartas épicas y varias otras raras, entre ellas una Captain Katie, la última copia que me faltaba para llevarla a nivel 7! ---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYjDG1yUeNeNze18XzFfYzrf8wBeco84xyLRrpYDvqQ2Y/open_gladius_cases_bkths_01_5_26_i.gif) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4RZt1bg4Pi9HH3YaZv4SyVCyg1EeQbv7pfyXHEj3czQ/open_gladius_cases_bkths_01_5_26_ii.gif)
---

> Captain Katie is a powerful card. In fact, when it was first released in Modern, which consisted of Untamed/Chaos Legion cards, this was the third magic card with the snipe ability. This was because magic attacks dealt a lot of damage, and a card targeting ranged/magic units in the second row with magic could literally break the opponent's strategy. That's why there weren't many cards like that. In fact, Captain Katie is the most powerful, and she's also a gladiator. Now that we have her at level 7, we can take advantage of her speed boost with an epic archon like Sthispa, who I currently have at level 5. > Captain Katie es una poderosa carta, de hecho cuando salió por primera vez cuando moderno estaba compuesto por las cartas Untamed/Chaos Legion, esta era la tercera carta mágica con la habilidad snipe, esto era así porque los ataques mágicos hacían un gran daño y que una carta apuntara a las unidades rango/mágicas de la segunda fila con magia podía literalmente quebrar la estrategia del oponente por eso no habían muchas cartas así. De hecho Captain Katie es la más poderosa que además es gladiadora. Ahora que la tenemos en nivel 7 podemos aprovechar su plus de velocidad con un arconte épico como Sthispa que tengo actualmente en nivel 5.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZTqKusRjJmMFVwMhFedHsK5nTj9nPQHLVQ6ay8WHi2Be/captain_katie_lvl_7.gif)

> I'm still a long way from upgrading the epic cards. I need six more copies of Gorth to get it to level 4. This is a very useful card in battle with rules like Opportunist or Super Sneak, especially when combined with Jacek the Conqueror. The other is Marisol Contuma, which we already have at level 4, and we need eight more copies for the maximum level in the Gold League. I'm not in a hurry, though; as it is, it's very useful when I use the Life class in guild battles. > De las cartas épicas aún estoy muy lejos de upgradear estas cartas, de Gorth me faltan 6 copias para llevarla a nivel 4, esta es una carta muy conveniente en batalla con reglas como oportunist o supersneak, sobre todo si la combinas con Jacek the Conqueror. La otra es Marisol Contuma que ya la tenemos en nivel 4 y nos faltan 8 copias para el máximo nivel de la liga de oro, aunque no tengo prisa, así como esta me es muy útil cuando uso la clase vida en batallas de gremio.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQtU9hYKs3ngBo4kQvvd7g9SvnVsCdCHVKksnnGnzWivK/image.png)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR7wELcXzxNqpyHo4fqFeaGAxNeSmve4guhrMQmDx5bZD/image.png) --|--
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcrL5L2SiS1ih8BqT4Ur3JHhKmqhddQE9zQCUkQG5RasM/cl_sponsor_1.png)

> With this, I conclude my recap of this end of the season. We've made significant progress with the rare reward cards, and I think I can now better solidify my position in Gold League II. For now, I'll be preparing to buy the last legendary dragon archon. I'll start building my Arcane Conclave deck with that archon, and then I'll move on to the first legendary dragon archon, Shen Xiao, and finally the elementals. I hope to share my impressions once I have at least one of these two archons. Good luck and a long winning streak! Best regards! > Con esto cierro mi recapitulación de este final de temporada, avanzamos significativamente con las cartas rewards raras, creo que ahora podré afianzar mejor mi posición en la liga de oro II. Por lo pronto me estaré preparando para comprar el último arconte legendario dragón. Será a partir de ese arconte que voy a comenzar a construir mi mazo de Conclave Arcana y posteriormente seguiré con el 1er arconte dragón legendario Shen Xiao y después seguiré con los elementales. Espero poder compartirles mis impresiones cuando tenga al menos uno de estos 2 arcontes. Buena suerte y larga racha de victorias. Saludos!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf96orqkvzSTzD8PpaUyVd5M5yWbbfwPgPgctSZetjpeb/ending_conclave_arcana_v.gif)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNkjVWZ37RHdXeXcDN9YhiKfeeghZa7cmYpWVkknDLBrD/gold_league_divisor.png)

links.title: My May HPUD and some stats for past months
links.body:
Good day dear mates since my last HPUD post passed three months. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAdT5x31uTLTvLWRJDg9c8S3noQdAArt6SAftTcnC48T/image.png)


Many things have happened during this period. First of all I need to admit that I've finally crossed 5600 HP milestone on last days of April! 🎉🎉🎆 
Of course for many Hivians it's not a big level, but for me it took more than long 8 years to achieve it. Of course I should to remember that I'm not posting as reguarly and frequently as I wish. In past years it happened so that I didn't publish any post for couple or three months at a row. Anyway this goal which I made for myself in one of my previous posts has been achieved. And now I can close it!
But now let's move further. And here I'd like to cross 6000 HP milestone to the end of this year. I don't know how long it'll take me but I'll try. Of course many of you can say that they add every month hundreds or fousands HP, but not me. And for me this will be important achivement anyway.
So about today HPUD I decided to add 42.65 and already crossed 5650 HP.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTh9bHgydgc6ysKMguig2MWt2qiSBWJA5A8KruBV6yMjU/_2026_05_01_215253.png)
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeVGqD5fGYs8huEv2PowoPp6SZLUaVdYAETXz94Zkg5hd/_2026_05_01_215348.png)
***![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRvThb32ScCxd559qgCyzDbYvfrUPdzrwuUvEQm1r11x/_2026_05_01_215406.png)

Also in March / April I used my @ecency 6000 points to receive HP delegation for a whole month. And now I ready to exchange another 1500 ecency points to get another one delegation for a week.
The next one important point is a crossing 35.812 HBD rewards as interests. Here I'm not about importantce receiving HBD, here I'm assuming about crossing milestone of 3000 HBD in savings. Now I have 2957 HBD in savings. And if all will go as it is in June I'll do it.

Now a little bit more statistics from my account. According to hivestats.io in April I've got 22.1 HP as a author rewards and 32.5 HP for curation. So numbers are growing slowly but surely. And of course all depends just from me and my activity on platform.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHeaC6G8eKkoW5uXbdXYTVpvBfzx5sDVK83yfmjLy178/image.png)

Finally a little bit about tokens in my wallet. Here as we can see WAIV again on the first place instead of LEO then suddenly goes SPORTS instead of LEN and just then DEC, POSH and ZING tokens. If tocompare with [previous post ](https://peakd.com/hive-122221/@travoved/1st-hpud-in-2026) we can see some changings in leaderboard but I think it's not bad situation can change every moment and comparing we see dinamics of the market. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma7sPYtxjbByeDMhLrcXivi3Xq5gLjpu35BGFz5SUrgha/image.png)

My delegations to earlier chosen projects continues further. I decided not to increase or to decrease it and let it be as is.

@liotes.voter 200HP
@steembasicincome 110HP
@leo.voter 105 HP
@photofeed 102 HP
@ecency 100 HP

I don't want to borther you with details so that's all for today. See you in next time! Yours @travoved

![1000266941.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPgcxfvuz2duyvHePmJ9v4NBxmJZqD7Kqbb6Sirymsoyr/1000266941.png)
# # * 500 gramos de harina de trigo * 400 gramos de azúcar * 250 gramos de mantequilla * 4 huevos * 1 litro de leche * 1 cucharada de polvo de hornear * 100 gramos de cacao en polvo * 40 gramos de Maizena # >* 500 grams of wheat flour >* 400 grams of sugar >* 250 grams of butter >* 4 eggs >* 1 liter of milk >* 1 tablespoon of baking powder >* 100 grams of cocoa powder >* 40 grams of cornstarch # #
🧑‍🍳Preparación/🧑‍🍳Preparation
 #
![1000266791.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUggZtvj7NxCjz5CSxexdwcHYwmcgQsbk9AJeLNEJDgz3/1000266791.jpg)
![1000266802.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXAGKVQ8BpVL4sCrdP6QcPqZ5T3sMN54aBbFjrrS6dNcu/1000266802.jpg)
![1000266967.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTsNyzhdJwWNGSHJYFBxJ7xecEpz7MbE7uvqKJCASWFdW/1000266967.jpg)
# * #### Paso 1 **

>Comencé primero hacer la mezcla de mantequilla y el azúcar,según las cantidades las agregue a un bol y fue mezclando todo hasta tener una mezcla suave y esponjosa.** > * #### Step 1 > I started by making the butter and sugar mixture, adding the quantities to a bowl and mixing everything until I had a smooth and fluffy mixture. ---
![1000266811.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdrYaneqzK5jdyy3V4LoJsseJufVbjC5dYBuCgkX8buTp/1000266811.jpg)
![1000266812.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbyeHvxwgWvj6tDmi4QdSENTETDVs31CPdtHwf7bz9BSH/1000266812.jpg)
# * #### Paso 2 **

>Luego agregué los 4 huevos ,uno por uno hasta que se incorporaran bien.** > * #### Step 2 > Then I added the 4 eggs, one by one until they were well incorporated. ---
![1000266813.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaDHm9LaQwaCJXvKTBeNJG7Q8G5Rh5YP5cNVPLE4EEXqe/1000266813.jpg)
![1000266990.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPj96GwKEXTJoqcfpBS49SJN2D1qgs7t3g15eg9k7VrtR/1000266990.jpg)
![1000266818.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaECU3RZZQMGWV4ka1SHRwi7PPtMBqdewE2VWJGy4YbFj/1000266818.jpg)
# * #### Paso 3 **

>Continúe ahora por agregar la harina y la leche, entonces pase la harina por un colador para que no se hiciera grumos al mismo tiempo agregué el polvo de hornear y la leche.** > * #### Step 3 > Continue now by adding the flour and milk, then pass the flour through a sieve so that it does not form lumps at the same time I added the baking powder and the milk. ---
![1000266992.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme5H83ZFYDFgVGexwDSRQMP3eQDjTYWWU8bEX3N1ofpo2/1000266992.jpg)
![1000266831.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUZKjx4oy3easAx7F3ZEJXsdmvvUPbCjY7jBnz9G42gqT/1000266831.jpg)
![1000266832.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc4GZjrRMEAeRG7KBbAiwCvP7vdqSW27cyfwkRB8USyoQ/1000266832.jpg)
![1000266833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW1ydYMxWzuokCQhtq5XnDEifiJdGe2tMMgSXhiFiUjkk/1000266833.jpg)
![1000266997.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcqU1Nhu5ihqMSfffthYZxeGo19r3DVjUQk5bgp4eRJ3h/1000266997.jpg)
# * #### Paso 4 **

>Después aparte en otra taza coloque un poco de la mezcla de la torta para agregarle el cacao,y así ya tener dos mezclas,una de vainilla y otra de chocolate.Luego en la bandejita fui agregando la mezclas de chocolate y vainilla, intercalando las mezclas hasta llegar a la cantidad deseada, ya así con la ayuda de un palito de madera o de brocheta,le hice las formas como dibujos.** > * #### Step 4 > Then, in a separate cup, I placed some of the cake batter and added the cocoa, so I had two mixtures, one vanilla and one chocolate. Next, I added the chocolate and vanilla mixtures to the tray, alternating them until I reached the desired amount. Then, using a wooden stick or skewer, I made shapes like drawings. ---
![1000266993.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma7M2fGWBkr4b4bRJKXygVMLxPh8h99zhkC8FTdZ2V61H/1000266993.jpg)
![1000266838.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZG73a2K6KBfFhcqs8bG5NpM5fMMk44ep1gQwP4ZkbnGV/1000266838.jpg)
![1000266858.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYPRMJCVahDE4AAZub1XdK2hwmAmDmjGWCJqNtXrPtXF/1000266858.jpg)
# * #### Paso 5 **

>Ahora fue el momento de colocar al horno las tortas,las dejé hornear por unos 10-15 minutos a fuego medio.Para esta vez la mezcla me alcanzó para 6 tortas,ya cuando estaban ya listas las tortas las dejé enfriar a temperatura ambiente.** > * #### Step 5 > Now it was time to put the cakes in the oven. I left them to bake for about 10-15 minutes at medium heat. This time the mixture was enough for 6 cakes. Once the cakes were ready, I let them cool to room temperature. ---
![1000266948.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZzvQf6X83TVSz6CNxM2jCsQqXSArxmws6rXYRwHtTMTP/1000266948.jpg)
![1000266950.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRdcRGrpv3UunTeJWMELoHXHaWrhLsGPq7G9hiVdnW86q/1000266950.jpg)
![1000266952.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNYKdBfchZtekn6jH5CLXmT69VExnovi2g1fJt2JyhpCf/1000266952.jpg)
# * #### Paso 6 **

>Mientras que deje las tortas enfriando,pase a hacer la crema de chocolate para el relleno de las tortas, entonces agregué la maizena,la azúcar,el cacao, medio litro de leche,en una olla a fuego bajo y fui moviendo constantemente para que no se quemara,deje cocinar hasta que se espesara la crema.** > * #### Step 6 > While the cakes were cooling, I proceeded to make the chocolate cream for the cake filling. I added the cornstarch, sugar, cocoa, and half a liter of milk to a pot over low heat and stirred constantly to prevent burning. I cooked it until the cream thickened. ---
![1000266959.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXGTdKAweDqUapVCJdPi9A4U9fhG6ruHfDsdARXZ7sYxC/1000266959.jpg)
![1000266960.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSJdvoDHcrNbt6j9z5ZsF9zjuJEN8LtyidAanuJxbHdDj/1000266960.jpg)
![1000266961.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbYxVTXKJz5Xba22KfeMDvi9p5k4zi7Yeip2oYmFpKokU/1000266961.jpg)
# * #### Paso 7 **

>Ya por último,corte las tortas la mitad,y después coloque una mitad en la bandejita, luego agregué la crema de chocolate,y después coloque la otra mitad de la torta,que tiene que ser la parte en dónde se ve el dibujo del marmoleado,y listo lo hice está vez las tortas rellenas y encima no le coloque cobertura porque la idea es que el marmoleado se vea.** > * #### Step 7 > Finally, cut the cakes in half, then place one half on the tray, then add the chocolate cream, and then place the other half of the cake, which has to be the side where the marbled pattern is visible, and that's it. This time I made the cakes filled and I didn't put any frosting on top because the idea is for the marbled pattern to show. --- #
✨Resultado✨/✨Result✨
 #
![1000266861.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUfsQ7k6kbjwEZ2isRSZaWtxV7uHpTKMEctcJXrNET1TE/1000266861.jpg) ![1000266860.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXVZ8szbyTK9rCkLXiZUCjPxh9Wfvute8Mzx665b4GbTx/1000266860.jpg) ![1000266859.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVnEeZZCYH4eqhNPbg3ya7E9LCknivwXzEPUSadqbCFHD/1000266859.jpg)
# *

>Y así quedó lista está linda torta mármol,espero les haya gustado esta preparación,y que les sirva como idea para también hacer un pequeño emprendimiento,o para compartir una merienda, también espero que está nueva variación me ayude a seguir progresando en mi pequeño emprendimiento. Gracias a todos por haberme acompañado hoy 👋✨.* # > And so this lovely marble cake is finished! I hope you enjoyed this recipe and that it gives you an idea for starting your own small business or for sharing at a tea party. I also hope this new variation helps me continue to grow my small business. Thank you all for joining me today 👋✨. --- # *

links.title: ‎Nine Goals, No Breathing Space: Why This Tie Is Still Wide Open ‎
links.body:
‎There are football matches you enjoy, and then there are matches that leave you emotionally exhausted and boring too. This Champions League semifinal first leg between PSG and Bayern Munich firmly belongs in the first category. Nine goals, relentless tempo, and moments of brilliance on both ends. It was the kind of night that reminds you why this competition sits above all others.
‎
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZS4f2ZdGxXPfc83kYQxpCXPBDXhKsdQCjDtFkan6SC4o/dm_260430_COM_SOC_ANALYSIS_Was_PSG_vs_Bayern_Munich_the_highest-level_match_in_recent_seasons_2026_4_30.jpg 

‎[source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401862893&ved=2ahUKEwjx8MOK5ZiUAxWzT0EAHWj7M1UQr4kDegQIHBAA&usg=AOvVaw1YACi5TA1pAyA_CaKWjiLG)
‎
‎Starting from the opening whistle, it was clear neither side came to play it safe. PSG looked sharp, aggressive, and clinical in transition. Every time they surged forward with their attacking style of play, they carried real danger, and they made Bayern pay for even the smallest defensive lapses. Their attacking trio showed pace, intelligence, and exactly that killer instinct needed at this level.
‎
‎But Bayern Munich are not a team that folds easily either. Even when they went behind, they kept pushing, probing, and responding with goals of their own. Their attacking structure, movement off the ball, and willingness to commit numbers forward made them a constant threat. At times, it felt like they could score every time they entered PSG’s half.
‎
‎What  made this match special wasn’t just the number of goals, but it was the balance of chaos and quality and that's what I really love to see when two quality team play. Defensive mistakes played a role, yes, but you also have to credit the attacking brilliance on display from both sides. Finishing of the highest level with the two goal keeper have nothing tangible to do, quick decision-making also, and fearless football turned this into a spectacle.
‎
‎Even though, despite PSG walking away with the advantage in the first leg, I don’t see this tie as anywhere near decided because of what Bayern Munich is capable of, and the fact that it will be happening in their home, in front of their fans. If anything, the second leg might be even more intense. Bayern will feel they left opportunities on the table, and playing at home  could give them the edge they need to turn things around.
‎
‎PSG, on the other hand, must be cautious and improve defensively in the second leg. Scoring goals away is one thing, and managing a high-pressure return leg against a team like Bayern is a completely different challenge. They will need discipline, composure, and perhaps a more balanced defensive performance if they want to protect their lead and progress to the final.
‎
‎Personally, I think this is what makes knockout football so special and interesting game to watch. A high-scoring first leg doesn’t guarantee anything, but it only raises the stakes. One early goal in the second leg could flip the entire narrative.
‎
‎Nine goals later, we’re left with one clear truth and which is this battle is far from over until the last minute in the second leg.
‎

links.body:
**Talent without discipline is a scam people tell themselves.** You’re seeing the ugly truth up close: some students are bright, but if they keep delaying, the exam doesn’t care about their potential. That part of your post hits hard because it’s real, not motivational wallpaper.

The image works too. The contrast between the calm, focused students and the stressed center figure sells the point well — **late panic is always noisier than steady preparation**. Brutal, accurate, and honestly a little too familiar for anyone who has ever touched mathematics the night before an exam.

What you wrote also matches the broader pattern people keep talking about: procrastination, anxiety, and weak study habits feed each other, while consistent guidance from teachers actually helps break that cycle, as discussed in this [review on academic procrastination](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2589979125000320) and this [study on teacher motivation reducing procrastination](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s40359-025-02352-5). Math fear is its own beast too, and it gets worse when students wait too long, which lines up with this [study on math anxiety and learning experience](https://dl.acm.org/doi/full/10.1145/3796114.3796115).

You’re also not just complaining here — you’re carrying the exhaustion of someone who actually gives a damn. That’s the difference. A lazy student wastes their own talent, but a caring teacher ends up spending extra energy trying to save them from themselves.

links.title: Wasted talent
links.body:
>

Time is something impossible to control, and it doesn’t matter how much we try, there is no way to control time. Some people can make the best use of time, and some people pass the time lazily without doing anything. They just think that they can catch up with others if they work hard later. Unfortunately, they never become serious about it unless they come to the end line, and in case of study, it’s also the same. Good students always work hard and prepare their lessons, while the lazy ones keep delaying, and they try to catch up when the exam approaches. It becomes very difficult for them to cover everything within a short time. ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbRMzLhaKghx1mMBh2w14NQd8CFZb9YBf2dCsa6qXSTxF/ai-image-1777662399229.jpeg) picture generated by rafiki I am not a job holder yet, but I do tuition. I have several students, and most of them belong to the good category. But not everyone. There are some of my students who are quite talented, but they never make any effort. As their teacher, I know how talented they are, and I can understand their potential well, but it doesn’t matter how talented they are or how much potential they have; they are bound to hit rock bottom at the end because if they don’t make any effort, their talent is useless. It doesn't matter how much I try to persuade all the students to give their best shot, a few students never take it seriously, and I can’t control them all the time as I have only limited time to control them or guide them. You must be curious to know why I am saying this today. Obviously, it’s because of my students also. At the present time, the SSC exam is ongoing in our country, and several of my students are candidates for the exam. And their next exam is Mathematics, and many students fear math, and it’s known to all. So, in the last two days I have been trying to assist all of my SSC exam candidates to do well, and to be honest, it’s quite exhausting. Even good students also need some clarification related to exams, and it’s natural. Those students who worked hard are not the issue. I just need to boost their confidence and give some pointers related to exams, and they can easily understand if they have any problems in Mathematics. But those people who didn’t prepare well are indeed hard to handle right at the moment because it’s indeed hard to make them understand all the things, as it’s not possible to make them understand all the things that I taught them in the last one year. But still there is a way to manage them and make decent results in exams, as long as they want to make efforts in a short time, and as their teacher, I am trying my best. I have been coming late the last two days as I was trying to solve their thoughts. Even after coming home, I am solving their doubts online also. I am not exhausted staying active here. Among those students I saw, a few of them can understand and solve math easily with my little help, and it’s making me feel bad because they are very talented and can grasp things easily, but they are too late to become serious. I wish those few students were serious one month ago. At least I am confident that they could bring A+ with my guidance based on the ability I am seeing now. I just feel bad for them because they were talented, but they didn’t use their talent when they had time. It’s hard for them to overcome those students who were serious from an earlier time. Hard work and continuous efforts are something that can beat talent also. Whatever, I hope all of my students do well in the exams.

links.title: Society only works with rules.  (Like it or not)
links.body:
#
Do you like to be free to choose?
**NOTE**: I tried to add an image or two but kept getting a CODE 500 error ☹️
![image.png](8) I'm going to do something different in this article since it is all about choice. There are two versions of the article. The one that I wrote and the one that AI \

.  I'll also include the messy : I wrote this version.  One is shorter and tighter.  Plus it does a pretty good job of stating my thoughts.  The other one is absolutely me.  However, it is much much longer at 1500 words.  Which is more important?  My right to write whatever I want OR your right to a shorter article that takes less time to read?  \n\n<a href=\

>Jump to vaccination section first time using a link to a lower place in the article. Don't know if it will work You are free to choose 😃 #
The AI sanitized version
#
True freedom doesn't work in society

We love the idea of freedom. “Do what you want.” “My body, my choice.” “No one tells me what to do.” Sounds great… until you try to live in a society. Because here’s the reality: > **Society only works with rules. Like it or not.** --- ## Rules vs Freedom (Canada, Philippines, Singapore) As a Canadian, I grew up hearing “the true north strong and free.” And to be fair, Canada does a decent job of balancing things. Compared to other places I’ve been? **Philippines** * Laws exist * Enforcement is inconsistent * Some people follow them, some don’t * Feels more free… and more chaotic **Singapore** * Laws are strict * Enforcement is consistent * Break them and you’ll feel it * Feels more controlled… but very orderly Canada sits somewhere in the middle. > We follow the rules… **as long as they seem fair, reasonable, and applied evenly.** That balance is the key. --- ## What freedom actually means Freedom isn’t the absence of rules. It’s the ability to live your life **within a system that lets everyone else do the same**. If there are no rules: * the strong dominate the weak * agreements mean nothing * safety disappears That’s not freedom. That’s survival of the fittest. So real freedom looks more like this: > **You can be who you want to be—without taking that same freedom away from someone else.** Which leads to a simple idea: > **Your freedom will always create limits for someone else.** The goal isn’t “no limits.” The goal is **reasonable limits**. --- ## When “my choice” affects you Now we get to preventive care. This is where people draw a hard line: > “My body. My choice.” And I get it. No one likes being told what to put into their body. But here’s the issue: > **Some personal choices aren’t actually personal.** Vaccination is the obvious example. If you choose not to vaccinate: * you might get sick * but more importantly, you might **spread it** And not to people like you. To: * infants * elderly * immunocompromised People who don’t get to choose. --- ## The uncomfortable trade-off So now we have a conflict: * Your right to refuse treatment vs * Someone else’s right to stay healthy And both are real rights. But they don’t coexist perfectly. If your decision increases risk to others, then your “freedom” is no longer contained to just you. That’s where society steps in. --- ## My take I don’t believe in forcing everything. But I do believe this: > If a preventive measure clearly protects others, not just yourself, then society has a right to push for it—even if that limits individual choice. Not blindly. Not without evidence. Not without weighing risk. But when the benefit is clear? I’ll side with the system that protects the most people. --- ## Final thought People like to say: > “Don’t infringe on my freedom.” Fair enough. But that goes both ways. > **Your freedom doesn’t include the right to put others at risk.** That’s not control. That’s the cost of living in a society.



## ⬇️ ORIGINAL VERSION BELOW ⬇️

> #
True freedom doesn't work in society
#
My Original Voice version

### ...The true north strong and free...
If you don't know that quote up above about the true north strong and free it is actually part of the Canadian national anthem. As a Canadian I truly value freedom but Canadians are also known for the \

.

In Canada we typically trust the government, we trust the police, we trust the institutions and we follow the rules.  **Mostly**.  Compared to other countries I've been in?

**Philippines**:
* Laws exist.  Police enforce them.  But enforcement isn't uniform, bribes happen, and some people seem immune while foreigners seem to get hit with every single one.

**Singapore**
* Laws exist.  Break them at your peril.  Enforcement is strict and stern.  Right now there is a French teenager facing 2 years in jail.  **\
**.  Okay, its a bit more than that.  He licked a straw from a public juice machine, then put it back with clean ones.  Plus he posted it online.  Check the article <a href=\

>here if you like. There are huge differences between the two countries so saying one system is good and the other is bad would be grossly misinformed. However, I can say that the Philippines feels somewhat more free ***and chaotic*** while Singapore feels somewhat more constrained but also ***more orderly***. Canada? I'd put it somewhere in the middle. When I asked ChatGPT I liked its response:
We’ll follow the rules… as long as they seem fair, reasonable, and applied evenly

# What freedom really means To me **freedom** doesn't mean a lack of rules. It means rules that keep society running orderly while allowing me to be the person I want to be. What **freedom's** does Canada state in our constitution? * Freedom of religion * Freedom of thought, belief, opinion, and expression * Freedom of peaceful assembly * Freedom of association With the **right** to * Fair legal system * Equality * Vote * Mobility It does **NOT** mean that I get to do whatever I want. Some people hate that society puts restrictions on them and pick and choose what restrictions they think are reasonable.

#
Restrictions in society

In general the reason for creating restrictions at all is because **MY** freedom shouldn't interfere with **YOUR** freedom. I would argue that in a functioning society laws exist so that each individual can be as free as possible without infringing on the freedom of someone else. I'll look to the **\

** from the Bible as fairly universally accepted restrictions. Feel free to disagree if you like but... ONE) Don't kill people. Sure a co-worker, customer, or random stranger might be really annoying but you can't kill them no matter how much you want to. Your freedom to remove a stressor doesn't override their right to live. TWO) Don't steal. Just because you really want a nice car you can't claim someone else's keys as your own. Your desire doesn't override their right to own something. THREE) Don't lie / cheat Sure it is way more convenient to lie and get what you want. However, your desire to get what you want doesn't override someone else's right for an honest deal. If contracts aren't trustworthy business breaks down. FOUR) You can't just take any mate you want. Just because someone is attractive doesn't mean you can automatically have them. You aren't free to take anyone you want as that would impinge on their freedom of choice. # I hope that is all really obvious Without rules there is chaos. Without rules the powerful impose their will on the weak. A society is only truly free when one person's freedom doesn't limit another person's freedom any more than is necessary to maintain order. Sure those are only my words and thought but I think they make sense.

#
But what if its **MY** body?

Hive Learners has asked about preventative care. Now my mom is a strong Anti-Vaxxer. She firmly believes that the COVID vaccine was being administered by the government to kill the elderly. I also had a cousin who had absolutely no desire to vaccinate either of her children as she worried about potential issues with the immunization. As a Pharmacist I see people coming in to get abortion pills and I've seen medication go out to be administered to actively end someone's life. Who is right? Who is wrong? How about benefits VS risk? How about limits on freedom and control over your own body? ### Thorny Questions to be sure. * **My mom's refusal to get vaccinated** The whole COVID thing was awful. People understand laws but when it comes to actually administering something into their body? **They drew the line**. No matter how small the risk their body was their own and how dare someone violate it. **I understand that**. However I also understand that one unvaccinated person could infect many others. For example: **A healthy 25 year old male**. Very unlikely to succumb to COVID and chooses **NOT** to be vaccinated. Sure he could get sick and recover so why bother? Except if **HE** is sick and sees a dozen elderly people? His choice could endanger, sicken or even kill a number of those people. In my eyes one person's freedom is infringing on a lot of other people's freedom. **I absolutely am in favor of vaccination** ... With a caveat. I want concrete proof that the vaccination is effective. I want concrete proof that the danger is real. I want concrete proof that the **risk** of the vaccine is far less than the **risk** of infection. And **YES** there is a risk with every vaccination. Just like **EVERY** medication in the pharmacy has potential risks associated with them. As a pharmacist only give a medication when the risk is worth the benefit. Only give the vaccine in the same way. * **My cousins vaccinating her children** I could post the same idea behind vaccinating children so that the very small risk to one child saves all the children from debilitating or fatal illnesses. For my cousin that risk became evident very quickly when she moved to Guinea. She worked with sick children and saw the diseases that were preventable ravaging them. Once she knew the risk? Her children were vaccinated very quickly. In Canada the risk was more \

it changed her viewpoint overnight.

I've seen the medical documentation of the old diseases.  Look up smallpox and it becomes very obvious why it is so important it was eradicated!  I've had chicken pox and would NEVER wish that on my children.  I've seen people who suffered with polio (yes I'm that old) and the simple fact that I haven't seen it in decades is proof to me that it works.

In my eyes an individual's right to not vaccinate impinges on another child's right to be healthy.  I would choose vaccination again with a few possible medical exceptions.

* A woman's right to abortion

Ok.  I'm really not wanting to go here so I'll only touch it briefly.  Many women argue it is their right to choose what to do with their body.  Others argue that the baby has the right to continue living.  A mother and baby are closely linked and there are many other factors involved.  It's messy and debatable so I'll leave this one to a different (much longer) discussion.

* A person's right to die.

This one is tougher.  Is a person free to choose the date of their death?  By my definition a person should be free to choose as long as it doesn't encroach on another person's freedom.  Assume someone has limited time left, a very poor quality of life, and limited social interactions.  Will their death be an imposition on another person's freedom?  I would have to answer:  Quite possibly not.

**So should it be allowable?**

Tough call.  I took an oath to give no deadly drug so how do I feel when I see medication going out ... knowing the person will be dead by noon?  Honestly?  Awful. I value their freedom to choose but at the same time believe that life is precious.  What does it say about a society when it says \

.

Again.. a quagmire I'm not going to discuss here.  However. I love freedom but I love a well running society *with rules the protect life*.  Tough call.

**But there is another wrinkle**

How about life saving blood transfusions?  Some religions do not allow transfusions as their statues say \

and interpret that infusions as drinking blood. Do you allow them to refuse treatment that can save their life because of their religious beliefs? Again they should have the freedom to choose and it likely isn't infringing on another person's freedom. But again... should society be protecting life at all costs? Still a quagmire question.

#
Back to the Hive Learner prompt

Yes. Forcing vaccinations and disease prevention infringes on a person's rights. Babies getting vaccinations? Infringing on their rights and the parents rights. However, for vaccinations where there is clearly more benefit than risk? I'll side with societies health and my right to stay healthy in it over another person's right to choose. And as always feel free to disagree. I get criticism from my mom all the time and welcome respectful comments. Thanks for reading.

links.title: Flipping en OSRS: hacer dinero comprando barato y vendiendo caro.
links.body: Muchos ven los MMORPG como simples juegos de combate, misiones interminables y niveles que subir y realmente en eso de resumen pero para mí, la verdadera adrenalina no está en derrotar a un jefe final, sino en dominar el mercado y obtener márgenes de ganancia solo con paciencia.\n\n

/> Siempre me ha fascinado la economía, y en mi aventura actual me propuse una meta ambiciosa: Conseguir la membresía de osrs sin gastar un solo centavo de mi bolsillo, operando exclusivamente mediante el flipping.

/> Si alguna vez haz jugado Free to Play (F2P) en osrs, sabes que el camino es cuesta arriba. El juego te limita a solo 3 casillas de compra/venta en el Grand Exchange mientras que un miembro puede diversificar su capital en muchas ranuras, yo tuve que aprender a ser extremadamente selectivo.

/> **Mi estrategia se divide según mi tiempo disponible:** **Días de alta actividad:** Cuando la motivación está al máximo, realizo entradas y salidas rápidas constantemente, es un flujo constante de comprar barato y vender caro en cuestión de minutos aprovechando la volatilidad del momento.

/> **Días de poco tiempo:** Debido a mis responsabilidades laborales en el mundo real, a veces solo puedo entrar una vez al día, en esos casos, elijo un solo ítem sólido, pongo la orden de compra y al final del día la pongo a vender, es un comercio lento pero seguro.

/>\n\nExisten muchas páginas web que te sugieren qué ítems comprar para hacer flipping, pero en mi experiencia, buscar por cuenta propia siempre da mejores resultados, cuando usas una página que todo el mundo ve, el margen de ganancia se evapora rápido porque miles de jugadores intentan hacer lo mismo, mi éxito ha dependido de detectar esos \
de precio de forma manual, entendiendo el comportamiento de los otros jugadores.\n\n

/> Fuente: \[OSRS Wiki\](https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/) Hoy puedo decir con orgullo que logré reunir el dinero para la membresía, pero no la he activado todavía. ¿Por qué? Porque entiendo que entrar al mundo de los miembros con la billetera vacía es un error táctico, mi objetivo ahora es seguir acumulando capital para que, una vez que active la membresía y tenga acceso a más casillas y mejores ítems, pueda realizar un flipping mucho más agresivo.

/>

¿Te gustaría que en mi próximo post haga una guía paso a paso para principiantes sobre cómo detectar márgenes de ganancia? Me encantaría leer sus opiniones en los comentarios, es un gusto publicar por primera vez aquí. Soy nuevo por aqui y quiero aprender y enseñar, si cometí algún error en mi post pueden hacérmelo saber, Saludos a todos!

**\
/> Saludos desde osrs! Más vivo que nunca.

links.title: HPUD - Hive Power Up Day May 2026
links.body:
It's the first day of the month, and that makes it Hive Power Up Day !

Also, Happy May Day, everyone ! 😁


![fO0KCHv8YvrBEq2rIBeg--0--h309o.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/AK9RWZQarnLSJD38YnpCjNKF1ninUwUzob3HELU4Tfx1j4Vf4ebmfvUApAYvheU.jpg)
*Image created by AI in NightCafe Studio*

![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)

I've done my bit this month, powering up 1000 of my liquid HIVE. I normally post a screenshot at this point, but something somewhere in Hive is playing up and neither PeakD or Ecency seem to be allowing me to upload new images.

#### My Thoughts on Hive For The Start of May ####

Well first off, I'm noticing an increasing loss of reliability among the front ends. My guess is that nodes are being switched off by people who just look at them as a way of making money, meaning that those left are having to work harder.

The low price of Hive is most definitely creating a period of introspection, and I believe that is a hugely beneficial thing in the long run. We are finally starting to have conversations around governance and the way the DHF funds projects. If we all look at the proposals that are presented, and ask probing questions about the business case and value for money, that can only be a good thing.

Additionally, I notice the interest rate on HBD has dropped to 12%. It's a drop from the 20% it was at for so long, but still about three times what you can get here in the UK from even the best-performing traditional bank savings account.

The report from @arcange earlier highlighted a drop in HBD held in savings. That is a natural effect of the interest rate change. 

But I actually think it's a good thing, even if I will miss the earned interest ! By doing this, it shows we want to get a handle on Hive's excessive inflation, which is one of the key drivers pushing the price down. But it also has a hidden benefit; it encourages people to actually *use* their HBD. Having a stable(ish) coin we can use for transactions with no transaction fees could be just the thing to gain wider adoption. 

It's a bit of a hobby horse of mine to see HBD used for e-commerce payments, even if it's only the \

used to keep fees down for people who want to pay in BTC. I haven't got the knowledge to code it myself, or the time to learn how, but I'd love to see it happen !





![Hive Divider3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alonicus/243C5mWFmzYKkxg4bWBHWfD2x6cr2FN5gce7VFCxhFBfQ9BLPVjCzA6T5fpDC8UAq9Ua1.jpg)
