body.title: Un loquillo que controla el mundo (A guy who controls the world) [ES/EN]
body.body:
<center>

![portada Un loquillo que controla el mundo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rinconpoetico7/23x1HTgCySBqkWtNM2DX41AsvW78rNo9QqwPQwyYiLkQd7gHws73vRyyBVc2MUFk9EWtp.jpg)

***

![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

***
<center>Español
#### Un loquillo que controla el mundo</center>

<div class=\

>

Un loquillo, loquero, controla el mundo. Un loquillo anda desvariando, por aquí, por allá. Dice algo y el mundo explota. Dice algo y todos temen. Dice muchas cosas, bastantes de las cuales da para hablar.

Se mete en caos, se mete en apocalipsis de fuego. Mira el mundo y apunta a quien no hace su voluntad. Explota como una bomba de neutrones, su rostro enrojece cuando pierde la paciencia, su pelo falso vuela por el aire cuando pierde los estribos.

Su voz retumba por todos los países. Ultimátum lanza a diestra y siniestra, los ojos de muchos salen de sus órbitas, vuelan algunas cabezas, gobiernos caen, regímenes se vuelven fuertes, otros desfallecen ante su verbo violento y autoritario.

El loquillo es feliz cuando se hace su voluntad, cuando sus planes se concretan. Cuando trata de organizar un mundo con tantos matices ideológicos, tantos puntos de vista, tantas formas de gobernar, perversas, corruptas, socialistas, mentirosas, extremistas, idealistas, represivas y teológicas. 

El loquillo quiere mover a su corriente a todos, sea por las buenas o con una fuerza destructiva sin medida. El loquillo sueña tal vez con su mundo ideal, donde todos van por un mismo lado, donde todos hacen sin oponerse su voluntad, tal vez el loquillo se cree el rey del mundo.

Tal vez el loquillo recuerda a otro loquillo que quiso conquistar el mundo, en un pasado lejano, en un pasado lleno de muertos, millones y fanatismos contagiosos como la gripe. Tal vez recuerda a ese loquillo de bigote chistoso, pero que infundía miedo, reverencia y adoración sin límites. Una especie de dios que se creó desde una ideología.

Aquel loquillo del norte, tal vez tiene ese ideal, aunque sin tanto fanatismo, solo con violencia y el poder de las bombas y las balas que vuelan en nombre del loquillo, cambiando uno que otro régimen, unos caen, otros resisten la asfixia del loquillo que aprieta la garganta económica, siguen resistiendo, no por convicción, simplemente por orgullo y ego, sin importar lo que sufra la gente, el pueblo, aquel pueblo que juraron proteger con palabras falsas.

El loquillo sigue soltando sus bombas, sus discursos, un tanto atropellados, pero que generan miedo, precaución y en muchos casos sometimiento a pesar de...

Un loquillo que es rey, eso dicen, o tal vez se cree rey, nada de demócrata. Una corona que se ciñe en su sien, su imaginación divaga entre el dorado de una adoración real. ¿Será es su sueño? ¿Qué cucarachas andan por su mente? Muchos dictadores, muchos dirigentes, muchos fanáticos darían su vida al mundo del averno, por saber que pasa por aquella cabeza dorada, que secretos guarda para entender su accionar, su actuar atropellado.

Mientras tanto, el loquillo sigue peleando con todos, rojos, azules, blancos, oscuros, amarillos y todos aquellos que no hagan su voluntad, aquellos que no se pongan en su lado de la línea, sufrirán de las lanzas de sus palabras, que llevan consigo ultimátum, que llevan violencia, que llevan muerte, que llevan sufrimiento. Los que se envalentonaron acabaron mal o sufren por el poder del loquillo. Desde los aires decide el futuro de millones, en pro del beneficio propio, en beneficio de su dominio. Unos falsos héroes levantan la voz en contra de loquillo, pero cuando su voz retruena en sus tímpanos, se esconden dentro de sus cajas y miran para otro lado. Algunos dirían \

.

Mal o bien aquel loquillo dejara su huella en la historia, será recordado como un héroe o villano, depende del punto de vista. Eso sí, el loquillo sabe lo quiere e irá por ello cueste lo que cueste y tenga que pasar por quien sea. Ahora, el loquillo da media vuelta y se pierde entre las sombras con su gorra roja, que tiene una frase que tal vez cumpla o no, quien sabe, el tiempo lo dirá.

***
![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

***
<center>English

#### A guy who controls the world</center>

<div class=\

>

A madman, a shrink, controls the world. A little fool is running amok, here, there. He says something and the world explodes. He says something and everyone is afraid. He says a lot of things, enough of which he gives to talk about.

He gets into chaos, he gets into apocalypse of fire. He looks at the world and aims at those who do not do his will. He explodes like a neutron bomb, his face turns red when he loses his temper, his fake hair flies through the air when he loses his temper.

His voice resounds through all the countries. He throws ultimatums left and right, the eyes of many come out of their sockets, some heads fly, governments fall, regimes become strong, others faint before his violent and authoritarian verb.

The loquillo is happy when his will is done, when his plans come to fruition. When he tries to organize a world with so many ideological nuances, so many points of view, so many ways of governing, perverse, corrupt, socialist, lying, extremist, idealistic, repressive and theological. 

The loon wants to move everyone to his current, either by good intentions or with an immeasurable destructive force. Maybe the loquillo dreams of his ideal world, where everyone goes for the same side, where everyone does without opposing his will, maybe the loquillo thinks he is the king of the world.

Maybe El loquillo remembers another loquillo who wanted to conquer the world, in a distant past, in a past full of dead, millions and contagious fanaticism like the flu. Maybe he remembers that funny little guy with a mustache, but he instilled fear, reverence and adoration without limits. A kind of god that was created from an ideology.

That loquillo of the north, perhaps has that ideal, although without so much fanaticism, only with violence and the power of bombs and bullets that fly in the name of the loquillo, changing one regime after another, some fall, others resist the suffocation of the loquillo that tightens the economic throat, they continue to resist, not out of conviction, simply out of pride and ego, regardless of what the people suffer, the people, that people they swore to protect with false words.

The loquillo continues to drop his bombs, his speeches, somewhat run over, but that generate fear, caution and in many cases submission despite...

A loony who is a king, so they say, or maybe he thinks he's a king, nothing like a democrat. A crown that is cinched on her temple, her imagination wanders among the gilding of a royal worship. Will it be his dream? What cockroaches are running through your mind? Many dictators, many leaders, many fanatics would give their lives to the world of hell, to know what goes through that golden head, which keeps secrets to understand their actions, their trampled action.

Meanwhile, the loon continues to fight with everyone, red, blue, white, dark, yellow and all those who do not do his will, those who do not take his side of the line, will suffer from the spears of his words, which carry ultimatums, which carry violence, which carry death, which carry suffering. Those who were emboldened ended up badly or suffer because of the power of the loquillo. From the air he decides the future of millions, for his own benefit, for the benefit of his domain. Some fake heroes raise their voices against Loquillo, but when his voice echoes in their eardrums, they hide inside their boxes and look the other way. Some would say \

Either that little guy will leave his mark on history, he will be remembered as a hero or a villain, it depends on the point of view. Of course, the loquillo knows he wants it and will go for it no matter what it costs and has to go through whoever he is. Now, the loquillo turns around and gets lost in the shadows with his red cap, which has a phrase that maybe he will fulfill or not, who knows, time will tell. *** ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

body.title: Power of gratitude
body.body:
/>

We have a lot to be thankful for in our lives. As it is said that beauty lies in the eyes of a beholder. In the same way , the realisation of the blessings present in our everyday life can only be seen by those eyes that are grateful and that can see the wonders of nature playing as key players in their lives!!

Now a days everybody is focusing on the importance of gratitude for mental health and personal well-being .

The more you are grateful in your life, the more it has a compounding effect on your circumstances.!!

body.body:
Yes- students can still thrive academically despite financial struggles, but it takes strategy, not just willpower.

Hardship doesn’t automatically kill performance. It changes the conditions you have to work in. The students who make it through are usually the ones who treat their time, energy, and money like limited resources and build systems around that.

How it can be achieved:
Structure over stress: Financial pressure eats focus. The ones who thrive block out “money stress time” separately from “study time.” If you’re constantly thinking about fees or rent while reading, you won’t retain anything. Use weekends to solve money problems, weekdays to study. 

Textbooks, notes, and past questions don’t need to be bought by everyone. Study groups cut costs and improve understanding. Financially stressed students often excel because they’re forced to collaborate instead of competing.

They should be encouraged to take up side gigs- but not any gig. A student who spends 6 hours daily driving a bike or doing night shifts will crash academically. The goal is income that doesn’t destroy your main asset: brainpower.

Gigs that work for students:
Online/remote work: Writing, graphic design, tutoring, content moderation. You control hours and can do it between lectures.  
Campus-based: Selling snacks, printing services, helping lecturers with data entry. Low commute, flexible.  
Skills-based: If you’re a CS student, do freelance coding. If you’re a mass comm student, run social media for small shops. It pays and builds your CV.

The rule: If the gig takes more than 10–15 hours/week or cuts into sleep/lecture time, it’s costing you more than it earns. Academics is still the long-term leverage point.

Should they focus solely on studies? Only if they have a reliable support system - family, scholarship, or savings. For the majority who don’t, “focus solely” means dropping out eventually due to fees. The best answer is *“hybrid focus”*: studies first, gigs second, and both done intentionally.

The real key: Community Students don’t thrive alone. Mentors, alumni, and even classmates who share info about grants or gigs make the difference. Hardship isolates.

body.title: Why Do People Value You More When You’re Gone?
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXbX4P1yB8qPDMackFfMXNBJU2rWKA69gDcp35tSjMSAx/1777661817334.jpg)

It’s a strange thing, and honestly, a little painful to think about. People often have the nicest things to say about you… but only after you’re gone. While you’re alive, trying, struggling, showing up every day — many don’t notice. Or maybe they notice, but they stay quiet. No appreciation, no acknowledgment, nothing that makes you feel seen.
But the moment you disappear, everything changes.
Suddenly, you become “a great person.”
Someone says, “He was so kind.”
Another says, “I wish I told him how much I respected him.”
And you just sit there, wondering — why didn’t they say this before?
I’ve seen this happen many times, not just in big situations, but in normal life too. In families, in friendships, even in small communities. A person keeps giving, keeps being there, keeps trying to do right… but people take it as normal. Like it’s expected. Like it doesn’t need to be appreciated.
Maybe the truth is uncomfortable.
People are not always good at expressing appreciation in the present. They delay it. They assume there will always be time. They think, “I’ll say it someday.” But “someday” doesn’t always come.
And sometimes, people only realize value after loss. When something is no longer available, it suddenly feels rare. Important. Irreplaceable.
But here’s the hard truth — and I’m not going to sugarcoat it:
If you think you need to “disappear” or “break” or “end” just to be valued, that’s a dangerous mindset. It’s not strength. It’s not truth. It’s frustration speaking.
Because real value isn’t built after death. It’s built while you’re alive.
It’s built in your actions.
In your consistency.
In how you carry yourself when no one is clapping.
And yes, sometimes people won’t notice immediately. That’s reality. Not everyone is paying attention. Not everyone has the depth to understand what you bring.
But that doesn’t mean you are worthless.
It just means you are in a place where your worth is not fully seen yet.
Instead of waiting for people to appreciate you after you’re gone, build a life that forces recognition while you’re still here. Not by begging for attention, but by becoming undeniable.
Work on yourself.
Grow quietly.
Let your actions speak louder than your need for validation.
And also — be the kind of person who doesn’t repeat this mistake with others. If someone in your life is good, say it now. If someone matters, tell them now. Don’t wait for absence to create appreciation.
Because in the end, the real tragedy is not that people speak good after someone is gone…
The real tragedy is that they stayed silent when it actually mattered.

body.title: Minimal Light, Maximum Impact  / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR7K7RcenFVE4Mky12cE1DNVTdqJ8jDTWgi9rh4Ldkggb/_7504603_copia.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *

Greetings hivers.

Today we are going to play a bit with light. Shooting with a single light source may seem limiting, but it actually opens up a whole world of creative possibilities. With just one point of light, we can shape the body, guide the viewer’s eye, and build a very defined atmosphere.

Personally, I tend to lean toward low key lighting. I enjoy working with minimal light, letting the shadows breathe and allowing parts of the scene to remain hidden. Silhouettes, strong contrasts, and deep shadows allow us to suggest more than we show, and that is where, for me, the image gains strength.

Highlighting certain parts of the body while others fade into darkness creates an interesting balance between what is seen and what is concealed. It becomes a constant interplay between light and shadow, where every decision completely transforms the final result.

Here I leave you some examples of this type of lighting. They may seem like simple exercises, but they are rich in expressive possibilities.

Let me know what you think.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmao3pVA9jDd9XNFDTUQXqPNjaJ1q2Go8gUuhBNgh19TaL/_7504611_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkxcDaAhBC551J8MuYWRM6dH8yd1Y9DpW1WVUgMaehME/_dsc9260_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPQwTcKbrMS7Ma3ZsnVd3SHG9peZBZDt2PEm3dtk1bCk/_dsc9287_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVf7uWf6rkzKqtWUGtZ4GuqNG6qbwLfdt6RMYBfrZU1bF/_dsc9294_copia.jpg)

Saludos hivers.

Hoy vamos a jugar un poco con la luz. Retratar con una sola fuente puede parecer limitado, pero en realidad abre un mundo de posibilidades creativas. Con un solo punto de luz podemos moldear el cuerpo, dirigir la mirada y construir una atmósfera muy marcada.

Personalmente suelo inclinarme por las claves bajas. Me atrae trabajar con poca luz, dejar que las sombras respiren y que no todo esté completamente revelado. Las siluetas, los contrastes fuertes y las zonas en penumbra permiten sugerir más de lo que muestran, y ahí es donde, para mí, la imagen gana fuerza.

Marcar ciertas partes del cuerpo mientras otras se pierden en la oscuridad genera un equilibrio interesante entre lo visible y lo oculto. Es un juego constante entre luz y sombra, donde cada decisión cambia por completo el resultado final.

Aquí les dejo algunos ejemplos de este tipo de iluminación. Son ejercicios sencillos en apariencia, pero muy ricos en posibilidades expresivas.

Ya me dirán qué tal les parece.


* * *

To me, the concern here is that it creates an argument for all forms of crypto including DAO's to be fully regulated. Of course, it instantly creates issues around who regulates what and where (does the FTC have authority in the UK, EU, Africa, China ?). It also carries with it the implication that full KYC will be required for everything crypto-related.

All this destroys the whole point of crypto; it would just fold it neatly into the controlled and manipulated legacy finance system. Exactly what the legacy financiers want, of course.

So perhaps the answer is for people brighter than me in crypto to come up with ways for crypto to self-regulate that genuinely work without breaking anonymity. Then publicise them heavily. If there are ways to write contracts and structure DAO's that genuinely protects ordinary investors and users, I'd like to think we could create them. It could break crypto free of the dubious reputation that it has gained and lead to true mass adoption.

body.title: Weekend Movie – Experiment X Earth Threat (1954)
body.body:
![movie-film-roll-clip-art-10.jpg](4)


A 1950’s ‘creature feature’ for you all this week.  Experiment X Earth Threat concerns a nuclear scientist who whilst surveying the aftermath of a nuclear weapon test goes missing after his military plane crashes during the survey.  The pilot is killed but the scientist disappears.  He turns up some time later at his home but is behaving bizarrely and suffering from hallucinations.

He suffers a nervous breakdown, runs off, punching an FBI agent on the way, but is eventually captured and brought back.  Whilst under hypnosis the scientist accounts for his missing time but his story is a fantastical tale of being captured and experimented on by aliens with bulging eyes who want to exploit Earth’s nuclear energy resources.

This movie has been described as a mixture of Cold War anxiety and the fear of an extraterrestrial invasion.  I find that I agree with that description and the movie probably played well with American audiences who were both fearful of attack from the Soviet Union and of a destructive nuclear war.

This is probably not the best print of this movie that’s out there but it’s the one I could find.  Bear with the film print quality, it probably looked better in the cinema with a better, fresher, print. This copy has been chopped at the end, the conclusion and denoumont of the film is still there but the end titles and the big swirl of orchestral music that this sort of film had at the end, is missing. 

For those who like old communication equipment this film will be a treat.  There’s the lot here. Old two way radio transceivers, manual telephone switchboards with plugboards, telex and image facsimile machines and even Lamson Tubes (which are still being manufactured). There’s also old TV’s, telephones, a slide rule and even a cigarette machine in a hospital. 

Hope you like this one. You may have to click through and watch it on YouTube due to copyright reasons.

The first step is to sketch this character in pencil on paper, then scan it to convert it to a digital format

>Lo primero  es elaborar  este personaje en lapicero sobre hoja, luego de ello escanearlo para tenerlo en formato digital






<center>https://media.tenor.com/NgJGVMOst7MAAAAC/line-pink-light.gif</center>




Given this, the character has to fit certain typical tropes, so it’s only natural that his power involves using a laser gun 

>Ya con esto el personaje debe cumplir algunos clichés típicos, así que lo normal es que su poder es usar un arma de disparo laser 

<center>
![e1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23yU6vGknvzyokTEXGTa9Vh62RnwCd57T69q5pBxJ2R4U12miBBXc7gXenLzVwTGLrJ2G.png)
</center>

------------

Other individual attacks will be physical combat moves where you have to strike your opponent, so with that said, here is a list of them:

>otros ataques individuales serán comandos de batalla físicos donde deberá golpear al oponente, asi que  dicho esto aca un repertorio de estos:


<center>![e2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23tw9y9XQGkYGRD25cYJpqcM7TLPBU88eJdfbCeSu1i5jJ26A7cWYByeWg7NfSeaoTxU7.png)</center>

a ranged attack that knocks the opponent down

>un ataque a distancia que derriba al oponente


---

<center>![e3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23uFufP6pKFyzDsXj2DCkWZc791JdFBpb1eP4mszQVofkagxf9gMhSygL3P5MzZa9xVTj.png)</center>

a close-range attack that lifts the opponent

>un ataque a corta distancia que eleva al oponente


---


<center>![e4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23viTTnT3EjvUvxY2px1ySXDYei756Zaddz2ce56gzbX8x9auZdYyKfNPHho2cZMB1W7i.png)</center>

a uppercut 

>un gancho 

---

<center>![e5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/EonsDNhXZEmffKiDwjVy3RTEumzTkdLSDqXpeRDaYxeUgybKKcZSjwptKqWAvVjYtBD.png)</center>

A long-range grapple with a scorpion-style projectile that draws the opponent in, plus a flamethrower waiting for them 

>un agarre a distancia con objeto arrojadizo estilo scorpion que atrae al oponente. mas un lanzallamas que lo espera 

---


<center>![e6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23xf7YNjpLLv2kQQWufKWgVb7UXxVdSdpWhLWRKWhMTFxYN1SrhHBDZvsEn66LVRH3KXD.png)</center>

A close-range attack consisting of a powerful electric blast (Benimaru-style), combined with a black gravity blast fired from his ship that comes to his aid, knocking the opponent down

>Un ataque a corta distancia que es un disparo eléctrico de cerca (tipo Benimaru), junto a un disparo de gravedad negra desde su nave que llega a auxiliarlo, derribando al oponente

---


<center>![e7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23twAKV12xUZCnWoZZbSwjfGkCHei3261Gv6Z4csRgFcVg5tTQFfkFVripXc8ARe16Pb5.png)</center>

>a physical charge with the small craft he uses to move around the stage, which sends his opponent flying into the air
una envestida fisica con su pequeña nave que usa para desplazarse en el escenario, que eleva al oponente a los aires


---

<center>
![e8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23vsqgi4sDu816rDq5AR3x9SELiWHBJhJafYDXdgmADGcLsj9kohQdh6sYMCcEoGGGCEJ.png)</center>


Among his unique abilities is a shot that slows his opponent's advance toward him, while he wields a metal whip that sets his opponent ablaze

>dentro de sus peculiaridades un disparo que relentiza el avance de su rival hacia el, mientras carga un latigo metálico que incendia a su rival en llamas


---


<center>![e10.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23w3EiFH9EjLtZdPMYHkJfRue48uUYmAEWbFLR1xvgvDGEHhfKFbVZtdL53Y51WhTqBwr.png)</center>

a charge, gaining momentum with his ship, as he jumps out of it and uses a drill-shaped metal arm, plus a physical kick

>una embestida tomando impulso con su nave, mientras salta de ella y usa un brazo metalico en forma de taladro, mas una patada fisica


---


<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaLqVh184UKkybbGS92vKgaCh71R73wYra3ySJLWoWB5j/e9.png)</center>




---


An uppercut (shoryuken), but with something extraordinary—like dimensional fire and a satellite beam—something different from what we've seen in Street Fighter


>un gancho  tipo (shoryuken),pero con algo extraordinario, como fuego dimensional y un rayo satelital, saliendo del típico golpe que eleva de street fighters



<center>https://media.tenor.com/NgJGVMOst7MAAAAC/line-pink-light.gif</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWn3GVpuFehxBXEwFu5GfCMecCFdVx41waZsU8jHj71uM/e11.png)</center>



A close-range grab (not Ryu's throw) is more like slamming the opponent into the ground with a mechanical claw 


>un agarre de cerca ( no es la catapulta de Ryu) es mas bien un azote contra el suelo al rival con garra mecánica 


<center>![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/seko1P4L-aEAAAAC/kula-diamond-ryuji-yamazaki.gif)</center>


<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWwf8eAJvNkExrCwV5mnGH7bTZR7yuWuax9kejPbEKQwm/e12.png)</center>



Another ability is to reflect attacks; in this case, a portal beam that sends whatever the opponent throws at it right back at them.

>Otro comando es reflejar poderes, en este caso un rayo portal que devuelve lo que le arroje el rival justo detrás de sus espaldas.

---




<center>https://media.tenor.com/LrskwuTbCVoAAAAi/kof-kyo.gif</center>
S1 (Supers)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW1tH1x37FoEQa8cE1xP4HqXKetiTPVXUBTzrsUC38FKS/e13.png)</center>



He's an alien, and they'll always find a way to leave no trace of their visit. I came up with a move that temporarily erases the opposing player's movements.
Of course, to activate it, they have to hit the decoy with a physical attack, but it's interesting to try something different.

>es un alienigena, y siempre buscaran la forma de no dejar evidencia de su visita, se me ocurrio un disparo que borre temporalmente los movimientos del jugador rival
aunque claro que para activarlo deben golpear el muñeco señuelo con un golpe fisico, pero es interesante hacer algo distinto


---

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW287t96U6VMXSKHfkMd2Wi6Ugr2NDAp5sxnq3kqCoy5b/e14.png)</center>



And a more classic way to show off his true nature is to board his levitating ship and fire continuous laser beams at his opponent from it


>y uno mas clásico que demuestre su naturaleza, es subir a su nave que levita y disparar rayos laser continuos desde ella a su oponente
  

---

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYx8vKH1NWTuBW7ESQAAv1jDQ9bbBymQGwPBYqRbYdftE/sup_1_3.png)</center>



His dual superpower involves leaping backward while spinning and summoning a mechanical appendage that fires a bolt of lightning at ground level, electrocuting his opponent, followed by a complete transformation during which he mercilessly attacks with a barrage of laser blasts, obliterating his opponent.

>su super poder doble es saltar hacia atrás con un giro e invocar una extensión mecánica que lanza un rayo eléctrico a nivel del suelo que electrocuta al rival, seguido de una transformación completa donde ataca sin piedad con disparos laser continuos fulminando a su contrincante.



<center>https://media.tenor.com/NgJGVMOst7MAAAAC/line-pink-light.gif</center>

body.title: Around The World: Challenge - #52/6
body.body:
> Jedna z nejstarších pravidelných soutěží na Hive se blíží ke svému závěru.
Definitivnímu?
Doufám, že ne. Jsem připraven pokračovat sedmým ročníkem :-).

> One of the oldest regular competitions on Hive is coming to an end.
A definitive one?
I hope not. I'm ready to continue with the seventh annual :-). --- ---
**Welcome to the announcement of the final round of the sixth annual of the photography competition for all Hive users Vítejte u vyhlášení posledního kola šestého ročníku fotografické soutěže pro všechny uživatele Hive**

𝓐𝓻𝓸𝓾𝓷𝓭 𝓣𝓱𝓮 𝓦𝓸𝓻𝓵𝓭

--- ---

> Teď však myslete na to, jak co nejlépe uzavřít šestý ročník soutěže.
Pokuste se dodat fotografie ze všech kontinentů naší planety. Všude se dají najít a vyfotit zajímavé stavby, přírodní scenérie nebo něco, co přitáhne pozornost k vašemu regionu. Pokud se to povede, bude to skvělý závěr.

> Now, think about how to best close the sixth annual of the competition.
Try to submit photos from all continents of our planet. Interesting buildings, natural scenery or something that will draw attention to your region can be found and photographed everywhere. If you succeed, it will be a great conclusion. ---
![linka1.png](2) **Rules**.
• use the #aroundtheworld tag • put a link to the article with the contest photo in the comments section of this article! • the competition photo must(!) be your own and have in the caption where it was taken • only one photo from each competitor will be included in the competition • if your article will contain more than one photo, mark with words (eg \

) the photo you want to place in the contest - EACH CONTESTANT WILL PAY THE STARTING FEE IN THE FORM OF 100% upvote on the article announcing the competition round. Without it, the COMPETITION PHOTO WILL NOT BE ENTERED INTO THE COMPETITION!!!!
**Selection of winners**. I ask for your active cooperation. Your competition photos will be judged from Saturday morning to Sunday afternoon at two locations. *First place* [Discord](https://discord.gg/CeMsrCeN) Czech community in the special channel `#around-the-world-by-bucipuci` You can help me pick a winner by joining Discord and putting a \
under your chosen photo. Before each \

you can give out. *Second place* Article with poll. In this article too, I will tell you how much you can support with photos. When voting, focus on the attractiveness and quality of the photos!! I will evaluate the competition round on Sunday evening based on your votes under the competition photos *Note: don't put links to contest photos in the `#around-the-world-by-bucipuci` channel! This channel will only be used for voting!!!*
**Prizes for winners**.
First prize ... 0.8 HBD Second price ... 0.6 HBD Third prize ... 0.4 HBD
The photo with the most votes will receive a *special prize* (1 HBD) with the right to participate in an additional photo of the month competition. If your contest photo is part of the daily report for [ACTIFIT](https://actifit.io), I will add these prizes:
First prize ... 100 AFIT Second prize ... 80 AFIT Third prize ... 60 AFIT
I appreciate everyone who participates in the contest. The reward amount may change downwards depending on the number of prizes awarded. ---
**Pravidla**.
• použít značku #aroundtheworld • vložit odkaz na článek se soutěžní fotografií do sekce komentářů k tomuto článku! • soutěžní fotografie musí(!) být vaše vlastní a mít v popisku kde byla pořízena • do soutěže bude zařazena jen jedna fotografie od každého soutěžícího • pokud bude váš článek obsahovat více fotografií, označte slovy (např. „toto je fotografie do soutěže“) fotografii, kterou chcete umístit do soutěže - KAŽDÝ SOUTĚŽÍCÍ UHRADÍ STARTOVNÉ V PODOBĚ 100% upvote na článek s vyhlášením soutěžního kola. Bez toho NEBUDE SOUTĚŽNÍ FOTOGRAFIE ZAŘAZENA do soutěže!!!!
**Výběr výherců**. Požádám vás o aktivní spolupráci. Vaše soutěžní fotografie budou hodnoceny od sobotního dopoledne do nedělního odpoledne na dvou místech. *První místo* [Discord](https://discord.gg/CeMsrCeN) České komunity ve speciálním kanále `#around-the-world-by-bucipuci` Připojením na diskord a vložením „hlasujícího emoji“ pod vámi vybranou fotografii mi pomůžete vybrat vítěze. Před každým „hlasováním“ určím, kolik můžete rozdat „hlasů“. *Druhé místo* Článek s anketou. I v tomto článku vám napíšu, kolik můžete podpořit fotografií. Při hlasování se zaměřte na atraktivnost a kvalitu fotografií!! Vyhodnocení soutěžního kola provedu v neděli večer na základě vašich hlasů pod soutěžními fotografiemi *Poznámka: do kanálu `#around-the-world-by-bucipuci` nevkládejte odkazy na soutěžní fotografie! Tento kanál bude sloužit pouze pro hlasování!!!* Žádám tímto členy české komunity o aktivní účast na hlasování :-)
**Ceny pro vítěze**.
První cena ... 0.8 HBD Druhá cena ... 0.6 HBD Třetí cena ... 0.4 HBD
Fotografie s největším počtem hlasů obdrží *speciální cenu* (1 HBD) s právem účasti na doplňkové soutěži o fotografii měsíce. Pokud je vaše soutěžní fotografie součástí denního hlášení pro [ACTIFIT](https://actifit.io), přidám ještě tyto ceny:
První cena ... 100 AFIT Druhá cena ... 80 AFIT Třetí cena ... 60 AFIT
Ocením každého, kdo se soutěže zúčastní. Výše odměny se může měnit směrem dolů v závislosti na počtu udělených cen. --- ---

>\nPokud jste dočetli až sem, tak vás musím pochválit. Pravidla znáte. Je na vás, jestli se jimi budete řídit. Upozorňuji však, že nedodržení pravidel je stejné, jako by jste se soutěže vůbec nezúčastnili.\n

> If you have read this far, I must praise you. You know the rules. It's up to you to follow them. However, please note that non-compliance is the same as if you did not participate in the competition at all.
![linkaATW.png](3) ![tazilogo.gif](4) ![linkacz.png](5) ![czlogo.png](6) ![linka1.png](7)

> Tradiční poznámka na závěr:
Toto kolo soutěže se uzavře 8.5.2026 ve 20:00 SEČ

> Traditional note at the end:
This round of the competition will close on 2026/05/08 at 20:00 CET --- ---

> A ještě jedna poznámka:
Nezapomeňte v sobotu 2.5. sledovat #aroundtheworld. Zveřejním tam anketu s hlasováním pro fotografie 51/6 kola soutěže ATW!

> And one more note:
Don't forget on Saturday 05/08 follow #aroundtheworld. I'll post a poll there to vote for the ATW 51/6 round photos!

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | Doing Good To All Men
body.body: > https://youtu.be/l0M_dhre2fg?si=ie5b0dh6rWgL4RYb If there is a particular act God has commanded every Christian, it is the fact that we should do good to everyone. It is one of the most direct and even simple teachings in the Christiandom but not the easy to practice. Whenever doing good to men is mentioned, people are always tempted to limit it to mean doing good to people who are kind to us but that's not so. It actually means you are showing love, kindness and patience to even people that might not treat you well and that is one of the things that makes doing good to all men quite so difficult. The Bible reminds us in Galatians 6:10, “As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men.” This shows that doing good is not selective; it is a responsibility for every believer. Looking at my experience,there were days I have actually feel so tired and even hurt by others. It was actually so difficult to respond back with goodness because whenever you remember what you have done to those people and what they did to you. But I always hold onto God word in Matthew 5:44, “Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you. One of the things the word of God always do to me is to rise above my challenges, above my struggles and always act in love. I have learnt in recent years that doing good is not really about how I feel but it is about my obedience to God's commandments. Doing good to all men is a daily decision. It requires a sincere heart and a willingness to follow God’s word. I may not always get it right, but I keep trying because I know that every act of goodness pleases God. Through this, I believe I can become a better person and a true reflection of His love.

body.title: My niece showing her talent for drawing; in this case, it's a Toad from Mario Bros
body.body: > On a Friday to share a post here in the community #fungifriday, it's perhaps difficult to find them in their natural state right now because the sun is very strong and doesn't give me that opportunity, so how can they be drawn? I asked my niece @celester07 if she could draw me a mushroom, but she said it could be any kind, and well, I took the opportunity to ask her for a specific one. >Un Viernes de compartir una publicación aquí en la comunidad #fungifriday quizás es ahora mismo complicado encontrarlos en su estado natural debido a qué el Sol está muy fuerte y no me da esa facilidad así que cómo se pueden dibujar le pedí a mí sobrina @celester07 si podría dibujarme un Hongo pero me dijo si podía ser cualquiera y bueno allí aproveché de pedirle uno en específico. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSGNPGsGP1WrSyXhhBocFw9K3bvHAxaJo1KzM5qtSTuB/1777660370925.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNRu1YJt1NBbxhPtCXdyqsGxAUgcpeHMBbdwyDtnjRE59/1777660371141.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRVktFkSF8sjgevZT8bRvNaUCBUUvXv1mSmYmKreCs8Q/1777660371310.jpg) Since the new Mario Bros. movie is all the rage right now, I asked him if he could draw Toad for me. After a few minutes, since he has an incredible talent for drawing, he called me back to ask if it was okay. You can imagine my surprise when I saw it; it definitely exceeded my expectations. Plus, I can combine it with a Mario Bros. figure I have at home from a children's party a while back, so I brought that party favor home as a great souvenir. Since I was a kid, I've been passionate about video games and their characters, although my favorite is definitely Bowser. I learned to enjoy and grow fond of the characters because I spent my childhood playing and having fun with them. >Cómo ahora mismo está de moda la nueva película de Mario Bros le pedí si podía dibujarme a Toad y luego de unos minutos ya qué tiene un talento increíble para los dibujos me llamó para decirme si así estaba bien entonces se pueden imaginar mí sorpresa cuándo lo ví sin duda superó mis expectativas además puedo juntarlo con un Mario Bros qué tengo guardado en casa de una fiesta infantil que fué ya hace un tiempo así qué me traje ese cotillón cómo un gran recuerdo puesto qué desde niño soy un apasionado por los videojuegos y de sus personajes aunque mí favorito sin duda es Bowser aprendí a disfrutar así cómo encariñarme con los personajes puesto qué mí niñez la pasé jugando y divirtiéndome con ellos. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVQt5YAbPcGnLWc9qTC2AP8ckUSuXGGWV88tJXGr8fNuf/1777660426608.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYNSAhhv12RBeuRGcjX9evYqfEzN4gTeSTTh5UCtFCbM2/1777660426858.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc1HkjGivhYLMWbM7pZJ146YA8fZMYo98BTwbWLm5NP5H/1777660427043.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeoYL7xiZQVDizgrLNq1epszrBxYLWbA5xqBgT3mBAyNe/1777660427225.jpg) I'm signing off, but not before thanking our friend @ewkaw for the opportunity to share this great drawing made by my niece @celester07 here in the #fungifriday community. It's also an important part not only of my childhood but of so many others around the world who, like me, enjoyed video games, and some of us still do. >Me despido no sin antes agradecer por la oportunidad que nos brinda el amigo @ewkaw por la oportunidad en este caso de compartir este genial dibujo hecho por mí sobrina @celester07 aquí en la comunidad #fungifriday y bueno también parte importante no sólo de mí niñez sino también de tantos otros en el mundo qué cómo yo disfrutamos con los videojuegos e incluso ahora algunos lo siguen haciendo.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 01 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g5962af49b77e72bb8353b21b7a593811b7e60f6f4cd469881b0f86c090642c769afc1e069b39f15410f9f0d33f9e1a7d_640.jpg)
My last walk took place along the beautiful South Downs Way, a long-distance trail that stretches along the rolling hills of Sussex and Hampshire. The crisp autumn air was invigorating, and the changing leaves painted the landscape in shades of amber, gold, and crimson. As I trekked along the path, I was captivated by the expansive views of the countryside. The iconic white chalk cliffs of the Seven Sisters came into sight in the distance, standing majestically against the backdrop of the blue sea. The contrast of the green hills and the bright sky was nothing short of breathtaking. I also passed quaint little villages like Alfriston, with its historic buildings and charming tea rooms. I made a stop at a small café where I enjoyed a delightful slice of homemade cake and a cup of tea. The café owner was friendly and knowledgeable, sharing stories about the local history and the ancient church nearby, which dates back to the 12th century. Along the way, I met fellow walkers—an older couple who were retracing their honeymoon hike from decades ago. They spoke of their adventures and shared tips about lesser-known paths in the area. It was lovely to hear their stories and see the joy that walking had brought them over the years. This walk not only offered a feast for the eyes but also a reminder of the rich history and community spirit that embodies England's landscapes. I returned feeling refreshed, inspired, and eager to plan my next adventure! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: A Small Step, A Big Journey
body.body:
Life sometimes forces people to stop and think. I've been in such a process for the last two years. I wanted to be self-sufficient, earn my own money and see that I could achieve something. So I took a step and opened my own store on Etsy. It was a small dream, but it was very precious to me.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevosZasLDBrVjEBbmAg4mSdSMiCHqBWDDyaccZFRUaM5/img_1796.png)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYsXRrPRNsLw2u3V9kYmvJohqVLGXxLQ2DhFfBU8Cx9FK/8d29f4c6_b440_4d20_8ec3_4974bbe0706b.jpg)


At first, everything was very exciting. Choosing products, thinking about designs, taking photos... All of them felt very good to me. I started working especially on metal wall decors. It made me happy to produce something that touches people's homes and rooms. Even the idea of having a product I designed on someone's wall is very nice. Now I have 237 products on my store.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTC4H3Ao9RGEYQJ5h453VGXjCU1evGHSnk9K4KhQzfmiV/img_1797.png)


But not everything always went as I planned. Sometimes I worked hard, sometimes I couldn't care at all. There are ups and downs in life. That's why I haven't yet reached the income I wanted and dreamed of. But this process taught me a lot. I learned to be patient, to continue and that small steps are also important.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPvujaqHLDpbxn2DgWLD6mxs2LAhRGiqxUHvTfv9WcTzQ/4962cca5_c2a0_4359_b929_3652f8154dd9.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGs1xbeEG2WTHENLRgBwM8D1JHKqXKqKV3KujYdTAYi2/a1669947_468c_4797_891f_5f6212379197.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQyu6KqT3qorVYcvsEcCHQ62EHd1TVP7saeUAV64CZjje/125e5d4c_17f8_4ba7_a238_c8c61ecc8402.jpg)


I'm not working in an active job right now. So I really need additional income. But I'm trying to see it as an opportunity, not an obligation. Because my motivation is very high right now. I have the desire to start again. I want to be more organized, produce more and grow my store.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaGz2K7Ec8zAatXojjyCaQfM7vgNFw7NDFqsiz3eNLXwN/cdea6770_f267_4b4e_9291_a1a0b1ad1382.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCB9UnHK51A9Q3yCUbATnXKh97pygKaRuKZYcczX2Kc1/af8a8f65_00ff_435f_897e_5fb9d4a64900.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZiXhEqpyWDCa1Z9fBWE3oTcaJS5SHcWX1w8edd1g4qan/9ce998d8_ecaf_41bd_94ed_1a02c20f9b72.jpg)


There are metal wall decors in different styles in my Etsy store. I make minimal designs, written decors and products that can be prepared for special occasions. I can also prepare personalized designs for people who want them. While preparing each product, \

I think. This is very important to me.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPvsUdgxA6aMVS2utw8JvXsnf1rpYmCanUbf3bN2RaQ1/9cf381c1_aad4_4b81_ad4a_6df75a17aca0.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmREY8tETHMTEzyETjVCmPiWxGt94qMZorkdLZeY6YKoyd/60bf5e50_896e_436b_adee_c8879f3b934c.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUo9Cxiir9TnGXJWZo4mQ2ffvEZkEF41RgS575t6xEP5v/1cc491bd_0fb0_447b_af57_9d61605b97de.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaMbtkcFoiH4JpbNgQcrtUX3qioPrfTui1w7H7yVaAV9c/ef268b8e_2c5e_4168_b7a0_993837339032.png)


The reason I share on this platform is actually to share this journey. Maybe there are people like me who are looking for their own way and want to try something. Maybe it will be an inspiration, maybe I will just get a message of support. Both are very valuable to me.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPjg7ATgSV3V1jme5hKA4745vUSV6g4HXaBZbdGRnvx97/img_7599.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSauhsAfmSfJHkXHCvFVJFFEHFzfoTRhNVegran4s8QNt/img_6715.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxuLJ8xsAZYfXyUsnQ6MtCJ8wQ94A4o4SJshiXe1Gh6g/img_5931.png)


You can take a look at my store if you want. Your comments, ideas and support are really important to me. Even a small support sometimes raises a person's motivation a lot.

My store link: [JynArtDecor](https://www.etsy.com/shop/jynartdecor/?etsrc=sdt)

I'm still at the beginning of the road. But I believe that if I work regularly and don't give up, I can get to the point I want. Maybe one day I will only live my life with the income I earn from this business. This is my biggest dream.

Thank you to everyone who read this article. 🙏

body.title: Ujurak Brave's ability was flawless — not a single monster fell in battle
body.body:
![tle g.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23vsUYpN5u9dcLYECaqJ29fgHoKdyJTk31vRZtnsH1frPvQ9QGBZZ2hiiVSpAg8rz78EN.png)


Such amazing victories are very rare where all my allied units stay alive in the battle and all enemy allied units get eliminated. This are the battles which you fought in the best way and you get the greatest victory of the time.

This is the real great victory which is a matter of pride and it is a good sign that your monster selection is excellent and you have taken great care in positioning. This represents that your selection in every mana battle is good and you are going great. Anyway,

Todays battle was 21 mana where I selected 7 monsters and the opponent also selected 7 monsters. I remembered that in the previous battle when I had a low mana battle I did not keep any attack monsters. 

![Screenshot 2026-03-27 110451.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/48Gg9BmKK53TYGGXNGWsfR1GjDbHkLzKXtuGzzStc6iQtmpWFcgtMpvdi1bRv4HcLp.png)

That means I kept receiving damage from the opponent but I had no attacking monster. That is why this time I kept that mistake in mind and selected the best monsters which made a strong team combination.

In this battle on the top front line I selected a tank monster which became the best monster of this battle and also my favorite. In the mid line I selected offensive monsters which kept hitting the opponent continuously. 

In the same way in the back line I had attackers and supportive monsters which keeps hitting enemy units and also supporting allied units. In this way I used an attacking strategy even in a low mana battle so that I could hit as much as possible.

![Screenshot 2026-03-27 110410.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23t7jLPfDbxk2yZiELqDEWqFfdpfQsirb3SJqDoHf6n2f19vEZAzpm5rtHzwMBgS1W4bh.png)

Because in low mana battles most players select low health and low mana monsters so if you have more attacking monsters you can eliminate units quickly. I applied the same strategy because of which I got a great win.

In this battle my best monster was Ujurak Brave which proved to be a very strong tank monster. If I talk about survivability it stayed alive till the end of the battle and kept absorbing all the damage. That is why it is called a beast like fighter which is considered a heavy tank.

Its most impressive ability was its shield. That means the damage it should receive was reduced because of the shield. Its shield kept working as an armor based defense which kept weakening the enemy attacks. Because of this even my front line monster survived till the end.

![Screenshot 2026-03-27 110121.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23u5Z9PhRvq8uqdykwMMuXaYKnDs2dEpPv1CQ8LhdBCqAruxsUGaVZYbSMuWFMZEH4fsY.png)

But like other monsters it also has a weakness which is its high mana cost. In low mana battles like 21 mana you have to think before selecting such monsters because its mana cost is high. After selecting it it becomes difficult to manage the rest of the monsters.

What do you people think about this monster? Have you ever played with this monster? Tell about its any ability you know. Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

body.title: Ezekiel 25:17
body.body:
<center>
![IMG_6259.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXydRCUC95LbTSLSwad5WgeM7SQ1oSHF8zKtsYyBChPhC/IMG_6259.jpeg)
___
___
So today I lost track of time while watching some Futurama episodes. It was well past noon even before I was able to pull my stuffs together and leave the house. Eventually I left and got to school and I met a very different scene. A number of colleagues came around. Today is a public holiday and on days like this there are very few people around, even most eateries don’t open. 
___
We had loads to conversations on different topics ranging from childhood encounters to labeling. I mean, the scope was broad and before you know it, it was 5 pm. It was at this point that I knew I had to start drawing else I wouldn’t be able to meet up with posting. 
___
Interestingly I stumbled on a sketch of Samuel L. Jackson from a scene in the 1994 Tarantino hit **Pulp Fiction**. That scene where he said;
***“The path of the righteous man is beset on all sides by the iniquities of the selfish and the tyranny of evil men. Blessed is he who, in the name of charity and good will, shepherds the weak through the valley of darkness, for he is truly his brother’s keeper and the finder of lost children.***

***And I will strike down upon thee with great vengeance and furious anger those who attempt to poison and destroy my brothers. And you will know my name is the Lord when I lay my vengeance upon you.”***

After the short delivery, there was a shooting spree with little blood exasperation. If you’ve not seen this movie, I recommend that you do. It is a great watch.
___
Upon seeing the reference, there was no way I would’ve passed on it. Slowly and steadily I built the layers but I didn’t notice the mismatch in the eye. The piece turned out great though.
___

body.title: Solitary pianist
body.body:
>Hello everyone.
This is an acrylic painting depicting a pianist in profile, wearing a black hat and with a cigarette in his mouth. The work is inspired by a photographic reference visible in the upper left corner. I created this painting as part of an exercise.
>I present to you the different stages of the creation of the acrylic painting Amsterdam.

>The main figure is a man seated at the piano, seen from a three-quarter back view. He wears a wide-brimmed black hat that partially obscures his face, a white shirt, and a dark vest. A cigarette is casually placed between his lips. His hands rest on the piano keys. His right hand appears to be playing the higher notes, while his left hand is more relaxed on the lower keys.

\n\n

>The atmosphere is bohemian, melancholic, and elegant, evoking the world of jazz pianists, cabaret performers, or artists of the early 20th century.
The style is expressionist with a touch of impressionism. The color palette is dominated by blacks, grays, and whites, with touches of red and pink on the vest and hands. The background is treated very freely, almost abstractly, with streaks of paint.

>The hands and face are rendered with greater precision, while the rest of the body and the background are more gestural and loose.

This painting symbolizes sensitivity, creative solitude, and emotional expression through music.
>I should mention that I gave this painting as a gift after its completion. I felt that this painting wasn't my own creation but rather an exercise in reproduction.

>
Thank you for this brief read. Take care.

body.title: Haltefrist in Gefahr: Wie würden sich neue Krypto-Steuern auf Deutschland auswirken?/Holding periods at risk: How would new crypto taxes affect Germany?
body.body:
Innerhalb der Bitcoin-Community mehren sich schon die Stimmen derjenigen, die Deutschland nun verlassen wollen. Unter dem Strich könnte eine Steueränderung den Staat am Ende also sogar Einnahmen kosten.


![53802.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcpoKQGSk13KFcNNpDXqvX2cXzcFCsf31fGcYGYQVUh5h/53802.png)


Sollte in Deutschland die steuerfreie Haltefrist abgeschafft und auf EU-Ebene auch noch eine Abgabe auf Krypto-Gewinne eingeführt werden, hätte das weitreichende Konsequenzen.

Deutschland und die EU im Allgemeinen gelten ohnehin schon als unattraktive Standorte für Bitcoin-Halter sowie -Unternehmer. Unter anderem die umfassende MiCA-Regulierung sorgt dafür, dass hierzulande kaum noch Raum für Innovationen gegeben ist.

Der letzte Standortvorteil Deutschlands ist bis dato die Haltefrist, deren Tage jetzt wohl gezählt sind. Ein Blick nach Österreich, wo diese schon abgeschafft wurde, zeigt jedoch, dass es dem Staat kaum etwas gebracht hat. 2024 wurden so nämlich gerade einmal knapp 34 Millionen Euro eingenommen – trotz eines in diesem Jahr stark gestiegenen Bitcoin-Kurses.

Demnach ist die Rechnung von Klingbeil, dass durch die Bekämpfung von Finanz- und Steuerkriminalität sowie die neue Krypto-Besteuerung zwei Milliarden Euro zusätzlich eingenommen werden können, zumindest fraglich.

Die CDU positionierte sich doch als Pro-Krypto-Partei? Zum Teil stimmt das. Nachdem es diese Position nicht in den Koalitionsvertrag geschafft hatte, sagten mehrere Politiker der Kanzlerpartei, dass die Haltefrist nicht gekippt werden solle.

**Und ganz generell postulierte Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz bekanntlich, dass es keine Steuererhöhungen geben werde.**

Ich zitierte aus folgendem Artikel...

https://www.focus.de/finanzen/boerse/erste-bitcoin-besitzer-vor-auswanderung-wegen-neuer-steuer_1c092efb-33f9-4618-a3db-2a1dcf2c8556.html

Mein persönliches Fazit:
Die Versprechen der Politik sind so viel wert wie ein Scamcoin. Gerade Friedrich Merz, der designierte Bundeskanzler Deutschlands, hat bisher alle seine Wahlversprechen gebrochen. Das wundert mich nicht mehr. Ich persönlich habe mit der Streichung der Haltefrist schon im letzten Jahr gerechnet. Wenn ich in den nächsten vier Jahren mit Kryptowährungen einen Gewinn von 100 % erziele, dann sind eben 25 % plus Solidaritätszuschlag abzuführen.

Die Frage ist, ob es eine Sonderregelung geben wird, wenn ich Bitcoin und Co. als Währung nutze und Waren direkt kaufe?

---

English 

Within the Bitcoin community, voices are increasingly being raised expressing a desire to leave Germany. Ultimately, a tax change could even cost the state revenue.

![53802.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcpoKQGSk13KFcNNpDXqvX2cXzcFCsf31fGcYGYQVUh5h/53802.png)

Should the tax-free holding period be abolished in Germany and a tax on crypto profits be introduced at the EU level, the consequences would be far-reaching.

Germany and the EU in general are already considered unattractive locations for Bitcoin holders and entrepreneurs. Among other things, the comprehensive MiCA regulation ensures that there is hardly any room left for innovation in these countries.

Germany's last remaining competitive advantage is the holding period, the days of which now appear to be numbered.  A look at Austria, where this tax has already been abolished, shows that it has brought the state little benefit. In 2024, it generated just under €34 million – despite a sharp rise in the Bitcoin price that year.

Therefore, Klingbeil's calculation that an additional €2 billion can be generated through combating financial and tax crime and the new crypto tax is at least questionable.

Didn't the CDU position itself as a pro-crypto party? That's partly true. After this position failed to make it into the coalition agreement, several politicians from the Chancellor's party stated that the holding period should not be abolished.

 **And, as is well known, Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated that there would be no tax increases.**

I quoted from the following article...

https://www.focus.de/finanzen/boerse/erste-bitcoin-besitzer-vor-auswanderung-wegen-neuer-steuer_1c092efb-33f9-4618-a3db-2a1dcf2c8556.html

My personal conclusion:

The promises of politicians are worth about as much as a scam coin. Friedrich Merz, the designated Chancellor of Germany, has broken all of his campaign promises so far. This no longer surprises me. I personally expected the removal of the holding period last year. If I make a 100% profit with cryptocurrencies over the next four years, then I'll simply have to pay 25% plus the solidarity surcharge.


My personal conclusion:

The promises of politicians are worth about as much as a scam coin.  The question is whether there will be a special regulation if I use Bitcoin and similar cryptocurrencies as currency and buy goods directly?

body.title: Zoo: A Brutal Face of Mankind.
body.body:
Hi friends!  Think you  are captive in a case and others looking at you with wonder? It is funny to Imagine but do we know we ae doing this everyday? When I was child my most awaiting place to see was zoo. Not only me but also every child and especially villagers of Bangladesh is a dream to visit the zoo. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevZD4AZXjQMCoN3LQEhy6WZQkNVhXSrPy2ya9zqeqcyT/1777659428716.jpg)

The National Zoo of Mirpur, Dhaka is the largest zoo of Bangladesh. About 2000 animals and birds are kept here in 186 acres of land. Mist of the animals are captive in case. Few animals are semi captive. So they can roam in a limited open space sorrunded by grills. The first case is for monkeys. When I was child I felt very joy and funny to see the monkeys. But now when I visit here with my younger cousins I felt very sad when I see the monkeys.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd39dCJ6UbkLxsW4TYxTmYYQYiA6HrHSTF8CxTACVRV58/1777659555419.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbQWCKBvhdkLNabAQWChx3mwLAJvY4yKrP89ckTKyww2/1777659555537.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYVuQs2dPoW6udw5HwWcXg5LBK6b8xgtdPbjk7J6kjFPU/1777659555595.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ4THfrh3MTb4eKjWBMaBWSSTxf3z9RjjY1EF9Bb4sXth/1777659555670.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS2FbTYi5ecqXcFUcPAS5ZUAU4bbyhx38Yq1C3RQpH43y/1777659555768.jpg)


 But not only for Monkeys I felt sad for all captive animals and birds and feel shame for mankind. I think it is too brutal to the animals. Where they could move free in the jungle instead of government authority torturing them to entertain us. Here the lions and the tigers lost their Kingdom and their natural beauty faded away. They can't eat properly as they are animal of prey. As it is unnatural to feed them in case they feel very helpless. Their face speak their minds conditions. Many birds are captive in a large case made of glass. I can feel that the birds are shouting to make them free. Other animals conditions are also the same.

 I think this is not zoo this is a jail for many innocent creatures. There is a small museum where kept died animals following some special process. There was many fish aquariums also. The Zebras, Horses, Goyals, Donkeys, Elephants, Giraffes and few animals were semi captive so that they were looking fresher than full captive animals. 

 I think Zoo should be prohibited in all countries. Government should develop the safari park instead of the Zoo.

body.title: Street Art #881 Wynwood Miami Part II : Quake & Hiero
body.body:
In the StreetArt series, we're spending a few days (or even a few weeks) in the **Wynwood neighborhood of Miami**. Today, we're on 26th Avenue admiring a long mural created by [**Quake**](https://www.instagram.com/miamiquake/) and [**Hiero**](https://www.instagram.com/hieroveiga/). I didn't take a picture to show the entire piece because there were a lot of cars blocking the view. A problem that, unfortunately, everyone is familiar with.

> *Nous sommes pour quelques jours (ou même quelques semaines) dans le quartier de Wynwood à Miami**
**. Aujourd'hui, nous sommes sur la 26ème avenue pour admirer un long mur fait par [**Quake**](https://www.instagram.com/miamiquake/) et [**Hiero**](https://www.instagram.com/hieroveiga/). Je n'ai pas prendre une photo pour montrer cette oeuvre dans son entiereté car beaucoup de voitures devant. Un problème que tout le monde malheureusement connait.*

![Quake & Hiero](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23wqa3PghhYPnt4QcpQGHTNQp4LwzSGgPu9CdXccagZcHEr9TPjygwJjNaMwZG55xiJKM.JPG)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇʀᴇ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

This wall is located on 26th Avenue, almost at the corner of Second Avenue, in the Wynwood neighborhood of Miami, a bit of a mecca for StreetArt in North America 😀. On the map, I'll try to list all the posts about this neighborhood. The number in red corresponds to the relevant street art post. Example: 800 = [Street Art #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).

![Wynwood.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tcJUxGJKqNWvUieqSNbRDfGVozN2HjhGL7zfdtc7tvTSwEz7tfGta5byDLCyHSXNHwa.jpg)

> *Ce mur se trouve sur la 26ème avenue presque au coin avec la seconde avenue dans le quartier de Wynwood à Miami, un peu la Mecque du StreetArt en Amérique du Nord* 😀. *Sur la carte, je vais essayer de lister tous les posts au sujet de ce quartier. Le numéro en rouge correspond au post StreetArt correspond. Exemple : 800 = [StreetArt #880](https://peakd.com/hive-184784/@heroldius/street-art-880-wynwood-miami-part-i--el-mac-dface-and-maxi-bagnasco).*

🗺️ Position on [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=17/25.800876/-80.199037)

[//]:# (!worldmappin -65.36684 lat -25.31250 long Wall done by Hiero and Quake in 2022 d3scr)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴏ
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

## Quake & Hiero

![Quake & Hiero](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23vhqV5Hjgwf5xg6Mky2qCZDc2yAgZBe1GBDcxtAuZbfB4YxE5GQJCtAhx67fbPst6EfG.JPG)

When I travel to a city, before leaving, I always look up some information about the #StreetArt scene. In Miami, all the results point to Wynwood. And it's true, it's everywhere. Here we're in the heart of this neighborhood, on the wall that surrounds the [**Museum of Graffiti**](https://museumofgraffiti.com/).

> *Quand je voyage dans une ville, toujours avant de partir, je vais aller chercher quelques informations sur la scène #StreetArt. A Miami, tous les résultats se dirigent vers Wynwood. Et c'est vrai qu'il y en a partout. Ici nous sommes au Coeur de ce quartier sur le mur qui ceinture le [**Museum of Graffiti**](https://museumofgraffiti.com/).*

![Quake & Hiero](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23u5xWq8XR1iehCVYkjgihbrkCYCLayGwnhLR9e7RW1VYGRZntJ73VSa1XjQCXnUyB29N.JPG)

This is a collaboration between the artists [**Quake**](https://www.instagram.com/miamiquake/) and [**Hiero**](https://www.instagram.com/hieroveiga/), a mix of cartoon characters and lettering. The result is really cool. For your information, [**Quake**](https://www.instagram.com/miamiquake/) is a Miami artist who has been active since the 90s, initially working outside the law, before becoming the founder of the design company **Cushy Gigs Creative**. [**Hiero**](https://www.instagram.com/hieroveiga/), also known as **Hiero Veiga**, is a self-taught American artist with over 20 years of experience and international recognition. This explains the quality of this mural.

> *Il s'agit d'une collaboration des artistes [**Quake**](https://www.instagram.com/miamiquake/) et [**Hiero**](https://www.instagram.com/hieroveiga/), un mélange de personnages de dessin-animés et de lettrages. Le résultat est vraiment cool. Pour info, [**Quake**](https://www.instagram.com/miamiquake/) est un artiste de Miami actif depuis les années 90 dans l'illégalité pour devenir le fondateur d'une compagnie de design **Cushy Gigs Creative**. [**Hiero**](https://www.instagram.com/hieroveiga/) aka **Hiero Veiga** est un artiste américain autodidacte avec plus de 20 ans d'expérience, internationelement reconnu. On comprend mieux la qualité de ce mur.*

![Quake & Hiero](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23wgBTRshrcsBxbrLCpcjEbPNfmu2DNM9G5rhaddA5egvVEWAQtcPMLXMERttbFEPvrQ1.JPG)

***

## Sako Asko & Atomiko

![Sako Asko](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23ywqPwMeMzu1RptLv8YagE4R2EHY9zcmdkAWqaVPLEfQAoHFGYEXKHqRCrwcybRA8aMK.JPG)

Across the street, there's a piece by Colombian artist [**Sako Asko**](https://www.instagram.com/sakoasko/) featuring an anthropomorphic flower, perhaps sweating to water itself. Cool concept. Next to it is a huge pumpkin, the emblem of artist [**Atomiko**](https://www.instagram.com/atomiko/). The whole thing looks like it was created in 2025 for the Museum of Graffiti, whose entrance is nearby.

> *De l'autre côté de la rue, il y une oeuvre de l'artiste colombien [**Sako Asko**](https://www.instagram.com/sakoasko/) avec cette fleur anthropomorphe, peut être en train de suer pour s'auto-arroser. Cool concept. A côté, il y a une énorme citrouille, l'emblème de l'artiste [**Atomiko**](https://www.instagram.com/atomiko/). Le tout semble avoir été fait en 2025 pour le Museum Graffiti dont l'entrée se trouve pas loin.*

![Atomiko](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23zS3F45navHyjjzBTeKWP6xQUbzvkHpvS1vrtPChJLmVbB5PyF4C4gkNKCHpCuSmqadA.JPG)

And finally, a sticker, also in this street, done by [**Procanela**](https://procanela.com/), a Venezuelan artist.
**A favorite StreetArt work today?**

> *Et pour finir, un petit autocollant de [**Procanela**](https://procanela.com/), artiste venezuelien, qui se trouvait aussi dans cette rue.
**Une oeure préférée aujourd'hui ?***

![Procanela](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/23tvY8hGznWq6hG2Tveo4CU2EognwMtHbazZBLq9NXLm1UsR3tHrToXmZ5EkqSKHF1YNs.JPG)

# ෴ ᴡʜᴇɴ	
![line_hive.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/heroldius/xoycoMPQ-line_hive.jpg)

* **2022 / 2025**.

![line_grey.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSj2ThUhewrAjDZMFsx4UjSaXuS84cwHR2anDzyq9KWVh/line_grey.jpg)

body.title: Sheep paths of Snæfellsnes
body.body:
>Read this post on TravelFeed for the best experience
I noticed this mountain last year, while standing on the edge of the largest crater (Rauðkúla) in the Berserkjahraun lava field. It was greener and more gentle in shape, and it stood out against the jagged, bare rocks around it and the red soil of the crater.

/>
\n\n

/>
For the next five weeks, I kept coming back to the Berserkjahraun lava field, each time looking at the hill that had caught my attention that day. I thought it had no name. Only later, while checking map apps, I found it: Hafrafell. There is no official path or trail leading up to it. I couldn’t find anything even in Wikiloc, which I often use for ideas and which is full of routes recorded by other hikers. It’s especially useful in places like this, where there are very few official trails. Still, I knew the area well enough to try on my own. One day in July, I went to try it. I parked at a viewpoint overlooking the Berserkjahraun lava field and the lake formed by the lava flow. This place always takes my breath away.

/>
This time, though, I was looking in a different direction than most visitors. On the other side of the road rises the quiet, almost unnoticed Hafrafell. To reach its base, you have to cross wide stretches of tall, stiff grass and moss. Still, since I moved here, I have never regretted the effort of exploring new places. In return, I always get wide views, streams covered with bright green moss, and a complete reset.

/>
This time was no different. As I climbed, I kept looking around at the familiar landscape I had come to know well over the past weeks. On one hand, I love discovering new places. On the other, I like knowing exactly what surrounds me. The landscape has already settled so deeply in my memory that I can recognize it easily from different angles.
/> At first glance, it all looks harsh. But once you get closer, you notice the softness of the moss and the contrast of colors.

/> As I climbed, I kept looking at the Berserkjahraun lava field. Even after three years, it still feels like I’m seeing it for the first time. I take photo after photo, and later I realize I already have hundreds just like them ;)

/>
\n\n

/>
\n\n

/>
\n\n

/> The ridge of the mountain was long, and although it looked gentle, at one point it became quite steep. I thought about turning back. But after going a bit lower, I found a sheep path. I figured that if sheep could walk there, so could I.
/> Getting closer to the green part of the hill that first caught my attention weeks earlier. The photos don’t really show it, but the contrast with the surroundings is striking.
/> Right next to it stands the rocky Kerlingarfjall.
/> It looks more intimidating than it really is. I managed to climb it in October last year.
/> A bit further on, another mountain I have my eye on -  Grímsfjall. And in the distance, other mountain ranges. Including Helgrindur, where I live below.

/>
The walk turned out to be quite long, but I managed to cross the entire mountain. The last part, pushing through the grass and moss back to the parking spot, was the most tiring.
/> That summer was full of sunsets. Most of my walks ended with watching this quiet spectacle.

/> I never really planned it. It just kept happening. This time was no different. I reached the parking spot just as the sun was setting over the Westfjords. Even then, I knew this summer would become a legend for me.

>@astinmin
I'm the only author of the text and photos

El Clarinero convive en el campo y en la ciudad majestuosamente, también se conoce con el nombre de Zanate, nos regala su ejemplo silvestre, capaz beber mientras se sumerge en el agua para refrescar su cuerpo y vuela bajo la lluvia y en contra del viento intenso...

body.title: LA TELENOVELA EN VENEZUELA: CARISSIMA (2000).
body.body:
***Hola mi gente espero que todos esten super bien, un gran abrazo para todos, hoy mi gente la ediciòn es sobre una novela que tuve un gran impacto en el pais, con una de las actricez mas emblematicas del pais, ROXANA DIAZ.***

---

![198..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb45Wg3ZWQejWVWi9YYj1zQVtX4xfgSMVz76uvHTAwhad/198..jpg)

<center>***Portada realizada por mi.***</center>

----

<center>***INTRODUCCIÒN.***</center>
-

***Carissima es una telenovela venezolana que comenzó a emitirse en enero de 2001 por RCTV. Fue escrita por la destacada autora Mariela Romero. La historia se caracterizó por su trama de intriga, secretos del pasado y una profunda lucha por la justicia, alejándose un poco del melodrama convencional para centrarse en una búsqueda de identidad y redención.***

---

<center>![httpsblogger.googleusercontent.comimgbR29vZ2xlAVvXsEhdbQ5adDpYLTWLKOX1gGirNpo28R35sUpjP_kAMeamlJe5yCnZ-iG3oDPJ50LUUbNzZ859x8uNCBQeDScu1HsavrnCEvAAwb0p8UNSH1dioc3Mm_seU8FqTG2hJVMbuzK8vCZv7uV5RAs1600top+(1).jpg.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbvRfECLg9x8NXpydDcCdmW9qQxuZeK4CjuVfYVgqpVzk/httpsblogger.googleusercontent.comimgbR29vZ2xlAVvXsEhdbQ5adDpYLTWLKOX1gGirNpo28R35sUpjP_kAMeamlJe5yCnZ-iG3oDPJ50LUUbNzZ859x8uNCBQeDScu1HsavrnCEvAAwb0p8UNSH1dioc3Mm_seU8FqTG2hJVMbuzK8vCZv7uV5RAs1600top+(1).jpg.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsblogger.googleusercontent.comimgbR29vZ2xlAVvXsEhdbQ5adDpYLTWLKOX1gGirNpo28R35sUpjP_kAMeamlJe5yCnZ-iG3oDPJ50LUUbNzZ859x8uNCBQeDScu1HsavrnCEvAAwb0p8UNSH1dioc3Mm_seU8FqTG2hJVMbuzK8vCZv7uV5RAs1600top+(1).jpg)</center>

---

<center>***FICHA TECNICA.***</center>
-

***-Titulo Original: Carissima.
-Productora: Radio Caracas Televisión (RCTV).
-​Año: 2001 (103 episodios).
-​Guion: Mariela Romero.
​-Dirección: José Alcalde.
​-Protagonistas: Roxana Díaz y Carlos Montilla.
​-Antagonistas: Franklin Virgüez, Maricarmen Regueiro y Catherine Correia.
​-Elenco Estelar: Carolina Tejera, Carlos Cámara Jr., Dalila Colombo y Félix Loreto.
​-Tema musical: \

, interpretado por Carlos Montilla.***

---

<center>![httpsi.ytimg.comvi_U5xA6oSIkcmaxresdefault.jpg.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVpEkMwCaTj3eXfRiZZywqpo8CYm2zHv58SXjfMtKRsE/httpsi.ytimg.comvi_U5xA6oSIkcmaxresdefault.jpg.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsi.ytimg.comvi_U5xA6oSIkcmaxresdefault.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***SINOPSIS.***</center>
-

***​La historia gira en torno a Avril Zurli (Roxana Díaz), una joven hermosa y decidida que cree ser hija de una familia adinerada. Sin embargo, su vida da un vuelco cuando descubre que su verdadero origen está ligado a una tragedia del pasado: su padre biológico fue acusado injustamente de un crimen y ella fue entregada a otra familia para protegerla.***

***​En su búsqueda de la verdad, Avril conoce a Gabriel Santuario (Carlos Montilla), un hombre íntegro pero atormentado por las deudas morales de su propia familia. El amor entre ellos nace en medio de una guerra de poderes entre los Zurli y los Santuario. El conflicto central es la lucha de Avril por recuperar su verdadera identidad y limpiar el nombre de su padre, enfrentándose a la maldad de Montserrat Vallemari (Franklin Virgüez), un villano despiadado que oculta los pecados que originaron toda la trama.***

---

<center>![httpsvencor.narod.rufilmspiccaris00.jpg.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVXbz6x8TbV3rBwsKPnSTLdb9sN5FNEnH1i5RTk3gKGQ6/httpsvencor.narod.rufilmspiccaris00.jpg.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpsvencor.narod.rufilmspiccaris00.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***BREVE RESEÑA***</center>
-

***Esta producción es muy recordada por marcar el regreso protagónico de Roxana Díaz a RCTV después de varios éxitos en la planta. La crítica elogió su capacidad para interpretar a una heroína con carácter, que no se dejaba amilanar por las adversidades.***

***La química con Carlos Montilla fue excelente, y al igual que en otras producciones, Montilla puso su voz para el tema principal de la novela, el cual se convirtió en un éxito romántico.***

***​Un punto destacable fue la actuación de Franklin Virgüez, quien interpretó a uno de los villanos más cínicos y recordados de la época. También llamó la atención el papel de Maricarmen Regueiro, quien regresaba a las pantallas venezolanas en un rol complejo. La novela destacó por sus locaciones elegantes y una dirección que enfatizaba el suspenso y los giros inesperados en el guion de Mariela Romero.***

---

<center>![httpswww.ecured.cuCarissima#mediaFileCarissima.jpg.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ69yksFXaJWAHRy3JN1uSTo4H2HDdMViCvXVeuqBPCx1/httpswww.ecured.cuCarissima#mediaFileCarissima.jpg.jpg)</center>

<center>[Protagonistas de la novela](httpswww.ecured.cuCarissima#mediaFileCarissima.jpg)</center>

---

<center>***CONCLUSIÒN.***</center>
-

***Carissima es recordada como una novela elegante y madura. Logró mantener el interés del público gracias a un misterio que se iba revelando poco a poco y a un elenco de primeros actores que dieron solidez a cada escena. Su legado reside en haber sido una de las historias que cerró con broche de oro la etapa de las \

de principios de la década en RCTV, antes de que el canal se volcara por completo al género del misterio policial.***

---

<center>![httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202301Carissima_900x900-768x768.jpg.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQmDpzDTh5RUP3MjrRoWtt91Ti1hpNi193zC74wYtoRF3/httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202301Carissima_900x900-768x768.jpg.jpg)</center>

<center>[Portada de promociòn de la novela](httpswww.rctvinternational.comwp-contentuploads202301Carissima_900x900-768x768.jpg)</center>

---

***Bueno mi gente hasta aqui la ediciòn del dia de hoy, espero que sea de su total agrado y nos vemos en una nueva oportunidad con mas de las novelas de nuestro pais. Mil bendiciones.***

---

![BANNER POST novelas..jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNaa3MP3tkX4tsoycy7jekEkQa3uqkw223yPhg5uhNBWd/BANNER%20POST%20novelas..jpg)

body.title: Stocks To Watch
body.body:
## Nvidia Hits a New All-Time High

This week, Nvidia reached a new all-time high, with its share price surpassing $217.

The stock had been moving sideways for around seven months, but suddenly the market seems to have realized that we are going to need much more computing power.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWwiqEG35CSYFXMXmXCYYShPSduCoB2ppntuDZDDLywqq/image.png)


In other words, Nvidia remains the most valuable company in the world, and that is now being reflected in its stock price as well.

The company’s market capitalization has now surpassed $5.2 trillion, which is around $1 trillion more than the second-largest company, Google. Google also moved higher yesterday, with its stock surpassing $350.

It will be interesting to see whether Big Tech companies announce higher capital expenditure tomorrow, as that could mean even more demand for Nvidia chips.

---

## Visa Reports an Excellent Quarter

Yesterday, Visa announced its quarterly results, and in my opinion, they were excellent.

The company beat analysts’ expectations both on revenue and earnings per share, delivering a clear double beat.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXnXyUyFpNrfUMbFUnCNGM4z5jgtQvDZGXBDRQcQRe44/image.png)


The growth Visa is still producing on a yearly basis is impressive.

Revenue increased by 17% year over year, while earnings per share rose by 20%.

On top of that, the board authorized a $20 billion share buyback program for the coming years.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKk7QCeVRbTan7HFSzAXBfpCsjwMNVFk8tbMQtjnWEnw/image.png)


Following these results, the stock jumped 5% in after-hours trading.

In my opinion, Visa continues to look very undervalued.

---

## Three SaaS Stocks: Opportunity or Value Trap?

Today, we are looking at three companies that continue to deliver steady revenue growth, but whose stock prices have been under pressure.

First, Salesforce.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaFDZ5r8VyRtP9iNLd5BKCBCDW7ZvQZ9GzSyvQzkvhgfC/image.png)


Its last twelve months revenue is up 37%, while the stock is up only 9.6%.

Second, Fair Isaac.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaryHc98yntYrwap2kNT3ZNdjJrY9qNy9JNEiqxtyS7eu/image.png)


Its last twelve months revenue is up 50%, while the stock is up 144%, although it has recently suffered a sharp decline.

Third, CoStar.

Its last twelve months revenue is up 53%, but the stock is down 48%.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7fZZqfdKRYGzCsdacyAwFigC4XaVaFbqxmP97EQHY1G/image.png)


The sell-off in SaaS companies continues.

The next earnings reports will be crucial for the future direction of these stocks.

---

## The Incredible Semiconductor Rally

Over the past month, the semiconductor sector has absolutely exploded higher.

We are talking about huge returns.

Intel is up 75%.

AMD is up 58%.

Texas Instruments is up 41%.

Broadcom is up 32%.

Micron is up 30%.

Nvidia is up 16.5%.

The semiconductor ETF chart clearly shows the explosive upward move in the sector.

Over the last month, it is up 29%.

Year to date, it is up 51%.

It looks like the narrative that “we will need massive computing power in the coming years” has fully returned to Wall Street.
