![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXXM7n3S2hpnZRMUNQRcCyyVgGARXmH52iZLbK79oUZ2/season_181_report_seattlea.png) ##
📖 Introduction
Here is my Season 181 report covering battle performance, earnings, rewards, tournaments and market activity. Please note that the image above contains real data collected from this report. This report data is collected by running Docker Containers from @beaker007 GitHub Repository code that can be found at: https://github.com/gamerbeaker007/spl-stats-next Running your own Docker is not a requirement, it just gives me more control over the data and reduces the load on beakers service that can be accessed for free at: http://spl-stats.com And finally, I am allocating 5% of the earnings from this post to Beaker in appreciation of his wonderful work on the tool that I believe is the best free data tool for Splinterlands. ##
⚔️ Battle Results — @seattlea
| Format | League | Battles | Wins | Win% | Rating | Rank | |--------|--------|--------:|-----:|-----:|-------:|-----:| | Modern | ![](https://images.hive.blog/75x0/https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/icons/leagues/modern_150/league_13.png) Champion III | 468 | 238 | 50.9% | 3840 | #113 | | Wild | ![](https://images.hive.blog/75x0/https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/icons/leagues/wild_150/league_10.png) Diamond III | 1 | 1 | 100.0% | 2940 | — | As you can see this season I was completely focused on the Modern League and played just one battle in Wild in order to drop my account a bit further down for the next time I decide to play in Wild in order to collect more league progression chests. body.title: GLM-5.1: Open Source Took First Place in the Benchmark That Actually Matters
body.body:
For a long time, there was an unwritten rule in the world of artificial intelligence: closed models lead, and open models try to keep up. Z.ai — the Chinese company formerly known as Zhipu AI — just broke that rule in a rather loud way.

On April 7, 2026, GLM-5.1 was released as open source and immediately took first place on SWE-Bench Pro with 58.4 points. That means, for the first time in the history of that benchmark, an open-source model surpassed every closed model in the world at the task of solving real software problems.

## What SWE-Bench Pro Is

SWE-Bench Pro is not a multiple-choice test. It takes real problems that were opened by developers in public GitHub repositories — bugs, failures, unexpected behaviors — and asks the model to write code that actually solves the problem.

No cheat sheet. No hints. The model needs to understand the problem, analyze the existing code, propose a solution, and the solution needs to work. It's the kind of test that most closely mirrors what a developer does day to day.

With 58.4 points, GLM-5.1 ranked above GPT-5.4 (57.7) and Claude Opus 4.6 (57.3). A small numerical difference, but enormous in symbolic significance.

## The Architecture Behind the Result

GLM-5.1 is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 744 billion total parameters, but only 40 billion active parameters per processed token. That matters because it defines the real computational cost.

It works like a team of specialists: instead of activating the entire team for every task, the model activates only the experts relevant to that specific situation. Result: far greater efficiency than dense models of equivalent size.

The context window is 200,000 tokens — enough to process extensive technical documents, complete codebases from medium-sized projects, or very long conversations without losing reference.

## MIT: The License That Changes Everything

The detail that transforms GLM-5.1 from good news into important news is the MIT license.

The MIT license is one of the most permissive in the software world. You can download the model, use it in production, modify it, include it in commercial products, redistribute it — without paying anything, without asking permission, without significant restrictions.

This contrasts with other \

models that, in practice, have commercial use restrictions or require special agreements for certain applications. GLM-5.1 is genuinely free to use.

For companies that need to keep data internal — healthcare, legal, finance, defense — having access to a cutting-edge model that can run locally, without data leaving to third-party servers, is strategically relevant.

## What This Means for the Industry

There's an argument circulating in Silicon Valley that closed models will always lead because they have more resources. GLM-5.1 is the most concrete counter-argument the market has ever seen.

Z.ai is not a startup: it's a company with years of research and solid academic partnerships in China. GLM-5.1 is the result of a long-term bet on large language models, with a focus on code and technical reasoning.

## Where to Find It

The model weights are available on HuggingFace under the MIT license. The maximum context output is 131,072 tokens. For those with the infrastructure to run a model of this scale, access is immediate and free.

The message GLM-5.1 sends to the market is direct: open source has reached the top. It may not stay there forever. But it got there.

La Garza es la poesía de la memoria de nuestros sueños, ave majestuosa que se viste de pureza, como la libertad de sus sueños inalcanzables y que con gratitud hacia la vida del sol y la luna, nos regala la calma de su alma escondida...

body.title: 🌌 SpacePicture of a Day: Markarian's Chain 🪐
body.body:
![Markarian's Chain](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2605/M84andM86_1024.png)

***

>Near the heart of the Virgo Galaxy Cluster, a string of galaxies known as Markarian's Chain stretches across this telescopic field of view. Anchored in the frame at bottom right by prominent lenticular galaxies, M84 (bottom) and M86, you can follow the chain's gentle arc up and toward the left. Near center you'll spot the pair of interacting galaxies NGC 4438 and NGC 4435, known to some as Markarian's Eyes. An estimated 50 million light-years distant, the Virgo Cluster itself is the nearest galaxy cluster. With up to about 2,000 member galaxies, it has a noticeable gravitational influence on our own Local Group of Galaxies. Within the Virgo Cluster at least seven galaxies in Markarian's Chain  appear to move coherently, while others may appear to be part of the chain by chance.

body.title: Visit to my village: Korali (Naini)
body.body:
Hello, Namaste to all Hive users reaching this post. I hope you all are doing great. So today I am going to share a few pictures of my village, Koralii (Naini).

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ3zX2ZNdZHn4ir3XcPYU5yWFVU92LLXUXW2rtfiqVwyv/1777657017897.jpg)

Firstly I went to Almora on 20 April and from there went to Naini the next day with my uncle. I was really excited going to my village, I had visited Naini 1 or 2 times, the last time I visited when I was in 4th or 5th standard so this time I was visiting after many years and the main reason for visiting the village was that there was a Puja organised ( जागर ) there. I really enjoyed myself there. 

The entire family came for the worship.

While going to Naini we stopped near the Jageshwar temple and had some food. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5xxRg6LgNa5ZxcuVAAWQb7Hxq9esM9jBDzJZouxWEoq/1777643396893.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSE3pUdWCKwupHKRYhi23bfQmh9rZFHLYAVdwSLzEFsWx/1777655350518.jpg)

There were many beautiful flowers present there.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd3X84XcGKozAyqJHgvL7XE9qBZWns95UpXh6NRFZGh5r/1777643397149.jpg)

 After reaching the stop, we walked a little and reached home. 
There was also a wedding in a nearby area of the village due to which other people had also arrived there,  so it felt much better.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZGxcCK7Hv2Q19iCS28gVf1xBj6uKfwtBFS65v25R3YAh/1777643397290.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdzCZ8xgF4YuMZixrT8c8afC8Snmh8bh4BUVcJwEmbWLk/1777643491063.jpg)

We had a big lemon tree near our home, so we had a sweet and tangy recipe of it ( सना नींबू). It was very delicious.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNDpW5JAZBuWs4H6pvUpAxTZVvfTNEvkZUcFi911MT2V/1777643491259.jpg)
The market was a little far from our house, these were a few houses in the market area.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc6aveW2PAS9dCt1ebdzdK45bBQEtm8a1ivkQBabNMSuL/1777643545029.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZFiQNQCe21k15HeW8TAGfrkUHrFnvZj3emjSsUXKKzKv/1777655996395.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUGcFgQP42R4UjGakx8mCHMkTLKArpWv8xFfWuWLTZWyE/1777655996582.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAdDpELx1rkyvVVbVioA1jzuNSCcMZXX6iPv3UaS4WP1/1777643545189.jpg)

The view was really amazing there 🤩 .
For water, we had to go a little distance and open a tap and that place was above our house. It felt nice to sit there because there was a cool breeze. We walked a lot in the village, sometimes we went to the market, sometimes we went to open/close the tap and sometimes when we were bored at home, we went for a walk but the thing is we didn't feel tired there.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmezq6MWkTjgnRTatsApK5cx7wZraMbPfUtKnzPWYjae4e/1777643545446.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU4PkNY2RBn3icxErGohWQ5izJgJQX5MgGhvwCgH4r7iJ/1777643545596.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZzAJkPRqT5PdCeJ5vBuHPkwQoGMYD5nnHaWbQtk1EzjT/1777643585112.jpg)

The thing I love the most was that everyone was sitting together, gossiping, and enjoying. Not like normal days, when everyone is sitting alone doing their work.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZF4dZuoZ9rTUmvJYn2yJBKCy8TPwFt1qUwTqUraJh72B/1777643585347.jpg)
 I had hisalu ( yellow Himalayan raspberry)for the first time, and it was a little crunchy and tasty.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGFnAY26h1xvFcjVS5iYxonxx4rb61TXjJ2EARnJwd2n/1777643585453.jpg)


Clicked many pictures there ...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcorMZ6SJSvEevAefjiMvygiD9FyBHK4oGRKRu6SRvzvx/1777643848046.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnACxwPo4NwQkSxa9oPmg3HAAKKLvAnD9kcZWoMGXoZw/1777643848202.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQAtcnckBjd6cH6UmGynLxQ4p6RVZcsbCVYwZChDpPa6C/1777643848347.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU9t2Sc7qKM3mMmBfE7N8fW276YLhJxPuc8G2JbgrWLnV/1777643848471.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXdssX93GvyTnq73BWpcJLxNzx1resYyvKk4Y2f8YPSjh/1777657102517.jpg)
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVHwGrV49fJ4JG2AzRohprB6D5Y2HF4A7feEnaZKuC8aJ/1777657102561.jpg)
 
Went back to Almora on 25  April. That's all for today , I will be sharing the rest of the pictures of Almora in the next post.
Hope you all liked it, thank you for visiting my post.

body.title: Geography, Mathematics and Something More
body.body:
> Happy start to the weekend, everyone! Today I'm here to participate in the 307th edition of Weekend Engagement, specifically responding to the first topic proposed by Dr. Galenkp. In elementary school, one thing was certain: I was an average student, far from bad and even further from the best, but I considered myself one of the most outstanding among the average students (though that seems a bit sad now that I'm writing it). From a very young age, I loved everything related to planet Earth and the universe. I was quite the child prodigy, learning about the seasons, countries, natural phenomena, planets, and so on. In fact, during my adolescence, I became very interested in the elements of the Earth in subjects like Chemistry, and I learned about rocks in Geology. Yes, I was quite the nerd, and this always made me stand out in Geography.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmetgkLKeCkM2jJ6DamUegLGb848tKV8QyN63VtaPVBiyG/img_20240801_111849.jpg)
*Cuyagua, Cata, El Playón*

Being one of the average kids in all the classrooms I was in, nobody outperformed me in geography. I always got the highest grades, even my teachers were surprised, because I didn't learn things robotically, but rather I understood the reason behind everything, and I learned a lot of it from my atlases, because they were the kind of gifts I used to ask my parents for, along with telescopes (pretending to see the planets) 🤣 I traveled by plane for the first time in 2024, quite past my age, but that trip to Europe left at night and I took a middle aisle seat. On the other hand, between Venezuela and Spain you only see hours and hours of the Atlantic Ocean and lots of clouds, so I didn't miss anything. But when I traveled to Colombia four months later, my wife made sure to reserve window seats for me, mostly for comfort, but to her surprise, and as we flew over my own country, she went crazy when I started naming beaches, lakes, cities, and mountains that were very easy for me to recognize, even in the next photo I'm showing you, which is actually a close-up of In the one above, you can see the white buildings of Cata Bay and in the residential area of ​​Ocumare de la Costa I dare to point out possibly the block of the house that my godfather lent us every August when we traveled to the coasts.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSaCSdMvYMBk6s5JV3rZ6gJ2sKJCNp4kBqEBJUxobG6JR/img_20240801_111909.jpg)
*White Towers of Cata on the Left and Ocumare de la Costa*

I was looking through my photos to write this post and came across the following image, which I'm showing you below this paragraph. I also have a photo of Patanemo, a place in Carabobo State that I discovered long after this trip to Colombia, and perhaps that's why I didn't recognize it at the time. But from marking so many pins on Worldmappin, I know the shape of the coastline and even the swampy lagoon there by heart, so I've just surprised my wife again 🤣 Yes, it was my favorite subject, and although my work today has nothing to do with Geography, beyond enjoying traveling, it's still something I'm passionate about, completely different from what happens with Mathematics...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbcdHZ8BrHBCQdrhdprYh57yHcs1nauMdpheJZG3rjYHR/img_20240801_112121.jpg)
*Patanemo and Puerto Cabello*
I was, and probably still am, terrible at math; the funny thing is, I'm a musician, and there's a lot of math in music, so I understand it better that way 😅 That said, maybe that weakness slowed me down on my path to becoming a professional at reading music, and even now I still get a little confused with strange rhythms or furious speeds. Despite being so bad, I never had to repeat the subject, much less retake it, but the truth is, I became an expert at cheating on the tests, which is probably why I survived.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQoNfgdSStWb3dQMUjMjBx7v5Z1UbBRf8fYeoWJvA7Wmp/img_20240806_113710.jpg)
*Lake La Salina, Goaiguaza Island, and Puerto Cabello*

Another thing that has always struck me as very curious, even now as an adult, is that although I loved chemistry and everything related to the elements of the earth and their reactions, and although I also loved physics, which explains the logic both on earth and in the universe, I actually got mediocre grades in those subjects. I even had to retake physics and almost repeat it when I was 15, but I finally passed with the lowest possible grade. There are two things I suspect. The first is that, whatever the reason, being bad at math made it harder for me to solve the formulas for the exercises in both subjects, which is strange because knowing the formula, there shouldn't be any error, especially since I was so passionate about these topics. But then my other suspicion arises: the teacher!...
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3oYDoqTy2KmTunnNzu1CrdF3hLW2FVD1et56DeRLiu6/img_20240806_113756.jpg)
*King Island, Alcatraz Island, Santo Domingo Island and Long Island*

Let's start with Chemistry. From eighth grade onward, all the ninth-grade students said the teacher was the Devil, and that her sole purpose was to make sure they failed. I actually remember the woman, and boy, was she scary. But when I started classes, the teacher went on leave. I never knew why, and we did very well with the substitute. She taught with love and understood everything. The original teacher arrived only three months before the end of the school year, but what I did in her absence was enough to prevent her teaching style from affecting me. So, I can't really say much about her. But the Physics teacher... Wow, that man hated me. Yes, there were reasons. I think the nickname RoboCop that the whole school ended up giving him originally came from my small group of friends, maybe even from me, and I don't remember. But anyway, I was just a 15-year-old teenager, and he was an adult over 30 who really did behave like a robot without feelings. The nickname suited him well.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNsKHVfsSd8wzZ5Vt1HHcgqy2g4M9uPErV7ABdLVmXCpC/img_20240801_111404.jpg)

To avoid repeating Physics, my mom hired a private tutor, and I actually did quite well. The tutor always said that physics came easily to me and that sometimes my problem was that I lost focus, but I understood the principles, and even so, I failed the first exam with RoboCop. I spent my entire August vacation studying physics, and even then, I passed with the minimum grade—the only subject I had to struggle with to pass. The worst part is that I liked it, because that didn't happen with math (even though I cheated)... I didn't realize the tutor hated me at the time, but I did over the years, trying to understand the logic behind it all, because now I like physics much more, and even as a child, it was clear that if I hadn't become a musician, my life would probably have taken me down the path of science. That said, I tried to steer clear of science because math is fundamental, and no, I don't like math... Well, I think I went on a bit in this post, but I always enjoy writing for Weekend Engagement. It makes me delve deep within myself, and there's always a photograph that connects to my writing. I even thought I'd never share these photos on Hive. I hope you enjoyed it. A heartfelt hug to everyone who read and supported me 🙏
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSiqwDyWSZYaZPSpN1bDm9ep4HSNe2Hgfoi36oukrRdzo/img_20240806_095810.jpg)

body.title: It's On! Tracking My Way Out of My Old Life
body.body: <div  class=text-justify>\n\nI'm so loving how my life has been going since this year, it's from one \

to another. The most exciting part is, I find myself enjoying every one of them even though they feel hard at some point. Indeed, information is power and my life for the past months have been proving that fact. I didn't just start journaling for the first time this year. As a matter of fact, I started on the 4th day of the year to show that I had no plans for that kind of habit. But today, I have an update journal, with information and growth visible enough to keep coming back to it so I could keep writing. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQaEepQXGraWwDNx3tvEKcnFf45KHHouFAD9p4ybRVZKx/IMG_20260501_180806.jpg So I could keep up with journaling things that will excite or make me proud of myself, my daily activities slowly began to change from just going on autopilot to doing a few things intentionally with the mind of growth and so that I will have nice and cool things to write on my journal daily. Doing things intentionally led me into new habits, habits that I wouldn't do before because I thought they were too good for me, time consuming and a waste of time. These habits are what people live with like it's so normal with them but I struggled so hard to even start adopting a few. Well, I learned to appreciate and love myself more. That shift changed how I live my life now and it led me to intentionally building new habits that will take me out of my old self completely. It's been a bit on and off since I started but my journal time feels better, and I created a thing. I created a habit tracker to intentionally track them for the month of May and hopefully, continue from there. I got the habit tracker idea while I was watching a video online and it has helped me a lot in just thinking about how satisfying it will be when I keep up with a tracker. So yeah, this post is simply about sharing my habit tracker update and how I came to have one. I'm excited about crossing off all the ones I did today, tonight. Looking forward to not missing a day or a habit in between. >Muy buen día, comunidad de #HiveGaming. Otro día, otra victoria en Mobile Legends Bang Bang. Y es que jugar con el campeón Diggie es muy divertido, ya que es un pájaro inmortal que no puede morir; sólo se transforma, como lo hace la materia.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<center>![3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbkVU1sKjDbjPBpXDqUcovaZg4ZZ9GNbSdWBc4FUKudaC/3.png)</centeR>

<div class=\

>

Since my character is a support, I started by causing mischief in the enemy jungle, trying to steal their monsters, but I didn't succeed. I also helped my teammates around the map; I never stood still.

So I spent my time running around, helping kill enemies, and assisting my teammates who needed my help most at any given moment. After having a good time hunting the enemy, I decided to focus on destroying the turrets.

> Como mi personaje es de apoyo, empecé haciendo travesuras en la jungla enemiga intentando robarle los monstruos, pero no lo logré, también ayudé a mis compañeros alrededor del mapa, en ningún momento me quedé tranquilo.
>
> Por lo que me la pasé de aquí para allá ayudando a matar a los enemigos y a mis compañeros que más necesitaban de mi ayuda en cierto momento. Luego de divertirme un buen rato cazando al enemigo, decidí irme por la destrucción de las torretas.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3jIo3oxhQqI


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)



<div class=\

>

I started by providing support in the middle lane and then moved to the upper lane. Up there, the fight was toughest, since the enemy tried to use more defense on that side.

Many wanted to kill me, but when I transformed into my egg form, I was the one who dealt them the most damage, relentlessly, until I exploded and revived. In that form, everyone ran away because even though I looked like a cute egg, I was quite dangerous.

> Empecé dando apoyo en la calle central y luego en la calle superior. Allá arriba era donde estaba más ruda la pelea, ya que el enemigo quiso usar más defensa por ese lado.
>
> Muchos querían matarme, pero al transformarme en forma de huevito era yo quien les hacía más daño de manera imparable hasta que explotaba y revivía de nuevo. Allí, estando en esa forma, todos huían porque aunque me veía como un tierno huevo, era bastante dañino.

<center>![8.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSmwVjWAnLjhCF8vpDLLGYivhFFL4HHZKasXjq8CFAwtf/8.png)</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)


<center>![10.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTLdp2af8z11nTKwWVsTrttHDGSQTNJBZdfMih9vkg8bS/10.png)</center>


<div class=\

>


More than killing enemies, I really enjoyed supporting my teammates so they could take down the opposing team. Those guys tried so hard that they even killed the Lord, but they still couldn't beat us.


> Más que asesinar enemigos, disfruté mucho dándoles apoyo a mis compañeros para que mataran al equipo contrario. Tanto se esforzó esa gente que hasta mataron al Lord y no pudieron vencernos.

<center>![9.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTNwHSdC611Cro3ZGDTGNfX3Rds3CquFMco5v32197fRg/9.png)</center>


<div class=\

>

My performance earned me the title of Ideal Sidekick, which is like having a good friend who supports you at all times. This means I got 23 kill assists in total, way more than all my teammates combined, so between getting kills and collaborating, supporting others is also a way to earn more points.


> Con mi desempeño me gané el título de Compinche Ideal que es como un buen amigo que te apoya en todo momento. Esto significa que conseguí 23 asistencias de asesinatos en total, mucho más que todos mis compañeros juntos, así que entre asesinar y colaborar, también es válido apoyar para ganar más puntos.

<center>![12.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW7JyqkaAvDyzG3j8J2QU7u2czgesSoYcYz1ghcZWkAWk/12.png)</center>

<div class=\

body.title: HANDS-ON CRAFT FEELS MEDITATIVE
body.body:
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaaaheUdncVSubhp2pnYQh7SK4CKgNSk27YGRkN2us5pZ/1777657693101.jpg
[source](https://www.pexels.com/search/traditional%20crafts/) 

Doing a job you love which involves hands on crafts is very much different from digital work. Hands on craft allows you to focus your attention in a more healthy way which includes the fact that you have to deal with physical materials to achieve the particular goal. 

My point actually is that when you are doing an entrepreneurial job as I would put it as against hands on craft which includes sewing, jewelry making, dIY and so on, it allows you to work with physical materials such as fabrics, threads and so on. In doing this you notice that your brain tends to work more efficiently and helps you focus. However, digital works has you focusing your mental capacity on screens and bright light these can also be mentally satisfying. 

The prompt for this week allows us to differentiate between how entrepreneurial works and digital work helps to relax the mind. In this case However, handcraft involves you to repetitively carry out certain actions that keeps your brain active as a human being. 

Assuming you are a tailor, you would notice that it takes process to achieve a particular design. This means that your mind and body at the same time takes a break from overthinking because assembling the materials and everything to make a particular dress look beautiful and perfect can almost feel as if you are meditating. 

However, digital work can be the Direct opposite because your brain is in a constant state of doing one particular thing over and over again. 


This is my participation in the @scifimultiverse community weekly prompt, to join in check through this [link](https://peakd.com/@scifimultiverse/scifi-multiverse-prompt-week-65-edition-2-or-importance-of-skills-and-hand-craf)
>In this prompt we invite you to share your opinion with us on this prompt. In what ways do you find that focusing on a hands-on craft, like jewelry making or sewing, helps you clear your mind compared to digital work? How can mastering a specific handcraft today serve as a foundation for launching a personal business or brand in the future?

Thanks for stopping by my blog...

body.title: What People Who Are New To Investing In Silver Should Know
body.body:
**What People Who Are New To Investing In Silver Should Know**  
Silver is sometimes regarded as the metal that serves as the entry point for novice investors since it is both affordable and versatile.  
For new silver investors, they need to be aware that silver is quite volatile and is more of an industrial commodity than a safe-haven asset. More than 60% of silver demand is for industrial purposes such as solar panels. As a novice, it’s best to stick with real coins/bars from reliable vendors or Silver ETFs to avoid expensive manufacturing costs on jewellery. And prices might have dramatic falls following record highs. So, keep exposure to 5-10% of a portfolio.  
**Should You Invest in Silver?**  
There is value in silver for both industrial and financial purposes. Electronics, solar panels, and medical applications are just some of the areas that make extensive use of it, which helps to ensure its continued demand.  
**Silver Price**  
**Some of the key metrics are:**  
· Cost of [silver bullion](https://aubullion.ca/product-category/silver/) metal  
· value of silver in US dollars today  
Market trends and entry points may be determined with the use of these.  
**Silver Products That Are Popular**  
The following options are available to novices:  
· [1 ounce of silver coins](https://aubullion.com/product-category/1-oz-silver-coins)  
· 10-ounce bars of silver  
· Bars of silver weighing 5 ounces and 100 ounces  
A monster box provides a substantial amount of benefit to those who invest in bulk.  
**Storage of Items**  
Because silver has a lesser worth per ounce, it takes up more room than gold does. Especially when dealing with huge amounts, proper storage planning is very necessary.  
**Choices Between Physical and Digital:**  
· Physical (Coins/Bars): Allows direct ownership, but needs to be stored safely, insured, and may be subject to VAT (Value-Added Tax).  
· Digital (ETFs/Mutual Funds): Offers better liquidity, lower costs, and no storage problems.  
**How to Handle Risks**  
· Timing the Market: If you buy when the price is at a new high, you could lose a lot if the market goes down.  
· Costs of Storage: Physical silver needs to be kept somewhere safe, like a bank room.  
· Market Sensitivity: When the economy slows down, demand drops, which has a bigger effect on the 1 ounce silver price than on the price of gold.

body.title: Preparing My First Pizza / Preparación De Mi Primera Pizza
body.body: > ***English Version*** ### **Preparing My First Pizza** Hello, dear friends, I'm back with this recipe; I hope you like it. There are times when we enjoy food so much that we need to try and experiment with other favorite dishes. I consider myself a foodie. Now I'm dedicating some time to preparing the meals I love; I wanted to share my experience with you, fellow food lovers. This weekend I ventured into making a pizza in the air fryer; there are days when we just want fast food. >***Versión en Español*** >### **Preparación De Mi Primera Pizza** >Hola, queridos amigos, de vuelta les traigo esta receta; espero que les agrade. Hay momentos en que disfrutamos tanto de la comida que es necesario probar y experimentar por cuenta propia otros platos favoritos. Yo me considero de buen comer. Ahora estoy dedicando un tiempo para preparar esas comidas que me gustan; quise compartir mi experiencia con ustedes, amantes de la buena comida. Este fin de semana me aventure con una pizza hecha en la freidora; hay días en que solo queremos comida rápida. ![IMG_20260424_210210.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tbwZkRb2hx5tQEH6bkaFJ2fd6PgpQRWHgpdYbBjQQNBEVtJAFYeZYJGcrk8TJM5EtzN.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_205444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/2458NimxSWdod1Lj1GY6suRRbrMPrdeGXSDvLW85Xufai99gmsEW5KVhyrayt83g2bSKF.jpg) Making pizza is quick and easy; the first thing to consider is selecting your ingredients. Making the dough from scratch guarantees a fresh crust. To achieve this, I used a recipe my mother gave me. >Preparar la pizza es fácil y rápido; lo primero que debemos tomar en cuenta es seleccionar nuestros ingredientes. Hacer la masa desde cero es una garantía de una masa fresca. Para lograr realizarla, me ayudé con una receta de mi madre que me la obsequió. I realized that you can add a variety of vegetables and other ingredients to a pizza to make it more appealing; I have enough for a Margherita pizza. After this experiment, I can make other varieties. >Me di cuenta de que para realizar una pizza uno puede colocarle una variedad de vegetales y otros productos que la hacen más apetitiva; yo tengo para una pizza margarita. Luego de esta prueba, puedo hacer de otra variedad. ![IMG_20260424_210157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23uFVzaDQsghDiuMmpyvXdGghbvKvpoMY9feYTqi1hFfdTEwdXEYtaGYJ2Y6yhdFmWHuf.jpg) To begin the recipe, I confess that I changed a few things to give it that particular touch. Para dar inicio a la receta, les confieso que varié algunas cosas, para poner ese sello particular. --- #### **Ingredients:** - 3 tomatoes - 4 tablespoons tomato sauce - 2 eggs - 1/4 gram pepperoni - 1/4 gram mozzarella cheese - 3 cups self-rising flour - 1/2 teaspoon salt - 1 tablespoon sugar - 1/4 gram ham - 1/4 gram corn kernels - 1 cup water - Oil --- > #### **Ingredientes:** >- 3 tomates >- 4 cucharadas de salsa de tomate >- 2 huevos >- ¼ gramo de pepperoni >- ¼ gramo de queso mozzarella >- 3 tazas de harina leudante >- ½ cucharadita de sal >- 1 cucharada de azúcar >- ¼ gramo de jamón >- ¼ gramos de maíz >- 1 taza de agua >- Aceite ![IMG_20260424_181438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wMaeukjKFUvWCpiEBhjK39Hcf7pUdnkfPrcNW3qwtaPFbUUgqNB5e463qLWwCXpHi7e.jpg) --- **Preparation:** To begin, I use a saucepan to pour the eggs, add the sugar, salt, water, and mix. >**Preparación:** >Para comenzar, utilizo una cacerola para verter los huevos, agrego el azúcar, la sal, el agua y voy mezclando. ![IMG_20260424_182522_HDR-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/AKF8TdNaHLz6X7PExzVKi5Hr8tJVwuZz8Tni8f8Zeh3zH8QjMNxmakVvYtPNEaZ.jpg) ![Brown Aesthetic Vintage Scrapbook Photo Collage Instagram Story (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wgMwAdgYHX9PzueKpiSwbqvckagLBJJHKq51AYKCThtTJQdgaAzsoLJkJJXLbqDDruQ.png) ![IMG_20260424_182713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/242XtsrchyMz4SGax3LGFt3ihTAss6ne9C9ozn4eXxCbzoM3LhpkRfBmQUUAHfNiDWCp9.jpg) Now I gradually add the flour and mix it in, kneading continuously. >Ahora voy agregando la harina de a poco y voy uniendo, amasando continuamente. ![Brown Aesthetic Vintage Scrapbook Photo Collage Instagram Story (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wqnseiK1YyUrWG4ynGL5iXjVnMhcxyhrXhkdjDj4A9SGK59X39Qxb2vyxmY2rC37Aic.png) Once the dough has formed, I place it on a floured surface and knead it until it has a manageable texture. It's ready when it no longer sticks to my fingers and kneads easily. >Una vez que la masa toma forma, la coloco en la mesa ya enharinada y amaso hasta lograr una textura manejable. Está lista cuando ya no se pega de los dedos y se amasa con mucha soltura. ![IMG_20260424_183127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Ep7tDaaJQ3ZTsTmAofRH2aZwHXJAWQPsKcV2zwZkWPT9UXJ8vL6iZSXUVHHW5FjYHFJ.jpg) ![Brown Aesthetic Vintage Scrapbook Photo Collage Instagram Story (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tvngBzrErRQgW91S3426UGLzrYteR8mUqcDnBav6xt6ShGdUBSFX75npnZwnp5fc6vR.png) The time is right to place it in a container, cover it with a cloth, and let it rest for an hour; this makes the dough rise. >El instante es oportuno para colocarla en un envase, tapada con un paño y ponerla a reposar por una hora; esto hace que crezca la masa. ![Brown Aesthetic Vintage Scrapbook Photo Collage Instagram Story (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wCE6TPhHwANzvKjJdHbDhpeA6EytZUvk1RB3ALdfdcjbchu1LLxLkyvBdq5Q5ptf5fC.png) During this time, we put the tomatoes in a pot to boil them; when they cool, we blend them to make the sauce and I complement it with tomato sauce to give it a better texture. >En este intervalo de tiempo, montamos los tomates en una olla para sancocharlos; al enfriar, licuamos para hacer la salsa y yo complemento con la salsa de tomate para que tenga una mejor textura. ![IMG_20260424_190544-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpGSDaVxdziKj4ATUaudqDkE87Rqk3fxe4y3bfdXdQFjnxMWbzTJKgrRafUweU1jG2j.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_191209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpxrfeTUauvHGuD6Jp5Wp2KA1quQUsXBvx9iDK4mJ3ZLX6d8vf3j4a42j6xSvrqc6xu.jpg) I dice the ham; I leave the cheese as it came, in slices. >Pico el jamón en cuadros; el queso lo dejo de la misma manera que venía, en lonjas. ![Brown Aesthetic Vintage Scrapbook Photo Collage Instagram Story (3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23u6Hs3aCKsNfwoy1sx9CYuHxjBLQ1Cag1NVPCg4jfSTg5reP9tXzeF9KsQTjtEFksf4n.png) Once the time is up, we stretch the dough; the size should be the same as our fryer oven mold. When transferring it to the tray, it should be greased. >Cumplido el tiempo, estiramos la masa; la medida es del tamaño de nuestro molde del horno freidor. Al pasarla a la bandeja, debe estar engrasada. ![IMG_20260424_192221.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpJY7C8weWFKgi8CTqjUKyNCT87BvCmv554sNB7Gr46C3EVGVc7NWUPAsaNwdRJLU72.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_192252_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23x19Ft34bota3Ex4K6ReS1qdNHUYzXx4jbYyPAXo7cg1tTVSKaXG4jdgfojJzhx5Zutz.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_192540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tvg61Bpf5iYFudP9KrrwPWG5NYCf2frqzVUmhUREJmg1mXypgJtCVcD1k5i36XmTqkM.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_192538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23uFVvnF6js91jcrsUR2J1WbPp2FozMtbrLY5NJNTxTH6XanWzX5PS76nfoLN3bm1wodf.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_191957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eou9DSUq6ieRUapt73HxzURoaLVrkMUK2RGCJX2B3hnmNgmKkBQ6epg5PrcaSZcZopc.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_192005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpNos5K5KU1H9YF61aeq5ydjTiTe7dNyJTedSHBe4FqymHb9i4rcjavKFsoEnicNvcm.jpg) We add the sauce, place the cheese, the ham, the pepperoni and, finally, the corn; the quantities depend on each person's taste. >Agregamos la salsa, colocamos el queso, el jamón, el pepperoni y, por último, el maíz; las cantidades dependen del gusto de cada persona. ![Brown Aesthetic Vintage Scrapbook Photo Collage Instagram Story (6).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23u6FdFk6iy3Qcb2zt6GMsRKoqN5NhAWBVkWmAa65dy6CW6nu4T4CeGMNBcH8jm3gQSxa.png) ![IMG_20260424_193937.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23u67PgLzbPQ85NXpacWFPFy2Xzsgh3DxUJ43DJTTrRCkWraaxQHmSA4jMvy1Fhyndrpz.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_194045_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wqkdu3uJp3idi3y8fxqY8kCur8A8pSEjgT8iapQjuqLGHNygdBqGUwoNtJvQu1BXGLh.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_194106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eoc8R4BXXPybzwTeY5LRgRbtfp5waRh83i87yRjJjKq5LAT6NbM8BUK7gaFeSx4Soec.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_194137_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpEHkFDYwbojk3YzXx2Yq8RprB9TGrjcjVmRZkVeDJM87sHSUcpz8iUn9f8rZBiyg9B.jpg) This time I timed the cooking. I preheated the oven to 160°C and then lowered the temperature. The cooking time was approximately 20 to 25 minutes. I hope to continue honing my culinary skills with this new project. >En esta oportunidad medí el tiempo de duración. Precalenté el horno a 160° y luego le bajé la temperatura. El tiempo de cocción fue de aproximadamente 20 a 25 minutos. Deseo seguir afinando mis habilidades culinarias en este nuevo proyecto para mí. ![Brown Aesthetic Vintage Scrapbook Photo Collage Instagram Story (4).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xL2zt28G9Ti1wzTeJJDHSitUe6T2BBW98P8fdWkPeJyr24rdWFdRRyqM8fkVE8ZzgrM.png) ![IMG_20260424_194400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23zS1DQc2Fv3Y9BbzWLP13MDoEAxsHQeG2wpuv6kb8EWN1q9JEzQfWW3w1kH32ZSsF993.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_205453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/2432Hq2x85czzhDrFgV1qYBa9f7SveCb8SwjniyZJhjBBJ6kfbFTmnqKVKV6jNTmtanrX.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_210205.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23uQvaHAcoX1ctAcBgAy1jRt89FbiGu7k4488B8e55vqkCPuUXNsDAuEtMLFqcdGPCFwx.jpg) ![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAbzQkJ9G8uVvM1WjDyRRLVVNw8ZkC7TWGETBJTvCKqyhVtq1XD2fZTjwNy1z7pPnXX8sPSVo4Jkb6Lrey483NiqafDw4viERK5hnozR8iGc9hudG.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/23tkfzgkFvfEwYG79V7mCkgN4mjvJMj84fZAsqPYHaseWjEjTYqB8d52z9sDsVd9zb6xm.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@iscrak/preparing-my-first-pizza-preparacin-de-mi-primera-pizza-avn)

body.title: The Renaissance the the USA Didn't Want You to Know About - 07-24-2017 - 10X Speed
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1777656330997-ee1c857276e6d915.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/c7238eae)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/c7238eae)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

body.title: In Italy, it's Labor Day, but do we women really have reason to celebrate? I say no./ En Italia es el Día del Trabajo, pero ¿acaso las mujeres tenemos motivos para celebrarlo? Yo digo que no.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcfvV6kGpKNR1Ev1XxHsEJeg7oyDKFKCjm3Mri7u6kLqJ/1777655341796.png)



Good morning, blogging friends, how are you? Today I decided to post on this community outside of the contest. Here in Italy, today is Labor Day, but I'm wondering, is there really any point in celebrating women today? In my opinion, ISTAT data, statistics, newspapers, and even other women I know, absolutely not. Meanwhile, in Italy, despite having a female prime minister, policies are being implemented that absolutely do not benefit women. A woman who is an enemy of women has rejected the minimum wage proposal, the proposal for longer maternity leave for fathers (currently ten days), cut bonuses for mothers, for working women, and for daycare centers, and to help women who care for sick or disabled family members. There's money for weapons and other nonsense, but not for women! 


And so, in Italy, the majority of unemployed people are women of all ages, but especially those over 35 because there are no benefits and companies prefer to hire younger people. Why? Because they pay them less and can offer them apprenticeships until they're 30! Furthermore, women in their 30s and 40s are reluctantly hired because employers are afraid they might get pregnant and claim maternity leave, even though it's illegal.

 This often happens in interviews (it's happened to me and all my female friends) if you have children or want to have them. In short, there's a high rate of female unemployment here. Furthermore, there's still no equal pay for men and women; in the same role, many men earn more than their female colleagues. Furthermore, let's not even talk about mothers. Our dear female minister scolds Italian women for not having children and the birth rate is at an all-time low, but she certainly doesn't ask why or propose serious solutions.


🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑

Buenos días, amigos blogueros, ¿cómo están? Hoy decidí publicar en esta comunidad fuera del concurso. Aquí en Italia, hoy es el Día del Trabajo, pero me pregunto: ¿realmente tiene sentido celebrar a las mujeres hoy? En mi opinión, según datos del ISTAT, estadísticas, periódicos e incluso otras mujeres que conozco, absolutamente no. 

Mientras tanto, en Italia, a pesar de tener una primera ministra, se están implementando políticas que no benefician en absoluto a las mujeres. Una mujer que es enemiga de las mujeres ha rechazado la propuesta del salario mínimo, la propuesta de una licencia de maternidad más larga para los padres (actualmente diez días), recortes en las primas para las madres, para las mujeres trabajadoras y para las guarderías, y para ayudar a las mujeres que cuidan a familiares enfermos o discapacitados. 

¡Hay dinero para armas y otras tonterías, pero no para las mujeres! Y así, en Italia, la mayoría de las personas desempleadas son mujeres de todas las edades, pero especialmente las mayores de 35 años porque no hay beneficios y las empresas prefieren contratar a gente más joven. ¿Por qué? ¡Porque les pagan menos y pueden ofrecerles prácticas hasta los 30! Además, las mujeres de entre 30 y 40 años son contratadas a regañadientes porque los empleadores temen que se queden embarazadas y soliciten la baja por maternidad, aunque sea ilegal.

 Esto suele ocurrir en las entrevistas (me ha pasado a mí y a todas mis amigas) si tienes hijos o quieres tenerlos. En resumen, aquí hay una alta tasa de desempleo femenino. Además, todavía no existe la igualdad salarial entre hombres y mujeres; en el mismo puesto, muchos hombres ganan más que sus compañeras. Y ni hablemos de las madres. Nuestra querida ministra reprende a las mujeres italianas por no tener hijos y la tasa de natalidad está en mínimos históricos, pero desde luego no pregunta por qué ni propone soluciones serias.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemet5ndLV2Uy9QqSakuQmQCv7GUahQQmjsQCrUmwmmC9/1777655380209.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPHbMT6UBczbquQ19uRnNKAWp6U8eSDUcpJW78qwLqn6L/1777655380371.jpg)


Working mothers face even more problems, with incompatible schedules, almost nonexistent and expensive daycare (so much so that many mothers give up work in the first few years to care for their children, just as the burden of sick or disabled family members, unfortunately, almost always burdens women who are forced to leave work because there are no facilities here either, and those that do exist are ridiculously expensive), limited leave and the risk of mobbing if they take time off for their children, very little support or bonuses, and numerous organizational difficulties in managing children and work. In short, the working conditions of women in Italy are not good. I myself, unfortunately, have been unemployed for years except on short-term contracts.


 However, this is a problem for both men and women: the difficulty in finding long-term, decently paid work. For women, there's also a greater mental burden. In Italy, thanks to a patriarchal mentality, even women who work eight hours a day often also take care of children and housework. Practically all the housework and childcare falls on women, even if they work as much or more than men. This is truly a mentality issue. Here, many men still don't do household chores and aren't capable of taking care of chores or children. So, for us Italian women, there's very little to celebrate today. What's the situation like in your countries? I'd be curious to learn about the women/work situation in countries other than my own.


🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑🛑


Las madres trabajadoras se enfrentan a aún más problemas: horarios incompatibles, guarderías casi inexistentes y caras (tanto que muchas madres abandonan el trabajo en los primeros años para cuidar a sus hijos, al igual que la carga de familiares enfermos o discapacitados, que lamentablemente casi siempre recae sobre las mujeres, quienes se ven obligadas a dejar de trabajar porque tampoco hay guarderías disponibles, y las que existen son ridículamente caras), permisos limitados y el riesgo de sufrir acoso laboral si se toman tiempo libre para cuidar a sus hijos, muy poco apoyo o bonificaciones, y numerosas dificultades organizativas para conciliar la vida familiar y laboral. En resumen, las condiciones laborales de las mujeres en Italia no son buenas. Yo misma, por desgracia, llevo años desempleada, salvo con contratos temporales. Sin embargo, este es un problema tanto para hombres como para mujeres: la dificultad de encontrar un trabajo estable y bien remunerado. Para las mujeres, además, supone una mayor carga mental. 


En Italia, debido a una mentalidad patriarcal, incluso las mujeres que trabajan ocho horas al día a menudo también se ocupan de los hijos y las tareas domésticas. Prácticamente todas las tareas del hogar y el cuidado infantil recaen sobre las mujeres, aunque trabajen tanto o más que los hombres. Esto es, sin duda, una cuestión de mentalidad. Aquí, muchos hombres aún no colaboran con las tareas del hogar y no son capaces de ocuparse de ellas ni de los niños. Así que, para nosotras, las mujeres italianas, hoy en día hay poco que celebrar. ¿Cómo es la situación en vuestros países? Me gustaría saber cómo es la situación de las mujeres en el ámbito laboral en otros países.





![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDWSvcRC4FNA3aPNDaNehADthrry2WgKdzTnU22VNZy9/1777655380615.jpg)

body.title: Should Personal Beliefs Override Public Health?
body.body: > Health they say is wealth. You never know how important good health is until you lose your health which is actually very true. Most of us out there are so caught up in the busy life we forget to take care of our health, both physically and mentally. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcshjf24DL8LrKDTWzm2KCRwgPcwVbegBFVA8K2YRvWfi/img_0610.jpg) To some extent, I’d like to blame the healthcare system because in some parts of the world, healthcare is a luxury to the average citizen. In Ghana here, healthcare is very expensive. Public hospitals which are supposed to provide the best healthcare to everyone are those that provide the worst healthcare. Instead one treating patients rightly, most doctors in public hospitals prefer to rather refer their patients to their own private hospitals for the profit of it all. Speaking of good health, it’s advisable that we all go for general body check up at least once in six months. This is to make sure all is well with you because some conditions can be latent for years. Over the years, the issue of preventive care has become a recurring topic among the general public. I’ve seen and heard of parents who refuse to give their babies vaccinations because they have their own beliefs and thoughts on that. There’s also those who refuse as much as blood transfusions even in the case of an emergency due to their beliefs also which I totally understand and respect. We all have what we stand by and it’s not up you as a healthcare officer to judge. There was a case where parents refused to grant permission for their young child to receive blood after losing a lot of blood. They were actually ready to lose their child because and as healthcare providers, you’d have to intervene by calling the social services and letting them take care of that. Social services came it, took the case to a judge and at the end of the day, the judge gave the go ahead for the child to be given the blood. Today, this kid is up and well. In a situation where he was old enough to make his or her own decisions, he’s have decide what he or she would do but in a situation where you’re underage, you stand the chance of having other decide whether you life or die. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2y9p8rG63yPjAACm1WVcSFm5AzGkWJkn5ohrWNKxisy/img_0618.jpg) Honestly, this topic is a subjective one and I don’t think I’m in the best position to judge or decide. But it’s worth noting that, everyone one deserves the chance at life and no one should try to deny them that based on beliefs. Sometimes we have to consider the intensity of the situation and make logical decisions because in that moment, someone’s life is in your hands and you sure won’t want to be the one responsible for messing it up. It can be a tough choice to make but there is only one right choice and that decisions lies in your hands. Prevention they say is better than cure. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

### Welcome to the monthly financial report about the Hive blockchain.

All the information presented in this report is based on the data collected from the blockchain until 2026-04-30 midnight UTC. This report aims to provide you with a clear view of what is happening on the Hive blockchain.

![](https://arcange.eu/hive-images/2026-04-30-HiveSupplyVirtual-EN.png)

This graph shows the evolution of HIVE virtual Supply. The virtual supply is the sum of HIVE supply (liquid and staked HIVE) and HBD supply (converted into HIVE).

body.body:
Introduction


Hello everyone, Worldmappin friends! I'm @lauramica, and I'm here to share with you our Saturday Travel Digest, following the launch of our amazing Worldmappin V2! Come see the places we'll be visiting today ❤️ This time, our featured posts take us on a stroll along a beautiful beach in Cumaná, Venezuela, we visit the Natural History Center of Serbia, and we explore Langsa City Forest Park in Indonesia. We'll also visit other places around the world like Italy, the Philippines, Turkey, and Nepal—a little bit of everything! Thank you all for sharing your posts on the map! Have a wonderful day! 😃❤️


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 Get away to Playa San Luis/ Escápate a Playa San Luis 😎🏝️🌊🪸 by @nancybriti1

Cumaná is the city where I was born, grew up, and have lived my entire life, and it is the capital of the Sucre state, a state of Venezuela that has the Caribbean Sea to the north. Cumaná is bordered by different beaches, but the largest in extension is Playa San Luis, with more than 1500 meters, which is located on Av. Universidad, right in front of the University where I work. This is the place where stress surrenders to the waves.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 A visit to the Natural History Center of Serbia in Svilajnac by @jelenaa

If you have read my previous posts, you know that I wrote about a small town in central-eastern Serbia and its surroundings, Svilajnac. The reason we actually went to this town is that my son won an educational quiz that was organized in our city of Belgrade and won a family ticket to the Natural History Center of Serbia in Svilajnac.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 LANGSA CITY FOREST PARK // Enjoying a peaceful afternoon amidst the lush trees of the charming Langsa City Forest Park by @riyat

In this post, I will share my experience and moments when I visited Langsa City Forest Park with the aim of recreation and seeking peace in the embrace of nature.This place is always my main destination when I miss nature, especially since this tourist spot is also quite close to the center of Langsa city, if I'm not mistaken the distance is only about 4 kilometers.

body.title: Good musical taste - The Tale of Sigmund - ENG- SPA
body.body: > For Sigmund, becoming a pianist required a great deal of hard work, so much so that he still doesn't understand how things could have happened because of his own stubbornness. What happened in the past is in the past, but for him, it's still almost the present because his own decisions delayed his achievements and the opportunity to realize more dreams. He was just a beginner when he began to notice a quality in himself that he hadn't known existed. At home, he could practice playing the piano and he did very well in front of friends and family. He could even give his teachers a demonstration without any problem. He had a very good playing ability, so everyone already thought he would be very successful in the future. What happened was that once he left school and started living alone, he became somewhat isolated. He lost contact with his old friends and only saw his family occasionally. Meanwhile, at home, he continued practicing the piano; he knew that this would be his vocation in the very near future. Although his music teachers had told him that he was ready to take on the world, he had insecurities about his ability. And he thought people would see him as a fool or someone who didn't know what he was doing. So day after day he tried to perfect his technique at home, but with a consequence: since there was no one around to tell him it was time to leave his room and start playing, he just kept perfecting his technique. The strange thing is, it never seemed enough. As is to be expected in this state, the years passed and he remained there alone. He wasn't getting anywhere with so much practice if in the end he wasn't playing for anyone.

> Para Sigmund llegar a ser pianista tuvo que pasar mucho trabajo, tanto que el todavía no entiende como esas cosas pudieron pasar por su propia manía. Lo que pasó en el pasado ya es pasado pero para el aún es casi presente porque sus propias decisiones retrasaron sus logros y la oportunidad de alcanzar más sueños. Era solo un principiante cuando empezó a notar una cualidad suya que no conocía hasta ese momento. En casa podía practicar a tocar el piano y lo hacía muy bien frente a amigos y familiares. Incluso en su escuela podía hacerles una demostración a sus profesores sin problema alguno. Tenía muy buena habilidad tocando, así que ya todos pensaban que sería un buen éxito en el futuro. Lo que pasó es que él una vez dejó la escuela y empezó a vivir solo se aisló un poco. Perdió contacto con sus amigos antiguos y solo veía a la familia de vez en cuando. Mientras tanto en la casa seguía practicando el piano, el sabía que esa sería su vocación en el futuro muy cercano. Aunque sus profesores de música le habían dicho que ya estaba listo para comerse el mundo el tenía complejos con su habilidad. Y pensaba que la gente lo vería como un tonto o alguien que no sabe lo que hace. Así que día tras día intentaba perfeccionar su técnica en casa, pero con una consecuencia, como no había nadie cerca para decirle que ya era hora de salir del cuarto y empezar a tocar el solo continuó perfeccionando su tecina, lo extraño es que nunca le parecía suficiente. Como es de esperar en este estado los años pasaron y el solo continuó ahí. No llegaba a ningún lado con tanta practica si al final no tocaba para nadie.
![piano-3402557_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23vi8FN8A34yYZtZ5mBoJvU2gjXyfbb9aoZGehh3PoeJsdPUq6CfVWPVQa8gffoXN6w2x.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> He became so dissatisfied with his lack of satisfaction that he eventually stopped practicing altogether, even thinking that music wasn't for him. This was a very self-deprecating view, as he was actually quite talented; he just couldn't see it. Once he stopped playing, he devoted himself to other things that had nothing to do with his beloved piano, the instrument that had once motivated him. He let himself be consumed by negative feelings and abandoned his musical aspirations. He was never happy again after making that decision, feeling like a frustrated pianist, someone who hadn't fought for what he wanted. He was lost, and his condition was steadily worsening. Just when he thought he couldn't continue battling these negative feelings of having wasted his life, something incredible happened. He was cleaning floors at a hospital, working as a janitor. A man approached him, recognizing him. It was his former piano teacher, and he was shocked to see him in such a state. He clearly noticed that he hadn't pursued music. So, he avoided asking him directly. He simply asked if he was okay. Since Sigmund didn't talk much with people, the fact that an acquaintance asked him that question, especially his piano teacher, made him finally open up. His teacher understood that he had let himself be consumed by a mania for perfection, or perhaps by the fear of being judged in music. He simply couldn't leave him in that situation without offering the help he needed. The teacher himself had gone through something similar in his youth; the difference was that he had overcome it, while Sigmund kept dwelling on what he hadn't been and what he was today.

> Llegó a sentirse tan mal por no estar nunca satisfecho que llegó un punto en el que dejó de practicar, y hasta pensó que la música no era para el. Era algo muy complejista de su parte, ya que en realidad ya era muy bueno, solo que el no lo veía. Una vez que dejó de tocar, se dedicó a otras cosas que no tenían nada que ver con su querido piano, el que una vez lo motivaba en el pasado. Se dejó arrastras por sus sentimientos negativos y dejó de lado su vida en la música. Nunca estuvo feliz de nuevo al tomar esa decisión, pues se sentía un pianista frustrado, alguien que no luchó por lo que quería. Estaba ya perdido, y cada vez estaba en un peor estado. Cuando pensaba que ya no podría seguir luchando con esos sentimientos negativos de que desperdició su vida entonces pasó algo increíble. Estaba limpiando pisos en un hospital, pues ahora era conserje. Un señor se le acercó pues lo reconoció. Era su antiguo maestro de piano, le sorprendió mucho verlo como se encontraba. Y claramente notó que no se dedicó a la música. Así que evitó preguntarle directamente. Solo le dijo que si estaba bien. Dado Sigmund no hablaba mucho con la gente que un conocido le hiciera esa pregunta, y más su maestro de piano lo hicieron soltar todo lo que sentía. Su maestro comprendió que el se había dejado llevar por la manía de la perfección, o al miedo al ser juzgado en la música. Simplemente no pudo dejarlo en esa situación sin ofrecerle la ayuda que necesitaba. Y es que ese mismo maestro había pasado por eso en su juventud, la diferencia es que el lo superó, pero Sigmund solo seguía dando vueltas a lo que no pudo ser y a lo que es hoy en día.
![piano-7890735_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23w2iyXsPQc92JZ8GmshewvDSTdjzKuLMS725utTFSxBDUnkcoGkLYdoYYvMRNRjT5ynb.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> After listening attentively, the teacher invited him for coffee that same day. They agreed to meet at his house a few days later. Once there, he told him about his own experiences and what had helped him overcome his fear of being judged or his tendency to be overly perfectionistic. For the first time, Sigmund felt understood, so he allowed himself to be helped. First, he went to therapy to regain his self-confidence. Then, he let his former teacher guide him to resume piano lessons and perhaps remember what he had forgotten over the years. With this support, he was able to see the mistakes he had made in his career, mistakes he had created himself, because he had always been very talented. The main lesson he learned is that it's impossible to please everyone, and the moment you understand that, you can create music you love. Sigmund overcame everything, and his current music is proof of that. But he will never forget what happened.

> Luego de escucharlo detenidamente el maestro lo invito a tomar un café ese mismo día. Luego quedaron en verse en su casa unos días después. Una vez allí el le contó por lo que también había pasado y que cosas le habían ayudado a superar el miedo a ser juzgado o siempre ser demasiado perfeccionista. Por primera vez Sigmund se sintió comprendido así que se dejó ayudar. Primero fue a terapia para volver a sentirse bien consigo mismo. Luego se dejó guiar por su antiguo maestro para retomar las clases de piano y tal vez recordar lo que había olvidado con los años. Con esas ayudas el pudo ver los errores que había cometido en su carrera, errores que el mismo se había creado, porque en realidad siempre fue muy bueno. El objetivo principal que aprendió es que es imposible gustarle a todos, y en el momento en que entiendas eso podrás crear música que te guste. Sigmund lo superó todo, y su música actual es muestra de ellos. Pero nunca olvidará lo que pasó.
![pianist-14245_640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/Eo8Kc1qTDi7rzWYTN8CzuJ7mwcwjzro3RJt76siMkkPqPYTLn42BAViBmt2c1RLqn8P.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

The English version was translated using Google Translate. Esta publicación es completamente original, y de mi autoría. NO se han usado programas para modificar el texto o para reparar la gramática. Tal cual lo lees así lo escribí. La versión en ingles fue traducida usando Google traductor.

body.title: Different coffee shop, same destination
body.body:
Greetings, friends.

The headquarters of the Nicolás Guillén Foundation in Las Tunas dates back to 2002, when I was just a child. However, even back then, when I wasn't even thinking about becoming a writer, I was already participating in literary events held there.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ71KRg6SX3gibWNQ6EErpNygzQab8YXDApp3SLbezVSK/1777635615657.jpg)

Since its very founding, that cultural center has always had a café. I think many of us from Las Tunas have said this: coffee and literature always go hand in hand.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXJzjLr8mUzkpUkrzbczCxu7tLByLVwqXpoThb8p1Jiuz/1777635615719.jpg)

But that café back then isn't the same as it is now. Over these twenty-plus years, it has had different owners, each with their own style, recipes, and interests. Some were artists, others weren't. Some, like the current owner, aren't artists, but they have great artistic sensibility and like to have the place full of artists.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdnaq58CjqqV5Xwpv48FiY5b4QVBzgG47KbBknjTrTgL8/1777635615896.jpg)

Perhaps that's why this design is quite bohemian, rustic yet comfortable, with an abundance of natural elements, fresh, pleasant, and with various seating options, from tables to armchairs, rocking chairs, or sofas, as if we were in our own home.

And that is precisely the idea behind having a café at the foundation: to make us feel at home.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZn5W9PFoP39iG8gkq8d3LqNBdhtKGK7zVc51pcgaLSf6/1777635616077.jpg)

Perhaps that's why it's not the biggest coffee shop in the province. It's true that it's not a large establishment, nor does it have the extensive coffee menu we all might wish for. That's true, but it is a place designed for artists to have a space to talk about our projects, about our lives; a place to work calmly and peacefully.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTF7vKBV9ZgzX6cQRxyunoCvvw1hCbH5jvDKMCFMm1WU/1777635616225.jpg)

It's a place for us. Therefore, for more than 20 years, I have not stopped coming.
body.author: daveza

body.title: Mayday, Mayday
body.body: >\n\nIt is the May Day public holiday today, to celebrate the start of spring. And despite it snowing a few days ago, it was almost twenty degrees today, which brought out all the folks into the Vappu markets. We go every year the weather is good enough and buy some fairy floss, Smallsteps plays some sideshow games and never wins anything other than the \

prizes, eat some muikku (vendace), and buy a balloon. This year though, we stopped last night at the market to get the balloon, because we wanted her to have a specific one. 


---

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/427899493183258625/1499787957673136248/IMG_20260501_131753.jpg?ex=69f611e1&is=69f4c061&hm=4455e29860d9777491cf72fdb2d1e533a39ad5df0432290b8a9ad52fd71af6cc&=&format=webp&width=1186&height=741

---

I used the little bit of self-restraint I possess to not buy any churros or liquorice, though I did have some fairy floss, because that is a bit of a tradition for us. It was on this day that I asked my wife to marry me, after I had bought her two massive balls of spun sugar. She was high with a sugar rush when she said yes.

<div class=\

>https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/427899493183258625/1499787959346397264/IMG_20260501_133600.jpg?ex=69f611e2&is=69f4c062&hm=84a45ef16c8d5faa5b75f1168e1c99c17baf8fdaeb4979ef0599ecf24480bad5&=&format=webp&width=558&height=741 --- # Can you guess which balloon Smallsteps got? https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/427899493183258625/1499787958570450995/IMG_20260501_132116.jpg?ex=69f611e2&is=69f4c062&hm=db65bc159bc1184af3ae4f6b472ed28a45770502a6ce7ddccb270289681b3953&=&format=webp&width=1186&height=741 ---

>https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/427899493183258625/1499787959707373630/IMG_20260501_132802.jpg?ex=69f611e2&is=69f4c062&hm=6a6d9cb7a1eba8054d11e571dfdb96f3bb63b24fb25ae0f2b0e2b838ed192d11&=&format=webp&width=593&height=741 --- We weren't the only ones who attended the market - it was *packed.* They used to have it in the city main square and now they have moved it to a park between two roads, so the thoroughfare is really narrow. It took ages to get anywhere and it wasn't helped by some thoughtless and cruel people taking their dogs through there. It must be horrible for dogs to be packed around so many people, unable to see anything and getting bumped by people who don't see them down low. > Some people are idiots. https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/427899493183258625/1499787958243557488/IMG_20260501_140349.jpg?ex=69f611e1&is=69f4c061&hm=2c25f8ea4591156e430fb7d63abdfd8f990368a444ad7daec756a5ef0556d77b&=&format=webp&width=1186&height=741 These things are always the same, but it is not a bad tradition to go with children, and a lot of adults enjoy it too. May Day is also the day where people celebrate graduating high school once upon a time, and many Finns where their white, graduation cap. Back in the day, not many people went to high school here I guess, but I am not sure how important it is now. Still, people hold onto the traditions strongly here. Oh, and while we didn't see it, at the same time we were walking through a fair filled with balloons and fairy floss, a few hundred meters away there was a demonstration with about 200 skin heads who are part of an anti-immigration and white-only movement, and around the equal number in opposition to them also. Lots of shaved heads and Nazi salutes. > Quite the contrast. But instead of caring about that, we went and bought some sausages, corn, asparagus, zucchini and mushrooms, and grilled outside in the sunshine. While it is warm today and will be okay tomorrow, the temperature will drop on Sunday and it will rain again. In Finland, one has to take advantage of some sunshine when it is there. Though with global warming, it might soon be a desert. Finns will still be in the sun, just in case it doesn't shine tomorrow. body.title: America's Energy Advantage: Why Natural Gas Remains Remarkably Affordable in the United States
body.body:
In a world where energy markets are often volatile due to geopolitical tensions, the United States stands out with relatively low and stable natural gas prices. As of early May 2026, Henry Hub spot prices—the U.S. benchmark for natural gas—hover around $2.70–$3.00 per million British thermal units (MMBtu), offering a stark contrast to much higher prices seen in Europe and Asia, especially amid disruptions from the ongoing conflict involving Iran.

This affordability is no accident. It stems from decades of technological innovation, massive domestic production, and a market structure that keeps most supply serving American consumers and industries first.

### Record Production Keeps Supply Abundant

The U.S. is the world's largest producer of natural gas, with output projected to reach record levels in 2026, driven by advancements in hydraulic fracturing (fracking) and horizontal drilling. Shale formations like the Permian Basin, Haynesville, and Marcellus continue to deliver strong volumes. In many cases, natural gas emerges as \

alongside oil production, further boosting supply even when oil-directed drilling fluctuates.

The Energy Information Administration (EIA) forecasts U.S. dry natural gas production to grow in 2026, supporting domestic needs while allowing for exports. High storage levels and efficient shale operations have helped maintain a supply cushion, insulating prices from some global shocks. In certain regions like West Texas, oversupply has even led to occasional negative spot prices at hubs such as Waha due to pipeline constraints.

Unlike oil, which trades in a highly integrated global market and is heavily affected by events in the Strait of Hormuz, U.S. natural gas remains largely a North American story for now. Most gas moves via pipelines rather than tankers, limiting immediate exposure to international disruptions. This has kept domestic prices relatively flat even as LNG and oil markets react to Middle East developments.

### Benefits for Consumers, Industry, and the Economy

Low natural gas prices deliver broad advantages:

- **Household Savings**: Cheaper gas translates to lower heating bills in winter and more affordable electricity in many regions, since natural gas powers a significant share of U.S. power generation. This eases pressure on family budgets at a time when gasoline prices have climbed due to oil market tightness.

- **Industrial Competitiveness**: Energy-intensive sectors like chemicals, manufacturing, and fertilizers benefit enormously. Affordable feedstock and fuel help U.S. companies compete globally, supporting jobs and keeping consumer goods prices in check.

- **Power Sector Stability**: Natural gas serves as a reliable \

fuel, balancing renewables and providing dispatchable power. Its lower cost supports affordable electricity even as demand grows from data centers, electrification, and economic activity.

- **Inflation Control**: By keeping a key energy input affordable, low gas prices help moderate broader inflationary pressures compared to scenarios where all fossil fuels spike together.

These benefits highlight why abundant domestic energy resources act as an economic stabilizer.

### Challenges and the Road Ahead

While prices are currently favorable, the landscape is evolving. Growing LNG export capacity is linking the U.S. market more closely to global demand, which could lift the domestic price floor over time and introduce more volatility. EIA forecasts suggest Henry Hub averages around $3.60–$4.30/MMBtu for 2026 overall, with potential for higher winter premiums or tighter balances in future years as exports expand and power demand rises.

Pipeline infrastructure bottlenecks, weather-driven demand swings, and policy decisions on exports will continue to influence prices. Regions with excess associated gas may see persistently low local prices, while export-heavy areas feel global pulls.

Nevertheless, America's resource base and production capability provide a strong foundation. Unlike many nations dependent on imports, the U.S. enjoys an enviable position of energy abundance.

### A Strategic Asset Worth Protecting

The low price of natural gas in the United States is a testament to innovation, entrepreneurship, and sound resource development. It delivers tangible benefits to American households and businesses while enhancing national energy security. As the country navigates global uncertainties and transitions toward a more diverse energy mix, maintaining this competitive edge through continued production and infrastructure investment will remain crucial.

In an era of energy challenges worldwide, affordable domestic natural gas isn't just an economic boon—it's a strategic advantage that underscores the strength of U.S. energy independence.
