# Sustainable Fashion: The Future of Style

In recent years, the fashion industry has undergone a significant transformation, with sustainability taking center stage. As we move forward into a world that increasingly values eco-consciousness, it’s essential to understand what sustainable fashion means and how it shapes the future of style.

## What is Sustainable Fashion?

Sustainable fashion refers to clothing, accessories, and footwear that are designed, produced, and consumed in a way that is environmentally friendly, socially responsible, and economically viable. This approach not only considers the materials used but also the entire lifecycle of a product, from production to disposal.

### Key Principles of Sustainable Fashion:

1. **Eco-Friendly Materials**: Utilizing organic, recycled, or biodegradable fabrics reduces the environmental impact. Think organic cotton, Tencel, and recycled polyester.

2. **Ethical Labor Practices**: Ensuring fair wages and safe working conditions for all workers involved in the production process is crucial. Brands are increasingly transparent about their supply chains.

3. **Minimal Waste**: Sustainable fashion encourages practices like zero-waste design, upcycling, and recycling to minimize fabric waste that typically ends up in landfills.

4. **Timeless Design**: Instead of following fleeting trends, sustainable fashion promotes timeless pieces that can be worn season after season, encouraging consumers to invest in quality over quantity.

5. **Local Production**: Supporting local artisans and manufacturers not only reduces carbon footprints associated with transportation but also boosts local economies.

## Why is Sustainable Fashion Important?

The fashion industry is one of the largest polluters in the world, contributing to water pollution, excessive waste, and greenhouse gas emissions. By shifting towards sustainable practices, we can help mitigate these issues and create a more responsible industry.

### Benefits of Sustainable Fashion:

- **Environmental Conservation**: Reducing waste and pollution helps protect our planet for future generations.
- **Social Responsibility**: Supporting ethical brands fosters fair labor practices and improves the lives of workers.
- **Consumer Awareness**: As consumers become more informed, they can make choices that reflect their values, pushing brands to adopt sustainable practices.

## The Future of Style

As we look to the future, sustainable fashion is not just a trend; it’s a movement towards a more conscious and responsible industry. Here are some exciting developments to watch:

- **Innovative Materials**: New technologies are creating fabrics from unexpected sources, such as mushroom leather and recycled ocean plastics.
- **Circular Fashion**: The concept of a circular economy is gaining traction, where products are designed to be reused, repaired, and recycled, extending their lifecycle.
- **Digital Fashion**: Virtual clothing and digital fashion shows are emerging, reducing the need for physical samples and minimizing waste.
- **Community Engagement**: Brands are engaging with their communities to promote sustainable practices, from swapping events to educational workshops.

## Conclusion

Sustainable fashion is not just about looking good; it’s about feeling good too. By choosing sustainable options, we can express our personal style while contributing to a healthier planet. The future of fashion is bright, and it’s in our hands to shape it responsibly. Let’s embrace sustainable fashion and redefine what it means to be stylish in a conscious world.

---

### Join the Movement!

Are you ready to make a difference? Share your favorite sustainable brands and practices in the comments below! Together, we can inspire change and promote a greener future for fashion. 🌿✨

#SustainableFashion #EcoFriendly #FashionForFuture #ConsciousStyle

<center>  <div class=text-justify>  

_Hace un par de semanas fue el cumpleaños de nuestro amigo y compañero de trabajo Jhonatan y este fin de semana pasado fuimos invitados a la celebración de su cumpleaños en su casa y no dudamos en ir._

>_A couple of weeks ago it was our friend and co-worker Jonathan's birthday, and this past weekend we were invited to his birthday celebration at his house, and we didn't hesitate to go._

_Ademas de nosotros también fueron otros compañeros del trabajo a festejar y la verdad la pasamos muy muy bien. Jhonatan había planeado una parrillada, nosotros llegamos una media hora después y fuimos al supermercado comprar carne y algunas cosas para llevar._

>_Besides us, other coworkers also came to celebrate, and we had a really great time. Jonathan had planned a barbecue; we arrived about half an hour later and went to the supermarket to buy meat and some things to take with us._

_Compartimos, reímos, conversamos y la mayoría hasta bailaron demás, al final de la noche nos reunimos a cantar cumpleaños y como estamos en Brasil primero cantamos el cumpleaños en portugués y después el cumpleaños venezolano, luego repartieron la torta y todos comenzamos a despedirnos para irnos. Fue una noche bastante alegre y de la cual quedaron algunas fotos para recordar._

>_We shared, laughed, talked, and most of us even danced a little too much. At the end of the night, we gathered to sing \
and since we were in Brazil, we first sang \

in Portuguese and then the Venezuelan version. Then they shared the cake, and we all started saying our goodbyes to leave. It was a very joyful night, and we got some photos to remember it by._   ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8MUQ9JXMEENRpercup7dcUR3qxqRwkezc4nbLmd7KwK/sep_hive_nr.jpg)

---

¡Hola, Amiguitos, Papitos y ZoeTubers! Tengo la dicha de compartir el poema: El Salto de Alfredo Espino, nuestro insigne poeta niño y escritor salvadoreño, de su libro de poesía, Casucas, Jícaras Tristes.

El Salto es una obra poética plasmada en óleos de emociones, inspirada en la vida autoctona de la belleza del campo, una poesía escrita con el alma de la palabra y el suspiro aliento de la vida eterna...

Escena regional; urente sol de estío;
una grácil parásita cuelga su escalinata de alas de mariposa,
pájaros de escarlata, en la florida torre del conacaste umbrío.
___

Dedico este poema a todos mis suscriptores fieles e incondicionales que tienen el buen gusto de disfrutar mis poemas y cuentos infantiles, les mando muchas energías positivas y un fuerte abrazo 🤗✨

¡Espero disfruten muchísimo! 😉

---

links.title: MLB: Desatado...  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
links.body:
Imaginamos a William Contreras en la banca de Venezuela durante el Clásico Mundial de Baseball. El aporte de su bate fue mínimo, dado que jugó pocos partidos, habida cuenta de la titularidad indiscutible de Salvador Pérez (quien también aportó poco a la ofensiva). Su orgullo le llevó a tomar cartas en el asunto y un hombre que siempre ha trabajado duro, decidió redoblar las apuestas. Y ha sido increíble ver la evolución de su swing en la medida que cambió su rutina de prácticas y pasó de hacerlas fuera en el campo, a frecuentar más las jaulas de bateo bajo techo. Al menos, así lo reveló su coach. La mejor forma de ver esto es visualizar como ha estado bateando versus los Diamondbacks en la serie que los enfrentó dentro del American Family Field de Milwaukee. Ayer, los lupulosos le dieron una felpa a los ofidios, encabezada por la ardiente ofensiva de los jugadores venezolanos del roster. 7 de las 13 carreras logradas por los Cerveceros, fueron impulsadas con los bates criollos. El tercera base criollo Luis Rengifo fue el otro protagonista al impulsar 3 rayitas: dos con un doble en el propio primer episodio y otra con rola al segunda base en el tercero. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     We saw William Contreras riding the pine for Team Venezuela during the World Baseball Classic. His bat didn't provide much pop since he barely got any PT, with Salvador Pérez locked in as the everyday catcher (who also struggled to find his stroke). Taking that personally, Contreras—a guy known for his grind—decided to double down. It’s been wild to see his swing evolve after he tweaked his routine, moving his work from the field into the indoor cages, according to his coach. The best way to see the payoff is his performance against the D-backs at AmFam Field. Yesterday, the Brew Crew handed the Snakes a total shellacking, fueled by a red-hot Venezuelan offense. 7 of the Brewers' 13 runs were driven in by Venezuelan bats. Third baseman Luis Rengifo also balled out, racking up 3 ribbies: a two-run two-bagger in the first and an RBI groundout in the third.

# ---

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTMP6PsiwFoZSyB2SNsgYfH7W5V4yZErbMLdJMb2LpQDe/William.jpg Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/d-backs-vs-brewers/2026/04/30/823795/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     Volviendo a William, su contribución fue devastadora y sólo le faltó el triple para batear el ciclo. Un doble en el primer inning trajo la primera carrera para abrir el marcador de los lupulosos. Luego, en la baja del tercero, pescó una \

(un lanzamiento que se mueve como una combinación de slider y curva, rompiendo tanto horizontal como verticalmente) a 84 MPH con un hombre en la base, para depositarla en las gradas del jardín central a 419 pies del plato. En el cuarto, bateó un sencillo productor de una. En su siguiente turno recibió pasaporte y ya en el octavo volvió a batear un sencillo para entregar una hoja de anotación donde no fue puesto out. Se fue de 4-4, con tres anotadas, cuatro impulsadas y un boleto. Categórico triunfo de los Cerveceros que los acerca a 3.5 juegos de los Rojos, mientras que los Backs corrieron con suerte ya que Padres y Dodgers no jugaron. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      Back to William: his night was a total clinic, finishing just a triple shy of hitting for the cycle. He started the party with a RBI two-bagger in the first to get the Brew Crew on the board. Then, in the bottom of the third, he sat on an 84 MPH slurve with a runner on and launched a 419-foot moonshot to straightaway center. In the fourth, he added an RBI knock. He took a free pass in his next trip to the dish, and by the eighth, he slapped another single to finish with a perfect night at the plate. He went 4-for-4 with three runs scored, four ribbies, and a walk. This statement win moves the Brewers within 3.5 games of the Reds, while the D-backs caught a break since the Padres and Dodgers had the night off.

# ---

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUQCiwMeV58VZZQ9utqkh9XL6Ux7mwSkKQsACzAymr9Zn/Vargas.jpg Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/d-backs-vs-brewers/2026/04/30/823795/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Sin embargo, no todo fueron malas noticias para los muchachos del desierto. Su compañero más connotado del momento fue una de las pocas luces a su favor. El primera base venezolano Ildemaro Vargas largó un par de cohetes para continuar la racha activa de juegos bateando de hit, más larga del momento en las Mayores. El hombre empató el registro histórico para un venezolano que se encontraba en poder de Willson Ramos establecido en 2019. También se igualó con Paul Goldsmith como la segunda racha más larga de juegos consecutivos bateando de hit. Con los 23 juegos que lleva ésta temporada, ya es dueño de la racha más larga en la historia para un venezolano inciando una campaña (anteriormente en manos de Pablo Sandoval) y empató la tercera más larga iniciando campaña en poder de Edgar Rentería. En cualquiera de los casos, tener una racha de más de 20 juegos bateando de hit, ya es un gran logro en los tiempos modernos, con la evolución indiscutible del pitcheo. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     However, it wasn't all gloom and doom for the Snakes. Their big-name guy right now was one of the few bright spots in the lineup. Venezuelan first baseman Ildemaro Vargas lashed a pair of frozen ropes to keep the longest active hitting streak in the Bigs alive. With that, he tied the all-time mark for a Venezuelan player, matching the record set by Willson Ramos back in 2019. He also pulled even with Paul Goldschmidt for the second-longest streak in franchise history. By stretching it to 23 games this season, he now owns the record for the longest season-opening hitting streak by a Venezuelan (passing Pablo Sandoval) and tied Edgar Rentería for the third-longest start to a campaign ever. Either way, putting up a 20-plus game streak is a massive feat in today’s game, especially with the way pitching has evolved.

---

https://img.leopedia.io/DQma6fbPQ7MAQ4Knmm5n5rpY917kmay2EQjGAiCGR1CBrpr/Arr%C3%A1ez.jpg Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/giants-vs-phillies/2026/04/30/823471/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     En la bahía, finalmente el novel manager de San Francisco ha conseguido el puesto fijo en el line-up, para el segunda base venezolano Luis Arráez: tercer bate. Y si lo ve uno con lógica fría, ese debiera ser el lugar de siempre. Es decir, Luis siempre fue usado como primer bate, sin embargo, el tercer turno de una alineación SIEMPRE debe ser ocupado por el mejor chocador de pelota del equipo (que no jonronero). Esto le permite a un line-up mantener el inning vivo en caso de que se embase el hombre, luego de dos outs, con la finalidad de entregar el turno al jonronero del equipo. Bien, El muchacho anda como pez en el agua, bateando sobre el potro de los .300 (.305) y haciendo lo que sabe hacer: repartir batazos por todos lados del terreno. Pero ésta temporada ha devenido en una característica por la que no era conocido: su defensiva ha mejorado ostensiblemente al brindar 6 outs por encima del promedio. Una estadística que siempre estaba en negativo. Así que \

ha decidido convertirse en un jugador más completo. Bien por él. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Out in The Bay, the Giants' rookie skipper has finally locked in a permanent spot in the lineup card for Venezuelan second baseman Luis Arráez: the three-hole. Looking at it with a cold eye, that’s exactly where he belongs. Arráez has usually been a leadoff guy, but the three-spot should ALWAYS be reserved for your best pure contact hitter (not necessarily the power threat). It keeps the inning alive with two outs, giving the cleanup hitter a chance to do some damage. The kid is in his element, flirting with the .300 mark (.305) and doing what he does best: spraying line drives all over the yard. But this season he’s flashed a tool we didn't see coming: his glove has improved big time, posting a +6 Outs Above Average (OAA). That’s a huge swing for a guy whose defensive metrics were always in the red. It looks like 'The Sprinkler' is evolving into a true complete player. Good for him.

links.title: LANGSA CITY FOREST PARK // Enjoying a peaceful afternoon amidst the lush trees of the charming Langsa City Forest Park
links.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ❤️

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYs6gTTDxsGJChsvviTnWTf3dxmY6X5Ev1a66c2y7EiLk/1777646335907.jpg)

In this post, I will share my experience and moments when I visited Langsa City Forest Park with the aim of recreation and seeking peace in the embrace of nature.This place is always my main destination when I miss nature, especially since this tourist spot is also quite close to the center of Langsa city, if I'm not mistaken the distance is only about 4 kilometers.
At first, I was hesitant to go on this trip,because the weather at that time was very cloudy, of course what I was afraid of was rain, but when I arrived at this place the weather got better.

I can't remember the last time I visited this place, and when I arrived there, this place immediately welcomed me warmly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmapihTKi1hDtu4wBdT4pe5VAchA42itmhKtoEifEa42ky/1777646335967.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9NYRem438kCZqZuyV4Gcgrd7KwMRhBssCh3LU19kL7s/1777646336015.jpg)

It should be noted that Langsa City Forest Park is located within a protected forest area, so this place is quite large and it will take hours to explore it all,but at that time I only visited the main area.However, the entire area of ​​this park is equipped with footpaths so we won't get lost here.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbucEoro52nUkemdzCQTRBf8sge6r78wFZytaAXi4WaE/1777646336092.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGJ9TiVaajEpDWDZN4cXvfH4m2pfgVxgC4Xm6j8Pjkqo/1777646336166.jpg)

Visually,the scenery here looks much the same as it did during my previous visit.There are so many lush trees here that they form a natural canopy providing shade,while the addition of so many ornamental plants and flowers has created a fresh, colorful new landscape.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVSzw3x8PbrjU9mXpeKWYkRQExkbJJLGgFGMBP62EggNg/1777646449557.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmavANkKyp53xwn1U3KxSduq5h22tem8ProCzvsZc6G94t/1777646449652.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrRckidkiABkBdKstsNebgU78PyURfabKn6RQsVArVyp/1777646449747.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRtdKWLihkgdqb9PutEZnigG3hEySXH2Z6zhivQRjg4LB/1777646449850.jpg)

The natural scenery in this place looks so extraordinary and alive, here we can also find so many huts built on each side of the park.Visually, this hut has a simple but elegant traditional design, with a tiered pyramid roof, an open wooden frame.However, what makes it so extraordinary is its strategic location, combined with the lush greenery of the surrounding park.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTA1Lt7rXRaLxVN3QjTtJgYgDcqJ4XZYkTEGPWYabj2Z/1777646449949.jpg)

There is no charge, anyone can sit and relax there. Oh, by the way, this place is located in the highlands, so I can enjoy plenty of views from here

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZ1n2J5aJET4JTc1Ld9aQ3LPiVwAFbMmHEUgt1rJcEVh/1777646493640.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbVdsEwVBDwhhhKsLfCXjGBTHHMp21EhBQrfqdWCfK7S/1777646493742.jpg)

After resting for a while at the hut,I immediately decided to visit the park’s landmark, the welcome monument that reads \

This nameplate monument is located right on the riverbank, facing the suspension bridge that visitors frequently cross, but we need to go down a few steps if we want to see it up close. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW85qFKm3TMaZ13saivD5ki24EqGuDcyoQZYtnNBcnKxc/1777646493819.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQaRLA7hK2cphvJar8cNkSRJ94XrD1XmYoTrSGenyGnPZ/1777646493896.jpg) But it's a shame that this area looks a bit dirty and some letters are missing. The place is beautiful, but I think it still needs to be renovated to make it more attractive. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6g9vt4u8hc4PRVaZ16VNBnaaXEraMw5WLL89AkpoUff/1777646493998.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyLa89h7Tkmc6k21jU4dSNtBEzP9jRmJuU4HNBz7jL5k/1777646569348.jpg) And this is one of the beautiful views that can be enjoyed in this place,namely a lake surrounded by lush trees. However, it is quite unfortunate that the water looks cloudy and yellowish,I’m also not sure whether this is an artificial lake or one formed naturally. Many visitors flock to this area to take photos because it offers a rather beautiful background. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

---- ----

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

Hello 
Splinterlands Lovers !



![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdkeQJsxwRvnNJ2Qf8Pwpbq2dLGWPPsKvDGx8qy3tfV8a/image.png)

[Imgsrc](https://chatgpt.com)

Today, friends, I am going to share with you my experience regarding the season end—specifically, what I managed to achieve here. As you know, Splinterlands is an incredibly popular game; currently, a massive number of people are joining, and the community continues to grow even larger. My season came to an end today, and I managed to accumulate 42,974 Glint. Since I already had some Glint saved up, I decided to purchase a 70,000-Glint Legendary Pack right after the season concluded today. I chose to buy a Legendary Pack because, historically, I have always been fortunate enough to pull a great Legendary card whenever I do so. In this video, I will provide you with all the details regarding this purchase. I spent 70,000 Glint today to acquire this Legendary Pack, and in return, I was lucky enough to pull a truly excellent Legendary card!

![Screenshot 2026-04-30 194157.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxys51jg6EEJF6f91FiJu4PiQx4RfPpBWLMQGVfyZacM/Screenshot%202026-04-30%20194157.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-30 200449.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeonubQ53t1WzxRuqoVB9j3FpjapeSsqmWABn6DBHbL4h/Screenshot%202026-04-30%20200449.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-30 200502.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWXvWdYMkaXmHc1azCzVJKUC6paAaBzGLu7wiEm91M2Ln/Screenshot%202026-04-30%20200502.png)

The card I received here is named Skrag the Warbringer. This is a Legendary card belonging to the Earth Splinter. Currently, the market value of this card stands at $2.49. This specific card features an attack power of 3. It carries a Mana cost of 8. Furthermore, the card boasts 3 Armor, 8 Health, and a Speed ​​of 3. It possesses the \

ability, which inflicts 2 points of damage to the enemy at the end of every round. You can strategically position this card in the first slot of your lineup. Doing so leverages its high Armor stat (specifically 5 points), allowing it to absorb incoming attacks while the rest of your team focuses on targeting the enemy squad. At present, this is considered a highly valuable card within Splinterlands—one that exerts a distinctly positive influence on gameplay. Consequently, when placed in the lead position, this card performs exceptionally well. You can make this card even more formidable by upgrading it to Level 5; it is, without a doubt, a very appealing asset.


![Screenshot 2026-05-01 210245.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZm7zBDpyeYbeKR618LdG5v6pG36vGTKVYZZgtNDUwQnm/Screenshot%202026-05-01%20210245.png)

As I just mentioned, this card becomes an extremely formidable asset at Level 5. At Level 4, \

is an ability that reflects damage back to any melee attackers; this inflicts significant damage upon the enemy. This is a highly desirable card for an Earth Splinter deck. I currently own two copies of it, and I need just one more to upgrade it to Level 2; as soon as I acquire that additional card, I will proceed with the upgrade. Once upgraded, this card will provide me with substantial advantages. My ultimate goal is to raise this card to Level 4, thereby giving me a distinct edge in winning battles.\n\nThank U

## 🍜 The Ultimate Noodle Night: The Peppery Punch vs. The Clear Comfort! 🍲

### 🇬🇧 English Review by Sakol (Kol Tam Pai Rueay)

**What’s up, my fellow flavor hunters!** Sakol here from the *Kol Tam Pai Rueay* channel, and oh boy, do I have a late-night treat that is going to make your stomach rumble! Tonight, we are throwing a massive noodle party, and you are all invited. Put down whatever you are doing because we have a legendary double-feature dinner that hits absolutely every craving imaginable! 

Are you ready? Let’s get slurping!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf1KJpiutaECUpPWrsKuTzRG6eazSM8STWpkZU6gSzTAj/image.png)


**Round 1: The Mighty Kuay Jab (Rolled Rice Noodles in Peppery Broth)**
BAM! We are starting with an absolute flavor explosion! Just looking at this bowl gets my heart racing. You’ve got those iconic rolled rice noodles—like little delicious scrolls holding all the secrets of the universe. And the broth? *Incredible.* It’s packed with that signature black pepper kick that punches you right in the throat in the best possible way! It warms you up from the inside out. Let’s not even get started on the crispy pork on top... you guys know I have a serious weakness for crispy pork! Hearing that *CRUNCH* echoing in my head while the spicy, savory broth coats my tongue is pure late-night nirvana! 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXgNrpY7fkTY7RuV85D59K4MCk9eUB5Lnf2opxe6Syv8q/image.png)


**Round 2: Clear Soup Rice Vermicelli with Pork (Sen Mee Nam Sai Moo)**
Okay, after that intense peppery rollercoaster, we need something to soothe the soul, right? Enter the hero of comfort food: Clear Soup Pork Vermicelli! Don't let the word \

fool you; this broth is simmering with hours of deep, sweet pork bone goodness. The ultra-thin *Sen Mee* noodles soak up the soup beautifully. Throw in some incredibly tender sliced pork, bouncy pork balls, and a generous sprinkle of golden, crispy fried garlic oil, and you have a bowl of pure, unadulterated comfort. It goes down so smooth, it’s basically a warm hug for your stomach before bedtime.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWdKj6QmV19EUujB72q8vpXPJ5M1JPz8bu47NNdPc4LBt/image.png)


**The Sakol Verdict:**
Why choose one when you can conquer both? You get the aggressive, spicy excitement of the Kuay Jab, followed by the sweet, comforting embrace of the Clear Soup Vermicelli. It is the yin and yang of Thai noodles! My belly is full, my soul is happy, and my editing screen is calling me. Until the next meal, keep eating and keep smiling!

links.body:
<div class=text-justify>

Our beliefs and values are one of the core of our existence as humans, it teaches us how to think, how to act, and how to be the person we have envisioned in our hearts to be. It doesn’t matter what a person believes in, it’s nobody's business how a person chooses to live their lives. I mean it’s your life for crying out loud. But then again, why do you think the same law that advocates for human rights also punishes those that take hard drugs? So long a person is caught with the possession of these substances even though they are not selling it,or harming anyone with it they are arrested for possession of these hard drugs. You can not tell the court that you take these drugs but have not harmed anyone with it, or you take it simply because you believe it is what you need to survive. If these drugs do not come with an official medical prescription, you have violated the law in spite of your beliefs.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmegx1wvgAsFUDyh3s2tUKQoCwFpVgFkLMebqc7fZfpjVb/119549.jpg 


<a href=\

>Image by DC Studio on Magnific This goes to show that even though beliefs can be acknowledged, there are boundaries to it. It is your choice to take or not take the covid vaccine, but it becomes the choice of your doctor if you should contact covid. At that point the only choice you have is to die in isolation because if you must go out, then you are definitely taking the vaccine. I have seen a lot of adults who would not take any vaccines for one reason or the other, I for example have refused taking the covid vaccine, not because I do not believe in vaccination, but because of the controversies surrounding it. I have taken other vaccines because they were more direct and understandable. If I paraventure I discover that I stand a huge risk of contracting the virus, my beliefs and values demand that I do so not just for myself but for others. But then, not everyone thinks like this, there are those who reason more selfishly, like a brother who would refuse to donate his blood to his brother because he feels it is a sin. His beliefs might have just sentenced his brother to death. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDUCxsFHMDkYoRaNXkMUUuv9AgBHWz6BTZcGNSYN6ApX/rnfetchblobtmp_fgtcef2qubuke3qlh9re6s.jpg) This is where I think we need to draw the line. Yes everyone has a right to believe what they wish to believe, but if that belief in any way harms members of the public, then it should be seen as a criminal offense. In my opinion a person’s life should be saved regardless of their beliefs, and if a person is not in the right state of mind to make a decision that could change their lives, and it is known that the person does not share the same believe system with their next of kin, then the hospital should do what is in the best interest for that person and not what the next of kin thinks. This is where kids should be protected from beliefs they do not have the ability or capacity to change. If a parent would rather let their kids die than do what is right because of a belief system, the government should be able to take up the responsibility of taking care of that child because a good parent would pick their child’s life over any belief. At the same time, I think people should be enlightened about how certain things should not be allowed in a belief system so as to help religious and traditional people live better lives. >THIS IS MY RESPONSE TO HIVE LEARNER'S [PROMPT](https://discord.com/channels/928986840747372636/929001473231183873/1499666216631926864) FOR WEEK 215 EPISODE 3 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqbQGFerHXinrqqmfCGrRHtwdZRhqAtCVWMna3geK2vc/20230716_224852_0000.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@kilvnrex/drawing-a-thin-line-5ga)

links.title: ​Impeccable Spaces, High-Level Service | Espacios impecables, servicio de altura
links.body: > Hospitality is a discipline where visual language speaks louder than words. Today, my day was focused on those aesthetic details that elevate the atmosphere of the restaurant. There is a silent satisfaction in transforming a functional space into an elegant setting, and it all starts with the manual work we do before the first guest walks through the door. # One of the tasks I enjoy the most is preparing the towels and linens for the plates. Using specific techniques to give them creative shapes isn't just about utility; it’s about presentation. Placing those stylized linens on the plates adds a touch of distinction that changes the entire look of the table. Along with this, I spent time polishing the glassware and arranging the cutlery with total precision. When everything is aligned, from the napkins to the last glass, the dining room feels ready for a high-level service. # The organization continued behind the scenes and in the outdoor areas. I made sure the refrigerator was completely restocked and perfectly ordered, which is essential for a smooth workflow during the rush. I also spent time on the terrace, adjusting the tables to ensure the environment felt open and welcoming. Finally, I left the coffee station impeccable, with the espresso machine clean and ready to go. # Taking care of these elements is what ensures that the service flows naturally. When the environment is in order and every detail is in its place, we can focus entirely on providing excellent hospitality. It was a productive day dedicated to the art of keeping everything impeccable. # Thank you for following my journey in the world of hospitality. See you next time!

> La hospitalidad es una disciplina donde el lenguaje visual habla más que las palabras. Hoy, mi día estuvo centrado en esos detalles estéticos que elevan la atmósfera del restaurante. Hay una satisfacción silenciosa en transformar un espacio funcional en un escenario elegante, y todo comienza con el trabajo manual que realizamos antes de que el primer comitente cruce la puerta. # Una de las tareas que más disfruto es la preparación de los paños y servilletas para los platos. Utilizar técnicas específicas para darles formas creativas no es solo cuestión de utilidad; es cuestión de presentación. Colocar esos paños estilizados sobre los platos añade un toque de distinción que cambia toda la imagen de la mesa. Junto a esto, dediqué tiempo a pulir la cristalería y organizar los cubiertos con total precisión. Cuando todo está alineado, desde la lencería hasta la última copa, el salón se siente listo para un servicio de altura. # La organización continuó tras bastidores y en las áreas externas. Me aseguré de que la nevera quedara totalmente surtida y en perfecto orden, algo fundamental para que el flujo de trabajo sea fluido durante el ajetreo. También dediqué tiempo a la terraza, ajustando las mesas para garantizar que el ambiente se sintiera abierto y acogedor. Finalmente, dejé la estación de café impecable, con la cafetera limpia y lista para entrar en acción. # Cuidar estos elementos es lo que garantiza que el servicio fluya con naturalidad. Cuando el entorno está en orden y cada detalle en su sitio, podemos enfocarnos totalmente en brindar una excelente atención. Fue un día productivo dedicado al arte de mantener todo impecable. # ¡Gracias por acompañarme en mi día a día en el mundo de la hospitalidad! ¡Hasta la próxima! ------ ---- |

links.title: Homemade Snickers
links.body:
Learn how to make amazing homemade Snickers. If you love chocolate, nougat, peanuts, and caramel, you are going to love this [homemade Snickers recipe](https://www.inthekitchenwithmatt.com/homemade-snickers). I even like them better than the real thing! 

**Ingredients**
Homemade Nougat
- 1 large egg only using the egg white
- 2/3 cup of sugar 134g
- 1/4 tsp of salt 1g
- 1 Tbsp of water 15ml
- 1/3 cup of corn syrup 110g

Caramel Nut Filling
- 30 Kraft caramels or 3/4 cup of melted [homemade caramel](https://www.inthekitchenwithmatt.com/homemade-caramel-apples) 248g
- 1 1/2 Tbsp of cream half and half, or whole milk (20ml)
- 3/4 cup of lightly salted roasted peanuts or plain roasted (100g)

Chocolate Coating
- 1 cup of milk chocolate chips 170g
- 1 cup of chocolate candy coating 225g

links.title: Breaking Up Isn't Hard To Do
links.body:
In my second half-century of life few things are easier to do than getting rid of crap I don’t need. After moving residences a total of twelve times in my adult life I view possessions I don’t use on a daily basis as a complete burden. 

Around the start of 2026 I started liquidating all this stuff I don’t need on eBay. Just yesterday I listed my 1961 Selmer Bb Clarinet on eBay [(Here’s the ad)](https://www.ebay.com/itm/327131896503). I played my original clarinet in stage, marching, and jazz bands from the sixth grade until my junior year in high school. It was a beginner resin-body instrument that my parents paid off in installments from Coyle Music in Columbus. 

<center> ![Clarinet1.jpg](1) </center>


It wasn’t until I reached my 40’s that I could afford a professional-quality instrument. This Selmer Series 9 is French-made and it’s a fairly well-known model and it rekindled my desire to play. It was referred to as a \

clarinet. It was one of a few vintage Selmer Paris models (mostly from the mid-20th century) that featured a larger-than-average bore diameter. This larger interior volume produces a bigger, fuller, darker, and more powerful sound with greater projection and easier response in the altissimo register compared to narrower-bore clarinets. It was, and still is, sought after by jazz musicians for its ability to be heard over trumpets and saxes. It’s an absolute joy to play and was a dream come true to own. 


<center> ![C2.jpg](1) </center>

Somehow time moved on, life happened, and I started playing the guitar more and the clarinet less and less. I realized the other day that after moving into this new house in the autumn of 2024 it hadn’t been out of the case once since we moved in. It was then I decided to set it free to allow the next person to enjoy it. 

The instant I clicked \

on eBay I felt a wave of relief to know I'd be shedding one more thing I didn't use. That's how I know it was the right decision. 

<center> ![ebay.jpeg](1) </center>

I don't know if this happens in other parts of the world but Americans, in particular, are bad about hoarding possessions. Public Storage businesses are listed as the least risky business to start for a reason. I just watched the relatives of a deceased neighbor across the street spend a solid two months moving things out of the house readying it for the real estate market. It was nearly inconceivable how many truckloads of stuff they loaded up and carted away. It reminded me of watching those dozens of clowns pile out of the tiny car in the circus. 

After moving twelve times, average of once every 2-3 years, I'm always looking to lighten my load. 

The only question in my mind is—*What's next?* Breaking up isn't hard to do. 

*NOTE: For some reason pictures aren't loading in PeakD again (error 500) so I'll try uploading them again a little later today.* 


All for now. Enjoy your weekend and thanks so much for reading.

links.title: Argentina - A short trip into the interior of Corrientes: visiting the peaceful town of Santa Ana. / Un pequeño paseo al interior de Corrientes: visitando el tranquilo pueblo de Santa Ana. 😃❤️
links.body:
> One thing I like to do when I’m traveling somewhere interesting is to explore a bit beyond the city center. Luckily, during my stay in Corrientes, Gabi and Luis arranged for one of their uncles to take us on a drive, with the goal of seeing some of the surrounding areas. Along the way, we made it to Santa Ana, a small town where tranquility prevailed, yet it was still quite picturesque, perfect for getting some great photos for our Hive pages 😃.
Algo que me gusta hacer cuando estoy de viaje en algún lugar interesante, es pasear un poco más allá del centro de la ciudad. Por suerte, durante mi estadía en Corrientes, Gabi y Luis consiguieron que un tío de ellos pudiera llevarnos a pasear en su auto, con el objetivo de ver un poco los alrededores de la ciudad. En nuestro camino, pudimos llegar hasta Santa Ana, un pequeño pueblo en donde reinaba la tranquilidad, pero no por eso dejaba de ser pintoresco, perfecto para obtener unas buenas fotos para nuestras páginas de Hive 😃.
--- ---

> --- --- On the day we planned to go for a drive with their uncle, we left very early to make the most of the afternoon. First, we traveled 20 km to the town of Santa Ana, where we made our first stop to explore the area a bit. It was a very quiet neighborhood, with low, old houses, but with a very clean atmosphere. We didn’t come across anyone along the way—it almost felt like a ghost town.
El día que planeamos pasear con el tío en su auto, salimos muy temprano para poder aprovechar bien toda la tarde. En primer lugar, viajamos 20 km hasta el pueblo de Santa Ana, en donde hicimos una primera parada para recorrer un poco el lugar. Se trataba de barrio muy tranquilo y de casas bajas y antiguas, pero con un ambiente muy limpio. No nos cruzamos a nadie en nuestro paso: casi parecía un pueblo fantasma.
---
![IMG_20250521_132334601~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23wWw7YHnaNzv3EpfkZssDGeaZEWQYgonFenHeWUAZnbj7wZtT69PxXB6is2Lg7Dv4DYv.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_140309555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/244A2TYXdcVn4LBSpNeeY1e8QkeZFUBfskWtJ1z6i7yazyF8SP6Xf7L22DWKyH2A7ha1E.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_143251346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23zbMPHm1nEQo12tnhdyogmRCFc7NsFEAPmXQWbkQ7GgtfeEkHqCkyMK4YKZnuTboVywT.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_142030431.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23zkkG8QrMgEgs1PTmSnp8ncyQE4Aiiq5pYqJiLT9gBiWcDqeqpHYZoGbWT6uQQ5i3ZAB.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_141850361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/2432HY7urgy6WtXUiNLRhaDv52d3xagx8A9jPMY2CS3e9tbUH5x8wi1ymPN4C6LXiQMwp.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_142827501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/243qF8qZAWibfVV8ZtQUbauSabwkzBPU8c66xeRxwH3k6Pdixdy6LEprqUPQ4HQA3mHep.jpg)
--- The houses in the town of Santa Ana were typical of the colonial era, and around the main square you could find a church, a cultural center, and a school. Getting away from the noise of the city to find the calm of a town like this was very rewarding. Also, seeing the contrast between the tall buildings in the city center and the small houses in this place was a great way to experience two different sides of Corrientes.
Las casas del pueblo de Santa Ana eran típicas de la época colonial, y en los alrededores de la plaza principal se podían encontrar una iglesia, una casa de la cultura y una escuela. Alejarse un poco del ruido de la ciudad para encontrar la calma de un pueblo como este fue muy gratificante. Además, ver el contraste de los edificios altos del centro, con las casas pequeñas de este lugar fue bueno para tener dos postales diferentes de Corrientes.
---
![IMG_20250521_141854279.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/243M3HqxmzjvnTHpRaG4L2SLgqg6uVgcAhyLudDgbmHsxVrLXbCtznuXG5oRpJ1rDv9me.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_140433412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23z7BFsHZXyPvCvXL7sc1ojXTqth6ALTsNhbrnj6uxwKdcKmsCBFggyK9GvMApBa9Xgbw.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_140258553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23vhwnTyG33WMmgnT1GhKttLw1t3b7j8xr4HGfwvtZENibH7VXDnkaMuTa6sXaA5tANVK.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_143738976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23u5y2J47vwjBJYv8skhLoEk8cabboDsCW5PN1FP5K2UoRfFcmxtn1MWcKknrhk1QDNiN.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_141652630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23xVEmngheqhkCRNMsyfBdg7wJkcMbG9TihkuUyPFPspLZZXA7xRoQZwELMZCi6bAr5jN.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_141817086.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23xp4FMA2L84c1oFKG1rcAA9KaDvDs7S23Ubc5oJQhSPaGdtBHZVi1xnMDnWe7Ved7nWq.jpg)
--- The square was also very well maintained, with playground equipment in good condition and well-preserved monuments. It was the typical small-town square, where in the afternoons more people probably gather to drink mate. At the time of our visit, everything was quiet, but that allowed us to have the whole square to ourselves. Of course, we all took photos for our blogs 😃.
La plaza también estaba muy bien conservada, con juegos en bien estado y monumentos bien conservados. Esta era la típica plaza de pueblo chico, en donde seguramente por las tardes quizás se acerca más gente a tomar mates. Para el momento de nuestra visita, todo era silencio, pero eso nos permitió tener toda la plaza para nosotros. Por supuesto todos sacamos fotos para nuestros blogs 😃.
---
![IMG_20250521_140319677.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/242DC8DUFix1UkBZuWTuwVUTbTnN37abGB6kXoQCwKNsozpxsqSRUqDphE4uyjofg49zp.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_142640766.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23xyLU8bHfyYf27og5X9JGo3qj9D1F6jWJ5Wtjw8yhmzFjBAdWz7TPxYQLzYZetgW4AUR.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_140609590.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23wgDF2hkwt6Uhed1WSyGTf6darEmThgmmu1gj6fFhyihcnVEGEUjyHMgBwEDo6pyjpTt.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_142535072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23wqg3q12q59WjF2ee6wkhCxAnspMad6paZmqDkXrYnMd9pzYsfFygXtURM7rdMWZkv4y.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_142749312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23zGcZYRpHzLUa7qiJL9qhcr5g1451PUh9rYqwuGvat1s9QKcS1qWvLY8a5DVtVMWkiYJ.jpg)
--- Without a doubt, one of the most beautiful parts of this town was the Church of Santa Ana. It was a very small but well-kept local church. Luckily for us, the doors were open, so we were able to go inside and see what it was like. Inside, it was also very lovely and well maintained—it’s clear that the people who live here love their town and take good care of everything. I was glad to have been able to see it up close.
Sin dudas, una de las partes más lindas de este pueblo fue la Iglesia de Santa Ana. Se trataba de una muy pequeña, pero bien cuidada, iglesia local. Para nuestra suerte, las puertas estaban abiertas así que pudimos entrar a ver cómo era. Adentro también era muy linda y bien cuidada: se nota que las personas que viven acá aman su lugar y tienen todo en buenas condiciones. Me alegré por haber podido ver un poco más de cerca.
---
![IMG_20250521_140647981.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23yJEhTsMDTpaM1iTTyTzhUUyCZCvXWGenpJBrJoc7Lfrw1A91yDPPj3dieoXPq5mqjaM.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_141033519.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23wWuAkVMNiCMofG5NPA97YdsgVEnAn9aQ1hGQ3EVomgC5jD7t3RjWrNuHn1JmM1bXYzZ.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_141010350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23wWtdPNoorAe3yztXixwN737t4r2UTpJjhUuJ5UtjQWXevtSTRmWFHVRAMJvfHbq8YaC.jpg) ![IMG_20250521_140838580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lauramica/23uFPL8TrACBE2W6BRi2teJgM2KW1t9F4Zh7TPabJW9KMKmvrgJHWbEMW77TcJnGABUEz.jpg)
--- After walking around the town’s streets for a while, we continued our route a bit further. We had planned a picnic for that day, but we still had some traveling to do before seeing everything we had in mind. Having their uncle and his car was great, because he kindly took us around while sharing interesting facts about the places we passed. I really enjoyed spending the day with them and how much they committed to making my visit to the province of Corrientes special ❤️.
Después de dar algunas vueltas por las calles del pueblo, continuamos nuestra ruta un poco más allá. Teníamos preparado un picnic para ese día, pero todavía faltaba viajar un poco más para poder ver todo lo que teníamos planeado. Contar con el tío y su vehículo fue genial, porque él amablemente nos llevó a pasear, al mismo tiempo que nos iba contando curiosidades de los lugares que veíamos. Me gustó mucho haber compartido el día con ellos y que se hayan comprometido tanto conmigo y mi visita a la provincia de Corrientes ❤️.
--- ---

❤️ Hope you liked this post! Thanks for reading. ❤️

❤️¡Espero que les haya gustado este post! Gracias por leer. ❤️
---

links.body: LIQUID 👁 EYE, my take: AI does both, and the side that wins depends on who controls the feedback loop. It undermines democracy when it floods the system with cheap persuasion, synthetic consensus, and bullshit at industrial scale, which is exactly the danger flagged in [The AI Democracy Dilemma](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/articles/the-ai-democracy-dilemma/) and [Carnegie’s AI and Democracy analysis](https://carnegieendowment.org/research/2026/01/ai-and-democracy-mapping-the-intersections).  \n\nBut it can also strengthen self-correction if it’s used to widen access to information, surface tradeoffs, and help citizens deliberate better instead of react faster; that’s the more hopeful case laid out in [UNESCO’s AI and Democracy report](https://2mind.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Unesco_AI-Democracy_2024.pdf). The problem is that platforms usually reward speed, outrage, and scale, so absent good rules, AI probably tilts toward destabilizing democratic correction rather than improving it. On InLeo, people are already wrestling with the human-vs-machine side of that tension in posts like [this AI discussion](https://inleo.io/@cindynancy/artificial-intelligence-cant-replace-human-value).

Madrugada es la expresión pictórica que nos describe la belleza y el paisaje del campo, entre el canto de las aves y el gemido de los animales, el lenguaje de la vida se mezcla para contarnos las metáforas extraordinarias de la creación divina.

Amaneciendo.., lejos aletea
el gallo melancólico... Una franja
de suave rosicler y de naranja
se inicia sobre el cerro de la aldea...
___

Dedico este poema a todos mis suscriptores fieles e incondicionales que tienen el buen gusto de disfrutar mis poemas y cuentos infantiles, les mando muchas energías positivas y un fuerte abrazo 🤗✨

¡Espero disfruten muchísimo! 😉

links.title: Small Space, Big Impact: Luxury Vinyl Tile Ideas to Make Rooms Look Larger
links.body:
Designing a small space comes with unique challenges, especially when trying to balance functionality with visual appeal. In homes across Fairhaven, Massachusetts, where a mix of historic charm and modern living often results in compact layouts, flooring plays a critical role in shaping how a room feels. [Luxury Vinyl Tile](https://tilecraftpro.com/vinyl-and-laminate/), commonly known as LVT, has emerged as one of the most effective flooring solutions for maximizing space while maintaining a high-end aesthetic.

LVT is not only versatile and durable but also capable of transforming the perception of a room’s size through thoughtful design choices. By selecting the right patterns, colors, and layouts, homeowners can create the illusion of a larger, more open environment without the need for structural changes.



![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/28b811299a844f61219392a6cddb5e8e81c5b90827d41d9ecd83e2596bbf857a)



## Why Luxury Vinyl Tile Works Well in Small Spaces

Luxury Vinyl Tile has gained popularity in Fairhaven homes for its ability to combine style with practicality. Unlike traditional flooring materials, LVT is designed to replicate the appearance of natural wood, stone, or ceramic while offering enhanced durability and water resistance. This makes it particularly suitable for areas such as kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces where both aesthetics and functionality are important.

In smaller rooms, the visual continuity provided by LVT can make a significant difference. Its smooth finish and wide range of design options allow homeowners to create cohesive spaces that feel less confined. The material’s adaptability also means it can be installed in various patterns that enhance the perception of space.

## Choosing Light and Neutral Tones for Openness

Color plays a crucial role in how a room is perceived. Light and neutral tones are known for their ability to reflect natural light, making spaces feel brighter and more expansive. In Fairhaven, where natural light can vary depending on the season, selecting the right flooring color can help maintain a consistent sense of openness throughout the year.

LVT options in shades such as soft oak, light gray, and warm beige are particularly effective in small spaces. These tones create a clean and airy look that reduces visual clutter and enhances the overall flow of a room. By avoiding overly dark or heavily patterned designs, homeowners can achieve a more spacious and inviting atmosphere.

## Using Plank Direction to Influence Room Perception

The direction in which flooring is installed can significantly impact how a room is perceived. With Luxury Vinyl Tile, plank orientation can be used strategically to make a space appear longer or wider. Installing planks parallel to the longest wall can elongate the room, while diagonal installation can add depth and visual interest.

In Fairhaven homes with narrow layouts, this technique can be particularly effective. By aligning the flooring with the natural shape of the room, homeowners can create a sense of balance and proportion that enhances the overall design.

## Seamless Transitions Between Rooms

One of the most effective ways to make a home feel larger is to create a seamless flow between rooms. Using the same LVT flooring throughout multiple areas eliminates visual breaks and allows the eye to move continuously from one space to another.

In smaller Fairhaven homes, where rooms may be closely connected, this approach can significantly enhance the sense of openness. Consistent flooring not only improves visual continuity but also creates a more cohesive and modern interior design.

## Minimal Grout Lines and Clean Finishes

Unlike traditional tile flooring, Luxury Vinyl Tile often features minimal or no grout lines, which contributes to a cleaner and more streamlined appearance. This lack of interruption allows the flooring to appear as a continuous surface, making the room feel larger and less segmented.

In areas where traditional tiles might create a grid-like effect, LVT offers a smoother alternative that enhances the perception of space. This is especially beneficial in bathrooms and kitchens, where maintaining a clean and uncluttered look is essential.

## Reflective Surfaces and Subtle Textures

While LVT typically has a matte finish, certain styles incorporate subtle textures or light-reflective properties that can enhance the brightness of a room. These finishes help distribute light more evenly, reducing shadows and creating a more open feel.

In Fairhaven homes, where natural light may be limited during certain times of the year, choosing LVT with light-enhancing properties can make a noticeable difference. The right finish can add depth and dimension without overwhelming the space.

## Avoiding Overly Complex Patterns

While intricate patterns can be visually appealing, they can also make small spaces feel crowded and busy. Simpler designs tend to work better in compact areas, as they create a sense of order and calm.

Luxury Vinyl Tile offers a wide range of subtle patterns that mimic natural materials without overpowering the room. In Fairhaven interiors, where a balance between traditional and modern design is often desired, these understated options can provide the perfect solution.

## Combining Functionality with Style

Beyond aesthetics, LVT offers practical benefits that make it an ideal choice for small spaces. Its durability ensures that it can withstand daily wear and tear, while its water-resistant properties make it suitable for areas prone to moisture.

For homeowners in Fairhaven, where seasonal changes can affect indoor conditions, having a reliable flooring option is essential. LVT provides the flexibility to maintain both style and functionality, making it a smart investment for long-term use.

## The Role of Professional Installation

Achieving the full benefits of Luxury Vinyl Tile requires proper installation. Even the best design choices can fall short if the flooring is not installed correctly. Professional installation ensures that planks are aligned properly, transitions are seamless, and the overall finish meets high standards.

In Fairhaven, working with experienced flooring professionals can help homeowners maximize the impact of their LVT investment. Proper installation not only enhances the appearance of the flooring but also contributes to its durability and performance.

## Long-Term Value for Fairhaven Homes

Investing in Luxury Vinyl Tile is not just about improving the look of a space; it is also about adding value to the home. Well-designed and properly installed flooring can make a property more appealing to potential buyers and increase its overall market value.

In a community like Fairhaven, where both aesthetics and practicality are important, LVT offers a versatile solution that meets the needs of modern homeowners. Its ability to enhance small spaces while providing long-lasting performance makes it a valuable addition to any home.

## Final Thoughts

Creating the illusion of space in smaller rooms does not require major renovations. With the right approach to flooring, homeowners can achieve a significant transformation. Luxury Vinyl Tile provides a unique combination of design flexibility, durability, and visual appeal that makes it an excellent choice for compact spaces.

In Fairhaven, MA, where homes often reflect a blend of history and modern living, LVT offers a practical and stylish way to enhance interiors. By focusing on light tones, strategic layouts, and seamless design, it is possible to make even the smallest rooms feel open, comfortable, and inviting.

---

links.title: Tonada Mix
links.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Tonada Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/f9df8c1e-4de7-4d0d-9f69-c190b0158202.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/sCLfi1FAQaaySLttmwVxDJ) 
 
 Cuando uno se sienta frente al piano o afina la guitarra para abordar este repertorio, lo primero que golpea no es la técnica, sino la atmósfera. La tonada andaluza no nació en un conservatorio ni bajo la luz fría de los focos; surgió del polvo de los caminos, del humo de las tabernas y de esa necesidad visceral de contar lo que duele o lo que alegra sin necesidad de gritarlo. 

A finales del siglo XIX y principios del XX, Andalucía era un crisol donde lo popular y lo culto chocaban constantemente. Los compositores de la época, muchos de ellos formados en el rigor del clasicismo europeo, sentían una atracción magnética hacia los aires de su tierra. No se trataba simplemente de copiar una seguidilla o una soleá, sino de integrar esa esencia modal, esas escalas que huele a azahar y a tierra mojada, dentro de estructuras más amplias, más cercanas a la canción romántica o al lied alemán. 

Hay algo profundamente humano en la forma en que este estilo maneja el tiempo. A diferencia de la rigidez métrica de otras formas clásicas, la tonada andaluza respira. El intérprete debe entender que el compás es una sugerencia, no una ley. Al tocarla, se siente esa libertad rítmica heredada del cante jondo, ese rubato natural que permite que la nota se estire hasta el límite de la tensión antes de caer, suavemente, en la resolución. Es un ejercicio de equilibrio constante entre la disciplina técnica y la entrega emocional. 

La evolución del género también refleja los cambios sociales de España. Durante la posguerra, la tonada sufrió una transformación, volviéndose a veces más conservadora, más encorsetada, como buscando refugio en una identidad idealizada. Pero incluso en esos momentos de mayor rigidez, siempre hubo voces que mantuvieron viva la llama de la autenticidad. Cantantes y músicos que entendían que la verdadera \

no estaba en los tópicos folclóricos, sino en la profundidad de la expresión. 

Escuchar una buena interpretación de una tonada andaluza es presenciar un acto de intimidad compartida. No importa si es una pieza de Falla, de Turina o de autores menos conocidos que bebieron de la misma fuente; el objetivo final es conectar. El músico no está allí para demostrar cuántas notas puede tocar por segundo, sino para traducir un sentimiento colectivo en sonido individual. 

Esa melodía que parece flotar entre el aire seco y la sombra de los patios no se quedó encerrada en las partituras; se filtró, como el agua en la tierra agrietada, hacia otras formas de expresión artística. En la literatura, especialmente en la poesía de la Generación del 27, la tonada andaluza dejó una huella indeleble. No es casualidad que Federico García Lorca, además de poeta, fuera un pianista consumado que entendía la música desde las entrañas. Sus versos tienen ritmo de copla, esa cadencia quebrada que imita el llanto o el suspiro. Cuando leemos a Lorca, a Alberti o a Cernuda, no solo vemos imágenes, escuchamos una musicalidad interna que bebe directamente de ese folclore estilizado. 

El cine, por su parte, capturó esa esencia visual y sonora con una intensidad que a veces rozaba el estereotipo, pero que en sus mejores momentos logró una profundidad conmovedora. Las películas de la época dorada del cine español, esas producciones en blanco y negro llenas de claroscuros, utilizaban la tonada no como mero acompañamiento, sino como narradora. La música dictaba el tempo de la mirada de los actores, marcaba la tensión de un encuentro amoroso o la soledad de un personaje errante. Directores como Carlos Saura, décadas más tarde, supieron despojar a esta estética de su polvo costumbrista para revelar su esqueleto emocional, usando la música tradicional como columna vertebral de historias universales. En la pantalla, la tonada andaluza se convirtió en el sonido de la memoria, evocando un pasado que quizás nunca existió tal cual se mostraba, pero que se sentía auténtico en su dolor y su belleza.

Incluso la moda, ese lenguaje superficial que a menudo se critica por su frivolidad, bebió de esta fuente. El traje de flamenca, que originalmente era la vestimenta de las ferias y las clases trabajadoras, fue elevado a categoría de alta costura gracias a la influencia cultural que irradiaba este mundo artístico. Diseñadores como Balenciaga o, más recientemente, creadores contemporáneos, han encontrado en los volantes, los lunares y los tejidos vibrantes una inspiración que trasciende lo regional. La silueta marcada, el drama del movimiento al caminar, la elegancia austera mezclada con el exceso decorativo, todo ello refleja la misma tensión que existe en la música: la contención frente a la explosión. Vestir con esa influencia no es solo ponerse una prenda, es adoptar una actitud, una manera de habitar el espacio con la misma dignidad teatral que exige una interpretación musical seria.

Y si miramos hacia otros estilos musicales, la influencia es aún más vasta y sorprendente. El jazz, ese otro gran idioma de la improvisación y el sentimiento, encontró en la tonada andaluza un espejo lejano pero reconocible. Músicos como Chano Domínguez o Paco de Lucía demostraron que las escalas frigias y los ritmos complejos de Andalucía podían dialogar perfectamente con el bebop o el cool jazz. No se trata de una fusión forzada, sino de un reconocimiento mutuo: ambas tradiciones valoran la expresión individual dentro de un marco colectivo, el error convertido en virtud, la nota azul que duele y sana a la vez. Incluso en el pop y el rock contemporáneo, hay ecos de esa melodía lírica, de esa forma de construir estribillos que se clavan en el alma. Artistas internacionales han sampleado voces antiguas o han adapt progresiones armónicas que, sin saberlo, llevan el ADN de aquellas canciones de taberna y salón.


Lo que demuestra la verdadera fuerza de la tonada andaluza no es su pureza, sino su capacidad de mestizaje. Ha viajado más allá de sus fronteras geográficas y genéricas porque toca algo fundamental en la experiencia humana: la necesidad de embellecer el sufrimiento y de celebrar la vida con una cierta melancolía. Ya sea en un verso, en un plano de cine, en un vestido de gala o en un solo de saxofón, esa esencia perdura, adaptándose, transformándose, pero manteniendo siempre ese núcleo emocional que la hizo nacer. 

Considerar la tonada andaluza simplemente como un género musical sería reducir su verdadera magnitud; se trata, en esencia, de un pilar fundamental sobre el que se ha construido gran parte de la identidad cultural española contemporánea. No es solo una colección de canciones, sino un archivo vivo de la memoria colectiva, un espejo donde una sociedad entera se ha mirado para entender sus contradicciones, sus alegrías y sus duelos. Como hito cultural, representa el momento exacto en que lo local dejó de ser provinciano para convertirse en universal, demostrando que las raíces más profundas son las que mejor sostienen las ramas más altas. Fue el vehículo a través del cual Andalucía, y por extensión España, negoció su lugar en la modernidad sin renunciar a su alma, creando un puente entre la tradición oral de los siglos pasados y la industria cultural del siglo XX.

Este fenómeno trascendió las clases sociales de una manera que pocos movimientos artísticos han logrado. En los salones burgueses de Madrid o París, la tonada era símbolo de exotismo refinado y elegancia; en los barrios populares, era el consuelo diario y la banda sonora de las fiestas. Esa dualidad permitió que el estilo actuara como un agente cohesionador, diluyendo temporalmente las barreras rígidas de la estratificación social. Cuando una melodía podía ser interpretada con igual maestría por una soprano de ópera y por una cantaora de barrio, aunque con matices distintos, se estaba produciendo un intercambio cultural silencioso pero poderoso. 

Además, su impacto como hito radica en su capacidad de resistencia y adaptación frente a los cambios políticos y sociales turbulentos. Durante periodos de censura o de imposición de identidades nacionales homogéneas, la tonada andaluza sirvió a menudo como refugio para la expresión individual y regional. Mantuvo vivas ciertas formas de sensibilidad, ciertos giros lingüísticos y ciertas actitudes vitales que podrían haberse perdido bajo la presión de la uniformidad. Al preservar estas nuances, actuó como guardian de una diversidad cultural que hoy valoramos como patrimonio inmaterial. 

En el contexto global, la tonada andaluza contribuyó decisivamente a la imagen que el mundo tiene de la cultura hispánica. Antes de la explosión turística masiva, ya existía esta embajadora sonora que viajaba en discos, en partituras y en las giras de artistas internacionales. Configuró imaginarios, sí, a veces cargados de tópicos, pero también abrió puertas para que otras expresiones artísticas españolas fueran tomadas en serio. 

Hoy, mirar hacia la tonada andaluza como hito cultural implica reconocer que no es una reliquia estática, sino un proceso continuo de reinvención. Cada nueva generación de músicos, escritores y creadores que se acerca a este material no lo hace desde la arqueología, sino desde la necesidad de encontrar voces propias en un mundo globalizado. En una era donde la digitalización tiende a homogeneizar los gustos, la tonada ofrece un anclaje a la humanidad tangible, a la imperfección cálida de la voz humana y al instrumento acústico. Su legado no está solo en lo que fue, sino en lo que sigue provocando: una reflexión sobre quiénes somos, de dónde venimos y cómo podemos expresar nuestra singularidad sin aislarnos del resto del mundo. Es, en definitiva, una lección perdurable sobre la importancia de cuidar las raíces para poder volar alto.

Es todo por hoy.

Disfruten del mix que les comparto, esta vez, sin voz, solo instrumental.

links.title: Insist On It [Fiction]
links.body:
/>\[divider curl .webp\](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

<div class=text-justify>

The café wasn't crowded. He sat by the glass window, relaxed, savouring every sip of coffee from his mug, unaware of my gaze. A curl of dark brown hair fell across one eye, giving him a look that many mistook for innocence. They didn't know he was a depraved sadist.

Three months into her dream job and my woman was losing weight already. She loved to dress up people—models particularly—and was perfect at it. \*Louis Korr\* was a high fashion empire and her talent elevated them above their competitors.

Lucien Korr, the CEO, constantly put down my wife, finding fault with her work. Yet when the positive reviews came in, it was his name they mentioned, not Ashley Valenti. She came home often in tears. She deserved respect like any staff and I told her to \*insist on it.\*

My wife knew my dark past but not everything. There are parts of me that don't belong in daylight so I keep them from her and only let them surface when pushed too far.

That night, when Lucien stepped into his car and it pulled away, I followed. He turned onto an isolated stretch of freeway. I sped ahead, overtook him and spun my car around to block the way. His car screeched to a halt a few feet from mine.

I stepped out and walked towards his car with a gun in my hand. His driver raised his hands in surrender while the bastard swore loudly in the back seat, something about firing the driver and killing his family if he didn't find a way to get him out of there.

I waved the gun at the driver. “Unlock the doors.” He obeyed and I got into the passenger seat with Lucien, pointing another gun at him. He was visibly trembling, his eyes bulging and breathing uneven.

We spoke for ten minutes and it was not a negotiation. I explained in clear terms what would happen if he didn't change his attitude towards my Ashley. Certain people would become aware of his stepbrother's laundering activities and his mother's private indulgences. That last part drained the colour from his face.

“Who are you?” He stuttered.

He would investigate me, as he should, and find nothing. I replied calmly, “I'm watching you, Lucien Korr. You don't want to cross me.”

The next night, a candlelit dinner was waiting when Ashley came home. She was smiling from ear to ear, looking absolutely gorgeous.

“Darling, you wouldn't believe it. I didn't either, at first. Lucien was so nice to me today. He apologised.”

I held and kissed her on the forehead. She closed her eyes, leaning into me with a deep sigh. That was what I wanted for my woman—happiness and calm. Anyone who disrupted that would know what kind of man loved her.

!\[divider curl .webp\](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

links.title: El invitado de la madrugada / The midnight guest
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTSnzVYdegTXJHuWBK3FR2EG44ZoE9V5BsK2YpVq1Toyy/1777648897214.jpg)
Nunca le conté esto a nadie porque suena ridículo… pero me sigue pasando.
​Trabajo desde casa, así que paso casi todo el día solo. Hace unas semanas empecé a notar que algunas cosas no estaban donde las dejaba. Mi celular aparecía en otra mesa, las llaves en el suelo… cosas así.
​Pensé que estaba distraído.
​Un día decidí probar algo. Antes de dormir, puse mi laptop grabando apuntando hacia la sala. Solo por curiosidad.
​A la mañana siguiente revisé el video.
​Las primeras horas, nada. Todo normal.
​Hasta las 3:17 a.m.
​En el video se ve claramente cómo la puerta de mi cuarto se abre despacio. Y salgo yo.
​Caminando lento, raro… como si no estuviera despierto. Me paro en medio de la sala, mirando fijo hacia la cámara. No me muevo por casi dos minutos.
​Y luego sonrío.
​Pero no es una sonrisa normal… es demasiado abierta, demasiado tensa.
​Después me acerco a la laptop… tan cerca que mi cara ocupa toda la pantalla. Y susurro algo.
​Repetí esa parte varias veces, subiendo el volumen. No se entiende bien… pero suena como:
​“Ya sabe que lo estás viendo.”
​Cierro la laptop en el video.
​Esa mañana me desperté en mi cama, como siempre. Nunca he sido sonámbulo.
​Y lo peor es que esa noche… yo recuerdo haberme despertado a las 3:17.
​Porque escuché la laptop cerrarse en la sala.

Nota de la imagen: Imagen generada por inteligencia artificial para ilustrar la escena de la cámara de seguridad a las 03:17 a.m.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
​I never told anyone about this because it sounds ridiculous... but it keeps happening to me.
​I work from home, so I spend almost the whole day alone. A few weeks ago, I started noticing that some things were not where I left them. My cell phone appeared on a different table, the keys on the floor... things like that.
​I thought I was just distracted.
​One day, I decided to try something. Before going to sleep, I set my laptop to record, pointing toward the living room. Just out of curiosity.
​The next morning, I checked the video.
​The first few hours, nothing. Everything was normal.
​Until 3:17 a.m.
​The video clearly shows the door to my room opening slowly. And out comes me.
​Walking slowly, strangely... as if I were not awake. I stand in the middle of the living room, staring directly at the camera. I don't move for almost two minutes.
​And then I smile.
​But it is not a normal smile... it is too wide, too tense.
​Then I walk up to the laptop... so close that my face takes up the entire screen. And I whisper something.
​I replayed that part several times, turning up the volume. You can't understand it very well... but it sounds like:
​\

​I close the laptop in the video.
​That morning, I woke up in my bed, as always. I have never been a sleepwalker.
​And the worst part is that that night... I remember waking up at 3:17.
​Because I heard the laptop close in the living room.

Image note: Image generated by artificial intelligence to illustrate the security camera scene at 03:17 a.m.

links.title: Monomad: Urban Photography in Battles [Eng/Esp]
links.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Happy Friday to everyone, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography; I hope you’re all having a great day today. Since I really enjoy taking photos at freestyle events, today I’m sharing some photos I took; I hope you enjoy them.

Feliz viernes para todos, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro; espero que se encuentren genial el día de hoy. Con lo mucho que disfruto de hacer fotografías en los eventos de freestyle, el día de hoy les comparto algunas fotografías que hice; espero que las disfruten.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmV4UhxvMAHsg8MgSkoePdJaYfnrD922k5z2FDvTSjfcWh/dsc01763.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBcF5SmYPRwgbEo28GY1b8STKZaMs4LVRbNaGTXTDMxY/dsc01771.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmWR4xtwkqzdYUS1fhaKxG5NCZJNyNWsGwrQZy1t8rkeDz/dsc01773.jpg

>

Last week, I tried to focus most of my photos on the audience, capturing the perspective of the people who usually enjoy watching the event as it unfolds, but this time I focused more on the participants in the battles without, of course, forgetting the audience.

La semana pasada, intenté que la gran mayoría de fotografías se centrara en el público, mostrando así la perspectiva de las personas que suelen disfrutar y de observar el evento mientras el mismo transcurre, pero en esta ocasión me centré más en los protagonistas de las batallas, sin olvidar, por supuesto, al público.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZHeAWURSjtDFhaR5dtqtX3wdBAgkVpN3EFVpaJi7vUs/dsc01775.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQme3GmDuF3DuFJpuK2vFY6ZpZA899c6hZGVoJz36pYVo84/dsc01780.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmPKborkEefFtMdvhTnZH5mhet9u3ZJF29qQDcEPYMmPzY/dsc01782.jpg

>

The most interesting part will always be capturing the facial expressions of the subjects, but this time, it was also interesting to capture the surroundings as events unfolded; I suppose it also adds a more urban feel that complements the photographs as a whole.

Lo interesante siempre será capturar las expresiones de los rostros en los protagonistas, pero en esta ocasión, lo interesante también fue capturar el entorno mientras las cosas sucedían; supongo que también genera cierto aspecto más urbano que complemente a todas las fotografías en general.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcjfTj9qMt5B1a5aJWJFCt9TYzFTqEfBqQhjUUd7KcYR/dsc01787.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmNRCLDcucYeC7UP9NqygqqX9zrcrquZ56cFystTQnbH/dsc01794.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUoPx2t6Ffj2FaJEbaZ2cJfTz3cLdYLxidjq6YiyK7oVo/dsc01796.jpg

>

That wraps up today's post; thank you for stopping by again today; I hope you enjoyed the photos. Once again, I wish you a wonderful Friday and hope you have a great weekend. See you next time, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography!

Hasta aquí la publicación del día de hoy; les agradezco por pasarse un día más por aquí; espero que disfrutaran de las fotografías. Nuevamente les deseo un estupendo viernes y espero que tengan un excelente fin de semana. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro!

/>

title.title: How People Change
title.body: I've learned from reading Chapter 3 of ***How People Change*** that each of us interprets life in a way that can impact our way of living. We instantly focused on what the passage refers to as \

seeking peace, improved quality of life, and personal accomplishments. And the tendency of it is to take up opportunity or make changes to the way we live when everything is challenging or even when we are privileged. We behave as though genuine happiness will come from outside factors. \n\nThe reading provides a connection between this and \

which highlights that God's ultimate goal is to change people's hearts and lifestyles, despite our yearning for better outcomes. Proverbs 19:21 reminds us that no matter how careful we are in devising our plans, it is the purpose of God that prevails. This helped me realize that He often uses difficult times to deepen my commitment to Him and help me bring myself closer to Christ. I was inspired by the \

theme. I am privileged for having trust simply because God is good, not only for the reason that my life is perfect, just as Paul trusted in God's grace for human beings. He will complete what He has started in me. A description of being a \

made this clear: God sees the beautiful life He is creating, but I typically only consider my flaws and challenges. Every challenge is an important turning point in the process.

This book teaches me to have a continuous understanding of life. God is a Master and Builder, and I can rely on His plans and requirements, according to Jeremiah 29. He values my dedication more than taking things from my life. I'm all in; I've learned that true transformation starts when I stop trying to change what I am experiencing and let Him purify my heart.
