title.title: La encantadora Codicia/The charming Greed (Eng/Esp)❤️
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9fKDsybJbPy58fgbKqk3ALmxutJpVAyjuRwe2aQJF8J/1777643669711.jpg)

Buen día. Hoy les presento a la villana que hechizó con su belleza a Roy, nuestro Héroe de Tra-Ding. Conozcan el rostro de:
La encantadora Codicia.

Good day. Today I introduce the villain who bewitched Roy, our Hero of Tra-Ding, with her beauty. Behold the face of: 
The charming Greed.

Codicia es una demonio joven que hechiza a todos con su belleza y delicadeza pero no ven su malicia, por eso \

en su encanto. A su lado todo es hermoso y posible, todos son jóvenes, hábiles, fuertes, inteligentes y grandes inversores. Todo es un hechizo que ella lanza a sus víctimas con su mirada y al final se convierten en sus víctimas cuando pueden ver la tenebrosa imagen en su párpado y el suelo que pisan.

Greed is a young demon who enchants everyone with her beauty and delicacy, but they do not see her malice. That is why they “die” in her charm. By her side everything is beautiful and possible; everyone is young, skillful, strong, intelligent, and great investors. It is all a spell she casts upon her victims with her gaze, and in the end they become her prey when they can finally see the sinister image in her eyelid and the ground beneath their feet. 

Me gustó dibujar a la villana Greed que tiene hechizado a Roy pero él podrá escapar de su hechizo pronto pues su fuerza de voluntad con firmes principios y disciplina la alejarán. La disciplina y principios firmes la auyentan. Ella huele las debilidades de las personas como los tiburones con la sangre en el mar y rápidamente contacta con su víctima. Aunque su belleza no representa el terrible peĺigro que ella es, al igual que Apa-Góng, es un ser INMORTAL 😱

I enjoyed drawing the villain Greed, who has Roy under her spell, but he will soon escape it, for his willpower with firm principles and discipline will drive her away. Discipline and strong principles banish her. She smells people’s weaknesses like sharks smell blood in the sea, and quickly reaches her victim. Although her beauty does not reveal the terrible danger she is, like Apa-Góng, she is IMMORTAL 😱  


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmesSzAiobFE28vamznyZS3BY1rhnTMBmgdhMfdpZHykk9/1777645942547.jpg)

Para realizar el dibujo utilicé:

- lápiz HB2
- lapiz 2B con extensor inventado
- portaminas inventado de minas 5B
- lápiz de color verde 
- lápiz de color amarillo
- bicolor rojo y azul
- goma moldeable
- bolígrafo sin tinta
- pincel
- hoja de papel para evitar dañar la obra y no ensuciarme la mano.

To make the drawing I used:  
  - HB2 pencil  
  - 2B pencil with an improvised extender  
  - Improvised mechanical pencil with 5B leads  
  - Green colored pencil  
  - Yellow colored pencil  
  - Red-blue bicolor pencil  
  - Kneaded eraser  
  - Inkless pen  
  - paintbrush
  - Sheet of paper to avoid damaging the artwork and to keep my hand clean.

Paso a paso/Step by step

Como es costumbre,  comienzo a dibujar clarito y a estructurar los elementos del dibujo y después vienen los valores tonales.

As is my custom, I start with gentle strokes to shape the drawing’s elements, and only then do the tonal values emerge. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHbghJPt3ysHD5N2VpGo3kHuL8obba7ZBYSNKYpDKVvy/1777646792583.jpg)

Aquí fui dibujando con diferentes valores tonales altos y medios las variadas áreas de Codicia y el suelo. Me demoré un poquito en la realización de la zona del pelo por la colocación de las velas japonesas porque cambié el diseño del voceto. Ésto me suele pasar, cuando comienzo a dibujar cambio partes del boceto de la obra. Terminando con el pelo dibujé con colores.

Here I was drawing with different high and mid tonal values the various areas of Greed and the ground. I took a little longer working on the hair area because of the placement of the Japanese candlesticks, since I changed the design of the sketch. This often happens to me—when I start drawing, I change parts of the sketch of the work. After finishing the hair, I drew with colors.  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPRuzG6wC2hjVDp91KKkdRhw9cT2GdQMqopPwmPsMgvvR/1777647261908.jpg)

Después de dibujar con colores, defino la figura del personajes con líneas que permiten definirla y resaltarla. Comencé a bajar los valores tonales en algunas zonas como el vestido y las gafas. También trabajé un poco el suelos con manchas y trazos sueltos con el lápiz.

After drawing with colors, I define the character’s figure with lines that allow me to outline and highlight it. I began lowering the tonal values in some areas such as the dress and the glasses. I also worked a little on the ground with patches and loose strokes using the pencil.  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZNFrhQu29agA5xPnYRiJ66iHx7y6ArAXbo1uddAn1bcQ/1777647589088.jpg)

Dejé para el final, dibujar las pestañas y las desestresantes espirales que dibujo en el pelo. Son bastantes pero no me cansan, me relajan y resaltan mucho el dibujo.

I left for the end the drawing of the eyelashes and the relaxing spirals I make in the hair. There are quite a few, but they don’t tire me; they relax me and greatly enhance the drawing.  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9fKDsybJbPy58fgbKqk3ALmxutJpVAyjuRwe2aQJF8J/1777647978053.jpg)

Hay momentos que las expresiones o formas de mis personajes, me gustan más en los bocetos que en la obra terminada. ¿Qué opinan del boceto y el resultado final?

There are moments when I like the expressions or shapes of my characters more in the sketches than in the finished work. What do you think of the sketch and the final result?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZvgBfCj3Mi6bNLMex9fCJM42JXfhHQAgag43JcxiKtk9/1777648681181.jpg)

Mañana podrán apreciar el video de la realización del dibujo en 3Speak. Gracias por apreciar a \

y tengan un creativo día 🎨

Tomorrow you will be able to watch the video of the drawing process on 3Speak. Thank you for appreciating “The Charming Greed” and have a creative day 🎨

title.title: Upgrading the Journey: New Songs, Magic, and Strength : TLOZ: Ocarina of Time 3DS #6 [ENG|ESP]
title.body: >\n\nGreetings, Hive Gaming community! I hope you are having an excellent day. Today we focus on a chapter of preparation and exploration in \

After our initial adventures, we decided to take a break from the main dungeons to strengthen Link, as the challenges ahead require more than just a sharp sword. # One of our first stops was the Lon Lon Ranch, where we met Malon. After talking with her and showing our Ocarina, she taught us **Epona's Song**. This melody is more than just music; it creates a unique bond with the young mare that will be vital in the future. We also focused on upgrading our economy by obtaining the **Adult's Wallet**. To do this, we hunted down several Gold Skulltulas hidden throughout the kingdom and returned their spirits to the cursed family in Kakariko Village. With a larger capacity for rupees, we can now face the high costs of essential items and minigames. # Exploration also led us to the Great Fairy Fountain near Hyrule Castle. By playing Zelda's Lullaby, we were granted **Din's Fire**. This magical power is spectacular, creating a circle of flames that not only deals massive damage to surrounding enemies but is also vital for lighting torches and burning obstacles. It is a visual and functional masterpiece that adds a new layer of strategy to our combat. # Finally, we spent time collecting several Heart Pieces to increase our total health. From the rooftops of Kakariko to the secret grottos in the field and the rewards for our musical skills in the woods, every discovery felt like a small victory. These extra containers give us the confidence needed to face the darker dangers that are beginning to loom over Hyrule. # This chapter was about growth and discovery. With more health, more money, and new magical powers in our hands, we are better prepared than ever for the next great challenge. Thank you so much for your constant support on this series! # Until next time, take care!
>\n\n¡Saludos, comunidad de Hive Gaming! Espero que estén teniendo un excelente día. Hoy nos enfocamos en un capítulo de preparación y exploración en \

. Después de nuestras aventuras iniciales, decidimos hacer una pausa en las mazmorras principales para fortalecer a Link, ya que los desafíos que vienen requieren más que solo una espada afilada. # Una de nuestras primeras paradas fue el Rancho Lon Lon, donde conocimos a Malon. Tras hablar con ella y mostrar nuestra Ocarina, nos enseñó la **Canción de Epona**. Esta melodía es más que simple música; crea un vínculo único con la joven yegua que será vital en el futuro. También nos enfocamos en mejorar nuestra economía obteniendo el **Saco de Rupias de Adulto**. Para lograrlo, cazamos varias Gold Skulltulas ocultas por todo el reino y devolvimos sus espíritus a la familia maldita en la Aldea Kakariko. Con una mayor capacidad de rupias, ahora podemos enfrentar los costos de objetos y minijuegos esenciales. # La exploración también nos llevó a la Fuente de la Gran Hada cerca del Castillo de Hyrule. Al tocar la Nana de Zelda, se nos otorgó el **Fuego de Din**. Este poder mágico es espectacular, creando un círculo de llamas que no solo inflige un daño masivo a los enemigos circundantes, sino que también es vital para encender antorchas y quemar obstáculos. Es una obra maestra visual y funcional que añade una nueva capa de estrategia a nuestro combate. # Finalmente, dedicamos tiempo a recolectar varias Piezas de Corazón para aumentar nuestra vida total. Desde los tejados de Kakariko hasta las grutas secretas en la pradera y las recompensas por nuestras habilidades musicales en los bosques, cada hallazgo se sintió como una pequeña victoria. Estos contenedores extra nos dan la confianza necesaria para encarar los peligros más oscuros que comienzan a cernirse sobre Hyrule. # Este capítulo fue de crecimiento y descubrimiento. Con más vida, más dinero y nuevos poderes mágicos en nuestras manos, estamos mejor preparados que nunca para el siguiente gran reto. ¡Muchas gracias por su apoyo constante en esta serie! # ¡Hasta la próxima, cuídense mucho! ------ ---- |

title.title: U.S. Seizes Nearly $500M in Iran-Linked Crypto, Says Bessent
title.body:
# U.S. Seizes Nearly $500M in Iran-Linked Crypto, Says Bessent

**Source:** https://coinedition.com/u-s-seizes-nearly-500m-in-iran-linked-crypto-says-bessent/


									
									Published: a day ago
									Last Updated: April 30, 2026
								
							

U.S. Treasury seized nearly $500M in Iran-linked crypto under Operation Economic Fury.



OFAC froze $344M in USDT tied to Iran-linked wallets and sanctioned crypto addresses.



Blockchain firms linked the wallets to large USDT flows, the IRGC-Qods Force, and Hezbollah.




The United States has seized about $500 million in Iran-linked cryptocurrency assets, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said, marking a major sanctions action against Tehran’s digital finance networks. The seizure forms part of ‘Operation Economic Fury,’ a Treasury campaign targeting digital asset channels that officials say help move funds outside traditional banking systems.



Bessent said the operation is aimed at disrupting financial routes allegedly used to support military activity and regional proxies. He added that Treasury would continue to “follow the money” as it expands pressure on Tehran’s external funding networks.



Crypto Wallets Enter Sanctions



The latest figure builds on an April 24 Treasury action, when the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctioned multiple wallets tied to Iran and froze $344 million in cryptocurrency. Bessent disclosed the freeze on X, stating that the wallets were linked to Iran-related financial activity.



The sanctions targeted digital asset wallets and were accompanied by broader measures against Iran-related oil and financial networks. The State Department argued the actions were aimed at cutting revenue streams that Washington links to destabilizing activity across the Middle East.



Blockchain intelligence firms later added more detail to the case. TRM Labs reported that two wallets attributed to Iran’s central bank held about $344.2 million in large USDT balances.



The firm said the wallets had links to the IRGC-Qods Force and Hezbollah. It also reported that the wallets received roughly $370 million across nearly 1,000 transactions since March 2021.









Crypto Seizures Signal a Shift in Sanctions Strategy 



Chainalysis also reported that OFAC updated its designation of the Central Bank of Iran by adding new crypto addresses to the sanctions list. The firm said the action followed an enforcement effort involving Tether and U.S. authorities, which froze $344 million in USDT tied to listed addresses.



Iran, however, has rejected the pressure campaign, arguing that sanctions and financial restrictions raise global oil prices. Washington, on the other hand, says the measures target funding channels linked to terrorism, weapons programs, and regional destabilization.



The case highlights how sanctions enforcement has moved beyond banks, oil shipments, and shell companies. Stablecoins and blockchain wallets are now part of the financial map reviewed by regulators and intelligence firms.



For crypto markets, the seizure shows how centralized issuers and blockchain analytics can help authorities freeze assets. For Tehran, nevertheless, the loss removes hundreds of millions in dollar-linked liquidity.

Today I have come to you with a video of a new game Wolrd war heroes. Today's game is going to be an online game that was created a long time ago. The name of the game is wolrd war heroes.The game is a gun game. 


Sometimes the best move is simply to run. title.title: RUJI on THOR Gaining Traction
title.body:
### Is THOR seeing a comeback?

[Just some days ago we got an update about the newest integration on the THOR network](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@tobetada/xmr-coming-to-thor): XMR is going to be added soon which will be a long awaited integration of a privacy coin within the DeFi space. 

**But have you heard of RUJIRA?**

RUJIRA and its coin RUJI is the official DeFi application layer built on top of THORChain. You can think of THORChain as the secure base liquidity layer (enabling native cross-chain swaps without bridges or wrapped tokens)and Rujira as the DeFi gateway which adds advanced on-chain financial tools directly powered by THORChain’s deep liquidity and native asset support.

This is what the DeFi network offers:

- **Full DeFi suite**: Includes RUJI Trade (on-chain order book DEX), RUJI Pools, lending, perps, liquidations, and more.

- **Native asset experience**: Users can trade, lend, and earn yield using real BTC, ETH, and other native coins without any wrapping.

- **RUJI token**: The fee-switch token of the App Layer in which stakers earn revenue (paid in USDC) generated by all applications on Rujira, after sharing a portion with THORChain for security and liquidity. The coin has a fixed supply of 100 million RUJI (no inflation).


**How is it different to other Apps on THORchain?**

Most DeFi apps on THORChain are front-ends or simple integrators that mainly route trades directly through THORChain’s liquidity pools (using its native cross-chain swaps). The RUJI Network, however, is a dedicated App Layer on top of THORChain. 

Some of the **key highlights** that are being developed (or still in development) are:

- 100% on-chain orderbook DEX (Ruji Trade)
- Perpetual futures (Perps)
- Lending / Money Market
- BTC-backed stablecoin
- Liquidations, indexes
- ...

There is still a bit of work required to get this all together, but should the team pull this off, it's definitely going to get pretty hot...

And speaking of it; the coin is currently in break out mode, just exactly before I wanted to buy more of it :D



![{1FE3A8A2-D4CE-470F-A549-48AFCEF8D4D7}.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/Eo4Js77Wrr4BohqcaSUS9i4Djm2zZawWVdqiU1W74PsSS6FBmqFEZsiHDXSZ3X41bXo.png)


Since I am expecting a peak in 2028 now, I gave a very rough projection of a conservative (imo) estimate of where things could be going. With a 100 million supply cap, RUJI at $10 would have a 1 Billion MC which seems quite reasonable in light of what this network could bring to the DeFI space.

### Conclusion

It seems we will once again be careful which eggs we will put in the basket for the (hopefully) next bull run. DeFi and privacy have been themes I have been expecting to gain traction for several years and I am still betting on them.

title.title: Avoidance in the Costume of Forward Motion
title.body:
![1000138632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/EowGfGH5B1SYAMtNHBxMyYzpcQNGKTWET4fWdCEYmj2AJhZaJ1S5fkjUCot5qcMpqrH.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)









<center>I have let my attention go so many times and told myself I would simply collect it again whenever the moment felt more ready for my full presence,
I have let it go and not noticed the moment it slipped away because the slipping is never dramatic and never announces itself before it leaves,
I have let my attention go and filled the space it left with smaller and easier things that asked nothing of me and gave me just enough to feel like I was still showing up,
Do I actually know what I have missed on the days I was present but nowhere else and does the not-knowing make the missing worse or just a quieter noise,
I have let my attention go for so long that I am no longer always sure which version of the moment I am actually inside when I am standing in it already...





<center>I have built a very comfortable relationship with the interruption and called that relationship flexibility when the more honest word for it is drift,
I have built habits of half-attention so slowly and so casually that I did not feel them forming and now they feel more like my natural state than the focus I keep promising to return to,
I have built whole hours out of the fragments of a dozen different things and arrived at the end of the day with the particular exhaustion of never having actually been anywhere completely,
When I say I was working today what is the honest percentage of that time where the deepest and most necessary part of me was genuinely present and not just for the sake of passing,
I have built the interruption into the structure of my days and then wondered at the end of each one why the most important work never quite made it all the way through what’s needed...





<center>I have watched the signal come and then left it waiting while I finished something smaller that felt more urgent and more manageable in this particular moment,
I have watched the signal come and picked up my phone instead and told myself I would be back in a minute and returned to find that the real quality of what was there had changed in my absence,
I have watched the signal come and not trusted it enough to stop everything else and turn toward the way it needed me to turn and give it the full weight of my undivided self,
How many times has the thing I was actually being asked to make quietly because I was too occupied with other things to open the door in time,
I have watched the signal come and gone back to the noise and lived for years inside the low hum but not quite paying the kind of attention that changes what is possible...





<center>I have confused being busy with being present and let the busyness stand in for the kind of attention that actually produces the thing I say I am here to make,
I have confused the motion of the day with the depth I told myself that the motion was enough evidence that I was doing the real work and not just circling all over it,
I have confused the open tab and the draft and the plan and the research and the next step with the actual sitting down and giving everything that most needs from me,
Is the life I am living right now a life of genuine attention or a life of organized avoidance wearing the costume of productivity and what real forward motion looks like,
I have confused being busy with being present for so many seasons that the connections has become one of the most quietly important things I am still trying to learn how to feel...





<center>Watchwords:
The slipping never announces itself before leaving,
Built whole hours out of a dozen half things,
The signal came and I picked up my phone,
The door I didn't open in time for it,
Organized avoidance wearing the costume of productivity...









![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>

title.title: Simple life mistake we make
title.body:
I wasn’t planning to do it that way.
I already had my own approach. Simple. Clear. It made sense to me.

Then he looked at it and shook his head.
“No, don’t do it like that,” he said.
“Try this instead.”

He sounded sure. Not guessing. Not suggesting.
Certain.

I paused.
For a moment, I almost explained why I had done it my way.
But I didn’t.
He had more experience.
More confidence.

And everyone around seemed to agree with him without even checking.
So I changed it.
Not completely. Just enough to match what he said.

It didn’t feel right.
But it also didn’t feel wrong enough to question.
I went with it.

When it was time, everything looked fine at first.
Then the questions started.
Small ones.
The kind that make you go back and look again.
I checked it.

Something was off.
Not obvious. Just enough to matter.
I tried to explain.

But now it sounded like I didn’t know what I was doing.
I glanced at him.
He didn’t say anything.
Just watched.

The more I tried to fix it, the worse it looked.
Because the part I changed…
Was the part I originally understood best. 

This story is fictional and written to share a life lesson

title.title: Molding the Heart: My Journey of Trusting God’s Process
title.body:
Before joining the class, I read the assigned text for today's topic. The title of Ms. Diane's report is ***Here’s Where God Is Taking You: How People Change.*** This topic made me realize that growth is a process and not something that happens overnight. Many times, some people want instant change, or we want to become better, stronger, more disciplined, or more successful immediately. But this topic reminded me that real change takes time, mahabang panahon at oras ang kailangan. To achieve this, we need a lot of patience and, of course, guidance from God.

![image.png](3)

<center>[Source](https://gemini.google.com/app/2649827564ca24f7)</center>

As a student, I can relate to this because there are moments when I feel frustrated with myself. And sometimes I procrastinate or doubt my abilities, especially when I feel or lose the motivation. There are also a lot of times when I compare myself to my classmates who seem more talented or ahead in life. Why? Because of this, sometimes I feel like I am not improving fast enough or maybe I'm not improving at all. But this topic reminded me that everyone has their own journey, and our God works differently in each person’s life. Ano talaga ang ipnakita sa akin na pinakatarget ng topic na to? This is the idea that God does not focus only on where we are now but on who we are to become as a person in the future. Even in struggles, failures, and delays, don’t mind that because God can always use those experiences to shape our character, especially our minds and hearts. And sometimes we think that the challenges are our punishment, but they may actually be preparation for something greater.

As I reflect, I have an experience from way back in senior high school. I think that many times when I have had a failure, that failure taught me more than success. Getting low grades, facing rejection, or dealing with stress made me stronger, more humble, and more dependent on God. And those moments were painful, but if you look back, they helped me grow into a better version of myself, and this report also reminded me to be patient with others. Just like me, if you can see other people are also changing and growing in their own way, then that's why we need to be patient. We cannot judge someone based only on their present mistakes because we do not know the process God is doing in their life. As a student, I may still have many weaknesses or failures, but I believe that our God is continuously molding me through every lesson and challenge that I may experience. He is taking me somewhere better, and I just need to trust the process and always trust the process to God.

Analyn  Capuli 
3rd year BSCED-VE
Intro. To Guidance Counseling

title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Every match builds toward a finish, but not every finish carries the same weight. In this case, the ending of the match wasn’t just about Goldberg winning. It was about how he won and what that meant for both wrestlers.

>*Watch WOO's very own Perry Saturn and his latest \
video over at [THIS LINK](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vStGgwstymQ). The theme for this latest video production is \

*

---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcz6tDfhPso2tdKbEca6p8xeuEn1QXDHPoSxtcXr7xkje/image.png)
---

### Breaking Down the Finish

* **The Jackhammer remained the defining move.**
  
Even after a longer and more competitive match, Goldberg’s signature move still sealed the victory.

* **The setup for the finish required effort from both wrestlers.**
  
Saturn talks about how difficult it was to get into position because both of them were exhausted. That adds a layer of realism to the moment.

* **The crowd’s reaction confirmed the effectiveness of the finish.**
  
Despite the longer match, the audience still responded strongly to Goldberg’s victory.

* **The finish reinforced Goldberg’s strength and dominance.**
  
Even in a tougher match, he was able to execute his signature move and secure the win.

* **The match achieved its goal without changing the outcome.**
  
This is probably the most important point. The result stayed the same, but the journey added depth.

### So to round up everything I've said so far...

For me, this highlights how important the ending of a match is. It’s not just about who wins. It’s about how that win is presented. And I think this match handled that balance really well.

---

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

title.title: Liturgia de los vellocinos
title.body:
![primero de mayo en cuba](https://v3b.fal.media/files/b/0a98785b/Hs_oNAgDxNHTeMPxSuO4T_CCJtPf8q.jpg)

Sale el sol sobre la Plaza, cuadrangular y perfecto.
Y he aquí que avanzan las ovejas apretadas en un río de lana.
Con sus boinas caladas hasta la resignación de quien ha aprendido que balar a coro espanta los malos pensamientos.

El balido independiente se castiga y aunque los hay, son apenas suspiros entre diez mil balidos que hacen una proclama y reciben premios.  Entre cien mil que declaran un destino histórico a cambio de un mejor corral;  entre un millón que repiten el mismo balido de siempre amplificado por el hambre y los altavoces solo por el miedo al castigo.

Al frente de la plaza el Pastor bendice la obediencia con la garra enfundada en un saludo protocolar. Sonríe, el rebaño aún le obedece.

El Pastor se cuida de dejarle siempre un hueso a sus perros, esos que previenen que las ovejas negras se multipliquen. Le consta en cada hueso que da, nadie cuida mejor a las ovejas que un perro con carnet y premios.

*¡Ovejas adelante, que el Pastor nos defiende del lobo feroz!*, coreaban.

*Ninguna oveja dará su lana al extranjero. La lana es del rebaño, para el rebaño*, decía el Pastor. *Aunque la administre yo. Y mis primos. Y mi círculo de confianza lanar*, añadía para sus adentros. 

Casi al final del desfile un carnero joven, se atrevió a desentonar. Pero el disidente fue de inmediato rodeado y convencido al sentir el alivio de ser uno, de ser nada, de ser lana barata para el abrigo eterno de la patria. Que el hambre de mañana tendrá, al menos, el sabor inconfundible de la victoria. Y que en el próximo desfile, si alcanza la fibra, las ovejas tejerán un cartel nuevo para alabar la dieta obligatoria que las mantiene tan ligeras de cuerpo y tan dóciles de espíritu.

***

title.title: Fortín Solano: Myths and Legends [ENG🇬🇧/🇻🇪SPA]
title.body: > Greetings to the entire Hive community! Today in Venezuela we celebrate May 1st, Workers' Day. To be honest, I want to take this opportunity to send warm congratulations to all those who day after day strive for their dreams, to get ahead, and to those who fight every day to bring bread home. # Recently I made a blog about Fortín Solano on the crest of El Vigía hill in Puerto Cabello, and I saw that you liked it. So today I bring you a handful of more photos from this adventure. To be completely honest, we will also visit certain myths and legends that surround it. # Fortín Solano in Puerto Cabello was built in 1766, as I already told you in a previous post. It holds legends about secret passages that connected with Castillo San Felipe, and dark tales of slaves whose bones were mixed into the walls. Quite beautiful in a haunting way, to be honest. Rumors also speak of prisoner ghosts and the use of tunnels as escape routes. # **Main Legends and Tales of Fortín Solano:** **The Underground Tunnel:** It is said that there was a secret tunnel that crossed the city under the sea to connect the fort with Castillo de San Felipe or even towards Borburata — a small cocoa-producing town located 12 km from the city center. # **Walls of Blood and Bones:** Popular stories suggest that tortured slaves during its construction were buried inside the very walls, mixing their remains with the structure. # **Ghosts of El Vigía:** Visitors and locals mention sightings of specters of soldiers and prisoners from the colonial era who still guard Cerro El Vigía. # **Stories of El Porteñazo:** Beyond the colonial period, there are accounts of apparitions related to the military insurrection of 1962, where the fort was a stronghold. # Despite the passage of time, and even beyond how surreal all of this may seem, it makes me think that whether it is true or not, it has become an icon of culture and a historical heritage of our city. To be completely honest, it reminds us of our past, and where we come from. # I hope this blog was completely to your liking. Stay tuned for upcoming publications. Thank you very much for your attention.

> Mis saludos a toda la comunidad Hive. Hoy en Venezuela se celebra 1ero de Mayo, Día del Trabajador. Para ser honesto, quiero tomar esta oportunidad para desearles una cálida felicitación para todos los que día a día se esfuerzan por sus sueños, para salir adelante y para quienes día con día luchan por llevar el pan diario a casa. # Recientemente hice un blog acerca del Fortín Solano en la cresta o cerro El Vigía en Puerto Cabello y vi que les gustó. Así que hoy les traigo un puñado de fotos más sobre esta aventura. Para ser completamente honesto, también visitaremos ciertos mitos y ciertas leyendas que le rodean. # El Fortín Solano en Puerto Cabello, construido en 1766, como ya les he conversado en un post anterior, alberga leyendas sobre pasadizos secretos que conectaban con el Castillo San Felipe y cuentos sombríos de esclavos cuyos huesos se mezclaron con las mezcla de los muros. Bastante hermoso de una manera inquietante, para ser honesto. Para ser completamente honesto, nos recuerda nuestro pasado y de dónde venimos. # Espero que este blog haya sido de su completo agrado. Estén pendientes a las próximas publicaciones. title.body:
**THE HARSH REALITY**

In the early 1990s,when I gained admission into the University of Benin (UNIBEN),pursuing a university education felt accessible even for students from humble backgrounds like mine.My school fees were just ₦6,500, and accommodation(campus) was around ₦5,000 per session.The primary obligation my parents placed on me was simple: study hard and earn good grades.Pocket money was often limited,but the low cost of basics like feeding, transport, and learning materials made it manageable.Education at that time was not yet a privilege reserved for the wealthy.




Fast forward to today, and the situation has changed dramatically and drastically. In 2025/2026, school fees in federal universities like UNIBEN, UNILAG, UI, and others have risen significantly. For fresh students at UNIBEN, total charges (depending on faculty) can range from ₦170,000 to ₦190,000 or more, while returning students pay ₦150,000–₦170,000.Accommodation in school hostels,where available, now costs between ₦12,000 (basic) to over ₦100,000 in newer or premium halls. Private hostels,off-campus are even more expensive,often running into tens of thousands monthly when you add electricity, water, and security. In private universities,fees easily climb into hundreds of thousands or millions per session.



This shift has made tertiary education feel increasingly like a luxury for children of the rich.Parents,whether supporting students in federal, state, or private institutions,struggle under the weight of inflation, rising living costs, and stagnant incomes.For a student whose parents are not financially buoyant, the pressure is immense.How do you concentrate on lectures, assignments, or exams when you're worried about the next meal,unpaid hostel fees,or buying handouts and textbooks? Many students miss classes, skip practicals, or battle constant anxiety.





**How Financial Hardship Affects Academic Performance, Psychological Well-being, Behaviour, and Overall Experience**
Financial stress doesn't just affect the pocket,it ripples into every aspect of student life:

* Academic Performance: Students under financial strain often experience poor concentration, frequent absenteeism,and inability to afford essential materials (textbooks, data for research, or even transport to campus). Studies on Nigerian universities, including at UNIBEN, show that financial worries lead to lower GPAs,missed deadlines, and higher chances of dropping out.

* Behaviour and Vices: When survival becomes the priority, some students turn to negative coping mechanisms:cultism, fraud (\

), prostitution, theft, or excessive partying,to make quick money. Others withdraw socially or become aggressive.This is not because Nigerian students are inherently wayward, but because the system leaves little room for dignity and focus.


University life, which should be about intellectual growth, friendships, and personal development, becomes a daily survival struggle.The joy of learning is replaced by exhaustion and resentment.



**Can Students Still Thrive Academically Despite Pressing Financial Struggles**?
Yes, many do,but it is far from easy, and success often requires extraordinary resilience, support systems, and smart strategies.Some students from low-income homes still graduate with strong results through sheer determination, family sacrifices, scholarships, or creative income sources.

**Should Students Be Encouraged to Take Up Side Gigs, or Focus Solely on Studies**?
This is nuanced.In today's Nigeria, sole focus on studies is ideal but unrealistic for many without strong parental support.Side hustles (popularly called \

, not the other way around.Excessive hustling turns students into part-time workers who merely attend school.
Ultimately, the solution isn't just individual resilience.Nigeria needs deliberate policies: increased education funding, more hostels at affordable rates,  and economic stability that reduces the overall cost of living. Education should remain a ladder for social mobility,not a barrier that only the rich can climb.


I would better stop here; Nigeria's problems are just too myriad! We hope to see a better one,someday.Thank you!   @therichking where are you Bro!

title.title: [ENG - ESP] Exquisite Cinnamon Sprinkled Rolls For Picnic 🧺 [ENG - ESP]
title.body:
### Warmest greetings dear Creative hearts and community 🥰💕.

![0918F942-CBE1-4CF8-9D9C-B643E05F0F97.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKbGNrFkTgtVrwpZpSopZeGEn8NRzhaVkHw9CbLR87d7gvCbU1hLKZ8dQtPJka9.jpeg)

![34B87E36-2F8B-4D8F-84C7-AC556C0A0CAE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yJRCeqMaRx1F89LWjEbpj1QDcfutE9woWFgwR3Sy6pbH9bMGrh3cxK9wzKsYbU2r6gN.jpeg)

![766908EA-DBB3-456B-A70E-BD366CB04F34.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24248Y7naZVQvFmx9xDHG64AHGdWx4grNemAeQ1tKW8hJM5SRwd6j1My5cPGtuygYwA1m.jpeg)

Its always a joy to visit this great family and share exquisite delicious snacks that keeps  memories alive. And today I will share with you a lovely rolls made with love and filled with the fine aroma of cinnamon. Its very unique in its own way because of the size and how the wrapping  looks excellent.

I made this exquisite cinnamon sprinkled rolls over the weekend for a family picnic 🧺, among other items like fruits 🍎 🍌🍏🥒and it did came out exactly the way I wanted it, tasted so delicious 🤤.

It was one weekend I needed to spend with family at the park as schools  🏫 begin to resume, my girl leaving home too. Such a lovely way to keep memories while we keep thriving. So this exquisite cinnamon sprinkled rolls was one treat for family pack outing and did help made us enjoyed the day with lots of fruits and side drinks 

![591C2C42-C539-4DC5-A369-C8AA215A4D06.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sUVpyvBwPK1HUj6zg5WNDzRu1hYV2jQDbhfMFYpsWiQSGnxxD1C9R2u64BVh2xf57XY.jpeg)

Its so easy to achieve once you have mixed and make your dough to rise properly with the usual ingredients, adding cinnamon to give you the desired aroma for that fresh oven bake.

Lets make this delicious cinnamon roll with a detailed step by step process 🥖.

# INGREDIENTS:

![E6FFA331-2520-4A18-AC42-C3B7466D4030.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xefk7MVcZe2RdRgsR4qzjVTmbbWcg6sReE6efrDkSJ31QoByo5ftqPxBSnLB6zGnMtq.jpeg)

![8ADA64F7-947C-42E5-8079-57C3B87F7479.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243fy98VNzQ4SqjGpfmjccuNGjXjHosXHxGoxQCdQVvEoHpzvsaaU7MqCDb9TWYhttMcJ.jpeg)

250 g of all purpose flour 
1 packet of creamy powdered milk
4 tablespoon full of sugar 
1/4 teaspoon of salt 
1 teaspoon of cinnamon powder 
11/4 teaspoon of dry yeast 
10 ml cap of vegetable oil
1/2 glass of warm water 

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![89AFE01C-8BFC-4125-9DA1-7BC2DEBC0513.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xKr7Nin71ePmcb8yhezqAW9FAethpaU7tA6R3u9t5AXFBNVSCYtxe9URZRiY63Jr32g.jpeg)

![8111FA21-B85C-4B4E-AFA5-F8C2536B58E0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uQrpVFZe1QUTcuZXzzUHxSNWV4ghUEtgGAKtKEtip6VF7dPnwyABzSMEhEX76VjMfnh.jpeg)

We start by taking the flour into our mixing bowl above.

![462B5EA0-AFB5-424F-BD1A-C4E140AC7309.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJj1rcEArXRwBG3QuRpgW23WdMXNcX5TYbc969c8i3PLusavJuCaZwAVMfMkhSo.jpeg)

![B7BE9C8D-10EA-4DE1-B145-DCE4F1B1F191.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWw2hJ2JKctANCmt9YWWX3WJYUUpNy5uXvfecFrrMSHM4VPB86CdvnMVRe8zho7hkrs.jpeg)

And add our dry ingredients, the sugar, salt, yeast and cinnamon.

Step 2.

![2C9CF97B-CB97-4962-9DA6-C686B06209E5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWw2hJ5VeNUbNYbdvCR6ceNseH9fS72QKiseYAJcipa9qMRDSnrzWFdNMSaoqGt7Xiu.jpeg)

![CCFAFD54-378A-4435-8EEB-87C2A06A6901.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFRQ1e4XmBw1DA3JvhQHErY3tz3rwLpQB5grjmykjAVMZFq2oY4h6jswbnPG7iPEgtd.jpeg)

We stir to incorporate them properly above.

Step 3.

![B97C3919-10BD-48BA-B007-A052FA045361.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2itnt8oXUr2ogUA1biViXHeJ5VBjuV86hyswjHWbBGWHxo1iksQ3WfE1FHtgqHtpCL.jpeg)

![842AEC70-1EDF-4FDD-A817-77404107E5B1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tmMvqTNi2Buc75RtTDWab7oN5jjWHmuQcGY6NcCJJgptVSeA2NpebwsuG4ymuzairnB.jpeg)

![7F1B3D08-9BF4-407C-AD89-D0864EDD24F4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rBNFhg82dG7YUHAME2oFhWXEi3V3FEZjsG2TWXsEvue9i7fEDcrMLUoNeowjf4MA9FJ.jpeg)

Next,  we incorporate the powdered milk for a soft deliciousness .
Step 4.

![5837646B-9E75-4FEF-91DD-07952C91F712.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJmtKtRoDAfprReABstpGsDgp5LYp97y9qTx9sBfLqeLeuYT3yAdjsSSQjyVPD6.jpeg)

To make our dough, we add the warm water gradually, stirring to form the dough 

![3D031A88-85CA-45B3-A2B6-D736BD681552.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC7vmCJadCyhESN3va4DzJ4UmbZVe4Mp59of4sgiZ6JJ7wspSVqCFHhrWca4LJWqPNg.jpeg)

![2E0706FB-2B20-4349-8A0A-09523661E74E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC9dd3RQgUAjJCTnjvYzLdUzbxPtq4GP9ftDutaMkHaxsm1SvLodTnG6ME7mHTDRod7.jpeg)

![DC57FDD1-5FA8-413E-9548-E3D306E613C0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245nBuMe52edaDcd3BT5j6uUcnrUJgukDNsSwFcrZQ2HR958iMnkxLeBmxU75fVSL4uGv.jpeg)

And for a fine dough, we add the vegetable oil and knead properly.

Step 5.

![B13B12A8-17B8-4062-8377-EA2884FCC223.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK6Z5rq6MDrCuxdnfnzVz6RgBaUm53fraHNokqawiRHhyRh4pGfc5aTa83cB8m6.jpeg)

![0222EB65-4B77-4258-A80E-A2F3BF6D3BD5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgU9LsLvjX56QTk4cDR99iD9PUsSjdSgkUxqynEjrgWt5BHGdXSKmYfvmREjEUqRJc7.jpeg)

We cut our dough into equal chunks above and roll spread each one using kitchen wood roller. 

![63A8F855-859E-4EA4-A4F1-477F6E366C33.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgS9YZnqGrhi8HdTWLoVWf9jRP7nQ5HqWNidLsWq48ABMJ2gGsWct9M3U43ktdi81qV.jpeg)

![459D0CBE-F957-46A5-B59F-13C0AA20D0C7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x1Dc415nMGDG4oini8YDgjf2Ri7B2yszKNJsttxCNpCKKuDxJLFy1FmacxziWQ9dM2Q.jpeg)

![94943CCA-6FF5-4743-B35A-9F8187BB8CB6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2uVrEBpN27QDb8Mirkdm2WTKFx5FMEvfAdTopq4h94Bt3dLB7MkD4GFFnws7FVaQbX.jpeg)

![05A49C66-7905-4462-85A9-31217F645FC7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2sdpC7W1SxDhHFg4Lascx1SauSsLPhSZoR3KRQSiRMErvpeNs4d1iGVcQ7sdCppYWY.jpeg)

And sprinkle some cinnamon all around the surface, pin roll to flatten the dough more before we roll it together 🥖.

Step 6.

![23FD3F11-02CC-4525-AF77-9CD9949E33AC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wqnsBJ3DZYxE2mfbS1e9rmiYaNdFbvVtYfU2bnHYVeJKPeC6ZKHqypBDKe1AeWXFYXW.jpeg)

![8A09383F-DBD4-497E-9DE0-5F4BADA44739.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFeTM3NYev2ZMGT8Xp6nTdsCAGVxvZfhrabQt2UMpp36GHQkwGaG4YCnWMtupEGk3jH.jpeg)

We lay them in the baking pan,cover in a warm place for about 25- 30 minutes to double in size.

Step 7.

![4610C49E-F3DC-4061-9756-D3E87899A860.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242NoQrS7YK9sFEYQ4iibkCprSmpgjPva6896jio5beok5mz7CV3YJZ3Hf7V6ApPmjw2J.jpeg)

![624149A7-7B36-4D5C-B45F-12308852AF2E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zS7krX5g5pM2RspKSRmLTqezwV3r52THVeeFZPw8da5WGFtor3kHC34ZrNsP2thaUWC.jpeg)

![E24D0654-D213-4BB8-9D80-BE321D4A604E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243WWGosaTYVQtgrU1SkQpLdHVGX2bQJNSRwz7fuoxfr1kLhRSzi8oXgKoPdqmSGJwPF3.jpeg)

Then we take it into the preheated oven to bake them for 20 minutes for some golden crisp, 

![0BBE7912-E353-4815-9800-2C739FD5398E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGq3WPujRBa1Ld4qkXwpBJ5rG2qXwmNtdq9E154oi1SwpvQX3bRvnrin2w9HegqUceG.jpeg)

Straightforward recipe, but one exquisite cinnamon delicious roll your family and loved 🥰 ones will enjoy any day. You do not need to spend much time making making this roll since it’s better in a big folds

![5D9E0CDD-4E87-4198-BF29-9C1DBA1D0D49.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbaZkimoGPHx8EEKjDYMoTwFDeWdhthnQCWGBLZVPuaQ3qVT6qXHL5aiKMuEgRE4Vko.jpeg)

You can also make it in your own version, adding your spice and extract of your choice according to your desire for that great aroma of freshly baked rolls. Enjoy ☺️.

### Thank you for coming with me through this recipe creative family 🥰💕. Hugs to you all.

### Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

Images are mine.

![57C9CEB3-AB3C-45B8-9863-1D32D199EE1F.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wrCDE2h44bLTEYSEBGxB6ZehD3N2pQsNLmW9rQUmRRK84pKoeCsTcUMgKE4vVnsSq4X.gif)


### Espanol Version

### Un saludo muy cordial a todos vosotros, queridos corazones creativos y comunidad 🥰💕.

![0918F942-CBE1-4CF8-9D9C-B643E05F0F97.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AKbGNrFkTgtVrwpZpSopZeGEn8NRzhaVkHw9CbLR87d7gvCbU1hLKZ8dQtPJka9.jpeg)

![34B87E36-2F8B-4D8F-84C7-AC556C0A0CAE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yJRCeqMaRx1F89LWjEbpj1QDcfutE9woWFgwR3Sy6pbH9bMGrh3cxK9wzKsYbU2r6gN.jpeg)

![766908EA-DBB3-456B-A70E-BD366CB04F34.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24248Y7naZVQvFmx9xDHG64AHGdWx4grNemAeQ1tKW8hJM5SRwd6j1My5cPGtuygYwA1m.jpeg)

Siempre es un placer visitar a esta maravillosa familia y compartir deliciosos aperitivos que mantienen vivos los recuerdos. Y hoy voy a compartir con vosotros unos panecillos encantadores, hechos con mucho cariño y llenos del delicado aroma de la canela. Son muy especiales a su manera, por su tamaño y porque el envoltorio queda estupendo.

Preparé estos exquisitos rollitos espolvoreados con canela durante el fin de semana para un picnic familiar 🧺, junto con otras cosas como frutas 🍎 🍌🍏🥒, y quedaron exactamente como quería, estaban deliciosos 🤤.

Era un fin de semana que necesitaba pasar con la familia en el parque, ya que las clases  🏫 empiezan a reanudarse y mi hija también se va de casa. Una forma encantadora de crear recuerdos mientras seguimos adelante. Así que estos exquisitos bollos espolvoreados con canela fueron un capricho para la excursión familiar y nos ayudaron a disfrutar del día con mucha fruta y bebidas. 

![591C2C42-C539-4DC5-A369-C8AA215A4D06.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sUVpyvBwPK1HUj6zg5WNDzRu1hYV2jQDbhfMFYpsWiQSGnxxD1C9R2u64BVh2xf57XY.jpeg)

Es muy fácil de preparar una vez que hayas amasado y dejado que la masa suba correctamente con los ingredientes habituales, añadiendo canela para darle ese aroma característico de recién horneado.

Vamos a preparar este delicioso rollo de canela siguiendo un proceso detallado paso a paso 🥖.

# INGREDIENTES:

![E6FFA331-2520-4A18-AC42-C3B7466D4030.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xefk7MVcZe2RdRgsR4qzjVTmbbWcg6sReE6efrDkSJ31QoByo5ftqPxBSnLB6zGnMtq.jpeg)

![8ADA64F7-947C-42E5-8079-57C3B87F7479.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243fy98VNzQ4SqjGpfmjccuNGjXjHosXHxGoxQCdQVvEoHpzvsaaU7MqCDb9TWYhttMcJ.jpeg)

250 g de harina para todo uso 
1 sobre de leche en polvo cremosa
4 cucharadas soperas de azúcar 
1/4 de cucharadita de sal 
1 cucharadita de canela en polvo 
1 1/4 de cucharadita de levadura seca 
1 tapón de 10 ml de aceite vegetal
1/2 vaso de agua tibia 

# PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:

Paso 1.

![89AFE01C-8BFC-4125-9DA1-7BC2DEBC0513.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xKr7Nin71ePmcb8yhezqAW9FAethpaU7tA6R3u9t5AXFBNVSCYtxe9URZRiY63Jr32g.jpeg)

![8111FA21-B85C-4B4E-AFA5-F8C2536B58E0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uQrpVFZe1QUTcuZXzzUHxSNWV4ghUEtgGAKtKEtip6VF7dPnwyABzSMEhEX76VjMfnh.jpeg)

Empezamos echando la harina en el bol de la batidora que vemos arriba.

![462B5EA0-AFB5-424F-BD1A-C4E140AC7309.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJj1rcEArXRwBG3QuRpgW23WdMXNcX5TYbc969c8i3PLusavJuCaZwAVMfMkhSo.jpeg)

![B7BE9C8D-10EA-4DE1-B145-DCE4F1B1F191.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWw2hJ2JKctANCmt9YWWX3WJYUUpNy5uXvfecFrrMSHM4VPB86CdvnMVRe8zho7hkrs.jpeg)

Y añade los ingredientes secos: el azúcar, la sal, la levadura y la canela.

Paso 2.

![2C9CF97B-CB97-4962-9DA6-C686B06209E5.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wWw2hJ5VeNUbNYbdvCR6ceNseH9fS72QKiseYAJcipa9qMRDSnrzWFdNMSaoqGt7Xiu.jpeg)

![CCFAFD54-378A-4435-8EEB-87C2A06A6901.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23uFRQ1e4XmBw1DA3JvhQHErY3tz3rwLpQB5grjmykjAVMZFq2oY4h6jswbnPG7iPEgtd.jpeg)

Removemos para mezclarlos bien.

Paso 3.

![B97C3919-10BD-48BA-B007-A052FA045361.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2itnt8oXUr2ogUA1biViXHeJ5VBjuV86hyswjHWbBGWHxo1iksQ3WfE1FHtgqHtpCL.jpeg)

![842AEC70-1EDF-4FDD-A817-77404107E5B1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23tmMvqTNi2Buc75RtTDWab7oN5jjWHmuQcGY6NcCJJgptVSeA2NpebwsuG4ymuzairnB.jpeg)

![7F1B3D08-9BF4-407C-AD89-D0864EDD24F4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23rBNFhg82dG7YUHAME2oFhWXEi3V3FEZjsG2TWXsEvue9i7fEDcrMLUoNeowjf4MA9FJ.jpeg)

A continuación, añadimos la leche en polvo para conseguir una textura suave y deliciosa.

Paso 4.

![5837646B-9E75-4FEF-91DD-07952C91F712.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJmtKtRoDAfprReABstpGsDgp5LYp97y9qTx9sBfLqeLeuYT3yAdjsSSQjyVPD6.jpeg)

Para preparar la masa, añadimos el agua tibia poco a poco, removiendo hasta que se forme la masa 

![3D031A88-85CA-45B3-A2B6-D736BD681552.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC7vmCJadCyhESN3va4DzJ4UmbZVe4Mp59of4sgiZ6JJ7wspSVqCFHhrWca4LJWqPNg.jpeg)

![2E0706FB-2B20-4349-8A0A-09523661E74E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wC9dd3RQgUAjJCTnjvYzLdUzbxPtq4GP9ftDutaMkHaxsm1SvLodTnG6ME7mHTDRod7.jpeg)

![DC57FDD1-5FA8-413E-9548-E3D306E613C0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245nBuMe52edaDcd3BT5j6uUcnrUJgukDNsSwFcrZQ2HR958iMnkxLeBmxU75fVSL4uGv.jpeg)

Y para conseguir una masa fina, añadimos el aceite vegetal y amasamos bien.

Paso 5.

![B13B12A8-17B8-4062-8377-EA2884FCC223.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK6Z5rq6MDrCuxdnfnzVz6RgBaUm53fraHNokqawiRHhyRh4pGfc5aTa83cB8m6.jpeg)

Cortamos la masa en trozos iguales y los extendemos uno a uno con un rodillo de madera. 

![63A8F855-859E-4EA4-A4F1-477F6E366C33.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgS9YZnqGrhi8HdTWLoVWf9jRP7nQ5HqWNidLsWq48ABMJ2gGsWct9M3U43ktdi81qV.jpeg)

![459D0CBE-F957-46A5-B59F-13C0AA20D0C7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x1Dc415nMGDG4oini8YDgjf2Ri7B2yszKNJsttxCNpCKKuDxJLFy1FmacxziWQ9dM2Q.jpeg)

![94943CCA-6FF5-4743-B35A-9F8187BB8CB6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2uVrEBpN27QDb8Mirkdm2WTKFx5FMEvfAdTopq4h94Bt3dLB7MkD4GFFnws7FVaQbX.jpeg)

Y espolvorea un poco de canela por toda la superficie; aplana un poco más la masa con el rodillo antes de enrollarla 🥖.

Las colocamos en la bandeja de horno, las tapamos y las dejamos reposar en un lugar cálido durante unos 25-30 minutos hasta que dupliquen su tamaño.

Paso 7.

![4610C49E-F3DC-4061-9756-D3E87899A860.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242NoQrS7YK9sFEYQ4iibkCprSmpgjPva6896jio5beok5mz7CV3YJZ3Hf7V6ApPmjw2J.jpeg)

A continuación, las metemos en el horno precalentado y las horneamos durante 20 minutos hasta que queden doradas y crujientes,

title.title: Persimmons In Oil Pastels, Start The First Day Of May With Art!
title.body:
>
The story behind this drawing is that when I was still on my highschool or college era, I used to watch kdrama, the influence in food is number one for me, I remembered I used to be curious about “Kimchi” and I love to taste it because on how delicious they ate it so I decided to make one and at first I was hesitate but when I know what to do with it, I can’t stop making it. When sangyupsal was still starting here in the Philippines, I always asked my family to eat one for experience, and I am telling you right now, sangyupsal is better before than now. And back to the topic the one k drama I used to watch ate persimmons it look good so me and my cousin try to find one on the market and we saw one and I didn’t like it at all it taste like chico like we have here and lately my mom bought some and I tasted it, it taste different from what we bought on the market, the reason is that the persimmon is overripe so that is why LOL. So yeah, I decided to draw a persimmon in oil pastel today, and to start the first day of the month of May! Oh, by the way, it is Labor Day today. -----
Materials I Used:

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc9zYoKcwCoqL9Lz5RVB4kPPJ5hyWzceZHN6MUwYi44ztCcTLwroYR7nt42UEpWM4C.JPG) I promise myself to be productive starting today. To draw the line art, I use pretty much any color my hand touches. It is fine. -----

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokfwyBpvAMdSi9ky5LdRRbV2ABrnrpXhZdTmrMejU6yVZ8oP6hd8ACGUwm6t9tYEZ6.JPG) Start by layering the base color on each part of the persimmon. I do it lightly in the moment. ----

> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc9VCK3RTAXqLRjTUWEcrKWadN6GnusST7PSYcarQoFHixKGveaCAti4zjxJdjjhYT.JPG) Then I layer it with more of its base color I start to add the shadows to the part that is darker. -----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokgXjPVg3zvzREnfwLjDVbhCeBfd4WKxCdpuQSEAV12oATsPiNWVp6vUyNn2tGanwS.JPG) Sometimes when I am so focused on one part, I always forget the other part, so that is my focus on this part. -----

> ![10.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3gDop4P66H6CfWaUR8XxGPF85noJvpd35a5d5icDoD6tXprCGts2ivmc5kvBu6co4.JPG) I was doubting whether I would use green as a background color, but I still did. -----
> ![12.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoke1NwARwU5F1ei42y3vJrEWQyM9ntgk3KfemcvCs7Wg9hv82x9rBqTAVrfnLvCnDp.JPG) I like the blend, some of it with white. -----

> ![16.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonkURprduAseu6giMKpT5P5rSA1SV9nzpiRYFR6xe9VR3D4PBGQPakqX921EyTgo9a.JPG) I never forget the accent colors. I finally decided green is the background color, so commit to it. -----

> ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokdYjWqLTkGPaPLxJyY5v4gtoNXWmpM56jJX9R2qye37Gp2897EkZTp33wtLdUEVu9.JPG) This one is my favorite part of the process, adding texture using a scratching tool. -----

> ![21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos2JRVegxE4DQJTEYc8H7Mbjs7BLbo4XpFbVo5j1VZxSZ2bETr4MqsKiTCaCKiXvzR.JPG) Here is the close-up look. I love the texture that oil pastel makes. ----- ![22.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc7ZFeJ3uPWJLpzv7kn415FFEeaQgstMGSXidkb9D8t1dZLxPKxGrRQr51PeygY8bi.JPG) I hope you like it :D ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---

title.title: I Spilled Water On My Old Plugin Calculator, a song. 5.1.2026
title.body:
allowfullscreen></iframe>

This is the latest song I put up on my Youtube Channel, of David777111. Where I wrote the lyrics and used SUNO AI to make the music and LyricEdits to make the video.

Well, it all happened when I had a glass of water on my little table where I also do my bills. I knocked over the glass by accident and water was all over, then I noticed my plug in calculator was wet also, and I noticed no numbers on the screen, cause I never turn off my plug in calculator. To me it doesn't use that much electricity.

So I unplugged it, cause who knows what else can happen with a shorted plugged in calculator? Then I thought, hey this story can be a song, and I will call it, I Spilled Water On My Old Plugin Calculator, a song.

So I used SUNO AI and told it, I wanted a pop/rock with a motif running through the song. I told it I wanted a strong chorus with Soprano, Alto, Tenor, and Bass in the vocals for the chorus.

I did write all the lyrics as I didn't want to the AI to take all the credit of the song. This way I still have some control over the song and besides I am a writer of sorts. I mean I am writing this blog of a song where I did use the AI, but I wanted to write the lyrics. So there. I don't want to give the AI all the credit.

How old was my old plugin calculator, I think I bought it in the 80's or 90's so it is decades old and I am sorry to see it go. It is like having a car that would always start and take you to where ever you wanted to go, then one day the car didn't work at all and it was too expensive to fix.

Yes, you just can't go and have your plugin calculator fixed cause it would be cheaper just to buy another plugin calculator.

Well, I did just that, only I bought 5 handheld battery calculators and it cost me about 20 dollars. Yes if you are going to buy a small handheld calculator you might as well buy more than one, cause a little thing like that can get lost and then I would have to buy another one. So I bought 5 and put them in different places in the house. I don't think I can lose all five that way.

So anyway, I did enjoy the song, and I thought I would write a little blog about it. Please go ahead and click on the image you see to play the song.

Let's end with a scripture, as it is written, A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing; Ecclesiastes 3:5.

If you enjoyed this blog, please upvote and follow.
Thank you, David Oyog.
Video is mine on my Youtube, channel, called, David777111.

title.body:

***

沙漠是一个神秘而又壮观的地方，辽阔的沙丘在阳光下闪烁着金黄色的光芒，让人感受到自然的伟大和宁静。偶尔的风掠过，带来阵阵沙粒的低语，仿佛在诉说着岁月的故事。在这里，虽然环境极其恶劣，却也能够感受到一种独特的孤独与自由，仿佛时间在此凝固，心灵得到了释放。沙漠的美在于它的原始和纯粹，让人反思生命的意义与自我存在的价值。

title.title: [EN/ES] Girl in a dress (Chica con vestido)
title.body:
### Girl in a dress > ### Chica con vestido ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWCS2wXuvV2iZXmTycLGPNwVYrfx44CF8UuTN4hbUFFqj/286_sin_t_tulo_20260422000632.jpg) Hello, I share with you my latest drawing, a study from a reference of a girl wearing a nice dress and ballet slippers. It's a drawing made digitally in the Ibis Paint app. I tried to emulate pencil-on-paper work, since that's what I wanted as a result, for that I used a brush with a graphite texture. Also at the end I added some lights and some shadows to increase the volumes. This study took me about an hour and helped me practice everything I've been sharing so far on my blog: human face, female anatomy, and hatching. I hope you like my drawing, and I share the step-by-step process with you. > Hola, les comparto mi último dibujo: un estudio a partir de referencia de una chica usando un bonito vestido y con zapatillas de ballet. Es un dibujo realizado digitalmente en la aplicación de Ibis Paint. Traté de emular el trabajo de lápiz sobre papel, ya que es lo que quería como resultado, para eso me apoyé de un pincel con textura de grafito. También al final agregué algunas luces y algunas sombras para aumentar los volúmenes. Este estudio me tomó alrededor de una hora y me sirvió para practicar todo lo que he estado compartiendo hasta ahora en mi blog: rostro humano, anatomía femenina y hatching. Espero que les guste mi dibujo y les comparto el paso a paso del proceso. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkGNMNpwnFc8UmBdzU3MTF8PgsRd154QQCSt8KNH45T2/videocapture_20260501_100425.jpg) I started by creating the base and structure of the body from simple shapes. I have drawn this pose few times, so it will be a bit challenging. It's not the best structure I've made, but it will work as a base. I tried to find points of tension and gravity in my reference and transfer them to my structure. > Comencé creando la base y estructura del cuerpo a partir de formas simples. Esta pose la he dibujado pocas veces, así que tendrá un poco de reto. No es la mejor estructura que he hecho, pero funcionará como base. Traté de encontrar puntos de tensión y de gravedad en mi referencia y traspasarlos a mi estructura. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXSKiMPGSTdo9fBTamDpHDNwV7tELzHH5yLr23ULmUce/videocapture_20260501_100429.jpg) With my sketch and structure ready, I'll simply lower the opacity of the layer to start drawing. This is a great advantage of making drawings digitally: you can simply lower opacities or disable layers and keep drawing, which makes the workflow simpler and more visual. > Con mi boceto y estructura listos, simplemente bajaré la opacidad de la capa para comenzar a dibujar. Esto es una gran ventaja que tiene hacer dibujos en digital: simplemente puedes bajar opacidades o desactivar capas y seguir dibujando, lo que hace el flujo de trabajo más simple y más visual. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiA32KQWi6D86Wpyof1ogUYoVnhpCq8jQMVFRMPwwWaJ/videocapture_20260501_100438.jpg) Now I will start focusing on the shapes of the face and the elements that compose it. Since this is a topic I am just beginning and don't fully understand yet, I can make many mistakes when it comes to proportions, so I have to erase again and again and keep trying. > Ahora sí comenzaré a centrarme en las formas del rostro y en los elementos que lo componen. Como es un tema que apenas estoy empezando y no comprendo del todo, puedo cometer muchos errores a la hora de las proporciones, así que tengo que borrar una y otra vez y seguir intentándolo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWZg4ZNxEhr4rqvViyCGMmXM57hJi4QMD5JR6JetNGqFj/videocapture_20260501_100450.jpg) Now I will start focusing on the shapes of the face and the elements that compose it. Since this is a topic I am just beginning and don't fully understand yet, I can make many mistakes when it comes to proportions, so I have to erase again and again and keep trying. > Ahora sí comenzaré a centrarme en las formas del rostro y en los elementos que lo componen. Como es un tema que apenas estoy empezando y no comprendo del todo, puedo cometer muchos errores a la hora de las proporciones, así que tengo que borrar una y otra vez y seguir intentándolo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXaeeZ3idsYvf5NfZiaTTKrgyyxg1HQh3QfpoSGU6E68K/videocapture_20260501_100517.jpg) With the general elements of my drawing placed and all the parts of the body, it is slowly taking shape. > Con los elementos generales de mi dibujo colocados y todas las partes del cuerpo, va cogiendo forma poco a poco. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBknkZwPMNJxRtDiEL7mgPv66KVoJD3WkgVhe4j2jCvm/videocapture_20260501_100523.jpg) I used different types of hatching to frame the darkest and deepest areas of the drawing. > Utilicé distintos tipos de hatching para enmarcar las zonas más oscuras y profundas del dibujo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwZUf43vUpkSB6aZKU6zvycn9obASQApc9oq34hSaHaH/videocapture_20260501_100553.jpg) Using a solid brush, I also added areas of complete darkness and the details of the dress, the hair, the bow, and the ballet slippers; with an intermediate tone, the areas where the light doesn't reach the skin. > Utilizando un pincel sólido también agregué zonas de completa oscuridad y los detalles del vestido, el cabello, el lazo y las zapatillas; con un tono intermedio, las zonas donde no le da la luz en la piel. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSFYL6PWQNgXxisZegHcrXoNySLSWVQ6AKaK62Rh1vbY/videocapture_20260501_100620.jpg) As a final result, I obtained this study, which was a fairly comprehensive practice of what I have learned during this time. Additionally, I think the drawing turned out quite nice, and I am somewhat proud of the small advances and progress I have made. > Como resultado final obtuve este estudio, que fue una práctica bastante completa de lo que he aprendido durante este tiempo. Además, considero que el dibujo quedó bastante resultón y estoy algo orgulloso de los pequeños avances y progresos que he obtenido. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWCS2wXuvV2iZXmTycLGPNwVYrfx44CF8UuTN4hbUFFqj/286_sin_t_tulo_20260422000632.jpg) Thank you for accompanying me one more day of drawing. > Gracias por acompañarme un día más dibujando. --- ***About:*** ==*Sketchbook and Journal of a Learner*== **If you like my content, join my [Fanbase clicking here](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=nestodibuja&i=2)**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc31AecQSitU5xAjsqS4snajcWh6CMMyapx88itjomSah/thanks.png)
___ *All photos and images are created by me. These are pictures of my sketchbook. Many of my drawings are practice pieces rather than finished works. Images from the internet may or may not have been used as references, copies, or sources of inspiration as part of my learning process.*

title.body: Finance is very essential for students to thrive well academically, the expenses in higher institutions now is just too much, the cost of living in our society is high and it's really affecting students. The high cost of data, daily feeding, house rent wahala , test books/hangout, and many other basic expenses. They need money to achieve all of these and even more. It's not easy for students, and they need so much support. It's difficult for students to strive academically facing financial struggles and even when they get a side hustle it is always difficult for them to balance both activities. I support side gigs amongst students and I encourage many students I know to have a side gig, because having a side gig back in school really helped me as a student, even when there's support, it's necessary to still have a side gig, just to be able to provide some personal needs. For struggling students, it's usually difficult to balance school activities and a side hustle, but with determination and proper balance of activities, I believe they can achieve academic success. @chefqueen @goldenproject @cohlson @marsdave @afrikens It's another hangout 🥳🥳

title.title: Another cultural option in Havana, monument to Luz y Caballeros (en/es)
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbR49T1XfQ7dLokzWSPwmrUe7MMQdnRJ2qicFU232XHp8/1777645728937.jpg)

ENGLISH VERSIÓN 

Greetings to the hivers of the community.

Today I propose that we come and take a closer look at a site that I consider very interesting in the area of ​​Havana's Puerto Avenue. It is a monument that I have not heard of with the resonance that is mentioned of other monuments in the oldest part of the capital. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcp6PfBcXmfFbPeMEJZsESHowakSunW5PRDrY4D6p48bS/1777645948900.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqDwNtpP4Bt5D5c9ttLyJQXfxenPT2efy3wajTHmBMMi/1777645949224.jpg)

What causes me the most admiration about this place is the presence of gravel-type stones on the floor of the pedestal. Every time I pass by, I see the same scene, as if they were original components of the monument. And although I have never asked about such a thing, I think with almost certainty that they were added for another reason.

And I do not see any connection to the majestic monument erected to José de la Luz y Caballero, who is said to have been the first to teach us how to think, and who was also the teacher of our José Martí and a good part of his generation back in the 19th century.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZ2dJGvnAKH4jxUsRsLxbcHkHv4reXcvV2GrZPxfiDz4/1777646136105.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU8u19ttCZS4MSB24yZeLmEMmAFNLZoJCTEADtJjUdCnw/1777646136330.jpg)

The truth is that around the base of the monument the small stones are present in abundance, but well scattered like a protective layer of the stepped floor around the monument to the illustrious thinker and teacher.

The location, despite being very close to the constant movement of cars through the arteries of the port avenue, is a peaceful place where you can breathe the soft and purified air of wisdom.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme1hZ9h1Jk1DahHkFQhMArtgQaVYrxsDZ3UwzSb34YTPp/1777647310386.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWYYutBz2vR5xH7HkK8Qz7PjWm7QFHrDPDMDXLMxsEhn9/1777647310574.jpg)

The sitter is sitting as if he had just crossed his legs, with one hand resting on the pedestal, while with the other in his lap he looks up and looks from above at the another side of the bay, perhaps beyond Morro and La Cabaña, finding a philosophical solution to a concern of the restless youth of the time.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRB88ETTaEMsH87HAMEYVE4vEtFaAzzGkz2kHuv9ibCBb/1777646992334.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcZDqRER8HeJNmJL5headhNFyQt6Qyixb645Uz4cVzjp/1777646992716.jpg)

The seated figure diffused in bronze is life-size, its movement was reflected as life-like. As if wanting to give an anti-academic and relaxed attitude, it hints at the hidden spirit of freedom that induced the students.

It is good that, in gratitude for their great contributions to the people, large commemorative monuments are erected for them. But for me, personally, I would like them to be a little lower so that I could talk to them and have them share their experiences with us face to face. Furthermore, these great allegories almost always contrast and sometimes contradict their economic conditions and their social ideas, especially their humility.

But hey, the monument also has its own laws, and those chosen to be on the pedestals have to abide by them; or else they are left out of those stories. This monument to José de la Luz y Caballero, an essential Cuban in our history, who came to life at the very beginning of the 19th century and who left the physical plane in 1962, is a recognition, in the first instance, in the light of the knowledge that he put in the heads of the Cubans of the time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXKrLFsNvvd9kqwLCmKEhoGMMSTHQXZz37BwYeoRfUsnb/1777647092669.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3etRWLCKg3MGRV1WiParu2G2UWJASr98kCiBr5cUpGS/1777647092966.jpg)

I like this place because it is peaceful and because it invites reflection and meditation, since it takes me back in retrograde lines to the time when this eminent character was among the students, teaching and educating to overcome a raw and painful time of slavery and colonialism.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW5vgDWtEhaUR7H5hFEBC12BBDQLuSkAVnpnzXzyDHjCZ/1777647195772.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdBw3jH925bYr98yGWzfnTzTkTWC2vXpqyFEZj47XyJeT/1777647196046.jpg)

Thank you for accompanying me to visit this quiet and beautiful place.

Original text of my authorship.  
All rights reserved © davidsantafe.

>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL 

>Saludos para los hivers de la comunidad.

>Hoy les propongo que nos acerquemos a observar de cerca un sitio que considero muy interesante en la zona de la avenida del Puerto habanero. Es un monumento del que no he oído hablar con la resonancia que se menciona de otros monumentos en la parte más vieja de la capital.

>A mí lo que más admiración me causa de este lugar es la presencia de piedras tipo gravilla en el piso del pedestal. Cada vez que paso cerca, veo la misma escena, como si las mismas fueran componentes originales del monumento. Y aunque yo nunca he preguntado por tal cosa, pienso casi con certeza que fueron agregadas por otro motivo.

>Y es que no le veo ninguna conexión al majestuoso monumento erigido a José de la Luz y Caballero, de quien se dice que fue el primero que nos enseñó a pensar, y que además fue maestro de nuestro José Martí y de buena parte de su generación allá por el siglo XIX.

>Lo cierto es que alrededor de la base del monumento están presentes en abundancia, pero bien diseminadas, las pequeñas piedras como una capa protectora del piso escalonado alrededor del monumento al ilustre pensador y maestro.

>El emplazamiento, a pesar de estar bien cerca del trasiego constante de los autos por las arterias de la avenida del puerto, es un lugar apacible donde se respira el aire suave y purificado de la sabiduría.

>El retratado está sentado como si acabara de cruzar las piernas, con una mano apoyada en el pedestal, mientras que con la otra en el regazo levanta la vista y mira desde lo alto al otro lado de la bahía, quizás más allá de Morro y la Cabaña, encontrando una solución filosófica a una preocupación de la inquieta juventud de la época.

>La figura sedente difundida en bronce es a tamaño natural, como natural fue reflejado su movimiento. Como queriendo dar una actitud antiacadémica y relajada, insinúa el espíritu oculto de la libertad que inducía a los alumnos.

>Es bueno que, en agradecimiento a sus grandes aportes a los pueblos, se les erijan grandes monumentos conmemorativos. Pero a mí, en lo particular, me gustaría que estuviesen un poco más bajos para poder conversar con ellos y que nos transmitan de tú a tú sus experiencias. Además, casi siempre esas grandes alegorías contrastan y a veces se contraponen con sus condiciones económicas y sus ideas sociales, sobre todo con su humildad.

>Pero bueno, la monumentaria también tiene sus propias leyes, y los elegidos para estar en los pedestales tienen que acatarlas; o, de lo contrario, se quedan fuera de esas historias. Este monumento a José de la Luz y Caballero, cubano esencial en nuestra historia, que llegó a la vida en el mismo principio del siglo XIX y que dejó el plano físico en el año 1962, es un reconocimiento, en primera instancia, a la luz del saber que puso en la cabeza de los cubanos de la época.

>A mí me gusta este lugar por apacible y porque invita a la reflexión y la meditación, ya que me traslada en líneas regresivas al tiempo en que este eminente personaje andaba entre los alumnos, enseñando y educando para superar una época cruda y dolorosa de esclavitud y colonialismo.

>Gracias por acompañarme a visitar este tranquilo y hermoso lugar.

>Texto original de mi autoría.
