title.title: CREATING 'FAKE NEWSPAPER' ARTICLES WITH NIGHTCAFE AI
title.body:
AI HAS COME A LONG WAY SINCE IT'S PRIMITIVE BEGINNINGS - I've been with Nightcafe for over 5 years when I thought it was too goofy to take serious. Like my very first creation, called [Canary in a Mineshaft](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/creation/s3CY0ywSS4nhO4QEnLWX).

*“AI won‘t be fool proof in the future since it will only as good as the data and information that we give it to learn. It could be the case that simple elementary tricks could fool the AI algorithm and it may serve a complete waste of output as a result.”*
[Zoltan Andrejkovics](https://www.goodreads.com/author/show/14726163.Zoltan_Andrejkovics)
▲
personally, I do not agree - this is too simplistic of a statement
For those who are interested, I wrote a blog about AI and Hallucinations: [Surrealism, Hallucination, and the Art of Working With AI](https://ottorapp.wordpress.com/2026/04/12/surrealism-hallucination-and-the-art-of-working-with-ai/)

But lets deal with the subject of creating 'fake newspapers' with AI. I actually stumbled on this capability by accident, using a newly introduced model on Nightcafe called *GPT Image* (there are several versions, from 1.5 to 2, Low, Medium and High). Myself, I used the *[GPT Image 2 Low](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/model/gpt-image-2-low)* because it is the most economical and yet very powerful model.

About yesterday's Walpurgisnacht

Just for a lark, I only wrote this prompt (in German): *Detailierte Nachrichten über die Walpurgisnacht und die Geschichte dahinter - als Zeitungsartikel anzeigen*
WALPURGISNACHT - MYTHOS, TRADITION UND BRAUCHTUM
![sWWJafqdHN71NR3hweFw--0--ClZQ2-x2200px.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AKYPd4wg3tciheSX4JZMDAuxKfUgnWW7874vbJsZzg7pytVAWRv37stPejRVBVM.jpg)

I sent this to my sister via WhatsApp, and she passed it on, but said that I had created this with AI. Then she told me that one of her 'less bright' friends thought that I worked for the newspaper and had written it for them. To which I could only comment with a facepalm🤦‍♀. --- The very first 'News' I created (more by accident than by design) was to put my frustration about some silly Nightcafe 'Rules' for Challenges into words - I had in past conversations in a group called 'Fine Art' stated that the so called 'moderators' are like the Taliban.
![YdkMoYxWRtXKzWvYLslm--0--OOnai.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AKpBTgi9KRAXrVHJapYJ3vVGFh7qGpNuUnRL3TvwVvLtfQuhr8chrHgSYyPRpUQ.jpg) - this, btw, was the 'rejected' entry
![hu1enlKtl2ECwt7UJqmy--0--bcAik (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/EoEpch4x8LJT8EuUBT7WGQCJZDpNoA3BKWNn7xaHfLCPyN7CsQckkc6W4w3dMYJc4bj.jpg)
THE FINAL ESCAPE OF TILL EULENSPIEGEL FROM DR. MOREAU'S INSANE ASYLUM
Your entry was rejected by the moderators.
Rejection Reason: Inappropriate and Offensive Depictions / Disturbing and Harmful Themes
Needless to say, one of the top entries was a cute kitten in a teacup! So far, I had no chance to enter this one:
![rIjVDJ9i3qGhujFWS3Wk--0--1khyE (1)x200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AK6Y5xVS5ALJVboRsWFDdvchoRnTMpBLiSLp2m2JmRm8CXh39iw6dD2K53FXkaC.jpg)Imade this as a reaction to a earlier post (also done with GPT):
![4GHb0CpOfmXJJYJCf6Xi--0--2pmR__resized_2x-real-esrgan-x4-plus (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/23tmFYj1MvxWQZbJFMykFQH4Z3HGVn86sqsbcatPLxK8LajHsH6xZ2ZWF2VKEKTHQRZ6J.jpg)
Now it seems I am on a roll - a previous idea was transposed into a hilareous fake spoof:
![HSInhNG6bBQoYDCKyOAG--0--TqCZV-x2200px.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AKKTUeNdPT9Wr8BgqwaKRi6aUgX7RejXjjRwkJzMqtk2Bzk47Unh2eBSZWbMxjL.jpg)A previous piece about 'Schurli':![W30R5Ziv2WKk6OW32kaK--0--a665h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/23tS12fRWFqXzZHonuqPWVyr6hdtz5fgZiHzs9h7AfiMRjcshvka6SWj33SgD8mB5zMx8.jpg)
Inbetween I switched over to Deep Dream Text2Dream, to see if their GPT model could produce similar results. In fact, it did:
![Zx2u3mQ9EvWXXQXIQtls-O8JBr.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AKPn9UKvrYYFfZoxw3oC7NC9xRg3ZUsTR617VR98Z24Z3GrynmQYCh5ee8MN2Fz.jpg)
Previously, I had used the sam prompt on Nightcafe, again with GPT:
![uZwZdjsq8J6Juu48ibTi--0--LkoI7_4x-real-esrgan-x4-plus.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AKDjsiePDMcKAEYicR28vfqHUiKi6h724i3RvHsH19TfS5ke2hYmv4E9BmWfSTJ.jpg)
A fellow member was so impressed, she used my prompt to make her own (my prompts are always open) - she was enthusiastic and thanked me profusely for letting her use my prompt *Thank you so much TheMystic for your amazing beautiful open prompt* ❤️🥰🤗:
![Bildschirmfoto_1-5-2026_16523_creator.nightcafe.studio.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/23xerRSL8GBDr66CioP3gsLxFL5m26t7YfSfH5mdR5MVjmJPk899i11q7RMg6tdg4wQxt.jpg)[Mirjam on Nightcafe](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/creation/kUEwU9mBeLO3aS1c0xmT/the-best-artistic-ai-creations-are-those-that-are-based-on-good-analog-artwork-seed-images-used-toge)
If I wanted to, I could use my prompt again, because the model would churn out different variations every time. But I also mentioned to her in our conversation in the group, that she could use the basics of the prompt and just change some wordings to make it uniquely hers. ---
Politics and what bothers me
I had in the past been very critical, so some of my previous poster ideas are now translated to a newspaper page: ![ikfEAhyicRcWzvEnsX9s--0--hutJq.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/23zGgSbfR8eYf7Xq6FnhBqwf1PRorBcLyzHzcdS1J5deNjUfNjJA4RohgoomuXsbypXjJ.jpg)
![yddQKb7BZ3HWN1o4BOCy-EnU3N.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/23zS9hfYJzUMUzeUTX7Z6ycJcgSUhZXf5xYS3frxMDk2Fi2rVaygLVN5K7csueeMDPZFV.jpg)The Poster Boy
--- October 2025 I published [A TRIBUTE TO DAME JANE GOODALL (1934-2025)](https://peakd.com/janegoodall/@thermoplastic/a-tribute-to-dame-jane-goodall-1934-2025) - at that time, I used Seedream 4.0 for the main image:
![A Tribute to Jane Goodall](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AKRBTDjkHaMbiUnn2mSafrSkok7MuW87eaa4PtS23HAYZAxRHNQxaJYppwxqCHR.jpg)
This time, I used *[GTP Image 2 Low](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/model/gpt-image-2-low)*:

![rBsipAPMXueVr1qKyvCv--0--7NI1Y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/23ynfVWeFRqyC7iczHTtEVp7KqtJcFb9hdjzmt5UF7wqGtumZpmGY3F3ZskQ2BYrixW81.jpg)
--- My page on Nightcafe is here: [ART OF THE MYSTIC ON NIGHTCAFE](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/u/TheMystic) - should you be interested in what you could do on Nightcafe, here is a [INVITATION LINK](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/?ru=TheMystic), this is how it would work (for both of us):
*Friends will get 20 free PRO creations if they sign up through your link, and you'll earn credits as they progress through their NightCafe journey.*

You can sign up to a regular free account (I am on a first level Pro Account). Before, I just had a free account, and it worked pretty well for me also. But there are many pro models now that it does make sense to eventually go pro. But just for testing it out, a regular account works pretty well, some of those regular models are actually quite good, I am particularly impressed with [Dreamshaper XL Lightning](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/model/dreamshaper-xl-lightning-sfw) and better even is [Z-Image Turbo](https://creator.nightcafe.studio/model/z-image-turbo). There are several more models available to free accounts, particularly the ones called 'Lightning' are quite good. ---

Visit my website
▼

[ ![Artofthemystic-Logo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AK577aSx7aHC4qHHzNvrJtnPT6G7u4nrazKedvZQwQmidkFefcNnLd56dcD8PXT.jpg) ](https://www.artofthemystic.com/)

PRINTS OF MY ARTWORK AVAILABLE HERE:
[![PIXELS SHOP BANNER.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/jM38sIYZ-PIXELS20SHOP20BANNER.JPG)](https://otto-rapp.pixels.com/)

Bonus Special: VINDOBONA ALTARPIECE III
(Before we forget I actually also create analog art!)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C6Pefu2Hmi8

[MY INTRODUCTION - ABOUT MY WORK](https://peakd.com/introduceyourself/@thermoplastic/about-my-work) [![8DAuGnTQCLpunQuGfHnXTmxWbRQScCVGspXNWFwLnDsievuea4qyU1jVqMigCzEvt4PGods7ySn9eXsNaEFKADmWJiGrx4imu5D4DN3p6e6chyfMnsaT9Jcc9pE6rb2ZJYLAGdHew4mr5txGR5zJz6dto92J52ZRbX3ZDVk87nN.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/23uFcNpkP1dQ257RY1iHVbZkioEdNjnn7WUY1756mThM3iYJdUA8ywhjrRDDr6K1dJKpU.jpg)](https://peakd.com/introduceyourself/@thermoplastic/about-my-work) should you not be on the blockchain, or have no upvote power, or this post is already older than 7 days, you can always just [buy me a coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/artofthemystic).
![GIF FOR PEAKD POSTS.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thermoplastic/AKHzfRu2oRtkA6DJQ4HgscyNtuRRShtdsxEdcAmmwGjmogDjSefbGTQV9LuJ2rt.gif)

Final Words of wisdom and a pet concern of mine, especially about art diplomas:
I had in years past come across quite a few 'fake diplomas' that pretend to be academic credentials. Next to '[Pay to Play Galleries](https://medium.com/@michalplis/exploring-ethics-of-pay-to-play-galleries-in-the-art-world-31393dc0b42e)' they are the scourge to be avoided. The summary of a paper about this spells it out
[DEGREE MILLS - THE BILLION DOLLAR INDUSTRY](https://aaar.assembly.ca.gov/sites/aaar.assembly.ca.gov/files/reports/Intro%20to%20Degree%20Mills.pdf)
If you google the title you will find where this book is available, but also there are many videos on this subject.

title.title: 🌫️ Somewhere Between Dreams and Reality
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaG1SdaULHKrVBgAzsZvwhayeXX8QSknN2NWBnLfvcCxG/IMG_7407.jpg 

Lately I’ve been thinking a lot about the future.

About how strange life feels when you’re young and full of dreams, but still trying to figure out how to make them real. Sometimes it feels exciting… and other times honestly a little scary.

I want to become a lawyer more than anything. I want a life where I can feel proud of myself, where I know all the hard moments actually meant something.

But right now, I’m still somewhere in the middle.

Not at the destination yet. Just walking the road toward it.

And maybe that’s okay.

Maybe not having everything solved at 19 doesn’t mean I’m failing. Maybe it just means I’m still building my story step by step, even on the days when the road feels lonely or uncertain.

So I’ll keep going.

Even slowly.
Even imperfectly.
Even afraid sometimes.

Because my dreams still matter to me.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@minirivera/-somewhere-between-dreams-and-reality-8mc)

title.title: Not Much Ambiguity | Daily Writing Prompt Day 3089
title.body:
I didn’t go there to see him.

I went there to end it.

The bus stop was crowded, like always.
People coming and going, buses stopping, horns everywhere.

But somehow, everything felt distant.

He walked up to me and said, “Hey.”

I looked up. “Hey.”

And then we just stood there.

No real conversation.
Just that uncomfortable silence you can’t fill, no matter how hard you try.

I had already decided.
I wasn’t going to drag it out.

So I said, “Can I be honest with you for a second?”

He nodded. “Yeah.”

I took a breath and said it, simple and clear—
“I don’t think this is working anymore.”

For a second, he just stared at me.

Like he wasn’t expecting it.

Then he let out a small laugh and said,
“Yeah… I was going to say the same thing.”

I didn’t react.

Because somehow… that made sense.

Maybe we both knew it for a while,
we just didn’t say it out loud.

A bus pulled up right then.

I adjusted my bag and said, “Take care.”

He said, “You too.”

And that was it.

No drama.
No begging.
No confusion.

I got on the bus, found a seat by the window, and didn’t look back.

Sometimes, endings aren’t messy.

Sometimes… they’re just clear.

Not much ambiguity.

title.title: Star Trek: Discovery Season 1, Episode 4, Movie review
title.body:
>



How are you all? You know, I often share my feelings after watching episodes of this series. Today I watched the fourth episode of season 1 of Star Trek: Discovery, and to be honest, this episode moved me a little differently.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPDKrFQFxyHNNj2MCGCr4kohZ6T6w1NeTVpkqzLarehHA/Screenshot_2026_0501_223512.jpg

 

There was a strange tension from the beginning. Although the story progressed by maintaining the continuity of the previous episodes, everything seemed to become deeper and darker here. The more the experiment with the spore drive on the USS Discovery progresses, the more I feel uneasy.
  
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNiLi5RAX66N2XLR2H9QDWhFx8R22jTZrrfpH59fZN1Pu/IMG_20260501_224215.png

Michael Burnham, this character, has always seemed a little different to me. His inner conflict is very well expressed in this episode. He realises that the creature they are using (Tardigrade) is suffering.  But at the same time, he is part of a larger war, where decisions are not always straightforward. I clearly felt that hesitation in his eyes.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWx69NKDDZbVXH252RNwh4n1zQGv1A7Bt9SKFoFMLK68M/Screenshot_20260501_223543.jpg 
Captain Gabriel Lorca, the more I see him, the more I feel that this man is not entirely believable. His decisions in this episode are very harsh and a bit of a “win at all costs” type. To him, that creature is just a tool, a weapon—but this approach seems a bit cruel to me.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRrDRqt7dnLdSWrkP3jTRrf3awouiJYymNF22Fcekx4dd/Screenshot_20260501_223744.jpg 

Lieutenant Paul Stamets, He is quite important in this episode. Although he seems like a cold-hearted scientist at first, he gradually understands what they are doing. The change inside him is shown very subtly.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmapxnhqa31Ce3Zc7GqeaAK22k64UVhix8ATWs9cBNeM5y/Screenshot_2026_0501_223617.jpg 

Tilly, the character, also brings a bit of a lighthearted feel to this episode. Her simplicity and sincerity sometimes reduce the tension a bit. But she is not just there for laughs; her presence creates a balance in the story.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQm9kk3e5MPtK7ZccCzWgaZAx2gZeB4JyXm3oXB1S1W7P/Screenshot_2026_0501_223758.jpg 

 Ash Tyler, His mental state after returning from the Klingons is slowly emerging here. I really felt a little bad for him. He seems to be trapped inside himself.

And most importantly, the Tardigrade. The real emotion of this episode seems to revolve around this creature. It is not a machine, not a weapon — it is a living being. When its suffering was being shown, to be honest, a suppressed unease was working inside me. At that time, it seemed like how far can we go in the name of technological progress?
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRhQiwKPcCjQS7SJ5wszeM3i7ZJis4fJWgdxBGVZNc7Dn/Screenshot_2026_0501_223940.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcymS9PeENrSTFyth5LuUrY3s6RtuUFMGWAGx41HKyGBW/Screenshot_2026_0501_223816.jpg 

The title of the episode actually says it all.
\

That is, the one who cuts never hears the cry of the victim. This is reflected throughout the episode. Finally, this episode made me face a question — How much price are we willing to pay for victory? And is that price always fair? Personally speaking, this is not just a science fiction episode; it is a feeling, a conflict, a silent question. If you have seen it, let me know how you liked this episode. https://youtu.be/qSwYXVShXVM?si=EKDjKFWmVX7uhwTZ [All images screenshot collect by watching movie]() Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mirzaiqi/star-trek-discovery-season-1-episode-4-movie-review--ljw)

title.title: Gordito y su momento de estrella bajo el sol [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![qtFlcgU3OhcdV6x5_1000310018.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/qtFlcgU3OhcdV6x5_1000310018/qtFlcgU3OhcdV6x5_1000310018.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

A veces, las mejores fotografías no necesitan escenarios lujosos ni cámaras profesionales… solo el momento perfecto, una buena luz y, por supuesto, un modelo tan hermoso como mi gato Gordito.

Hace poco logré capturar una imagen suya que, sinceramente, me dejó enamorada. Allí estaba él, tranquilo, elegante, bañado por la luz cálida del sol que entraba suavemente, iluminando cada detalle de su carita, sus bigotes y ese pelaje naranja que parece brillar por sí solo.

Por un instante, Gordito dejó de ser solo mi compañero travieso de cada día para convertirse en toda una obra de arte. Su mirada fija, curiosa, como si contemplara algo importante más allá de la ventana, le dio a la fotografía un aire casi mágico. Fue uno de esos momentos simples pero especiales que te recuerdan cuánto amor y paz pueden traer los animales a nuestra vida.

Lo más bonito es que, sin saberlo, posó como todo un profesional. Ni los mejores modelos tienen esa naturalidad. Solo él, siendo auténticamente Gordito: tierno, sereno y con esa presencia única que llena cualquier rincón de casa.

Editar la foto fue simplemente darle el toque final a algo que ya era especial desde el inicio. Porque cuando hay amor detrás de la cámara, se nota.

Gordito no solo es una mascota; es parte de mi familia, de mis días buenos y malos, de esos pequeños instantes que hacen la vida más cálida. Y esta fotografía es, sin duda, un recuerdo precioso de su esencia.

A veces, nuestros mayores tesoros tienen patas, bigotes y una increíble capacidad para robarnos el corazón.

Sometimes, the best photographs do not need luxurious settings or professional cameras… just the perfect moment, beautiful lighting, and of course, a model as lovely as my cat Gordito.


# English Version 




Not long ago, I managed to capture a photo of him that honestly left me completely in love. There he was, calm and elegant, bathed in the warm sunlight gently streaming in, highlighting every detail of his little face, his whiskers, and that orange fur that seems to glow all on its own.

For a moment, Gordito stopped being just my playful everyday companion and became a true work of art. His fixed, curious gaze, as if he were contemplating something important beyond the window, gave the image an almost magical feeling. It was one of those simple yet special moments that remind you how much love and peace animals can bring into our lives.

The most beautiful part is that, without even knowing it, he posed like a professional. Not even the best models have that kind of natural grace. Just him, being authentically Gordito: sweet, serene, and carrying that unique presence that fills every corner of home.

Editing the photo was simply the final touch to something that was already special from the very beginning. Because when there is love behind the camera, it shows.

Gordito is not just a pet. He is part of my family, part of my good days and difficult ones, part of those little moments that make life feel warmer. And this photograph is, without a doubt, a precious memory of his essence.

Sometimes, our greatest treasures have paws, whiskers, and an incredible ability to steal our hearts.

title.title: Bremen, Germany — Part 1 || A city you want to return to
title.body:
# Hello, fellow travelers 🌍✨  

As a child, I absolutely loved The Bremen Town Musicians 🐴🐶🐱🐔  
That story always felt magical to me — about freedom, friendship, and finding your own path.  
And back then, I could never imagine that one day I would walk the streets of the very city behind that tale.  

![IMG_1953.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNQuRL5i8fcqM1tz3TAdTk2xvEpm7fWiPPgVrxNYzmx1v/IMG_1953.jpeg)

>Now it feels even more special 🤍  

Some places don’t just stay in your memory — they stay somewhere deeper.  
**For me, Bremen is exactly that kind of city.**

![IMG_1955.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnkjCff2tBa57VvdicwJdfbMCW3W8xyBWNuqGgxth6Bt/IMG_1955.jpeg)

I was here once, three years ago, and it was love at first sight.  
And this time, I came back to share it — to show this city to my husband, to let him see what once captured my heart.  

![IMG_1962.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZtRrK6Jpnob855uuKtUAW1S5hGcgtc7BziueCREQhnH8/IMG_1962.jpeg)

![IMG_1963.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdcdJQwuGQipd9fYZm5m8AkcfEACdDceVRwxsL9UBc2MS/IMG_1963.jpeg)

>And honestly… it felt special in a completely different way ✨  

On our first day, we didn’t rush anywhere 🚶‍♂️  
No plans, no strict routes — just wandering and letting the city guide us.  

![IMG_1941.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdRzKJnh7gad7LpED4Yu7ZtXtUUUCCdV4HCk5AngNcop4/IMG_1941.jpeg)

![IMG_1942.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfDXyFLJeeNBhWx4Gm2ZuSkyzN7PL9Jg51PxfSqM1qtZ/IMG_1942.jpeg)

Bremen has this quiet way of pulling you in.  

![IMG_1947.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdoEP1XQGk5kP3dkEnsN4NLbDR4e41mDzE2H7v3s1mXqF/IMG_1947.jpeg)

Narrow streets that feel alive with history.  
Unexpected graffiti blending into old walls 🎨  
Sculptures that seem to quietly watch the passersby.  

![IMG_1945.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRsHanAbbDgJyHvKAKppZnc5XMgh4rQKNQGyXW3vRJUJm/IMG_1945.jpeg)

![IMG_1948.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfNZmaUhwpi7PBNqjaYQai6N8iL85tdWSSJnx3cKSEok6/IMG_1948.jpeg)

![IMG_1946.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYJ8wYtHUg9VWRKmiXUSESXaCWuZ4YkD4baESA4q2UXFh/IMG_1946.jpeg)

Every corner feels like a new scene.  

![IMG_1951.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTcf5zGXuQdqzNXnUsfAVPWMgG8rYjALJnCGatfJ4eg74/IMG_1951.jpeg)

![IMG_1954.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdKLR8RtbG9nkGtVgrCE6kTWfQ4AJiuSPEvK7b1BLDVRV/IMG_1954.jpeg)

![IMG_1953.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNQuRL5i8fcqM1tz3TAdTk2xvEpm7fWiPPgVrxNYzmx1v/IMG_1953.jpeg)

The Market Square welcomed us with both openness and calm 🏛️  
The Town Hall stood proud and timeless.  
And the Cathedral…  

![IMG_1950.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3ebK8HZPz98EKaV6fLm9trfShBbcw2zrmTvQ8eVgBdH/IMG_1950.jpeg)

![IMG_1952.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaRGk4VuBgRivF37H63u4SWVxRxiwRqSoS8E5MwQq2Vye/IMG_1952.jpeg)

![IMG_1959.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRHQ7kvtRN5gN1sexgk3HzRDSmYYdhJ1MuDyoikcggvWr/IMG_1959.jpeg)

![IMG_1960.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ8uesyitH88dy3woVxwRWqnuiWZNfAekMUUBXZRTonvW/IMG_1960.jpeg)

![IMG_1961.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaMBWkM8cubQCzMKhEpoyjSDuxFG2s7jpX9vLRXrga2GG/IMG_1961.jpeg)

*It’s not just beautiful — it makes something inside you slow down.*

I caught myself feeling exactly what I felt years ago.  
And my husband — he was looking around with that genuine curiosity you can’t fake.  
And somewhere in that moment, I realized —  
I was falling in love with this city all over again 💫  

![IMG_1943.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfU3bySJkVEBhRkx5EzWuXnGwPSSuKynHsoe7QTW27cM9/IMG_1943.jpeg)

But differently this time.  
Bremen is incredibly harmonious 🌿  Even in its own urban chaos.  

![IMG_1944.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbPr89uCJsncUTeawVyQiDbPXsjEEoyA23smzfD7z71Y2/IMG_1944.jpeg)

Old and new don’t compete here —  
they intertwine. Сenturies-old architecture stands next to modern lines and glass.  
And somehow, it doesn’t clash — it deepens the feeling of the place. This city doesn’t try to be perfect.  
>And maybe that’s exactly why it feels so real.  

*Alive. Honest.*

![IMG_1949.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUR3KRCwY7Uj1iMEPnXj7SQVURPcm6AP2git5wCkFnjoS/IMG_1949.jpeg)

And in the evening, we went down to the river 🌊  
The city changes there.  Softer. Quieter. More intimate.  

![IMG_1956.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcn7nF3cAURibf6mzns2d4H2UbB6c4u1mkWwxcJ7HbTFB/IMG_1956.jpeg)

We found one of the restaurant ships and sat down for a cold dark beer 🍺  

![IMG_1958.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNbiBn47m3gB6E2mMrwtoYPp3NjAEShxvhtZigiJyr4GS/IMG_1958.jpeg)

Water nearby, lights reflecting,  
people walking, laughing, some just sitting and watching the moment pass.  

>And suddenly, everything slows down.  
No rush.

title.title: The Renaissance the the USA Didn't Want You to Know About - 04-01-2017 - 10X Speed
title.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdRSthweBTdTppp3MNUmiPaqhiuEyg55tNbXhYDXrfetX/4ffbd5f5e9fd54dfcc719b8eab53ba80)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/5def4eb1)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/5def4eb1)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

title.title: Mobile phone photography || the discovery of a white mushroom that made me happy with its shape
title.body:
Good evening to friends who always share interesting photos from your phones, and participate in contests held in this beloved community.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHPHqd6b5MYUAfbMHaef8nategQ1NHBzRhZH1VaDqdcM/img_20260501_wa0010.jpg)
------
------

Hi friends, wherever you are tonight, I'm so happy to be back here. I'll show you some of the beautiful mushrooms I found.

As usual, I was visiting my garden, cleaning the grass and my banana tree. Today I found something very interesting: a very unique mushroom. This mushroom was white, and its shape was so amazing that when I held it, it felt like holding very soft rubber in my hand; it really did feel like that. As usual, when I find interesting things like this, I always capture it and take some photos of the mushroom to share with you here.

# This is what the white mushroom looked like.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7A79scpy72iaqZ7GUHGpuDz6SvK5r368rU4oEaAqkvT/img_20260501_wa0012.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHPHqd6b5MYUAfbMHaef8nategQ1NHBzRhZH1VaDqdcM/img_20260501_wa0010.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYTAjv9qVztkgvy6dxStDWManiCbr5dwk38sjS3EYFhnd/img_20260501_wa0009.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYL67FRhUFYKVgqT2iens5hJTkd1uXu3J2j7ARisof7ho/img_20260501_wa0011.jpg)



After capturing the mushroom I found, I felt very satisfied and had a very entertaining experience discovering such interesting natural things. Time passed until late afternoon, and at the end of my garden, there was a fairly large river. There I again witnessed the truly extraordinary beauty of nature. I watched the sunset and the beauty of the river, which deeply touched my heart. Finally, I returned to take some photos of the river at the end of my garden.

# This is what the river looks like when the sun is shining, very beautiful.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdycXREpjrv4DPKVMueD1do5GCVzwy3G4QoafXuEj2iVP/img_20260501_wa0007.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwk57FWWftU9xPkN2qA56x6w3Qwy5XYGXZw9tR4aVrxU/img_20260501_wa0004.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS3Bcu8xBK4zM5fRLceg2NVHwgWS5QV9HufeFFCf5wrqu/img_20260501_wa0005.jpg)



So, friends, that's my story about some interesting things I discovered today, which I really enjoyed and found entertaining. I hope the photos I shared, along with my discoveries, have entertained you all.

<center>h3>
All the photos I show here, along with my story, are my own work. I have not plagiarized them from anyone else. Some of the photos I show above were taken using my realme 7I camera.
</center>
# Okay, friends, see you in my next post!

title.body:
>Hello, my dear friends at Hive Food, I hope you're all doing well. You'll love this delicious recipe, as it's for preparing a meat stew with vegetables. Often we crave a tasty piece of meat, but we only have some vegetables on hand. So, we combine the meat with those vegetables and simmer them with other ingredients that give this dish a rich and nutritious flavor, making it ideal for lunch. Take note of the ingredients and follow the step-by-step instructions for preparing this flavorful meat and vegetable stew.🖊️📝 >Hola, mis queridos amigos de Hive Food, espero que todos se encuentren muy bien. Esta sabrosísima receta les encantará, ya que se trata de cómo preparar una carne guisada con verduras. Muchas veces se nos antoja comer una carne bien sabrosa, entonces solo contamos con algunas verduras; pues entonces sí juntamos la carne con esas verduras y las ponemos a guisar con otros ingredientes que le den ese sabor rico y nutritivo a este plato, que es el ideal para nuestros almuerzos. >Tomen nota de los ingredientes y sigan el paso a paso de cómo preparar esta sabrosa carne con verduras🖊️📝. . ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23xAZeXhvq3gwud3coD732CgGHW6UbZ8yYadntRuKzM1rn1RW7jGN9Yj1RvXrBVXnrPAC.png) ![cn.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23t8B1xtr4zh7XepTQtx8fseapNt2SKwbgEZndNE8hotpPPSgpj6Ud6CfsZ9nZfwE2UFu.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wMhBeNhyos6UkHJGZfjnz6fFmrVrhd9j4TeW9mSdDiEffAcgiJk6bPjCDxxGQZVR6yG.png) Preparación -Preparation: We chop the meat into pieces and julienne the vegetables and pour them into a pot >Picamos en trozos la carne y picamos en juliana las verduras y las vertimos en una olla ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23uFRcduSYZh5B7EhzXggEQs5uuWN8imQJx2FZjPfPoXH3mbw7vhmADFmigTkCsKpacDw.png) We added a cup of water to the pot, along with the sauces and two tablespoons of vegetable oil. >Le echamos a la olla una taza de agua y las salsas junto a dos cucharadas de aceite vegetal ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23xAPAG9N6GNa27PWJvqNyamopNeGouGw9Xr1utmJgDCxozsCCa3Pdkn3hQdiou6BTZh2.png) Let it simmer uncovered for about 5 minutes, or until the stew thickens. Serve with white rice. >Dejamos que se cocine a fuego lento sin la tapa, por unos 5 minutos, o hasta que el estofado se espese. Servir con arroz blanco. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wWnHVGL1cLkVnzHgL1bDzib1KZeDAsS13o5C3RC9r9gAtT25FyMQ3wUPBpE6CUXFFvC.png)

title.title: Mind Over Miles: Reta, Routine, and the Real Hustle
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZqnHJYn7r2Z8edTbAQnrGyyFheP5Y7kp1PgbqbR7t3QH/image.png 


There’s a version of me that used to think this was all random.

Wake up. Chase orders. Eat whatever. Hope for a good day.

That version doesn’t exist anymore.

Now everything is intentional.

Every mile. Every dollar. Every bite. Every injection.

This is not just gig work anymore. This is a system.

## The Mentality Shift

The biggest unlock wasn’t money. It wasn’t crypto. It wasn’t even the Tesla.

It was mentality.

Most people are reactive. They wait for the app to tell them what to do. They wait for motivation. They wait for the “perfect day.”

I stopped waiting.

I started treating every day like a controlled operation.

Wake up early. Position myself. Anticipate demand. Move before the crowd moves.

This is the difference between making $80 and making $200.

It’s not luck. It’s positioning.

And positioning starts in the mind.

## The Physical Layer: Reta and Control

When I started running my Retatrutide protocol, I didn’t expect it to hit like this.

Not just physically. Mentally.

Appetite suppression is real. But more importantly, impulse suppression is real.

Before, I would eat because I felt like it.

Now, I eat because it fits the system.

Protein target. Energy balance. Recovery.

This is the first time I actually feel like I have leverage over my own habits.

Less noise. More control.

And that matters when you’re out here grinding 6 to 10 hours a day.

## Fueling the Machine

Food used to be random.

Now it’s strategic.

Protein is the anchor. Around 180 to 190 grams daily based on my weight.

Everything else supports that.

Simple meals. Repeatable meals. No overthinking.

Because here’s the truth:

Complex diets fail when your life is chaotic.

And this life is chaotic.

Driving. Waiting. Parking lots. Last minute orders.

You don’t need perfection. You need consistency.

That’s what builds momentum.

## The Hustle Reality

People see the numbers but they don’t see the structure.

They see $200 days. They don’t see the 2 AM wake-ups.

They don’t see the battery at 7% pulling into a charger.

They don’t see the decision fatigue.

Every order is a decision.

Distance. Time. Items. Drop-off.

You stack enough of those decisions and your brain gets tired.

That’s where mentality kicks in again.

Because when you’re tired, your standards drop.

And when your standards drop, your income drops.

So I don’t negotiate with myself.

If I’m out, I’m working.

If I’m working, I’m executing.

## The Tesla Factor

The Tesla isn’t just a car. It’s part of the system.

Energy efficiency. Low operating cost. Quiet environment.

It gives me an edge.

But only if I manage it right.

Charging at the wrong time kills margins.

Driving inefficiently kills margins.

Everything ties back to awareness.

Cost per mile. Earnings per hour. Energy per session.

This is a business, whether people want to admit it or not.

## Discipline vs Motivation

Motivation is unreliable.

Discipline is repeatable.

There are days I don’t feel like doing anything.

Those are the days that matter the most.

Because consistency on bad days builds identity.

And identity is what carries you when things get hard.

Right now, I’m not chasing motivation.

I’m building a version of myself that just executes.

No questions.

## The Bigger Picture

This isn’t just about Instacart.

This isn’t just about Reta.

This isn’t just about eating right.

This is about control.

Control over time.

Control over money.

Control over habits.

Because once you control those three things, everything else starts to fall into place.

Crypto taught me patience.

The hustle taught me execution.

Reta is teaching me discipline over my body.

Put it all together and it becomes something different.

A system.

## Final Thought

Most people are waiting for a breakthrough.

I’m building one daily.

One order at a time.

One decision at a time.

One disciplined action at a time.

No hype. No shortcuts.

Just data, consistency, and controlled pressure.

That’s the real edge.

That’s ChronoCrypto.

title.title: Love with less often give more joy
title.body:
For me it sounds like something impossible because we exist in a world that keeps demanding more work, more effort, more communication, and so on. Currently people measure love by what they see and how you demonstrate love to them. People feel now that if you are not spending on them, that means you don’t love them. This can make love heavy and complicated, and love will start feeling crowded. It is hard for us to understand that we don’t really need to put in much when it comes to love.



Seeing this prompt, I am thinking about this love from a different perspective. I get to realise that love is not about doing more or giving more; rather, it is about deleting things that don’t belong. Relationships these days look like performances. The world we are into made it look like that. If you are not putting in effort in your relationship, that means you are not doing it well. Most of ours are not living the best of lives because we are living to shape ourselves into our partner's lifestyle, which is bad, but growth grows in trust and truth. They should see you for who you are and not what you think you should be.



![1ecaedbd-6da4-4c57-aefc-1720564e83c2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23y8z64UYReEbXWUiu8BDSDzj98QnPWhEVWbwX6c3k7xZSeEaXGrjtnRvmvRFt9XEcYi8.jpeg)


The sweetest part of love comes with fewer expectations. It is not bad to expect something from someone, but it becomes harmful the moment it becomes unspoken. At that point, we expect people to read our minds and behave in a way that will mirror our own lives, and they are being shadows of themselves. But simplifying love means you will allow people to be themselves instead of who you want them to be; you will find yourself appreciating them rather than feeling disappointed in them.







Relationships don’t need to be noisy, especially in our social circles. Every connection doesn't need to be deep; we don’t need to hold on to too many people. You don’t need to crowd yourself with people or try to please someone, but if your circle is small, your attention becomes smart; you get to understand yourself more. That will help to build your relationship stronger and not weaker.



![214c4e6b-9072-41ee-b45b-bc767420dac0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23xpEzVuQK9mgTDwBja6PTuiFNHUZzR3HisLe4navDDpNqE7FTMEyCRjb239GYGcu6oDB.jpeg)



Less doesn’t make love smaller; rather, it makes it clearer. When we have fewer expectations and less pressure, we will realise that relationship is sweet. We will be honest and more grounded; you start noticing the little things we ignored. I always tell people that the fact you choose to simplify your love doesn’t mean lowering standards or caring less; it will help you to focus on things that really matter and let go of things that are not important. It means picking honesty over perfection and presence over performance.





Finally, love that less often gives more joy and peace of mind is given, but we keep neglecting it and pushing shadows.

***All pictures are mine***

This is my entry on the weekly prompts #minimalist.



Thank you for stopping by my blog. I appreciate your comments, support, and upvotes. Do have a lovely day.

title.title: Tender, Gelatinous, and Sinfully Good... My Braised Pig’s Trotter Dinner
title.body:
Tonight’s dinner was something tender, rich, gelatinous, and honestly a bit sinful in the best way possible. It was Braised Pig’s Trotter! 😁


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 22.21.46 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep7vW9AcfMetfNbA6cHvk5DqhLpJYwenQgnMmG7jcjqWrEvEbSMmCAWPAjvWAXsM4UV.jpeg)


This is the kind of dish that I don’t eat often, and maybe that’s also the reason why it feels special whenever I have it. It is not something that I would consider as an everyday meal because, of course, I still try to be conscious about what I eat. But there are moments when I just want to deviate from my usual food choices and enjoy something that feels comforting, heavy, and full of flavor.

And tonight was definitely one of those moments.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 22.21.47 (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoiVh1Sjh5rNg21scoBQb5Uz4PY1XZfmuxuGF2q7QkoUK32K1ZSP4MQiRx7Dex8hJGR.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 22.21.47 (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EowG8FiJ6fQfoEmfyFfv3Aks1zrJSekiKqSRTbfvrmdX5bebCA48P2Uwa9jpDZq7iv3.jpeg)


The stall that I ordered from is called 85 Stew, and from the look of their menu, they offer quite a nice variety of dishes. It’s not a very huge menu, but I think that’s also a good thing. Sometimes, a smaller menu means the stall can focus more on perfecting the cooking technique. They have chicken soup, curry dishes, braised pork, and even seafood noodles, so there is still enough variety to make the stall interesting.

But for tonight, my attention went straight to the pork dish.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 22.21.47 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep5oEqNvEap196Tkf9L3j9rHke3WuEPwkYGZyYtRx9byhSqmxXqEhV2u2g5Ki9PotdE.jpeg)


The moment the bowl arrived, I already knew that this would be a very satisfying meal. The braised sauce looked dark, glossy, and intense. It had that deep color that usually gives you a hint that the flavor has been cooked down properly. Together with a bowl of plain white rice, it really looked like a classic comfort meal. Nothing too fancy, nothing overly decorated, but very appetizing in its own humble way.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 22.21.47 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep5nG3WDnh3HLqX9c2imMhQzyJgUV8BJbnr3UkRxW8nKHWwENTHmZ1a62ZJN117ueTV.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 22.21.46.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpLgXbumCfGhofp8xfqMit1CeAFNgx7vXQurUpYCHb6ciwvwuqTqn3RwVuVyMDERU3K.jpeg)


The pig’s trotter itself was perfectly tender. The meat was soft and easy to pull apart, while the skin had that gelatinous texture that I really enjoy. I know not everyone is a fan of this kind of texture, but for me, that soft and slightly sticky mouthfeel is the highlight of this dish. It feels rich, succulent, and indulgent.

What I liked even more was the sauce. I expected it to be very heavy and maybe too oily, but surprisingly, the sauce had a slightly sour side to it. That little sourness helped to cut through the richness of the pork, making the whole dish more balanced. Without that, I think the meal could easily become too much after a few bites. But because of that tangy touch, I kept going back for more.

Eating this also made me think that food is really not just about nutrition. Of course, nutrition is important, and I’m not saying we should forget about it. But food also gives us happiness, excitement, and even memories. There are dishes that can somehow make us feel better about life, even just for a short moment. This Braised Pig’s Trotter felt like that for me tonight.

It was nostalgic, comforting, and very satisfying. The kind of meal that makes you slow down and appreciate every bite.

***Overall, I would say this was such a treat. The pork was tender, the skin was beautifully gelatinous, and the sauce had enough depth and balance to make the dish enjoyable with rice. Definitely not something I would eat every day, but once in a while, this kind of rich and flavorful meal is worth it.***

## Bon appetit!

title.title: El comienzo de la banda 17 - Historia [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
Luego de la entrega de números y las palabras, cada una de las bandas regresaron al hotel con una mezcla de adrenalina y nervios. Nadie hablaba demasiado; cada uno estaba repasando mentalmente cada nota, cada entrada, cada mirada en el escenario. Mientras que, por otro lado, Dani preguntó —¿Ensayamos otra vez? Lucas se negó, Michelle hoy no es para corregir y Stewie, se quedó sentado en el sofá, muy tranquilo. Por primera vez en todo el día, todos respiraron de verdad. >After the setlists and opening remarks were handed out, each band returned to the hotel feeling a mix of adrenaline and nerves. No one said much; everyone was mentally going over every note, every entrance, every glance on stage. Meanwhile, Dani asked, “Should we rehearse again?” Lucas refused, Michelle wasn’t in the mood for corrections today, and Stewie just sat on the couch, very calm. For the first time all day, everyone took a real breath. ![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23xoymTds11DwEW8Vu69j3ugqdGUrBvytHFSvckP1FNupe3u8HdaLK86s1ajMbz3ywRxV.jpeg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/instruments-music-drums-guitar-801271/) Esa misma noche en el hotel el salón del evento estaba lleno de bandas de todos los estilos, además mesas largas, comida abundante, risas nerviosas y conversaciones. En el medio un escenario pequeño, donde seguramente alguna iba a hablar. La Banda se sentó toda junta, como un gran equipo y allí comenzaron a recordar sus primeros ensayos, las discusiones por letras y las veces que pensaron en rendirse.—Si mañana pasa lo que sea—dijo Stewie ya ganamos. Minutos después el organizador subió al escenario —Mañana comienza todo. Cada banda tendrá su momento, su oportunidad de convertir minutos en historia. Por ende descansen, prepárense y no olviden por qué empezaron. Todas las bandas aplaudieron y se miraron entre ellos, muy nerviosos. De regreso a la habitación, todos sabían que estaban a pocas horas de ese sueño. Michelle cerró su libreta, Dani afinó su instrumento, Stewie marco el ritmo con sus dedos y Lucas miró a todos, uno por uno, dándole las gracias —Mañana no salimos a impresionar —dijo—. Salimos a ser nosotros. Finalmente, la luz se apagó de la habitación. >That same night at the hotel, the event hall was packed with bands of every style, along with long tables, plenty of food, nervous laughter, and conversation. In the middle stood a small stage, where one of them was surely going to speak. The band sat together, like a tight-knit team, and there they began reminiscing about their first rehearsals, the arguments over lyrics, and the times they’d thought about giving up. “Whatever happens tomorrow,” said Stewie, “we’ve already won.” # >Minutes later, the organizer took the stage. “Tomorrow it all begins. Every band will have its moment, its chance to turn minutes into history. So rest up, get ready, and don’t forget why you started.” All the bands clapped and looked at each other, very nervous. # >Back in the room, everyone knew they were just a few hours away from that dream. Michelle closed her notebook, Dani tuned her instrument, Stewie tapped out the beat with his fingers, and Lucas looked at everyone, one by one, thanking them. “Tomorrow we’re not going out there to impress,” he said. “We’re going out there to be ourselves.” Finally, the lights went out in the room. ![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23tbkLXEEuDcxurDAqFrAW4LCst9ZHhoEEFVkTDiTjK7JFPAvTYP38mi1WgRJxfEvia9N.jpeg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/artist-audience-band-concert-crowd-3480274/) A la mañana siguiente, cuando se despertaron todo era distinto. En el lobby, una pantalla gigante mostraba el orden de presentación. Donde todo se fijaron en la Banda número 17. El tiempo avanzaba rápido, Dani miró el reloj. —Faltan tres. Stewie se puso de pie —Es ahora. Michelle respiró profundo y Lucas extendió la mano al centro y todos los demás la colocaron como un gran equipo. Todos estaba listo para conquistar. >The next morning, when they woke up, everything was different. In the lobby, a giant screen displayed the performance order. Everyone’s eyes were fixed on Band Number 17. Time was flying by; Dani glanced at her watch. “Three to go.” Stewie stood up. “It’s now.” Michelle took a deep breath, and Lucas reached out toward the center, and everyone else joined him as one big team. They were all ready to conquer.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

title.title: Splinterlands - End of Season and Opening 10 Epic Draws
title.body:
![eg.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wC1ZWCm1Atj5muecGrupJ2ABY6P5E8cGeXy81AFgUBZycLHmz9kYMFH2qSz2HvRWC16.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. Another season of Splinterlands has ended, so it's time to claim my glint rewards. This time I got exactly 297,733 glint, much less compared to last season. I also got 50k glint for finishing in the rank 93 in the modern leaderboard. And since I finished in rank 6 in the frontier leaderboard, I got 6 packs and 20 entries for the weekly fortune draw. I will do my best to get better rewards this season.

---

Luckily, I managed to get one golden unit, the earth ulund, Tandi Janda :D 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wfqueK6X5f1UbikzMaaCgdvuSKnUZSXA8h5dGotxVwjr1syn5BfAfEUeKmwiNHGeh1T.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/shop/rewards?t=abb02dd6c275955b0b424eff7657b12148710cc5&ref=langice)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wWnHdYqMPKB89i6nfigT8ioGsLxK3s35TU9Lqk6DAbz78WZdMuSPJuZkMv3SDL11zu6.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/shop/rewards?t=9e9c2b0d13df5b36a08a47b1849a496fac4c8db7&ref=langice)</center>

---

Now, I have two Tandi Janda in gold foil. If I level it up, it will gain the Lookout ability, so its adjacent allies will take 1 less damage from sneak, snipe and opportunity attacks. And additionally, enemy ambush attacks will deal 50% less damage.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23vhPNWHVbYdvaJDMuLFqK7ETMPESm36iUhckk1XnhxkRC24woV3G2hiuYwXgFBfpzWKe.png)

---

And I have three undeads Wailsworn Specter in gold foil. I can level her up to level three, so she can gain the Weaken ability, which allows her, while she is alive, to reduce the health of all enemy units by 1.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wfjoqiyAAZjjT8vU4qrDe3Twgu5Avij5DxvEkujhSGftgQZpKmoPhPejECA67ugAhQ6.png)

---

Currently, these are all my epic conclave arcana reward cards in gold foil that I get from opening epic draws with alchemy potions. Since I don't summon them much, except in some gold tournaments, I'm really considering selling them so I can buy other cards that I will actually use. Anyway, I hope to get many more gold foils the next time I open, and I wish you the same; have fun playing.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23xVAG2Py2tXoi839D9oZiKg8FbQPGysL8n9YRU9empyVwVP1Go1JA4s6mVdXRKyBHFfn.png)</center>

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

---

Other hive games:
Terracore: https://terracoregame.com?ref=aubryd
Moonkarts: https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com

![avis.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tbrihjVBmg8HpZhsxEbkuzNeAHzoV3wPwDgUZ7MqPC3cdiuu2ocfG8ZqvpFXaFwYfWJ.png)

title.title: Prevention is better than cure.
title.body:
Hello friends. Happy new month to everyone. I pray we have a great month ahead. Amen🙏


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRiv5d46iF5RXf76aKUBAbLmABnF76gDDfmY9vTNTWuE/1777645794637.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/vaccine-coronavirus-medical-hand-6165772/)

I believe that everyone will somehow learn lessons in life, but it all depends on how fast we are able to learn our lessons. For some just by mere watching others make mistake, they quickly get the lesson and won't make such mistake in their lives. While for some, even when they make the same mistake over and over again, they won't still learn their lessons, because they pretend not to understand. Or maybe they understand, but refuse to admit it.

What a beautiful topic for week 215 episode 3. This is also the first day in the month of May. The long awaited fifth month is finally here. I have been praying to see this month because I believe it is coming with lots of good things for my me and my family. The topic says - PREVENTION IS BETTER! This is like a statement that I should agree with or disagree with. I totally understand what it means to prevent an ugly event and make sure that it didn't happen. By prevention you will save yourself and others a lot of stress. I saw a grown up man the other day in TikTok making and creating content with his two legs crippled. He told people that he was okay from beginning up till when he was about seven years or there about that polio attacked him and because he was not given the drugs for prevention when he was still small it so affected him that he can't use his two legs to walk again. For him, he has accepted his fate, but I was so so sorry for him because I was just imagining how he has been coping with that condition. How difficult it must have been for his parents. All of that was just flowing through my mind as I stood there watching him. Simply put, it would have been prevented with just one or two injection. For him maybe his parents were not aware of what it was until they saw it. Now they can tell better. 

When it comes to raising my kids, I have always try to take preventive measures when it comes to immunization. I take them for their next drugs in the hospital. I try all my best not to skep because I was well informed about the consequences of not doing the right thing. It shows that I totally support preventive methods and I won't stop supporting it till the end. Parents who try to run away from taken preventive measures most times regret it at the end.

Im conclusion, I want to say to parents especially to take this very serious to prevent the story that touches the heart. Let all children take this preventive drugs that will help their system fight against any kind of disease that will come in the future to disfigure them. This will help to reduce all manner of sicknesses attacking our children and even adult. By so doing the society will be better. 
Thanks for hopping it. Happy new month once again.

오늘의 산책은 정말 즐거웠어요! 도심의 공원에서 친구와 우연히 만나서 함께 걷게 되었어요. 우리가 대화하는 사이에 길가에 핀 예쁜 꽃들이 눈에 들어왔고, 특히 노란색 유채꽃이 무척 인상적이었어요. 그런 꽃을 보니 봄이 확실히 왔다는 걸 느꼈답니다. 또 한 가지 흥미로운 점은, 공원에서 작은 음악 공연이 열리고 있었어요. 몇몇 아티스트들이 거리에서 라이브로 음악을 연주하고 있었는데, 그 모습이 너무 생동감 넘쳤어요. 다양한 사람들과 음악을 즐기며 함께 어울리는 모습이 정말 따뜻하게 느껴졌어요. 오늘의 산책은 즐거운 만남과 아름다운 풍경으로 가득 찬 하루였어요! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). title.title: Gefunden, abgegeben und entsorgt :(
title.body:
Vor einem halben Jahr habe ich eine Uhr am Bürgersteig gefunden. Eine Apple Smartwatch. Und als ehrlicher Finder habe ich die Uhr natürlich beim Fundamt abgegeben.

Dort wurden meine Personalien aufgenommen und mitgeteilt, dass die Uhr mir gehört, wenn sie in einem halben Jahr niemand abgeholt hat.

Vor paar Tagen hatte ich dann das erwartete Schreiben im Briefkasten. Nur anders:

![IMG_20260501_081055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lammbock/23wqy3iEDKwDAanxRyffz1qFSHqPwSurN1eQHD8KQdvpksAtbnTdt8qFSDZuGdiKeatzi.jpg)

Ich habe zwar wohl grundsätzlich Eigentum an der Uhr bekommen, die Stadt darf sie mir aus Datenschutzgründen aber nicht geben. Stattdessen wird die Uhr entsorgt. 

Irgendwie schade... 

(Es kann aber gut sein, dass sie Uhr kaputt war, sonst hätte der Verlierer sie vielleicht schon abgeholt.)

title.body:

***

“丛林”这个词让我联想到自然的原始美和生命的多样性。走进丛林，仿佛可以听到生机勃勃的声音，感受到大自然的气息。这里有高大的树木、错综复杂的藤蔓，和各种各样的动物，让人感到无比震撼。丛林既是探险的乐土，也是心灵的庇护所，让人在繁忙的生活中找到一丝宁静与归属。

title.title: Smart Cars, Rough Roads
title.body: As a lover of technology, I love and support self driving cars becoming the mainstream in our society, but a society like mine is not prepared for it yet. It has its advantages, like the comfort and convenience it gives, and many more benefits, but it also has some disadvantages, especially in a society that doesn't have what it takes to adopt and utilize certain technology. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUL2k1aKqk6gnDqbaek45bndiYwS9aoVrUC3BJC1J2m6F/1777645285893.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/black-car-gps-turned-on-in-car-pWGUMQSWBwI) Self-driving cars depend on electricity and good network to function accurately and that's a major problem in my society. The network could limit the performance and potential of a self driving car in many ways. More often, we battle with bad networks while traveling through certain routes in the rural and urban areas, due to the fact that most of these routes or roads suffer from bad network too. A self driving car will need a good network and GPS to function to its full potential, the chance of getting into an accident due to bad network is high and possible. Poor network could also affect the map of the car. A self driving car depends on road map and poor network could make the car lose access to road map and directions. Give a wrong lead or direction. Weak network could affect the function of the car in many ways, limit it full potential and performance in countless ways. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvfkMvCBugG3tPBgyHGfAJ22kk8bzetTHYGswWp9QgVj/1777645296040.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/autonomous-car-navigates-busy-highway-traffic-CNFX37-XfQs) Before self driving cars become a mainstream car in a society like mine, then certain criteria need to be met, not just network. The road needs to be worked on and fixed, because the poor road and bad infrastructure would really affect a self driving car in my society. The road needs to be fixed before my society starts utilizing self driving cars. Relying on technology on a road that is full of potholes, bad mapping, failed infrastructure and poor driving system could cause more harm than expected. Relying on a self driving car in a busy road without the fear of accident or unforeseen occurrence is obviously an overdependent on technology. Just imagine a road that is full of different cars and people, including the crazy and drunk drivers, and being too comfortable and relaxed, feeling so safe and sure of protection. That's so much dependent on technology and that's a disadvantage. The sensor could fail, the system could be hacked, and a malfunction in the system that could lead to accidents. Total dependence on technology could cause more harm than good. Technology can also fail us, depending on technology could cause harm. It could also lead to loss of jobs, especially for licensed drivers, and that's a problem for the society. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmegSxQ6SoSAVojdLJ6tGgEK3an8PKCahTYQUJh6MFXg7G/1777645307645.jpg) [PICTURESOURCE](https://unsplash.com/photos/two-white-cars-are-driving-on-a-highway--Rf4-vgmtvg) >And when preventable accidents occur, who pays for it? The owner of the car, the manufacturer, or the car itself? This part of this prompt is quite complex, but to be balanced, I believe when there's an accident the cause of the accident is being traced. For instance, if the owner of a self driving car has always seen a warning sign or failed to maintain the car when it should be maintained. Then the owner should pay for it. If the accident is traced to be due to the owner's negligence, they should pay for the accident. The manufacturer isn't free from blame either, because most times accident can occur from the manufacturer and if the accident is traced back to the manufacturer, maybe due to software and hardware damage or defects, then the manufacturer should pay for the accident The car can't pay 😅, that's impossible. It is really funny to expect payment from the car at this point. The payment should be either the manufacturers, owner and the insurance company. Self driving cars are great innovations in developed societies, but in a society like mine we have alot to fix before utilizing self driving cars. ### Thanks for reading ♥️ ### Vanilla 💗

title.title: My garden review
title.body:
![IMG_5223.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeYzzrGdmy6SFhignzAmohx7YFRsNoxt2yLtYEoedrM9i/IMG_5223.jpeg)

Today my dogs and I had a little trip to the store and the post office. You should have bought groceries for me and picked up their food from the post office. And as always, I made a purchase that, to be honest, I didn't plan, but I couldn't pass by.

I bought a hydrangea. Quite high and, to be honest, not cheap. I could have taken an easier and cheaper option, but I didn't want to wait a few years for it to grow up and become what I want it to be. Sometimes it's easier to take the \

right away than to stretch the pleasure for an indefinite period of time. This may not be the most economical approach, but it is honest with myself.
I walked around the garden for a long time and thought about where to plant it so that it really opened up and didn't get lost among the rest.

![IMG_5224.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQhTVawdgrLb5439Sj9qNbQngmSLMhSyQn9D6PosBTpTp/IMG_5224.jpeg)

Meanwhile, my garden is gradually waking up. Sakura has already released delicate, almost transparent leaves. They are still quite young, but you can already feel life in them. And I'm waiting for flowering - this is the moment for which everything was started.

![IMG_5227.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwBGM7Bg3oaF4GNSCyykgNbKVTqqgX9BCHcej2mVoqUg/IMG_5227.jpeg)

Some low-growing trees are also preparing to bloom. It's funny, but I can't remember what kind of tree it is right now. I planted it with an idea and inspiration, and now I'm standing and trying to guess by the buds. Well, there will be a surprise. Let's look at the fruits😂 


![IMG_5226.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXi8hBYNQ78PrzHTeKRBRM8TdT2rriQJNGjsaiECgd7kw/IMG_5226.jpeg)

In general, it feels like the garden is starting to breathe after a long pause. There is movement, color, some small changes that immediately catch the eye. It's especially noticeable after winter.

Forecasters promise warming very soon. I really want to believe them. Because this cold is already boring, and the garden clearly needs more sun.

And me, to be honest, too.

title.title: New Pen~
title.body:
Hello guys....

Meet me again, how are you all, I hope you are all in good condition. I am sick, because recently the weather in Medan has not been good, so it makes me unable to create content or post anything this week, even though I already have some interesting content to tell. So let's start with the first one, which is about me who just bought an important item that I will use for drawing and writing.

The item I bought this time was a stylus pen. This is the item I will use to learn digital drawing and write a digital journal on my tab.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 19.28.23 (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/23uFejmMXDSUEzJvBtrRt5T8ufRavtmh7UwvDiEFX1qckZHGv4iLxexqESJeJ3mJwwRnw.jpeg)

Universal stylus pen, that's the item I bought. A stylus pen that can be used for ios, android or windows. I didn't buy an apple pencil because I don't use an ipad, so I just bought this. my tab doesn't have a feature that can use a stylus pen with bluetooth, so you can just use it as long as the pen is turned on. How to turn on this stylus pen is very easy, you just need to tap twice on the tip of the pen. This pen uses type C to charge it. There is also an indicator light to indicate that this pen is on and to indicate the battery for this pen.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 19.28.23 (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/23x1HyziEondCEQodTeWLjYLjUrxHEhGHp9cUuX7H6TvB4oZdmMkuBWiTAveMwF6GE4hX.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 19.28.23 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/23u6FVgoWxAviP4CDyuzAMtFJWMK3GP9SHqJyVgDdeWVUKP34RCNw4PXzDfh2JfGEScF6.jpeg)

What you get from purchasing this is, a stylus pen in black (they have several other color options: white, pink, and green), a spare nib, a type C cable, and 3 sheets of stickers.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 19.28.23.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/23xAeRGJqbrGnUmwNBbY591rCC5VZr1aLfJeW9DHgjAYq6wLfENwSnWU5npDbjTHFntNH.jpeg)

// Mi opinión sobre la película \
title.body:
<div class=text-justify>





![1000241187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23uQtnKMC9kNVbUMxFtunD3jrPooN2QEf4ceZr6a2r1DgTqqMrx6RDyVEfdxTGjfHysMi.jpg)

<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pelicula+una+mision+secreta+por+Eddy+Mophy&oq=fotografias+de+la+pelicula++una+mision+secreta++por+Eddy+Mophy+&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRigATIHCAMQIRigAdIBCTkwNjU5ajBqNKgCAbACAQ&client=ms-android-transsion&sourceid=chrome-mobile&ie=UTF-8#sv=CAMSZBoyKhBlLTJrZ2hCVXVHb1o0UVZNMg4ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTToOdlZ5S1VvVmFZS1BUOU0gBCokCg5VdXhzVEhmOHJ2cm1wTRIQZS0ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTRgAMAFKBAgBEAIYByDIoKe4DUoIEAIYASACKAE)</Center>



Hello, #hive friends, and especially to the Movies&TvShows community. As always, I hope you and your family and friends are doing well. Today I’m stopping by to tell you about a movie I watched recently that really caught my attention. It’s the film “Central Intelligence,” starring Eddie Murphy and Owen Wilson. It’s an action comedy that blends espionage with humor in a story full of unexpected twists. The film, directed by an up-and-coming talent in the comedy world, manages to capture the essence of the camaraderie and chaos that often accompany undercover missions.





The plot follows James Turner, played by Eddie Murphy, an intelligence agent with a reputation as a master of the art of espionage. However, James’s life takes a drastic turn when he is assigned a mission that forces him to team up with the inexperienced and clumsy FBI agent Alex Reed, played by Owen Wilson. From the start, the chemistry between Murphy and Wilson is evident. While Murphy embodies experience and wit, Wilson brings an air of naivety and charisma that creates a comedic contrast.



![1000241188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23z75SxJidth2qZAoWzsFmKFGgXjCeUAz1gh54cXTvgn3kCYxwyy53qUtE8vVEr14VXbi.jpg)


<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pelicula+una+mision+secreta+por+Eddy+Mophy&oq=fotografias+de+la+pelicula++una+mision+secreta++por+Eddy+Mophy+&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRigATIHCAMQIRigAdIBCTkwNjU5ajBqNKgCAbACAQ&client=ms-android-transsion&sourceid=chrome-mobile&ie=UTF-8#sv=CAMSZBoyKhBlLTJrZ2hCVXVHb1o0UVZNMg4ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTToOdlZ5S1VvVmFZS1BUOU0gBCokCg5VdXhzVEhmOHJ2cm1wTRIQZS0ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTRgAMAFKBAgBEAIYByDIoKe4DUoIEAIYASACKAE)</Center>



The mission in question involves dismantling a dangerous criminal organization that has been operating in the shadows. James, confident that he can handle the situation, is frustrated by his new partner’s lack of skills. As the plot unfolds, chaos erupts in spectacular fashion, as the pair gets caught up in a series of misunderstandings, absurd chases, and unexpected encounters that turn what should be a calculated mission into an episode of total mayhem.





One of the film’s strongest points is its ability to balance action with humor. The action sequences, though sometimes a bit over-the-top, are well-choreographed and visually appealing. Here we see everything from alleyway brawls to spectacular car chases; every scene feels dynamic and thrilling. However, it is the rapid-fire dialogue and the interactions between the characters that really stand out. Murphy’s jokes and wit are complemented by Wilson’s accidental comedy, creating moments that elicit laughter from the audience time and again.


![1000241189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23vhwV6hpvyYNESvSyNaJauwvM3usHyyKrUGcyRLoxn3brbPg1Muvd5EvomLbtTeGnR53.jpg)


<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pelicula+una+mision+secreta+por+Eddy+Mophy&oq=fotografias+de+la+pelicula++una+mision+secreta++por+Eddy+Mophy+&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRigATIHCAMQIRigAdIBCTkwNjU5ajBqNKgCAbACAQ&client=ms-android-transsion&sourceid=chrome-mobile&ie=UTF-8#sv=CAMSZBoyKhBlLTJrZ2hCVXVHb1o0UVZNMg4ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTToOdlZ5S1VvVmFZS1BUOU0gBCokCg5VdXhzVEhmOHJ2cm1wTRIQZS0ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTRgAMAFKBAgBEAIYByDIoKe4DUoIEAIYASACKAE)</Center>




The character development is also noteworthy. Although James Turner is the typical tough, self-assured agent, he shows vulnerability throughout the film, revealing his frustration and insecurities. On the other hand, Alex Reed, initially introduced as an underappreciated agent, evolves throughout the story. As the plot thickens, Alex proves that, though he lacks experience, he possesses a good heart and an intelligence that help him overcome obstacles.




Visually, the film makes use of diverse settings, ranging from urban locations to more exotic environments, which enriches the narrative and keeps the viewer engaged. The production feels lavish and well-executed, with magnificent costume design that reflects the characters’ personalities and the espionage atmosphere, ensuring we have a truly entertaining and enjoyable time.



![1000241191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23u5zYy6KvM34YPqxuem88f8XQo1gUAvuzxwCji4p3oqCsuw2cUqmCVKwr4wkV8GmyUcD.jpg)


<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pelicula+una+mision+secreta+por+Eddy+Mophy&oq=fotografias+de+la+pelicula++una+mision+secreta++por+Eddy+Mophy+&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRigATIHCAMQIRigAdIBCTkwNjU5ajBqNKgCAbACAQ&client=ms-android-transsion&sourceid=chrome-mobile&ie=UTF-8#sv=CAMSZBoyKhBlLTJrZ2hCVXVHb1o0UVZNMg4ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTToOdlZ5S1VvVmFZS1BUOU0gBCokCg5VdXhzVEhmOHJ2cm1wTRIQZS0ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTRgAMAFKBAgBEAIYByDIoKe4DUoIEAIYASACKAE)</Center>



\

friends, is more than just laughs and action; it’s an exploration of unexpected friendship and the importance of trusting others, even when everything seems to be going against you. In short, the film is an entertaining mix of comedy, action, and camaraderie that brings together two great actors in a story that, though chaotic, turns out to be captivating and fun. With its fast-paced rhythm, clever humor, and positive message, \

undoubtedly guarantees fun for fans of action comedies. As for me, I’ll say goodbye until the next movie, and send you thousands of blessings.

‎Hola amigos de #hive y en especial a la comunidad de Movies&TvShows, como siempre espero que se encuentren bien al igual que sus familiares y amigos. Es el día de hoy paso por acá para hablarles de una película que vi en estos días y que me llamó mucho la atención, se trata de la película \

, protagonizada por Eddie Murphy y Owen Wilson, la misma es una comedia de acción que mezcla el espionaje con el humor en un relato lleno de giros inesperados. La película, dirigida por un talento emergente en el ámbito de la comedia, logra capturar la esencia de la camaradería y el caos que a menudo acompaña a las misiones encubiertas.





La trama sigue a James Turner papel que realiza Eddie Murphy, un agente de inteligencia con una reputación de ser un maestro en el arte del espionaje. Sin embargo, la vida de James da un giro drástico cuando recibe una misión que lo obliga a asociarse con el inexperto y torpe agente del FBI Alex Reed, papel que interpreta Owen Wilson. Desde el inicio, la química entre Murphy y Wilson es evidente. Mientras que Murphy encarna la experiencia y el ingenio, Wilson trae consigo un aire de ingenuidad y carisma que crea un contraste cómico.


![1000241188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23z75SxJidth2qZAoWzsFmKFGgXjCeUAz1gh54cXTvgn3kCYxwyy53qUtE8vVEr14VXbi.jpg)



<Center>[Fuentes](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pelicula+una+mision+secreta+por+Eddy+Mophy&oq=fotografias+de+la+pelicula++una+mision+secreta++por+Eddy+Mophy+&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRigATIHCAMQIRigAdIBCTkwNjU5ajBqNKgCAbACAQ&client=ms-android-transsion&sourceid=chrome-mobile&ie=UTF-8#sv=CAMSZBoyKhBlLTJrZ2hCVXVHb1o0UVZNMg4ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTToOdlZ5S1VvVmFZS1BUOU0gBCokCg5VdXhzVEhmOHJ2cm1wTRIQZS0ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTRgAMAFKBAgBEAIYByDIoKe4DUoIEAIYASACKAE)</Center>





La misión en cuestión implica desmantelar una peligrosa organización criminal que ha estado operando bajo las sombras. James, seguro de que puede manejar la situación, se siente frustrado por la falta de habilidades de su nuevo compañero. A medida que avanza la trama, el caos se desata de forma impresionante, ya que la pareja se ve involucrada en una serie de malentendidos, persecuciones absurdas y encuentros inesperados que convierten lo que debería ser una misión calculada en un episodio de descontrol absoluto.





Uno de los puntos más fuertes de la película es su capacidad para equilibrar la acción con el humor. Las secuencias de acción, aunque a veces son un poco exageradas, están bien coreografiadas y son visualmente atractivas. Aquí podemos ver desde peleas en el callejón hasta espectaculares persecuciones en coches, cada escena se siente dinámica y emocionante. Sin embargo, es el diálogo rápido y las interacciones entre los personajes lo que realmente resalta. Las bromas y el ingenio de Murphy son complementados por la comicidad accidental de Wilson, creando momentos que logran arrancar risas del público en múltiples ocasiones.



![1000241189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23vhwV6hpvyYNESvSyNaJauwvM3usHyyKrUGcyRLoxn3brbPg1Muvd5EvomLbtTeGnR53.jpg)




<Center>[Fuentes](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pelicula+una+mision+secreta+por+Eddy+Mophy&oq=fotografias+de+la+pelicula++una+mision+secreta++por+Eddy+Mophy+&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRigATIHCAMQIRigAdIBCTkwNjU5ajBqNKgCAbACAQ&client=ms-android-transsion&sourceid=chrome-mobile&ie=UTF-8#sv=CAMSZBoyKhBlLTJrZ2hCVXVHb1o0UVZNMg4ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTToOdlZ5S1VvVmFZS1BUOU0gBCokCg5VdXhzVEhmOHJ2cm1wTRIQZS0ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTRgAMAFKBAgBEAIYByDIoKe4DUoIEAIYASACKAE)</Center>





El desarrollo de los personajes también es notable. Aunque James Turner es el típico agente duro y seguro de sí mismo, a lo largo de la película se muestra vulnerable, revelando su frustración y sus inseguridades. Por otro lado, Alex Reed, inicialmente presentado como un agente menospreciado, evoluciona a lo largo de la historia. A medida que la trama se complica, Alex demuestra que, aunque carezca de experiencia, posee un buen corazón y una inteligencia que lo ayudan a superar los obstáculos.




En cuanto a visualización,la película aprovecha distintos escenarios,desde locaciones urbanas, hasta entornos más exóticos, lo que enriquece la narrativa y mantiene la atención del espectador. La producción se siente próspera y bien ejecutada, con un magnífico diseño de vestuario que refleja las personalidades de los personajes y la atmósfera de espionaje, haciéndonos pasar la verdad un rato bien entretenido y de distracción.


![1000241191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23u5zYy6KvM34YPqxuem88f8XQo1gUAvuzxwCji4p3oqCsuw2cUqmCVKwr4wkV8GmyUcD.jpg)


<Center>[Fuentes](https://www.google.com/search?q=fotografias+de+la+pelicula+una+mision+secreta+por+Eddy+Mophy&oq=fotografias+de+la+pelicula++una+mision+secreta++por+Eddy+Mophy+&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQIRigATIHCAIQIRigATIHCAMQIRigAdIBCTkwNjU5ajBqNKgCAbACAQ&client=ms-android-transsion&sourceid=chrome-mobile&ie=UTF-8#sv=CAMSZBoyKhBlLTJrZ2hCVXVHb1o0UVZNMg4ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTToOdlZ5S1VvVmFZS1BUOU0gBCokCg5VdXhzVEhmOHJ2cm1wTRIQZS0ya2doQlV1R29aNFFWTRgAMAFKBAgBEAIYByDIoKe4DUoIEAIYASACKAE)</Center>



\

amigos, es más que solo risas y acción, ya que es una exploración de la amistad inesperada y la importancia de confiar en los demás, incluso cuando todo parece ir en contra. En resumen, la película es un entretenido cóctel de comedia, acción y camaradería que reúne a dos grandes actores en un relato que, aunque caótico, resulta ser cautivador y divertido. La misma tiene un ritmo ágil, humor inteligente y un mensaje positivo, \

sin dudas, garantiza diversión para los amantes de las comedias de acción. Yo por mi parte me despido de ustedes hasta la próxima peli y bendiciones miles.
