title.title: First Context - How EA Credits and Trusted Scout Status Work
title.body: A combined explainer for new beta testers: where credits come from, how to multiply them, and how to graduate from new-scout (5%) to trusted-scout (100%), either by being invited, granted by an admin, or earning it organically. * * * Part 1: How to Earn EA Credits on First Context ----------------------------------------------- EA Credits are First Context's beta currency. They track every piece of context you contribute during the pre-launch window, and they convert to permanent credits when the platform exits beta. Here's exactly how they work. ### What are EA Credits? EA stands for Early Access. They're not a token, not a coin they're a record of contributions during beta. The point of them: when First Context goes to full launch, the earliest scouts who built the network shouldn't get lapped by latecomers. EA Credits will convert to permanent First Context credits at a ratio announced before transition, weighting beta contributions heavier than equivalent post-launch ones. This way there is more of an incentive to become an early adopter of this tech. ### The four levers that change your earnings #### 1\. The Content Catch Itself (base credits)

/>

When you Catch content either via a single URL paste via the Thoughts on chain section, or batch via using the Catch Content bookmarklet, you earn credits based on how fresh the content is:

<table style=\

>

Content age when you catch it

>

0

The two top tiers (the 3 and the 2) only apply on **in-demand creators** meaning a creator at least one other scout already follows on First Context. The first scout to a creator doesn't get the speed bonus on day one - once anyone else subscribes, future fresh catches start earning the speed bonus. This is intentional: it rewards the act of _covering_ creators that already have an audience watching. #### 2\. The Signal Bonus (+50%) When you catch, the yellow⚡Add Signal button is optional.

/> Click it, fill in all five fields: * **What kind of content is this?** (original post, repost, thread, podcast clip…) * **Is it authentic?** (genuine signal, satire, ad, AI-generated…) * **How important?** (notable, major, breaking) * **Best timestamps** (up to 3 deep links into video content) * **Why it matters** (one or two sentences in plain language)

/> Fill all five and your earnings on that catch jump by 50% minimum +1 credit. So a 3-credit fresh catch + full Signal becomes **5 credits**. A 1-credit same-day catch + Signal becomes **2 credits**. The reasoning: anyone can click a button. Adding structured context turns raw catches into something the next scout (or the next reader) can actually use. We pay for the effort. #### 3\. Your trust multiplier (the gate) Every credit you earn gets multiplied by your account's trust score: * **New scouts** start at **0.05×** until they graduate. * **Verified scouts** earn at **1.0×** (full credits). * **Beta testers** (invited cohort, role-based) earn at **1.0×**. * **Manually granted trust** by an admin: **1.0×**. * **Throttled accounts** (caught gaming): **0×**. Until you graduate, your catches earn **5% of what they would at 1.0×**. Part 2 below covers exactly how the trust gate works and how to clear it. #### 4\. Your Thoughts on Chain (a different reward path) Posting a Thought on Chain is your interpretation of a piece of content, written and signed via Hive Keychain. This doesn't pay EA Credits directly. It pays you in **Hive** instead: your comment lives on the Hive blockchain, earns upvotes from the Hive community, and pays out in HBD/HP via the standard Hive curation rewards system.

/> Long-term, this is the bigger reward. EA Credits track your beta contribution; Hive payouts compound forever. Beta scouts who write thoughtful Thoughts on Chain are building a Hive reputation, not just a credit balance. ### Anti-gaming you should know about * **Sybil dampening**: 10 accounts catching the same URL don't earn 10× rewards. The system fingerprints catches and merges duplicates within a 24-hour window. * **Coverage saturation**: once a creator has plenty of scouts watching, marginal catches earn less. Rewards shift to creators who _need_ coverage. * **Old content cap via bulk**: bulk-catching an entire archive of a creator's old content earns 0 credits per item. Bulk catch is for _fresh_ timelines, not history mining. ### Quick reference card > **Maximize your earnings:** catch in-demand creators within 5 minutes > of publish + click ⚡ Add Signal + fill all 5 fields = **5 credits per catch** at full multiplier. > > **Minimum viable earner:** any same-day catch = **1 credit** at 1.0× multiplier (or 0.05 at new-scout multiplier earn 3 approved sources to graduate). > > **Bonus path:** Thoughts on Chain comments earn Hive payouts directly, not EA Credits. Hive payouts are the long game.

/> ### Where EA Credits go from here When First Context exits beta, EA Credits convert to permanent credits at a ratio announced ahead of time. Beta scouts who built the catalog get weighted heavier than post-launch contributors. The exact perks unlocked by permanent credits are priority slots, governance weight, potential revenue share access. Catch fresh content. Add Signal. Get verified early. The next scout you onboard might be your future curator.

/> * * * Part 2: How to Become a Trusted Scout ------------------------------------- A trusted scout earns at the **full 1.0× multiplier** instead of the **0.05× new-scout floor** (a 20× difference on every catch). Trusted scouts can also flag bad content and sources. There are three ways to get there: invitation, admin grant, and organic graduation. ### Path 1: Beta tester invitation (the fast path during beta) If you've been personally invited to the beta via DM, the Hive launch post, or a direct Keychain handshake with the team you'll be assigned the **beta tester** role at signup. This skips the organic graduation path entirely: from your first catch onwards, you earn at 1.0× without needing to prove yourself first. Beta testers do **not** get admin powers. The role is purely an economic boost — you're trusted enough to earn full credits and flag content, but you don't get to approve creators, resolve flags, or assign roles. Those remain with admins and seed-admins. To request beta-tester status: DM the team on Hive and provide your Hive handle. We'll confirm and apply the role to your account. ### Path 2: Admin manual grant A super-admin can call **grant-trust** on any user account directly, regardless of role: * **Grant** sets manual trust status to 'granted'so the multiplier locks at **1.0×** regardless of catches/sources. * **Revoke** sets revoked so the multiplier drops to **0.05×** even if the user organically met the threshold (used for misbehavior that doesn't quite warrant a throttle). * **Clear** wipes back to null so user falls back to organic evaluation. This is the same primitive used for case-by-case decisions (e.g. a returning scout from a previous platform with established credibility, or a known Hive personality joining the network). Admin grants and the beta tester role both result in 1.0× (they're parallel paths, not competing ones). ### Path 3: Organic graduation (no admin needed) Most scouts will graduate organically. Two simultaneous conditions clear the gate: 1. trustScore >= 0.6 2. sourcesApproved >= 3 Until both are true, multiplier sits at 0.05× (organic-not-yet-verified). Once both are true, multiplier jumps to 1.0×. #### How trust score builds Trust score isn't built by catches, it's built by **source suggestions**. When you suggest a creator's account on a platform (e.g., a YouTube channel ID or Twitter handle for an existing creator), an admin reviews: * **Approved** counts as 1.0 toward your reputation * **Modified** (admin tweaks then approves) counts as 0.5 * **Rejected** counts against you

(capped at +0.3) is awarded by **on chain endorsements** from already-trusted scouts who upvote your scout-catches with valuable signals, so the network amplifies high-quality scouts independently of admin review.

#### Auto-throttle (the downside guard)

If you accumulate **3+ rejected sources AND your trust score is below 0.2**, the system auto-throttles you so the multiplier drops to **0**, hard stop. This is automatic, so no admin action needed. Throttled accounts are manually reviewed before being un-throttled.

### Priority order (what wins what)

If multiple conditions apply, the resolver checks in this exact order:

1.  **Throttled flag** 0 (admin kill-switch — always wins)
    
2.  **Manually revoked** 0.05 (admin revoke beats role + organic)
    
3.  **role = \

** 1.0 (pre-launch invitee fast path)
    
4.  **Manually granted** 1.0 (admin grant beats organic)
    
5.  **Organic predicate met** 1.0 (trustScore ≥ 0.6 AND sourcesApproved ≥ 3)
    
6.  **Otherwise** 0.05 (new scout)
    

Throttle and manual revoke always beat the beta tester role meaning bad-faith beta testers can be cut off.

### Practical TLDR

*   A scout becomes trusted in three ways: an admin grants it, you got the beta tester role from invitation, or you earn it.
    
*   To earn it: submit at least 3 source suggestions an admin approves, and keep your trust score above 0.6.
    
*   Most scouts hit verified within their first week of active catching.
    
*   Beta testers get the boost from minute 1. DM the team to be added.
    

* * *

Together: How to maximize your beta earnings
--------------------------------------------

1.  **Get verified fast.** Either request beta-tester status, or submit 3 high-quality source suggestions in your first week.
    
2.  **Catch fresh.** Stay subscribed to creators you actually follow, click Scout Catch within minutes of new content dropping.
    
3.  **Add Signal every time.** The +50% multiplier compounds with the speed bonus. Full Signal on a fresh catch on an in-demand creator is the maximum-credit play (5 credits per catch at 1.0×).
    
4.  **Post Thoughts on Chain.** EA Credits are the beta record; Hive payouts are the long game. Both grow together.
    
5.  **Stay clean.** Don't game it. Sybil dampening, coverage saturation and the auto-throttle all run quietly in the background. Content Catches that look gamed earn nothing or get reversed.
    

The earlier you get verified, the bigger your beta record when EA Credits convert to permanent credits at launch.

title.body:
1. How does financial hardship affects students....
I think I have some things to say and my experience to share. Because finance and academics can not in any way be separated. So, after a long illness that forced me to let go of school, I decided to go back, since I feel continuing my education is the best thing for me, I couldn't work or do stressful stuffs, and eve though school itself is stressful I knew I would find my way around. At this time when I returned to school, my parents and siblings were still struggling to recover from the debts and financial issues my illness brought their way..and in all honesty it was weighing down on me too, while I was concerned about the various money I was to pay in school, their own focus was to be paying back debts and make sure I was buying my pills.

And like I said earlier, it weighed me down big time, I almost regretted coming back to school. Because now, my health should be my priority and not my education, na person wey dey alive dey go school...and that was how I began to miss classes, test and all, I began to avoid people too and my grades dropped,  because I can't just stop thinking and that was getting too much as well.

What I'm saying in essence is that, if there's a comma with finance and you're in school, it will definitely affect your performance and the ay you relate with others. Finance can change the whole school experience...that is how powerful it is.



2. Can students still thrive despite pressing financial struggles?

Huhm, this is huge but I will like to say, yes, they can, even though it's not easy, it still sums up back to such students.

After a while in school when I saw how pressing things were, and it's obvious I can't keep depending on my parents and siblings who have their lives too, I went my way to learn customization work, it is less stressful and my boss who was a student as well is a very understanding person. He even allowed me to tell people that I now make frames, magic mugs, throw pillows and the likes then even though I was still learning and very new to it... Best part is, he will allow me take the money. And that was how I began to do that together with my academics, he made sure he helped me out a lot and guide me till I could do things myself. And in a student area, the work was booming to some extent, that it began to affect my academics, that was how my boss called me back to attention.

And this was why I said yes, it is possible. This boss of mine who was also a student is a very talented person, he does electrical works, he paints, he does furniture, he repairs and do swapping phones business together with that customization work, still he never allowed it to mess with his reading/class time. He told me all these side gigs are good and can help me, but it needs to be controlled, tha the works shouldn't be controlling me. And that day,he said something... *\

While formal education remains important and it's importance cannot be over emphasized, it is also important for one to be able  to create, innovate and repair with his or her hands. At times learning a tech skill is very important. Especially in a world and country like ours that is rapidly growing in the aspect of technology and innovation. Learning a skill and handcraft is important in many ways , to some extent it serves as your second address.
‎
‎But before we continue let's understand skills and handcraft.
‎Skill is the ability for an individual to perform a specific task or solve problem perfectly at a high level of proficiency and experience. In the other hand, Handcraft is the ability for one to use his hand to develop and create something new that is useful to yourself and others.
‎
‎The following are few importance of skill and craft :
‎
‎It promote self dependency ; any one that aquire skills or Craft will reduce the level at wish he depends on people for some stuffs. And at a point he or she will not even depend on anyone again, instead will create opportunities for others. Having a skill and craft promote self reliance. In a country like Nigeria where unemployment remains a major challenge, learning a skill is very important.
‎
‎Skills and handcraft contribute significantly to economic growth of the national and locality, because some raw materials in our locality will be used to innovate news things and this alone will boost the economy and also instead of importing some things we can use what we produce without sending the cash outside. With the rise of digital platforms, skilled individuals  and those with handcraft can now easily market their products globally, increasing their reach and income potential and also earn in foreign currencies.
‎
‎Having a skill and handcraft is also a side hustle, that can put food on your table. They are invisible assets in today's world. Investing in skill is not just an option but a necessity.

</center>

五一第一天过得也是相当的充实啊，反正我觉得很满意了。昨天晚上又熬夜了，这两天我迷上了《黑执事》，这部动漫太好看了。反正最初我是被他的画风和那个很有鲜明特色的角色给吸引进去的，但是我发现他的故事也不赖，幽默又诙谐，有些情节整体的节奏也把握的很好，第一季看完，我靠，根本没法释怀呀，那个结局，但是好像我也没有不释怀的理由。唉。

然后昨天晚上看的马戏团篇。就差两集看完了，但是已经实在太晚了，就只好忍痛割爱先睡觉了。早上又补完了后面的两集，很难受啊这个结局。马戏团的成员们都身不由己，他们那个时代，那个社会，他们的出生可能就是不对的吧？与其在后面要遭受被抛弃然后被利用去做伤天害理的事情。，以及还被蒙蔽在那个变态的创造出来的那种他们以为的理想世界里面，就很不值得，看完，哎呀，难受半天，我靠，很难释怀，这个是真难释怀呀，他们明明都是很好的人，但那个社会就不允许他们这样的人活着，或者说就是要榨干每一个人的一切价值。我们现在社会不知道啊。这个我也没法说。人心真的很复杂啊。

中午吃完饭我就找了个空教室，一直待到现在了。学了一会的习，好难啊，实在好难啊。真的是绞尽脑汁都很难理解那些东西。哎，我真的很佩服一些人，轻而易举就懂了，但是我肯定不可能因此贬低自己。但是我能做的就必须要为我谋划另一条生路，反正搞科研，搞研究这条路我是万万走不通的，我一动脑子就费劲，或者说这方面的脑子我是转不起来的，但凡动一点点我就苦不堪言。

今天依旧去健身了，我这个也不能叫健身吧就是。健走30分钟，出一身汗，也不知道有没有用。但是我一个新手那些器材都弄不明白，还是从这些最基础的来吧，更何况我的目的也就是减减肥，然后当然我的体态能矫正过来，那就更好了，也不奢望别的，唉，反正吧，我这两天感受就是哪怕我仅仅只是在跑步机上跑个30分钟下来之后都很舒坦，可能他们有些人每天要在健身上花一两个小时，可能也就贪恋于这份浑身轻松的舒适吧。

转眼之间就到了劳动节。好像上次4月1号愚人节好像过去没多久。

三天的假期，眨个眼睛就过了。所以还是留在深圳，懒得跑来跑去的。

谁知道后面等到昨天晚上通知51放五天。气的我那牙根痒痒的。
早知道放五天假的话，我肯定回家去。然后又拿出我的铅笔。画了两个圈圈。
诅咒老板出门开车轮胎漏气。第二个诅咒老板的早上起床没有牙膏了。

结果昨天晚上就看咱能不能找到深圳回汕头的高铁。就是时间太晚了。
谁知道昨天的高铁票被抢得一干二净的。又没办法，就留下来了。
别的同事特别机灵，几天前就抢好了车票。他们就安逸的回家去。

还好我要求领安排好工作之后再走。反正在这里闲着也是闲着，还不如做事。
至少51这几天上班还是有钱拿的。到时候休息两天，然后去外面买点吃的。
安慰一下我这受伤的心灵，被别人坑的这么惨。算了，还是拿铅笔再画两个圈圈吧。

so i tried Ninja's Creed 2 again after a day and yeah same feeling hits

its one of those sniper games where you just sit and zoom and wait for perfect shot. kinda relaxing sometimes. kinda boring sometimes too

i was actually playing it while sitting on roof in evening light. wind was there phone brightness low. and i kept missing one target like 3 times in a row. my cousin was laughing again same guy. i just ignored him

game is simple. aim shoot upgrade. nothing too deep. graphics are fine not amazing but ok for mobile. slow motion shots still feel satisfying even after repeat

but yeah it gets repetitive fast. like same missions different name. enemies sometimes feel too easy. sometimes suddenly they become annoying hard. balance feels random

ads are there yeah. you just deal with it or mute and wait

i think its good for killing time not for long sessions. like 10 15 min then you close it and forget

i dont even know if i will keep it long term. maybe yes maybe no. depends on mood honestly

title.title: Trapped in Terror: Escaping the Deadly Granny & Grandpa House
title.body:
https://youtu.be/7ZgMlKkqBYE?si=b4Vtk0kavXINnTZu
Watch on YouTube 

Granny and Grandpa Haunted House is a horror game that takes the player into a unique blend of fear, thrill and cunning. In this game you get trapped in an old and deserted house where two dangerous characters Granny and Grandpa are searching for you every moment. This game not only tests your courage but also challenges your intelligence.

The most special thing about the game is its atmosphere. The darkness the silence and the sudden sounds make your heart race. Every room hides a secret and every step must be taken carefully because a slight mistake can get you caught. The player has to use different items found inside the house to find a way out.

Granny is a fast and clever character who rushes toward you the moment she hears a sound while Grandpa is relatively slower but powerful. The presence of both makes the game even more difficult and exciting. You have to learn the skills of hiding, running and making decisions at the right time so you can escape this terrifying house alive.

This game is not just a game but a complete experience that presents fear and adventure together. If you like horror games then Granny & Grandpa Haunted House can prove to be an excellent choice for you.

title.title: A puzzle, like something to calm the heart.
title.body:
A puzzle, like something to calm the heart. Any task in an unfamiliar field initially seems incredibly simple, or, conversely, incredibly complex. This is often what makes us decide to take on a task, or abandon it before even taking the first steps. We always have several helpers in this decision-making process: hard work and laziness, regularity and haste, lack and abundance of time, and a host of other helpers waiting in a long line for our mind and heart, which will rejoice if everything goes well and be sad if, having taken on the task, we fail. ![19contestDSC05207.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUSjXoQBkGwNP7iVA5ReHNwkDDbih3f9ihVDdtf6GeoMF/19contestDSC05207.png) Perhaps among these helpers, one of the most valuable is time and what we can spend it on. Sometimes, this something resembles a puzzle, but it turns out that they not only, as they say, develop out-of-the-box thinking, but can also calm our hearts. After all, it's not always possible to look at all aspects of a complex matter, due to the same rush or the rose-colored glasses that someone sometimes tries to put on our noses. ![1123contes1tDSC00088.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmfSKLcVs17y3haxeZmPiMRR3vQ6SRTnJaAtbVxLH2D1Lh/1123contes1tDSC00088.png) It's good when a puzzle can be solved with a cool head, and a cool head doesn't tolerate haste. Maybe this all seems confusing lol, but I'm talking about ways to rationally use one of your spaces, where you can grow mushrooms, or, for example, set up cages for quail, or broiler chickens. But, for some reason, this isn't possible, and you'll have to choose one thing, right, for peace of mind, and that's a real puzzle :) Birds or mushrooms? The first match was for 39 mana. The match was very easy, there were no difficult problems. I made a team like I wanted, and my team started playing well from the beginning. I won the match in 5 rounds. I got +20 rating from this match.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXnFR5T25eCQMvYFp5b527rzpi845pEcXGWo5xZ3QCDP9/1777643001603.jpg)

The second match was a little tougher. Here the mana was 60, and my and the opponent's power were equal. So I was a little tense. The match went until 8 rounds, in the end I won. I got +20 rating from here too.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdyei9MQ9PLwvAZvK7rV9v7JbPG8wQbJmQxzL74XsadL/1777643009140.jpg)

title.title: Prevention Is Better — But At What Cost?
title.body:
/>

The concept that prevention exceeds treatment effectiveness has gained broad acceptance. Vaccines and early screenings and other preventive measures have succeeded in saving millions of lives while decreasing the demands placed on global healthcare systems. The question arises about whether people should be permitted to decline preventive treatment when their behavior will impact others because societal expectations have replaced personal choice as the standard for preventive measures.

The fundamental value of personal freedom remains vital to contemporary society. The right to decide about their bodies and their children belongs to people who follow their personal beliefs and cultural practices and medical knowledge. The practice of enforcing preventive measures through mandatory requirements results in unauthorized control over people which leads to violations of their freedom to choose. Citizens need to trust institutions which operate in a diverse society by treating all people as individuals.

The need for vaccination through preventive healthcare services extends beyond personal responsibility. Infectious diseases spread across all areas of human existence without any regard for personal space. Vaccine refusal creates a danger which affects not only the individual but also high-risk populations which include newborns and elderly people and individuals who have immune system deficiencies. The health of the public relies on people working together in unison.

The concept of herd immunity requires a majority of the population to achieve immunization protection before it can function. When that threshold is not met, entire communities become susceptible to outbreaks that could have been avoided.

The situation presents an ethical problem because it requires societies to determine how much individual freedom should be allowed before public safety needs to be enforced. People who receive total freedom without any responsibility will create dangerous situations, while people who experience total control without human understanding will develop rebellious attitudes towards authority.

An effective solution requires an equal distribution of resources. The combination of education and transparent information and accessible resources should serve as the main focus for both governments and health organizations.

People choose to avoid preventive health services because they believe false information, they experience anxiety, and they cannot obtain necessary resources. More effective public health results will occur when organizations address problems that exist at the fundamental level. Health regulations become necessary during high-risk situations which include pandemics and school environments because they help protect public safety.

The process of preventing disease actually provides more health benefits than curing diseases, but this method requires more than just enforcement to succeed. The process requires people to work together with their community through trustworthy connections and knowledgeable understanding and mutual duty. The goal should not be to force conformity, but to encourage informed choices that benefit both the individual and the community.

title.title: CANJE: resumen de abril
title.body:
El precio de Hive se mantiene bajo, pero aún así es mejor refugio de valor que el peso cubano. Por lo cual, aunque las ganancias de los hivers cubanos son menores en términos de USD continúan representando un monto importante.

En el mes de abril [CANJE](https://t.me/CubaCanje_bot) entregó a los clientes una cifra de 181438.32 pesos. Esto en dólar representaron 316.706 USD. De los cuales 306.706 correspondieron a HIVE y HBD, y 10 a USDT (Red BSC). 

Porque sí, CANJE también tiene opción para cambiar más de 40 criptomonedas por pesos cubanos o MLC. Por tanto, ya puedes mandar remesas desde tu cripto favorita usando CANJE. 

Este mes ningún cliente escogió como destino el MLC. Una moneda del estado cubano que ha desaparecido prácticamente de la preferencia de los usuarios al tener cada vez menor caso de uso en el país. 

![IMG-20250901-WA0004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/canje/23w2sH4aXYLbvmUidpDdXcYSJoatW6QeNWYnnnyiW2eUdbS1XE9mGvCxLFWdhqQp7UcRd.jpg)


El precio promedio en marzo para el dólar cripto en CANJE fue de 572.89 pesos.

Recueden que el valor fluctua según el mercado y hoy en el bot 1 DÓLAR CRIPTO se paga a 590 pesos o 1.05 MLC.

Lamentablemente la devaluación del peso cubano y la inflación no se detienen. Cuándo CANJE nació el valor de HBD estaba en 162 pesos. Desde entonces el peso cubano se ha desvalorizado un 264.2%.

![BuhlhyckLBshmR57_1001402055.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/isgledysduarte/images/BuhlhyckLBshmR57_1001402055/BuhlhyckLBshmR57_1001402055.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Mi princesa asistió a una de sus últimas evaluaciones de Morfologia I en este primer semestre. La defensa de un Lapbook sobre tejidos cartilaginosos en equipo. 

Está evaluación corresponde a dos puntos de la unidad curricular y es grupal. Así que todos debían manejar el tema y estar listos para las preguntas. Unos más nerviosos que otros en la ronda de preguntas. Cuando no sabía otro respondió,no sabemos hasta que punto afectó su calificación. 

Pero están viviendo una de las mejor etapas de la vida y preparándose para vivir la vida de la manera que han elegido. 

Me siento feliz de verla así y anhelo el día que reciba su título. 

**English Version**

My princess took one of her final exams for Morphology I this first semester. It was a group presentation of a lapbook on cartilaginous tissues. 

This exam accounts for two credits toward the course and is a group assignment. So everyone had to be familiar with the topic and ready for questions. Some were more nervous than others during the Q&A session. When she didn’t know the answer, someone else answered for her; we don’t know to what extent that affected her grade. 

But they’re experiencing one of the best stages of life and preparing to live life the way they’ve chosen. 

I’m happy to see her like this, and I look forward to the day she receives her degree.

title.body:

***

天空是一幅壮丽的画卷，时刻在变换着色彩。无论是晴空万里，还是阴云密布，天空都能唤起我内心的宁静与思考。它象征着无限的可能性，让我感受到自由与广阔。而在日落时分，绚丽的晚霞更是让人心醉，仿佛时间都在这一刻静止。仰望天空，我常常会思索人生的意义，感受到自然的伟大与自身的渺小。

title.body:
>
Hello, there! **@saydie** here, playing **Splinterlands** everyday!

> So, another season has passed, and we are now in Modern Format Ranked Season 95. Just before the last season ends, there are some major updates to the game that were implemented, such as the overhaul of the SPS rental market and the addition of Phoenix Ash to reduce the cooldown of cards in Survival mode. I do not know how it is currently affecting Survival gameplay since I do not even try to play this season, but I can imagine how it will make the format more manageable for players with smaller card collections, particularly with the Archons, which is the most important card you need in Survival. Aside from that, there were also new rulesets that were added to the game. title.title: The Universe
title.body:
It's been a pretty busy month of April for me, and yesterday, being the last day of the month, I got reminded why sometimes, we don't have to take certain things for granted.

![photo-1444703686981-a3abbc4d4fe3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prayzz/23wWpaAQkJSLHHS5xdsRCQdy8iTAgbHrHcDiWeP1HmHxzpqGqoaZUcRoeK1xmX52fgBq2.jpeg)
<sub> [photo by Greg Rakozy](https://unsplash.com/photos/silhouette-photography-of-person-oMpAz-DN-9I) </sub>

A few days ago, I had packed up my bags because I had a trip to go on. And I remember that after I left my house for the bus park, I had asked the bus driver for directions, and he had casually told me that I would most likely be arriving at my destination later at night. This was around 10am when we had this conversation.

Unlike most developed countries where the buses have a particular time when they get to the station and leave the station or parks, it's not the same thing over here. In most parks, the bus wouldn't leave until it was completely filled with passengers. What that means is that if you happen to be the first person on the bus, then you probably would be sitting there for hours, waiting for it to get filled up before your journey would even start.

Sadly, in order to get to my destination, I would be making use of two bus parks. The first one, which also happens to be the one where the driver had given me a reality check, had gotten filled up a bit quickly. I barely sat for thirty minutes before we were on our way.

I eventually got to the second bus park, and luckily for me, I was the last passenger to get on the vehicle. So the moment I got on it, we were off. So, unlike what the first driver had predicted, I had gotten lucky, and after about four hours, I got to my destination safely.

Well, fast forward to when I eventually had to leave some days later. I had gotten up, gotten my things together, and gone over to the first bus park on my way back, and believe it or not, I was the last passenger to get to the park. So the moment I got in, we were on our way again.

By this time, I was starting to feel untouchable, like there was a force somewhere just making things go my way, and I loved it. But then we got to the second park, and almost as if the universe wanted to teach me a lesson for being so cocky and feeling untouchable, I had gotten into a vehicle that had about six people already in it.

This was an eighteen-seater bus, and with me making it seven people, I felt it wouldn't be a big deal getting the remaining eleven other passengers.

I sat in that bus for the next four hours, doing nothing but just constantly drying my face up with my handkerchief due to excessive sweating from not just my face, but everywhere. When we eventually got on the road, I soon realized how lucky I had been during all of those other trips.

And I got to understand why that first driver had told me that I could get to my destination late at night. It made me realize that I wasn't appreciative enough when I had those first three trips, and maybe that was why the universe showed me what I would have gone through if it hadn't stepped in when it did.

title.title: Going With the Rain
title.body:
There was a heavy rain today, and after it slowed down, I saw an opportunity to take photos of one of my favorite subjects: raindrops on leaves. I always find this kind of scene amazing because the droplets make the leaves look more alive and dramatic. Even the simplest plant can become an interesting subject once the rain touches it. ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 21.43.59 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6Bdd4mvjv2raJ6gpCCvpwNhaLr7bcjFNpiaTffWxFrqwqcErEEpAX3ByYe8mX8us8.jpeg) I also decided to edit these photos in black and white because I wanted to bring out the contrast, texture, and shine of the water drops. Without the colors, the shapes became more noticeable. The small droplets, the shadows between the leaves, and the smooth surfaces all stood out in a different way. It reminded me again why I enjoy monochrome photography so much. It gives ordinary details a stronger mood. I guess the rainy days have already started, which means I may have more chances to capture scenes like this very soon. It’s something I look forward to because rain changes the atmosphere around us. It may slow down our plans sometimes, but it also creates moments that we can appreciate if we are willing to look closely. Life is also like that in many ways. We cannot control the weather, the seasons, or even the timing of many things that happen to us. Sometimes we just have to accept the change and go with the flow. Instead of resisting what we cannot control, we can try to find something beautiful in it. Today, the rain gave me these quiet little moments to capture, and for that, I’m grateful. Have a good day ahead. *** ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 21.43.59 (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6Bdd4mvjv2raJ6gpCCvpwNhaLr7bcjFNpiaTffWxFrqwqcErEEpAX3ByYe8mX8us8.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 21.43.59 (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1vTqKn8BCngcr1AP24EcWgN7CH112BhFc2837XsfA2rn9c7h7PDGBqCYRvWMzdpPo.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 21.43.59.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo6CGS5kxN6rQFKeJu8HyAM2XGdoq89kenpvdcCs5b6ZZTSikoEVRRt5isyW8ecLb4y.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-01 at 21.43.58.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EonjUdUpUx2rVJMSyYYes7Pyk6rLxsP7w5XXrJPdSpLuXYhVF5WxmZjnHCmt849YF5D.jpeg) ***

”To see in color is a delight for the eye, but to see in black and white is delight for the soul.”

*~ Andri Cauldwell*

title.title: Metal Slug Andriod Game Threespeaks
title.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU8DwWcf5Pp1RQNKMKoKUQHkNhaPfsFqCcKTX2VDL1WaD/bb1179702a3c947d88707418ce2b6d97)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=inkbyte/09eb8d26)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=inkbyte/09eb8d26)


---

i was playing metal slug again yesterday on my old laptop. not even sure why i opened it. maybe just bored or maybe i just missed that chaos. the game still loads with that same old sound and for a second it felt like im back in those childhood gaming shop days. you know those small places with noisy keyboards and random kids shouting.
metal slug is weirdly simple but also not simple at all. like you just run and shoot right. but then suddenly there are tanks aliens zombies everything at once. and you die in one hit. one hit. thats it. no mercy. i kept pressing continue again and again like an idiot.
i remember once i was at a cousin house. electricity went out and we were just sitting there doing nothing. then light came back and first thing we did was turn on that old pc and open metal slug. we didnt even talk much. just passing keyboard turn by turn. losing again and again but still laughing. idk why that memory came while playing yesterday.
the pixel graphics still look nice. like not fancy but they have that charm. explosions feel loud even without sound sometimes. characters look tiny but somehow expressive. marco running like crazy. that heavy machine gun sound stuck in my head now.
controls feel a bit stiff though. or maybe its just me getting slow. enemies pop from everywhere and i panic. i keep jumping for no reason. sometimes i even forget to shoot. just standing there and boom dead.
also those random funny things like turning into a mummy or getting super fat after eating too much food. its so random. makes no sense but still funny. i was smiling at screen alone like a weirdo.
i think what makes it fun is that it doesnt try too hard. no long story no complicated system. just pure action. maybe too much action sometimes. my fingers actually started hurting after like 20 minutes.
anyway i lost all my lives at the same boss again. that huge tank thing. couldnt even reach half health. kept thinking ok last try then ill quit. but yeah i didnt quit.
its strange how a small old game can still pull you in like that. even when everything now is big graphics online stuff open world blah blah.

---

title.title: We Are Not Just Saving Moments, We Are Preserving Dreams || Not the End of a Class, But the Beginning of Greatness || April ,2026 Students Photos
title.body:
>

A person wants to save the moment of his life, but the moment that brings joy in a person's life brings satisfaction. All such moments that bring satisfaction in a person's life make every person's heart want to save these moments. These pictures that you are seeing are some memories of those moments. These are the same moments that I also want to save because these are not just pictures. The people seen in these pictures are not just a few people, but they are also the future. They are also the bright face of the coming tomorrow. These are my students whom I want to see successful. Those who are crossing the threshold of youth. Those who have big dreams in their hearts, in their minds, in their desires. They also want to do something. They want to become a successful, a great person. I have spent a journey with them and today, sitting in these pictures, we are making a new promise that when we go into our practical lives, we will help the community around us and become good people for them.

There comes a time when a small child enters school and does not recognize anything: pen, paper, book, letters, alphabet. Then he meets a teacher. The teacher holds his hand. When the teacher holds his hand, the teacher hands the pen to the small child. He teaches the pages of books. He makes him recognize each letter and that recognition is the recognition of humanity. Humanity is associated with every letter. Every word that is formed by combining a few letters takes a person to the heights of humanity. And then when that same child learns to hold a pen in his hand, he writes those letters with the ink of the pen. Then he combines the letters to make words from them. Then he makes sentences. Then he dreams in his life that with this pen that he is holding, he will improve the destiny of people. He will do justice with this pen. He will become a doctor or a lawyer or whatever field of society he will go to. This is the limit of the letters learned. This education will make him a better person and a person with better morals and present him in front of people. So this young man you see  These are not just faces, but they are successful people. These are successful faces. These are bright faces. These children have passed their matriculation exams and are now moving towards the next destination to achieve more successes. This will be my third article about this journey and I feel very good that I am expressing these thoughts and writing for the readers here at different times.

When we were traveling to many places and got tired of traveling, then we vowed together that we will definitely succeed. We will work hard for success. We will put into practice the words we have learned to make and the words we have learned to speak. We meet and will meet many people in life. Because in this journey, a person meets someone at every turn and every corner. And each person is a lesson, a chapter, and each person's character and morals differ in their character and ethics. But I have seen one thing that when these students who you see in the pictures, with whom I am traveling as a teacher today, are giving farewell parties, when I meet them at some point in their lives and when they are successful, when they appear to me as a victorious young man, then my heart and my pride will grow. Pride means my happiness. Pride means my heartfelt prayer that I always make for my students. Maybe when these students who are in the pictures  You see, five years later or 10 years later, I may not be able to recognize them and they will stand in front of me, I may not be able to recognize them, but they will definitely recognize me. And these pictures are not just for recognition, but they are a history. They will give birth to a story. The story that we are writing today or the one I am talking about here today. So, my prayer is that whenever any person, any young person who succeeds in writing a story from these pictures, writes it in beautiful words, beautiful thoughts, and those thoughts should also be such that they benefit every human being and provide motivation and appreciation.

![IMG_20260423_124010.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS7JPhgyiArK9YdgSuKRBWv2yEj31BVRo9pMzKu3v745C/IMG_20260423_124010.jpg)

You are also seeing some pictures in which you see my students dancing, swinging and being enthusiastic. This enthusiasm and passion is a symbol of these shortcomings. It is the satisfaction of the dreams that a person achieves or feels. You are seeing my students doing their traditional dance. You will see them swinging in the pictures. I have also made a video of these students dancing and swinging and traditional dance, which I will upload on 3Speak in the coming days. But when I upload them in video, those videos will also be prominent pages of my history. They will be that Iraq that as any viewer turns these pages, looks at these pages, turns these rows, he will see a garland of fragrance. That fragrance will be of success, which will be satisfying. But this life is very beautiful. This life is very beautiful and it becomes very beautiful when we move towards the fulfillment of our dreams. And I pray that  Whoever is my student, whether you see them in these pictures or not, whenever they climb the ladder of success, their every success has a fragrance that not only brings satisfaction to others but also speaks of beauty to them.

I had taken these children to a place where my journey with them was complete. And when they go to university level, there will be many teachers holding their hands there too, who will definitely take them to greater heights. In life, a person does not always stay in one place. A person keeps moving. A person who hopes and struggles to achieve his goals never stops. And be it a student or a teacher, their journey never stops. If there is a person who is fascinated by wandering and is fascinated by wandering, then his fascination ends when he takes a breath in the beautiful lap of nature and calmly sees his dreams in the lap of value. A student feels peace at that moment. A teacher feels peace at that moment.  He feels when his student is moving towards success and when a student turns the pages of books to gain knowledge for success, then each page becomes his ladder and takes him towards success. This writing of mine, these words of mine are motivational for all of you who are reading and to whom it is being read and recited. Please tell me how my words can help you.

title.title: An old tree stump.
title.body:
An old tree stump. Once, when I first started going mushroom picking with my father, I couldn't understand why we walked through the forest for so long instead of starting looking for mushrooms right away once we reached the forest's edge. My father explained that we needed to find an old clearing with lots of dead wood. That's where the chances of finding mushrooms were highest, and ultimately, it would save us time, even though we spent a fair amount of time hiking through rough terrain. But yes, indeed, often, deep in the forest, where there were many old tree stumps, we found ourselves in the middle of a veritable mushroom Klondike. After all, there were so many mushrooms, and most of the other mushroom pickers were too lazy to venture that far into the forest. ![DSC09958.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmP89nsJRaSio6WtJ3zmiMfLmrHgqSkmXbarf69k5aZ6Vi/DSC09958.JPG) As a result, mushrooms were frequent guests on our dinner table, marinated, fried, stewed; we froze and dried them, but somehow, there were no new variations on how to cook mushrooms, and this, too, is a bit reminiscent of an old stump that has become woody and you can't expect anything new from it. ![1artDSC00289.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmeEKmrr6nEhVvYksWgwNZKR1xvpJ548A8wfPve212uFDU/1artDSC00289.JPG) I must admit, I've never tried making mushroom caviar like they do with zucchini, or eggplant, or liver pâté, and it's supposed to be very tasty, at least according to the chefs who've made it and whose recipes I've watched. Perhaps there weren't too many mushrooms, although there were plenty of them, lol, but at the right moment, the idea somehow just wasn't there. I'll have to remember this the next time mushrooms appear on the table. ![20181201_093256.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZhqUAAZFBa18Spg1owhoxtae9E8xB5PThXj4XfkZn2Pv/20181201_093256.jpg) --- Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. # The Unseen Ledger: A Reflection on Power, Silence, and Exodus

*In the manner of writers who wield language as both scalpel and torch*

<a href=\

>from Imgflip Meme Generator There is a peculiar violence in the quiet click of a button—a violence that requires no hand raised, no voice lifted, only the cold arithmetic of disapproval. You who sit in judgment behind screens, do you imagine that the downward press of your finger bends the world to your will? Perhaps, for a moment, it silences. Perhaps it discourages. But never, *never* does it extinguish the human impulse to speak, to share, to stand. Some will yield. Some will retreat into the soft shadows of compliance. But others—those whose backs have been straightened by injustice, whose voices have been tempered by fire—will simply turn and walk. They carry their words to new soil: to Blurt, to Steemit, to any ground that promises not perfection, but the simple dignity of being heard without the threat of digital exile. And as they go, they illuminate. They pull back the curtain on the machinery of influence. They ask, not in anger but in clarity: *Who is cashing out? Who is accumulating? Whose hands hold the weight of this economy?* Consider, for instance, the public ledger before us—the wallet of `@gateiodeposit` on PeakD. There, in stark numerals, the story unfolds: > **1,591,850.537 HIVE** > Staked. Delegated. Moving. > Transactions flowing like rivers: from Binance, from mxchive, from countless hands known and unknown. > An estimated value nearing **$100,000**—not as boast, but as evidence. This is not gossip. This is transparency. The blockchain does not lie; it records. And in that record, we see not conspiracy, but *behavior*. We see capital in motion. We see influence concentrated. We see the very dynamics that drive people away. --- ### On Blurt.blog, there is no downvote button. Read that again. There is no mechanism to silently punish. No tool to bury without debate. What you earn, you keep. What you say, stands. It is not utopia—it is simply a different choice. A choice to value discourse over control, growth over gatekeeping. If you are reading this on Blurt, you are early. Not in the way of hype, but in the way of discovery—the quiet thrill of finding a path before the crowd arrives. title.title: (ESP-ENG) Kill Blue | A anime premiere bonus that goes unnoticed!
title.body:
**<center>Hello friends, good vibes to all.</center>**

> Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.


![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/2432ajTf9VyStKyN24pRxLDNPBYa5eKuLpPQXdbtM5LPLJ7rRQRXrgF5sBz7B9Fh23K8u)
 

[Source!](https://www.crunchyroll.com/es/series/GT00371896/kill-blue?srsltid=AfmBOorJb4dMp6W40L9fWAlp_HhHWHuAMbf21yBplyyq428YjhnvSCcu)

<div class=\

>This might be the last or one of the last anime I'll talk about, and while the list is long, I tend to focus on those that catch my eye. This particular one was recommended to me recently, and after watching just two episodes, I can say it's very similar to Sakamoto Days. I'm telling you, the resemblance in terms of tone, animation, and plot is quite striking. This anime is from a studio called CUE, which I'd honestly never heard of before, probably because it's new, from 2023.

> Puede que este sea el último o uno de los últimos anime que se han estrenado de los que hable y es que aunque la lista es grande tiendo a hacerlo con aquellos que me llaman la atención. Este en particular me lo recomendaron hace poco y con tan solo 2 episodios vistos se puede decir que estamos ante algo muy parecido a lo que es Sakamoto Days, pero es que de verdad les digo que el parecido en lo que a tono, animación y trama es bastante similar. Este anime es de un estudio llamado CUE, el cual honestamente nunca lo había escuchado o leído y es porque creo que es nuevo, del 2023.

>Juzo Ogami is the protagonist here, a professional assassin, one of the best and most feared in the world, known for never failing a mission. One night, after wiping out a criminal organization, he's stung by a wasp—but not just any wasp, it's one loaded with a kind of venom. The thing is, after that, Juzo faints, and when he wakes up, he's shocked. It turns out that when he regains consciousness, he's in the body of a 13- or 14-year-old boy, so we have a man with the mind of a 39- or 40-year-old killer trapped in a teenager's body. They have to find a cure, and they're already working on that, but he has a mission.

> Juzo Ogami es el protagonista acá, un asesino/sicario profesional, de los mejores y más temidos dentro de este mundo, quien además es conocido por nunca fallar una misión o trabajo. Una noche después de terminar de aniquilar a una organización criminal recibe la picadura de una avispa, pero no es una cualquiera, es una alterada con una especie de veneno. La cosa es que después de aquello Juzo se desmaya para que al despertar la sorpresa lo invada. Resulta que cuando vuelve en si lo hace en el cuerpo de un niño de 13-14 años por lo que tenemos a una persona con una mente de 39-40 años de asesino dentro de un cuerpo de adolescente. Hay que buscar la cura y ya están eso pero él tiene una misión. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tvCnxnA29Y9RVg8VK12f8ydn8cSH1sDPbdeDHdFY6nY1XLpwtogywd5aeZ2UqBdAgGS.jpg) [Source!](https://butwhytho.net/2025/10/shunsuke-takeuchi-kill-blue-anime-release/) --- ![3.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/EprXRQynBmd4K7K3iSw3y1YpfoDcyHTY5YWdHrMU3NWT3mKiRDMVhJaU5c6bknsRnvb.webp) [Source!](https://www.crunchyroll.com/es/news/latest/2025/8/31/kill-blue-anuncio-anime-2026?srsltid=AfmBOop6rMnnYmcIsu1fHyKRNqGCo1b10FJiy14rVA_2JfH2eYBREn0b)

>To keep working for his boss and receiving a paycheck, he's given a job: infiltrate a school to gather information on a particular student who might be key to the cure. So we have this man trying to navigate a typical school life, dealing with the usual high school characters, teenage situations, and, of course, imminent danger. Yes, despite the context, threats still exist, in this case, for the student in question. The anime is incredibly funny, with that particular touch, because everything that happens is surreal for the protagonist. Imagine being an adult and having to start practically from scratch, but with all his life experience behind him. As an assassin, he retains his skills, so when he has to do something, he has to do it without anyone noticing or suspecting.

> Para poder seguir trabajando para su jefe y seguir recibiendo dinero este le encomienda un trabajo: infiltrarse en un colegio para buscar información de una estudiante en particular que puede ser clave para dicha cura. Entonces tenemos a este hombre tratando de hacer una vida escolar en donde tendrá que lidiar con los típicos personajes de colegio, situaciones de adolescentes y obviamente con un peligro inminente porque si, a pesar del contexto sigue existiendo amenazas en este caso para la estudiante en cuestión. El anime es super comico, tiene ese tinte, porque todo lo que pasa es surrealista para el protagonista, imagina ser un adulto y tener que empezar prácticamente de cero pero con toda la experiencia de vida encima. Al ser un asesino sus habilidades las mantiene por lo que a la hora de hacer algo tendrá que hacerlo sin que nadie se de cuenta o sospeche.

>In the first two episodes, we see how, in this new body, he has to face assassins, and although his strength isn't the same, his skill remains intact. He always carries weapons in his bag, along with his books. I'd say the genre is comedy and action, and I repeat, the resemblance to Sakamoto Days is striking. It definitely looks like it will be in that style, about a character who leads a double life without anyone knowing and who has to confront the criminals who cross his path. This guy, Juzo, also has a daughter and a wife who plays an important role within the organization he works for. I think the anime is quite fresh, and although I can't say it's groundbreaking in terms of context, the truth is that it makes you want to watch it because of how surreal the situations can be.

> En los dos primeros capítulos ya vemos cómo en ese nuevo cuerpo le toca enfrentarse a asesinos y aunque la fuerza no es la misma la destreza si está intacta. En su bolso siempre lleva armas junto a los libros. El género les diría que es comedia y acción y es que repito, el parecido con Sakamoto Days es máximo. Tiene toda la pinta que será de ese estilo, del personaje que lleva una doble vida sin que nadie lo sepa y que tendrá que hacer frente a los criminales que se les cruce por su camino. Este tipo, Juzo, también tiene hija y esposa la cual cumple un rol importante dentro de la organización en la que trabaja. Creo que el anime es bien fresco y aunque no puedo decir que es novedoso en lo que a contexto se refiere la verdad es que dan ganas de verlo por lo surrealista que pueden ser las situaciones. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23vrpX6psRoR9T55xKmnwwAF6DsU26EzHMxtWnRePopsRAGM5P9YKec2dcLm7Jsj3AKq7.jpg) [Source!](https://www.primevideo.com/-/es/detail/0OMVXGVSTM448QNDNEI9149350) --- ![5.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23xe38oHTpqEDNJg5yr9mbKX8mJqDXSApYTbHziM5RkhH5G6jdVyjRTkoqbwWikEs1VJS.webp) [Source!](https://fandomwire.com/kill-blue-episode-2-release-date-time-plot-watch-guide/)

>The animation is excellent, the action scenes are incredibly well done, there's a lot of movement, lots of acrobatic fights, and the typical skills of this type of assassin. So far, this aspect is a 10/10; for a new anime from a relatively new studio, it looks fantastic. It really has everything: it can make you laugh and enjoy great fight sequences. But it's not all about the latter; you'll also see a lot of the story about daily life at school and how he manages, with great difficulty, to make new friends and try not to mess things up in the process. I like it; it's interesting, so yes, I can recommend it to everyone if you're looking for a cool and lighthearted story. I'll leave the trailer below so you can get a better idea of ​​what it's like.

> La animación está muy buena, las escenas de acción están super logradas, hay mucho movimiento, mucha pelea con acrobacia y con las habilidades típicas de este tipo de asesinos. Hasta ahora este departamento es un 10/10, para ser un anime nuevo de un estudio relativamente nuevo tiene una excelente pinta. Y es que lo tiene todo, te puede reír y disfrutar de buenas secuencias de peleas. No todo es esto último, muchas cosas que verán es el día a día en el colegio y como va logrando, a duras penas, hacer nuevas amistades y tratar de no meter la pata en el intento. Me gusta, está interesante por lo que si, se los puedo recomendar a todos si están buscando una historia cool y ligera. Les dejo el tráiler por acá abajo para que vean más o menos como va la cosa. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rW2BXlYQZHM ***

Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

title.title: Lost Between Lies and Facts: The Struggle for Truth in the Age of Information Overload
title.body: Today’s era is one of information abundance where countless news opinions and ideas keep appearing before us every moment. Social media, websites and various media outlets have made access to information extremely easy but at the same time distinguishing between truth and falsehood has also become difficult. Everyone presents their opinion as fact which blurs the true shape of reality. In this flood of information people often accept everything as true without investigation. Emotional news, sensational headlines and incomplete information immediately influence people. That’s why fake news spreads rapidly and the truth gets left behind. Through this process not just individuals but the entire society can fall into misguidance. This weakness of truth is not only due to an excess of information but also because of human behavior. People prefer to believe whatever aligns with their own views. Due to this bias they ignore the truth and accept false information. In this way the distinction between truth and falsehood becomes even more complicated. In this age of information, protecting the truth has become a major responsibility. We should not accept every news item or piece of information without investigation but rather verify it. Adopt critical thinking and rely on credible sources. This very approach can keep us closer to the truth and help in building an aware society.

title.title: Never Ignore A Mad Man's Act
title.body:
There is a saying in my tribe that says if we say we should leave the corpse of a mad man's mother for him to bury, he might roast her to eat. Which implies that there are some situations we can't actually stay quiet just because it's the person's life and they will be bearing the consequences alone. Just in case we might be forgetting something, that with all these act of ignorance by people whereby we ignorantly also ignored the fact that we are supposed to speak up against their acts, we directly or indirectly suffer from the consequences too.

![1000661890.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23tSgr4DQHjGra1AyYE5PgiTxgb2pRyjwZHnYN2K3fuCwrX8rfQtkKjWMX8u83gJFKkEb.jpg)

It's not until a fellow being will be affecting us with what they do before we try to stop them if truly there's a genuine love and connection.
Although there are still some people who would be adamant on their decisions and you might end up looking like an imposter to them.

Let's take for an instance, during the period of pandemic (COVID-19) when everyone was urged and beseeched to go for the vaccine and all that. Some counted it serious to take and collected the dose in full, some collected halfway not getting full dose while some insisted it's all false vaccination and that it's just a mere malaria sickness the government were trying to camouflage us with as COVID-19. 

Unfortunately when these set of people get infected with this virus, they are the type who lives in a crowded environment where they easily infect 20 people and those 20 also unknowingly infect their household. Before you know it, the whole community is infected and it's a lockdown of the virus already.

So definitely, we are not supposed to shut up in cases where the ignorance of these people will not only be affecting them alone but also others who come across them or stay in same environment as them.
Someone who refuses to get his or her baby vaccinated for polio because of one belief or misconception about vaccine should know that they are endangering the lives of other children who would be in same space with their children in the nearest future.

I saw a video of a doctor on LinkedIn where she was analysing a situation of a family whose wife is in labour and couldn't go further unless she undergo caesarian section and the husband was asked to sign the consent form of which he refused, saying the wife must deliver the way her mum delivered her and the mother-in-law too insisting she must deliver her baby like the Hebrew women.
In fact, the husband insisted when he realized that the wife wanted to sign the form by herself since he was still conscious that if she signs it and go ahead with it, he would divorce her...... Like is it even correlating?
Divorce and someone at the point of death!

![1000661896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/23x1RwJmrfC63yFEPGFfyxUfZfcxmW3tgaLYWB8cfDEZJpaPFsVkeKJ3uewKoN4tbUhPb.jpg)

I guess the medical practitioners were not really doing the needful and that's why the doctor came on to address the issues from the video that such husband was meant to be taken out by securities and either allow the woman sign the form since she is still conscious or the med practitioners sign their own form which she called one name or medical term (It overrides every procedure if it's a case of medical emergency) to save the woman's live as the whole begging with man is only endangering the wife's life and even the baby.

So many people are like that proverb at the first paragraph of this article. They would roast their family corpses if left alone.
It's not about right infringement or any grammar we may want to call it but the fact that saving them is saving a community, a society and a nation.

title.title: A Social Feature I'd like to see on Hive
title.body:
![260892.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23w3CmU7U2vWgp65aXX9C7ZMB8HDEVYHbuCH5hX9bsFepkYhdMffCiG2z5DcrwBxRKjFY.png)



<hr>

**Today an idea but me. Why can we just have a social feature for blogging on Hive where users can easy quote the posts of others?**




This quote will be like a long or lengthy reaction of someone about a particular post made by another person. This makes it easy for people to react based on the ideas of another person in a whole separate post.. 

In the past we've seen people leave lengthy replies in the comment section of others, and deprive their followers the pleasure of seeing their thoughts on some particular subject matter. 


 Sometimes we see post regarding issues that we want to address, and this quote option is a very powerful social tool which we can use to achieve this. 

I also think that this addition might not be a core feature of the chain, but ends like **ECCENCY** or **PEAKd** can add it, since it's not a chore Blockchain feature that will require a fork or rearrangement of codes or something like that, so it's probably not going to take a lot to do. 

**So let me give you a little backstory on how I came up with this idea**

### The idea

Today I came across a very good post from someone and it triggered my reaction and tore open my thought process. 

I had a lot of things to say, but I couldn't gather my thoughts enough. However I left my comment  on the post, but but that wasn't everything I wanted to say. 

I had a lot in my mind, and I also wanted to share this same thoughts to my followers as well, and also give others the idea to understand the standpoint of the original owner of the post. 

The moment I saw the post I knew I wanted to say something bigger, I wanted to wrote 3 or 4 paragraph about how I felt towards that idea, but unfortunately I couldn't, since it wasn't a feature we have. 

Infact in order to appreciate the original thought process owner, we can dedicate some percentage of rewards to motivate that person after we've quoted the post or we can choose not to, total by choice. 

While this is not an innovative idea or one that can boost price or reduce the bleed in the DHF, it's actually a fun one that improves or add to the social experience of a user on the chain. 

> This isn't all. 

**I think this creates a lot of awareness.**

A lot of people share controversial, relevant information through their content which can involve proposals, subjects about Hive security, the DHF, and other stuff; being able to quote directly with one's own thoughts, opens door for more conversation will certainly create awareness and users can easily pass their thoughts across using these powerful tools of communication, thoughts and exposure..


While it's also not new in any social web2 space, I think it's an essential social experience features that any social space should have, irrespective of web2 or 3. 

I don't know how these changes are done, but I know it's not a core Blockchain thing that requires a fork, and this is why it's even better.


 I talked about it bit being essential to the tokenomics of the chain, the core structural setup of the chain or anything, but it can also bend narratives. On Hive We're sometimes limited to seeing contents of who we follow except we go to the trending pages, this can somewhat change what. What do you think of this?

We were served with great and healthy food from Batangas like fried tawilis, fern salad with salted eggs, boiled garden vegetables and fried milk fish with tomatoes and onions.

---

title.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1888
Friday 01, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1953
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

TGI Friday Fam. 

It’s weekend 1 of 5 in this month of May. Since back-to-back Friday the thirteenths, (February, March) we’ve been paying closer attention to the characteristic and patterns of the various months. It’s something to do. We doubt that it will become a habit. But if it does, we can imagine the vessel 70 years from now babbling to the staff about what months will look like on the calendar and maybe even “feel” like, in a cosmic kind of way. 

That’s the way the simulation works. It’s like, that icon that shows up on your screen. “I don’t remember adding that program. So you run it. You like it. It shows you something you haven’t seen before. Next thing you know, you’re like, Rainman. “New Year’s day is on Thursday, that means February and March have Friday the 13th, five weekends in May, another Friday the 13th in November.” You know all the moon phases and cycles, can predict eclipses. Start associating months and moons with human behavior and psychology, and there you are, in an asylum, being attended to by humans who were born the same year you marked your Century. You’re that crazy old dude who refuses to die, predicting events, conflicts, demographic trends, fads, cycles. And nobody cares. Because nobody gets it.  

Sounds like a great movie. 

Speaking of movies. Watching these AI generated videos, makes me think about the early days of moving pictures. “Now that we can tell stories on celluloid, what stories should we tell?” DW Griffith might have asked. 

The European diaspora has an obsession with doom and violence. All those “slasher” flicks I wouldn’t watch as a kid are available somewhere on line these days. One can evaluate a “culture” by what it considers “art.” How much different is “pedo-art” from bondage/revenge flicks? These fantasy screenplays appeal to the lowest vibrating emotions. There’s envy, desire, dominance, violence, and on the B-side, resilience, vengeance, violence, retribution, and always lots of blood, severed limbs, and general gore. 

Hindus like to dance, and work through emotions and misunderstandings. Japanese like prehistoric space dinosaurs. Chinese like feudal-era kung-fu themes. British like their sophisticated gentlemen-spy flicks. (This is all old-school, by the way. I think all modern movies are super-hero themed these days.)  

Most of the AI-videos use recognized “movie-stars” from the past, or maybe there’s a fantasy character.  

But let’s wrap this up. I appreciate you reading these thoughts. They wander. Speaking of fantasy characters, The “Bajai Kulture” comic strip series debuted today. They are posted as articles so subscribers will receive them, or they might just pop up in your feed here and there. So far, the series will run daily through June.  

Stay safe, stay strong, stay sane, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.  

PEACE     




May Day Planet Earth

![1953.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTgjLeXoLny1qGRvd5Ssu3L9nQ8gPA6v81KAUG6SRrYXQ/1953.png)

Synchronicity
Friday Meditation 
That time I walked three miles on a sore ankle.                       
 
Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1888_full_5-01-26_1953_mayday:4?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 

I don’t speak Chinese, either. Did I mention that? I might learn. 

Welcome to a brand new month in the land of megalomania, propaganda, and flat out lies. America is on a collision course with its destiny. The Colonial Supremacy brought this upon itself, but most of us will bear the brunt of the payment. The “elite” is the mouth that writes a check, the ass, (that’s us), can’t cash. We take advantage of the day and use the title as a double-entendre. May-Day! Planet Earth. 
In case you don’t watch old black and white movies, \

is an internationally recognized distress signal used in voice communications, primarily by pilots and mariners, to indicate a life-threatening emergency. Hearing this word means that a vessel or aircraft is in grave and imminent danger and requires immediate assistance.
This is certainly state of the Occident, but I don’t care as much about Europe as the US. I live here, not there. Good luck with Russia, dumb-ass! 

America is in imminent danger and requires immediate assistance. Who ya gonna call?   
American, quiet as it’s kept, and it will likely stay quiet for, biblically speaking, seven generations, (about a century and a half), is gonna call China. It’s our call. Whether this is something we want to happen or not, is irrelevant. The alternative is the United States slipping further and further into an abyss until it starts to look like a scene out of Soylent Green, which was released in the late sixties and was set in New York in 2022. 
We are not allowed to talk about how America slowly became a Jewish country. Not religiously so. Not overtly anyway. I don’t know exactly when referring to American theological “values” switched over from “Christian” to Judeo-Christian. It must have been while I was dreaming secular dreams. Anyway, that would be an intriguing wabbit hole to crawl through.  

But we’re talking about China. Don’t fool yourself into believing that Chinese policy-makers and futurists have not noticed how the US was infiltrated and how its values changed from picket fences, mom and apple pie, to satanism, cannibalism, massive drug, including alcohol, addiction, blackmail, misomnyism, (hatred of everything), mental slavery, infertility, shortened life spans and general insanity. Meanwhile, China is thriving. In a fashion that would make J D Rockefeller envious, it has monopolized damn near every “rare-earth mineral” necessary to make everything from chips, to lithium batteries, to weapons of mass destruction, and they, China that is, are not exporting them to the United States.  So much for the Military Industrial Complex. 

The US imported nearly half a trillion dollars in good from China in 2024, and that volume is plummeting. And there are no signs that it’s ever coming back. This is just a wild guess, but by the middle of the 2030s, the United States will be ready to cry “Uncle.” And capitulate to China’s terms. 

This brings us back to Rocky 3.5. 
Like Rocky, Uncle Sam is slow, bloated, divided against itself and barely standing. It’s goaded into a championship match against a contender that it, (the US) can no longer dismiss. Rocky gets clobbered. He knows he brought it on himself. Of course in Rocky 3, former adversary Apollo Creed comes to the rescue and gets Rocky back on his feet for the inevitable rematch with Clubber Lang. 

But how did Clubber Lang beat Rocky? 
Clubber “was” Rocky. Clubber was hungry and relentless the way Rocky was in the first movie. 
China emulated the US. Not only the US, but likely the UK as well. Not out of any admiration. Maybe a little bit. But because they were going to beat the West at its own game. It’s no small coincidence that the opiates that entered the US in the previous decades came from China. Just sayin’. 

This is where we leave Rocky, on the mat. Down for the count. 
After millennia of dealing with the west, China knows that rehabilitation is fruitless. While it has America on her knees, begging for financial aid, industrial resurrection and dreams of being “Great” again, China knows the score. It’s not the “human resources,” it’s the system. Without a fundamental change in the system, educational, philosophical, theological, Anglo-Europeans will descend right back into the habits of tens of centuries ago. Consumption. Competition. Bigotry. Fear. Scarcity. Violence. Decadence. Eventually power, which will once again manifest in conquest, genocide and dark rituals. 

This is why and how, Chinese Supremacy will come to the United States. Don’t worry. You won’t see it in this life. But seven generations hence your descendants will be better off. They will be honoring You, as an ancestor instead of some wrathful, jealous “God.” They will practice tai chi and yoga in the park. Work shorter weeks, earn more purchasing power, have larger families, live longer & healthier lives. They won’t elect their leaders by popularity but through a system of merit, similar to the way the Chinese do it today. The US population might hit a billion, in a hundred years. But that’s cool. There’s plenty to do. No scarcity, real or manufactured to sell widgets. 

The best part of all about this scenario, is that I’m not married to it. A hundred years might not be long enough for Americans to exorcise all of that European insanity that’s ingrained in their brains.
