title.title: Chucky, you can never get rid of him.
title.body:
<center>[Collider](https://collider.com/chucky-8-new-movie-don-mancini/)center>
Recently, **Don Mancini**, creator of the **Chucky** doll and the ***Child's Play*** franchise, announced that he is working on a new movie in the saga (which, despite all the setbacks, is still very well-liked by its most captive audience). This is not just another movie (as happened with the most recent projects, which were released directly on streaming channels), it is a new attempt to revitalize the franchise with a theatrical release.
The announcement came after the cancellation of the TV series, and although there are still no further details about what is to come, Mancini assured that the project will be a modern version; but at the same time, bringing more subtle connections to the journey that has already been built up to this point. In other words, he wants to deliver to the public a new version of what is already a classic. The flirtation with the past to build a new present (and perhaps a new future) seems to be a good concept, but everything depends on how he will work within the new approach he will choose.
<center>[Collider](https://collider.com/chucky-season-3-don-mancini-interview/)</center>
After two decades without releasing any movies from this franchise in theaters (and it doesn't seem like it's been that long), this project is surrounded by great expectations, at least for fans of the franchise and horror cinema in general (and I totally include myself in both categories). Returning to theaters after so long is the perfect step to bring back to the public better-produced movies, and with global distribution. Older fans have the chance to go to the cinema to acclaim this already established franchise... While new fans can certainly emerge.
It is worth mentioning Mancini's effort in returning to direct, maintaining the essence of the project as it should really be. There are many connections he can work with, and with that, write a narrative that can \

everything that is already known to the general public. I hope he can forget at least some of the nostalgia of the old cast, and bet on the insertion of a new cast to build a new legacy. Chucky deserves a reshaped era.
---
<center>**Chucky, nunca te librarás de él.**</center>
Recientemente, **Don Mancini**, creador del muñeco **Chucky** y de la franquicia ***Muñeco Diabólico***, anunció que está trabajando en una nueva película de la saga (que, a pesar de todos los contratiempos, sigue siendo muy querida por su público más fiel). No se trata de una película más (como sucedió con los proyectos más recientes, que se estrenaron directamente en plataformas de streaming), sino de un nuevo intento por revitalizar la franquicia con un estreno en cines.
El anuncio llegó tras la cancelación de la serie de televisión, y aunque aún no hay más detalles sobre lo que está por venir, Mancini aseguró que el proyecto será una versión moderna; pero, al mismo tiempo, con conexiones más sutiles a la historia ya construida hasta el momento. En otras palabras, quiere ofrecer al público una nueva versión de lo que ya es un clásico. El coqueteo con el pasado para construir un nuevo presente (y quizás un nuevo futuro) parece un buen concepto, pero todo dependerá de cómo trabaje dentro del nuevo enfoque que elija.
Tras dos décadas sin estrenar ninguna película de esta franquicia en cines (y no parece que haya pasado tanto tiempo), este proyecto está rodeado de grandes expectativas, al menos para los fans de la franquicia y del cine de terror en general (y me incluyo en ambas categorías). Volver a los cines después de tanto tiempo es el paso perfecto para traer de vuelta al público películas mejor producidas y con distribución global. Los fans de siempre tienen la oportunidad de ir al cine a aclamar esta franquicia ya consolidada... Mientras que nuevos fans seguramente surgirán.
Vale la pena mencionar el esfuerzo de Mancini al regresar a la dirección, manteniendo la esencia del proyecto tal como debería ser. Hay muchas conexiones con las que puede trabajar y, con ellas, escribir una narrativa que pueda \

todo lo que el público ya conoce. Espero que pueda dejar de lado al menos parte de la nostalgia por el antiguo reparto y apostar por la incorporación de un nuevo elenco para construir un nuevo legado. Chucky se merece una era renovada. ---
**Chucky, você nunca consegue se livrar dele.**
Recentemente, **Don Mancini**, criador do boneco **Chucky** e da franquia ***Brinquedo Assassino***, anunciou está trabalhando em um próximo filme da saga (que apesar de todos os pesares, ainda é muito bem quista pelo seu público mais cativo). Não se trata apenas de mais um filme (como aconteceu com os projetos mais recentes, que foram lançados direto nos canais de streaming), se trata de uma nova tentativa de revitalizar a franquia com o lançamento nas telas dos cinemas. O anúncio veio depois do cancelamento da série de TV, e apesar de ainda não haver maiores detalhes sobre o que está por vir, Mancini garantiu que o projeto será uma versão moderna; mas ao mesmo tempo, trazendo conexões mais sutis em relação a jornada que já foi construída até então. Em outras palavras, ele quer entregar ao público uma nova versão do que já é um clássico. O flerte com o passado para construir um novo presente (e quem sabe um novo futuro) parece ser um bom conceito, mas tudo depende de como ele irá trabalhar dentro da nova abordagem que ele ainda escolherá. Após duas décadas sem lançar nenhum filme dessa franquia nos cinemas (e nem parece que já faz tanto tempo assim), esse projeto está cercado de grandes expectativas, aos menos para os fãs da franquia e do cinema de horror em geral (e nessas duas categorias eu me incluo totalmente). Voltar aos cinemas depois de tanto tempo é o passo perfeito para trazer de volta ao público filmes melhores produzidos, e com uma distribuição a nível global. Os fãs mais velhos têm a chance de ir ao cinema para aclamar essa franquia já consolidada... Enquanto os novos fãs certamente podem emergir. Vale à pena mencionar o esforço de Mancini em voltar a direção, mantendo a essência do projeto como ele realmente deve ser. Há muitas conexões com as quais ele pode trabalhar, e com isso, escrever uma narrativa que consiga “abraçar” tudo o que já é conhecido do grande público. Espero que ele consiga esquecer ao menos uma parte nostalgia do elenco antigo, e apostar na inserção de um novo elenco para construir um novo legado. Chucky merece uma era remodelada. Some of you, who are following me and reading my posts know, I like do post art cocktails, in which I'm mixing all kinds of artworks, the greater the variety, the better as I think it's a nice way to enjoy something from each category. 

![Art Cocktail Tuesday.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/48WDg2fCKZFiJeD5WhbB1Jfcr2DYhGap6HcRGSax9STDtuQoz1CD4HFjE1bbWYiaGq.jpg)

This week, as I mentioned, I visited three exhibitions, one of which was art already mixed, which not only makes my job easier, but it also gives me a chance to enjoy what I'm usually mixing for you, at the venue.  

This was an exhibition of a group of artists from Transylvania, including painters, sculptures, photographers, textile and metal artists and so on. 

![20260428_114722a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wX3o5uxrH2dfU44ub9zc9kvtSKdAz7jAvmS6RXC8QY1tutsf85p61CeAsuYTKuoA11U.jpg)

First impression always counts and when I saw these beauties, knew right away it's going to be a nice journey to artland. Unfortunately I wasn't alone, so I had to change my routine and start in the second room as I don't like to bother others, standing next to them, as I don't like others to bother me either, by standing next to me and me being forced to listen to their assessment and opinion. 

![20260428_114742a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23z7HdeQFSYN8a9hPeU5FMu9HjZX9FUXSGfntcLHMocGAjKxjAXtQFMPqSWBmqfeVDqdJ.jpg)

*László Vince - Along The Nyárád*

Nyárád is a Transylvanian river, which you won't see in this painting, but you can see the colorful woods. It's an unusual presentation of this part of nature, a very colorful, but I love it. The balance between these vivid colors is perfect in my eyes. Would look nice in my study, but without the glass though. I hate glass when it comes to paintings and photographs. 

![20260428_114755a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23y8yrD48eCeDihuSgKA1pNXxaLuoD7JWfrQKWLRDKELzL8gtX1MV7jP6o1icLgi1TUis.JPG)

*Ádám Baróthi - Flying In Pairs*

Pretty expressive metal sculpture, but it's not exactly to my taste. 

![20260428_114800(0)a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xVPJDHZPzCtJP5qo9NhMQAZeVTeJEWer2JsgpKozNzUW7dxnYVnwYvtwx58EiWHfBJZ.JPG)

*József Miholcsa - The Funeral of the Horseman*

A nice wooden carving, with a mysterious meaning. I bet you can't figure out how this wooden piece is connected to a funeral. I have a clue, not sure it's accurate, but I think it symbolizes the \

, which is a traditional wooden headstone used in some part of Transylvania. It doesn't look like this, but since it's carved wood, this is the only thing I can think of. ![20260428_114826a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xL2npXHpZ6uDbtPvTvi7xPyN8MxYUwMEX8ek79y9zgpLMexJka8adnsKvbDJeB3MNKX.jpg) *Annamária Banta - The Echo of the Palace* This is where things started to get interesting for me. I love this type of collages and painted on it. This is a bit strange, I admit, but still out of the box art. ![20260428_114838a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23w2sRnnCJiN4TQXTxKeRQ9GNH6macHKD4BQFjHgppmrR5nDo9X7z2vYXr8B5hLoB6kBo.jpg) *Ede Tordai - In Two* A wonderful monochrome photo of a scene you rarely see these days. The farmer with one of his best friend, working the land. Working the land these days is mostly done with machines, so once this generation passes, so will this type of work. But what is more important to understand here is the relationship between the owner and the animal. These are not pets, but trust me, some are respected and loved like a family member. ![20260428_114858a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpA3XdpnS7kR1zgiCEb3t7gaoAEejxVcaAk1uYen2kfmSA4SBUGQByDCxEsvmChBdCt.jpg) *Rozália Kozma - Overwritten Character* I've seen this textile wall art before, it's definitely one of a kind. ![20260428_114924a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wgRi64ZMdVDsy5KevfP2eWkqMkjENuwUtK21Fg2W4nPQtEMf5FQ74wzCtpPUpUbjgDo.jpg) *Ádám Baróthi - Bull Calf* It's been ages since I last saw a carbon drawing like this. Even though this is about an animal, the way the artist chose to draw it, it's a bit of abstract I'd say, which makes it even more interesting. ![20260428_114934a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xpHAP4W91JcrY843ozAEwB7DazN58mSN4gVNAF2NVfAkymwVw1xSJJXZ7ZYHf6dUm1T.JPG) ![20260428_114938a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wMebmfyXq13yicSHSwXSDcEV3WSQWLjg5wB1fqx5NgLYmMpKbrrFF6Ha8dVbFRX97D1.JPG) *Vince Bocskay - Villon* Villon is a famous figure and I love his work, but I think it's the first time, or maximum the second, when I see him mentioned or featured in art, live. There are several paintings, drawings about him, I don't know if he looked like this or not, but it doesn't' matter. I can just enjoy matter as the statue, or the bust looks great. It brings you back those times nicely. This is it for today. Let's see if you have a favorite today. Let me know in a comment.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 **The key point is brutally simple:** *The AI Doc* is **in theaters now**, **not streaming yet**, and the likely landing spot is **Netflix** in the next couple of months because it comes from Focus Features. The movie’s bigger hook is even better: it frames AI through a very human question — what does it mean to bring a child into a world being reshaped by a technology some insiders compare to nuclear risk?
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The documentary’s full title is *The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist*, which tells you the tone right away: not pure doom, not blind hype, but a tense middle ground. Director Daniel Roher and Charlie Tyrell use the film to wrestle with AI as both a breakthrough and a possible catastrophe. That “apocaloptimist” angle is the whole engine of the piece — hope with a siren blaring in the background.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The film leans hard on heavyweight voices. It includes interviews with **Sam Altman**, **Daniela Amodei**, **Dario Amodei**, and **Demis Hassabis** — basically the people helping build the machine. But it doesn’t just hand them a mic and call it balance. It also brings in critics and safety voices to argue that AI could scale into something deeply dangerous if development keeps sprinting ahead without serious guardrails.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The most striking part of the article is the trailer’s framing. Tristan Harris says he knows people in AI risk who **don’t expect their children to make it to high school**. Aza Raskin goes even harder, saying AI risk should be treated as seriously as **global nuclear war**. That’s not subtle. The doc is clearly selling itself as a high-stakes, existential debate — less “cool new tech explainer,” more “maybe humanity should stop sleepwalking.”
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
5/5 🧵 So the practical answer: **you can watch it in theaters now**, **you can’t stream it yet**, and if the expected release path holds, **Netflix is the most likely future home**. The article is really doing two jobs at once: telling you where to find the film, and warning that the movie itself is built around one ugly question — are we creating the most powerful tool in history, or the dumbest self-inflicted crisis imaginable? 📎 Source

# The News No, I am not in Alicante for [Hive Open Days](https://hiveopendays.com/), but lots of other people are. There is a [community](/c/hive-148309/created) for their posts so you can see what goes on. Although I could not be there this time I always recommend that people get to any Hive meetup they can. They are always interesting. If there is none near you then organise something. It does not have to be anything fancy as you just need a place and a time. That can be in a bar or a park or any place that people can hang out for a while. What matters is that people are there and talking. ![Prices from @coingecko](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23uFuVPWzHZNXs3RFZuR2yGHswHErb7zp5tW4B2nP2hjtFVNuCrXybnjNtjnq4DToZmiT.png) $HIVE is currently under 6c, but not crashing (like the blue coin should). For some reason the [coin](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bep20-leo) I track for $LEO is not showing any activity in the last few days. I do not know what is happening with that. # Friday Follows * Today is Hive Power Up Day (aka #HPUD). So you have a chance of a badge from @hivebuzz if you power up at least 10HP. * @selfhelp4trolls has [some thoughts](/hive-126152/@selfhelp4trolls/hive-is-finally-where-it-should-be-hear-me-out-k9f) about the state of Hive. We know it is far from ideal, but many people still use it every day. It cannot just be about earning when the price is so low. I see it is better than some corporate platforms, but we need more compelling content. Also check out his music. * Talking of compelling content, @northwestnomad [continues](/hive-156509/@northwestnomad/nerd-by-northwest-368-mirror-marxists) his fantasy comic series that has been running since 2018. Some of you have a lot of catching up to do. * @ds-tech has some issues with his account, but is back with cool videos about Linux and other technology. That is right up my street. * @thetroublenotes have a new creative project that involves [a book](/music/@thetroublenotes/the-book-has-arrived-the-journey-has-officially-begun) as well as music. * @starkerz has yet another project in [First Context](/hive-181335/@starkerz/07c494e7) that lets you record information about content from other platforms on our blockchain. As I understand it you can follow creators even if they are not on Hive, but obviously we would like more of them here. # The End I will skip the Dog House this week as I have nothing to report in that area, but feel free to share what you find. I will be producing another #BritList at the weekend, but I am not finding many people to add lately. We need those who are here to stay active. Hive is about more than just earning as it gives you control of your content that can take many forms. Bring your friends here so they can see it too. I have done #FollowFriday posts for years, but I claim no ownership of the tag and anyone can use it to share news and recommendations. Hive five!

body.title: Strange Happenings                 ...Unsettling Childhood Events
body.body:
*We are born with whirlwinds, forest fires, and comets inside us. — Robert McCammon*


![Strange But Wonderful.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYQH6qTqZpuVefKHruLeZSc29DkbgAqJc44PPpGU19QMZ/Strange%20But%20Wonderful.png)
*Strange But Wonderful*


As a child I experienced several strange events that still mystify me as an adult and fill me with a sense of wonder. One unusual experience happened when I was eight years old and my family was living in a very old row house in Toronto. The house was built in the 1880’s and had a dirt cellar and a coal chute. It constantly creaked and made strange noises. My Nanny told me it had ghosts. I saw a ghost there one night in Nanny’s room. The creaking house had frightened me and I scampered down the hall and crawled in beside her. Later, I was awakened by a noise. I peered over her sleeping form and saw a man in top hat admiring himself in the dresser mirror. He was dressed in the style of a bygone age and was quite a dandy. He stood preening himself, twisting his moustache and delighting in his reflection. But then, he glanced up and saw me. He glowered and I sheltered behind Nanny, hiding under the covers.

“Did you look again to see he was gone?” Billy asked. I shook my head. “Why not?” “Too scared, I guess.” He pushed his glasses up on his nose and gave me a disdainful look. “I would have gotten out of bed and told him if he didn’t get out of there, I’d call my father.”

I gazed at Billy in admiration. Billy was a pudgy science nerd with coke-bottle glasses and a penchant for acting rash. The week before he had carried out an experiment involving burning things in the wood furnace—his father found telltale ashes on the floor. I wondered how eager Billy’s father would be to chase a ghost at three am. Most of what happened to me back then, I kept a secret. I was a dark, brooding boy—a perpetual observer. I found it hard to share my feelings—and Billy hadn’t helped in that respect. I resolved to be even more discreet in the future.

That fall, I went into Grade Three and my teacher was Miss Tracy—she was a beautiful, young girl with long blonde hair and a soft voice. She liked me—Why, I don’t know, but I soon became her project. Maybe it was my dark brooding stare—maybe she just thought I was needy. Who knows? But quickly enough, her fidelity to me was tested. Patrick brought in a huge magnifying lens for show and tell. It was larger than a dinner plate and very powerful. We all wanted to look through it and I got to do that more than the others because Patrick was my friend. He put the lens inside his desk and we all went out for recess. When we returned the lens was gone.

Miss Tracy didn’t panic. “Now, I’m sure someone knows where the lens is, so just tell me and it’ll be all right.” The silence was deafening. Donald MacDonald, who was ten years old and still in grade three, shouted out. “Someone stole it.” Miss Tracy was horrified. “I’m sure no one stole it, Donald—they just meant to look at it and now they’re frightened to return it.” “Like I said, they stole it,” Donald yelped. Miss Tracy stood him in the corner. When I acted out, she allowed me to sit under her desk. I liked that—especially when she sat down and I could be close to her and the red and yellow tartan skirt she wore. Tartans would forever more be bound up in my mind with the colors of autumn leaves and Miss Tracy’s skirt.

“We can figure out who stole it,” I told Patrick at lunch. “How can we do that?” “We’ll make a list of all the pupils and cross off the ones we saw in the schoolyard.” Patrick was excited. “It’ll be like Sherlock Holmes.” By the time the dismissal bell sounded, Patrick and I had narrowed our list to two girls and a boy. “No way a girl would take it,” Patrick concluded. That left Donald MacDonald. We made up our minds to confront him at morning recess.

The next morning, however, after we said prayers, we were all trouped down to the principal’s office. Mother Charlotte was a no-nonsense type who decided to take matters into her own hands. One by one, students would go into her office, come out and return to class. Then, it was my turn. I looked at Patrick and he gave me the thumbs up sign. I entered the unfamiliar room and was greeted by the diminutive nun standing by a statue of Mary, fingering the black rosary beads tied round her waist.

“Come closer, Paul,” she whispered. I obeyed. She stared deeply into my eyes. “Did you take the lens?” “No, Mother.” She patted my head. “Good boy. Then, you can go back to class.” Within minutes the class reassembled and the morning routine began—Spelling, followed by Reading and then, recess.

We were reading a story about a boy who lived in a river valley. He was all alone in the house and a gnome came by—apparently, he had been drawn by the aroma of mutton the boy was roasting on the fire. I thought it odd the boy would be trusted to tend the fire when Billy definitely would not be allowed. Suddenly, Miss Tracy announced, “Okay, it’s close to recess. Put away your books.” I slid my reader into the slot beneath my desk and my hand touched something smooth and round. My heart sank. I pulled on it and Patrick’s huge lens slid out onto my lap. I had no recourse, but to raise my hand.

“Miss Tracy—I found this in my desk.” Her face fell. She saw the startled looks of my classmates, and quickly recovered. “That’s all right, Paul. We know you didn’t take it. Somebody did and put it back in your desk. Now, let’s all stand and pray and thank God for returning the lens.” “Yeah, but we all know who took it,” Donald yelped. “That’s enough, Donald—you can remain behind.”

At recess, I was a pariah—shunned by all. I sought out my older brother, Michael, in the sixth grade and spent the recess with him and his friends. When we returned to class, Donald was sullen and dark. His hands were red and swollen and he kept licking them until Miss Tracy put him out in the hall. When we left for lunch, she gave me a look of profound sadness. I didn’t return that afternoon. I had a stomach ache and stayed home. Later, when school was out, all the neighborhood kids were gathering leaves into a huge pile and jumping in. We did this for about ten minutes until one of us saw Billie had found a mysterious black rock.

“It’s really weird, “ he said, “It’s warm to the touch. Watch this—” He struck the rock against the sidewalk and dull red sparks flashed out. “What is it?” I asked. “It’s a flint, stupid—like what they use in lighters to make a spark.” Billy did seem to know quite a bit about making fire—in fact, all of us huddled around him in the gathering dusk watching him strike sparks. We must have resembled the painting of cavemen in the library entitled, *Man Discovers Fire.*

We each took a turn. Gradually, the house lights came on and each of us was called away to supper. Finally, it was only Billie and I left. “Look, I can’t take this home—you know how my dad feels about fire.” I nodded grimly. “Hide it under your porch and we’ll play with it tomorrow.” I nodded, just as we heard, *Billieee!* His mother was on the porch, beckoning him in.

I was alone with the stone. What should I do? Something spectacular, for sure. I was tired of striking sparks. *I knew! Throw it as high as I can and when it comes down and strikes the sidewalk—Who knows what might happen?* I tossed it high to the stars, glimmering innocently in the purple sky. The rock described a perfect arch and came down with a mighty thud. A huge white star, an orb, the size of the great Communion Host Father O’Toole offered each Sunday, appeared. The white host emerged from the rock and then whooshed like a spiral sky rocket, flying directly at my face. It halted and hung suspended in mid-air—right before my eyes. I gazed into the paten and saw the image of Miss Tracy’s lovely face.

body.title: A Splinterlands Season That Wasn’t Always Perfect
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUepQ5HgbBEsRanFcmxfaD2CUayMoJ1UNGAZ6eaTrqmVQ/thumbnail.png)

Hello Splinterlands warriors—how did your season end? Hopefully still good, or at least not too painful. Because honestly, last season wasn’t a glorious one for me—but that’s exactly what made the story more interesting.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7oZWPbTGNHKHJqriRyBvMCfsBa1pKPX5iUSBxnBNMZM/silver_1.png)


I finished the season in **Silver I**. Not my best achievement, but not a total failure either. There was a calm sense of “it is what it is,” even though deep down there was still a whisper: *I could’ve done better*. But that’s how it goes—I was a bit off my rhythm last season. Real life stepped in—work came unannounced, and Splinterlands had to share the time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT9iSRrfcw9737Ka6nNPauPrFxXhYN1NJzU2XigadWX5L/rewards.png)


Even so, reaching Silver I still came with small rewards. A few **Common cards** showed up as tier rewards. Nothing special, but enough to remind me that every step still counts, no matter how small.





If we’re talking numbers, I only managed to collect around **36,707 Glint from gameplay**, and by the end of the season it totaled about **70,000 Glint**. A number that… well, honestly, isn’t very satisfying compared to previous seasons at the same tier.



Usually in Silver I, I can be a bit more aggressive—both in terms of battle volume and results. But this time, the rhythm just wasn’t consistent. Sometimes I played, sometimes I didn’t. Sometimes I was focused, sometimes my mind was still on work. And as always, Splinterlands isn’t too forgiving for half-hearted players.

But strangely, that’s where I learned something:
**not every season has to be a peak. Some seasons are just about surviving.**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhucQtEh56eXsReqKtkpDJj21WMbXcSE3ng3K3ytf3Hs/season_end.png)

What made this season feel different was the number of new things introduced all at once:

* **new cards**
* **new rulesets** that sometimes force you to rethink everything from scratch
* even **skin features** that start to change how we see cards

The Splinterlands arena feels more alive now—but also more demanding. It’s no longer enough to rely on old strategies. Sometimes you have to be willing to fail first before getting it right.



I had a few matches that, looking back now, are actually quite funny. Going in confidently with my favorite combo, only to lose in two rounds because the ruleset didn’t fit. That’s when I realized—the meta keeps evolving, and we can’t afford to stand still.

|Archived Rila Fen|Whispered Rila Fen|
|------------|------------|
|    ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb7gyVVXJDNd8j8ziwdc92kHf73xuipNezB9ix8HhGwSB/archived_rila_fen.webp)    |   ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbor3NexiQUHNqD2e3ziJCqch4UAXmetZA6kdgiLLTQAE/whispered_rila_fen.webp) |


In the middle of an average ranked performance, I still managed to join several **Brawls** with my guild. And honestly, this is one of the things that keeps me connected to the game.

From Brawls, I still earned:

* **SPS**
* **Merits**

And more than that, I gained something you can’t measure with numbers:
**a sense of togetherness.**

Sometimes we lose together, sometimes we win together. But there’s always a story afterward. And that’s what keeps me logging in—even when I’m busy.

---

### Lessons from This Season

With around **70k Glint**, I already have a simple plan:
just open it—turn it into cards. Because honestly, what I need right now isn’t just savings, but **collection upgrades**.

My card levels still need a push. And from experience, sometimes a single small upgrade can change the outcome of many battles.

So even though this season’s results weren’t optimal, there’s still a small hope at the end:
maybe the next chest opening will bring a surprise that makes up for everything.



From this “ordinary” season, I actually learned some uncommon lessons:

* Consistency matters more than short bursts of ambition
* Adaptation matters more than memorizing strategies
* And most importantly, enjoying the process matters just as much as the result

Because if you only chase rank, you burn out quickly. But if you enjoy the journey, you last much longer.

---

This season may not have been my best, but it wasn’t wasted either. The journey is still long, and the Glint is still waiting to be opened.

A short piece of advice from me:
**play at your own life rhythm—don’t force it, but don’t stop learning either.**

See you in the next end-of-season report. 🔥

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)

body.title: Echoes of Childhood on a Broken Swing
body.body: In a corner of the old park that broken swing still stands silent as if it’s a relic of some forgotten moment in time. Once this very swing echoed with children’s laughter swaying with the wind as it told stories of joy. But now its chains are rusted and the wood is cracked. This isn’t just a swing but a silent story of passing time. Every passerby who sees this swing probably pauses for a few moments as if trying to feel the memories hidden within it. Some remember their childhood some recall those carefree days when small joys meant everything. This broken swing has become the guardian of memories that now live only in hearts. Life is somewhat like this too sometimes it takes you to great heights and sometimes it stops you suddenly. Just as this swing’s motion has stopped some dreams also remain incomplete. Yet there is a beauty even in those incomplete dreams because they teach us that every moment is precious and every joy should be lived fully. Perhaps one day someone will come fix this swing again and it will sway once more. But even if that doesn’t happen there’s still a deep message in its silence that time changes things break yet memories always remain alive.

body.title: Bridge Sketch
body.body:
![PENUP_20260501_205305~3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steempampanga/23wByQfnrbXGedzrwtHm4H1mXNbSNsyoZa4XihDvEadjXUP8QaCsScom3dW3hFCCuPBRE.png)


The cool blue glow of the night sky, a sturdy stone bridge with light catching the arches, and tall, modern buildings shining in the distance. This scene doesn’t come from my local neighborhood, but was actually inspired by a nighttime urban moment I saw while watching a TV series. The atmosphere was just so striking that I knew I had to capture it in my own way for this digital drawing.

The view across the water immediately made me think of the SketchQuest contest hosted by @quatro, so I took the time to finish this piece and make it fit for submission. I focused on trying to get that urban, cinematic feeling of seeing bright lights contrasted against the cool blues of evening. The reference scene has snow actually but I am afraid this composition might end up with everything white so I skipped the snow. It’s a bit of an experiment, trying to recreate a setting from TV
It was fun to use a fictional inspiration for this urban sketch and challenge myself with the light and reflections. I’m satisfied with how it turned out and that I got it ready in time to submit. The digital brush mostly gouache had some challenges like a layer not adding to my intent for some weird reason but it was fun 

Thank you for dropping by to check out my latest work and my contribution to the contest. Goodbye for now

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 30 2026 : Last day of April
body.body:
Hello Everyone Welcome to my blog 🥰 It's the last day in the month of April. I am so glad about it, indeed I have been saying that I would enjoy 2026. But I am facing a lot of challenges that are clouding the enjoyment. The only thing that keeps me going is the mercy of God. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/87a40ec8-dda8-4789-8cc5-f5a2f8842587.jpg) I even had a lot of mixed feelings on this day and I dislike feeling this sort of way but I guess this is what keeps me alive. Of course I went to work on this day, and I went early enough. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/abaf0471-5ba7-44bd-9f29-5ef6b716c7a0.jpg) Work on this day was kinda dull, well servicom came to check on workers and their attitude towards work, which mainly involves coming early and not leaving until the end of work and also not missing work. In the ward, I was so happy about one of our patients speedy recovery. She adhered to dietary regime and the evidence is seen. I enjoy working with this kind of persons because we have another one that, to me she is not helping herself and making the management so difficult and complicated for us. She makes me worried always whenever I remember going for ward rounds. And she is pushing for discharge. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7ae6edd0-5820-4788-ba35-6e1676d222d4.jpg) This is understandable because of financial difficulties but she doesn't want to understand that prolonging her stay is in her hands. The rest of my day went well, we even took a selfie, I would say we are making memories because very soon we would move to another unit. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0d15f8e7-abee-4b20-ae40-d850524fa2cc.jpg) I am enjoying working with my colleagues now, unlike before. I guess we have come to understand each other. The rest of my day went so well and cool. I came back and relaxed because I was exhausted but I needed to do some certain things at home. I had to put them on hold because the next day is public holiday. So, I would do some certain things around the house and it's going to be a long weekend.....I love love. --- --- Thank you very much for visiting my blog 🥰 Do have a fabulous day. > All photos are taken with my android mobile phone

Today we have for you a guitar pick from the band called 

Motorhead

Motörhead was the quintessential bridge between heavy metal and punk rock, defined by a relentless, high-decibel sound they famously dubbed \
Formed in 1975 and led by the legendary Ian \
Kilmister, the power trio became icons of the underground with a grit that few could match. Their signature track, \

remains one of the most recognizable anthems in music history, characterized by Lemmy’s gravelly vocals and distorted, rhythmic bass playing. Over four decades, the band maintained a fiercely loyal following, embodying a raw, uncompromising attitude that influenced generations of thrash and speed metal bands. Though Lemmy passed away in 2015, Motörhead’s legacy as the loudest, toughest band in the business is firmly cemented in the rock pantheon.

---

Here's what eBay had to say about this guitar pick 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5b52e271-747b-4e16-a83b-36cda93c5bec.jpg)


This collection is a remarkable physical record of rock history, featuring a diverse array of guitar picks gathered from some of the most legendary North American tours. Each piece represents a specific moment in time, coming directly from the hands of the most influential touring bands of the last 20 to 40 years. From the thrash metal precision of Megadeth to the grunge-era icons like Eddie Vedder, these picks are more than just gear—they are tangible artifacts from the high-energy arenas and stadiums that defined a generation of music.
The significance of these picks lies in their connection to the peak of live performance culture across the continent. Over the past four decades, touring reached a massive scale, and these picks were used by artists who headlined the most iconic festivals and venues in the world. Whether it's a specialty \

design or a classic tour-stamped plectrum, having items from bands that shaped the sound of the 80s, 90s, and 2000s makes this a curated chronicle of modern rock’s touring legac. I'm putting this guitar pic together. Alphabetical order over the next few weeks and months.

body.title: Marrying a close relative what does the bible say about it// Mcgi review
body.body:
https://youtu.be/R_GVqSdYWUU?si=JC_FzFI9xEylPf-I
The Bible generally discourages marriage between close relatives. In the Old Testament, God gave clear laws to the Israelites warning against sexual relationships among close family members such as parents, siblings, and close blood relatives. These instructions were meant to preserve moral purity, family order, and respect within the home.

Beyond the spiritual reason, such unions were also discouraged to protect families from complications and harm that could arise from such relationships. The Bible presents marriage as a union that should honor God and promote healthy, respectful relationships, not create confusion or disorder within the family structure.

body.body:
Financial situations are usually a big issue when it comes to tertiary education.

I can say that if you have your financial needs catered for by someone, so you don't have to worry about it, your academic performance will most likely be good.

But when you're struggling financially, it's takes a huge toll on you as a student. Emotionally, physically and every other way possible, you will struggle. Most times, people look for side gigs to help themselves financially, but this only means they would allocate the time they would have used for academics to that side gig.

The end result most times is a drastic decline in academic performance. Ultimately, you find people just looking for a way to graduate irrespective of what CGPA or grades they graduate with.

body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmSGkCoe5rePSxUfAgDEreuztKvWw9u2BfXH7N1VWmc1Yp/InCollage_20260501_134245993~2.jpg

It was lovely and sunny this morning as I walked around Holmebrook Country Park. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcCZ9aRHsorRqgi3KhNjXGUwpFtnynzGosy5cThpeMj77/5416.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmcFxPuPJ3Qh2KEm1rGQqyUXuAhpsti6enH7KDgFP4FHgW/5423.jpg

The park looked really pretty, with the colours really popping. There was lots of wild garlic near the stream and a few bluebells.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmUZSH8fHh2rUk7RfkRk1NyqEuVCU3ktAkzDaNGzZbrA9r/5486.jpg

There seemed to be a lot of squirrels about,  with some coming quite close to me. I saw a couple of people with bags of birdseed and nuts, and as the squirrels didn’t appear to be afraid of people, I expect they get fed as well. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYAjUHf2Sko3ztw3zm2t3ta71pz7EPNCd3E1QkuuKt23K/5510.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeCFzrUkdnGozGVQJSPLpJYpEc2gHN9nVHF6c9PQpjgQ/5525.jpg

I’ve come to the conclusion that I need to bring various snacks with me when I go out walking to feed all the animals.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWVX21SWRA29Xw9jpat23VDGbpxtC7LqX5hrArxA8esKy/file_00000000eba471f48ed78943fd26a7b5~2.jpeg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmNiaQsv1EW8jhNJAC38iFunYtVQyfxfBRV7r3hr7NB63n/file_000000004f1071f4beb5f35dcb35fc7a.jpeg

I spotted a swan on her nest. She was rolling her eggs around beneath her.  They do this for various reasons, such as keeping the eggs at the same temperature, protecting them from predators if an egg has rolled out of place, or sometimes the mother will get rid of one if she realises it's not viable.

https://images.hive.blog/DQme6Kap8pf3g6iG5Nmk1jACPVACcoJhLfw1XDBAiChdkn9/5537.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ8XcKpJzntS3wi7USpg8gTXuqpiRtFnTjVtUNGuELn1v/5540.jpg

Her mate was very close by, keeping an eye on the proceedings.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmSsTCMwbsaRtni4q7g4sTKqirk2U94e7E3Z9Mc98hMLSJ/5561.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWuWaYu47qVzqnsbTL1nFrU3LxyLHZUpnMqP45tcdb4cX/file_000000007e247246aadf4501afeb7d17.jpeg

I think it’s the first time I’ve witnessed a crow and a mallard duck having a bit of a set-to. The crow went looking for a fight, but the ducks had the last say (or quack), so the crow flew off!  I was very lucky to get a photo, as it all happened very quickly.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmSHfHcsC5XJFguazQ9G3DSRsJdWe8zHifJ5rWLH47NbGS/5414.jpg

It was a really enjoyable walk and a good way to start the day, seeing so much wildlife. I will go back again with some nuts for the squirrels and to check on the imminent hatching of the cygnets.

body.title: The Out-of-Focus Lens
body.body:
There are moments when the world loses its sharp edges, and everything begins to merge into a singular, hazy hum. It’s not that you aren't moving, but rather that the days have lost their distinct colors. You wake up, you drift through the motions, and you find yourself back in bed before you’ve truly felt present. It is a life lived in the background of your own mind, where the faces are soft, the voices are muffled, and the future feels like a distant shore hidden behind a thick, unrelenting fog.

The Out-of-Focus Lens

The morning sun is just a smear of white,
A pale reminder of the passing night.
I walk through streets where shadows have no end,
And wait for colors that the world won't lend.

I hear my name, a sound from far away,
As clocks dissolve the substance of the day.
The people pass like ghosts in silver rain,
Too soft to touch, too ghost-like to explain.

I reach for anchors—something real and fast,
But find my fingers slipping through the past.
The goals I held, the dreams I used to know,
Are blurred by winds that never cease to blow.

It’s not a darkness, just a lack of light,
A static hum that steals away my sight.
I’m moving forward, yet I’m standing still,
A leaf that’s caught against the window sill.

I wait for focus, for the world to snap,
To find the exit from this velvet trap.
But for today, I’ll let the edges run,
A life in blur beneath a hidden sun.
There is a strange, quiet comfort in the haze, even if it feels like losing a part of yourself. Living in a blur is often a way the heart protects itself from the sharpness of reality—a temporary sanctuary until we are ready to see clearly again. I am waiting for the moment the lens shifts, trusting that eventually, the lines will harden and I will find my footing in a world that is no longer out of reach.

body.title: How does Hive Governance works
body.body: I think there will be a lot of theory about how Hive works as an \
that needs human beings to function.\n\nThe reality is that, apparently, there is no \

even though it supposedly was born as a reaction to the purchase of Steem by an individual, to supposedly be a place where the community rules.\n\nI am new and know little about all the Steem and Hive drama, but what I notice is that the \

of Hive also believe they own Hive the same way Sun owns Steem.\n\nAnd they act accordingly. Fundamental decisions are made by 20 witnesses who represent a form of Plutocracy, since by holding more tokens than the rest of the \

they are the ones who divide the pie — and they apparently see Hive as a business, not a community.

This is especially evident in the way DHF expenses are approved. Projects don't need to be useful, or even good, as long as they involve people with the right connections.

A single person's vote approves or discards projects — some of which seem to be more of a way to provide disguised \
\n\nI know you will ask for proof, but when we all see what is happening, you cannot pretend it isn't happening just because there is no \
\n\nFrom their annual parties and meetups to the rally race that never appeared anywhere other than Hive, the \

to promote Hive have always been whims paid for with a fund they treat like the Goose That Lays the Golden Eggs.

Those who put up money to be the ones who decide how Hive's funds are used are within their rights, but what they must not do is put on the comedy that Hive is a community when in reality it is a Private Club that lets a few outcasts and lackeys in — because otherwise it couldn't be sold as a social network with 20 or 100 users.

But what I find most disgusting is that people who did \

for Hive are now coming to ask for financial compensation for work they performed voluntarily — for fun, because they believed in the project, or to travel and party around the world.

If your intention was to get paid for your work, then it was not voluntary work, like the work thousands of people do every day around the world under far less favorable conditions, doing more valuable work for which they are not asking for retroactive payment — unlike the person who started this proposal https://peakd.com/proposal/@crimsonclad/proposal-ecosystem-operations-bizdev-growth-retrospective

You lack dignity and principles, miss I-don't-remember-your-username, because even if you designed a space rocket while doing something for which nobody offered you a job and a salary, you cannot come 6 years later saying you built the best space rocket and therefore are asking for money.

That is wrong from every point of view. If you weren't doing it for the good of a \

of which you are a member, you should have planned it from day one: *I want money for my efforts.* That is morally and ethically correct.

But when you have the right friends, it doesn't matter if the request is outlandish or immoral. That is why Hive did not grow as a community, and I don't think even 5 annual parties in Kuala Lumpur will make it grow — because those parties are accessible only to a small elite.

I don't expect them to be altruistic and give away their money or not want to earn money on Hive. I only expect them to be honest about their intentions, say it openly, without euphemisms, and put their cards on the table.

And to show that there are volunteers doing free and important work — and that this poor martyr is not the only one — here is a brief list of people who do not put a price on their time when driven by their principles.

---

## 🌐 Internet Infrastructure and Protocols

- **Paul Vixie** – Contributed for years to maintaining BIND (the world's most widely used DNS server), largely voluntary work within the community.
- **Daniel Stenberg** – Creator and lead maintainer of **cURL**, a tool used on billions of devices, maintained largely as a personal/voluntary project.
- **Theo de Raadt** – Volunteer leader of **OpenBSD** and **OpenSSH**, security software critical to all of the Internet's infrastructure.

---

## 🐧 Linux Kernel and Operating Systems

- **Linus Torvalds** – Although he now works for the Linux Foundation, the Linux kernel is sustained mostly by **thousands of volunteers** from around the world.
- **Greg Kroah-Hartman** – One of the most active Linux kernel maintainers, coordinating global volunteer contributions.

---

## 🔒 Security and Cryptography

- **Werner Koch** – Creator and almost sole maintainer of **GnuPG (GPG)**, the email encryption standard, for years with minimal funding.
- **The OpenSSL Team** – For years, only **2 part-time people** maintained OpenSSL, which protects most of the world's HTTPS traffic (a situation that became public after Heartbleed in 2014).

---

## 📦 Universal-Use Software

- **Evan Coury** – Maintainer of critical npm packages used by millions of projects.
- **Florian Weimer** and other **GNU libc (glibc)** volunteers – The standard C library used in virtually every Linux system.
- **Thomas Dickey** – Volunteer maintainer of **ncurses**, **xterm**, and other terminal tools for decades.

---

## 🏛️ Key Foundations and Organizations

| Organization | Volunteer Role |
|---|---|
| **Free Software Foundation (FSF)** | Thousands of volunteers translate, document, and maintain GNU software |
| **Apache Software Foundation** | Almost all its projects (Apache HTTP, Kafka, Hadoop) are maintained by volunteers |
| **Mozilla Foundation** | Volunteers contribute to Firefox, MDN Web Docs, and localization |
| **Wikimedia Foundation** | Thousands of volunteers maintain Wikipedia and its sister projects |
| **Let's Encrypt / ISRG** | Volunteers and donations sustain the free CA that encrypts over 50% of the web |

---

## 📚 Documentation and Educational Infrastructure

- **Eric Raymond** – Volunteer author of foundational texts such as *The Cathedral and the Bazaar* and maintainer of the **Jargon File**.
- **MDN Web Docs Contributors** – Thousands of volunteers document web standards used by all developers.

---

## ⚠️ The Problem of \

A well-documented phenomenon is that **critical Internet infrastructures depend on one or a few people working for free or nearly free**, as illustrated by the famous **xkcd #2347** comic:

> *\

*

This led to initiatives such as the **Core Infrastructure Initiative** and **OpenSSF** to fund these maintainers.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcWRuR3DzYJG5YHyGUQn3TWC3tgnXPP965PbK3d87yQdR/1777640759536.jpg)




## ¿Cómo funciona la Gobernanza de Hive?

Creo que realmente habrá mucha teoría sobre el funcionamiento de Hive como \
que necesita de seres humanos para su funcionamiento.\n\nLa realidad es que al parecer, no existe un \

Comunitario, aunque supuestamente nació en reacción a la compra de Steem por parte de un individuo para supuestamente ser un lugar donde la comunidad mande.\n\nSoy nueva y se poco de todo el drama de Steem y de Hive, pero lo que noto es que los \

de Hive también creen ser los dueños de Hive como Sun lo es de Steem.\n\nY actúan en consecuencia. Las decisiones fundamentales son tomadas por 20 testigos que son una forma de Plutocracia, ya que al tener más tokens que el resto de la \

son quienes parten el pastel, y aparentemente ven a Hive como un negocio y no una comunidad.

Se nota sobre todo en la forma en que son aprobados los gastos del DHF. Los proyectos no necesitan ser útiles, ni siquiera buenos, siempre que involucren a las personas con conexiones correctas.

El voto de un solo tipo aprueba o descarta proyectos. Algunos de los cuales parecen ser más una forma de dar \
.\n\nYa sé que pedirán pruebas, pero cuando todos vemos lo que pasa no pueden fingir que no pasa porque no haya \
.\n\nDesde sus fiestas anuales y encuentros, hasta la corrida de rally que nunca figuró en ningún lugar que no sea Hive, las \

de marketing para promocionar Hive siempre fueron caprichos pagados con un fondo al que tratan como a la Gallina de los Huevos de Oro.

Los que pusieron dinero para ser los que deciden cómo se usan los fondos de Hive están en su derecho, pero lo que no deben hacer es montar la comedia de que Hive es una comunidad cuando en realidad es un Club Privado en el que permiten ingresar a unos cuántos parias y lacayos, porque de lo contrario no podría venderse como red social con 20 o 100 usuarios.

Pero lo que me parece más asqueroso es que ahora personas que hicieron \

## 🌐 Infraestructura y protocolos de Internet

- **Paul Vixie** – Contribuyó durante años al mantenimiento de BIND (el servidor DNS más usado del mundo), trabajo en gran parte voluntario dentro de la comunidad.
- **Daniel Stenberg** – Creador y mantenedor principal de **cURL**, herramienta usada en miles de millones de dispositivos, que mantiene en gran parte como proyecto personal/voluntario.
- **Theo de Raadt** – Líder voluntario de **OpenBSD** y **OpenSSH**, software de seguridad crítico para toda la infraestructura de Internet.

---

## 🐧 Kernel de Linux y sistemas operativos

- **Linus Torvalds** – Aunque hoy trabaja para la Linux Foundation, el kernel de Linux se sostiene mayoritariamente por **miles de voluntarios** de todo el mundo.
- **Greg Kroah-Hartman** – Uno de los mantenedores más activos del kernel Linux, coordina contribuciones voluntarias globales.

---

## 🔒 Seguridad y criptografía

- **Werner Koch** – Creador y mantenedor casi en solitario de **GnuPG (GPG)**, el estándar de cifrado de correo electrónico, durante años con financiación mínima.
- **The OpenSSL Team** – Por años, solo **2 personas a tiempo parcial** mantenían OpenSSL, que protege la mayoría del tráfico HTTPS del mundo (situación que se hizo pública tras Heartbleed en 2014).

---

## 📦 Software de uso universal

- **Evan Coury** – Mantenedor de paquetes críticos de npm usados por millones de proyectos.
- **Florian Weimer** y otros voluntarios de **GNU libc (glibc)** – La librería C estándar usada en prácticamente todo sistema Linux.
- **Thomas Dickey** – Mantenedor voluntario de **ncurses**, **xterm** y otras herramientas de terminal durante décadas.

---

## 🏛️ Fundaciones y organizaciones clave

| Organización | Rol voluntario |
|---|---|
| **Free Software Foundation (FSF)** | Miles de voluntarios traducen, documentan y mantienen software GNU |
| **Apache Software Foundation** | Casi todos sus proyectos (Apache HTTP, Kafka, Hadoop) son mantenidos por voluntarios |
| **Mozilla Foundation** | Voluntarios contribuyen a Firefox, MDN Web Docs y localización |
| **Wikimedia Foundation** | Miles de voluntarios mantienen Wikipedia y sus proyectos hermanos |
| **Let's Encrypt / ISRG** | Voluntarios y donaciones sostienen la CA gratuita que cifra más del 50% de la web |

---

## 📚 Documentación e infraestructura educativa

- **Eric Raymond** – Autor voluntario de textos fundacionales como *The Cathedral and the Bazaar* y mantenedor del **Jargon File**.
- **Colaboradores de MDN Web Docs** – Miles de voluntarios documentan los estándares web usados por todos los desarrolladores.

body.title: From Ceasefire Hopes to Double Blockade: The Irony Driving Oil to $120
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVGZxwMZ7E7zJD1y7H4b55ccjscvyGS8tuBFAxNTJYU7g/Crude_Oil_soar.png 
*More Inflation Pain for Markets after Ceasefire Break. Image generated using [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/app)*

## Ceasefire Fails, Oil Surges: Markets Feel the Inflation Pain

Markets don’t just react to war—they react to the failure of peace.

The recent [ceasefire talks in Islamabad](https://beincrypto.com/brent-crude-4-year-high-iran/) failed to resolve escalating geopolitical tensions between Iran and the U.S.–Israel axis. That failure alone was enough to push oil markets into panic mode.

## ⚠️ Ceasefire Break = Inflation Risk Returns

With no de-escalation:
•	Brent crude surged, touching the $120 zone 
•	Strong support levels are now visible at $104 and $95 

If talks had succeeded—especially with easing of disruptions—the price could have cooled back toward the $95 range or below.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmX14f19J5Lpu1NDyvmMfyKmd7TcRDNZPqJU34AZXTVmzz/BRENT_2026-04-30_09-56-38.png 
[Tradingview Chart>>](https://www.tradingview.com/x/gg8sJ9Yc/)

But instead…

**🚫 From One Blockage to Two**

Rather than relief, the situation escalated.

•	Earlier disruptions had already halted flows from the Persian Gulf region 
•	Then came a second blow: [U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM)](https://beincrypto.com/ran-oil-storage-blockade-output-cuts/) actions restricting maritime traffic from Iranian ports 

👉 Result:
•	Continued disruption in regional oil flows 
•	Additional halt in Iranian exports 

This effectively created a compounded supply shock.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTAfHiPugsMtt1GLhrc8RhVghAwu9gb9Mgkh9VCLayQrW/Iran_oil_blockage.png 
*A Bonus Blockage!!! Economy is not got over the Hormuz Blockage Oil Supply Disruption Effects!* *Image generated using [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/app)* 

## 📉 Supply Collapse in Numbers

The impact is no longer theoretical—it’s [measurable](https://beincrypto.com/ran-oil-storage-blockade-output-cuts/):

•	Global crude supply impact: ~11–12 million barrels per day decline (April) 

•	Persian Gulf disruption: ~4.5 million bpd loss 

•	Iranian exports: 
o	March: ~1.85 million bpd 
o	Now: ~567,000 bpd 

That’s a massive drop of 70%.

## 🛢️ Storage Pressure Forcing Production Cuts

With exports blocked:

•	Iran began stockpiling unsold crude 
•	Storage capacity is expected to fill by mid-May 
•	This has already forced production cuts of ~2.5 million bpd 

👉 If the blockage continues:

•	Further production cuts are likely 
•	Global supply tightens even more 

## 📈 Oil’s Explosive Move

To understand the scale:
•	Jan (pre-conflict): ~$63 
•	Now: ~$116 

That’s nearly an 80% surge in a short span—driven by layered disruptions, not just speculation.

### 🌍 What This Means for Markets

This is where your core idea hits hard:

Rising oil prices ripple across the entire economy:

•	🚚 Higher transportation costs 
•	🏭 Increased manufacturing input costs 
•	🛒 Costlier consumer goods 
•	📉 Shrinking business margins 

👉 Result:
•	Inflation pressure builds 
•	Purchasing power declines 
•	Growth slows 

###⚠️ Recession & Stagflation Risk

When high inflation meets slowing growth:
You enter stagflation territory
Markets hate this combination.

And that’s why:
*Ceasefire failure hurts markets the same way heartbreak hurts humans.*

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVGZxwMZ7E7zJD1y7H4b55ccjscvyGS8tuBFAxNTJYU7g/Crude_Oil_soar.png 

## 💬 Final Thought

This isn’t just an oil rally—it’s a warning signal.

•	Peace failed 
•	Supply tightened 
•	Prices surged 

If disruptions persist, oil may not just stay elevated—it could push economies into a painful adjustment phase.

Hello, my lovely Hive Naija people. It’s another beautiful weekend, and we’re excited to have you here once again. A new weekend simply means another chance to buzz the Hive blockchain, connect with one another, and simply have fun. You'll also agree with me that there’s something special about bringing everyone together to gist, share opinions, and enjoy good vibes. That is exactly the reason we will continue to meet every weekend.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/5e0cISlXlk8AAAAC/quby.gif)
##### OBJECTIVE Sam's Hangout is focused on promoting the togetherness of the Nigerian brethren through active engagement on the blockchain. Beyond that, it is also centered towards the wellbeing of everyone who takes part in our weekend discussions and helps keep our discord running with their presence. **Note that** this account was created to make the engagement more personal and official. HARDSHIP IN TERTIARY INSTITUTIONS”**.  
Almost all or most of us have seen the four walls of tertiary institutions, and during our time as students, we realized that our universities are quite different from all they have been portrayed to be. The fun, excitement and transformation that happens in there is of immense value to us, but for many students, it comes with its fair share of challenges. Beyond academics, students constantly experience various forms of financial pressure, emotional stress, and the struggle to excel in their studies. While some of these situations may feel manageable, others can become too overwhelming, making one question whether to give up on everything or keep striving with hope for the future.

Here’s the question!

***<div class=\

>How does financial hardship affect students’ academic performance, psychological behaviour and overall experience in tertiary institutions, and in what ways have you seen or experienced this?***
OR
***

>Do you think students can still thrive academically despite their pressing financial struggles? If yes, how do you think this can be achieved? Should they be encouraged to take up side gigs or just focus solely on their studies?*** If you have a topic you would like us to discuss in our future hangouts, please feel free to suggest it to us in the comment section and tag @sam.hangout to it.

Be as simple and sincere with the discussion, hehehe.
*

FRIDAY PLANS, OWANBE SATURDAY, AND SUNDAY REFLECTIONS
** To make our hangout more interactive, we have decided to add two events to spice it up. On Saturdays, we share our owanbe stories, party gists, and even pictures. On Sundays, we reflect on the weekend and things we learnt so far, as well as share plans for the new week. Don't forget to join us!!
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/7SRjtQccwVMAAAAC/selfie-theres-someone-inside-your-house.gif)
There are no strict rules as regards this weekend hangout. Feel free to speak any Nigerian language you like, whether Igbo, Yoruba, pidgin, Efik, or others, as long as it can be understood. |***
Please, do not take it to the extreme.

body.title: CKI Outreach Activity: Street Kids Tutorial Program
body.body:
> Hello there, lovely hoomans! I got some free time recently and can finally join some extra-curricular activities again. Actually, I have missed a lot of it since I need to prioritize my research and on the job training to pass our final year in college. I might be strayed away for quite a while with volunteering but my passion still lingers in me. It something that can't be forgotten and disappear from my personality. In celebration of our organization's international day, we had conducted an outreach activity by the public plaza and invited some of the kids nearby to join the short program. We have collaborated with few teachers and student-teachers to make this happen. With members like us, we gave any help we could have to facilitate the event smoothly. ![IMG_20260124_144631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/Ep1Xwwp8tu5PPNQPiKcs3wB9WV27gWezCc2nSmB5irAR7p9ZNmHqX8AhnqCDhvbw2iU.jpg) I never taught any kids before, and I'm not good with handling kids. I don't really know how to approach them since we're strangers to each other. I'm not even good with having my own kid's attention when I try to teach her. ![IMG_20260124_134108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/EoiWjJgt2B8tpaSjkCnxbRAPMjUGd3GSJ2TXhRqhgRq7wrJBnAECiCJEEhnc9h7tgNY.jpg) For kids to have a better experience, I let my co-member to take over. I watched how she handled them naturally while I assist her with the materials. Why is it so easy for them to socialize while it's a torture for me? Look at her, she seems so stressed dealing with them but she still delivers the job nicely. ![IMG_20260124_134140.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/Eokf7ARcpQEyxhzRu7Rz4cenG6Er7PbsLmKzxyYviXZqKFz7GxqFEWiLQwpKJewKJUX.jpg) We taught them how to read, color, review math problems and read them a story. There's also prices for those outstanding children at the end of the session. Most of the kids are already knowledgeable since they're studying in a gradeschool nearby. It was the parents that brought them here, so they could have some valuable playtime even for just a few hours. Those kids were lovely. They enjoy their lessons with us and was very attentive. They were even competing to those questions asked after the storytelling. I hope they could keep up that kind of behavior and study well until they finish their studies in the future. Opportunities like this are rare for me to experience since I have other priorities to attend. However, I hope time would allow me someday to experience this again to help other kids.
This is the end of this blog. See you in the next one. Thanks for reading! ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLH61jJ6Ftm6Eqe3fDXzw3Cx5N2Y2qCuSRLCzQHgLXE5XFvRm54Sn248CRT5itY3DJbLgqa3FYJJJ6pbvdgq4gGwB3ZLqN9azwC2vhXjpFcUuu2hSzGer (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ayane-chan/23wCbb1sRLHKU724Ko6dWVbuN2QdYWiG1izWZycWmXWRntfdPJkQQ6qSnZAK14dGPHeAu.png)

Eine Kanonenkugel hat es erwischt!' – 'Und wie haben Sie Ihre Hand verloren?' – 'Arr, das war bei einer Entermission! Ein Schwerthieb hat sie abgetrennt!' Der Barkeeper deutet auf die Augenklappe: 'Und Ihr Auge?' Der Pirat seufzt: 'Arr, das war an meinem ersten Tag mit dem Haken. Eine Möwe hat über mir ihre Notdurft verrichtet...' Der Barkeeper ist verwirrt: 'Moment, man verliert doch nicht sein Auge durch Möwendreck!' Der Pirat nickt traurig: 'Arr, normalerweise nicht. Aber es war mein erster Tag mit dem Haken...'**

In this blog, I'll share with you our little walk around Bogo and what we did that was memorable, enthusiastic, and vibrant. We headed to the Star Frappe cafe immediately because we had to cool our minds from outside, as the weather here is too hot and scorching it burns our soul. Cafes here are cold and cozy, so it was best to visit a cafe to not be stressed by the sun. This cafe sells many foods including quesadillas, fries, pizzas, frappes, milk teas, and coffees. We bought all-cheese pizza, lemonade, and coffee. The main problem we had in this cafe was the fact that it is not pet-friendly, so we had to leave Zuki outside for two hours. But he was fine since the outside balcony was still cozy and full of shade. We also did our work and listed our for-sale items in the cafe since we are selling our unused items in the house for funds. cafe, we walked around the city plaza where many students were practicing their school performance, visitors were taking their daily retreat, and hikers were going around the plaza multiple times. Many skaters were performing at the fountain corner, and most visitors were watching them. The plaza is filled with many trees of different species, and what I like about this plaza is that it gives people a place to breathe since the town is busy and stressful. This place is the only corner that gives us a safe place to breathe and calm ourselves. Zuki was able to run around the plaza, and he greeted many students. We sat on a bench watching people pass by, feeling nature, and loving the company I have with my boyfriend and our dog. ![Messenger_creation_02E287A4-C204-4601-8FD2-E22FDD0EF000.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpXJ16UALXcdsVrkhncnGW84yyufiuT9Tk3iBZNWHFC2KeC9CQR6TDGB6Eoyu4jYAom.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_615783AB-EA72-414A-A243-660DC5972DBD.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpT3DhbtHimKzT9ywRgovrmCsheQHuykeqZtty6nL4TKHghSbYBb3ndcx5BVdQmbcJ3.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_0F14FE03-E92C-409C-A455-F7F8334E6D6D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpLfWPtXcv9c9AkKXVk2opdj8Dd8rQqv5rDyceVqWjJMVWmNK5ua3BUJtxVQSw3TgAn.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_9046FD53-761A-4493-A18C-E0E67606CBE8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpT3DhgEbWAU2xwKsVYukBmkEHQUenEGmMNdRgdhni1vmihcou1aE5SLCkM7gFxkrMe.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_828674D0-EB7C-4A1C-BA18-5AF1725B02B7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243zSz5xjcQTcSgWgho5GVAJG1R7zAfkj3nsKsaS9WYL8Bc85ix2kLXj23K3Kivxa6cwQ.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_D759B295-6F50-4765-8006-302D867218AE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/2449tET5oqybf3KvT2SHfpQQkSEGHZfzFh9r3i4JzUyKf4nuvdmWvg9aNe6PgMFf27dTp.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_F69F78BF-557E-42D0-9F76-C19B77EF8367.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243fhfaLEhBF3ujGG9kKD6j7p6sEiJrmceVBipFXeqWRVFCzAhJar5YxSLtVNHWR7FvqE.jpeg) We then headed to the pantaland, but what we expected to see wasn't there since the pantaland is still under construction after the destruction from the 6.9 magnitude earthquake that hit the town. This town, for the record, was the ground zero or the epicenter of this big earthquake before. The town is still recovering in all aspects, including its physical appearance. The pantaland is part of the repairs, and there were no hikers, students, or visitors who used to be here or flock here, since it is under construction. But the view did not change. The beauty of the sea, the scene of nature, the blue atmosphere that would later turn orange as sunset happens, and the breeze from the seawater are still here. Only the pantaland itself changed and is not safe for staying since the road and concrete are destroyed and dust surrounds the area. ![Messenger_creation_99E76079-B933-4374-B8F3-EB0DCDEDE4EA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243qB3mp4DzjjoKu885psbUzTMmBHp6oAncnX3dLyAS4u86RV2gBWhFiWpRJe3bkWzDaY.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_2757DC60-9DC0-4626-8ADF-EA2DCC00C70F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243qD7pUPpu5G9HmL6YRcm5vVbJWwx6vspvBsTbrXjVrMJ2gRbFSMUbe3sXuvfNQodRfS.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_53461D44-F747-454E-A6BA-65C9445CFA54.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243BeGDXwjWWfEaKAkmjmoQm4eqpwQtii2cvPD9XXZUC6WuKDmU2x5QqWDw5Y8dpddoPo.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_A351722F-F29E-47DB-B881-E3E8C398571A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23u6FnyTsxkGC2DVdWNNNYTiizRKcm9qRoqDkcGvxUgv1d27pjW4Nu8ovUBsZatohMjWT.jpeg) After that, since it was getting dark, we headed back to our town in San Remigio, which is 30 minutes from Bogo City. We had a quick walk around the town's complex and let Zuki run for the last time. Even though some parts of the town were not what we expected, the day still felt complete in its own simple way. The slow walk, the quiet moments, and the small joys we shared made the trip meaningful, reminding me that even an ordinary day can turn into something special when spent with the right company. ![Image By OpenAI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/243fxZP1GpdnvoL6z4ZvAyG5F4ZatbRGnwYWsQAjemDvcS33wwXvrehGGLZxwHHF6BGan.png)

Hello Everyone

As usual, I write my saving update with #Slothlysavers, a new project as a #saturdaysavers replacement.

As usual on every 1st of all month, we have a HIVE POWER UP DAY (HPUD). This day was supposed to be great, and it was during the old days. However as Hive Price is dipping, people start to lose interest with all kind of long goal on HIVE, so many people stop participating this event. Some even say posting HPUD is just a way to shit post for rewards, well everyone has their right to sound out their opinion.

I have my own reason why I keep posting HPUD every month. It is almost similar with the reason why I join #SLOTHLYSAVERS club. I love to save up for something in future, let say I am a long term holder and a dreamer... but not delulu, maybe almost be delulu lol.

I believe that we should encourage people by our action, not our words. I like being here on HIVE, so I stake HIVE regularly and I let people know that I am still staking HIVE up. I do not get align with people who push other to stake and hold because they have more HIVE POWER. I think it doesn't matter if you have already massive amount of staked HIVE (HP), that's great, but how can you encourage other people to increase their HP if yourself is keep withdrawing? It is similar as forcing new people to be your exit liquidity.

So it doesn't matter how big you are, how small you are, all of us here should power up for the sake of making the ecosystem better. And during HPUD it doesn't matter if you will do it big or small, your participation that matters most.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tGVdSYcC3fwz8wEZ3ubhisZfheTBQQgbUETqZL2ATDHEUt5R49igUFWxLoXyi9U4vFh.png

I powered up for 200 HP earlier. It is around 12 USD. That a small volume right? Sometime I confuse some big stakers say why I keep doing this useless investment volume... Well I am confused why you do not even willing to spend $10 to power up every month...

My previous plan was to power up 1000 HP today, but I had to bail my mothers tax yesterday, around $700. So I run out of cash again this week. But still... I have no excuse not to power up any today.

#### My HIVE Performance

I am not tracking my account growth and performance in detail, but I make a record about them in my saving post, which is this post and it is call as Slothly Savers Club. However let me share you things that I do not recorded them here

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23swiPSrBEHk1HA9ZhxWNpWdtC2xdGjJuwZtBupKfYRbCNSDMvG5WDP7in3SvGyGSss5t.png

During last month, I have made many posts and I have got around $57.85 from them. It was equivalent with 974 HP, but I did not take them all nor staked them all. Half of it went to Hive-Engine, either to support some projects or to fund my gaming Activity.

My curation rewards was low, only around $5.13. I need to power up more to pump up this part. If you are less likely to be active, you do not need to curate yourself. You can delegate your HP to other projects and let them curate for you. That's why even you have low curation rewards, it doesn't mean that you do not care with other people.

Sadly some people, even for ones that have spent years on this chain, do not think that way.

#### My HIVE Gaming Activity

I play several games on HIVE, the most intensely played are Splinterlands and Rising Star Game. Everyweek I post some Splinterlands content, from my daily battle, to reason rewards, and sometime I share my tips and tricks.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23u5VDMLzpHWcUFjg5SHQEU9Wgbx37jTW58GXqDi7TYpxLs1D47YdsoaDFZuEFpPtoAPN.png

The things that people do not realize is that playing Rising Star Game is not as simple as it looks. You can play it for free, and you rank could climb up rapidly. However you will hit a ceiling soon, which only people who have spent more time and resource could go higher.

However I have reached rank 53 leaderboard. I have a plan to break in top 50 and it requires me some HIVE to get as many cards that are needed. So that could be pricey if I do not watch my spending correctly.

Let's hope my gaming activity won't hurt my saving goals lol.

Now we get into the main part here

#### PRIMARY GOAL: HIVE POWER (HP)

> My Primary goal is to build up my Hive Power (HP) to a Hive Orca Size, or around 62.000 HP. It is definitely very difficult, almost impossible for me, but that's a goal should be.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23ydJub7fCjYBWM2Nn1xoXN51GVkaKtv8yZWEfD7cXgvGRkF8xws3egPV1WnNxmWyEsEM.png

I have got 358 HP this week, which is actually only 158 HP from organic growth. I have an extra 200 HP from today Hive Power Up Day, so basically everything goes as I have planned before... except the HPUD one.

It would be a lie if I say I am happy with 200 HP for this HPUD. I planned before for 1000 HP or 5000 HP before, however I need to be realistic and a bit stoic here. Tax sometime, or often, fuck people wallets. When it does, we should be happy if we can shut it down, or PAY them off.

So I am happy that TAX doesn't fuck my real world life now. I will take some days off to rest a bit, before I plan again for the mitigation of the lost fund due to that TAX.

#### SECONDARY GOAL: EDSI (HIVE-ENGINE TOKEN)

>EDSI was EDS in the past, is the income token from eddie earner, the sub project of SPI for the previous #saturdaysavers club. My goal this year is to get atleast 400 EDSI token, so I can get some weekly HIVE regularly.

This part is over, wrapped... wait till I publish my new secondary goal when my EDSI hits 400 tokens.

So that's slothly savers post week 18 for 2026. Let's give our best to achieve our goals this year.

# **The Ghost in the Machine: A Meditation on Repetition, Freedom, and the Echoes of Abandoned Platforms**


<a href=\

>from Imgflip Meme Generator There is a peculiar tragedy in watching a dancer rehearse the same misstep, night after night, while wondering why the audience has departed. On Hive, the performance continues. The downvoting farmer whales—those who wield influence like a scepter forged in shadow—repeat their choreography with mechanical precision. They cast their votes not as gardeners pruning for growth, but as reapers clearing the field for a single harvest: their own. They farm rewards through synchronized patterns, delegate power to vessels holding less than their own stake, and wonder, with genuine perplexity, why the theater grows quiet. **The Ghost Blockchain** Hive was conceived as a beacon—a decentralized haven where merit would rise like dawn, where voices would be measured by their resonance, not their connections. Yet walk its digital corridors today, and you encounter an echo. Not the vibrant hum of creation, but the hollow reverberation of bot accounts posting in perfect unison, of fake engagement masquerading as community, of rewards flowing through predetermined channels while genuine creators withdraw their faith. This is not decentralization. It is simulation. A blockchain that looks like a community but functions like a closed loop. **The Hypocrisy of Promoting \

**

And still, they promote. Still, they speak of Hive as a land of liberty, of open expression, of creator empowerment. The irony is so thick it could be carved.

*How can a platform offer freedom when a single gesture—a downvote cast without justification—can erase months of labor?*
*How can a community claim openness when the same voices that preach inclusion are the first to silence dissent?*
*How can a system promise meritocracy when rewards flow not to quality, but to allegiance?*

You cannot build a sanctuary on a foundation of selective enforcement. You cannot preach freedom while practicing control. The world is watching—not with malice, but with the quiet clarity of witness. And what it sees is a paradox: a platform built for creation, methodically dismantling its own foundation.

**The Exodus: Where Voices Find Refuge**

People are not leaving Hive out of spite. They are leaving out of self-preservation.

They migrate to **Blurt**, where the most radical innovation is also the simplest: *there is no downvote button*. Not as oversight, but as intention. Not as limitation, but as liberation. In Blurt's open fields, a newcomer's voice stands beside that of the veteran. A controversial truth may stir debate, but it will not be erased. A beautiful thought may find no immediate audience, but it will not be buried.

They return to **Steemit**, where the downvote button exists—but is wielded not as a weapon of control, but as a tool of last resort. Where community norms, not coordinated campaigns, guide curation. Where the past is acknowledged, but not weaponized.

This is not nostalgia. It is discernment.

**The Unlearned Lesson**

The downvoting farmer whales do not lack intelligence. They lack introspection. They repeat the same patterns—coordinated voting, selective enforcement, promotional rhetoric divorced from reality—and expect a different outcome. This is not strategy. It is surrender wearing the mask of patience.

But here is the hope, written in the same ledger that records the hypocrisy: truth, once seen, cannot be unseen. And a community, once awakened, cannot be put back to sleep.

Hive can still be reclaimed. But first, its stewards must name the weeds. Must choose integrity over influence. Must remember that freedom is not a slogan to be marketed, but a practice to be lived.

*For in every garden, the first act of restoration is to see clearly what has been allowed to grow.*

Fuel prices in Brazil have ceased to be merely an economic statistic and have become the center of one of the most heated debates in national politics.

For followers of the **Jaguardopote** channel, understanding this dynamic is fundamental, especially considering that the content of political cuts and debate analyses, as seen in the recent video about Arthur do Val's response to activism, frequently touches upon this issue that affects the daily lives of millions.
