```python
    new_password = request.form.get('new_password')
    # ... update password in database ...
    return \

```

The token is random, unpredictable, and tied to the user's session. The attacker can craft a form that submits to `/change-password`, but they CAN'T include the correct `csrf_token` value because they don't know it. The same-origin policy prevents them from loading the form page and reading the token from the hidden field. Without the token, the server rejects the request.

Every major web framework has CSRF token support built in -- Django has it enabled by default (`{% csrf_token %}` in templates), Rails has `protect_from_forgery`, Express has the `csurf` middleware. The implementation is handled for you. You just have to not disable it (which, unfortunately, developers do when they get annoyed by 403 errors during development and then forget to re-enable it for production).

**2. SameSite cookies** -- the modern defense:

```
Set-Cookie: session=abc123; SameSite=Strict; HttpOnly; Secure
```

`SameSite=Strict` tells the browser: NEVER send this cookie with cross-site requests. Period. A form on `evil.com` submitting to `bank.com` won't include `bank.com`'s session cookie. The request arrives at the bank with no session, so the server treats it as an unauthenticated request. CSRF defeated in one cookie attribute.

`SameSite=Lax` is a middle ground (and the **default** in modern Chrome and Firefox since 2020). Lax allows cookies on top-level GET navigations (clicking a link to `bank.com` still logs you in) but blocks them on POST requests, subresource requests (images, iframes), and form submissions from other origins. This stops most CSRF attacks while keeping the user experience intact -- you can still follow links to authenticated sites without having to log in every time.

```python
# Setting SameSite in Flask
@app.after_request
def set_cookie_flags(response):
    # Modify the session cookie to add SameSite
    if 'Set-Cookie' in response.headers:
        cookies = response.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
        new_cookies = []
        for cookie in cookies:
            if 'SameSite' not in cookie:
                cookie += '; SameSite=Strict'
            new_cookies.append(cookie)
        response.headers.pop('Set-Cookie')
        for cookie in new_cookies:
            response.headers.add('Set-Cookie', cookie)
    return response
```

SameSite cookies are arguably the strongest CSRF defense available today because they work at the browser level -- the application doesn't need to do anything per-request (no tokens to generate, no tokens to validate). Set the attribute once and forget about it. The only limitation is legacy browser support, but as of 2026, every modern browser enforces SameSite.

**3. Referer/Origin header validation:**

The `Origin` header is sent by the browser on cross-origin requests and tells the server where the request came from. A request from `evil.com` has `Origin: https://evil.com`, not `Origin: https://myapp.com`. The attacker can't spoof the Origin header -- the browser sets it, not the client-side JavaScript.

Having said that, Origin/Referer validation is the weakest of the three defenses. Privacy extensions can strip the Referer header. Some browsers don't send Origin on same-origin requests. HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects drop the Referer. If your validation rejects requests with MISSING headers, you'll break functionality for some legitimate users. If you ALLOW requests with missing headers, you create a bypass (the attacker uses `<meta name=\

Not because CSRF went away, but because modern browser defaults (`SameSite=Lax` as default) and framework-level protections (Django, Rails, and Laravel all have CSRF protection enabled by default) have reduced its prevalence in well-maintained applications.\n\nBut \

CSRF isn't solved. It's just easier to prevent if you use modern tools correctly. And as we've been seeing throughout this series, \

is a bar that a shocking number of applications fail to clear.

The web attack surface keeps layering. SQL injection attacks the database. XSS attacks the browser. CSRF weaponizes the browser against the server. Each attack exploits a different trust boundary -- and they chain together in ways that make the whole greater than the sum of the parts. We'll keep peeling back these layers as the series continues.

body.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1888
Friday 01, April 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1953
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
May Day Planet Earth

![1953.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTgjLeXoLny1qGRvd5Ssu3L9nQ8gPA6v81KAUG6SRrYXQ/1953.png)

Synchronicity
Friday Meditation 
That time I walked three miles on a sore ankle.                       
 
Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1888_full_5-01-26_1953_mayday:4?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9 
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 

I don’t speak Chinese, either. Did I mention that? I might learn. 

Welcome to a brand new month in the land of megalomania, propaganda, and flat out lies. America is on a collision course with its destiny. The Colonial Supremacy brought this upon itself, but most of us will bear the brunt of the payment. The “elite” is the mouth that writes a check, the ass, (that’s us), can’t cash. We take advantage of the day and use the title as a double-entendre. May-Day! Planet Earth. 
In case you don’t watch old black and white movies, \

is an internationally recognized distress signal used in voice communications, primarily by pilots and mariners, to indicate a life-threatening emergency. Hearing this word means that a vessel or aircraft is in grave and imminent danger and requires immediate assistance.
This is certainly state of the Occident, but I don’t care as much about Europe as the US. I live here, not there. Good luck with Russia, dumb-ass! 

America is in imminent danger and requires immediate assistance. Who ya gonna call?   
American, quiet as it’s kept, and it will likely stay quiet for, biblically speaking, seven generations, (about a century and a half), is gonna call China. It’s our call. Whether this is something we want to happen or not, is irrelevant. The alternative is the United States slipping further and further into an abyss until it starts to look like a scene out of Soylent Green, which was released in the late sixties and was set in New York in 2022. 
We are not allowed to talk about how America slowly became a Jewish country. Not religiously so. Not overtly anyway. I don’t know exactly when referring to American theological “values” switched over from “Christian” to Judeo-Christian. It must have been while I was dreaming secular dreams. Anyway, that would be an intriguing wabbit hole to crawl through.  

But we’re talking about China. Don’t fool yourself into believing that Chinese policy-makers and futurists have not noticed how the US was infiltrated and how its values changed from picket fences, mom and apple pie, to satanism, cannibalism, massive drug, including alcohol, addiction, blackmail, misomnyism, (hatred of everything), mental slavery, infertility, shortened life spans and general insanity. Meanwhile, China is thriving. In a fashion that would make J D Rockefeller envious, it has monopolized damn near every “rare-earth mineral” necessary to make everything from chips, to lithium batteries, to weapons of mass destruction, and they, China that is, are not exporting them to the United States.  So much for the Military Industrial Complex. 

The US imported nearly half a trillion dollars in good from China in 2024, and that volume is plummeting. And there are no signs that it’s ever coming back. This is just a wild guess, but by the middle of the 2030s, the United States will be ready to cry “Uncle.” And capitulate to China’s terms. 

This brings us back to Rocky 3.5. 
Like Rocky, Uncle Sam is slow, bloated, divided against itself and barely standing. It’s goaded into a championship match against a contender that it, (the US) can no longer dismiss. Rocky gets clobbered. He knows he brought it on himself. Of course in Rocky 3, former adversary Apollo Creed comes to the rescue and gets Rocky back on his feet for the inevitable rematch with Clubber Lang. 

But how did Clubber Lang beat Rocky? 
Clubber “was” Rocky. Clubber was hungry and relentless the way Rocky was in the first movie. 
China emulated the US. Not only the US, but likely the UK as well. Not out of any admiration. Maybe a little bit. But because they were going to beat the West at its own game. It’s no small coincidence that the opiates that entered the US in the previous decades came from China. Just sayin’. 

This is where we leave Rocky, on the mat. Down for the count. 
After millennia of dealing with the west, China knows that rehabilitation is fruitless. While it has America on her knees, begging for financial aid, industrial resurrection and dreams of being “Great” again, China knows the score. It’s not the “human resources,” it’s the system. Without a fundamental change in the system, educational, philosophical, theological, Anglo-Europeans will descend right back into the habits of tens of centuries ago. Consumption. Competition. Bigotry. Fear. Scarcity. Violence. Decadence. Eventually power, which will once again manifest in conquest, genocide and dark rituals. 

This is why and how, Chinese Supremacy will come to the United States. Don’t worry. You won’t see it in this life. But seven generations hence your descendants will be better off. They will be honoring You, as an ancestor instead of some wrathful, jealous “God.” They will practice tai chi and yoga in the park. Work shorter weeks, earn more purchasing power, have larger families, live longer & healthier lives. They won’t elect their leaders by popularity but through a system of merit, similar to the way the Chinese do it today. The US population might hit a billion, in a hundred years. But that’s cool. There’s plenty to do. No scarcity, real or manufactured to sell widgets. 

The best part of all about this scenario, is that I’m not married to it. A hundred years might not be long enough for Americans to exorcise all of that European insanity that’s ingrained in their brains.

body.title: Getting closer to acquiring more land and a nicer building right next to us...
body.body:
This is a follow up to:

https://peakd.com/hive-114308/@vincentnijman/dreaming-of-manifesting-more-storage a post I shared 4 months ago, where I talked about the building and the plot of land right next to our property being available/ for sale as its current owner is getting too old to work it.

If you haven't already done so, or to refreshen your memory, I suggest checking that write up out first.  For the avid readers amongst you, there is also a link to a post @clareartista wrote about the same subject.

Or, if you can''t be bothered/ are low on time, just keep on reading...

Since we acquired our plot of land, late July last year, Clare and I have been struggling with living in the only building on there. In fact, we have spent more time sleeping in a tent near our ~~un~~house than nights sleeping inside the building.

**To summarize:**

Our current land is amazing  It's full of life ( edible geens, beautiful flowers, nut trees, fruit trees, olive trees, a forest area and all the birds, insects and bigger wild life that comes with it ). 

The casetta that came with it is an ugly construction, built on old stables, that is mainly suitable as a storage space, eventhough it isn't entirely dry/ weatherproof.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFRW7KD9G7Vthe3MtAhUAfhN8zMyS8xNfD1DhAQvHSYC/image_3bdec6a4_b70d_4e74_b330_f4e93f547f3f5427072680456164723.jpg)

*our unhouse, as seen from our recently changed olivegrove ( due to extreme rainfall )*

We have been - and are trying - to live in this building but are only partially succeeding.

It was more out of necessity, during Winter ( we couldn't stay in our tent ). And because our attempt at staying in a rental house only lasted 5 weeks. 

We have been trying to sell Clare's/our old house in a city 3 hours from here, for many months now, but haven't had much luck so far.

The aforementioned, plus the fact that we are two creatives who have been vomited out by the system ( we have practically been 'debanked', in a world that is going through a time of extreme inflation and a huge financial shift that only benefits the rich and possibly those who comply ) , we are quickly running out of funds.

Suffice to say that we can hardly afford groceries, let alone find the money to improve our house. 

In fact, we are trying to do as much as we can without spending anything: foraging/ living from the land, using natural building materials that we find around us, etc. but we can only stretch ourselves so far and things move forward at a snail's pace... 🐌

The current crypto bearmarket ( and - let's be honest - the price of Hive ) doesn't help much either. Having to sell our Hive that we've worked so hard for, for so long, for a measly 6 cents per coin is painful, to say the least, but we have to keep ourselves fed. And just living on greens from the garden doesn't cut it.

Anyhow, eventhough Clare and I have gone through some seriously stressful times and the end isn't in sight yet, there is a glimmer of hope on the horizon.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8z1U7nYcCy24GdC9aYYKz9TnfvtEjhuiqQapW4n9SAW/image_d5b4ad90_84b1_4550_89bb_0bb8cd95322c3936552565779965335.jpg)

We are in the talks with my mother to acquire a sum of money that will allow us to not only buy our neighbor's land and the building constructed on top of it but hopefully also leave us with some extra funds, so we can invest in actually doing some restoration/renovation work, make our lives more comfortable ( we don't have a bathroom nor a toilet, right now ) as well as to keep ourselves properly fed/ our morales up in the next couple of months. 

It will sure take the pressure /weight of our shoulders and make our life quite a bit easier.

Clare and I have been inspecting our neighbor's land and property in the last couple of days and are trying to visualize  living there/ taking care of it. In fact, we are already taking care of some beautiful old fruit trees that have been utterly neglected in the last half a year or so.

It feels like it's all meant to be ( ours ) :^)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQDh7zMYD6MNqF5AyFN8d977tJTngkBDCihd8UpXGm1xj/image_362703a8_099b_443c_a27a_619ef73334475994542283410332981.jpg)

*Our current house, on the left, plus our neighbor's building, on the right*


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqQFfWnrnmGFuu5aKdkEP6XT6KPBpXcLqQPy4ngxK39Z/image_3519850f_5eac_431e_992a_ef1d0535c3251848563571738854474.jpg)

*And here's the two buildings, as seen from below our neighbor's orto/ veggie garden.*

These pictures also show how little space there is between our buildings. Clare and I didn't.move to the countryside to have direct neighbors one meter away from us ;^)

Comunque/anyhow, we are about to talk to our neighbor very soon and start the negotation process and are also continuing the conversation with my mother. 

We truly ~~hope~~ trust that we can convince her that helping us out financially is the right thing to do.

Fingers crossed that it's all gonna work out.

---
---
**To Be Convinued...**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdx7wX32pMYWqvGyeqEZeWHsnD6VBmrw2Z151prgHJHyH/image_2ded120e_a270_4f65_9b0c_6cece890b735471907944974346763.jpg)

body.title: Hafen Zingst
body.body:
Gestern haben wir einen kleinen Spaziergang zum Hafen gemacht. Die Hafenanlage in Zingst wurde bis letztes Jahr komplett erneuert. Es ist wirklich schön geworden man kann zwar am Hafen jetzt nicht mehr parken muss also auf den Fest ausweichen aber es sind ja nur ein paar 100 m und man kann gleich die schöne neue Promenade und die Hafenanlage entlang laufen. ￼


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpYTxyuGjGHGkzdosuDmsjVW1cWptfwzsyGBA9pmHvQw/img_4877.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQvbqNMeRiTLkmDuqD7cpEVB4jN9rYQAke47twVF34FGX/img_4878.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSEiTXh6rJ9mnzZdVEjoFmLpUUNvjbtaZf5VTnrEeF2X/img_4880.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWaePEnXJjdSJdnKycNNVJNawkwtAFzCoQvTgSo6wJMbJ/img_4881.jpg)

Kurz vor dem Hafen liegt die Mona Lisa ein altes Schiff, was dort einfach so steht. Ob das mal ein Museum sein soll oder warum das da steht, hat sich mir nicht erschlossen. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdxdB7GP8s8K67jtFZ4rHPeQdHHjK2ba3seBFE76ZkdU2/img_4879.jpg)

Die Hafenanlage ist ein Ausflug wert. Es gibt ein paar nette Restaurants und eine riesige Sonnenbrille was ein sehr starkes Fotomotiv ist. Am Kai liegen ein paar Schiffe, mit dem man ein paar Bodden Touren machen kann oder bis Hiddensee fahren kann und der auf alt gemachte Dampfer ist auch gerade vorbeigefahren.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV8kQ65WyegsqyELxoxrUBnyk4bLcAGAM8L695Y6WkVp9/img_4884.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgfQVeSZjkYGuK7ayhZyYzMiFntQb75V4oU5JjdBHmKi/img_4883.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdbJ8SgvKVkmUNpd4Dxm9bVvGVLWxgVbCgsFC1tdA22RT/img_4882.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP71gWdBBrgUoiFn67cUr5psLxsPTgxgCP78fx5So9FNi/img_4893.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRfNsgvF5yWF1XDUhJk928UhojVvVaC4bZpzfV8u7pjnn/img_4894.jpg)

body.title: Adiós a la coleta! Un respiro para mi cabello y mi autoestima.Goodbye to the ponytail! A break for my hair and my self-esteem.
body.body:
> ¡Hola, chicos! ¿Qué tal? Luego de un tiempo, volví a plancharme el cabello. Debido a tantos procesos respiratorios, no era la mejor opción usar la plancha (ni para otros, ni para mí), pero ahora que ya me siento un poco mejor, fue una gran decisión. Puedo decirles que esto es una de las cosas que más me hacía falta.
Hey, guys! How's it going? After a while, I straightened my hair again. With all the respiratory issues I've been having, using a flat iron wasn't the best idea (neither for others nor for me), but now that I'm feeling a little better, it was a great decision. I can tell you that this is one of the things I needed most.
​En este momento, mi cabello es mitad rizado y mitad liso. Por lo general, suelo hacerme un tratamiento llamado \

; no se trata de falta de aceptación de mis rizos, sino de pura practicidad. A veces el factor tiempo no está de mi lado y mantener el cabello rizado toma mucho tiempo, productos y técnica, algo de lo que carezco actualmente. Por eso, me resulta más sencillo realizarme este tratamiento cada cierto tiempo y mantenerlo.
​Debido a mi proceso de salud, no podía usar la plancha y mucho menos aplicarme químicos, pero ayer finalmente pude hacerlo. Me sentí súper bien, segura y bonita de nuevo; ya tenía como dos meses usando solo una cola de caballo. Al soltármelo, me di cuenta de lo mucho que ha crecido y, sobre todo, de la cantidad de canas que tengo.
<blockquote>
Right now, my hair is half curly and half straight. I usually get a treatment called \

; it’s not that I don’t accept my curls, but rather a matter of pure practicality. Sometimes time isn’t on my side, and maintaining curly hair takes a lot of time, products, and technique—things I’m currently lacking. That’s why I find it easier to get this treatment every so often and maintain it. Because of my health journey, I couldn’t use a flat iron, let alone apply chemicals, but yesterday I was finally able to do it. I felt amazing, confident, and beautiful again; I’d been wearing just a ponytail for about two months. When I let it down, I realized how much it had grown and, above all, how many gray hairs I have. ​Les juro que pensaba que tenía unas cinco canas, ¡pero son como cinco en cada espacio! Justo ahora que he decidido dejar de pintarme el cabello, me toca aceptarlas y aprender a lidiar con ellas. Además, cuando me lo plancho, ellas son las primeras en saltar; no se quedan quietas.
I swear, I thought I had about five gray hairs, but there are like five in every section! Just when I’ve decided to stop dyeing my hair, I have to accept them and learn to deal with them. Plus, when I straighten my hair, they’re the first ones to pop up; they just won’t stay put.
​Lo cierto de todo es que logré plancharme el cabello y me gustó muchísimo el resultado. Aún no tengo un estimado de cuándo pueda hacerme el tratamiento —que, de hecho, ya es bastante urgente porque el uso constante de la liga lo quiebra—, pero ya les contaré cuando lo haga. El antes y el después va a ser bastante sorpresivo, tanto para mí como para cualquiera que lo vea. ​¡Les dejo un abrazo fuerte!
The truth is, I managed to straighten my hair, and I absolutely loved the results. I still don’t know when I’ll be able to get the treatment—which, actually, is pretty urgent because constantly wearing the hair tie is breaking my hair—but I’ll let you know when I do. The before-and-after results are going to be quite surprising, both for me and for anyone who sees them. Big hugs to you all!

body.body: Esta semana he estado toqueteando con un servidor de Proxmox casero, de esto ya he venido hablando en un post y me gustaría dar algún pequeño tutorial de la creación de una máquina, lo más básico de la plataforma. Lo primero para crear un volumen de máquina virtual es subir un contenedor imagen del sistema o ISO al servidor. Las ISO de las distribuciones Linux se consiguen normalmente en las páginas los proyectos o sus GitHubs. Para esto se debe dirigir a almacenamiento local del servidor de Proxmox y seleccionar **Imagen ISO** y presionar **Cargar**, luego seleccionaremos la ISO descargada de la carpeta donde dejamos guardada la ISO.
/> – Imagen ISO Subimos a la parte superior derecha y seleccionamos **Crear WM**
/> Obtendremos una pantalla donde se realizara el proceso de creación, primero le daremos un nombre al contenedor que tendrá la instalación, presionamos siguiente.
/> – Imagen Pestaña General En la pestaña **SO** seleccionaremos la ISO que ya hemos subido previamente y le daremos siguiente

/> – Imagen Pestaña SO En la pestaña **Sistema** podremos presionar siguiente, aunque sí desea alguna configuración especial de GPU para una implementación con escritorio es bueno documentarse para ver que seleccionar.

/> – Imagen Pestaña **Sistema** Luego **Discos** allí podremos seleccionar entre los volúmenes de discos disponibles en **Proxmox** en **Almacenamiento** y Tamaño del Disco que deseamos crear en dicho volumen **Tamño de disco:(GiB)**

/> – Imagen Pestaña de **Discos** En la pestaña de CPU se puede seleccionar la arquitectura a utilizar, dependerá de la arquitectura que prefieras y que soporte tu procesador, Zocalos (en caso de ser más de uno podrá alterarlo) y número de núcleos a utilizar en dicha máquina.
/> – Imagen pestaña **CPU** En la pestaña **Memoria** podránn seleccionar la cantidad de RAM disponible según la disponible en el equipo anfitrión.

/> – Imagen pestaña **Memoria** Por último la pestaña **Red** donde se debe configurar la red, esto puede cambiar según el número de dispositivos de red disponibles en el equipo y la forma como se desean manipular, si lo dejan por defecto será una tarjeta virtual que permitirá trabajar sin mayor problema.
/> – Imagen pestaña **Red** Por último Finalizar en la pestaña **Confirmar** donde podremos ver el resumen de lo implementado.

/> – Imagen pestaña **Confirmar** En Proxmox tendremos una lista de las máquinas creadas, seleccionamos la que deseamos, vamos a consola, iniciamos la máquina y empezaremos el proceso de instalación que dependerá de cada sistema, para un ejemplo más visual dejo el siguiente Short

/> \-- Lista de Máquinas creadas [https://youtube.com/shorts/Xl6aVbbeLr8?feature=share](https://youtube.com/shorts/Xl6aVbbeLr8?feature=share) Ahora si los vídeos que subí a mi canal de Youtube esta semana, que ha sido movida realmente. https://youtu.be/Yncvz9wxywY https://youtu.be/aTJU7GAq2bA https://youtu.be/D\_xAUmqOoNc https://youtu.be/ntTYjrCsW0w https://youtu.be/cFhEVfhqogg https://youtu.be/EqM\_6\_mimmY https://youtu.be/7R995A-M99Y https://youtu.be/iqZOL3hcSNk https://youtu.be/wV3fA-bDZdY https://youtu.be/fG5K96mVUSc https://youtu.be/OSO80Qes\_E4 https://youtu.be/9dcLj6wu7Qo Es momento de #viernesdeescritorio continua CachyOS con Plasma, !una maravilla¡

>https://x.com/EntreVideos/status/2050032887672520837?s=20](https://x.com/EntreVideos/status/2050032887672520837?s=20) [https://social.linux.pizza/@manosymaquinasentrevideos/116496855075057610](https://social.linux.pizza/@manosymaquinasentrevideos/116496855075057610) Gracias por su atención Feliz Fin de Semana Nota: Los vídeos colocados en este post pertenecen a mi canal de Youtube [https://www.youtube.com/@MaquinasLinux](https://www.youtube.com/@MaquinasLinux) y las imágenes del #ViernesDeEscritorio son capturas de pantalla de mis escritorios También se encuentra material en el Telegram [https://t.me/+RlAVNsKQbM5Z0hkt](https://t.me/+RlAVNsKQbM5Z0hkt)

body.title: Salary: The Modern Slavery Many Nigerians Are Quietly Enduring
body.body:
/>

Yesterday was salary day.

For a few brief hours, I felt relieved. My phone buzzed with the credit alert, and like every working-class Nigerian, I smiled. Not because I was rich, but because at least I could breathe again. I started making calculations immediately. Rent. Transportation. Food. Electricity. Data subscription. Family support. Debt repayment.

Before sunset, the money was almost gone.

The painful part? Some bills are still sitting there waiting for me.

That moment forced me to ask myself a difficult question: _Is salary truly financial freedom, or is it just a more polished form of survival?_

In Nigeria today, many people wake up at 5 a.m., battle traffic, endure stressful work environments, and spend their entire month waiting for a salary that disappears within days. The system has created millions of hardworking people who are permanently exhausted but still financially trapped.

That is why many now describe salary as modern slavery.

Not because working is evil, but because the average worker is giving away their time, strength, peace of mind, and sometimes even their dreams, yet they still cannot afford a decent life.

A lot of Nigerians are not lazy. In fact, Nigerians are among the most hardworking people I know. The real problem is that wages are struggling to keep up with reality. Prices of food, transportation, fuel, school fees, and rent keep rising, but salaries remain almost the same.

You collect ₦80,000 or ₦150,000, and before the middle of the month, you are already borrowing or praying for another alert.

The truth is painful.

Many workers are one emergency away from financial disaster.

One hospital bill. One rent increase. One family crisis. That is all it takes.

What makes it even more frustrating is that society often pressures salaried workers to “look successful.” So people keep suffering silently while trying to maintain appearances online and offline.

I have come to realize that depending on salary alone in Nigeria is dangerous. Salary should be a support system, not the only lifeline.

So what can be done?

First, Nigerians need to embrace multiple streams of income. A side hustle is no longer optional for many people. Whether it is freelancing, farming, online business, teaching, content creation, tailoring, baking, photography, or selling products online, extra income matters.

Second, financial education is important. Many people were taught how to work but never taught how to manage money, invest, or build assets. Schools prepare us for employment, but not always for financial independence.

Third, the government and private organizations must improve workers’ welfare. Better wages, stable electricity, affordable healthcare, and lower living costs would reduce the pressure on ordinary citizens.

Fourth, people should stop looking down on small businesses. In Nigeria today, pride can keep someone poor. Honest work is honest work. Whether you sell akara by the roadside, run an online store, or farm cassava, dignity is not determined by job title.

Finally, we must begin to redefine success. Success is not wearing expensive clothes while drowning in debt. Real success is having peace of mind, financial stability, and the ability to take care of yourself and your family without constant fear.

I am not against salaries. Salaries pay bills and put food on tables. But I believe no human being should work tirelessly every month and still live in fear of basic survival.

Yesterday, my salary was deposited into my account.

Today, most of it is gone.

And somehow, the month has not even truly begun.

body.title: Some Random Thoughts For #Shadows Hunters 423
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmexej5pTBMxxPkkWHkCi2dy1JWVx76k2bE77feF6ABQHy/1777636731713.jpg)
Day by day we go in out in different circumstances as life rotates us. Some of those circumstances are pleasing some are not pleasant. But the thing is that we can't stop ourselves from going through them. The reason why we can't stop ourselves from going through them is because we do not have the power to control those situations. Some of them are purely control by the Ultimate Power that controls all of nature. Well, we only commit our lives into the hands of the one who has the power over our destiny.

Over the week a friend had to undergo some unpleasant situations. Many things just happened together around her. Someone close to her lost her baby at the point of delivery. She herself ran into some chaotic eventualities at were she is working. What a world. One could just be happy and excited a day before then the next day she is facing some terrible circumstances. The bitter part of the things happening is that there is a lot of money involved. They have spent a lot of money on the lady who lost the baby yet the child did not live. The lady herself is in a critical condition.

Well, whatever we see, we should always be thankful unto God. This is why we pray always to commit ourselves and our affairs unto the able hands of God.

body.title: Doing Good To All Men
body.body:
God has made us salt of the earth, we have been created to have dominion to the earth, to share one to one another, to make people around us happy.

https://youtu.be/l0M_dhre2fg?si=kyOGPZSlUhlsVr_G

The Lord Jesus Christ referred to the disciples that they are the salt of earth and salt is always good, they are what bring taste to things. We are expected to bring taste and caring to one another.

The Bible confirms that. It warns us that when the salt of the Lord eats several, then there won't be the usefulness of it again. It cannot bring down the taste of the food. When we understand this, this will make it clear that we are meant to always do good things.

We are in this world of seasoning. God has already ordained us as children to stay in this world, to make it a better place. Let us avoid doing things that are not in line with what we are in need of.

We  must always help one another in our faith, do good to one another. Not only do good to one another, we must share, we must care. We must share. We must take care of one another. We must allow the darkness of sin or evil, or evil has to dominate our life.

Let us lead by light through our good works. Let us shine in the light before all men so that they may see our good work and glorify our Father in heaven. Let us live a Christlike life.

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5 minutos-El columpio roto/ Daily 5 minute message- The broken swing
body.body:
> Hay espacios donde nos balanceamos con temor de caer, simplemente no recordamos esas vivencias de la infancia donde nos balanceamos en los juegos infantiles. Creo que esos juegos nos van preparando para la vida, para entender los altos y las bajas. Son siempre oportunas experiencias. Simplemente cuando el columpio se rompe y caemos vamos mirando con otros ojos la vida, nos pone atentos para no volver a caernos. La vida es así, para algunos nunca se rompe el columpio, ni sus espacios de vida, pero para otros parece ser una constante presente.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLcb2cbV3qNV9C58mDmahVCr6Vk5CibMjkEvD63VPWWn/imagen.png)
A veces hasta las dolorosas espinas que nos van apareciendo en la vida nos van dejando marcas, que sabemos que hay que superar. Es valioso mantener la vista en no caerse otra vez, pero a veces simplemente no se puede evitar. No es solamente mantenimiento en nuestros espacios, a veces no sabemos los cambios que nos vienen en la vida. Hoy enfrentamos desde diferentes lugares la incertidumbre de saber donde estamos parados hoy y mañana no sabemos donde estaremos pisando. El columpio roto es una metáfora que nos lleva a pensar lo reparamos o lo dejamos así.
***
Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario del amigo @latino.romano y @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/1-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3090-the-broken-swing) **ENGLISH VERSION** There are spaces where we teeter, fearing we'll fall, simply forgetting those childhood experiences of swinging and playing. I believe those games prepare us for life, helping us understand its ups and downs. They are always valuable experiences. It's simply that when the swing breaks and we fall, we begin to see life differently; it makes us more aware of the dangers of falling again. Life is like that; for some, the swing never breaks, nor do their living spaces, but for others, it seems to be a constant presence. Sometimes even the painful thorns that appear in our path in life leave marks that we know we must overcome. It's valuable to keep our focus on not falling again, but sometimes it's simply unavoidable.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUaXczztp2L4yRnHQwbm5ujZwqikbv6ZpVPZUydrLEK6/imagen.png)
It's not just about maintaining our spaces; sometimes we don't know what changes life has in store for us. Today, we face the uncertainty of not knowing where we stand today, and tomorrow, we don't know where we'll be stepping. The broken swing is a metaphor that leads us to consider whether we repair it or leave it as it is.
***
This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of my friend @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/1-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3090-the-broken-swing)

body.title: Unrighteous ones as servants in heaven instead of melting in hell?
body.body: Good day guys! Today in the morning, I came across a post on X that made me think about the topic of Heaven and Hell again. _Is there really a heaven or hell somewhere?_ _If there is heaven and hell, are there people who will make it to heaven, or will everyone be sent and confined to hell?_ I'm a Christian, and I understand how the concept of heaven and hell works as it is explained in the religious book of Christians, the Bible. But it is no longer news that there is doubt about the existence of these two, or even if they do exist, how people are going to make it to heaven, which is where everyone is striving to go at the end of one's existence on earth. I've heard stories about moments where people died, went to hell or heaven, and returned to earth. These people brought back information about the strict criteria used to identify and separate those meant for hell and those meant for heaven. There are instances such as someone borrowing something from a neighbour and forgetting to return the item, even though the neighbour from whom the item was borrowed did not take it to heart, yet it is still used to judge whether the person should enter heaven or hell. The Post: ========= _The post I saw on social media suggests that instead of God denying those who do not qualify for heaven, they should be allowed to go to heaven and serve there as servants in the kitchen or farm, rather than God allowing them to burn in hell._

/>

The controversial point is an interesting one, but another person replied with a more eye-opening perspective, stating that there would definitely be an uprising in heaven by the servants(the unrighteous ones), and they would take over the place since the servants would be many. Did you get that? It means the unrighteous ones due to their extra large numbers, are going to overthrow the righteous who were actually meant for the heaven.

Food for thought.

Thanks for reading.

. --- La premisa es tan simple como perturbadora: los recursos del universo han desaparecido y tú, un convicto sin nada que perder, eres enviado a una misión suicida de exploración. Pero aquí está el verdadero giro: estás sellado herméticamente. No hay ventanas, no hay escotillas y no hay salida. Tu única conexión con el exterior es un monitor de coordenadas X/Y, un sensor de proximidad y una cámara fotográfica de baja resolución que tarda valiosos segundos en revelar una imagen granulada de lo que tienes enfrente. --- Lo que hace que Iron Lung destaque en la comunidad de gaming no es su complejidad técnica, sino su impecable diseño de sonido y atmósfera. Navegas completamente a ciegas, confiando únicamente en un mapa rudimentario y en el eco de tus instrumentos. Cada crujido del metal bajo la presión abisal y cada pitido errático del radar se sienten como una sentencia de muerte inminente. --- La jugabilidad te obliga a una vulnerabilidad total. No ves el peligro venir; solo escuchas cómo algo colosal choca contra tu casco mientras intentas desesperadamente mantener el rumbo hacia tu siguiente objetivo. Cada fotografía tomada es un momento de tensión pura, revelando presagios, estructuras imposibles y entidades que desafían la lógica. En definitiva, es una experiencia de horror psicológico que demuestra que lo más aterrador no es lo que vemos, sino lo que nuestra mente imagina en la oscuridad absoluta. ¿Se atreverían a descender a este abismo carmesí?

> Have you played Iron Lung? This title by David Szymanski (2022) proves that you don't need a million-dollar budget or hyper-realistic graphics to generate visceral fear. The game traps us inside the SM-13, a rusty, claustrophobic submarine navigating an ocean of blood on a desolate moon, following a catastrophic event known as the \

--- The premise is as simple as it is disturbing: the universe's resources have vanished, and you, a convict with nothing left to lose, are sent on a suicide mission of exploration. But here's the real twist: you're hermetically sealed. There are no windows, no hatches, and no way out. Your only connection to the outside world is an X/Y coordinate monitor, a proximity sensor, and a low-resolution camera that takes precious seconds to reveal a grainy image of what's in front of you. --- What makes Iron Lung stand out in the gaming community isn't its technical complexity, but its impeccable sound design and atmosphere. You navigate completely blind, relying solely on a rudimentary map and the echo of your instruments. Every creak of metal under the abyssal pressure and every erratic beep of the radar feels like an imminent death sentence. -- The gameplay forces you into total vulnerability. You don't see the danger coming; you only hear something colossal crashing against your hull as you desperately try to stay on course toward your next objective. Every photograph taken is a moment of pure tension, revealing omens, impossible structures, and entities that defy logic. Ultimately, it's a psychological horror experience that proves the most terrifying thing isn't what we see, but what our minds imagine in absolute darkness. Would you dare descend into this crimson abyss? --- |

I strongly disagree.  I don't care about the opinions of toasters, but of free people.    
AI is just a clever sorting device, when you dig down into how it works.  Stefan Wolfram in <a href=\

>'What is ChatGPT Doing and Why Does it Work?' points out that AI just weights it's training data. It doesn't actually understand anything. It doesn't understand what 2+2 means, even though it can provide the correct answer '=4' to the equation. It's just providing the answer people have figured out and written. It can be a useful tool, but we have to be careful to not project our own understanding onto it, because it very much looks like 'someone' is providing the responses to our prompts, and we naturally project our understanding into people we communicate with. AI isn't people, and projecting our thought processes into it is misleading, because AI isn't thinking. It's plagiarizing other people, and when we think it's 'thinking' it's actually sorting text per it's weighting algorithms. I have always been a scientist at heart, applying empirical evidence to disprove false hypotheses. Dr. Jacobo Grinberg-Zylberbaum showed that couples that sat in a sound-proof and electromagnetically isolated room and establish communication through meditation. Once the connection was established, one of the participants was moved to a separate room. When a flash of light was turned on in one of the booths, it triggered a response in the brain activity of the other participant, who was in the dark. This shows that consciousness communicates between people via mechanism(s) we do not understand. No EMF could pass through the isolation. No sound could either. This simple experiment shows that consciousness isn't any aspect of the universe we can measure. There's no known mechanism of the brain that does this. No pheromones could induce the physiological response in the isolated subject, no electrical signal, no physical vibration, nothing we can measure. Consciousness is something else. When you also factor in that single celled creatures can learn, remember, and make choices, and single celled creatures don't have brains because brains require multiple cells, then the hypothesis that brains create consciousness is disproved. I am not advocating for some religion, but for applying empirical evidence and using the scientific method to disprove false hypotheses regarding consciousness.

body.title: 五一假期第一天，没有主题。
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![69ef1DztCfzPLrI6_b23f6ba6023edfb6.webp.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/69ef1DztCfzPLrI6_b23f6ba6023edfb6.webp/69ef1DztCfzPLrI6_b23f6ba6023edfb6.webp.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这个假期我们没有去赶热闹，没有远行的计划，主要就是周边转转。本来计划1~2天带娃去周边玩一玩，不过还是觉得酒店太贵，假期去玩还是性价比太低。还是家里蹲吧。

家里蹲的好处就是比较自在，没有什么出行的压力。

早晨我去跑了个5KM的步，因为第一天睡觉到自然醒，没有很早，就没有跑10KM，5KM刚刚好。然后上午就弄弄早晨，家里做做清洁，主要就是配娃做做家庭作业。

不知不觉，上午的时光很快就“忙”完了，下午我也没闲着，计划到眼镜市场去换个镜框。

目前的眼镜已经用了四年了，镜片稍微有点划痕，不能在用的主要原因是镜框已经有些老化掉漆，夏天流汗，我就皮肤过敏。

于是，很早就决定找个假期把这个事情办了。

我坐地铁过去的，哇地铁里的人还真多，看着大多数也都是背包和行李箱准备出行的人，我是少了些许他们那样的蹦波，多了也许的自在。不过依然还是有一点点向往远方。

这让我想起之前李笑来说过的一个习惯：他每次都是假期时家里待，反而是专心做自己的事。从来不去凑热闹。

而这些年，我也基本有个习惯，不想假期的第一天就去堵车在路上。家里蹲，做做清洁，悠然自在。

不过明天有些许计划，买了一个剧场的票，准备带娃去看剧了。



---

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 01 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc3f420fb98bf73acb4bf8d998429629b5649184f94ef176777cc7c034d3caf43fbbe53525acd7f523e14a0a56fe74e72522b14524d3d5f43332d89cf85f2536f_640.jpg)
Hoy decidí recorrer un nuevo barrio de la ciudad, lleno de vida y color. Desde que salí de casa, el sol brillaba intensamente, y el aire fresco me llenaba de energía. En mi camino, pasé por un parque donde había un grupo de personas practicando yoga al aire libre; la tranquilidad que transmitían contrastaba con el bullicio de la ciudad. Conocí a un anciano que se sentaba en una banca, observando el ir y venir de la gente. Me contaba historias de su juventud, cuando ese parque era un lugar de encuentro para artistas y músicos. Era impresionante escuchar cómo la ciudad ha cambiado, pero al mismo tiempo, algunas cosas siguen igual: el amor por la comunidad y el arte. Más adelante, vi a un grupo de jóvenes pintando un mural vibrante en una pared. Ellos me explicaron que era un proyecto comunitario para embellecer la zona y fomentar el arte urbano. El mural representaba la diversidad de la ciudad y la unión de sus habitantes, un recordatorio colorido de que todos somos parte de algo más grande. Esta caminata no solo me permitió ejercitarme, sino también conectar con personas y aprender acerca de las historias que dan vida a nuestra ciudad. Sin duda, siempre hay algo nuevo por descubrir en cada paso. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: An inspiring experience with Versengold and the start of the Season
body.body:
Dearest Troublemakers,

Today marks the beginning of a very busy season. We’re heading into our first tours with music from Echoes of Eldbriaris, and there is a lot we’re excited to share with you in the coming weeks.

But before we charge forward, we wanted to take a moment to look back at the past two weeks… our time on the road with Versengold.


![DSC_9654.jpg.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thetroublenotes/23uQBro5vX9mHCAdVbKRAiYPfPC18gJUieae8jgUKmJmzK62EBohx7bg14cpoVZ1RhoE7.jpeg)


What an experience.

Those arena shows were, quite simply, the biggest indoor stages we’ve ever stepped onto. Standing there, looking out over thousands of people, we felt both the weight and the opportunity of the moment. And as always, we learned a lot.

We brought some new repertoire with us… and also an incredibly important member of the team: Craig.


![DSC_9699.jpg.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thetroublenotes/23xe866LAmAW2pc9zTBU6TtJEyNdLwQwc7UwNN2V3dLvA2skX2CwVxvSHxzdibiTEtzNh.jpeg)


Craig comes from Cornwall and has been the in-house engineer at the Minack Theatre in recent years. We first met him in St Ives a few years ago, where he connected deeply with our sound. Since then, he’s been wanting to work together — and when we realized we needed someone we could trust to carry our sound into 4000+ capacity arenas, his name came up immediately.


![DSC_0088.jpg.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thetroublenotes/23tRtD1ejLVnuWfVD5LtUGkw4jBK4w3Bmxw8ghHpidzu78heAEpnr6F1tmwGDb2rbGPpV.jpeg)


Looking back now, we honestly can’t imagine doing it without him.

He was calm where things could have been chaotic, precise where it mattered most, and above all, he understood what we are trying to create. He became not just an engineer, but a vital part of the sound itself.

The shows?
They flew by.

25–30 minutes each night feels like a flash when you’re on a stage like that, but the response was incredibly positive. The crowds were engaged, open, and ready to receive what we brought. And perhaps most importantly, we connected deeply with Versengold and their entire team.


There is a generosity and professionalism in their camp that left a real impression on us. We learned a great deal simply by being around them, and it feels very clear to us that this is just the beginning of a long friendship — one that will almost certainly lead to future collaborations.

And now…

We set sail again.

With new music in our hands, new stories beginning to unfold, and a renewed sense of confidence and momentum. There’s a quiet feeling among us that something important is starting to take shape.

We’re ready for what lies ahead.

And as always, we’re grateful to have you with us on this journey.

With love and trouble melodies,


The Trouble Notes 🎻


![DSC_0095.jpg.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thetroublenotes/23vrnNGXDvsM9odEBY8rtNFCzLBDADNJRB68oerunHYAfB6UJdx4ZRrhDFWbqLhdiGuPo.jpeg)

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRjCE2AgeiWdgYSa7mmw7TTcEjZrG4dpHwNUP4bn3uwDv/PXL_20240324_172535075.webp)

----------------------

Although the majority of the season was pretty easy for the Tiffin Dragons, I am not too sad to see them face a little bit of adversity here in the G-MAC tournament.  While it would be nice for them to just win every game and sweep the whole field, I think we all know that is pretty hard to do.

Things kicked off two days ago with Tiffin having a banger of an opening game beating Cedarville 15 to 0 to advance to the next round of games.  That moved Cedarville down to the consolation bracket which honestly doesn't seem like a fair name.  I'd call it the losers bracket, but you can still fight your way back to the championship, so that doesn't seem very accurate either.

Meanwhile, in other games, Findlay beat Hillsdale to move along to the next round as well.  That pushed Hillsdale down into the secondary bracket to face Cedarville.  Remember, this is a double elimination tournament, so one loss doesn't totally screw you over.  

Ashland took down Northwood University to secure their place against Ohio Dominican who bested Ursuline.  You can probably guess, that means that Northwood and Ursuline had to face off against each other.  

Hillsdale beat Cedarville to knock them out of the tournament and keep their hopes alive.  Meanwhile, Northwood did the same to Ursuline sending them on their way home.  

Unfortunately, Tiffin lost their game against Findlay by two to get sent down to the secondary leg of the bracket to face Northwood University in a game later yesterday.  It ended up being a walk off win for Tiffin moving them along to the next round of the secondary bracket. 

Back in the main bracket, Ashland took down Ohio Dominican to advance to a game today against Findlay.  This moved ODU down to the secondary bracket where they got beat yesterday in a stunner against Hillsdale. That sets Tiffin up for a game against Hillsdale at 5:15 PM this evening.  Whoever wins that game will then face the loser of the Findlay/Ashland game to try and keep their hopes alive.  

If Tiffin is able to battle their way through the consolation bracket, they will need to beat the winner twice to get the title.  It's not a big deal, Tiffin has had their fair share of sweeps this season, but they are going to have a tough road to get there.  These next four games are going to be brutal for them if they hope to win it all.  

Either way, I think they have already punched their ticket to the NCAA Division II tournament, so this would just be icing on the cake.

I am re-blogging this @michupa 

Prevention is better than cure,and you nailed the core tension at the end: individual freedom stops being purely individual the moment it harms others.

Whether it's refusing a blood transfusion due to religious beliefs or rejecting vaccines because of misinformation or politics, the consequences often spill over,outbreaks, preventable deaths, and strained healthcare systems.
Beliefs deserve empathy and respect, but when they create clear, foreseeable harm to children or the wider community, responsibility must outweigh personal conviction. Education first, but society has a legitimate role in protecting the vulnerable through targeted measures when voluntary prevention fails.


Many lives have been lost unnecessarily because ideology trumped evidence. Your closing point is spot on: decisions are not truly yours when they negatively impact other people’s lives.

Thanks for this,such an important post and it is still happening as we speak.

body.body:
这一天舍友约我去面包节上逛逛，我们就决定在四月十二号那天出发去大魔方招商花园城。之前成都也举行过抹茶节，我看朋友圈里有人去了，看起来还挺好玩的，就想着这次也去体验一下。我们到那儿时候还不到十二点，因为商场才开门不久，人还挺少的，不过商铺们己经开始准备营业了，当天是面包节的最后一天，所以非常遗憾的是有些品牌的摊位已经把面包都卖完了，所以没能品尝到。


![22.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWMQ33vKpTC9fiysZL7P8ePT3CWBhKvoTfPV2C74q8fTp/22.jpg)


![21.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdWm4AM6tnoq891yrGTsuctwKKovc3pCuXgx1WdMFmrZ4/21.jpg)


到场的品牌大多是成都本地没有的，有从天津、贵州等地来的，刚入场时还看到了一对外国情侣，中文还说得挺流畅。现场的面包种类特别丰富，比如可露丽、恰巴塔、贝果、马卡龙、米面包、酸面包等等，琳琅满目，看的人眼花缭乱，还有卖伊比利亚火腿的，片几片火腿下来，配一些蔬菜沙拉和酱汁，这样就是一份了。


![18.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTiP3Mbnd9r24sSSnAQ1SLg4ASnfWCHgVJYo7bSdaBmBW/18.jpg)


![17.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfKCouNEG5jQG6vYgEDjKFTuYgaZ6MKNgmqVHZdYkTGr2/17.jpg)


![20.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmagzLv8zDMTR7rS7ErBPCgnX5ZacLYGv1gyNvNAaJMBjj/20.jpg)


![19.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd3VKFg6jwBap3p8RVuGhLxp9RNH6YKCRQVbu6jvgeH8S/19.jpg)


我买了一些比较特别的东西，比如朗姆酒味白脱饼干，这个吃起来口感很好，顺滑醇厚；还有薄荷巧克力味的可露丽，里面是一半的薄荷味冰激凌一般的巧克力，很好吃既清新又很特别；还有一份现做的贵州豆米火锅把子肉馅儿的恰巴塔，里面还夹了特别多的酸菜、折耳根之类的，特别有贵州风味，把子肉也炖得特别烂，很好吃；还买了一个榴莲奶皮子冰乳酪司康，这个不像平常的司康那么硬，更加软糯一些；最后还买了一个红豆恰巴塔。下面的这张图片是我和同学的购物成果展示，我们每人还去领了两枚鸡蛋。


![16.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdcvaRQhYfnAjujYniWSWJnhK1JMG7FFBoPxAt7UoH4xM/16.jpg)


今天的分享就到这里啦，我们下次再见！最后祝大家五一劳动节快乐，祝大家都能度过一个愉快的假期！

Como es una zona comercial, hay mucho movimiento, por lo general caótico. Hi everyone, I took these photos with my phone while walking through the streets of San Miguel del Padrón (Havana, Cuba) because I thought the sunrise was beautiful. It was very early in the morning, but as you can see in the photos, people were already rushing from one place to another.

​Since it’s a commercial area, there’s a lot of movement, usually chaotic. It is one of the areas in Havana where the most money is made in a day; yet, in contrast, the streets are arguably among the worst. Because of this, public transportation generally avoids the area, and working-class people face the most stress because not everyone can afford private transport—like the so-called 'moticos eléctricas' (electric scooters)—which are very expensive compared to the basic salary of a state worker.

body.body:
/>

Звідки взявся Bank Holiday і чому ціла країна раптом отримала право просто не виходити на роботу.

Уявіть Ірландію 150 років тому.  
Ви прокидаєтесь і йдете на роботу.  
Завтра — знову на роботу. І післязавтра теж.

Шість днів на тиждень. Часто всі сім. Відпусток не існує. Вихідних майже немає.  
Якщо не працюєш — не отримуєш грошей.  
Відпочинок тоді не був правом. Це була розкіш для одиниць.

І ось 1871 рік.  
З’являється Джон Лаббок.  
Він пропонує ідею, яка звучала як чисте божевілля: офіційно закріпити дні, коли ніхто в країні не працює.

Але був нюанс.  
Лаббок розумів: якщо прямо просити «відпочинок для людей», бізнес його знищить.  
Тому він зайшов з іншого боку.

Він не закрив заводи.  
Він закрив банки.

І тут почалося найцікавіше.

Як тільки банки зупиняються:  
завмирають угоди,  
не виплачуються зарплати,  
торгівля сповільнюється.

Економіка стає на паузу. І автоматично вся країна починає відпочивати.

Це був один із перших моментів, коли відпочинок перестав бути «доброю волею роботодавця» і став нормою, закріпленою законом.

Люди настільки здивувалися цим змінам, що певний час називали ці дні «днями святого Лаббока».

Сьогодні Bank Holiday — це не бонус, а право.

Якщо людина працює в цей день, роботодавець зобов’язаний або заплатити більше, або дати додатковий оплачуваний вихідний.

Зараз в Ірландії близько десяти таких днів на рік. В понеділок - 4 травня- наступний 🌟

body.title: The Freemium Paradox: AI’s Democratization vs. Monetization Challenge
body.body:
AI has already democratized product development to a degree that would have seemed impossible just a few years ago. What used to take a large number of teams to do, just one single AI can actually set that in place and you can have a change of a lot of things. What used to take team of engineer months can now be prototyped in days. 

Staying consistent, and there are modern tools now that can play the role of AI assistant and will surely keep things in track and in check and render a near 100% efficiency. Getting users through social media, ads, and SEO, the playbook has consistently proven that AI is here to stay. The platforms are accessible and the initial transaction is achievable.

The number of increase and success when it comes to AI use is increasing daily. Despite **1.8 billion** people using AI platform globally, only 3-5% converts to paid subscription. That's a market theoretically worth 432 billion annually but currently generating only 12 billion. 

The gap between the acquisition and monetization is not a matter of optimization. It is defining challenges of modern product development. You can have millions of free users and still struggle to keep the light on. 

Yes, we have a lot of AI now in place and there are a lot of users that are using it but not everybody is ready to pay for the premium version and it's increasing every day. So it is very possible to have millions of free users and still struggle to keep light and keep your application up and running. This phenomenon isn't unique to AI product. 

The entire SaaS industry wrestles with the freemium conversion challenge. While offering a free plan is excellent for acquisition, it still does not convert on the large scale of things. The critical insight here is that conversion isn't about forcing an upgrade. 

It is about clearly demonstrating additional value that makes paying feels like a natural and something like a next step things to do. There are reasons why free users don't become paying customers. The problem did not start with how they think or how they see the value. 

Free users already know that your product works and they are not arguing with that. It's just that sometimes they have a lot of free platforms that they can use and huzzle from the first one to the next one and before you know it, their work is done. So they can move from Sharjah PC now and when it reaches the limit, they will copy what they have done there and move it to cloud. 

When that one reaches the limit, they will copy it and move to publicity. By the time they use two to three top-notch AI, they are done with doing. You should also know that no matter how much platform that you are setting up, you should be well aware that there is another AI tool somewhere that is competing with you.

So when I say that the most successful products identify and optimize for the aha moment, the specific point where users realize your product's core value and it has a very short core value, they will surely want to buy it. Sharjah PC plus has achieved 71% six-month retention specifically because it delivers consistent value that justifies the subscription. So people must be able to see the value that they are giving. 

So if there is more value and the value is consistent as time goes on, people will tell the other person and one or two honest reviews online will surely make your product to convert. Professional tools like g-top copilot has reached 80% license utilization by integrating into daily workflow, making the product indispensable rather than optional. The pattern is clear, products that drive daily habit and workflow integration retain users at rates that casual use customer apps simply cannot match. 

Then there is also a strategic friction which is the art of designing freemium intent. The best freemium mode they aren't accidents, they are casually designed systems that offer genuine value. In this case segmentation becomes critical here, not all free users are equal and you cannot treat them uniformly and waste resources.

Some users will never pay regardless of your effort, others are ready to convert but you need the right notch at the right moment. Buvira segmentation identifies users showing signs of conversion. Converting free users to paid customers requires systemic thinking across multiple dimensions. 

First you have to map the complete user journey from sign up to payment, identify drop-off points and friction moments. The next thing to do is you have to leverage data and AI for predictive engagement, who and who is engaging and how is their engagement turning into conversion. 89% of marketers report that AI-powered recommendation leads to more repeat purchases and 86% say predictive segmentation has boosted customer lifetime value.

This means that when there is a recommendation of your app over and over again, the conversion rate tends to go up and that is one thing that works at every point in time.

body.title: (EN-ES) Could Vocal Media have its own cryptocurrency?-¿Podría Vocal Media tener su propia criptomoneda?
body.body:
(English version)

The possible benefits for Vocal Media as a result of introducing its own crypto coin

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RlCkuBsnxHs&pp=ygUrd2hhdCBkb2VzIGl0IHRha2UgdG8gY3JlYXRlIHlvdXIgb3duIGNyeXB0bw%3D%3D

In an era that the concept of cryptocurrency is increasingly embraced by society, it could be a good idea for Vocal Media to have its own cryptocurrency.

How easy is it for an online platform, such as Vocal Media, to develop its own cryptocurrency?

According to online sources, and namely, an article by Bob Leibholz, it only takes 7 step to develop a proprietary cryptocurrency.

**Why it could be a good idea for Vocal Media to have its own cryptocurrency?**

Since the process of creating a new cryptocurrency is straightforward, there could be potential value in creating one.

Cryptocurrencies have many utilities and are used in multiple applications and for various causes, so Vocal Media could possibly benefit from developing and running its own crypto.

For example, Vocal Media could become a marketplace itself, where users could exchange products and services, and of course, crypto assets among them, with the platform earning a small fee for each transaction completed.

Can you imagine that?

I could pay another user for their services in Vocal Media’s native cryptocurrency, without having to leave the website and visit online and/or offline suppliers and retailers; in fact, once those suppliers and retailers realize the potential of Vocal Media’s “internal marketplace”, they would be more than willing to create their own, preferably premium, seller accounts on Vocal Media, thus producing more revenue for the platform and making it a stronger, thriving place.

This would be a good addition to Vocal Media’s current focus on content-related activities, playing the role of a multiplying factor that could only enhance the importance of fresh, regular content on the platform, and this content could be rewarded even more, in turn.

Another key point is that, instead of using and paying in “fiat” currency, such as US dollar, euro, etc., paying in Vocal Media’s native crypto coin would make a transaction easier to complete and would eliminate exchange rate costs.

Currently, Vocal Media has established a series of strategic partnerships that could benefit from the introduction and adoption of such a cryptocurrency.

Other major retailers offering consumers the option of paying in crypto would be tempted to work in conjunction with a strong Vocal Media cryptocurrency.

**Adding to Vocal Media’s brand name and user value**

The fact should be taken into account that there are already writing platforms and websites using crypto to reward their writers and users for their activities.

However, the overwhelming majority of those platforms are only focused on using certain cryptocurrencies, with hardly any of them directly paying for user activity in a fiat currency.

If Vocal Media introduces its own coin, it will probably be the first major writing platform to enjoy the best of both worlds, since there are users or writers who would prefer being rewarded in USD or Euro, while others would like their rewards in some type of cryptocurrency, or both.

As a result, making transactions in both fiat and crypto could possibly appeal to a wider community of writers and creators, thus increasing brand visibility and reach for Vocal Media at a global level.

**Technical aspects of Vocal Media’s own cryptocurrency**

From a practical point of view, the technical aspects involved in this venture are critical and should be carefully considered to ensure success.

Since I am not an expert in this field myself, and I haven’t got the faintest idea of the technical requirements that need to be met for such an attempt to be fruitful, I cannot really express an opinion on that.

I am pretty sure, however, that it’s not impossible to find the right people to take care of the technical parameters, since blockchain technology has become increasingly popular, and more and more people have acquired professional knowledge of it.

(versión en español)

Los posibles beneficios para Vocal Media como resultado de la introducción de su propia criptomoneda

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RlCkuBsnxHs&pp=ygUrd2hhdCBkb2VzIGl0IHRha2UgdG8gY3JlYXRlIHlvdXIgb3duIGNyeXB0bw%3D%3D

En una era donde el concepto de criptomoneda se está popularizando cada vez más, podría ser una buena idea que Vocal Media tuviera su propia criptomoneda.

¿Qué tan fácil es para una plataforma en línea, como Vocal Media, desarrollar su propia criptomoneda?

Según fuentes en línea, en particular un artículo de Bob Leibholz, solo se necesitan 7 pasos para desarrollar una criptomoneda propia.

**¿Por qué podría ser una buena idea que Vocal Media tuviera su propia criptomoneda?**

Dado que el proceso de creación de una nueva criptomoneda es sencillo, podría resultar rentable.

Las criptomonedas tienen muchas utilidades y se utilizan en múltiples aplicaciones y para diversos fines, por lo que Vocal Media podría beneficiarse del desarrollo y la gestión de su propia criptomoneda.

Por ejemplo, Vocal Media podría convertirse en un mercado donde los usuarios pudieran intercambiar productos y servicios, incluyendo, por supuesto, criptoactivos, obteniendo la plataforma una pequeña comisión por cada transacción.

¿Te lo imaginas?

Podría pagar a otro usuario por sus servicios con la criptomoneda nativa de Vocal Media, sin tener que salir del sitio web ni visitar proveedores o minoristas, tanto online como offline. De hecho, una vez que estos proveedores y minoristas se den cuenta del potencial del \

de Vocal Media, estarán más que dispuestos a crear sus propias cuentas de vendedor, preferiblemente premium, en la plataforma, generando así más ingresos y convirtiéndola en un espacio más sólido y próspero.

Esto sería un excelente complemento para el enfoque actual de Vocal Media en las actividades relacionadas con el contenido, actuando como un factor multiplicador que potenciaría la importancia del contenido fresco y regular en la plataforma, el cual, a su vez, podría ser recompensado aún más.

Otro punto clave es que, en lugar de usar y pagar en moneda fiduciaria, como el dólar estadounidense o el euro, pagar con la criptomoneda nativa de Vocal Media facilitaría las transacciones y eliminaría los costos del tipo de cambio.

Actualmente, Vocal Media ha establecido una serie de alianzas estratégicas que podrían beneficiarse de la introducción y adopción de una criptomoneda de este tipo.

Otros grandes minoristas que ofrecen a sus clientes la opción de pagar con criptomonedas se verían tentados a colaborar con una criptomoneda sólida de Vocal Media.

**Contribuyendo al prestigio de la marca Vocal Media y al valor para el usuario**

Cabe destacar que ya existen plataformas y sitios web de escritura que utilizan criptomonedas para recompensar a sus escritores y usuarios por su actividad.

Sin embargo, la gran mayoría de estas plataformas se centran únicamente en el uso de ciertas criptomonedas, y casi ninguna paga directamente por la actividad de los usuarios en moneda fiduciaria.

Si Vocal Media lanza su propia criptomoneda, probablemente se convertirá en la primera gran plataforma de escritura en disfrutar de lo mejor de ambos mundos, ya que hay usuarios o escritores que prefieren recibir sus recompensas en USD o euros, mientras que otros las prefieren en algún tipo de criptomoneda, o ambas.

En consecuencia, realizar transacciones tanto en moneda fiduciaria como en criptomonedas podría resultar atractivo para una comunidad más amplia de escritores y creadores, aumentando así la visibilidad y el alcance de Vocal Media a nivel global.

**Aspectos técnicos de la criptomoneda propia de Vocal Media**

Desde un punto de vista práctico, los aspectos técnicos de este proyecto son cruciales y deben considerarse cuidadosamente para garantizar su éxito.

Como no soy experto en este campo y desconozco por completo los requisitos técnicos necesarios para que un intento de este tipo sea fructífero, no puedo opinar al respecto.

Sin embargo, estoy bastante seguro de que no es imposible encontrar a las personas adecuadas para encargarse de los aspectos técnicos, dado que la tecnología blockchain se ha popularizado cada vez más y un número creciente de profesionales la conocen a fondo.

(Esta publicación fue traducida del inglés al español con Google Translate)

_Sources and further reading:_

[How to Create Cryptocurrency – 7 Easy Steps](https://www.bairesdev.com/blog/steps-to-develop-create-cryptocurrency/)

[Can anybody make their own currency (like Bitcoin)?](https://www.quora.com/Can-anybody-make-their-own-currency-like-Bitcoin)

body.body:
The recipe promised happiness, but only if followed on a full moon. Jake glanced at his grandmother as if he has been told what he needed to know many yes ago. Maybe he should try this out to see if his current girlfriend will become happy, relaxed and more loving. These thoughts preoccupied his mind throughout that night as he bids his grandmother goodnight to sleep.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTWhsdzY8XwZPSFg1u6NckiSS25Cpd8KweB8BSojzFuo/1777634968841.jpg)
[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-in-gray-and-white-checkered-dress-shirt-0G2ZxV31kk4)

But deriving happiness from a recipe sounds more like gibberish to him. More or less superstition or half bedtime story.

Jake seems to have little or no option now, his new found love must not fail. This time, he makes up his mind to try it out. But the problem now is when will he get the chance to see the full moon not to talk of following a recipe which promises happiness.

*This is my entry to the Ecency Support Writing Contest: Finish The Tale (#62). To take part in this contest please click on the [LINK](https://ecency.com/hive-133311/@ecency-star/writing-contest-finish-the-tale-2ce21bc896cf) to familiarize yourself with the rules*

[Español](Spanish)

La receta prometía felicidad, pero solo si se seguía en noche de luna llena. Jake miró a su abuela como si le hubieran dicho lo que necesitaba saber hacía muchos años. Quizás debería probarlo para ver si su novia actual se vuelve feliz, está más relajada y se muestra más cariñosa. Esos pensamientos le rondaron la cabeza toda la noche mientras le daba las buenas noches a su abuela antes de irse a dormir.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbTWhsdzY8XwZPSFg1u6NckiSS25Cpd8KweB8BSojzFuo/1777635004841.jpg)
[Fuente](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-in-gray-and-white-checkered-dress-shirt-0G2ZxV31kk4)

Pero obtener felicidad a partir de una receta le parecía más bien un sinsentido. Más o menos una superstición o un cuento a medias para antes de dormir.

Jake parece tener pocas o ninguna opción ahora; su nuevo amor no debe fracasar. Esta vez, se decide a probarlo. Pero el problema ahora es cuándo tendrá la oportunidad de ver la luna llena, por no hablar de seguir una receta que promete felicidad.

body.body: > Hola queridos amigos de @Motherhood, saludos y bendiciones, en esta ocasión vengo para mencionarles una actividad que entre mi hermana y yo le armamos a mi hijo para su actividad de proyecto final con respecto a reconocer el abecedario o al menos una manera que se haga más sencillo en aprenderlo, lo cual resultaba entretenido y la mejor manera para ello. --- ![IMG_20260413_190141_795.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tm9TmF9HzzYVn4vuLxfSZAByVzWekshdFdyATUFqgnjt5xcmu3bGysny1djsKjNDCkm.jpg) **Imagen de mi Autoría** ---

>Para ello pensamos en algo didáctico, alusivo y que fuera algo más sencillo de aprender de la misma manera que resultara divertido, es por ello que pensando que se podía hacer recordé cuando mi familia jugaba Bingo, era algo fijo cuando nos reuníamos un fin de semana, fuese por un cumpleaños o simplemente para vernos, para pasar el rato no podía faltar el hecho de tener una partida de bingo, sobre todo por parte de mis tías, les gustaba mucho y se entretenían sobre todo cuando tocaba poner dinero jaja todos querían participar y ganarse el premio mayor que era con cartón lleno, era una pelea por saber quién lo obtendría jeje aunque era un juego de solo marcar números a la final el estar atento, pendiente de lo que marcabas, lo que estaba permitido para ganar si 4 esquinas, una línea recta, un cuadrado, así ps te permitía concentrarte y bueno de ahí se me vino la idea para esto. --- ![REVIEW (17).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23u69RDaFrJ9mXtwuNe7fd5Wkym1Rif2jyP3Z5S3ttE3Jvm8mriaE54ZhyfCcg1LZRvbX.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>Es por ello que pensando en un juego así se nos ocurrió en hacer un bingo del abecedario cosa que por ejemplo sacaban la letra A en el cartón debían ubicar la palabra o la imagen que comenzará con esa letra, claro al principio creíamos que con puras imágenes se podría hacer siendo esto lo mejor, pero también se agregó palabras o letras para que ellos pudieran ir reconociendo más rápido en eso, mi hermana como tiene habilidad con el diseño se puso a crear una a una de las tarjetas, se hicieron 14 que es la cantidad de niños que tiene el salón actualmente, para que cada uno participará entonces, así mismo ingresando las letras buscando no repetir mucho entre ellas para que hubiese variedad. --- ![IMG_20260413_190141_772.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wMYkvtmoTR7bBxvp5SrixW9D13Lwv9bXE1JCX9uCurLhLgnHc6cPzd524u8kjPciuSJ.jpg) **Imagen de mi Autoría** ---

>Su trabajo fue creativo, mi hijo al verlo le emociono mucho sobre todo porque al verlo impreso como un cartón en donde podía poner las piedras e ir marcando lo que se le decía le parecía genial, eso me alegro mucho porque es algo que va a entregar y que representa lo que quiere transmitir para aprender más sobre las letras y divertirse en el proceso, porque a veces enseñarle así nada más sin algo que le cause gracia ps resulta más sencillo para aprender, nos pareció distinto y más práctico, además que con esta manera tal dinámica pasa un buen rato también, me gustó mucho como quedo, el diseño y lo que se quiso hacer para que todos les agradara y aprendieran de igual manera. --- ![REVIEW (23).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23uFYHdfAhLx5d9raQG8uwLXk7Uc2z5tVk6H7bYrYdSVjDrtREW7HsXbzjbFWAydwUgZG.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

> **Muchas gracias por leerlo. Espero sea de su agrado. Cualquier comentario con gusto estaré para responder y si quieren saber más de mi les dejo mis:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png) **ENGLISH**

> Hello, dear friends at @Motherhood! Greetings and blessings. Today I’d like to tell you about an activity my sister and I put together for my son as part of his final project—specifically, to help him learn the alphabet, or at least make it easier for him to learn. It turned out to be both fun and the best way to do it. --- ![IMG_20260413_190141_795.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tm9TmF9HzzYVn4vuLxfSZAByVzWekshdFdyATUFqgnjt5xcmu3bGysny1djsKjNDCkm.jpg) **Image by me** ---

>So we came up with something educational and relevant—something that would be easy to learn yet still fun. That’s why, when I was thinking about what to do, I remembered how my family used to play bingo. It was a regular thing whenever we got together on the weekend—whether for a birthday or just to hang out. We couldn’t have a get-together without a game of bingo, especially with my aunts. They really loved it and had a blast, especially when it came time to put money on the line, haha. Everyone wanted to participate and win the grand prize for a full card. It was a battle to see who would get it, hehe. Even though it was just a game of marking numbers, in the end, staying alert, keeping track of what you marked, and knowing what counted as a win—whether it was four corners, a straight line, or a square— and so on—allowed you to focus, and well, that’s where I got the idea for this. --- ![REVIEW (17).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23u69RDaFrJ9mXtwuNe7fd5Wkym1Rif2jyP3Z5S3ttE3Jvm8mriaE54ZhyfCcg1LZRvbX.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

>That’s why, when we were thinking about a game like this, we came up with the idea of an alphabet bingo. For example, if they drew the letter A on their card, they had to find the word or image that starts with that letter. Of course, at first we thought we could do it with just images, which would be best, but we also added words and letters so they could recognize them more quickly. Since my sister is skilled at design, she set out to create the cards one by one. We made 14 cards—the number of children currently in the classroom—so that everyone could participate. We also included the letters, trying not to repeat them too often to ensure variety. --- ![IMG_20260413_190141_772.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wMYkvtmoTR7bBxvp5SrixW9D13Lwv9bXE1JCX9uCurLhLgnHc6cPzd524u8kjPciuSJ.jpg) **Image by me** ---

>His work was creative; when my son saw it, he was really excited—especially because seeing it printed on a card where he could place the stones and check off what he was told seemed great to him. That made me very happy because it’s something he’s going to hand in, and it represents what he wants to convey—to learn more about letters and have fun in the process. Sometimes, teaching him this way, without anything that amuses him, makes it easier to learn. We thought it was different and more practical, plus with this dynamic approach, he has a good time too. I really liked how it turned out—the design and the effort that went into making sure everyone would enjoy it and learn in the same way. --- ![REVIEW (23).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23uFYHdfAhLx5d9raQG8uwLXk7Uc2z5tVk6H7bYrYdSVjDrtREW7HsXbzjbFWAydwUgZG.jpg) **Design in CANVA** ---

> **Thank you very much for reading. I hope you enjoy it. I’d be happy to answer any questions you may have, and if you’d like to know more about me, here are my:**
![EL FINAL DE POSTHIVE (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tmBcG1dhAWXHSeTXHGahwcGe8eAbcEpZutQrCnSNiXxDwJJ31QA17giTgLpxPgJtEqN.jpg)
**Translated Using Deepl** ![separadoryasma2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23t7FGdvDtjjEnDiEmhiBDnp6mbsh7xtMBUvkUFiwLtYYSHA9MCnR3VGBuvWJeHNVDBGh.png)

body.body:
