> Hello Everyone, today I am back to prepare some beautiful mushrooms that I will be featuring in the #FungiFriday Community hosted by @ewkaw today.

>On this occasion, I returned to explore the small forest, but in this forest there are many trees, some of which have died due to flooding several months ago. And in this forest I again looked for mushrooms this Friday and before I left I didn't forget to bring my smartphone camera and macro lens, and at that time I immediately set off on my motorbike to the small forest in the neighboring village and hoped to find some unique and beautiful mushroom species in this small forest.

\n\n

>And not long after that I found a species of mushroom known by another name, namely Lentinus. And the shape of the large stem and the small cap, maybe this mushroom species has not bloomed yet and its slightly yellowish white color looks so interesting and unique, and at that time I immediately approached it and took several different angles of pictures and it looked very beautiful and elegant, and on this occasion I will again show some portraits of this mushroom species, and you can see them below.

![1000108526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Ep1WREpWJukpYwk4oDf4npFXWwdmNZKjSmGWvsDKkSQ2rcyYRf8XBwN1VTmV93t2K6d.jpg) ![1000108515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eoc718S2zaTbHcxCoutehGUqcpZe1ja4CgB3zDWRELc7t9Xw6DPNjJ5kafEoyhw3T4k.jpg) ![1000108512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Ep3eDukmJNTkqEcC8LTQEQrb3LZhyCRrDtNQo5TBjvFdkszJ8CM4Jk9Bq9tPjG4Uof6.jpg) ![1000108518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EoChhpN6awBPyJqqS5mKcEQDkxcCC9XZUXWqZBAN2q87ESYhM7xKXmKDzeWP894wx1T.jpg) ![1000108524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Ep1WtU4qtdBXA96oQAkdBipopPuDi7TwxJTrqEGQYNghFSHx2ba8J5XdXvZhZmYnqAc.jpg) ![1000108516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EogLszzhUVZVhGnS3bPMSvsc7zWHPb9Z2ycpuFVe728aCmu1x1pwrttCeS2AjhTwemj.jpg) ![1000108506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eokd7CMog7eSd1bLQNJcMbYj2M64vozhb9QotsprZs29ZrbGmBwk1U5uVf2AgvDdbJ4.jpg)

>And at that time I found in the bushes of plants and here I found a pile of rotten wood, and found a family of mushroom species that were quite numerous from that moment I immediately took several different angles of pictures to see the interesting side of the mushroom species, because this mushroom species has its own characteristics that look so perfect, and you can see it below.

>Lentinus is a genus of fungi in the family Polyporaceae. The genus is widely distributed, with many species found in subtropical regions.....[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lentinus) ![1000108513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eoc728ekf4evAQXEhSYvgSk6xFAoyVsNVyk8ymSm5b59vzqn8tszya9TqzRPugjT6ov.jpg) ![1000108508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Ep5nfQsKLkrVTafmxhGWP9RWTS69mRjsDXzwVM2r7H9FRgvLqryRyrXW6NDxz5w41Fa.jpg) ![1000108517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/EoAZpLJkdWJxQHwzwVuCrt6QBJBaKwBgG3cG9atCJkNahFxF4hFaimmSZXVVbXx1ES8.jpg) ![1000108506 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eokd7CMog7eSd1bLQNJcMbYj2M64vozhb9QotsprZs29ZrbGmBwk1U5uVf2AgvDdbJ4.jpg) ![1000108503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ridor5301/Eokd9vmKSQequb3mK88wRTtmpv518YoAafhvp1jdBnGGR9reX5bjAvorwHnMo4cFsoq.jpg)

body.title: Cuando aprendemos a dominar nuestra mente 🧠🦾
body.body:
**Versión del contenido en idioma español**

Hola y buenos días a todos los amigos de este espacio. De seguro habrán escuchado en algún momento la frase **tu mente te domina** o **estás controlado por tu mente**. Es un tema complejo con múltiples aristas que dependen de la situación y la vida de cada persona.

Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes, mis lectores de siempre desde mi reinicio en Hive, cómo poco a poco he logrado encontrar fuerzas para controlar mi mente.

**De qué trata esto**

https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKM1Cegxi2Dvb3UsUsau3XV3XP9UVLPhVbfqBD9FuhsX/1777633356750.jpg

[www.crehana.com](https://www.crehana.com/blog/estilo-vida/conoce-tecnicas-control-mental/)

Primeramente El “brain hacking”, también conocido como manipulación mental o espionaje mental es la aplicación de técnicas y/o tecnologías para conocer e intervenir en el estado mental, los procesos cognitivos o el nivel de funcionamiento a nivel psicológico de cualquier individuo o incluso de una sociedad.

Cuando hablamos de esta frase tan poderosa, muchas veces pensamos que no hay solución inmediata y que, por mucho que lo intentemos, siempre habrá espacio para una recaída. Ese es mi caso 🩺.

Todos saben lo difícil que es convivir con personas mayores, especialmente con quienes están próximos a los cien años. La vida se vuelve dura, la falta de interacción con el mundo exterior causa estrés excesivo y, cuando se suman otros factores anteriores, la situación empeora aún más.

Les hago este preámbulo no para justificarme, sino para que reflexionen sobre lo desafiante que pueden ser estas circunstancias y cómo la mente nos domina, haciéndonos cometer errores con consecuencias graves.

Pero, sabes acaso  ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre control mental y dominación mental?

Con el control mental tomas el control del enemigo, pero al mismo tiempo no puedes controlar a tu propio personaje. Con la dominación mental tomas a un enemigo como tu mascota temporal y ejerces un control casi sobre él, sin dejar de controlar a tu propio personaje.

**El avance que viví**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoUhAxaaAjeSYqA8gkLf5tfn8DAyt9LYqTLgrzjacbL7/1777634265549.png)

[www.flaticon.es](https://www.flaticon.es/icono-gratis/ignorar_5772623)

Llevaba días luchando contra algo que parecía sin remedio, pero hace poco logré dominar mi mente. No sé cuánto durará, espero que mucho, pero es realmente complejo. Aprendí a ignorar a alguien (aunque no del todo), y aunque dicen que la ignorancia es lo peor que puede pasarle a una persona, en este caso fue necesario.

Se trataba de gente que necesita atención constante para sentirse cómoda consigo misma y que disfruta del conflicto para encontrar paz.

Un día, vi algo mal hecho y decidí no decir nada. Desde entonces, he mantenido esta estrategia: trabajar en silencio para mantener mi mente enfocada en otras cosas y no en lo que esta persona hace o deja de hacer. El resultado: menos problemas.

**Reflexión final**

Aunque esto merecería más de quinientas palabras para cerrar con broche de oro, no quería dejar pasar este pequeño avance sin compartirlo con ustedes, mis queridos lectores y amigos de Hive.

Así que, amigos, para concluir: ¿cómo se sienten cuando logran dominar su mente?

___
___

**English Language Version of Content**

Hello and good morning to all the friends of this space. I'm sure you've heard the phrase **your mind controls you** or **you're controlled by your mind** at some point. It's a complex topic with many facets that depend on each person's situation and life.

Today I want to share with you, my longtime readers since my relaunch on Hive, how I've gradually managed to find the strength to control my mind.

**What is this about?**

https://images.ecency.com/DQmeKM1Cegxi2Dvb3UsUsau3XV3XP9UVLPhVbfqBD9FuhsX/1777633356750.jpg

[www.crehana.com](https://www.crehana.com/blog/estilo-vida/conoce-tecnicas-control-mental/)

Firstly, “brain hacking”, also known as mind manipulation or mind espionage, is the application of techniques and/or technologies to understand and intervene in the mental state, cognitive processes, or level of functioning at a psychological level of any individual or even a society.

When we talk about this powerful phrase, we often think there's no immediate solution and that, no matter how hard we try, there will always be room for a relapse. That's my case 🩺.

Everyone knows how difficult it is to live with older people, especially those nearing one hundred. Life becomes hard, the lack of interaction with the outside world causes excessive stress, and when other factors are added, the situation worsens even more.

But do you know the difference between mind control and mind domination?

With mind control, you take control of the enemy, but at the same time, you can't control your own character. With mind domination, you take an enemy as your temporary pet and exert almost complete control over them, while still maintaining control of your own character.

I'm giving you this preamble not to justify myself, but so you can reflect on how challenging these circumstances can be and how our minds can control us, leading us to make mistakes with serious consequences.

**The progress I made**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoUhAxaaAjeSYqA8gkLf5tfn8DAyt9LYqTLgrzjacbL7/1777634265549.png)

[www.flaticon.es](https://www.flaticon.es/icono-gratis/ignorar_5772623)

I had been struggling for days with something that seemed hopeless, but I recently managed to control my mind. I don't know how long it will last; I hope a long time, but it's truly complex. I learned to ignore someone (though not completely), and although they say ignorance is the worst thing that can happen to a person, in this case, it was necessary.

These were people who need constant attention to feel comfortable with themselves and who enjoy conflict to find peace.

One day, I saw something done wrong and decided to say nothing. Since then, I've maintained this strategy: working in silence to keep my mind focused on other things and not on what this person is doing or not doing. The result: fewer problems.

**Final Reflection**

Although this deserves more than five hundred words to bring it to a fitting close, I didn't want to let this small step forward pass without sharing it with you, my dear readers and friends of Hive.

So, friends, to conclude: how do you feel when you manage to master your mind?

___
___

body.title: What Matters Most to You?
body.body:
>

In one of my previous posts I wrote about the importance of living according to our values and how to build a Vision that guides our lives. But what happens when we still feel overwhelmed? What’s the impact of feeling like we’re going in all directions but getting nowhere?

Sometimes the issue isn’t that we don’t care or that we’re unclear about our values. In my experience, one of the biggest challenges my clients face is trying to do too much in too little time, even when they’re low on energy, capacity, and motivation. In short, they’re not focusing on what truly matters.

>If you don’t prioritize your life, someone else will.— Greg McKeown

When we talk about simplifying life, it’s not about doing less just for the sake of it. That’s a trap many in younger generations are unfortunately falling into, but that’s a topic I’ll save for a future newsletter. What I’m talking about here is doing more of what truly matters. And that begins with identifying the one thing, the single action that adds the most value to your life or to a particular area, and that reinforces what is genuinely important to you. At the end of the day, it’s what brings you the greatest return in reaching your aspirations.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnbg7qyB1yi1WrvV1d7iqrkn6fAPyotc5f3gLTUe4xid/one_action.png
This image was created by me with Napkin AI.

The One Thing

There are many things we could do in life. But what if we asked ourselves: “What’s the one thing I can do that, by doing it, everything else becomes easier or even unnecessary?” It may sound like a clever question, but its purpose is to bring clarity and help us prioritize what we do each day.

For example, if one of your values is friendship, then in theory, you should dedicate a meaningful amount of time each week or month to being fully present with your friends. If you value growth, maybe it means committing to daily moments of reflection or learning. Perhaps it’s pursuing a master’s degree or a course that helps you keep growing. When we align our actions with our values, we begin to live with more focus, purpose, and energy.

>It’s not about cramming more into your schedule. It’s about filtering out the trivial to make space for what’s truly meaningful. The 80/20 Rule

I’m sure many of you are already familiar with the Pareto Principle, or the 80/20 Rule, so I’ll just recap it briefly. Its importance lies in the idea that 80% of our most valuable results, both personally and professionally, come from just 20% of our activities. That means not all tasks carry the same weight. Not everything we do is equally important, and we need to learn to prioritize.

Let’s say you’re preparing for a final exam. Throughout the semester, you covered ten topics, but somehow—don’t ask me how—you’ve realized that most of the exam questions are going to be based on just two or three of those topics. Where do you think you should invest most of your time and energy while studying? Bingo. On what matters most.

The same applies to every area of life. If we know that only a few actions or activities bring us the most joy, growth, or progress, then we need to identify them and give them the priority they deserve. Focus brings clarity. And clarity brings peace.

A Simple and Significant Life

Let’s be honest, life isn’t always easy. There are bills to pay, responsibilities of all kinds, and expectations from all directions. But in the middle of all that, we can still choose to focus on what really counts. The goal isn’t to live a simple life in the simplistic sense. It’s to live an effective and meaningful life, one that reflects who we are and what truly matters to us.

Start Here

If you want to begin that process this week, I first recommend reading my previous newsletter. It’ll help a lot. Then, ask yourself the following questions:

* What’s one value that really matters to me right now? * What’s one small action I could take today to strengthen that value? * What distractions could I set aside, even for a moment, to make space for that?

You don’t need to have it all figured out from the start. Just begin with one thing. That’s enough.

Click here 👉

body.title: Hiking over fallen trees and through the mysterious corners of the Northern Himalayas
body.body:
![dfd.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPHYvehiszp6aMcppyGsv4oUPTRQvMEJWeq58KVsQyxfL/dfd.jpg)


![IMG_7963.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaRXr6wcqWAghnD7Pf2hYv3FUc72wBm5XHsj3K53vHP46/IMG_7963.jpeg)
Julley Everyone,


Starting this perfect hike at this perfect spot over here, somewhere in these mountains, hiking around this particular corner and making our way, it literally was a whole of a different experience that I had when I was at this place, walking these particular locations and capturing these photographs and enjoying these perfect afternoon or something that truly was peaceful and now sharing it with you guys through this post.

![IMG_7964.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPZWbV6dLoDbRzqzG5muyxs2JRLyqYn31y1ca1kqJfPW6/IMG_7964.jpeg)
It was all about the moment when we were making our way through these fallen trees. Literally they were the size of the huge trees that were on the ground, maybe from the past few years also, and then they have become all like this, and then we literally had made our way over walking across and beyond and reaching at a particular spot.


![IMG_7965.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcrDcVgxxVuurrdynPehJjh8hWmJvv3LYwHA8kUUZW9K1/IMG_7965.jpeg)
*Even at certain point, there were these points where such shade regions they were covered with snow, even in this particular time throughout the year as it was now the end of the winter season, beginning of the summer season over here.*

![IMG_7967.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaWBTqHCfdyb4ozFhjm5QLSVnvBPbNwraRtg6foWUyQrg/IMG_7967.jpeg)
<center>***The Fallen Trees***</center>


![IMG_7970.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeTXfn3pFxFNMxM948o8VSd3sdEonh7BkTjuz2rvKbA8L/IMG_7970.jpeg)

![IMG_7971.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNuNPCAp9ZJuoiZZampJXozkKPpgpDpHYbbuxRwzRJteD/IMG_7971.jpeg)
Another thing that I noticed when I was walking, I heard that there was some noise of flowing water, but literally the water was not flowing from anywhere, but it was that there was a huge stream that was going under the soil. That was the groundwater from the melting of snow and ice that usually I have seen in these higher regions around Himalayas.

body.title: Bitcoin at $76K — May Starts With a Test of Patience.
body.body:
🚨 The Numbers Right Now

https://kimi-web-img.moonshot.cn/img/image.coinpedia.org/7aff0c202f87b69ddf6d503b271cae0ca8816583.webp
BTC Price: $76,459

Today's Range: $75,829 — $76,631

24h Change: +0.94%

7-Day Change: -2.25%

Monthly Close (April): +14.8%

Bitcoin entered May trading near $76,300, holding above the critical $75,000 support level despite a volatile end to April . The market is consolidating, not breaking. And consolidation tests conviction more than any crash.

📉 What the Chart Shows

https://kimi-web-img.moonshot.cn/img/s3.tradingview.com/487250ef3f5c3ad2fd39fb318f829329487a3ba4.webp
Price: ~76,500 (sideways, waiting)

RSI: 54–61 — neutral, not overbought, not oversold 

MACD: Flattening near zero — compressed volatility, coiling for a move 

Funding Rate: -3.29% annualized — shorts are paying longs, meaning the market is not crowded with leveraged longs 

Fear & Greed Index: 28 (Fear) — extreme fear recovering from 7, but still fearful 

ETF Flows (30 days): +1.75 billion — institutions accumulated through the panic

ETF Flows (today): -$8.8 million — slight outflow, cooling after the April rally

The market is in a 74K–80K cage. Break one wall, and the direction becomes clear. Until then, we wait.

🐋 What the Whales Are Doing

https://kimi-web-img.moonshot.cn/img/cryptoslate.com/d5b315fa51c26dadafd1eed08022222791aea5ca.jpg

According to CoinDesk, open interest in the June 26 $76,000 put option surged 22.5% — pointing to increased demand for downside protection near current price levels . This suggests institutional participants are positioning defensively, either locking in gains or preparing for potential declines.

At the same time, over 770 million in Bitcoin has been sent to exchanges in the last week — generally regarded as a pre-sale step, pointing to possible selling pressure ahead .

But here's the counter: the 30-day ETF inflow of +1.75 billion shows that larger institutional buyers used weakness to accumulate rather than panic-sell alongside retail . The question is whether that accumulation phase is cooling into distribution, or simply consolidating before the next leg.

📊 Two Scenarios for May

Scenario 1: Gradual Recovery Toward $80K+ — 55% likelihood

BTC holds 75K–76K support. The 74K–80K range breaks upward with volume confirmation. ETF inflows resume. The Fear & Greed Index climbs from 28 toward neutral. We test $80K psychological resistance, then push toward 82K–84K (3-month high zone) .

Scenario 2: Deeper Retracement to 72K–73K — 45% likelihood

The $75K support fails. The 100-day MA near $72K gets tested. The bear flag pattern (resistance near $79.5K, downside risk toward $69K) plays out . This would be painful but not fatal to the broader structure — it would simply extend the consolidation timeline.
The probability of reaching $100K in May remains low unless we see a sharp shift in momentum and quick reclaim of higher resistance zones .

🎯 Key Levels I'm Watching

https://kimi-web-img.moonshot.cn/img/micms.stonex.com/edbd67a3d279e58d31fe1e30b84ab662a3cf3f4e.jpeg

$75,000 — Psychological support. Must hold for bullish structure.

$73,500 — Critical demand zone. Loss of this level weakens the case materially.

$72,000 — 100-day MA. Major medium-term floor. Break this, and the trend narrative shifts.

$77,200 — Local resistance. Reclaim this for short-term momentum.

$80,000 — Psychological breakout trigger. The wall that separates consolidation from trend.

$82,228 — Major breakout confirmation.

$84,757 — 200-day MA. Full trend reversal confirmed.

🧠 What I'm Doing (Ghana Learner's Strategy)

Continue DCA. I don't try to time the bottom of a consolidation. I just keep stacking small amounts.

Watch, don't trade. The 74K–80K range is a trader's graveyard. I'll wait for a breakout or breakdown with volume before adjusting my conviction.

Focus on Hive. While BTC consolidates, I'm building Hive Power. Two horses, one race. One pays me now, the other pays me later.

Ignore the noise. The same people who called for $100K last week are quiet now. The same people who called for $40K in April are quiet too. Nobody knows anything. The charts know more.

🌍 From Ghana — The Real Lesson

https://kimi-web-img.moonshot.cn/img/thumbs.dreamstime.com/fccb04e24bb3b6a7b3db417a1f8fe77bbd7a275a.jpg

In Ghana, we know that the dry season doesn't last forever. But neither does the rainy season.

Right now, Bitcoin is in its dry season. The price isn't moving much. The headlines aren't exciting. The Fear & Greed Index says people are scared.

But the 30-day ETF inflows of +$1.75 billion tell a different story . Someone is buying while others are afraid. Someone is planting seeds while others are complaining about the soil.

The chicken that walks slowly reaches the market even when the road is dusty.

❓ Question 

May is here. Bitcoin is consolidating. Are you:

•  Buying the fear at $76K?

•  Waiting for a clearer direction?

•  Selling because the momentum faded?

I'm still learning, so I want to hear your strategy. Drop a comment below — no judgment, just honest discussion.

body.title: Between belief and consequence [EN/PT]
body.body: > Prevention is better than cure. A popular phrase I’ve heard since childhood and often used in contexts that aren’t exactly about health. It speaks about how we can avoid problems. But considering that prevention is a necessary action in healthcare to avoid diseases and illnesses, many times certain beliefs and the refusal of parents to vaccinate their children are seen not only as an isolated issue, but as something that can affect other people and even society. How do we deal with these situations? It is something delicate when we are talking about refusal of vaccines or other medical procedures. There are two sides to it, empathy is necessary, even when we know that decisions based on belief can be associated with ignorance or fanaticism. We need to understand that procedures like these can shake people’s beliefs, but it is something so delicate that there are extreme situations where decisions need to be made. A wrong decision leads to bad consequences and many times it does not affect only the one who refuses. Once I heard about a person who went through an extreme situation because of their beliefs, they were not close to me, just an acquaintance of a friend. He told me that this person had suffered an accident and needed a blood transfusion, but the family did not allow the procedure because of their religious beliefs and the person passed away. I keep thinking about how the relatives dealt with this, because the death was a consequence of someone’s decision, a death that could have been avoided. But I also think that if the person had survived, how would they deal with the fact that a procedure was performed that goes against their religious doctrine. It is truly something very delicate and complex. How far can interference go to the point of not harming other people? Prevention is the best solution, but what about when someone simply refuses a vaccine, for example? Here in Brazil, during the pandemic, many people refused to take the vaccine because of fake news. It was not necessarily based on a religious belief, but on a belief imposed due to political conflicts. So even in this we can see that there is a correlation, whether religious or not, but connected to what people believe and, in that moment, it may have been one of the most necessary times for prevention against something that was killing thousands of people. How many people did this refusal kill directly or indirectly? So, even though I think what people believe should be respected, this needs to be analyzed carefully, because from the moment that decision affects other people, it should not be made by third parties, but guided by a collective sense of preserving others. If a decision is made for oneself, without external consequences, so be it. But there are limits that a decision cannot cross and that limit is when it brings consequences to other people. In the end, maybe the point is not to choose between respecting or intervening, but to understand the weight of each decision within the context in which it exists. Individual freedom is important, but it stops being only individual when it starts to impact other lives. And it is at this limit, often invisible, that responsibility needs to speak louder than belief. Decisions are not yours when they negatively impact other people’s lives. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png) Prevenir é melhor que remediar. Uma frase popular que escuto desde criança e muitas vezes usada para outros contextos que não seja exatamente sobre saúde. Isso fala sobre como podemos evitar problemas. Mas levando em consideração que prevenir é uma ação necessária na saúde para evitar doenças e enfermidades, muitas vezes algumas crenças e a recusa de pais em vacinar filhos é algo visto não somente como um mal pontual, mas algo que pode afetar outras pessoas e até mesmo a sociedade. Como lidar com essas ocasiões? É algo delicado quando estamos falando de recusas em vacinas ou outros procedimentos médicos. Existem dois lados ali, é necessário empatia, mesmo quando sabemos que decisões baseadas em crença podem ser associadas à ignorância ou fanatismo. Precisamos entender que procedimentos como esses podem abalar a crença das pessoas, mas é algo tão delicado que existem situações extremas em que decisões precisam ser tomadas. Uma decisão errada e consequências ruins acontecem e muitas vezes não afetam apenas a quem se recusa. Uma vez eu fiquei sabendo de uma pessoa que passou por uma situação extrema por conta de suas crenças, ela não era próxima a mim, apenas um conhecido de um amigo. Ele me disse que essa pessoa tinha sofrido um acidente e necessitava de uma transfusão de sangue, mas a família não permitiu o procedimento por conta de suas crenças religiosas e a pessoa veio a óbito. Fico pensando como os parentes lidaram com isso, pois a morte foi uma consequência da decisão de alguém, uma morte que poderia ter sido evitada. Mas eu também penso que, se a pessoa sobrevivesse, como ela lidaria com o fato de terem efetuado um procedimento que vai contra sua doutrina religiosa. É realmente algo muito delicado e complexo. Até onde pode ser interferido a ponto de não prejudicar outras pessoas? Prevenir é a melhor solução, mas e quando alguém simplesmente recusa uma vacina por exemplo? Aqui no Brasil, na época da pandemia, muitas pessoas se recusaram a tomar a vacina por conta de fake news. Não foi baseado necessariamente em uma crença religiosa, mas em uma crença imposta por conta de intrigas políticas. Então, até nisso podemos ver que existe uma correlação, sendo ela religiosa ou não, mas ligada ao que as pessoas acreditam e, nessa ocasião, talvez tenha sido um dos momentos mais necessários de prevenção contra um mal que estava matando milhares de pessoas. Essa recusa matou quantas pessoas diretamente ou indiretamente? Então, apesar de eu pensar que deve ser respeitado o que as pessoas acreditam, isso precisa ser analisado com cuidado, pois a partir do momento que essa decisão afeta outras pessoas, ela não deve ser tomada por terceiros, mas sim pelo senso coletivo de preservar o outro. Se uma decisão é tomada para si próprio, sem consequências externas, que assim seja. Mas existem limites que uma decisão não pode passar e esse limite é quando ela traz consequências a outras pessoas. Por fim, talvez o ponto não seja escolher entre respeitar ou intervir, mas entender o peso de cada decisão dentro do contexto em que ela existe. A liberdade individual é importante, mas ela deixa de ser apenas individual quando começa a impactar outras vidas. E é nesse limite, muitas vezes invisível, que a responsabilidade precisa falar mais alto do que a crença. Decisões não são suas quando impacta negativamente a vida de outras pessoas. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png)

body.title: Television Review: The Bear and the Maiden Fair (Game of Thrones, S3X07, 2013)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/2RVD5pIIiv7ZH0qnazwVrsPEFpP.jpg)

**The Bear and the Maiden Fair (S03E07)**

Airdate: 12 Many 2013

Written by: George R. R. Martin
Directed by: Michelle MacLaren

Running Time: 57 minutes 




The world of *A Song of Ice and Fire* is, by design, a brutal and uncompromisingly patriarchal one. George R. R. Martin’s literary endeavour has often been to interrogate this world not by forcing the reader to view it through the eyes of those it marginalises: the women, the bastards, and the broken things. This compensatory approach—using female perspective to critique a male-dominated milieu—finds a complex and sometimes flawed expression in *The Bear and the Maiden Fair*, the seventh episode of *Game of Thrones*’ third season. On one level, the episode can be read as a mosaic of female agency, from Daenerys’s imperial resolve to Brienne’s brutalised endurance. Yet, as directed by Michelle MacLaren in her series debut, it also exposes the show’s own conflicted instincts, where character study vies with a gratuitous hunger for sensationalism, ultimately rendering the hour a tense, uneven prelude to the carnage to come.

MacLaren’s involvement is historically significant. As the only female director to helm an episode of *Game of Thrones*, her hiring marked a rare concession by the production to a perspective other than the male gaze that so frequently dominated the series. A veteran producer and director from *Breaking Bad*, MacLaren brought a seasoned hand to proceedings, and would go on to direct three more episodes across seasons three and four. Her work here is competent, if not yet showcasing the visceral flair she would later employ. She manages the episode’s sprawling geography with clarity, but one senses the constraints of the material; much of *The Bear and the Maiden Fair* is an exercise in marking time, moving pieces across the board with deliberate, sometimes glacial, pacing. It is another season three instalment where little of epochal consequence occurs, its primary function being character exposition and the meticulous setting of stages for the seismic events of the season’s final act.

The most unequivocal assertion of female power comes, as ever, from Daenerys Targaryen in Essos. As the Unsullied army approaches the slaver city of Yunkai, Jorah Mormont cautions that its walls are strong, capable of withstanding a siege that would bleed Daenerys’s nascent forces dry. The political calculus shifts, however, when the number 200,000—the slaves within—is invoked. Daenerys’s resolve crystallises not merely as strategic ambition, but as a moral imperative. In a sharply written exchange with the city’s oily emissary, Razdal mo Eraz (George Georgiou), she dismisses chests of gold and jewels. Her ultimatum is simple, revolutionary, and utterly feminine in its empathy: free every slave, or face dragonfire. This is agency writ large, a queen defining her cause not by territory seized but by chains broken.

Elsewhere, agency is more circumscribed, negotiated, or violently stripped away. Near the Wall, Ygritte and Jon Snow’s romance is tempered by political reality. Their tender discussion of belonging is poisoned by the knowledge of Jon’s impending betrayal and Orell’s jealous warnings. Jon’s pragmatic argument—that the wildlings’ invasion is doomed, as all past attempts have failed—underscores the tragic inertia of their world; individual desire is crushed by historical cycles. A similar protective fatalism grips Osha in the North. Increasingly hostile to the mystical Reeds, especially after learning Jojen’s visions may lead Bran beyond the Wall, she shares a haunting story of a lover lost to the White Walkers. It is a moment of raw, feminine wisdom born of trauma, a warning against the allure of destiny that the show rarely affords its older women.

In stark contrast, the episode’s most notorious sequence presents agency as a grotesque parody. Theon Greyjoy’s continued torment at the hands of the mysterious Ramsay Bolton reaches a new nadir of sadistic theatre. Two women, Myranda (Charlotte Hope) and Violet (Stephanie Blacker), are sent to his cell. They disrobe, arouse the broken prisoner, and Myranda proceeds to have brief, joyless intercourse with him. MacLaren drains the scene of any eroticism, replacing it with dread. Hope’s performance is key; her depraved smile aligns her utterly with her unseen master’s cruelty. The audience’s foreknowledge that something terrible is coming transforms what might be a fantasy into a horror. The interruption by his tormentor, sarcastic comment on rumours of Theon’s large penis, and the subsequent order for his emasculation, completes the violation. This is where the episode’s, and indeed the show’s, ethical compass grows suspect. The scene is profoundly exploitative, a marriage of sexual display and extreme violence that feels less like a critique of torture and more like a lurid indulgence. It is made more problematic by the fact it is a pure invention of the television writers, a “spicy” addition not found in Martin’s texts. In this moment, *Game of Thrones* uncomfortably resembles the exploitation cinema it sometimes aspires to transcend, echoing the transgressive, but arguably vacuous, shock of works like Pasolini’s *Salò*.

The episode’s other deployment of sexuality could not be more different. Robb Stark and Talisa share a post-coital scene suffused with warm, romantic colour. They discuss her pregnancy and their future with a tender optimism that feels genuinely earned, a chemistry between Richard Madden and Oona Chaplin that had been lacking in prior episodes. Here, nudity and intimacy serve character and hope. This dichotomy highlights the show’s schizophrenic approach to HBO’s infamous mandate for sexposition: one scene uses physical intimacy to build connection, the other to amplify degradation, with the latter leaving a far more pungent aftertaste.

King’s Landing offers its own theatre of constrained agency. Margaery Tyrell performs a masterclass in political empathy, comforting Sansa over her forced marriage to Tyrion, all while advancing her own family’s designs. Tyrion, in turn, tries to reassure a fearful Shae, their private romance buckling under public duty. The episode also quietly underscores the real seat of power in a wonderful scene between Joffrey and Tywin. Joffrey’s petulant surprise at not being briefed on Daenerys is met with Tywin’s glacial dismissal.

The narrative finally coheres in its titular sequence, a masterful set-piece of tension and character redemption. Having turned back for her, Jaime Lannister arrives at Harrenhal to find Brienne of Tarth thrown into a bear pit, a wooden sword her only defence, while Locke’s men bawdily sing “The Bear and the Maiden Fair”. MacLaren’s direction shines here, balancing the grotesque spectacle with raw panic. Jaime’s leap into the pit is an act of instinctive chivalry, a culmination of his burgeoning moral awakening. With Steelshanks’s crossbow providing distraction, they escape, bound now not by chains but by mutual, hard-won respect. It is the episode’s most potent image of agency—seized a choice to protect another in the face of monstrous entertainment.

Fragmented moments elsewhere serve as connective tissue. Arya’s disillusionment with the Brotherhood Without Banners leads to her capture by the Hound, setting a new, darker course. A brief but effective scene with Melisandre and Gendry, sailing past the wreckage of the Battle of the Blackwater, ties past trauma to future sacrifice. Ultimately, “The Bear and the Maiden Fair” is an episode of profound contrasts. It gestures towards female power while wallowing in the sexualised violation of a male body. It builds romantic hope in one corner and snuffs it out with surgical cruelty in another. Michelle MacLaren steers this unwieldy vessel with professionalism, but the script’s conflicting impulses—between Martin’s empathetic character focus and the show’s appetite for exploitative shock—remain unresolved. The result is a compelling, if often uncomfortable, piece of television that holds a dark mirror to its own world, and occasionally, to its own creation.

RATING: 7/10 (+++)

body.title: 🌃 A Night Under the Pattaya Skyline
body.body:
Hello everyone!  
If you've ever walked around Pattaya, you've probably noticed one thing—no matter where you are, sooner or later your gaze catches on the same spot on the horizon.  
That tall, glowing structure that seems to watch over the city.  
I’m talking about the Pattaya Park Tower.

📸 Chasing the Perfect Shot

That evening I decided to slow down and actually work on a shot instead of just casually snapping photos.  
I experimented quite a bit — different shutter speeds, ISO tweaks, small changes in composition. Night photography always feels like a negotiation: too much light and everything blows out, too little and you lose the subject completely.  
In total, I ended up with three main shots. And you know how it goes — one is too dark, one feels off… but the second one? That one just clicked.  
Not perfect, but it had balance. Clean lines, controlled light, and that quiet feeling you only get at night.

<table style=\

>

* * * 🏙️ A Tower You Can’t Ignore A few quick facts about the tower: * located in the Pratumnak area * around 240 meters tall * part hotel, part observation deck, part attraction * there’s even a rotating restaurant at the top And yes — that long “needle” at the top is an antenna, which is why it looks a bit like a broadcast tower. But what makes it more than just a landmark is the experience. 🎢 Not Just an Elevator Ride Most people assume you just go up, enjoy the view, and come back down the same way. Not here. You actually have options: * a cable descent (kind of like a zipline) * small cabins sliding down a cable from the top At night, with all the city lights below you, it must feel surreal. I haven’t tried it yet — but honestly, it’s on the list. 🌈 When the City Turns Neon Pattaya after dark is a completely different place. The heat softens, the shadows hide the rough edges, and the city starts glowing. Neon lights spill across the streets, mixing colors in a way that almost feels unreal. You walk through it like you're inside some kind of low-budget cyberpunk movie — chaotic, colorful, alive. And of course, the brightest spots are always around the bars. Like moths to a flame, people gather there — laughter, noise, drinks, and that unmistakable energy that only nighttime can bring.

/> ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 🐍 A Random Stop at the Market Later that night, while walking through the Thepprasit Night Market, I stumbled upon something that instantly caught my attention — a small tattoo booth. I couldn’t resist.

/>

At first, I tried to be discreet, sneaking a few shots from behind. But pretty quickly it became obvious — they didn’t mind at all. In fact, they seemed totally comfortable with being photographed.  
So I stepped closer.  
Now here’s the funny part — I genuinely couldn’t tell who was sitting in the chair. A girl? A guy? Something in between?  
And that’s Thailand for you 😄

<table style=\

/> The tattoo itself was a snake with some kind of script — maybe symbols, maybe stylized lettering. It had a softer, more elegant look, which made it feel more feminine… but honestly, who knows. What surprised me most was the process. For some reason, I always imagined tattooing as something intense — lots of pain, maybe even blood. But in reality, it looked almost calm. Focused. Precise. The artist working steadily, the client just sitting there, completely relaxed. It felt less like something extreme and more like… a quiet ritual.

>

* * * ✨ Moments Over Perfection That night wasn’t about getting the “perfect” shot. It was about wandering, noticing, experimenting, and letting the city show itself in its own way. The tower, the neon streets, the random tattoo moment — none of it was planned. _Pattaya at night doesn’t try to impress you. It just glows — and waits for you to notice._ * * * Thank you for your likes, your comments, and your time. It never goes unnoticed. * * * _I write my texts myself, correct mistakes and translate via ChatGPT (which is not a violation on Hive)! All photos were taken by me personally - I am a beginner photographer, so I ask professionals not to judge strictly._ * * * **_Thank you for sharing these moments with me! Until new stories and new holidays!_** ✌️. * * * **Camera** 📷: Sony Alpha 7 IV full-frame **Lens** 🔭: Sony FE 70-200mm F: 2.8 GM OSS II **Lens** 🔭: Sony FE 90mm F2.8 Macro G OSS **Lens** 🔭: Sony FE 24–70mm f/2.8 GM II **Processed** 🛠: Lightroom

body.title: From $440K In $ACX To Character Development - The Diamond Hands Tragedy
body.body:
In crypto never take anything for granted! Things can change in a minute, and it's usually for the worst. I will entertain you with a tragedy in two parts, where diamond hands got shattered! 

I was a co-founder at Across, contribution there before people knew about it... before the bridge... before the $ACX token! Got many community roles and for some months I was even paid.

When $ACX was introduced to the world, I got a good airdrop and hold it since TGE day. Everything was staked and earned more $ACX, which powered the flywheel for years! 

I've seen the birth, the growth and the downfall... and I lived to tell the story! From humble cents to an ATH fueled by the Binance listing, my story can be told with a meme! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZngMbGK23XHaWBr1RREpjKwPSY5pvpje5anikkpCt5NA/image.png)


All the $ACX from my airdrop was stacked and earned 20-30% APR for months. Didn't claimed the rewards because that will reset the multipliers, and didn't want that.

When the loyalty/time-based multiplier was removed, I claimed bags of tokens and staked them as well. My monthly payments were also added in the vault for more gains! 

There I was, staring at my wallet like I’d just unlocked a secret level in life. The numbers didn’t even feel real anymore. At one point the bag was sitting at $300,000 and kept growing!

It was real value not hypothetical money. Not “if this pumps” or \

shit! Real life chanigng, glowing, screen-staring-back-at-me money. And what did I do? Nothing! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWFyRTCCxxpcL4pLzQTZ27eUo6mhAXa7YrBhGLK3pijfR/image.png)


Diamond hands, baby. Vision, loyalty and conviction. “This is just the beginning” I told myself like I was the main character in a Netflix crypto documentary.

Then it climbed even higher. $440,000. Four. Hundred. And. Forty. Thousand. Dollars. At that moment, any reasonable person would’ve at least taken something off the table.

A car maybe? A house deposit? What about “just in case I’m an idiot” sell? But no... Not me! I zoomed out on the chart like a philosopher. “This isn’t the top” I said at ATH! 

I was pacing around my room like a hedge fund manager who just discovered caffeine. “This goes to a million!” I said! Fast forward to today… I hold no $ACX but sold much to late! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXHtENhErqqj1pu8fZqo2DD4XTccNMLtGRGwvyd8MJfqU/image.png)


Same coins but a different reality, and I’m staring at it like it’s a ghost of my former self. Not even anger anymore... just that quiet hollow laugh. You know the one.

I really watched almost half a million dollars evaporate because I thought I was smarter than the market? Sold close to ATL for about $7,100  and the villain origin story is completed.

That’s not even a dip… that’s a full cinematic collapse It’s funny in a tragic way. If I told this story to someone who’s never touched crypto, they’d think I’m exaggerating.

Anyone who’s been in the game just nods like “yeah… that checks out” and feels the pain. My bag… and a personality is now built entirely on “I should’ve sold”. I’ve learned nothing! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZmVvmFp3ZGGETtfNBsMg7qyHBv72TxWPe5pJCCPDd7L7/image.png)

Suffering of the people who do good and the bad people prospering is something that is well known in this world. But we must know that suffering is not usually a punishment and those bad people who prosper is not a reward for being bad. Sometimes, God allows righteous people to go through challenges to build their faith, patience, and character. These trials can draw them closer to Him and help them grow spiritually, even when it is painful.

>“For the evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.” (Psalm 37:9).

body.title: Giant mosquito, and no it is not, Tipula maxima
body.body:
My son came to me with a scary story: Dad, dad, a giant mosquito. And he immediately got a blowtorch so we could go kill it. He was scared. I immediately guessed what he saw. We call it a garden mosquito. I know it has nothing to do with mosquitoes and it doesn't bite.

So I had to explain to him that this is a good mosquito and that it won't bite ours. And at the same time, I had to research the very species of this garden mosquito of ours.
![20260501_114406.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJkT7MvP5rXLTS2F9aXk4VuzAGYkXRz9qoaCL7Bp8WyvFfKMBxtxYu6THVZz1pd.jpg)

![20260501_114421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJoKCTH5irSsEquYaH1aM33DjA4qbcDmvyGurGvjTF2beJi8SrizT45z1bJcfRZ.jpg)
It was in a room that we don't use, our son sometimes plays there. Since the weather is warm and the windows are open, he wandered inside.
![20260501_114424.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJpkBXCu6Z5G4eWPwA8Yrpa6HM9Z9Y4Vcob8uGYU65m1sdUFNQFV64aNpAnsFqE.jpg)
What I was able to discover about this mosquito is that it is called Tipula maxima and belongs to the Tipulidae family.
And it is also the largest representative of its family.
![20260501_114445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AK56nWEUBHccCVWyAycwRWAWEiVYiN9CahAXXm8rJDYdxYuaYQboPAjnkgTa2je.jpg)
And I would say that this is our male because the females have a more elongated body and it looks like they have a stinger. It's actually the organ with which they lay their eggs. It's an ovipositor with which she drills into soft soil or moss to lay her eggs.
![20260501_114445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AK56nWEUBHccCVWyAycwRWAWEiVYiN9CahAXXm8rJDYdxYuaYQboPAjnkgTa2je.jpg)
Since this is a good type of mosquito, while I was researching I had to keep my son close to me so he wouldn't kill him. And to convince him that this is a good guy. That its young (larvae) feed on decaying plant material, rotting leaves and moss.
![20260501_114516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJmt48oMJWHiZZprDPEkSq1teGKVd81Yrf7ykKpDzQAAy68WibGVcqUg9LFEmy9.jpg)

We finally managed to get him to release this giant mosquito.


Thanks for reading.
Until next time.
Stay healthy.
Markone85.

body.title: How many times do we need to study the word of God// The old path
body.body:
The bible never tells us how many times we need to study his word daily, but it teaches us to always read and listen to the words of our creator. It is shown in the bible that we should always meditate in the words of our father day and night. It means keeping God’s word in our hearts and minds throughout the day.

https://youtu.be/lb9pM-VkUKE?si=jLWFW31shazt3F-b

The words of God helps us to grow spiritually and have a strong faith in him. Even if it is once a day, what matters most is sincerity and consistency. Some people may study in the morning to guide their day, while others may do it at night for reflection. The important thing is making it a habit that keeps you connected to God regularly.

There is no fixed number of times required, but the Bible encourages us to study as often as possible ideally every day. Whether once or several times, what truly matters is understanding, applying, and living according to God’s word. Consistent study strengthens our relationship with God and helps us live a righteous life.

body.title: A Big Month Ahead
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23sdQiYnEf9eAzStHHD9UDBeb8JMj5eh8S6Y83TXEBj1VPNnbP7P2cANGiLcVMpiTLYqp.png)</center>

------------------------

This is a pretty big month for me.  At some point during the month of May, I roll the human odometer over to that dreaded half century mark.  I have a lot of mixed feelings about it. It's not so much that I am dreading it, I just know that from this point forward things will likely get harder. It's one of those facts of life.  I'll do my best to keep my health in check, but you just never know.  Friends and family will start passing away, and the days, months, and years will seem to go by at a breakneck speed.

I got my welcome (please sign up for us) letter in the mail from AARP the other day.  After some great advice from my brother in law and @ericvancewalton, I will not be signing up for it.  It's hard to believe we are almost halfway through 2026 at this point.  I really prayed things were going to be different this year.  Perhaps a bull market...  I know what I didn't pray for was $5 a gallon gas and another war over in the Middle East.  Oye!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/Eo43s2hVBvDcEbzdRNoCyXSt9SB3jhXL2pnMTP7DzviuzjZNfiCT1dwEAp295M1m8So.png)</center>

-------------------------------

So I did the power up thing on HIVE Power Up Day.  I also powered up about half of the amount on my @bozz.sports account.  You should check that one out if you like some fun personal sports content.  I likely could have powered up a lot more on my main account, but I am really hoping the price of HIVE will eventually go back up and I can move some of my liquid HIVE into HBD.  

I'll also probably move a little bit of it off chain to invest in either [OmenX](https://app.omen.foundation?ref=B8B6D7E1D55D39) or [GoMining](https://gomining.com/?ref=AWSRZIN).  I haven't quite decided yet.  I think OmenX is more of a gamble, but they have some exciting stuff coming out soon that I am kind of interested in.

### Splinterlands

It was the end of the season on Splinterlands and though I did about the same as I usually do in Wild, Frontier was a new experience for me.  I was able to work my way up to Silver I with the cards that I have, but towards the end of the season I hit a brick wall and racked up a streak of losses that almost knocked me out of that tier.  I was chasing the daily quest rewards, so about two days before the end of the season I just quit playing. I didn't want to risk getting sent back down to Silver II.  

I expect things will be a bit competitive at the beginning of this season, but then eventually the hardcore players will move on and I will hopefully be able to make some progress and slide into the Gold tier if I am lucky.  We will see.  It looks like I have about six SPS proposals that I need to review and I also need to pay my bill to Monster Market for hosting my SPS Validator Node.  Give me a vote if you haven't already!  Please!



<center>![PXL_20260425_202306817.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23x1DKD14P44pB8h5rbNhV3kq15AD83oeSzXqHvR6i775dFFJD6o4amqy2gBeRaRs5TaL.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_214239319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23uFW3zYKUxx3deiVWSj7EjoMkf6xnefs7XFLMEB61PetDLYVUrR8G8WHzKjLxYFcMkHu.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

I just realized, I never shared these photos from this weekend when my wife and I were down in Ohio celebrating her sisters 50th birthday.  We went to a pretty cool bar called \

that I have written about before.  They have a little party room where my brother in law planned a surprise party for her.  We had some good drinks and a nice little pizza with garlic aioli, sausage, mushrooms, and onions.  It was delicious.

### NuScale

There's been a bit of big news with my favorite Small Modular Nuclear Reactor Stock lately.  While their earnings report was not that great, the price of the stock has recovered a bit in the past couple of weeks.  Part of that is due in part to Fluor vacating their position in the stock.  I'm not sure why that is a good thing, but investors seem to think it is.  I also saw the news yesterday that SMR is looking to build a facility in Texas.  I think right now it is just a training facility, but this could be a good step towards them actually producing a product now.  This isn't financial advice, but I still think SMR is a good buy right now.  Especially with the price back down around $10.

### Good as Gold?

My KGC or Kinross Gold Corporation stock doesn't seem to be doing too well over the past month.  I think that probably ties together with the general slide or sideways movement precious metals have been on after that dramatic rise earlier in the year.  I still think it's a good hold and I am not too mad about where it sits right now. Traditional investments like this don't really worry me too much in general.  There is just too much money tied up in them by the powers that be.  I know that barring some kind of natural disaster they are likely going to recover even if they take small dips.

Speaking of gold though, Apple announced their earnings per share the other day and it was something like $2 per share.  I think the big wigs adjusted it to just below $2, but it's basically $2.  While Apple used to be the big dog on the block, it appears that NVIDIA is the real darling now.  Perhaps NVIDIA is the stock equivalent of platinum and Apple is gold.  I don't know who that leave in the silver spot?  I'd say Tesla, but they seem bigger than that.

I've got an exciting weekend ahead and I can't wait to share it with you when I get back next week.  May is here!  Are you ready?

------

 











<div class=\

> On Wednesday, April 29th, the Forum on Lara State as a Megadiverse Natural Destination took place. The forum was originally scheduled for a week earlier but had to be postponed. This didn't deter a large turnout. I arrived early, a little before nine in the morning, and the hotel lobby was already full; among them were many tourism students from various universities in the city. We waited a few minutes before being able to access the mezzanine level of the Biotel Hotel, located across from the city's Obelisk. A line of attendees formed, waiting to be included in a database of Cortular, the regional government agency in charge of organizing the event. The hotel is quite nice, and in that area, some of the booths of other organizations that participated in organizing the forum were already set up, such as Inparques and the city zoo. The coffee company IMpetu was also present to showcase its specialty coffee. ---- > El miércoles 29 de abril tuvo lugar el Foro sobre el Estado de Lara como Destino Natural Megadiverso. El foro estaba programado para una semana antes, pero tuvo que posponerse. Esto no impidió una gran afluencia de público. Llegué temprano, un poco antes de las nueve de la mañana, y el vestíbulo del hotel ya estaba lleno; entre ellos, muchos estudiantes de turismo de diversas universidades de la ciudad. > Esperamos unos minutos hasta que pudimos acceder a la entreplanta del Hotel Biotel, situado frente al Obelisco de la ciudad. Se formó una fila de asistentes que debían registrarse para ser incluidos en una base de datos de Cortular, la agencia gubernamental regional encargada de la organización del evento. > El hotel es bastante bonito, y en esa zona ya se encontraban algunos de los stands de otras organizaciones que participaron en la organización del foro, como Inparques y el zoológico de la ciudad. La empresa cafetera IMpetu también estaba presente para mostrar su café de especialidad. ![IMG_20260429_113933_075.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpzxAefrKnmgu38ujGXKDGFMWkiPhboaDWWCZcwVUtAGUm4QaEuWN3m1avKBsBQt7FE.jpg) ![IMG_20260429_091754_174.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpzyjC73DaxxoPXNCERoxm8H3EnXTmeZTY4vmJm3VLE836xP5x1GY1f7W4pmLrS3wV3.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260429_091257_537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/242hYS8Sqt3LkiTV8TMnX83ExdtVpidNvXc57eHpPw4B9g6LUyzt8jriBhMpxr5quYeW4.jpg)|![IMG_20260429_091258_949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23ynQNmNUGVw2PLBNE8o1g2R1U4kopPYr5931AGRER2o4pDvP5PwNFz7D1ZpSpNAFQsLv.jpg) || ![IMG_20260429_091211_866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpQwL68vyXQvDintBLmDXpwp62qoMh1oTQkbsJHcCZHQuPxj1fzMtZh4jfhkgk5Vbpt.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260429_090850_854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EqSVv7HeDkdnFBCJfxma4roCUCNTDQZWPP2P5WNVdtStCtqqokJr66x5cBMyhfcSjeF.jpg)|![IMG_20260429_092823_235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EppMdxGgTxJbRSfAe3td14LbkKrjhYppQsZ9NqPTmPE4fgCrLwa7LYnq7NchutUzxTX.jpg) || ![IMG_20260429_091413_135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EnqT3rJTK6cVHPv9K9xUgTjGhmN7kjJWmcEzcEmodbz5f6hJpmfRJfZ3sso9R87eBLc.jpg) ![IMG_20260429_113454_552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23zS9udtVsq6Ci6sFsVQstbRR5QJoKPTpRZ2YsLP6mvWt7pe1mNaeB8bZitdEB1ivFgon.jpg)
----
Admission to the forum was completely free and open to the public. While waiting for the presentations to begin, I took photos and videos of the event and the attendees. The Tourism Queen, the Agro-industrial Queen, and the State Culture Queen were also present, and I took the opportunity to photograph them. I also had the chance to speak with the staff at the booths to learn a little more about the National Parks Institute (Inparques) and their role as guardians and caretakers of the national parks. I also visited the Zoological Park's booth, which I hadn't been to in quite some time. I think it's been about five years since my last visit. I plan to return to see how the facilities are doing. ---- > La entrada al foro fue totalmente gratuita y abierta al público. Mientras esperaba que comenzaran las presentaciones, tomé fotos y videos del evento y de los asistentes. La Reina del Turismo, la Reina Agroindustrial y la Reina de la Cultura del Estado también estaban presentes, y aproveché para fotografiarlas. > También tuve la oportunidad de hablar con el personal de los stands para aprender un poco más sobre el Instituto de Parques Nacionales (Inparques), sus funciones como guardianes y cuidadores de los parques nacionales. Visité además el stand del Parque Zoológico, al que no había ido en bastante tiempo. Creo que han pasado unos cinco años desde mi última visita. Planeo regresar para ver cómo están las instalaciones. ----- ![IMG_20260429_113604_328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23zktoAJffn94LuXPFk16j8A7MKAwFLRmmfSvXnJeMDqqqTYH9656j2aruuUx7Jej4w64.jpg) ![IMG_20260429_101644_574.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EowE7hgAcr1Wbf5fPJVZsSKHprdjJMt6Fy98bUFYehdEZCzWsCFXWWN727p4hw4FEfb.jpg) ![IMG_20260429_103707_725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EqNGEc4vaHPwxGqTTmFpoxAryhubnqeKzeq8BcV9Cfe4qL9bDT5YM1U4JPUS4PBJ71M.jpg) Foror Lara Destino Natural ![IMG_20260429_101218_497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpJY2PDDXqoaJL98DMXafTDtaZWpcdswPL314ogYo3h8xXi9ZRtMmHjcaxpq6P63X75.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260429_111613_527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EokWrxHRVfzxrvXvJyut1Fyp3vuAj2oPdoSeemheUG9ZsbgJAtGrjJL2zXeLiqBaSYf.jpg)|![IMG_20260429_115140_919.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/Eq7MLo5de779jYm3KB4NYKywUzvDJ5Rr9quHXG83Q17eNGjSnkdAk8J1PxBt11Ppnfz.jpg) || ![IMG_20260429_112245_711.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/243BkiGmQfqNjxJShrqX9uAti9M3DQubvnxKv2xdkk5n5bc3zLawkc5xjXjZuxWSdkD1k.jpg) ---- Before the presentation, there was a short musical segment with a local group that performed indigenous and traditional songs from the state. It was very lively, and the audience enjoyed the Lara rhythm, which fills all the inhabitants of the region with pride. There were three speakers, and all of them were very informative on the topics they covered. The goal was to raise awareness, not only among tour operators but also among visitors to tourist sites, so that we all take care of the natural areas, both the flora and fauna found there. It is everyone's responsibility to maintain our parks and tourist areas in perfect condition, visiting them without damaging the ecosystem that thrives there. The last speaker was a veterinarian who emphasized the care of animal species in our main parks. The care we must take with the animals that inhabit these places. It was already past noon when I had to leave, so I couldn't fully enjoy the last presentation, but the forum was very informative. I hope they continue to organize these kinds of activities more frequently. ---- > Antes de la presentación, hubo un breve segmento musical con un grupo local que interpretó canciones indígenas y tradicionales del estado. Fue muy animado y el público disfrutó del ritmo Lara, que llena de orgullo a todos los habitantes de la región. > Hubo tres oradores, y todos fueron muy informativos sobre los temas que trataron. El objetivo era crear conciencia, no solo entre los operadores turísticos, sino también entre los visitantes de los sitios turísticos, para que todos cuidemos las áreas naturales, tanto la flora como la fauna que allí se encuentran. Es responsabilidad de todos mantener nuestros parques y áreas turísticas en perfectas condiciones, visitándolos sin dañar el ecosistema que allí prospera. > El último orador fue un veterinario que hizo hincapié en el cuidado de las especies animales en nuestros principales parques. El cuidado que debemos tener con los animales que habitan esos lugares. > Ya era pasado el mediodía cuando tuve que irme, así que no pude disfrutar plenamente de la última presentación, pero el foro fue muy informativo. body.title: 100k stake yo
body.body:
Alright. Other than staking, I have also delegated a big portion of my power to ASEAN Hive, a small amount for #ecency, and another small portion to #indiaunited which I am considering to increase it for their community, too.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXWgQ2dCgPkBr7Gkjn7wkLmzqCocDuTX5AwryCQnPe1ps/1777632074809.png)

I don't delegate these for the profit. Merely using it where it belongs to. It's #HPUD and thanks to @davedickyyall reminding so I hold back the biggest portion of the power ups for 1 extra day.

I kept a small portion of the hive in the wallet, just in case if I needed some extra cash. With my current health condition, and the job isn't really that stable at this point of time, things can change from bad to ugly anytime. Not that I wanted to be negative, it's better to over prepared and NOT having to use it; then when needed and I'm unprepared. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRKWPWJhn7FZpAuyaSFQu8k1KWc659eM98HXjPJaQcJ9f/1777633056405.jpg)

I don't have a plan yet. At this moment, I am merely focusing on my daily routine. I wanted to report back my current health condition, but it's probably too boring. I restored like more than 50% of my mobility, but sometimes I still lost control and I don't know why. I did asked around, but other experienced patients told me this kind of things involving nerves systems differs from one and other. Some people recover within a month, some take years, or never fully regain their mobility.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmceiM45LVNzg8bz7264FV36KyhQRX4a92edHmr7Tzr7yE/1777632981384.jpg)

Took this panoramic picture this morning, with the old phone and it looks surprisingly awesome. It's public holiday here as we celebrate labour day, so I woke up early, did a long walk and went to church with the home minister. I did thought of whether to write the post before GMT0 or after my local time 12pm. And decided, I should just do it after the whole world turn their clock to May 1st, so I won't miss this important power up event.

On the last note before I end this. I have a collection of guitars, I don't play with them anymore other than 1 of the classical guitar and the other acoustic guitar. I did thought of, should I keep all of them? Or only the two essential ones. If I get rid of the rest, I'm sure at one point of the church event came knock on my door, I'll be scolding myself. But if I keep them, they're like everywhere in the house. Behind the TV. Beneath my bed. Besides the kids study table. Next to our dinning table. On top of the ironing board. After all, ever since my medical condition, I have trouble holding down a chord properly with my left hand. Such a boulevard of broken dreams.

https://youtu.be/Soa3gO7tL-c?si=kxWals0qgbkpAT1Q

Sorry, I am just way too overly occupied my mind. I don't even remember how I got here, from staking 100k to how to manage my guitar 😂 and ended up sharing a music video with y'all. I hope everyone have a fruitful labour day.

body.title: The Met Police Commissioner is right to do this.
body.body:
![Metropolitan-police-plaqu-011-3026688706-300x180.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/48HAR8FPVm2Puj1qbwEC4dLiU5ac1NLaq7opSDmWw1w59ibnUnYZxUJKzGWW9xxwDV.jpg)



For all sorts of reasons that include inefficiency, two tier policing, politicised policing of the Gaza hate marchers, personal experience of the Met, corruption and much more, I’m loathe to dish out praise for the Met or its officers.  They’ve not been all that we and especially Londoners should have expected them to be.

However, after seeing the Met’s Commissioner Sir Mark Rowley’s letter to the Green Party leader Zack Polanski, criticising him for his uninformed comments about the manner in which Met officers disarmed the Islamic man who is accused of stabbing two Jews in Golders Green, I find I have to step away from my previous position.  All of us who saw the video of the officer’s kicking the suspect to get him to drop the knife he was holding could see that this was extreme but necessary policing for a situation that was extreme. The officers had attempted the use of a Tazer several times on the suspect but it still did not relax the suspect’s grip on his weapon.  These officers did not know whether the knife was the only weapon this man was carrying and neither did they know whether or not this man, like so many other Islamic terrorists elsewhere in the world, was wired to explode.

Zack Polanski’s comments criticising the police’s actions here were so high profile and uttered at a time when there is serious political and social tension in the UK that they deserved a response. We are currently faced with a growing threat from terrorism from a variety of sources mostly Islamic but also from the jackboot lickers (neo-Nazis), non-ideological individually planned terror attacks, the remnants of Irish Republican terrorism and the threat of terrorism that is outside of these categories but which has often been linked to conflicts, such as between Eritreans, that has been imported from overseas. Britain has a terrorism problem and Polanski’s intervention has not helped the fight against such terrorism.

Sir Mark took the relatively unusual step of writing publicly to Polanski to express his displeasure at Polanski’s comments.  I’ve pasted the letter from the Met Commissioner below.  I’ve read this letter and cannot see anywhere in this letter that would imply, as many Greens and Leftists are saying, that Sir Mark is interfering in either free speech or the democratic process.  All that Sir Mark has done is defend his officers who were dealing with a live, chaotic and stressful situation and that Polanski’s comments and the comments that he’s amplified where officers have been criticised might make officers think twice before dealing robustly with terror suspects.  That’s something we do not need to happen.  We should want police to take robust action when apprehending terror suspects.  If they do not then the suspect might draw out a different more deadly weapon or set of an IED.

As I said there’s a lot to criticise about the Met but this apprehension of a dangerous terrorist is not one of them. In fact the terrorist got off lucky.  If this had been France or Germany or Italy or the USA or Israel, this terrorist would not live long enough to be apprehended.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 01 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/ga8b27030ee02b5c721ae581ad564124d336de6c1940b7dbf4d26bf265dab8df950a8e1b6889635eac760d410f22bde6393b2645b84f599165fb848651bea1cad_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. Comencé mi recorrido temprano, cuando el aire todavía estaba fresco y la luz del sol comenzaba a asomarse. A medida que avanzaba, me encontré con un grupo de artistas pintando un mural colorido en una pared. Se notaba la pasión en sus rostros mientras mezclaban los colores y discutían sobre el diseño. Les pregunté sobre su proyecto y me contaron que quieren reflejar la diversidad de nuestra comunidad. Más adelante, en un parque, conocí a una anciana que estaba alimentando a las palomas. Su nombre era Doña Rosa, y me contó historias de su infancia en la ciudad, llenas de recuerdos nostálgicos. Me impresionó su energía y cómo disfrutaba de cada momento. Esa conexión humana siempre me inspira. También vi pequeños detalles que alegran el día: flores que empezaron a florecer en los jardines, el sonido de música en vivo desde una cafetería y risas de niños jugando. Definitivamente, cada caminata es una nueva aventura llena de sorpresas y encuentros que hacen que me sienta más conectado con mi entorno. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). First up, the front… ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5DB2355D-E4C4-43EF-83C3-9D1A3B31A8681777618779.5811648) The big, heavy old petrol push mower does have a ‘self propelled’ function, which I’ve never used, though I know it burns a lot of fuel. Not happening today though! </liketuimages>

五天五一假期，美好的一天从营养早餐开启。依旧和往常一样，清晨七点准时起床，用破壁机打磨了醇香的五谷杂粮，又上锅蒸了软糯的铁棍山药、鸡蛋，还有香甜的红薯与玉米，满满一桌都是我格外爱吃的家常早餐。
 
只是大宝口味偏重，对清淡营养的粗粮早餐不太喜爱。不过我也从不强求，饮食健康最重要，不管孩子们吃多吃少，哪怕每人吃上一个鸡蛋，也足够补充身体所需营养。
 
今日早早和姐姐相约，带着家里几个小朋友一同出游。原本计划前往丰城新动物世界游玩，一直没能去过那里，想着可以近距离亲近小动物，孩子们一定会特别喜欢。但考虑到从南昌开车过去需要一小时路程，路途有些遥远，便决定就近选择融创茂出行。
 
这里前身是万达文化旅游城，后来更名融创茂，独具特色的青花瓷建筑外观十分亮眼。园区修建多年，平日里人流量寥寥无几，只有每逢节假日才热闹喧嚣，往来游客大多都是外地人。平时我们也很少过来，地段比较偏僻，从我家开车走高架，也需要半个小时才能抵达。
 
我们提前预约了园内的海世界海洋馆，线下门票价格着实偏高，成人票148元一位，儿童票89元。家中小宝身高一米一以下可以免票，身高超过一米五则需购买成人票。粗略算了一笔账，我和姐姐两张成人票，再加上四个孩子的儿童票，门票六七百元，实在不低。
 
还好我习惯性提前寻找优惠，闲鱼总能带来惊喜。美团售价89元的儿童票，在闲鱼仅需20元、29元、39元不等，只是优惠票数有限，每家仅有一两张。我只好分开下单，入手了不同价位的儿童票，两张成人优惠票一共220元，对比官网足足优惠了60元，精打细算又省下一笔，真开心，哈哈。
 
顺利检票入园，恍惚间有种似曾相识的感觉。南昌老牌海洋馆我曾经去过，这处海世界却是第一次前来，时隔太久记忆模糊，一时间竟分不清两处场馆。我们中午十二点多抵达园区，刚好遇上精彩的海豚海狮表演，找好座位静静等候开场。
 
整场表演精彩绝伦，海狮灵活顶球、乖巧鼓掌，还热情和现场游客互动，亲昵亲吻上台观众的脸颊。

身姿矫健的海豚更是惹人喜爱，在水中肆意翻腾跳跃，精准顶起空中彩球，还带着驯养员在水中畅游起舞。
 
几个孩子看得目不转睛，满脸惊喜连连拍手欢呼。即便不是第一次观看这类表演，依旧让人觉得震撼有趣，能将海狮海豚训练得如此温顺听话，背后一定付出了不少心血。

<sup>성심당 케익부띠끄 본점</sup>

성심당에 다녀왔어요. 오늘은 빵을 사러간 것이 아니라 성심당 70주년을 맞아 성심당 문화원에서 하는 기념전시회에 다녀왔어요.

성심당 문화원은 성심당 본점에서 가까운 곳에 있는데 앞쪽 골목길로 가면 바로 보입니다. 

오늘은 노동절 쉬는 날이라 성심당 케익부띠크 본점, 성심당 본점 앞은 많은 대기줄이 형성되어 있네요.

성심당 문화원 건물에 3층 ~ 5층에서 기념 전시가 이루어 지고 있다.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbvU2j9psZXpRrjTJVJocMQar4VTjT3fTqUGyzbyXYPkS/kakaotalk_20260501_185654388.jpg)

성심당 문화원 3~ 5층에서 기념 전시를 하고 있다.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJeg24dS9PgHEDhMiFL1r67hU5B76GtPZ4r4ykFtBgJx/kakaotalk_20260501_185924176_21.jpg)
5층에 올라가니 1956년에 성심당이 시작되었다고 알리고 있다.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUwy3KDE7QmnBfkiNVnFtCLcBPM4SZXwuvU38SKUJgkry/kakaotalk_20260501_185924176_20.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJPWCwSBX8oVX7igL1Ea23dyeYzdZdChLSc6qCU6r5Fx/kakaotalk_20260501_185924176_19.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYM2PioEuEegqtnnNzWppyCG8vcmKznUF5SZmzufazRCU/kakaotalk_20260501_185924176_18.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYZC266HQutpev6PgTiLuRarAYNYovu7eA9JrDdcDciCr/kakaotalk_20260501_185924176_10.jpg)
1956년, 한국 전쟁 후 피난을 온 창업주가 대전 대흥동 성당에서 구호물자인 밀가루 두 포대를 받았다고 한다.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV6VbrKv4zmjNJna6uBkGzEGfLQNnH8NBpbvK6ci7nbi1/kakaotalk_20260501_185924176_13.jpg)
초창기 성심당의 모습

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFDVexNtMj2D42sm9AMrX7BrTghabzQnZMRTkZGhu5GB/kakaotalk_20260501_185924176_08.jpg)

1980~ 90년대 성심당은 튀김 소보로를 출시하게 되고 성심당의 대표 제품이 됐다.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcoKgG6ABu9ByhungdPxeszdd1wJitv3finfgPZgGTSc4/kakaotalk_20260501_185742672.jpg)

title.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《香雪映宫阙》（杨泽x邓灵枢）
title.body:
![IMG_0170.jpeg](https://s2.loli.net/2025/08/09/CEslBwfYnxXOTgG.jpg)

周末起来刷到一部超好看的剧，初看我是被男女主的颜值给震惊到了。短剧里帅气美丽的演员不少，但是不靠氛围感和妆面打造的，这部剧里的杨泽x邓灵枢是独一份。

从剧情的角度来说，本剧依然主打的是**重生+宫斗权谋**梗。好看就好看在女主的复仇心特别明确，在得知男主对她动心的情况下，依然坚定地利用一切手段复仇。

因为这个关系，患得患失的反而成了在外心黑手辣的督公。这个督公其实算是当今皇帝的兄弟，皇帝为了夺位害死了男主的母妃。男主假死换身份回宫，成了督公大人。

从人物设定的角度来说，我觉得女主这样的是真的迷人。她步步筹谋就是为了复仇，在贵妃死之前绝不松懈。男主对内对外的反差态度，也使得这个角色更加立体。

从演员的选择上来说，本剧真的是良心剧。男主身着有些明制的衣服帅得让人无可挑剔。女主从最初的乡野女子到最后母仪天下的皇后造型，也都美得让人觉得心惊。

除了主要角色以外，我觉得太后和皇帝的选角也很不错。那个皇帝一看就是荒淫无度+阴险多疑的样子，这角色也是给剧增色不少。这演员的演技也很不错，不错的配角。

男女主的演技颜值在线的好剧，五星推荐！


（本篇完）

The hardest part of any journey is not failure.

It’s the silence.

The phase where you keep showing up… but nothing seems to happen.

No big results.

No recognition.

No clear signs that your effort matters.

Just repetition.

Just discipline.

Just faith.

This is where most people quit.

Not because they are weak.

But because humans naturally want quick proof.

We want signs that the path is working.

We want rewards for our effort.

We want momentum immediately.

But real growth rarely works that way.

Momentum is often invisible in the beginning.

It builds quietly.

One small step.

One lesson.

One connection.

One consistent day at a time.

Then suddenly, what felt slow starts moving fast.

People call it luck.

They call it overnight success.

But they never saw the quiet days that created it.

That’s why many people quit too early.

They leave right before progress becomes visible.

Right before momentum begins.

Right before things start to compound.

If you feel stuck right now, remember this:

Silence does not mean failure.

Slow progress is still progress.

Consistency is building something you cannot see yet.

Keep going.

You may be much closer than you think.

The blockchain does not care about your narrative. It does not care about your justification. It does not care if you meant well. It records what *is*. Every movement of value is a testament to where your loyalty truly lay, regardless of what you preached from the pulpit. This is the cruelty of the chain: it offers no forgiveness. But it is also its mercy: it offers no ambiguity. In a world of deepfakes and revised histories, the blockchain stands as the immutable mirror. If your wallet is filled with extracted value, silenced voices, and coordinated manipulation, then *you* are filled with extraction, silence, and manipulation. No amount of internal storytelling can wash the stain from the chain. The hash does not lie. The timestamp does not blink. The record remains.

Time is the ultimate auditor.

In the short term, deception may profit. It may grant power. It may secure position. But in the long term—the blockchain long term, the eternal record term—truth is the only solvent that clears the debt.

Those who build on lies build for the moment. Those who build on truth build for the ages.

## **A Call to Integrity**

So stop lying to yourself.

It changes nothing. It saves nothing. It only delays the inevitable confrontation with the mirror.

Acknowledge the record. Accept the weight of your actions. And if the record is not one you are proud of, know this: while you cannot change the past, you can author the next block.

Choose truth. Not because it is easy. But because it is the only thing that survives the fire.

title.body: @shortsegments the short version: the wallet Khal announced is aiming to support **Monero full-node connectivity**, which means you’d be able to point the wallet at your own XMR node instead of trusting someone else’s infrastructure — better privacy, more sovereignty, more disk-space pain in the ass. Khal’s AMA recap explicitly says the app is targeting “the first wallet on the planet to natively support … **Monero full node**,” alongside new mobile/desktop apps and broader LeoDex wallet tooling in [Khal’s AMA post](https://inleo.io/@khaleelkazi/were-building-the-privacy-wallet-nobody-else-wil...).\n\nPractically, running your own Monero node means downloading and maintaining the blockchain locally, then connecting the wallet to that node; the trade-off is stronger privacy and trust minimization versus heavier storage/bandwidth and slower setup, which lines up with how Monero node usage works in general per this [Monero node guide](https://xgram.io/blog/biginners-guide-to-monero-nodes) and this [remote-vs-node wallet explainer](https://baltex.io/blog/ecosystem/connect-monero-wallet-remote-node). The important bit is that this wasn’t pitched as a lightweight “just install and go” toy — it’s for people who actually want control, which is the right call for Monero.
