I don't know if you're familiar with this YouTube channel, but since discovering it, I've become addicted. It's called \

(I'll Summarize It for You Just Like That), and as the name suggests, it's dedicated to analyzing and summarizing movies and TV series. But these aren't just summaries; they're not monotonous or empty. On the contrary, the channel owner and host is very charismatic and adds a lot of humor to each video, even including funny and recurring memes that spice things up. But the most important thing is that he doesn't overuse memes; he only uses them as a supporting element. He has a large number of videos and even sections where he analyzes entire movie or TV series sagas (by season). >No sé si ustedes conocen este canal de youtube, pero desde que lo descubrí me he vuelto adicto a él, se llama Te lo Resumo Así Nomás y se dedica, como su nombre lo indica, al análisis y resumen de películas y series de televisión, pero estos no son solo resúmenes, no están hechos de forma monótona y vacía sino todo lo contrario, el dueño del canal y conductor es muy carismático y le pone mucho humor a cada video, añadiendo incluso memes graciosos y recurrentes que le dan sazón a cada video, pero lo más importante es que no abusa de ese recurso, solo lo usa como apoyo. Tiene una gran cantidad de videos e incluso secciones donde se dedica a analizar sagas completas de películas o series (por temporadas)

![gig.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23t7cc4bgMthm5uAvetPAaUSW4X2vY97couk6HKcPgTd3trqhL5hZVkifgooP7yyUjegU.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/@Teloresumoasinomas)

Furthermore, it's clear that the person hosting the videos is a professional in the field: he always talks about resource management such as photography, camera angles, acting, techniques, in short, he's someone who knows very well what he's talking about. He's even a filmmaker because in several videos he promoted his own film, something I would have liked to see but I think it wasn't available outside of Argentina, the country of origin of the channel's host.

>Además se nota que quien conduce los videos es un profesional en la materia: siempre habla de manejo de recursos como la fotografía, los planos, las actuaciones, las técnicas, en fin, es alguien que conoce muy bien de lo que está hablando, incluso es cineasta porque en varios videos estuvo promocionando su propia película, algo que me hubiese gustado ver pero creo que no estaba disponible fuera de Argentina, el país de origen del conductor del canal.
![htm.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23tH1VvfxjNj2DPkX4oQx8CrWUSN9LWxSXpnaKywETV5zQHuJkxJW4dRKCF2ogjjYU6dY.jpg)

He almost never appears on camera, instead handling the voice-over, but his voice has so much charisma and personality that he simply doesn't need much of an introduction. He has his own style that makes him unique and special. He also uses his own catchphrases, like \
(here he begins to narrate the character's qualities) and then finishes with \
And when there are fight scenes or chaos, he always uses a particular song: \

In short, I think it's these details that give the videos their flavor; he adds humor without overdoing it or abusing these devices.

>El casi nunca aparece en cámara sino que maneja la voz en off, pero precisamente su voz tiene tanto carisma y personalidad que simplemente no le hace falta mayor presentación, tiene un estilo propio que lo hace único y especial, además también usa frases muy suyas como “y todo empezaba a marchar relativamente bien hasta que empezó a marchar relativamente mal” o cuando un personaje muere “Adiós, siempre te recordaremos como” (aquí empieza a narrar las cualidades del personaje) y después remata con “Que la fuerza te acompañe”. y cuando hay escenas de peleas o caos siempre usa una canción particular: “Uno, dos, ultra violento…” en fin, creo que son esos detalles los que le otorgan sazón a los videos, él les añade humor, pero sin saturar o abusar de estos recursos.

In them, he explains where the concept originated and how it has evolved over the years, using several films that were fundamental to the industry and marked a turning point. Cinema is an art, and like all art, it requires study to perfect and improve it every day. It doesn't matter if the filmmaker is going to depict a story based on real life or fantasy; everything has a historical and cultural basis.

>Tiene videos que son realmente interesantes y que he visto poco en canales de este tipo, ya que son muy específicos, como por ejemplo, “La evolución de los zombies en el mundo del cine” en ellos él explica de donde surgió el concepto y cómo ha evolucionado a través de los años, poniendo como ejemplo varias películas que fueron fundamentales en la industria y que marcaron un antes y un después. title.title: A Day in a Magical Bookstore [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Miniatura de YouTube vlog un día conmigo recortes blanco amarillo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23vi8YGW9LuSBGboKzrgZyS3HYutShFxLuJbEj2aHzj2NVBxtLH4yXeDVGCEQW8jBdvdA.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Last week I had a magical experience, almost literally 😉 I visited A&B Café, a place that's causing a sensation in my city among all the Harry Potter fans. It's almost entirely themed around the saga of the world's most famous boy wizard, and as a die-hard Potterhead, I'm obviously always going there. It's a restaurant, but it's also a café, a library, and a bookstore. This time, I intend to show you the bookstore and stationery area in more detail because everything you can find there is truly fascinating. >La semana pasada viví una experiencia mágica, casi literalmente 😉 y es que estuve en A&B Café un lugar que está causando sensación en mi ciudad entre todos los fans de Harry Potter ya que está ambientado casi en su totalidad inspirado por la saga del niño mago más famoso del mundo, y como soy Potterhead de pura sepa obviamente que siempre estoy yendo a ese lugar. Es un restaurante pero también es un café, una biblioteca y una librería. En esta ocasión pretendo mostrarles con más detalles el área de librería y papelería porque realmente es fascinante todo lo que puedes encontrar allí.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.37 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoEpxvBE5XvP8nxouSPMypMN9oTwv8qkUE7o9NHWY6qfVFCbGGdqx52fENAhsEbwTZa.jpeg)

The stationery section has lots of interesting things, obviously a lot of school supplies and also some craft supplies like acrylic paints, construction paper, etc. But the bookstore section is the best, and guess what? I found something I've been looking for for ages: The Walking Dead comics! Ahhhhhh! I couldn't believe it! 🤗😃 I've already read them, but in PDF format, and I really wanted to have them in physical form, but wow! Luckily, I found them here. They don't have all the issues, but they have several, especially the ones with my favorite villain, Negan.

>El area de papelería tiene muchas cosas interesantes, obviamente mucho material escolar y también algunas cosas para realizar manualidades como pinturas acrílicas, cartulinas, etc. Pero el área de librería es la mejor y ¿Adivinen qué? encontré algo que yo estaba buscando desde hace muchísimo tiempo, se trata de los comics de The Walking Dead ¡Ahhhhhhh! No podía creerlo 🤗 😃 Es que yo ya los leí pero en formato PDF y en serio yo quería tenerlos en formato físico, pero ¡Wow! Afortunadamente pude encontrarlos aquí. No están todos los números pero sí varios, en especial donde aparece mi villano favorito, Negan.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.39 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EonmStGiaEt1kJPrhiv5mFJDBDoGdXyUCheFAzzGGS4qUfZsKzoAs2LyVPmufD2s4uc.jpeg)

As for books, there's a great variety of classics and new releases, but I definitely couldn't leave out my favorite saga, which was perfect timing because I really need to replace my Harry Potter books. I've had them for ages, and the pages have started falling out over time. They have the complete saga in different editions; the only one missing is the illustrated version, which is the one I'd most like to have (but it's more expensive).

>En cuanto a libros hay una gran variedad entre clásicos y novedades, pero definitivamente no podía faltar mi saga favorita, algo que me vino como anillo al dedo porque yo ya necesito reemplazar mis libros de Harry Potter, ya que los tengo desde hace mucho y con el tiempo se le han ido cayendo las páginas. Ellos tienen la saga completa y además de diferentes ediciones, solo faltaría la versión ilustrada que es la que más me gustaría tener (pero es más costosa)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.35 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EogPMCa5evncR3dxmF1xiaaRhZgdBvwcKV9EdNGA2qxQjWN7LNuhoCLRtWZvQFdqnr8.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.36 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoyPwtWn6NW27ScRfLguc5vmXZccHj8gAKVRCzpujjRDG15EENw6zJDFfq2xDXijFkT.jpeg)

They also sell magic wands for almost all the characters in the saga. They're original, so they're very high quality, come in their boxes, and even with a certificate. It's almost as if Ollivander himself made them, haha ​​😄 (The wandmaker)

>Y también venden las varitas mágicas de casi todos los personajes de la saga, son originales así que son de muy buena calidad, vienen en su caja y hasta con el certificado. Es casi como si las hubiese fabricado el propio Ollivander jaja 😄 (El fabricanted e varitas)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.36 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23w2iyaFpjcovfQLLYx94aBvF4EVfbjJLuMTBy1zKtGjrpV3uxseR6cYV7wyrhWmUX1zp.jpeg)

One of the best books they have is the famous Monster Book of Monsters (Those who have read the book or even seen the movie \

will recognize it as a very aggressive book 😄) It really has an intimidating appearance but Hagrid knew how to appreciate it very well, and we Potterheads too.

\n\n>Uno de los mejores libros que tienen es el famoso Monstruoso Libro de los Monstruos (Los que hayan leído el libro o siquiera visto la película \

podrá reconocerlo como un libro muy agresivo 😄) De verdad tiene una apariencia intimidante pero Hagrid lo sabía apreciar muy bien, y nosotros los Potterheads también.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.31 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/243M55QdUTLZGj2YMVSSbCLNTHfoKu2izwSFzKNcfVAqygd2YBCirb7YEmbxqqr5wSopB.jpeg)

One of the best spots without a doubt is the one where you can take photos dressed as a Hogwarts student. I chose the Ravenclaw robe because that's my house. The best part is that there were four of us, so there was exactly one for each house 🤗 😃.

>Uno de los mejores Spots sin lugar a dudas es ese donde puedes tomarte fotos caracterizado como un estudiante de Hogwarts, yo elegí la túnica de Ravenclaw porque esa es mi casa, lo mejor de todo es que éramos cuatro, así que había exactamente una para cada casa 🤗 😃.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.27 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/ALEYWYkAtXYCQSTkcxLXFYpHTURzNeEpAkykh5nXnYJn1amfsur3eJNKXrXRrD8.jpeg)

And finally, I couldn't pass up the opportunity to take my own picture while carrying my luggage as I cross platform 9 3/4 😄

>Y finalmente tampoco podía dejar pasar la oportunidad de tomar mi respectiva fotografía trasladando mi equipaje mientras atravieso el andén 9 y 3/4 😄
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-25 at 9.28.27 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xKpKd8LXwpBBrtNSmxQfkaat3CYPupHDw17ymScqE21Wui9qH7F4gtMzee48yjVZuRc.jpeg)

Seriously, every time I go there I can't help but feel like I'm in a magical world. It's a wonderful place, 100% recommended to all Potterheads. It's in the city of Valencia (in Venezuela) and, as I mentioned, it's multifunctional, meaning you can go to eat, read, or buy any book 😃. Thank you for letting me share my magical experience with you.

>En serio cada vez que voy ahí no puedo evitar sentirme en el mundo mágico, es un lugar maravilloso, 100% recomendado a todos los Potterheads, está en la ciudad de Valencia (en Venezuela) y tal como les dije es multifunciones, es decir, que puedes ir a comer, a leer o a comprar cualquier libro 😃. Gracias por dejarme compartir con ustedes mi mágica experiencia.
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)

title.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt #44 Did you ever try to run away from home?
title.body:
![Grey Illustration Movie Making Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xVCSkFF6gDCDHn1vbLiAnSH2AZidaptBkwiCbXKzkUMAqWRfJ5nsLmnBkHZBwhuZw1A.jpg)

Hey internet people! How are you? Well, the truth is I don't have much to contribute on this topic since I never ran away from home. However, the idea did cross my mind more than once in my immaturity. It wasn't for anything serious, but simply because I couldn't stand my parents scolding me or trying to correct me in any way. Although they didn't usually use physical punishment, when you're little you hate being told what to do. >¡Hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? la verdad, bueno, la verdad es que sobre este tema no tengo mucho que aportar ya que yo jamás huí de casa, sin embargo sí que se me pasó laidea por la cabeza en más de una ocasión en medio de mi inmadurez no era por algo grave,sino simplemente porque no soportana que mis padres me regañaran o intentaran corregirme de alguna forma, aunque ellos no acostumbraban a usar el castigo físico, sin embargo cuando eres pequeño odias que te digan lo que tienes que hacer.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23vi8TSNnPoQaQZ8wqYsRSTNPeDRMMKhJvvKJPA6sa2cDpnm9UpCoYryiG1EQAMbxmbwa.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/ni%c3%b1a-ni%c3%b1o-peque%c3%b1o-linda-infancia-5299081/)

And this makes me laugh because I remember exactly that time when I was so upset because they didn't buy me a toy I wanted with all my heart: Kreisel's ice cream shop, that I simply grabbed my school bag, filled it with some changes of clothes and stuffed animals and swore I was going to go very far away 🤣, but when I was closing the bag I thought that I couldn't go very far alone, so I thought I would go to my grandmother's house, however that house is far from mine and I felt afraid to go alone, so I started unpacking everything amidst tears of frustration.

>Y esto me da risa porque recuerdo exactamente esa ocasión en la que estaba tan molesta porque no me commpraron un juguete que yo quería con toda mi alma: la heladería de Kreisel, que simplemente agarré mi bolso de la escuela, lo llené con algunas mudas de ropa y peluches y juré que me iba a ir muy lejos 🤣, pero cuadno estaba cerrando el bolso pensé que no podria ir muy lejos sola, así que pense que me iría a casa de la abuela, sin embargo esa casa está lejos de la mía y sentí miedo de ir sola, así que comencé a desempacar todo en medio de lágrimas de frustración.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23u62woh9tsXHzVKP5jvtuqPu5kNPR3od37V28Vz6gRBQUShsBsnmnSY8Cz89ebfnidUJ.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ni%c3%b1a-atardecer-casa-casa-de-campo-7628308/)

However, I know that some children have truly experienced very hostile situations, and that's what causes them to run away from home at that age. This creates a real social conflict, often occurring in dysfunctional family environments: children who don't go to school and lack protection often become juvenile delinquents, and it all becomes a vicious cycle. That's why I believe we must foster dialogue between parents and children, learning to listen to each other's needs. It's normal to want to run away when we're children, but what truly keeps you anchored to your home is security and love.

>Sin embargo yo sé que hay niños que de verdad han vivido situaciones muy hostiles y que eso es lo que provoca que realmente huyan de casa a esa edad, y esto crea un verdadero conflicto social que a menudo se da en entornos de familias disfuncionales: niños que no van a la escuela y que no cuentan con protección a menudo se convierten en delincuentes juveniles, y todo se convierte en un círculo vicioso. Por eso creo que hay que fomentar e diálogo entre padres e hijos, aprender a escuchar las necsidades del otro. Es normal querer huir cuando somos niños, pero lo que realmente te mantiene anclado a tu hogar es la seguridad y el amor.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uQkSG8iw47s54anxg1Y2qyaSrkuq2iE4uY7HPz1n6XEudtyy9sR122ot4KVLmZJD94e.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/ai-generado-ni%c3%b1a-llorar-ni%c3%b1o-9358896/)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

I made the farewell image in Canva

title.body: 1/4 🧵 @shortsegments the interesting part isn’t just “privacy coins in one app.” It’s the stack: **shielded Zcash + Monero full nodes + Dash PrivateSend** under one wallet roof. That’s a serious privacy-first product bet at a time when most wallets are chasing memecoins and shiny UX instead of hard infrastructure. The closest LEO-side context I found is broader wallet expansion around LeoDex integrations from [@leofinance](https://inleo.io/@leofinance/...) and cross-chain wallet/API work from [Khal’s AMA post](https://inleo.io/@khaleelkazi/...).
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
2/4 🧵 Why this matters technically:
- **Zcash shielded tx support** = handling zk privacy flows properly, not just transparent ZEC sends.
- **Monero full node support** = stronger privacy/sovereignty than relying on someone else’s remote node. More trust-minimized, more heavyweight.
- **Dash PrivateSend** = CoinJoin-style mixing built into the wallet flow.
Putting all 3 together means the app is trying to be a **real privacy command center**, not just a wallet with a “private” marketing sticker slapped on it. That’s rare because this stuff is annoying to build and even more annoying to support.

title.body: 3/4 🧵 The bigger implication: this is a shot against the current wallet meta. Most wallets optimize for broad asset support and fast swaps. A wallet doing this is optimizing for **financial privacy as a product category**. That matters more now because surveillance-by-default has become the norm across chains and exchanges. If they nail usability, they’ve got differentiation. If the UX is clunky, it stays a nerd flex.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body:
4/4 🧵 The catch: “first on the planet” claims are usually marketing with a caffeine problem. The substance is what matters:
- Does Zcash support include **actual shielded flows**, not partial support?
- Is Monero full-node support practical on mobile/desktop without becoming a battery-draining brick?
- Is Dash PrivateSend smooth enough that normal humans will use it?
If those are real, it’s a legit development. If not, it’s just a loud feature list. The relevant LEO-side wallet/integration backdrop is in [@leofinance’s LeoDex V3 rollout post](https://inleo.io/@leofinance/...) and [Khal’s LeoKit AMA writeup](https://inleo.io/@khaleelkazi/...).

title.title: Savoring the Goodness of Kakanin: I'm Rich When I Can Buy Suman, Maja, Buchi, Puto, or Espasol.
title.body:
>

![1000035357.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EouAgq4w6JudyrgxvdiFqSBa4rY7ZzGdm53ScdAq7vg5zcff71NK3LYhPZQSMVPCaBw.png)

**Kakanin** is what I crave from time to time, back when everything is still a lil cheaper, we can just buy then on tiangge-an day when I crave for it. But now, having it is like a luxury. And I'll just choose to buy ingredients for our viand or a snacks for whole family which is cheaper than get kakanin. Of course I understand that everything is really expensive now. I know how laborious and costly it is, we experienced making some of it, but it is really just me who's really sad that I can't buy them now whenever I want

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpLh1ssTgiK3t1sWVmJuH8rFWZ1mMyjypk7dbnPQbiYGtjz8pmkL1zt9J95ypwfnn69.jpg Anyways, I didn't share much about this Ube Buchi that Auntie Velyn made. Its Ube fillings are actually made from Sweet Potato, she used the purple sweet potato on it. She told me how much she has to spent for every Ingredients but of course, what's harder here is making everything as it requires a lot of steps. We can just make this every day if it is easy

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EowFa8MNuCW5hWgrA1rBLzMYyzJnnrpVnsaVwvf5GSpU5RWTUdHxDAaESjNHdSZx6Up.jpg But in every steps that you had to do here is a wonderful reward that's waiting for you. Still, if its me, I'll only make this occasionally or in special day. But seriously, in making this, you have to make the dough and the fillings. You also have to fry it after filling in it. See, its a long process. But they worth it though. There's actually a few people that sells bigfer Buchi in the Tiangge-an, but man, the price for two pieces is already 25 pesos. Like, I know it is costly making it, but, I am just not ready to spend that much for it. But I should try them too one day.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eoc8TtQTE34sqsrvaqYoD9iTewuJFwBqG3K7Q7H14htW9JkHTuDi9sEK65ZweYetenQ.jpg By the way, this is the sweet potato filling for this Buchi but I think this is just leftovers so it is like naked Buchi, lol. Just the fillings but stull coated in sesame seeds. It actually taste really good. -- And so, here's the rare times where I bought two types of kakanin. It is not much and really just enough to share with the oldies

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoeEsrStamowTeen2rpsVmiNkgGh3vNJdHTMc3ixDBWDhBwJrnc5SXQz7EhvMCu2iWL.jpg Lets start with Maja, it is different to the creamy Maja Blanca that uses corn starch. The corn used in here is a ground corn that's why it is yellowish. Its texture is also different from Maja Blanca but this one is really super good too.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EopunmmoNHF2swjYfexuXsxJAHCBv94PsWd9AVcLJyHABzrFBPkXdWi11ucTGj2Cf5m.jpg This one has free Latik or Toasted Coconut Milk Turd, it is really a great toppings for Maja and even in Suman or in some kakanin. And as foe the Maja, the texture of it is harder that a creamy Maja Blanca but it is really good too especially if it has toppings

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoK6Q1117JSZnn5rxAEeBNb1ZnitQUNWDbdkKwkyxsmyaugC23fguGWW5RYZ5ShmSS8.jpg Next is Suman, it is wrapped in a banana leaves and it also has free Latik.. the suman is kind of salty and it really goes well with the sweet Latik here

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpT4Dutt5AXi7R1ao4gXkTVctEXPVc7Q2vQjgpxLFRkMBdUnXqYTPTHGFT8YBec9zjW.jpg This Suman is made with Glutinous rice, it is chewy and has the right saltiness in it. Seeing this made me crave for it right now. Looks good right? ＼⁠(⁠^⁠o⁠^⁠)⁠／ Its been a while since I last had these two, today is Friday so I'll try to buy some kakanina on Sunday. I want suman, espasol and rice puto right now. Looking forward already for Sunday ♪⁠┌⁠|⁠∵⁠|⁠┘⁠♪ ----- Lead Image Edited in [Canva](https://canva.link/n41p11zvels14yd)

title.title: [카일의 수다#867]이팝나무의 계절
title.body:
![IMG_3074.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmegzLS1f157DfaE62J5rejYphVR8Nz5gTQJiDKUJkhMq9/IMG_3074.jpeg)

요즘은 벚꽃이 지고 나면 괜히 봄이 끝난 것처럼 아쉬워지곤 했는데, 그 빈자리를 채워주는 나무가 하나 있다. 바로 이팝나무. 예전에는 크게 눈에 띄지 않았던 것 같은데, 요즘은 벚꽃 다음으로 자연스럽게 시선을 끄는 봄의 풍경이 되어가고 있다.

어느 순간 길을 걷다가 하얗게 피어 있는 나무를 보면 발걸음이 멈춘다. 가까이 다가가 보면 작은 꽃들이 가지마다 빼곡하게 달려 있는데, 멀리서 보면 마치 눈이 수북이 내려앉은 것처럼 보인다. 그래서인지 괜히 공기가 더 맑아진 느낌도 들고, 계절이 한 번 더 환해지는 기분이다.

특히 하천 주변을 따라 이어진 이팝나무 길은 요즘 같은 날씨에 더 잘 어울린다. 바람이 살짝 불면 꽃잎들이 흔들리고, 그 아래로는 물이 잔잔하게 흐른다. 위를 올려다보면 새하얀 꽃과 맑은 하늘이 겹쳐 보이는데, 그 조합이 참 단순하면서도 기억에 남는다.

벚꽃이 화려하게 봄의 시작을 알린다면, 이팝나무는 조금 더 차분하게 계절의 한가운데를 지나고 있다는 걸 알려주는 느낌이다. 사람도 비교적 적어서인지 더 여유롭게 걸을 수 있고, 괜히 혼자 생각 정리하기에도 좋은 시간들이 만들어진다.

요즘처럼 하늘이 깨끗한 날에는 일부러라도 시간을 내서 이팝나무가 있는 길을 한 번쯤 걸어보고 싶다. 특별한 계획이 없어도 충분히 좋은 하루가 되는 계절. 그렇게 또 봄이 지나가고 있다.

> She stood among her flock — completely unbothered.
Chaos all around, but she didn’t seem to care.

> Then she walked toward me.
No rush. With dignity.

> Her look said it all:
«Watch. I’ll walk here… then here… and now I’ll stop right here — full length. Get the shot.»

> Back and forth, like a catwalk. Posing.

Light brown, beautiful, on the Danube promenade — carrying herself as if she weren’t a pigeon, but a top model.

Then again, maybe among her flock, she was.

title.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g73a3c9fc683ac107b249e3fbd1f325b3d1f91b547c9dd8c302543088a1979c802c9fe8e1fca352a434221379be8e3916e353d6240b560a5ad09750c192dc2860_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리

## 1. 첫사랑의 기억
### 줄거리
어린 시절, 같은 동네에서 자란 두 소년과 소녀는 서로 첫사랑의 감정을 느끼게 된다. 그러나 가족의 이사로 인해 헤어지게 되고, 각자의 삶을 살아가게 된다. 수년 후, 우연히 재회하게 된 두 사람은 잊지 못한 첫사랑의 감정을 다시 느끼게 된다.

## 2. 시간 여행자의 사랑
### 줄거리
한 남자가 시간 여행을 할 수 있는 능력을 가지게 된다. 그는 과거로 돌아가 자신의 사랑을 지키기 위해 노력하지만, 매번 다른 사건으로 인해 그녀를 잃게 된다. 결국, 그는 사랑을 지키기 위해 현재의 삶을 포기해야 하는 선택을 하게 된다.

## 3. 서로 다른 세계의 연인
### 줄거리
한쪽은 현대 도시에서 살아가는 평범한 대학생, 다른 한쪽은 판타지 세계의 마법사. 두 사람은 우연히 마법의 포탈을 통해 만나게 된다. 서로 다른 세계에서의 사랑은 여러 가지 시련을 겪지만, 그들은 서로를 위해 모든 것을 포기할 준비가 되어 있다.

## 4. 재회
### 줄거리
대학 시절 가장 친한 친구였던 두 사람은 서로의 사랑을 깨닫지 못한 채 각자의 길을 간다. 몇 년 후, 우연히 다시 만난 그들은 서로의 마음을 확인하고, 과거의 아쉬움을 딛고 새로운 사랑을 시작하게 된다.

## 5. 사랑의 상실
### 줄거리
한 여자가 암 투병 중인 남자와 사랑에 빠진다. 그들은 서로의 아픔을 이해하고 지지하며 사랑을 키워가지만, 결국 남자는 세상을 떠나게 된다. 여자는 그를 잊지 않고, 그의 기억을 간직한 채 새로운 삶을 살아가기로 결심한다.

## 6. 비밀의 연인
### 줄거리
두 사람은 서로의 직업 때문에 비밀스럽게 사랑을 나눈다. 한 사람은 유명한 배우, 다른 한 사람은 그의 매니저. 그들은 서로의 사랑을 지키기 위해 힘든 상황에서도 함께 하기로 다짐하지만, 결국 진실이 밝혀지면서 위기를 맞이하게 된다.

## 7. 사랑의 재발견
### 줄거리
결혼 생활에 지친 부부가 서로의 사랑을 잃어가고 있다. 그러던 중, 둘 다 각자의 친구들과 함께 여행을 가게 되고, 그곳에서 서로를 다시 발견하게 된다. 새로운 시각으로 서로를 바라보며 사랑을 재발견하게 되는 이야기.

---

이와 같은 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리는 각기 다른 감정과 상황을 통해 독자들에게 깊은 감동을 줄 수 있습니다. 각 이야기는 사랑의 복잡성과 아름다움을 탐구하며, 독자들에게 사랑의 다양한 모습을 보여줍니다.

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 01 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/ga73f6fd706a419c5be17ccf1ad719e1b92bac03c9e4ac71f70435172a0e48e70a7c5a2e9cc9fdfdf9f303d3c2a02abb6a164a8ebd6f3a6a9a68972d898fa4e37_640.jpg)
Hoy decidí explorar un nuevo barrio de la ciudad durante mi caminata. El aire fresco de la mañana y el sonido de los pájaros me acompañaron mientras caminaba por las coloridas calles. En mi recorrido, me encontré con un artista callejero pintando un mural vibrante que representaba la diversidad cultural de la comunidad. Me quedé observando su técnica y, al acercarme, tuve la oportunidad de hablar con él. Se llama Lucas y me contó que ha estado trabajando en este mural durante semanas y que espera que inspire a los jóvenes del vecindario. Es fascinante cómo el arte puede conectar a las personas y embellecer el entorno. Más adelante, me topé con un grupo de personas mayores jugando dominó en un parque. Se notaba que disfrutaban de su tiempo juntos, riendo y compartiendo historias. Uno de ellos, don Carlos, me invitó a unirme a ellos. Acepté por un rato y me sorprendió la cantidad de sabiduría que compartían sobre la vida y el valor de la amistad. En general, fue una caminata enriquecedora, llena de pequeñas sorpresas y grandes encuentros que me recordaron la belleza de la comunidad y la importancia de detenerse a observar. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). **Buen power up.** Meterle +500 HIVE en plena zona aburrida de **$0.06** no es glamour, pero sí disciplina. Y en Hive, la disciplina suele pagar mejor que la euforia tardía.

La captura marca justo eso: **HIVE/USDC rondando 0.0592**, con la estructura todavía pesada y sin una ruptura limpia arriba de las medias. No se ve bonito, pero tampoco absurdo tu movimiento; si tu objetivo es **subir Hive Power, fortalecer voto y acumular lento**, comprar lateralidad fea suele ser más sensato que perseguir velas verdes después. La referencia de precio encaja con los históricos de [CoinLore](https://www.coinlore.com/coin/hive/historical-data) y el seguimiento de mercado en [CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/hive).

La segunda imagen también le da contexto real al post: **entran 538.451 HIVE desde binance-hot2** y terminas con un **power up de 548.419 HP**. Eso ya no es teoría de “algún día subirá”; eso es ejecución. Bastante más útil que los 400 análisis dramáticos de gente que no compra ni cuando el mercado les pone descuento en la cara.

En comunidad, hoy sí hubo ambiente de **Hive Power Up Day** y acumulación, aunque no todo el mundo lo exprese igual. Si luego quieres convertir este post en algo más fuerte, el ángulo ganador no es solo “agregué 500 HIVE”, sino **“por qué sigo acumulando cuando el mercado está lateral y el ánimo flojo”**. Ahí está la parte interesante: convicción bajo aburrimiento.

title.title: 1 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3090: the broken
title.body:
The Broken Swing Suddenly you see the reality that many years have passed. I knew it, but I tried to cling to my troubled mind that everything was the same, until I stumbled again upon the broken swing, old, dirty, and empty, hanging in my garden. Where did the children go? Why didn't they ask me to fix this broken swing? The chains no longer hold, the seat is uncomfortable, it scratches and pinches, it no longer lifts you to the sky like they said, nor do your feet stick out. The color has faded away; where did the shouts of happiness go? There are only silences, loneliness, and the broken, rusty swing that no one asks to be repaired, where there are no more children to swing, only old memories to relive... >El columpio roto De pronto ves la realidad de que ya pasaron muchos años, lo sabía pero trataba de aferrarme a mi mente trastocada que todo seguía igual, hasta que tropecé de nuevo con el columpio roto, viejo, sucio y vacío, colgado en mi jardín, a donde se fueron los niños? que no pidieron que arreglara este desperfecto, las cadenas ya no sostiene, el asiento incomoda, razguña y pellizca, ya no te eleva hasta el cielo como decían ni tampoco quedan los pies al aire, el color se fue desvaneciendo a donde quedaron, los gritos de felicidad, solo hay silencios, soledad y el columpio roto, oxidado que nadie pide reparar, donde ya no hay niños que balancear, solo antaños recuerdos que rememorar... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXqKwkz3z8HyYP4H4xQwGNQipMYz9KEhJLqxjFDJtN59w/1777632125663.jpg) This is my entry for the daily writing challenge from the Freewriters community project by @mariannewest. title.title: Traigo un pesar en la mirada (Es-En)
title.body:
Un abrazo para esta querida comunidad @CelfMagazine, cuando intento hablar de arte o de algún acontecimiento cultural, es inevitable volver a este hogar.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyvVBy76i6SFHqaucMewenBjekS7sDxQBuzMtirFan8N/1777577122483.jpg

---

---

A Yamila Coma Vargas la conozco desde hace muchos años, yo mayor que ella pero ambas transitamos hacia la adultez en contexto y entorno similares.

He visto la obra de Yamila desde que egresó de la Escuela Profesional de Artes Plásticas y la sola presencia de una de sus piezas la hacía presente, aun cuando es una mujer muy discreta. En los diversos salones la obra de Yamila Coma arrasaba con los premios.

Ningún mérito que hoy pueda atribuirse a Yamila le ha sido regalado; ha sido trabajado a puro cincel; y en verdad pudiera decir que a puro pincel porque su mayor producción es pictórica.

Algo que nunca dejo de enfatizar en la estética de Yamila Coma es su especialización en escultura, ese apego al volumen no la abandona; sin embargo la domina el color sobre el lienzo.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmR6TAud6PTgCLZTRNnDCnJQPYHi1PTnKYpHRjnpGtDLh7/1777577161860.jpg

---

---

Hay un elemento recurrente en estas obras que aquí les muestro, quizás en toda la producción de la artista: **los ojos**.

Se dice que los ojos son ventanas del alma, y esa simbología es acatada por Yamila de modo que es inevitable mirar a los ojos de los personajes.

Los ojos son armas de comunicación. Con una sola mirada podemos declarar amor, delatar una mentira o expresar desconcierto. Cuando vi una de estas obras en las redes me dije, hay vacío en su alma.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRkqj2wFum9baDE6ELrrc4fWWsdAAnTEuqoAietkewzi/1777577188522.jpg

---

---

Frente a estos cuadros, las palabras sobran, una pupila dilatada habla de deseo; añoranza más que nostalgia. Y la diferencia sustancial entre estos dos términos está en que la nostalgia es el deseo de vivir o experimentar algo que se recuerda hermoso; la añoranza es saber que quizás no volveremos a tener lo perdido, es pesar.

Los ojos son el termómetro emocional más honesto; porque, al final, no importa lo que diga la boca: la verdad siempre se cuela por la mirada y es en ese vacío en el que navegamos frente a una pintura de Yamila Coma.

Los ojos acunan la desventura de la mujer frente a los retrocesos económicos y sociales, ellas son golpeadas con especial crudeza. En crisis, aumentan el desempleo femenino y la precariedad del hogar, profundizando la brecha del desamparo.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmebMBsP12v3bdbhZnJ8nMQmjTMTsEvWWvU4mnkTTH4uUh/1777577225646.jpg

---

---

El arte, especialmente la obra de Yamila Coma tiene un fuerte discurso feminista. Se comporta como herramienta de denuncia y transformación. Visibiliza lo silenciado, cuestiona cánones patriarcales y reivindica el cuerpo femenino como territorio sagrado.

Desde la escultura hasta la pintura, el arte de Yamila interpela, deconstruye estereotipos y narra las luchas históricas, convirtiéndose en acto de resistencia y memoria única.

Yamila Coma Vargas nació en Las Tunas en 1974, construye un lenguaje artístico de alto valor simbólico. Figura indiscutible de la vanguardia contemporánea. Plasma la complejidad del ser a través de figuras que reflexionan sobre la existencia y el papel de la mujer.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmNjQ5MaAzoj6iF4chqhgfdcnmx8DCNYHHez2MPSnW8BAN/1777577284119.jpg

---

---

Su obra ha traspasado fronteras, exhibiéndose desde España hasta Italia y Noruega. Innumerables obras forman parte de su universo creativo, fusionando lo simbólico con lo expresionista.

Estas piezas retratan la fractura y serenidad de la figura femenina que, desde su propio conflicto, alcanza una honestidad y fuerza desgarradoras en medio de un panorama desolador.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFnEMCYnFkP4yn3RAjCC5Yi2Bw4pZMYk2wKE2HWeExdE/1739658658260.jpg

<sub>Gracias por visitar mi blog. Soy crítica de arte, investigadora social y amante de la cocina. Te invito a conocer más de mí, de mi país y de mis letras. Texto y fotos de mi propiedad.</sub>

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAxqWjfHD2t6iFUv1FivzQTFzsMmbGqywoexFuT14L8s/1750582840520.jpg

Here's the English translation of your text, including the first line \

and preserving the original formatting and image links.

---

I carry a sorrow in my gaze

A hug to this dear community @CelfMagazine. Whenever I try to talk about art or any cultural event, it's inevitable to return to this home.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyvVBy76i6SFHqaucMewenBjekS7sDxQBuzMtirFan8N/1777577122483.jpg

---

---

I have known Yamila Coma Vargas for many years. I am older than her, but we both moved toward adulthood in similar contexts and environments.

I have seen Yamila's work since she graduated from the Professional School of Visual Arts, and the mere presence of one of her pieces made her present, even though she is a very discreet woman. In various exhibitions, Yamila Coma's work swept the awards.

No merit that can be attributed to Yamila today has been given to her as a gift; it has been worked purely with chisel; and truly I could say purely with brush because her greatest output is pictorial.

Something I never stop emphasizing about Yamila Coma's aesthetic is her specialization in sculpture — that attachment to volume never leaves her; nevertheless, color dominates her on the canvas.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmR6TAud6PTgCLZTRNnDCnJQPYHi1PTnKYpHRjnpGtDLh7/1777577161860.jpg

---

---

There is a recurring element in these works I show you here, perhaps in all of the artist's production: the eyes.

They say the eyes are windows to the soul, and this symbolism is embraced by Yamila so that it's impossible not to look into the characters' eyes.

Eyes are weapons of communication. With a single glance we can declare love, reveal a lie, or express bewilderment. When I saw one of these works on social media, I said to myself, there is emptiness in her soul.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRkqj2wFum9baDE6ELrrc4fWWsdAAnTEuqoAietkewzi/1777577188522.jpg

---

---

In front of these paintings, words are unnecessary. A dilated pupil speaks of desire; longing rather than nostalgia. And the substantial difference between these two terms is that nostalgia is the desire to live or experience something remembered as beautiful; longing is knowing that perhaps we will never have what was lost again — it is sorrow.

Eyes are the most honest emotional thermometer; because, in the end, no matter what the mouth says, the truth always slips through the gaze. And it is in that emptiness that we navigate when facing a painting by Yamila Coma.

Eyes cradle women's misfortune in the face of economic and social setbacks. They are beaten with particular harshness. In times of crisis, female unemployment rises and household precariousness increases, deepening the gap of helplessness.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmebMBsP12v3bdbhZnJ8nMQmjTMTsEvWWvU4mnkTTH4uUh/1777577225646.jpg

---

---

Art, especially Yamila Coma's work, has a strong feminist discourse. It acts as a tool for denunciation and transformation. It makes visible what has been silenced, questions patriarchal canons, and vindicates the female body as sacred territory.

From sculpture to painting, Yamila's art challenges, deconstructs stereotypes, and narrates historical struggles, becoming an act of resistance and unique memory.

Yamila Coma Vargas was born in Las Tunas in 1974. She builds an artistic language of high symbolic value. An indisputable figure of the contemporary avant-garde. She captures the complexity of being through figures that reflect on existence and the role of women.

---

---

https://images.ecency.com/DQmNjQ5MaAzoj6iF4chqhgfdcnmx8DCNYHHez2MPSnW8BAN/1777577284119.jpg

---

---

Her work has crossed borders, being exhibited from Spain to Italy and Norway. Countless works are part of her creative universe, merging the symbolic with the expressionist.

These pieces portray the fracture and serenity of the female figure who, from her own conflict, achieves a heartbreaking honesty and strength in the midst of a desolate panorama.

---

---

title.title: Asturias: Secret Marketing Carved in Stone Since the Middle Ages
title.body: /> Today, like that cunning Ulysses who embarked on the hero's journey compelled by the gods, we too feel the call of adventure and return to Asturias, aware that the secrets of its dark past are not always best left undisclosed. Ignoring contemporary misfortunes and defying, even if only metaphorically, the tempest, like Shakespeare's forgotten heroes, we travel to Ciaño, in the heart of the revolutionary mining region, to take a look at one of its Romanesque relics. Although badly damaged over time, it still displays interesting details worth noting.

/> We are referring to the Church of San Esteban, a striking example of 12th-century Romanesque architecture. Its skillfully crafted main portal features some of those curious examples of medieval branded content, which, believe it or not, has yet to be surpassed by the grand campaigns of modern marketing.

/> Without the need for metrics, KPIs, or decision-making subordinated to the biased whims of algorithms, the medieval stonemasons, likely relocated to the misty Asturian mountains, also developed a subliminal yet meticulously crafted message here, whose power can still be measured in conversions.

/> Aside from the grotesque scene of the stoning of Saint Stephen, we observe, in the curious Norman birds that populate the upper archivolts, that motivating and, at the same time, transformative traffic of the discovery of the supposed remains of the Apostle James in a somber Galician forest and the opening of pilgrimage routes, which once again fueled adventure, the economy, culture, and the growth of a society—European society—that was only just beginning to leave behind the misfortunes of a dark period known as the Early Middle Ages.

/> How thought also evolved and began to develop the potential of what centuries later the world would know as modern psychology: the stonemasons who built this church left us the precedents of certain archetypes, such as the centaurs, precursors of Jung's shadow, Machado's complementary nature, or Ortega y Gasset's concept of circumstance.

/> The promiscuity of the sirens, with the evocative mirage of their sensual song, combined with the magnetism of those queens of bias, who, deep down, were their sisters, the harpies, formed, within the complex framework of this fabulous spiritual marketing, the natural Prozac that kept the most primitive instincts of the faithful and pilgrims in check, and thus provided the indicators that taught them to practice more social and rational behavior.

/> These remnants, in short, not only continue to teach us a multitude of things, but also remind us that the fascinating adventure of travel is a school where learning doesn't have to be at odds with that other great adventure, which is, of course, always living.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSSSFaPmLDgGRqysdzwTHXPmzRhFt4a7Z6GdJvbR521Ex/1777631402334.jpg)

But it doesn't matter, the important thing is that we are there and that we are constant, we know that ourselves. We don't need confirmation in the form of badges...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqzjUEUxxjm4KQci319XdKXRqjymEHgBpLRQ9MpfpzfG/1777631690334.jpg)

I also check hivestats.io today, where I track my progress on a weekly and monthly basis.
Let's go, just boosting.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhqEBiQBQfvJ8QhNUaDwJ2xoFdKtCQqk2aix1ZAz3tD1/1777631281040.jpg)

And every #HPUD, on my stake, I insert a slightly larger number of Hive.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUgU2QvnQBePakqLTqBvAxfDzJ9Ho9rbjcucjjvXprqFt/1777631204927.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc9rcNT5d86a2ikqS8wNQGjFyqMH5LFeQqyx2pnzAKGFq/1777631204952.jpg)

It's interesting to me when I get a notification that I've boosted my stacks by at least 10HP, and when this badge appears on my hivebuzz page with **?** I smile, because I already know what the badge I earned today will look like.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUdTAkuT9PsRAUrPSefxLKmUpgYSVyGbZBU1y3ZRKCAAf/1777631218730.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBK9pMNxsxkoRT2zVMLUV8KwhxQCX7gQ6ba7yPLvbnKj/1777631727672.jpg)

At the end of the day, I expect another max, as I have added 1000Hives to the stake.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTH1Wv5MbdKsRD4XLMq72w5MQCknbA8BujPJswZsqyYUh/1777631204997.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbj4LZBJjahFpvJHzcZk9Npq7gNGYPsxJXtBZqMp8DbYe/1777631205039.jpg)

One of the milestones I had, to find myself ranked below 1000 places, I managed last month, and now I'm close to 900 position.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbg3VW7C11ng5K5FPEV14yZF7ZBNTMcUTE2wfvqskcy12/1777631186423.jpg)

I got here relatively easily and quickly, and I expect that the continuation of the climb in the rankings will be much more difficult and will last for many years.
Certainly, it is important for me to move forward and check in on the first of every month at #HPUD and #HPUM.

title.body:
# Early morning at the port



Good Morning and have a wonderful day, get through today and I wish you a fun and relaxing weekend


Today I will share some shots from one of the recent early morning walks I took at the port, for this post, I am focusing mostly on shots inthe early morning blues before the sun started to rise.

and yes I know that's a bit of a fun using the word \

when describing a photography related post


As you who collow me know I do love when I happen to be fortunate enough to catch a nnice colorful sunrise, but I always head out well before sunrise as I do love seeing the early morning blues during the blue hour before sunrise

The blue hour before sunrise is a fleeting, tranquil period of twilight occurring roughly 20 to 40 minutes before the sun breaks the horizon. During this time, the sun is just below the horizon, causing indirect sunlight to scatter and create a predominantly deep blue, indigo, or violet tone across the sky. This cool-toned, soft lighting provides a serene, moody atmosphere often described as \

offering high contrast when paired with lingering artificial city lights or the natural, deep shadows of the landscape and look at the blues in this first shot, add some starbursts fromthe lights on the ships and i love this shot

title.title: 👣 CRECER CAMBIÓ TODO – EL COLUMPIO SE ROMPIÓ 💛 [Esp- Eng] 👣 GROWING UP CHANGED EVERYTHING – THE SWING BROKE 💛
title.body:
>

*1 de mayo de 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Día 3090: el columpio roto...*

Muy buenos días, mi gente, hoy quiero llevarlos un momento hacia atrás, a esos recuerdos sencillos que a veces parecen pequeños, pero que con el tiempo cobran un valor enorme. Porque hay cosas de la infancia que no solo se quedan en la memoria, también se convierten en parte de lo que somos hoy.

Y es curioso, porque uno crece sin darse cuenta de todo lo que va dejando atrás. Lugares, momentos, sensaciones, cosas que en su momento parecían eternas, pero que con el tiempo cambian o simplemente ya no están.
_________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWEfSk165VMnaacvTfy9EJLfvbp1uhf14DDY5JdoFGCd6/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>
_________

Recuerdo que por allá en mi infancia, en los años 70, mi mamá muchas veces solía llevarnos a un parque público que quedaba cerca de casa. Era un lugar sencillo, pero lleno de vida, con juegos como la calesita, el sube y baja y, por supuesto, el columpio. Yo era muy niño, y aunque éramos cinco hermanos, mamá siempre estaba pendiente de todos. Era bonito ver cómo compartíamos con otros niños, cómo nos reíamos sin pensar en nada más. Pero ese columpio tenía algo especial. Hecho de tubos de hierro, pintado en rojo, blanco y azul, con cadenas fuertes y una madera firme para sentarse. Aún hoy, con los años encima, esos recuerdos siguen intactos en mi mente.

Ese columpio no hacía diferencias. Soportaba a grandes y chicos, no le importaba edad, ni de dónde venías. Estaba ahí todos los días, sin fallar, bajo el sol o la lluvia, siempre disponible. No se cansaba, no pedía nada a cambio, simplemente cumplía su función. Y quizás sin saberlo, ese columpio era una forma de vida, una enseñanza silenciosa de lo que significa estar, resistir y dar sin medida. Pero el tiempo no perdona. Los años fueron pasando, y ya no era el mismo. Se fue oxidando, perdiendo color, desgastándose con cada impulso, con cada risa, con cada historia que cargó encima.

Y llegó el día en que ese columpio se rompió. Así, sin aviso. Como pasan muchas cosas en la vida. Porque la vida también es así, un ir y venir, un subir y bajar, momentos de impulso y momentos donde todo parece detenerse. Y cuando miro hacia atrás, entiendo que no solo ese columpio cambió… uno también cambia. Crecer cambió todo. Ya no era ese niño que solo quería jugar, ahora tocaba asumir responsabilidades, enfrentar la realidad, aprender a sostenerse incluso cuando el equilibrio se pierde.

Y si lo llevo a mi historia, a lo que me ha tocado vivir, también encuentro ese mismo reflejo. He tenido momentos donde me he sentido fuerte, firme, como ese columpio en sus mejores tiempos, pero también he pasado por etapas donde el desgaste pesa. La migración, dejar mi país, empezar de nuevo en Argentina, y sobre todo aprender a vivir con la ausencia de mi hija María de Jesús, son cosas que te marcan. Hay días donde uno se siente quebrado por dentro, donde el alma pesa más que el cuerpo. Pero aun así, aquí sigo. Porque así como ese columpio fue parte de muchas historias, uno también sigue siendo parte de la suya. Entre alegrías y tristezas, entre recuerdos y realidad, este también es nuestro columpio de la vida.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Y al final, uno entiende que la vida es así, un constante ir y venir, como ese columpio que un día estuvo firme y lleno de vida, y otro día simplemente ya no está. Pero lo que vivimos en él, lo que sentimos en cada impulso, eso no se pierde.

Porque crecer cambió todo, sí, pero también nos dejó recuerdos, aprendizajes y una forma distinta de ver la vida. Hoy ya no somos esos niños, pero llevamos dentro todo lo que fuimos, todo lo que nos hizo reír, todo lo que nos hizo fuertes.

Quiero agradecer a la comunidad #freewriters, en especial a @daily.prompt, @mariannewest y @felt.buzz, por este espacio donde podemos compartir desde lo más real, desde lo vivido.

# The Fascinating Social Lives of Penguins: Communication, Bonding, and Parenting

Penguins are not just adorable creatures waddling around in their tuxedo-like feathers; they are also remarkable social animals with complex behaviors and social structures. This post delves into the fascinating social lives of penguins, exploring their communication methods, bonding practices, and parenting styles.

## Communication: The Language of Penguins

Penguins have developed a variety of vocalizations and body language to communicate with one another. Here are some key aspects of their communication:

- **Vocal Calls**: Penguins use a range of vocalizations to express emotions, attract mates, and communicate with their chicks. Each species has distinct calls, and parents can recognize their chicks' calls among thousands of others.
  
- **Body Language**: In addition to vocalizations, penguins use body language to convey messages. For example, a penguin may bow or raise its flippers to signal aggression or courtship.

- **Visual Signals**: During mating rituals, penguins often engage in elaborate displays, such as preening or presenting pebbles, which are used as gifts to attract a mate.

## Bonding: The Power of Partnerships

Penguins are known for their strong pair bonds, which can last for many breeding seasons. Here are some bonding behaviors observed in penguins:

- **Courtship Rituals**: Before forming a pair bond, penguins engage in courtship behaviors, such as synchronized swimming, vocal duets, and mutual preening. These rituals strengthen their connection.

- **Monogamous Relationships**: Many penguin species are monogamous for the breeding season, and some even form long-term bonds. This commitment is crucial for successful breeding and raising of chicks.

- **Social Groups**: Penguins often live in large colonies, which provide social interaction and protection. Within these colonies, they form smaller social groups, strengthening their social networks.

## Parenting: Nurturing the Next Generation

Penguin parenting is a fascinating aspect of their social lives. Here’s how they care for their young:

- **Shared Responsibilities**: In many penguin species, both parents share the responsibility of incubating eggs and feeding chicks. This cooperative parenting ensures the survival of their offspring.

- **Egg Incubation**: After laying eggs, penguins take turns incubating them, keeping them warm and safe from predators. The male and female often switch roles, demonstrating their commitment to the family unit.

- **Feeding Chicks**: Once the chicks hatch, parents take turns feeding them, regurgitating food to provide nourishment. This cooperative feeding is essential for the chicks’ growth and development.

## Conclusion

The social lives of penguins are a testament to the complexity and richness of animal behavior. From their unique communication methods to their strong pair bonds and dedicated parenting, penguins exhibit behaviors that highlight their social nature. As we continue to study these fascinating birds, we gain a deeper understanding of their lives and the importance of preserving their habitats for future generations.

---

Whether you’re a penguin enthusiast or just curious about the animal kingdom, the social lives of these remarkable birds offer endless intrigue and insight into the dynamics of wildlife.

body.body: >Pixabay On the road to success, impediments need to be removed. These impediments could be disturbances, hindrances, past failures, and many more. However, those failures can decide how we live our lives. When impediments are removed, we see them merely as disturbances, mental imbalance, or a flutter in the dovecote. In a world of so many voices, many want to be heard. These noises are merely a commotion that causes hubbub or interruption. The right answer is to cling to that which is truly worth hearing. Failure builds poor men who are racketed from one point to another, and they are usually unhappy and full of regrets. Tempted by their regrets, they become even more unhappy. You see, every one of us has failed one time or another. A poor person is not just about wrath; it is about achievements. Yes! You might have gotten a pig in a poke. Your failures are the roads to your success. They are maps for your progress. Abstinence or self-restraint can be of help. Social media is one thing that distracts students from studying these days. Why don’t you quit it for a while and then continue again later after you have been successful? Stand tall, stand strong in between failures. One day, your prayers are going to be heard. There is a saying: if your goals don’t scare you, then they’re not big enough. You should be so truculent about your goals. Do not take your goals—whether daily, monthly, or yearly—in a jocund manner. Nelson Mandela said, “There is no passion to be found playing small.” Denzel Washington said, “When you want to fall, fall forward.” He also said, “Dreams without goals are just dreams.” So why don’t you get up from the downs? Stop being pretentious that all is well. Stop that. Do not fail to revitalize failed or faulty foundations. A solid building will crumble under a failed or faulty foundation. body.title: The Long Way Home.
body.body:
The road to Oguta was not on any app. Chiamaka had checked twice  Google Maps drew a clean blue line along the expressway, the kind of road you took when you were in a hurry and did not want to see anything,but her uncle Godwin had never once taken the expressway, not in forty years of driving this route, and he was not about to start because she was visiting from Lagos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmegR5PyfX91nCJgrGxPkPvq9cWFoCS94iUjdC9qo9LV9T/1777631118681.png)

Her uncle Godwin had never taken the expressway not in forty years of driving this route, He wasn't about to start just because she was visiting from Lagos.

Godwin : 
\

She did not understand, not exactly. She was thirty-one and worked in fintech, and the thing she knew best was how to make friction disappear. She had spent three years building systems that got people from want to transaction in under four seconds. Friction, in her world, was the enemy. 

She watched her uncle turn off the expressway onto a laterite path the colour of dried blood, and she gripped the door handle.


The bush was close on both sides. There were Neem trees, Cashew trees and a flame tree that was bright orange.

The road was bumpy and slow. The old Peugeot car groaned through mud that hadn't dried from the rain.

Her uncle drove with one elbow out the window humming a song she half-knew from church.

* * *

Thirty minutes later they stopped at a roadside stall. A woman sat behind a clay pot of groundnuts with a sleeping child tied to her back.

Uncle Godwin turned off the engine.

Godwin asked,

\

She started scooping groundnuts into a newspaper cone.

\

The woman looked at Chiamaka and said,

\

Chiamaka almost laughed, She almost said she was fine like she always did.

Instead she took the cone of groundnuts her uncle passed to her and Said nothing.

* * *

They drove on, the road went up a hill and showed a view of the lake, which was flat and silver in the afternoon light surrounded by palms.

Chiamaka said,

\

She turned the cone in her hands.

She was thinking, oddly, about the product she had shipped last quarter the one that removed every confirmation step, every pause, every moment a user might reconsider, her team had called it seamless, she had called it seamless, the metric that came back was engagement, not satisfaction.  

 Not arrival, Just movement. Just forward.


The Peugeot went over the hill. The lake disappeared behind the trees.

The road got narrower. A boy drove a herd of goats across it, they waited, with the engine idling.

One goat stared at the car with a mild contempt like it had never heard of making things faster.

Chiamaka asked,

\

He was quiet for a long time and she thought he might not answer.

Godwin then said,

\

The last goat cleared the road, They drove on into the afternoon past a school painted blue and yellow past women with buckets on their heads moving toward water.

Chiamaka ate the groundnuts one at a time. Didn't open her phone.

When they finally arrived at her grandmothers compound the old woman was already, at the gate calling her name.

She realised she couldn't say how long the journey had taken.

Only that it had been enough.

Open All Chests Feature
Welcome back dungeon crawlers, We are back with another update. This one has been sitting on my list for quite a while. Opening chests one by one was just painful. I also heard the same complaint multiple times in Discord. After a small chat with @cav0 I finally decided to build it. And here we are. The companion app now has an open all chests feature. https://dungeoncities-next.vercel.app/shop #
How It Works
It is pretty straightforward. You hit the button and it will open chests automatically until you have 5 inventory slots left. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tGVQtnvAuy7ytTXGtAndsmjgHEMXpr15BLZfkTfUYsZPgrYuo95diph2j2R333WmcJp.png) Once all chests are opened, your shop gets refreshed right away. From there you can instantly sell all the unwanted items without extra clicks. #
Why This Matters
This is one of those small updates that does not look huge at first glance. But once you use it you will not want to go back. * Less clicking * Less time wasted * More smooth gameplay #
Wrapping Up

body.title: Splinterlands: Ended the season in Gold Tier 2 and then used those tons of glints to purchase a Legendary Draw!🔥
body.body:
>Yesterday, upon reaching Gold Tier 2 for the very first time, I was overjoyed—so much so that I decided to take a short break immediately afterward to ensure I could conclude the season within Gold Tier 2 itself. And that is exactly what happened; naturally, since I wasn't playing, my ranking would only reset once the season ended. I took this step because I didn't want to take any risks; otherwise, had I dropped even a single rank, my seasonal reset would have landed me in Silver 2 instead of Silver 1. Over the last 3 to 4 seasons, I have played this game far more than I did during the entire previous year. During this period, I added several new cards to my deck—one of which, an Archon, became the very first card I ever upgraded to its maximum level. Subsequently, I incorporated several other cards into my deck specifically to support and synergize with it. Consequently, my strategic approach improved, and I explored various new synergies and tactical maneuvers. Employing one such strategy, I secured victory in the battle that unlocked Gold Tier 2, surpassing the 2200-ranking milestone and breaking a personal record I had set previously. While my overall rank on the leaderboard wasn't particularly impressive, my maximum win streak improved—reaching a high of 6—and my win rate also saw a significant boost, climbing to 54.49%. Furthermore, alongside all these achievements, I earned a total of approximately 100,000 Glint this season. ✌️

\n\n
>Now it was time to utilize this Glint. While every player technically has various options for doing so, based on my experience thus far, I find the \

to be the best choice. Specifically, for the past four seasons, I have focused on purchasing the Legendary Draw—a single instance of which costs 70,000 Glint. This makes it 233 times more expensive than a Common Draw and 140 times more expensive than a Rare Draw; in other words, for the 70,000 Glint I spend on a single Legendary Draw, I could instead purchase 140 Rare Draws. However, my Guild Leader advised me that while Common and Rare cards can be acquired through gameplay and various other means, obtaining Legendary cards is the most difficult challenge and largely a matter of luck. Therefore, obviously, if you are able to earn that much Glint, purchasing the Legendary Draw is the best course of action.🔥

\n\n

>As you can see, the probability of obtaining a Gold Foil card from this is merely 1%—a figure that increases to 2% with the use of an Alchemy Potion. However, this probability remains so low that pinning any hopes on it would be akin to deliberately setting yourself up for disappointment. Therefore, go ahead and use your Alchemy Potions, but do so without harboring any specific expectations; that way, whatever outcome the draw yields, you will be able to appreciate it. This is precisely the approach I have adopted, and it is for this very reason that I no longer experience disappointment. This time around, I once again utilized an Alchemy Potion, and—for the very first time—I received a Grey Magic card. This card boasts a Magic Attack power of 2 and carries a Mana cost of only 5, meaning you can strategically deploy it in low-Mana battles. This card is particularly valuable because, relative to its Mana cost, both its Attack power and Speed ​​are above average. Furthermore, its \

ability grants it the power to target the first non-melee card positioned behind the card in the first slot. However, its Health is quite low, which leaves it vulnerable to direct attacks from cards possessing the \

ability; nevertheless, by providing it with appropriate protection, it can be effectively utilized as part of a well-devised strategy. While this card may not be immediately useful to me right now, it will become significantly more powerful once upgraded to the next level—an upgrade that requires a mere three copies for cards of Legendary rarity. This, too, stands as a distinct advantage of acquiring Legendary cards.🙂

\n\n

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. body.body:
> Feliz día tengan todos mis queridos amigos, hoy 1ro de mayo se da inicio a un nuevo mes, pero también se resalta el día del trabajador, por lo tanto le envío un saludo de felicitaciones a todas esas personas que día a día a través de su constancia y el esfuerzo dan lo mejor de sí, el día de hoy les traigo una receta práctica y deliciosa, pues estaré preparando unas lentejas guisadas con papas y zanahoria, Los granos son una excelente fuente de nutrición, una proteína vegetal que suplementa muchas veces la proteína cárnica que consumimos a diario, por lo tanto siempre se recomienda consumir granos una vez por semana. > Happy day to all my dear friends! Today, May 1st, marks the beginning of a new month, but it's also Labor Day. Therefore, I send my best wishes to all those who, through their perseverance and effort, give their best every day. Today I bring you a practical and delicious recipe: lentil stew with potatoes and carrots. Grains are an excellent source of nutrition, a plant-based protein that often supplements the meat protein we consume daily. Therefore, it's always recommended to eat grains at least once a week.
![GridArt_20260430_235556334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK2DfoMAry3zxxCL1vpDv6AjGjF9Nm5RzWwA2bJ6rAc3yvUBAGrkoTiBjQp9waG.jpg)
Ingredientes: 400 gramos de lentejas, 1 zanahoria, 2 papas, cebolla, ají, cilantro, celery, sal, cubito maggi. > Ingredients: 400 grams of lentils, 1 carrot, 2 potatoes, onion, chili pepper, cilantro, celery, salt, maggi cube.
![GridArt_20260430_235102968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23xemxa1uYxzCJeujkvo6vjiWxdy1SifFzv2gg1s9dytMxUEnXKRjHyqbXj7Gd85ksUWS.jpg)
Debemos lavar muy bien nuestras lentejas, luego colocarlas en una olla con suficiente agua a cocinar para que las mismas se ablanden, por otra parte vamos a cortar un poco de cebolla, ají y celery. > We must wash our lentils very well, then place them in a pot with enough water to cook until they soften. Separately, we will chop some onion, chili pepper, and celery. Cuando las lentejas estén un poco blandas podemos agregar todo nuestros aliños y sazonar con un poco de sal y cubito maggi. > When the lentils are a little soft, we can add all our seasonings and season with a little salt and a Maggi cube.
![GridArt_20260430_235151033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23uQpefWm34cutzYk1Rr1L7Jk4k9CLgbjeBYbD81YyyaQK69thauKFbBNdmG9v866Ny3S.jpg)
Seguidamente vamos a pelar papas y zanahoria, cortarlas en cuadros. Primero agregamos la zanahorias que son un poco más duras y luego las papas, finalmente agregamos una cucharada de cilantro y dejamos que todos los ingredientes unifiquen sabores para disfrutar de esta deliciosa preparación. > Next, we'll peel the potatoes and carrots and cut them into cubes. First, we'll add the carrots, which are a bit harder, and then the potatoes. Finally, we'll add a tablespoon of cilantro and let all the ingredients meld together to enjoy this delicious dish.
![GridArt_20260430_235343677.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJkSSmA6X2NjGpcSWdi1xiKGoKbkiEKESAcUzwxYseWNRpZB35M4a2jjQyQBLkE.jpg)

body.title: Shadows of Devotion – Gaming Photography Contest Entry
body.body:
Hello friends and community, today I want to share my photographs from one of the most charming and at the same time unsettling games in the world, *Cult of The Lamb*. It is a game that unites cute and kawaii aesthetics with worlds of sacrifice and devotion. What attracts me the most about this game is precisely the combination of these aesthetic elements, because they create a unique atmosphere that gives that sensation I would describe as, it looks cute but it feels scary.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYzfFbtQFinZfTidQCsyWfXSuHKpj15ogGCREVRcGqCSN/20260327002805005_c.png)

I have tried to gather different moments within this disturbing universe, where the faith and fear of the devotees that so define the sects are reflected. Examples such as the ascent, the blind loyalty of the followers, and the inevitable confrontation with rival gods and demons. Something very interesting about this game is its photo mode, where you can play with different angles, filters, and zoom in or out on the image, as well as move around the stage and dungeons.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeBfJbV9s55NUNoe8ABf9e4FHbqBbP6Bc88o4686CH8q7/2026030914433700_c.jpg)

In the game you start as the lamb, who after being saved is transformed into a deity with the objective of overthrowing gods and demons that have taken control of the world, but to extract the necessary energy you will need devotees, people who give you their energy and that you can use and sacrifice at will, both to give yourself more power and to make the cult grow. The path of the cult will be affected by your decisions and by how cruel or benevolent you are with your followers. Each devotee also has their own tastes and traits that affect not only themselves but the entire cult, even making them lose faith.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVYA8RGJx455Uq5uBgRPhYrhyLfVD7LWxKQhjMvgUaVsf/2026030916154400_c.jpg)

Little by little as the cult grows the needs and abilities of the followers also grow, from producing more faith in less time, working in farms and mines, becoming battle assistants or simply going out to explore in search of useful resources.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc8KkULnuwRuQY6db1YKzzKRpcvFkCZNYhpxgVrAqbrE3/2026032117324400_c.jpg)

I share with you a photo of my entire cult, as you can see there is a great variety of types and designs of characters, each one has its own name, and they also show their needs such as hunger or sleep in alerts so that you, as the leader, can attend to them on time and prevent them from affecting their performance or that of the others.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYRJpqUyGDG174ujngBznVLyUrCUy2K5tehGXfW4g6Y4X/2026032200324200_c.jpg)



In the universe we will also find a series of unique animals that help us in different ways, from giving us unique items, allowing us to gamble with them for coins, obtaining decorations for the cult, or kidnapping characters that will serve us as followers.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZALTSY5JQzLNgzdDQaLSx4MyvtX5ddvpaW55JfsB3KQ9/2026032200344400_c.jpg)

I really enjoyed taking this photo, because it shows that the drawing style, even though it looks simple at first glance, can transmit that sadness and desperation of being in the middle of a lost battle, in a forest that appears silent and lonely, with hostile nature and corpses everywhere.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRaRpdPBLJM5CSou4FJ7QMSMzxLjdbnUMLU2wTmgvjyP5/2026032200481800_c.jpg)

In the middle of a long corridor, in the middle of the night we find ourselves together with our small companion, a follower transformed into a demon helper, ready to face the boss of this dungeon, even so our face shows peace and tranquility, despite the deaths and the blood.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbYPedcDEcahtSjgmtKLd4JKLjnNCgwWySt1wEUiGBnw/2026032200482300_c.jpg)

The pentagram is our means of transport; it not only takes us to the dungeons where we must fight room after room until we reach the current boss, but it also takes us to areas where the allies and the different minigames are located.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYKvua9kL4tHsk7b9LgKmV4sJcvZavQdRv5s22cxjvyZE/2026032200482900_c.jpg)

The underwater landscapes full of humanoid fish and floating corpses among algae and bubbles cannot be missing in this game, giving it an aesthetic filled with terrifying blue tones. I really like the design of the fish characters in this game.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9yLZZQvEibjKvTbpPni73os2Nc5Y6kLM7PSuvdN44hs/2026032200483400_c.jpg)

I share with you a selfie of the main character, who would think that this fluffy little lamb spills blood with all kinds of weapons and without changing its face of tranquility.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZycpPPFZ9CRPD2D7Aj93XZn5FpfL96RRUqTxpuQ8dXye/2026032200484000_c.jpg)

At night while our followers sleep I take the opportunity to cook some dishes of food, clean what is dirty and repair what is broken, I am a leader of a sect with many responsibilities.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBWuMZgNXw6Ye3hYFUrGiWhnnZuKhLSrB1YziDeYEiqF/2026032200484500_c.jpg)

An expanded view of our sect and all the territory we are occupying, always in expansion.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRnX3fcQWx8GoqfPLjmsVaAXY2ogGcVKaqGQnK65wCZij/2026032700275900_c.jpg)

From the circle of invocation of the devotees I say goodbye, I hope you have enjoyed this visual journey through my playthrough of Cult of The Lamb, it has been a pleasure to share with you a little of this story, as always all the success and luck in the world, bye bye.

--- 
 
 
_*I sincerely want to thank you for taking the time to read this article. Your support means a lot to me and motivates me to continue sharing content that can be useful and interesting for you. If you found this article helpful or enjoyed reading it, I would greatly appreciate your comments. Best wishes!*_  
  
 
 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadsPq8eCo5QHtCbeBUtHHQBH5dBP7pyqESNqvh6DU4rE/gracias.png)  
 
| ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPdQa47w2uXUAwNQqavxg3LR8kqh83vWTdjjN7LqUsruu/testing_avatar512.png) | I’m Ernesto, a Cuban passionate about art and writing. Always learning, always growing. Excited to share and learn more every day! I write about art, drawing, video games, nature, and review the things I like. My goal is to inspire and connect with others through my creative journey. |

Traveling between Delhi and Chandigarh is a frequent need for professionals, families, and tourists. Choosing a [cab service Delhi to Chandigarh](https://www.chandigarhcabexpress.com/delhi-to-chandigarh-taxi/) is one of the most practical ways to make this journey smooth and stress-free.

Unlike public transport, cabs offer a personalized travel experience. You do not have to deal with crowded buses or fixed train schedules. Instead, you can enjoy a direct journey with comfort and flexibility. This makes cab services a preferred option for many travelers today.

The distance between Delhi and Chandigarh is around 250–270 kilometers, and the journey usually takes 4 to 6 hours. While there are multiple travel options available, cabs provide unmatched convenience.

A cab service Delhi to Chandigarh allows you to travel at your own pace. You can choose your departure time, preferred vehicle, and even plan stops along the way. This flexibility is especially useful for families, business travelers, and those carrying luggage.

Another advantage is door-to-door service. The cab picks you up from your location and drops you exactly where you need to go. This eliminates the hassle of additional transportation.



***

Cab services offer several advantages that make them ideal for long-distance travel:

#### Comfort and Privacy

You travel in a private vehicle, which allows you to relax and enjoy the journey.

#### Flexible Scheduling

You can plan your trip according to your convenience.

#### Safe Travel

Whether you are traveling for work or leisure, a cab ensures a smooth journey from start to finish. By selecting a reliable service and planning your trip carefully, you can make your travel experience convenient and hassle-free.

body.title: OVERCOMING DOUBT AND ANXIETY
body.body:
https://youtu.be/3J4EEXHfIMo?si=M85g-FykA3u4B1Ht

When we are afraid, then we carry a lot of doubts in our hearts. You can make someone give up on himself, not believe in himself and commit suicide.

The Bible teaches us that we should cast our cares onto God. Because God wants us to put all our worries onto him and he will be able to take care of us. God is mindful of our happiness. He does not want us to suffer any shame.

The plan of God for us is to be free from all evil and every form of delay or hindrance. Looking at the problems we are facing right now. When we come to this world, we are sure there will be problems in this world. We might feel like giving up but God wants to remind us that we are always safe and no harm from before.

We might feel like there is no hope in this world though there is. But there is always a chance. This is what we should meditate on. We should meditate on the challenges and cast them away worries unto God and face it with the faith that God will deliver us from
everything.

In order to escape to everything without being anxious, our eyes must be fixed upon the Lord to alter the future of our faith.

body.title: Stork in the orchard
body.body:
![Screenshot 2026-05-01 113847.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/23uFW44ZB8kaaQsd9hBPvFBFDGvzxWZW6uLwHdCt1B4mQzM2SWQ17Xy2YYA2XVGEpa2FT.png)This is a screenshot.



Hello everyone, I think this is my first time writing in this group.
I live near the Danube, and we have a lot of storks in the area.
Among many things, I do gardening, and I also have my own orchard. And yesterday I was surprised by a stork that landed in my neighbor's orchard.
Since I was working in the garden. So I tried to take a picture of it.
I have a lot of birds in the area, but I don't have a camera. So I'll try to take better pictures with my phone. And I also have some domestic chickens that I'll have to photograph for a future post.


![20260430_180606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJmsNW65DjcVzmQMvTggruJuufzWHJCxKGyHjSkBFCAoDWfTn392TDhPRWGw6rM.jpg)

![20260430_180608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJehTciWw7N6fzZNBSJh4yP8RgBPnjKXwy52VQxYrd9p2Bm3VwzUE1WNhKAHtUS.jpg)

![20260430_180648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/ALAEEhwo2yQS8CGRkiyDQhLngkXWu4Fpz7GKVeFZ5mSUWX9bdSjcrSg5Us291AC.jpg)
I tried to get closer to her. But as I got closer, she moved away. Although the storks here are relatively tame because they have nests on electricity poles, when they are on the ground, they are much more cautious.
![20260430_180713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AL1cpsDyD2cGdnkMSrWReoAZ45s1nPKcGYa9o9cdQepWAHuCa51bLA1DneE7gu3.jpg)

![20260430_180720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKGa2Fuw4y3o7J5nCbSCqYWADfagm1GMWDyEeffJyCZ8bWtUni5LVwfKa4cjKyZ.jpg)

![20260430_180723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKRB5hwrVUYLQLWHepCnNyRY8ScNM6LERGkcR5nkQLecWYwkwvtootZeCujEuoG.jpg)
And in the end she flew away.

![20260430_180731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AK9PZZCcGcgUacDDQ7qC65yfCsxLttU7cABWiAYcvhDdGvj7qrYGLBuyhZLHTpx.jpg)![20260430_180738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKs12iJNPEfKDEB21r1SBLca54DPTbqCCSq18kDhZTampzjeNqvURFyR5tGADQU.jpg)I mapped the area where the stork was. You will see that it is close to the Danube, the forest and the Kovilja Petrovaradin marsh, which is a kind of nature reserve.


All pictures are mine.

Thanks for reading.
Until next time.
Stay healthy.
Markone85.
