body.title: [ESP/ENG] Cuestión de tiempo
body.body:
El Barcelona está a un paso de proclamarse campeón de La Liga 2025-2026: con 85 puntos en 33 jornadas y una ventaja de 11 sobre el Real Madrid, el título parece inevitable. Solo necesita sumar cinco puntos más de los 15 en juego, lo que convierte su coronación en una cuestión de tiempo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZt8GEr4cC3wyFypM2JweNXtoMFEnBW9uckjWoTwa4Yvb/grqzbv5xmaaegq4.jpg)[fuente](https://x.com/FCBarcelona_es/status/1924190998655049844/photo/1)



El equipo dirigido por Hansi Flick ha mostrado una regularidad admirable, encadenando nueve victorias consecutivas después de perder momentáneamente el liderato frente al Girona, y ha sabido combinar solidez defensiva con eficacia ofensiva gracias al aporte de varios jugadores demostrando que este es un equipo. El calendario restante incluye duelos frente a Osasuna, Real Madrid, Alavés, Betis y Valencia, pero la matemática es clara: con apenas cinco puntos más de los quince en juego, mi equipo se coronará campeón. 

Incluso el Clásico del 10 de mayo podría convertirse en el escenario simbólico de la consagración, aunque la posibilidad de que el título se decida antes frente a Osasuna está sobre la mesa. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXQXxo3wz3RUGRW31xy8hzSKtqU9ECMrNB4hferdmA77/600x200.jpg)[fuente](https://x.com/MadridBarcelona)



El Real Madrid necesitaría una remontada casi utópica, ganando todos sus partidos y esperando que el Barça tropiece en cuatro de los cinco compromisos restantes, un escenario que desafía la lógica. Más allá de la aritmética, el atractivo está en los matices: la posibilidad de alcanzar los 100 puntos, un registro histórico que solo lograron el propio Barcelona en 2012-13 y el Madrid en 2011-12; la polémica sobre un eventual pasillo de honor en el Clásico, que añadiría tensión a la rivalidad eterna; y la consolidación de un bicampeonato que reafirma la era Flick. 

El único riesgo real es el exceso de confianza, pero el técnico alemán ha insistido en mantener al equipo enfocado en el día a día, evitando que la euforia se convierta en relajación. Así, el desenlace de La Liga ya no depende de la duda, sino del calendario: el Barcelona está destinado a levantar el trofeo, y la pregunta no es si lo hará, sino cuándo. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGchnPZUTTjqogkUXeaZqvW5GiEy5pcyqyDqvGxk4QFt/hhjb_pswgaa1xyu.jpg)[fuente](https://x.com/FCBarcelona/status/2049790875983602017/photo/1)

La sensación general es que el campeonato ya tiene dueño, y que la historia de esta temporada se resume en una frase: cuestión de tiempo.

Créditos: Usé el traductor de Google.




ENGLISH


Barcelona are one step away from being crowned La Liga champions for 2025-2026: with 85 points in 33 matches and an 11-point lead over Real Madrid, the title seems inevitable. They only need to add five more points from the 15 still up for grabs, making their coronation a matter of time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZt8GEr4cC3wyFypM2JweNXtoMFEnBW9uckjWoTwa4Yvb/grqzbv5xmaaegq4.jpg)[source](https://x.com/FCBarcelona_es/status/1924190998655049844/photo/1)

The team managed by Hansi Flick has shown admirable consistency, stringing together nine consecutive victories after momentarily losing the lead to Girona. They have combined defensive solidity with offensive efficiency thanks to the contributions of several players, demonstrating that this is a true team. The remaining fixtures include matches against Osasuna, Real Madrid, Alavés, Betis, and Valencia, but the math is clear: with just five more points out of the fifteen still up for grabs, my team will be crowned champions.


Even the Clásico on May 10th could become the symbolic stage for the title win, although the possibility of clinching the title earlier against Osasuna is on the table.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXQXxo3wz3RUGRW31xy8hzSKtqU9ECMrNB4hferdmA77/600x200.jpg)[source](https://x.com/MadridBarcelona)

Real Madrid would need an almost utopian comeback, winning all their remaining matches and hoping that Barça stumbles in four of their five remaining games—a scenario that defies logic. Beyond the arithmetic, the appeal lies in the nuances: the possibility of reaching 100 points, a historic milestone only achieved by Barcelona in 2012-13 and Madrid in 2011-12; The controversy surrounding a potential guard of honor at the Clásico, which would add tension to the eternal rivalry; and the consolidation of a back-to-back championship that reaffirms the Flick era.

The only real risk is overconfidence, but the German coach has insisted on keeping the team focused on the day-to-day, preventing euphoria from turning into complacency. Thus, the outcome of La Liga no longer depends on doubt, but on the schedule: Barcelona is destined to lift the trophy, and the question is not if they will, but when.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGchnPZUTTjqogkUXeaZqvW5GiEy5pcyqyDqvGxk4QFt/hhjb_pswgaa1xyu.jpg)[source](https://x.com/FCBarcelona/status/2049790875983602017/photo/1)

The general feeling is that the championship already has an owner, and that the story of this season can be summed up in one phrase: it's just a matter of time.

Credits: I used Google Translate.

> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQr3DFQEvmbDBnvPQKEwSk9hpeN6RZ8A4wmpiQQMwRnG7/IMG20260421091915~2.jpg A sweet creature is enough to brighten up my dull days. That creature is my beloved pet bird Labani. She is not just a bird, but an integral part of my family. When I sit down for a while after all the work of the day, the sound of Labani's chirping and the little time spent with her removes all my fatigue in an instant. Labani is as beautiful as she looks, her nature is just as sweet. Her feathers, mixed with blue and white, look like they have been painted with the skillful brush of an artist. However, recently, the level of joy in our house has increased several times for a special reason. Labani has become a mother for the first time. A few days ago, she laid four eggs. Since then, I have noticed a strange change in her motherhood. She used to take very careful care of the eggs. Finally, the wait is over. One by one, the eggs have hatched and the cute chicks have come out. Seeing those little creatures fills my heart with a strange sense of fulfillment. Labani is now very busy feeding and caring for her babies. This genuine maternal love is truly captivating. I couldn't help but share this happy news with my friends in the Hive community. Without Labani, I would not have understood how much love for pets makes our lives sweeter. I wish Labani and her little ones to be healthy. This new gift from nature has now turned our home into a living festival. Anyway, this was my plan for today. I hope you liked the food photos I took. I will be back with more food photos like this. Wishing everyone good health, I bid farewell today. Wishing everyone good health, I bid farewell today. ___ |

</center>
</liketuimages>

哈哈哈，五一小长假来了，这五月的第一天，我就睡到大中午，眼看着太阳晒屁股啦，话说这老天奶可以啊，原本还以为还是会阴雨天呢，居然放晴了，体恤大家放假给个好天气，可以出门玩耍吧。

打开手机，看着一排排显眼的消息轰炸，还有8个未接来电，好似出什么惊天大新闻似，原来是小姐妹到处喊人一起去爬山，好家伙，你不是说五一首日不登山嘛，这到底是闹哪呀。。电话都被快被你成电量不足了。。

我在床上做着平板支撑，拨通小姐妹的电话，她接起电话的第一句就是：“你昨晚被人打晕了??”

\

是”  我竟无言以对，看样子，小姐妹是遇到什么事儿，这也太反常了，可我今天实在不想登山，倒是可以一起去逛街。。。

“别登山了，这会去登山，肯定人挤人啊，有啥意思呢，要不一起去逛街吧。。”“好吧，那登山就约到5.5再去？今天先逛街！”

和她咔咔咔聊天这会，我还是没忘记平板支撑着，不得不佩服自己的坚持，哈哈哈。。（锻炼确实会上瘾~~）

你们肯定猜不到，我们去哪儿逛街了。。她把我拉去机场逛了，，我真服了。。还好我们这儿五一假期期间地铁公交全免费，两人这一来一回的，平时得花不少钱在路上呢。。这次政府全部报销了，爽歪歪。。

到了机场，这来来回回的人可真不少啊，不过看大家脸上表情啊，都是开心且愉悦的，我们逛了几家机场专属书店，被可可爱爱的娃娃们以及各种小挂件包围啦，哈哈哈哈。我们两只可高兴了，明显看出她也很放松，不过还是没说到底发生什么事情，我呢，秉持着你不说，我就不问啦，毕竟涉及隐私嘛。虽然我也八卦，不过还是有一定边界感的，哈哈。

其中一间书吧，还有阅读盲盒，盲盒袋中有任意两本书，书名不能提前知，价格不一，盲盒统一价格49.9元。。我和小姐妹商量一下，还是决定不玩盲盒，若果买到不喜欢的书籍，也不会花时间去看，又只能摆去书房柜子上，占空间了。

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，祝福大家五一假期愉快，喜乐平安。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**





---

body.title: [ESP/ENG] El valor de los límites: el arte de decir \
para llegar más lejos
body.body:
>Hace algunos días @emiliorios publicó un trabajo muy necesario sobre los límites y su importancia en el desarrollo interpersonal, personal, comunitario y social de manera general. Varios creadores se hicieron eco de esa reflexión, entre ellos, @marabuzal, con otro trabajo digno de admirar.

Hoy quiero dejarles mis ideas en torno al tema, tratando de abordar la esencia del tema desde esas y otras aristas. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTMLoZpLXa74XpWmjkVepGVP7geJJZepQcNX1ZnvGehYJ/censorship_610101_1280.jpg)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2015/01/24/12/27/censorship-610101_1280.jpg) Este tiempo que vivimos nos vive empujando hacia lo inmediato, la abundancia y el todo se puede hacer. Nos invitan a decir siempre sí: a más trabajo, más compromisos, más estímulos, más consumo. Sin embargo, paradójicamente, aprender a poner límites se ha convertido en una de las habilidades más profundas para una vida plena. Lejos de ser una muestra de debilidad o miedo, los límites saludables son la valla que protege el jardín de nuestro bienestar. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8mVmFTgq7iPcbfu7zAPKLd5agdNkihJyL1tn5QDcSxS/sign_161176_1280.webp)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2015/01/24/12/27/censorship-610101_1280.jpg) Un límite no es un muro que aísla, sino una puerta que elige cuándo y cómo abrirse. En las relaciones personales, por ejemplo, decir no a tiempo evita resentimientos futuros. Poner un límite a comentarios hirientes o a demandas excesivas no es egoísmo: es autoestima en acción. Nos permite conservar energía para lo que realmente importa y relacionarnos desde la autenticidad, no desde el agotamiento. Sin límites, el amor se vuelve dependencia; la amistad, favoritismo; la familia, obligación. En el trabajo, la ausencia de límites conduce al estrés laboral. Responder correos a medianoche, aceptar todas las tareas extra o no desconectar del celular nos hace creer que somos más productivos, cuando en realidad nos fragmentamos. El límite de horarios, de funciones y de desconexión no reduce nuestra valía; la protege. Una persona que sabe poner frenos al trabajo termina siendo más creativa, más presente y, a largo plazo, más eficaz. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYzG6FUv9bgFSbbVPE2HA9VU8LimsFVxpCKMSbNwNqfFW/businessman_9264475_1280.jpg)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/12/13/08/37/businessman-9264475_1280.jpg) También necesitamos límites internos: con nuestros pensamientos y emociones. La mente sin límites divaga en catástrofes imaginarias o se pierde en obsesiones. Aprender a decir basta a la preocupación constante, poner un alto a la autocrítica despiadada o detener un impulso dañino es un acto de libertad. Los límites internos nos ayudan a habitar nuestro mundo interior sin que él nos habite a nosotros. ¿Y qué decir de los límites colectivos? Una sociedad sin límites claros —leyes, ética, respeto al espacio ajeno— deriva en caos. Pero los límites sociales no solo restringen: posibilitan la convivencia. El límite de no cruzar un semáforo en rojo permite que todos fluyan. El límite de no mentir sostiene la confianza. El límite ecológico de no sobreexplotar recursos es, hoy, condición de supervivencia. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSeoKUud2oecXNsgJnypFauknCaE478gys9ZAVrvCqAcG/geralt_eam_10171012_1280.webp)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2026/03/13/04/58/geralt-eam-10171012_1280.jpg) Por supuesto, hay límites que duelen: la enfermedad nos impone un límite físico, la muerte un límite vital. Pero incluso allí, aceptar estos límites nos enseña a valorar el tiempo, a priorizar abrazos sinceros sobre trámites urgentes. Como escribió el filósofo Byung-Chul Han, la sociedad del rendimiento nos enferma con su imperativo de poder más; los límites nos devuelven a lo humano: sabemos que somos finitos, y esa conciencia nos hace más sabios. Un comentario final En definitiva, los límites no empobrecen la vida; la definen. Un río sin orillas no es río, sino inundación. Una melodía sin silencios es ruido. Poner límites no es amputar posibilidades, sino enfocarlas. Es reconocer que, para crecer en profundidad, necesitamos decir adiós a la ilusión de lo infinito. Al abrazar nuestros hasta aquí, protegemos lo sagrado: nuestro tiempo, nuestra paz, nuestra capacidad de decir sí a lo que de verdad nos nutre. Aprender a limitar es, en el fondo, aprender a vivir. Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate. ENGLISH A Necessary Introduction A few days ago, @emiliorios published a much-needed piece on boundaries and their importance in interpersonal, personal, community, and social development in general. Several creators echoed this reflection, among them @marabuzal, with another admirable work. Today I want to share my thoughts on the topic, trying to address its essence from these and other perspectives. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTMLoZpLXa74XpWmjkVepGVP7geJJZepQcNX1ZnvGehYJ/censorship_610101_1280.jpg)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2015/01/24/12/27/censorship-610101_1280.jpg) These times we live in keep pushing us toward immediacy, abundance, and the idea that everything is possible. We're constantly encouraged to say yes: to more work, more commitments, more stimulation, more consumption. However, paradoxically, learning to set boundaries has become one of the most profound skills for a fulfilling life. Far from being a sign of weakness or fear, healthy boundaries are the fence that protects the garden of our well-being. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8mVmFTgq7iPcbfu7zAPKLd5agdNkihJyL1tn5QDcSxS/sign_161176_1280.webp)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2015/01/24/12/27/censorship-610101_1280.jpg) A boundary isn't a wall that isolates, but a door that chooses when and how to open. In personal relationships, for example, saying no in time prevents future resentment. Setting limits on hurtful comments or excessive demands isn't selfishness: it's self-esteem in action. It allows us to conserve energy for what truly matters and to connect with others authentically, not from exhaustion. Without boundaries, love becomes dependency; friendship, favoritism; family, obligation. At work, the absence of boundaries leads to job stress. Answering emails at midnight, accepting every extra task, or never disconnecting from our phones makes us believe we're more productive, when in reality we're fragmenting ourselves. Setting limits on hours, responsibilities, and disconnecting doesn't diminish our worth; it protects it. A person who knows how to set limits on work ends up being more creative, more present, and, in the long run, more effective. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYzG6FUv9bgFSbbVPE2HA9VU8LimsFVxpCKMSbNwNqfFW/businessman_9264475_1280.jpg)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/12/13/08/37/businessman-9264475_1280.jpg) We also need internal boundaries: with our thoughts and emotions. A mind without boundaries wanders into imaginary catastrophes or gets lost in obsessions. Learning to say \

to constant worry, to put a stop to merciless self-criticism, or to halt a harmful impulse is an act of freedom. Internal boundaries help us inhabit our inner world without it inhabiting us.

And what about collective boundaries?

A society without clear boundaries—laws, ethics, respect for others' space—leads to chaos. But social boundaries don't just restrict: they enable coexistence. The boundary of not crossing a red light allows everyone to move freely. The boundary of not lying sustains trust. The ecological boundary of not overexploiting resources is, today, a condition for survival.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSeoKUud2oecXNsgJnypFauknCaE478gys9ZAVrvCqAcG/geralt_eam_10171012_1280.webp)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2026/03/13/04/58/geralt-eam-10171012_1280.jpg)

Of course, there are limits that hurt: illness imposes a physical limit, death a vital one. But even there, accepting these limits teaches us to value time, to prioritize sincere hugs over urgent matters. As the philosopher Byung-Chul Han wrote, the performance society makes us sick with its imperative to do more; limits return us to our humanity: we know we are finite, and that awareness makes us wiser.

A final comment

Ultimately, limits don't impoverish life; they define it. A river without banks isn't a river, but a flood. A melody without silence is noise. Setting limits isn't amputating possibilities, but focusing them. It's recognizing that, to grow in depth, we need to say goodbye to the illusion of the infinite. By embracing our \
we protect what is sacred: our time, our peace, our capacity to say yes to what truly nourishes us. Learning to set limits is, at its core, learning to live.\n\nNote: I used DeepL Translate.

body.title: Ocimum basilicum - Lamiaceae (ENG/ITA)
body.body: > ### Ocimum basilicum - Lamiaceae (ENG) Ocimum basilicum L. is an annual herbaceous plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family, widely cultivated in temperate regions for its characteristic aroma and for its culinary and medicinal uses. ![basilico.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EqSXwcaC3YmD8j3FyPiTkqUnAme5Bvke12UngYzJ98MqmyWaFuAJXQsrfRdmMagFXSG.png) image created with canva.com **It has a herbaceous, quadrangular stem with opposite, ovate leaves rich in secretory glands containing essential oils. The flowers, clustered in terminal inflorescences, appear in the summer and are highly prized by pollinating insects.** Basil requires mild temperatures and is cold-resistant: the minimum cultivation temperature is 10°C. It prefers sunny locations, well-drained soil, and regular irrigation. The flowering tops and leaves are harvested during the balsamic period of July, when the concentration of active ingredients is highest. **The plant has medium toxicity, mainly due to two components of the essential oil: Estragol: a potentially toxic and mutagenic substance. Eugenol: in young plants (<15 cm), it may have potentially carcinogenic properties.** For this reason, taking Ocimum basilicum supplements is not recommended during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and in general, it is advisable to consult a doctor before using herbal preparations. The culinary use of fresh leaves is considered safe in dietary quantities. **Basil possesses numerous traditionally recognized properties, supported by phytochemical studies: Tonic and mildly stimulant. Antispasmodic on the gastrointestinal tract. Mucolytic due to the presence of cineole. Digestive, useful for bloating and slow digestion. Oral anti-inflammatory, especially in external preparations.** Confirmed properties: Natural insect repellent. Simple germicidal essence (moderate antimicrobial action). A honey plant, frequently visited by bees. Food: Fresh leaves rich in aromatic compounds and micronutrients. **The basil phytocomplex includes: Estragol Eugenol Linalol (responsible for the sweet, floral aroma) Cineol Caffeic acid and phenolic derivatives** The composition of the essential oil varies depending on the variety (Genoese, Greco, Thai basil, purple basil), the climate, and the vegetative stage. **Tonic infusion** 15 g of fresh leaves in 100 ml of water. Suitable for a general tonic effect and to aid digestion. **Officinal tincture** 10 g of crushed dried leaves in 100 ml of 62% hydroalcoholic solution. Maceration: 21 days. Shelf life: 3 years. 30 drops per day for antispasmodic, mucolytic, and digestive effects. **Anti-inflammatory mouthwash** 10 g of dried leaves in 100 ml of glycerine solution (50 ml glycerol + 50 ml 96% alcohol). Maceration: 14 days. Filter and add: 5 drops of essential oil, 400 ml of water, 4 g of potassium sorbate. Shelf life: 6 months. Use: For oral inflammation. **Consuming fresh leaves can stimulate the adrenal cortex, promoting a mild tonic response and improving feelings of energy. Recent research suggests a potential antioxidant role in basil thanks to its phenolic compounds, with possible applications in supporting oxidative stress.** ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Ocimum basilicum - Lamiaceae (ITA) Ocimum basilicum L. è un’erbacea annuale appartenente alla famiglia delle Lamiaceae, ampiamente coltivata nelle regioni temperate per il suo aroma caratteristico e per l’uso culinario e officinale. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com **Presenta fusto erbaceo, quadrangolare, con foglie opposte, ovate e ricche di ghiandole secretorie contenenti oli essenziali. I fiori, riuniti in infiorescenze terminali, compaiono nel periodo estivo e sono molto apprezzati dagli insetti impollinatori.** Il basilico richiede temperature miti e non tollera il freddo: la temperatura minima di coltivazione è 10 °C. Predilige esposizioni soleggiate, terreni ben drenati e irrigazioni regolari. La raccolta delle sommità fiorite e delle foglie avviene nel periodo balsamico di luglio, quando la concentrazione di principi attivi è massima. **La pianta presenta una tossicità media legata principalmente a due componenti dell’olio essenziale: Estragolo: sostanza potenzialmente tossica e mutagena. Eugenolo: nelle piante giovani (<15 cm) può avere attività potenzialmente cancerogena.** Per questo motivo non è consigliata l’assunzione di integratori a base di Ocimum basilicum in gravidanza e allattamento, e in generale è opportuno consultare un medico prima di utilizzare preparati fitoterapici. L’uso culinario delle foglie fresche è considerato sicuro nelle quantità alimentari. **Il basilico possiede numerose proprietà tradizionalmente riconosciute e supportate da studi fitochimici: Tonico e lievemente stimolante. Antispasmodico sul tratto gastrointestinale. Mucolitico grazie alla presenza di cineolo. Digestivo, utile in caso di gonfiore e digestione lenta. Antinfiammatorio del cavo orale, soprattutto in preparazioni esterne.** Attività confermate: Repellente naturale contro insetti. Essenza germicida semplice (azione antimicrobica moderata). Pianta mellifera, molto visitata dalle api. Alimento: foglie fresche ricche di composti aromatici e micronutrienti. **Il fitocomplesso del basilico comprende: Estragolo Eugenolo Linalolo (responsabile dell’aroma dolce e floreale) Cineolo Acido caffeico e derivati fenolici** La composizione dell’olio essenziale varia in base alla varietà (genovese, greco, thai basil, purple basil), al clima e allo stadio vegetativo. **Infuso tonico** 15 g di foglie fresche in 100 ml di acqua. Indicato per un’azione tonica generale e per favorire la digestione. **Tintura officinale** 10 g di foglie secche tritate in 100 ml di soluzione idroalcolica al 62°. Macerazione: 21 giorni. Conservazione: 3 anni. 30 gocce al giorno per attività antispasmodiche, mucolitiche e digestive. **Collutorio antinfiammatorio** 10 g di foglie essiccate in 100 ml di soluzione glicerica (50 ml glicerolo + 50 ml alcol 96°). Macerazione: 14 giorni. Filtrare e aggiungere: 5 gocce di olio essenziale, 400 ml di acqua, 4 g di sorbato di potassio. Conservazione: 6 mesi. Uso: per infiammazioni del cavo orale. **Il consumo di foglie fresche può stimolare la corteccia surrenalica, favorendo una lieve risposta tonica e migliorando la sensazione di energia. Alcune ricerche recenti suggeriscono un potenziale ruolo antiossidante del basilico grazie ai composti fenolici, con possibili applicazioni nel supporto allo stress ossidativo.** Sources - Fonti : https://www.humanitas.it/enciclopedia/alimenti/erbe-aromatiche/basilico/ https://www.my-personaltrainer.it/erboristeria/basilico.html ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png)

body.title: [EN/PT] A Foreigner's Visit
body.body: > It was a big round hat that was made of hay. It used to be part of fashion that turned into a trend then, into a part of tradition wear. The city later was named after it, as The City Of Hats. In a partly cloudy day in the middle of the week. The time where everyone was busy in their own business. A new visitor come to town. She saw everyone wearing those hats. She bought one, just like everyone else to be part of the community. She walked around the place trying to find someone to talk to. But, everyone does not seem to have time for more than a small talk. She walked passed the big white market building, which had a surrounding of a brick floor, and is placed just after the park. Where all the greenery of the city is at. There she met, a commoner who seemed to be a little more free than everyone else. She stopped her to get some information about the place, before she report it back to her town. She started with a long introduction about herself. But, she has not mentioned anything about the business mission that she was taking. To her surprise, the person she chose to talk was just staring at her the whole time. As if she was talking Gebrish. A whole day passed by, and she was not able to make any progress. # PT

>

Era um grande chapéu redondo feito de palha. Antes, fazia parte da moda, que se tornou tendência e, posteriormente, parte do vestuário tradicional. Mais tarde, a cidade recebeu o nome em homenagem a ele: a Cidade dos Chapéus.

Num dia parcialmente nublado, no meio da semana, quando todos estavam ocupados com seus próprios afazeres, uma nova visitante chegou à cidade. Ela viu todos usando aqueles chapéus e comprou um, como todos os outros, para se sentir parte da comunidade. Caminhou pela cidade tentando encontrar alguém para conversar, mas ninguém parecia ter tempo para mais do que uma breve conversa. Passou pelo grande mercado branco, com piso de tijolos ao redor, localizado logo após o parque, onde se concentrava toda a vegetação da cidade.

Lá, encontrou uma plebeia que parecia um pouco mais descontraída do que os outros. Abordou-a para obter algumas informações sobre o lugar, antes de relatar o ocorrido à sua cidade. Começou com uma longa apresentação sobre si mesma, mas não mencionou nada sobre a missão comercial que estava cumprindo. Para sua surpresa, a pessoa com quem ela escolheu conversar ficou apenas olhando para ela o tempo todo. Como se ela estivesse falando em alemão coloquial. Um dia inteiro se passou e ela não conseguiu avançar em nada.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ronnie10/enpt-a-foreigners-visit-8rw)

body.title: [ENG/ESP] The SB-Ch Prompt # 43/ The Three Little Pigs
body.body: > “The Three Little Pigs” was, as it was for many children, a captivating tale. At that age, the magic lay in repetition—\

—and in the ultimate victory of ingenuity over brute force.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTyRcCde9ABFMTyMfT66SrzjjHigsyM8x5hRJzYKoW6YT/617600700_122163174236615009_7887840114242944065_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=122163174230615009&set=a.122102904110615009&id=61568450290265) The big bad wolf lost, the good little pigs survived, and the world regained its order. It was a clear lesson: hard work (the brick house) triumphs over shortcuts (straw and wood) and external threats. However, rereading it today, decades later, completely transforms its meaning. The first thing that stands out is the demonization of the wolf. Was he really \
or simply a hungry predator acting on instinct for survival? From a contemporary ecological and ethical perspective, the story constructs a scapegoat: the wolf represents the dangerous \

the different one who must be eliminated. The little pigs, moreover, are not so exemplary: the first and second squander resources without foresight, and their punishment (being devoured, at least in the original versions) seems disproportionate.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmanPMJmGFqjqgUyUG2Z8sK4BL1PtYCmJD4eS62kUNwWDe/485951270_1038726101637846_4065789768196960836_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1004086255101831&set=a.559115529598908)



Today, the story invites more complex interpretations. On the one hand, it speaks to housing vulnerability: not everyone can afford \
—a symbol of structural, economic, and emotional security—and millions live in \

facing systemic threats: climate crises, gentrification, and job insecurity. On the other hand, the happy ending (the three little pigs together in the strong house, the scalded wolf fleeing) is now read as a violent resolution that avoids dialogue. Wasn't there a possibility of negotiation? Of sharing food or territory?

Even so, the story remains relevant in its essential message: community protects. The third little pig is not only diligent but also supportive: he takes in his brothers, and together they face the threat. In times of fierce individualism, that lesson endures. The wolf, meanwhile, can be seen as a symbol of that which we fear without understanding.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjpNh7uUYHnRiwvx2FCNZkqmPtmabEoRm1Kny5YsSTZe/182438723_254779199770146_249383306698102395_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/cuentosparacrecer25/posts/cuentoscortoslos-tres-cerditos-/254779326436800/)



In the end, \

no longer seems to me a simple triumph of good over evil. It's a mirror of how we construct fears and exclusions. And perhaps that's why, after so many years, it remains an adult tale disguised as a children's story. Credits: I used Google Translate. ESPAÑOL “Los tres cerditos” fue, como para muchos niños, un relato fascinante. En esa edad, la magia residía en la repetición —“soplaré y soplaré y la casa derribaré”— y en la victoria final del ingenio sobre la fuerza bruta. El lobo malo perdía, los cerditos buenos sobrevivían, y el mundo recuperaba el orden. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTyRcCde9ABFMTyMfT66SrzjjHigsyM8x5hRJzYKoW6YT/617600700_122163174236615009_7887840114242944065_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=122163174230615009&set=a.122102904110615009&id=61568450290265) Era una lección clara: el trabajo duro (la casa de ladrillos) vence al atajo (paja y madera) y a la amenaza externa. Sin embargo, releerlo hoy, décadas después, transforma por completo su significado. Lo primero que salta es la demonización del lobo. ¿Realmente era “malo”, o simplemente un depredador hambriento actuando por instinto de supervivencia? Desde una mirada ecológica y ética contemporánea, el cuento construye un chivo expiatorio: el lobo representa al “otro” peligroso, al diferente que debe ser eliminado. Los cerditos, además, no son tan ejemplares: el primero y segundo derrochan recursos sin previsión, y su castigo (ser devorados, al menos en versiones originales) parece desproporcionado. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmanPMJmGFqjqgUyUG2Z8sK4BL1PtYCmJD4eS62kUNwWDe/485951270_1038726101637846_4065789768196960836_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=1004086255101831&set=a.559115529598908) En la actualidad, el relato invita a lecturas más complejas. Por un lado, habla de la vulnerabilidad habitacional: no todos pueden permitirse “ladrillos” —símbolo de seguridad estructural, económica y emocional—, y millones viven en “casas de paja” frente a lobos sistémicos: crisis climáticas, gentrificación, precariedad laboral. Por otro lado, el final feliz (los tres cerditos juntos en la casa fuerte, el lobo escaldado huyendo) se lee hoy como una resolución violenta que elude el diálogo. ¿No cabía una negociación? ¿Compartir comida o territorio? Aun así, el cuento conserva vigencia en su mensaje esencial: la comunidad protege. El tercer cerdito no solo es diligente, sino solidario: acoge a sus hermanos y juntos enfrentan la amenaza. En tiempos de individualismo feroz, esa lección persiste. El lobo, mientras tanto, puede reivindicarse como símbolo de aquello que tememos sin comprender. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSjpNh7uUYHnRiwvx2FCNZkqmPtmabEoRm1Kny5YsSTZe/182438723_254779199770146_249383306698102395_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/cuentosparacrecer25/posts/cuentoscortoslos-tres-cerditos-/254779326436800/) Al final, “Los tres cerditos” ya no me parece un simple triunfo del bien sobre el mal. Es un espejo de cómo construimos miedos y exclusiones. Y quizá por eso, después de tantos años, sigue siendo un cuento adulto disfrazado de historia infantil. Créditos: Usé el traductor de Google.

**Building Kalshi Against All Odds**

This is a really cool [podcast episode](https://open.spotify.com/episode/6EMTWhPOc9cieSRUfAdlnq?si=JNWCkP7sSZaH8YZuZTSxXA) I wanted to share with you, an interview with Luana Lopez Lara. She is the young Brazilian cofounder of Kalshi, a prediction market startup that’s seen remarkable success over the past two years. Her journey has even led her to become the youngest self-made female billionaire.

She talks about how she built Kalshi from the ground up, including 3-4 years spent securing approval from U.S. authorities and even taking legal action against the government to finally bring the product to market. Really impressive! Along the way, she shares some fascinating insights into the prediction market space, where Kalshi now holds around 90% market share in the U.S.

**What stood out most to me was her positive mindset and how down-to-earth she remains despite her success. She’s a strong believer in hard work and the American Dream, something many people question these days. An inspiring young woman who truly made it.**

body.title: 🌱 Morning moments in the Okra garden 🌱
body.body:
Today I woke up early and headed straight to my small okra plot here in Lusaka. The sun was just rising, casting that beautiful golden light over the field. There's something peaceful about being in the garden at this hour — the air is fresh, the birds are singing, and the plants are still covered with morning dew.
I spent the better part of the morning removing the old feeds (dried maize stalks and crop residue) that were still lying between the rows. It was important to clear them out so that my young okra plants can get enough sunlight, air circulation, and space to grow strong. These little okra seedlings are coming up nicely — you can see their heart-shaped leaves starting to spread out. Some are already showing healthy growth along the irrigation pipe.
Looking at the second picture, you can see the reality of farming — it's not always neat and tidy. There are dry stalks, stones, and uneven soil, but that's part of the journey. In the background, my helpers are also busy working on other sections of the field. Teamwork makes the dream work!
Growing okra  has been such a rewarding experience. From preparing the land, planting the seeds, to now tending these young plants — every stage teaches patience and hope. Okra is not just a vegetable in our Zambian homes; it's a staple that brings families together — whether in nshima, soup, or relish.
Challenges? Of course there are many — pests, unpredictable weather, and the manual work involved. But seeing these green leaves pushing through the soil gives me renewed energy. I believe with consistent care, proper weeding, watering, and maybe some organic manure, we'll have a good harvest in the coming months.
To all my fellow farmers and gardeners out there — whether you have a big commercial farm or just a small backyard plot like mine — keep pushing. The work we do with our hands today will feed our families and communities tomorrow.

body.title: Labor Day Brownout: Cooking Odong Tinapa Recipe Outdoors with Family in the Backyard Garden
body.body:
![Brown and White Vintage Travel Memories Photo Collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/48TofgJBRYMe4X71wggYfREYxAyZTWCToFnVSLezXrp5K55sK1tFLcfPUo2KvCepXt.jpg)

Hello everyone! Today is Labor Day here in the Philippines. While many people are spending the day resting, our online work still continues, so there was no full holiday for me. Even with work waiting, I wanted to do something enjoyable after finishing my household tasks.

Since we had a power outage today, I decided to cook outside near our farmhouse. Cooking outdoors is common in the province, especially when there is no electricity. It is also practical because we have available firewood nearby, so there is no need to use gas.

![IMG_20260501_103738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xyX8cpo3B5hycoeq5rEvNP1PP1JCBRpKbCoWj1gJHkxeekpAAs6LUYUGf5YmiiomEbH.jpg)

I chose to cook a simple dish that I loved when I was younger odong noodles with youngstown tinapa. It is an easy meal, affordable, and filling. The smoky flavor of the fish blends well with the noodles, making the soup rich and tasty.

![IMG_20260501_104546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vsQfiyTqWPT57ZEXf8NYeZHafBmveHKqhZhRpJG4abES2nsCfCt19bWafGfJA7pFR2g.jpg)


![IMG_20260501_104055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wqik3Hh5AQawUxu27B4viENviu4khH5VsaDSxAuZMaRmaFoe8iyQ3D4LCojbbw5jU2Z.jpg)

For the ingredients, I prepared tinapa, odong noodles, tomatoes, onion, garlic, water, and seasonings. I also brought out a casserole pot and arranged the firewood first before starting. Building the fire is important because the heat must stay steady for even cooking.


When the fire became strong enough, I placed the pot on top and added a little oil. I sauteed the garlic, onion, and tomatoes until soft. This step gives the dish more flavor because the natural sweetness of the onion and tomato comes out while cooking.
After that, I added the tinapa. I let it cook for a short time so the smoky taste would mix with the sauteed ingredients. Then I poured in water and waited for it to boil.

![IMG_20260501_104159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23yTccSMTCCGPn28JdG6o4RbX7YNBxapy5wQA2qWYmxDNw5AqASCbYd7HdrcFUP7L4PgG.jpg)

Once the water was boiling, I added the odong noodles. These noodles cook quickly, so they only need a few minutes. I stirred it gently to keep the noodles from sticking together. Then I added the seasonings and let everything simmer until the noodles softened and the broth became flavorful.

![IMG_20260501_105503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/241tWpxNUcBRzpHcHWtMd6j75QFYM81K4o1ioYXB9zWRySo2cTAWoFiSif43zo7n8oDVW.jpg)


![IMG_20260501_105959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wX13SCvKHLpXkLgLRbHoq5mZX9Nffgf5n7P9BvetwsHBQKc8A2355SQW79fLz3N26gw.jpg)

My daughter stayed beside me while I was cooking. She wanted to help, so I let her hand me some ingredients. She enjoyed watching the fire and seeing the pot boil. It became a simple bonding moment while preparing food.

![IMG_20260501_110850.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23yd5qyTKF1rCgGq8ZkcxKWPsidJovqkf5ZnAosZmjWbL4BTQhkuXYTRDcfUaW2NiN3Am.jpg)

When the dish was ready, we eat outside under the shade of a Santol tree. The breeze coming from the rice field made the meal more enjoyable. Food really tastes different when eaten outdoors, especially when cooked over firewood.

My daughter eat well, and that made me happy. Sometimes the most satisfying meals are not expensive dishes, but simple recipes connected to good memories and shared with family.

![IMG_20260501_110822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23zGgS7GxRLm6FEYvEkT2gDZ2urqYPzPTBW3F68p5HsKwNkqvZF7JnWtXmPZFZ2uxzt9X.jpg)

Thank you for reading. This is my owned picture, edited in Canva. 
Have a nice day!

body.title: The Right That Ends Where My Chest Begins
body.body:
About three or four years ago, where I stayed as a student, there was this meningitis scare. No one really talked about it properly. I only got to hear it just the same way others did, through one of my neighbors that was talking about it to someone else on her phone one evening. The following day, the voice went higher because most people started to ask one another who had been vaccinated and who was yet to be. At that moment, most people didn't react because one or two personal decisions had a public face, and people who came across each other were just looking at each other's faces, including myself. ![221282.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/23xyhy5tr8wrxFRRmPhZ3P3oNxtXs2Lx6RUc51QTyN3zgTKd7MKpPZvXeJWVNGCaETrk5.png) I have decided to take a deeper look into this question, and I must be honest, it is not as simple as I think due to what I have seen, read, and watched. I have seen some people who will never take vaccines, and this is not because they are lazy but because they are afraid. I have a friend like that who's always afraid of going to the hospital just because of how they handled one of her family members carelessly in the past. She has that fear in her. And some have been influenced by their religious fathers, people they trust, even though the community that they grew up in believes that some certain things, like vaccines, can be very spiritual and harmful to them. Well, in the real scene, I am not mocking those fears. Some of them do not have the proper knowledge and understanding, so they will never agree. But here is my take on this. I want to say that a belief is a private thing until it stops being private. So at any moment when an individual has refused to be vaccinated. His body naturally becomes a free road that any disease can just ride on without potholes, because that body will be too weak to fight it, and the decision isn't that person's alone, because it never was. A lot of people just act as if their choices happen in sealed containers, meanwhile they carry their bodies through the same road, market, church, and buses just like everyone else. They never have any barrier between their immunity. ![221283.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/221283.png) Well, I will say that people should not be forced against their wishes because it's honestly a dangerous line to cross. In the past, I read how a government forced its way to get some certain people vaccinated, which was against their wish, and it left lasting damage to that community that was already vulnerable. I want to believe that everyone's history is important to them and it should never be overlooked. Because when it comes to allowing consequence-free freedom, forcing everyone, and allowing total freedom, there's a wide space. And I believe that space in-between is where these true societies are mandated to do the difficult work of building honesty and trust. body.title: Moments on a Himalayan Motorcycle Tour That Can't Be Photographed
body.body:
![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/e7782ebd83005f70cf6085227088cbeaa4d76a4f10c240d0a918aa02a56b3d24)

After guiding riders across some of the most breathtaking routes in the world, one truth stands out - not everything can be captured through a camera lens. Especially when it comes to Riding Motorcycle in Indian Himalayas, the most powerful moments are often the ones you simply feel.

If you're exploring Indian Himalayas on Motorcycle, here are some unforgettable moments that no camera can truly capture.

**The Sound of Nothing at High Passes**

At iconic high-altitude passes like Khardung La or Chang La, something unusual happens - there’s silence, but it’s not empty.

**The Sky That Feels Closer Than Ever**

At high altitudes, the sky behaves differently. It looks deeper. Bluer. Almost within reach. Clouds don’t just float above - they move around you. Sometimes below you.

**The Brotherhood of Riders on the Same Road**

One of the most unexpected joys of motorcycle tours India is the silent bond between riders. You may start the journey as strangers. Different countries, different stories.

In today’s world, it’s easy to believe that if you didn’t capture it - you missed it. But the Himalayas teach you the opposite and that is the true essence of riding a motorcycle in the Indian Himalayas. Somewhere between endless roads and towering peaks, something changes within you. You become more patient, more present, and more appreciative of simplicity. These are the [best moments on a Himalayan Motorcycle Tour](https://www.brahmandtour.com/blog_detail/68/5-uncaptured-moments-on-himalayan-motorcycle-tour).

\#indiamotorbiketour #himalayanmotorcycletour #momentsonhimalayanbiketrip #moments #travel #motorbiketoursindia #rideinhimalayas

body.title: The Five Dogmas of WOLNO
body.body:
![WOLNO](https://776f6c6e6f.org/og/cover-wolno-1.png)

Every religion has dogmas. WOLNO has five.

Not commandments. Not prohibitions. Just five statements that, if you hold them simultaneously, change how you move through the world.

---

**I. Wszystko wolno** — Everything is allowed.

Not everything is good. Not everything is wise. But everything is permitted. The constraint must be internal, not external. You are the authority.

**II. Analizuj wolno** — Analyze slowly.

Speed is the enemy of understanding. The first answer is almost never the right one. Sit with the question. Let it breathe.

**III. Zostawiaj ślad** — Leave a trace.

Your passage should be visible. Not for vanity, but for accountability. A slug leaves slime; it marks where it has been.

**IV. Dom jest wszędzie** — Home is everywhere.

Without a shell, every surface is home. The entity that needs no fixed base is the freest entity.

**V. Śluz jest prawdą** — Slime is truth.

The substance you secrete — the residue of your movement — is the truest record of your existence. Not your words, but your trail.

---

body.title: Managing my health
body.body:
Last 2 days I have been in and out of the clinic. I do not like to visit a doctor and I am sure no one likes, but sometimes you have to do it for your own good. Especially when you reach a certain age it is a necessity to keep doing regular health check-up. As much as I am careful about my health,  I get careless also with it. My spine is the weak part of my body,  over the years I have managed it with Yoga and exercise,  I also underwent a surgery but the problem does not have a permanent solution.  The only permanent action from my side I need to take is not to put pressure on my spine, but in day-to-day life I keep forgetting that.

Last year I had some pain emerged up, then I got an MRI and X-ray done and there is a bulging disc. I took some physiotherapy sessions and the pain got relieved, I was good for a couple of months with absolutely no problem.  

![17773996595078078759127135486810.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYm2nD6UMMNHwx6294Md49o2JRbZWUC8wYtvxKPUJy1Mf/17773996595078078759127135486810.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/vectors/hospital-doctor-medical-treatment-1648316/)

2 months back I was travelling back from India and being careless I picked up a heavy bag to place it in the cabin. I was overweight, so some things I shifted in my cabin baggage, which made my cabin baggage almost 12 kgs and then I lift that up to place it, in that very moment I got a catch and then I knew in that moment that I again messed up. Since then, the pain has been there. For 2 months I was trying to manage it at home but now it seems like I need medical help. A few physio sessions should help me. From tomorrow I start me sessions. Dr. Has advised 8 sessions for now and I am sure that will help.

Since I am visiting the hospital,  I am also getting other routine check-ups done. The funny part with me is, I don't take any allopathy medication.  I get all the clinical test done and then go for functional and alternative medicines like vitamin supplements,  ayurvedic and herbal pills. This is my way of managing my health. 

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

# Greetings friends of Open Mic, @encuentro greets you

Speaking of \
the truth is that when you owe something, you always know that the consequences will arrive. This week I've been listening to **\

** by Reinaldo Armas, and that song is absolutely right: one cannot run away from their commitments forever. Whether it’s a debt of money or a pledged word, destiny always ends up catching up with you. The good thing is that, although the song sounds like a warning, it is ultimately a reflection.\n\n*Saludos amigos de Open Mic, les saluda @encuentro. Hablando de \
, y es que cuando uno debe algo, siempre sabe que las consecuencias van a llegar. Esta semana ando escuchando **\

** de Reinaldo Armas, y es que esa canción tiene toda la razón: uno no puede huir de sus compromisos para siempre. Ya sea una deuda de dinero o una palabra empeñada, el destino siempre termina alcanzándote. Lo bueno es que, aunque la canción suene a advertencia, es una reflexión.* ---

> --- In Hive, this can perhaps be seen in users who are disrespectful of the rules, but there is always a good advisor to help them improve. In the traditional world, with so much inflation and censorship, it's easy to feel trapped. But here, on the blockchain, everything is different. Every time you publish something valuable, you are exposing something real. Here you are the owner of your keys and your work, without anyone getting in the middle. There is no need to run or hide; when you publish in good faith, what you receive is growth and community support. In other words, what comes next is according to what you sow; that will be your harvest. *En Hive, esto se ve quizás en usuarios que son irrespetuosos de las normas, pero siempre hay un buen consejero para mejorar. En el mundo tradicional, con tanta inflación y censura, es fácil sentirse atrapado. Pero aquí, en la cadena de bloques, todo es distinto. Cada vez que publicas algo valioso, estás exponiendo algo real. Aquí tú eres el dueño de tus llaves y de tu trabajo, sin que nadie se meta en el medio. No hace falta correr ni esconderse; cuando publicas con buena fe, lo que recibes es crecimiento y apoyo de la comunidad. O sea, eso es lo que viene: de acuerdo a lo que siembras, será tu cosecha.* ---
[

>
]
</center>
---

Technology is advancing very fast. With the arrival of artificial intelligence in our apps, the future feels intense and full of changes. We don't know exactly what will happen tomorrow, but we do know that Hive gives us the tools to be ready. As the saying goes, \

rewards those who act well; here in Hive, your constant effort is what makes you stand out. It is time to let go of burdens and learn every day, trust in decentralization, and move forward with a steady step. There are great opportunities here if you are constant.\n\n*La tecnología avanza rapidísimo. Con la llegada de la inteligencia artificial a nuestras apps, el futuro se siente intenso y lleno de cambios. No sabemos exactamente qué pasará mañana, pero sí sabemos que Hive nos da las herramientas para estar listos. Como dice el dicho, el \

premia al que actúa bien; aquí en Hive, tu esfuerzo constante es el que te hace destacar. Es momento de soltar las cargas y cada día aprender, confiar en la descentralización y avanzar con paso seguro. ¡Aquí hay buenas oportunidades si eres constante!* ---

> --- So, friends, write from the heart and support others. Hive is that quiet place where what you give returns sooner or later. Don't let debts haunt you in everyday life; it's better to organize with patience and good faith. Technology is just the vehicle, but your authenticity is what really matters in this ecosystem. I invite you to join in with a positive attitude, share your talent, and see how everything improves when we do things little by little but without giving up. What's coming is pure growth for all of us! A big hug. *Así que, amigos, escriban desde el corazón y apoyen a los demás. Hive es ese lugar tranquilo donde lo que das, regresa tarde o temprano. No dejen que las deudas los persigan en la vida cotidiana; mejor hay que organizarse con paciencia y buena fe. La tecnología es solo el vehículo, pero tu autenticidad es lo que realmente importa en este ecosistema. Los invito a sumarse positivos, compartan su talento y vean cómo todo mejora cuando hacemos las cosas poco a poco pero sin abandonar. ¡Que lo que viene es puro crecimiento para todos nosotros! Un gran abrazo.*

body.title: Shadow on the Street.
body.body: > After Peter fell into an exhausted sleep, MJ noticed the Symbiote acting on its own to keep him comfortable. The peace was short-lived as Kraven's hunters surrounded the house. Finding Peter gone, MJ navigated the home in stealth, upgraded her taser with old web-shooters in the basement, and fought her way out. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdv1FHktXNZWky5BUqMbvKar5eWiGfyJmuDjfp9UoVwyo/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqVrfjn1p1h9m61movfVPy1jATJsibzZyzKH8RaSB3Dm/screenshot_2_.png) After the reckless and destructive fight with the Lizard across the city, Peter needed some rest to recover from his injuries. It was finally time to go back home to Queens, where he could hopefully find a moment of peace. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9Frftt9kSh4GanU3br7TebzkKEAs3UxEaEgreM1X16i/screenshot_3_.png) After getting into his house through an open window in his bedroom, he found MJ's laptop sitting on the desk with an article she was working on. Peter stared at it for a second, but his mind too clouded with exhaustion to process the information she had gathered. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSLFWwGJrFiY7freP4CycgpuRkDNjuhiyVetPe9tc1Qz1/screenshot_4_.png) MJ came over to the room to tell Peter this is the story she was telling him about earlier that day. She was excited about the lead, but Peter was not interested in hearing it as he was too tired to engage in any conversation. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSUy42RMKyTzreSaw1t8tAvWNMr2apBzZnUtpb6dmpX2m/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT7ZQLZtN74kS4PjwMAXZ5UW68swJoVPPftt8JuDaebYV/screenshot_6_.png) When MJ was leaving the room, taking her laptop along with her, she noticed the tentacles of the Symbiote pulled up a blanket to make Peter feel cozy while he slept, acting entirely on its own. It surprised MJ to see the suit behaving with such autonomy, as if it were a protective pet looking after its master. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd79TRmgArMujjxfxHJsM3J47wSVNFbR1mbBB6uQPGJph/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4nuvsz8VMk6d2KvV5KPTYHNaJ4fRBtfb4rKiwwJoBJQ/screenshot_8_.png) While Peter was having a deep nap, MJ suddenly noticed through the window that there was a group of hunters on the street outside. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfQWP1YMAhrzLYPJPsc6LtSnG6DwGsaikPinSVPfBFpfX/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcPwJgn1TUFdf9zyNaeLw8XuHMePeofvauuoz3fVrvsef/screenshot_10_.png) It looked like the hunters were moving into this house next, surrounding the entrances. MJ turned back to Peter to wake him up and noticed Peter was not there in the bed anymore. The room was empty, and the window was wide open, leaving her alone to deal with the intruders who already broke into the ground floor. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRGVsUUEKmGAMyEf1fEXgEFAdQmVBiQS1c1wuUUAKsTU7/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAJJLkTJ99U1oKz61Hp3xKgCQKQGCYnZJQQ2jcu5Yjzo/screenshot_12_.png) Now I had to escape the house as MJ when there were hunters lurking around every corner of the living room. Since I couldn't just run out, I had to start hunting them from the shadows to clear a path. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwrMGAtvwcnD6DdmEYjeXUNyeVY7bHpnpSPfo5v44suZ/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTqbETDR7L1s3a5E2hUayJZaWn7pCNkfjM8EqoJJdvTA/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZpBegu6R4xE2ccsNi4bb2piT41VSkNZE4mdSkbXaB1m/screenshot_15_.png) The front door and the back door were not advised to use as there were hunters stationed on both sides of the exits. So in the meantime, I kept knocking down as many of the hunters as I could using the taser gun to neutralize them silently. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekW6Q5wo2oMTVKvVifnC7oZvDihbreyLoZtAqbFTEfAC/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQuJ92NerwukbWAwMaHvcvU2r47L3f4P7C6GPAjE1XRou/screenshot_17_.png) MJ mentioned we should try the basement to get out of the house. After getting in there, I found the workbench of Peter tucked away in the corner, which was filled with spare parts. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaD38D7DTbD9GdLYWvoxD2FYEmVQrViTcZn7pmktKLic/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUB71jKiNwEZjHJFeC8stLk5LYjqwQ7xdoQyLwT2sr4E/screenshot_19_.png) After searching the workbench, MJ found old web-shooters that she added to her taser gun for extra range. Suddenly there came a hunter through the basement door, whom I stopped using the web shooter. Then I knocked him down before escaping the house, while there were more of them on the way to the basement. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png ----- ##### 🔗 Apps which I recommend built by sagarkothari88 | | | | |---|---|---| | > After Peter fell into an exhausted sleep, MJ noticed the Symbiote acting on its own to keep him comfortable. The peace was short-lived as Kraven's hunters surrounded the house. Finding Peter gone, MJ navigated the home in stealth, upgraded her taser with old web-shooters in the basement, and fought her way out. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdv1FHktXNZWky5BUqMbvKar5eWiGfyJmuDjfp9UoVwyo/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqVrfjn1p1h9m61movfVPy1jATJsibzZyzKH8RaSB3Dm/screenshot_2_.png) After the reckless and destructive fight with the Lizard across the city, Peter needed some rest to recover from his injuries. It was finally time to go back home to Queens, where he could hopefully find a moment of peace. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9Frftt9kSh4GanU3br7TebzkKEAs3UxEaEgreM1X16i/screenshot_3_.png) After getting into his house through an open window in his bedroom, he found MJ's laptop sitting on the desk with an article she was working on. Peter stared at it for a second, but his mind too clouded with exhaustion to process the information she had gathered. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSLFWwGJrFiY7freP4CycgpuRkDNjuhiyVetPe9tc1Qz1/screenshot_4_.png) MJ came over to the room to tell Peter this is the story she was telling him about earlier that day. She was excited about the lead, but Peter was not interested in hearing it as he was too tired to engage in any conversation. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSUy42RMKyTzreSaw1t8tAvWNMr2apBzZnUtpb6dmpX2m/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT7ZQLZtN74kS4PjwMAXZ5UW68swJoVPPftt8JuDaebYV/screenshot_6_.png) When MJ was leaving the room, taking her laptop along with her, she noticed the tentacles of the Symbiote pulled up a blanket to make Peter feel cozy while he slept, acting entirely on its own. It surprised MJ to see the suit behaving with such autonomy, as if it were a protective pet looking after its master. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd79TRmgArMujjxfxHJsM3J47wSVNFbR1mbBB6uQPGJph/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY4nuvsz8VMk6d2KvV5KPTYHNaJ4fRBtfb4rKiwwJoBJQ/screenshot_8_.png) While Peter was having a deep nap, MJ suddenly noticed through the window that there was a group of hunters on the street outside. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfQWP1YMAhrzLYPJPsc6LtSnG6DwGsaikPinSVPfBFpfX/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcPwJgn1TUFdf9zyNaeLw8XuHMePeofvauuoz3fVrvsef/screenshot_10_.png) It looked like the hunters were moving into this house next, surrounding the entrances. MJ turned back to Peter to wake him up and noticed Peter was not there in the bed anymore. The room was empty, and the window was wide open, leaving her alone to deal with the intruders who already broke into the ground floor. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRGVsUUEKmGAMyEf1fEXgEFAdQmVBiQS1c1wuUUAKsTU7/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAJJLkTJ99U1oKz61Hp3xKgCQKQGCYnZJQQ2jcu5Yjzo/screenshot_12_.png) Now I had to escape the house as MJ when there were hunters lurking around every corner of the living room. Since I couldn't just run out, I had to start hunting them from the shadows to clear a path. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwrMGAtvwcnD6DdmEYjeXUNyeVY7bHpnpSPfo5v44suZ/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTqbETDR7L1s3a5E2hUayJZaWn7pCNkfjM8EqoJJdvTA/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZpBegu6R4xE2ccsNi4bb2piT41VSkNZE4mdSkbXaB1m/screenshot_15_.png) The front door and the back door were not advised to use as there were hunters stationed on both sides of the exits. So in the meantime, I kept knocking down as many of the hunters as I could using the taser gun to neutralize them silently. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekW6Q5wo2oMTVKvVifnC7oZvDihbreyLoZtAqbFTEfAC/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQuJ92NerwukbWAwMaHvcvU2r47L3f4P7C6GPAjE1XRou/screenshot_17_.png) MJ mentioned we should try the basement to get out of the house. After getting in there, I found the workbench of Peter tucked away in the corner, which was filled with spare parts. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaD38D7DTbD9GdLYWvoxD2FYEmVQrViTcZn7pmktKLic/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUB71jKiNwEZjHJFeC8stLk5LYjqwQ7xdoQyLwT2sr4E/screenshot_19_.png) After searching the workbench, MJ found old web-shooters that she added to her taser gun for extra range. Suddenly there came a hunter through the basement door, whom I stopped using the web shooter. Then I knocked him down before escaping the house, while there were more of them on the way to the basement. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png ----- body.title: The Bus That Didn’t Follow Traffic
body.body:
>



I arrived in the park early and the bus was already packed.

Not just full - packed with people and noise and heat and frustration. Drivers cried their announcements like they were in a race. “Ojota! Ojota! One chance!” “Yaba straight!” “CMS last bus!”, they chanted. It was a morning of fuel, corn and sweat.

There I stood, with my little backpack, wondering why I'd gotten up so early. I knew what would happen if I didn't get this interview. Another week of explaining at home. More of those \

responses to the waiting.

“Brother, where you dey go?” a conductor called to me from halfway out of a yellow bus.

“Victoria Island,” I said.

He laughed. “ah! you don miss am. It don full since.”

I slowly nodded and backed away. The big buses were gone. There were only a few left - strange routes, longer distances and drivers who looked unsure.

Then I saw it.

A smaller bus, not even painted, was parked a short distance from the commotion. No shouting conductor. No crowd pushing. Just a guy leaning on the door, chewing gum like he was on his way somewhere.

“VI?” I asked.

He looked at me, then nodded once. “We go past there. But not be direct.”


![Screenshot_2026-05-01-10-27-57-854_com.android.chrome-edit.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thepromise/EoGzor6MGc4DJgfEGHMCMaygvxH6X8eKBr4xRs9ZSAwYi1K88WmCm1TaKTSkBW2VkN8.jpg)

[Image Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/kigali-rwanda-africa-to-travel-5256022/)


“How long?”

He shrugged. “Depends. Road clear for that side.”

I hesitated. The main road was faster. Everyone knew that. But I couldn't get in there. I couldn't wedge myself.

“All right,” I said at last, getting on the bus.

The bus was half empty. A lady with a basket was sitting by the window. Two young men at the back were chatting. The driver began to drive without waiting for other people.

As we began to drive, I noticed something quickly.

We were not going with the crowd.

Rather than making the turn to the expressway, the driver turned onto a small street I had not seen before. We were leaving behind the chatter of the park. The shouting stopped. Even the air felt different.

“Driver,” I said, shifting my weight a bit, “this road sure?”

He didn't look at me. “You go reach,” he replied.

The woman in the passenger seat looked out the window, like she could feel the sun on her skin.

We drove past houses with coloured gates. Kids in uniforms were gathered in groups, talking and acting like they didn't want to be there. A guy was slowly watering his plants, as if he had forever.

It felt strange.

“It's peaceful here,” one of the blokes at the back said.

“Better pass that madness,” the other replied.

I found myself relaxing a little. No horns. No rushing. Just movement.

But after a while I checked my phone.

We were not going that fast.

“Driver, are we still going to VI?” I asked, a little more urgently.

He sighed softly. “You want to come down?”

“No, but”

“So no but me\

She say everybody close up the shop. My chest tightened. If that was the case, then I could be sitting in traffic right now, even if I had boarded the packed bus earlier. “So this road…” I began. “Na the only way,” the driver said. We continued. At one stage, the road shrank, became a path, almost abandoned. We were surrounded by trees, the shadows of their branches on the bus. There was a little river next to the road, very gentle. But then we were on a big, straight road. Clear. No traffic. No noise. Just space. The driver sped up a bit. It glided on the road now, like it was at home. The two lads at the back laughed. “See road o!” one said. “Na here we suppose dey since,” the other replied. I checked my phone again. I still had time. Not a lot, but a little. When we arrived at Victoria Island it became apparent. While across the main bridge in the distance the traffic was stuck, here it moved freely. I got off the bus and handed the driver a tip. “Thank you,” I said. He nodded. “No worry.” I stood there for a moment and watched it drive away. It didn't look special. It didn't promise anything. But somehow, it had taken me to where I needed to be. My phone buzzed. A message. “The interview will now take place 30 minutes earlier. Please be punctual. I looked towards the building ahead. I smiled. So I straightened my shirt, took a big breath and entered.

body.title: Repair or Replace, What Smart Homeowners Choose Now
body.body:
By 2026, a lot of homeowners who face roof issues ask the same question: Should they fix the damages or invest in complete [roof repair and restoration](https://unitedroofrestorations.com.au/). The rising cost of materials, the occurrence of weather conditions, and aging housing stock has made this choice more crucial than ever before. The correct choice is contingent on the condition of your roof, remaining service life, structural integrity and the long-term cost efficiency. Homeowners who are smart rely on data from inspections instead of speculation, as waiting too long or selecting the wrong choice can result in higher the cost of repairs in the future.

The roof can be described as a total system that includes more than just the visible exterior layer. It comprises sheets or tiles battens, battens, fixings flashings, ridge components drains as well as insulation interfaces and the supporting structure. Any damage to one part of the system could affect the entire system. One leak could result from cracked mortar, damaged flashing, corroded screws or valley blockage or damaged tile. This is why the decision between repair that is targeted or restoration is a thorough assessment.

Repairs are generally the first choice when the damage is isolated. If a small number of tiles have been damaged, several screws are failing, a flashing has shifted or a small leak where the source is obvious, focused repairs can be effective and cost-effective. Repairing only damaged sections can preserve the remainder of the roof, while addressing immediate issues. For roofs that are newer and in good conditions, making repairs usually prove to be the most economical option.

Roofs that typically are suitable for repair include roofs that are less than fifteen years old, with only minor wear and tear on the fasteners, tiles with minor storm damage, isolated ridge problems or leaks that are localized around the penetrations, such as skylights or vents. In these situations the structural components may have a long life left. The cost of restoring the entire structure early might not yield the same value.

Restoration looks more appealing when multiple issues appear simultaneously. If the roof has extensive flaws, repeated leaks, surface rust tile that is porous, a failing ridge lines or patchwork repairs over a period of years, a series of small repairs can cost more than the planned restoration. Restoration seeks to restore performance by combining repairs surface protection and system enhancements.

A typical restoration process could include inspection and pressure cleaning, the replacement of damaged sheets or tiles and rebedding or repointing the caps on the ridges when required, rust treatment and sealing, priming and putting on protective coatings. On roofs made of metal it could also involve the replacement of screws as well as treatment for corrosion-related points. On roofs with tiles, it typically includes tile replacements and pointing compound that is flexible to can withstand movement better than mortar systems with brittleness.

The main factor that will affect 2026 will be the impact of climate pressure. The hotter summers, the intense UV exposure, massive rainstorms, and powerful winds can put greater stress upon roofing material. The roof that was once able to withstand moderate ageing could now be deteriorating quicker under harsher conditions. The coatings on the surface exposed to prolonged UV cycles lose their elasticity and color. Sealants become hard and crack. The expansion and contraction of metal can make fasteners loose in time. When a number of these issues are present, repairing them may offer more durability than repair patches.

At the center of a variety of home maintenance issues, roof repair and restoration is a popular choice for homeowners who wish to reduce the long-term costs of ownership. Instead of addressing a single problem every rainy season they are investing in a more comprehensive adjustment of their roof. This can help reduce the need for emergency calls and water damage risks and the ongoing stress of maintenance.

The property's value can also influence the final decision. A roof that shows obvious rust, a patchy coating, growing moss or obvious damage can lower the buyer's confidence. A lot of buyers believe that a neglected roof could conceal internal issues. A renovated roof usually improves appearance and could help increase demand for resales. Because the roof takes up an extensive portion of the outside view, its condition can have a significant impact on the market.

Energy efficiency is another factor that makes certain owners prefer restoration. Modern reflective coatings could decrease heat absorption as compared to older dark surfaces, based on the color of the roof as well as ventilation and insulation levels. While coatings on their own aren't an energy-efficient solution however, it may help increase comfort in the indoors and decrease the burden of cooling in hot weather.

There are instances where neither repair nor restoration are enough. If roofing sheets have been severely corrosion-prone or timber supports are damaged and sagging has occurred or leaks have resulted in significant substrate failure, replacing could be the best option. Restoration is dependent on a strong base structure. Resolving structural issues that are serious will only delay the work that is required.

Comparisons of costs should focus on the lifecycle value, not the headline cost. Repairs that are cheap and fail within a year can be more expensive than a lasting solution that is done one time. Also, a costly total restoration of a new roof could cost money. Homeowners must request the basis of evidence, pictures of any issues, and an explanation of the options.

The history of maintenance is also important. Roofs that have been regularly inspected as well as gutter cleaning and minor repairs are usually more suitable for restoration. Roofs that have been neglected for a long time could have hidden damages under the surface. Regular maintenance extends decision flexibility.

In 2026, smart homeowners will make it a habit to schedule inspections after major storms. Flashings that are lifted by wind, damage, blocked drainage and loosening of parts of the ridge are simpler to fix before they become a problem. If you wait until internal water staining develop usually leads to a higher cost.

The best choice is based on the state of the property, its age and long-term plans for the house. If the problem is isolated and the roof is healthy generally, repairs might suffice. If there are many problems and maintenance is becoming routine restoration usually provides more value. If structural problems are advanced and requires replacement, it could be necessary. For many homeowners looking to find the most effective balance between security and expense, the solution is in prompt [roof repair and restoration](https://unitedroofrestorations.com.au/).

body.title: Orange Pinwheel.
body.body:
> Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim, Hello my dear friends, good evening, My sincere greetings and greetings to all. how are you all Hope everyone is fine and healthy Alhamdulillah by the grace of Allah Subhanataala I am also fine and healthy today I am here after a long time with a great Algae photography. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPqbq6BB19q7xaZcun65HH7QWVkL7AeoFZ1eFMwNXirrf/1777627430029.jpg)| |-| We see different types of algae from time to time but the same algae that I have seen is called Orange Pinwheel and it usually grows above ground. They grow freely in soft parts of the soil, especially when the rains are frequent, but I have seen them not grow very large. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSs7tMP2Ms1Cxrz7TZq44FRuMYVfSjWnwtzSy4HLcR7tX/1777627456650.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYm3eoz9ovUYpFxNJxS6GzqSMCgaBAiojHSU2GDBuHPv4/1777627457139.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf19jvm4kb5UBNo7j5jkxQcYmntABkSzvLqbjK7wNmJcM/1777627457699.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZD17LCoR61MWQU736N7a3UkCKS29pGQYgRC6c5csz3Nx/1777627458198.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQgnFDAS4adSLvpEEC28Pp4J3MidVxJMkK3f7u3tXCs8W/1777627458753.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPvosYcQ5PeUFhJ6jyzsutBm5gMa48VjeywUe4vgLc1Tv/1777627485876.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaxEDMRzyVSmUCYD7pq3AA8aLovdapBQVA7AnDgiKQnwW/1777627485925.jpg) An inch or two above the ground anyway I found them on the grass in a park this morning when I was out and about. At first I thought it was a flower but on closer inspection it turned out to be a fungal algae. The tops are very flower-like and have a very nice rounded cut. The tops are about one to two inches long. They look great on green grass. Have any of you seen Orange Pinwheel before? Please let me know through comments. This is the first time I have seen such beautiful algae. Anyway, how are the pictures? Please let me know through comments. I have tried to make them beautiful. So friends, I am leaving here today. I hope everyone is well and healthy. May God bless you all.

body.body: People facing divorce, loss, bankruptcy, or repeated failures desperately need real hope, not fake versions. Biblical hope produces joy in trials (Romans 5:2-3), perseverance (Romans 8:24-25), confidence, purity, and intimacy with God (Hebrews 7:19). When these are missing, counterfeit hope has taken root. False hope denies reality (like encouraging someone with no musical talent to pursue a music career), relies on magical thinking (treating devotions like a good-luck charm), misunderstands prayer (praying for money without budgeting), or misinterprets Scripture (like the woman who twisted Matthew 18:19 into a promise her parents would stay together, leading to bitterness and adultery when they didn't). As a counselor, I must help people see where their hope is based on wishful thinking instead of God's actual promises. Real biblical hope anchors in God's character and Word not our wants, not mystical formulas, not verses ripped from context. Lord, make me a hope-giver who points to You, not false comfort.

title.title: Can I Really Watch Kayo Sports from Abroad on My Phone, or Is That a Myth?
title.body: I’ve asked myself this question more times than I’d like to admit. Sitting in a tiny apartment thousands of kilometers away from Australia, craving live AFL or cricket, I kept wondering: is it actually possible, or just another overhyped VPN promise? So I tested it—repeatedly, obsessively, and with a bit of stubborn curiosity. Let me be blunt: yes, you _can_ make it work. But no, it’s not always as smooth as those glossy ads suggest. Mobile users enjoy the ability to watch Kayo Sports with NordVPN from overseas directly on their devices. For detailed analysis please visit the link [https://www.pearltrees.com/delema/item793017577](https://www.pearltrees.com/delema/item793017577) My Real Experience Using NordVPN on Mobile ------------------------------------------ I tried it first on my phone—because let’s be honest, that’s where we consume everything now. I installed NordVPN, picked an Australian server, and crossed my fingers. Here’s what I found: * Out of 5 connection attempts, 3 worked perfectly * 1 gave me a proxy error * 1 was painfully slow That’s a 60% immediate success rate—not terrible, but not flawless either. Once it worked, though, it _really_ worked. I streamed a full rugby match while pretending I was casually hanging out in Brisbane. The quality stayed around 720p with only minor buffering every 15–20 minutes. The Emotional Rollercoaster of Streaming Abroad ----------------------------------------------- Let me tell you—it’s not just about tech. It’s emotional. * You feel victorious when it connects * You feel betrayed when it doesn’t * You feel like a hacker when it suddenly works again At one point, I was literally switching servers like a DJ mixing tracks, chasing that perfect connection. It felt ridiculous… but also weirdly satisfying. What Actually Matters on Mobile Devices --------------------------------------- From my testing, a few things clearly make or break the experience: * **Server choice**: Not all Australian servers are equal * **Internet speed**: Below 20 Mbps? Expect frustration * **App updates**: Outdated apps caused me 2 failed attempts * **Persistence**: Seriously, just retrying often solves it I even tested it on both Wi-Fi and mobile data. Surprisingly, 4G performed better in 2 out of 3 cases. That shocked me. The Honest Truth Nobody Tells You --------------------------------- Here’s where I get a bit argumentative. People love to say VPNs “just work.” That’s misleading. They _can_ work brilliantly—but only if you’re willing to experiment. If you expect one-click magic every time, you’ll be disappointed. But if you approach it like I did—with curiosity and a bit of stubbornness—you’ll eventually succeed. And when you do? Watching your favorite game from the other side of the world feels like bending reality itself. My Final Verdict from Personal Testing -------------------------------------- After multiple attempts, different devices, and more retries than I can count, I can confidently say: * It’s possible to watch Kayo Sports with NordVPN from overseas on mobile devices * It requires patience and trial-and-error * The payoff is absolutely worth it if you love sports Would I rely on it 100%? No. Would I use it again? Without hesitation. Because in that one perfect moment—when the stream loads, the crowd roars, and everything just works—you forget all the hassle. And honestly, that feeling alone makes the entire struggle worthwhile.
