title.title: dinner at a cafe serving typical Japanese food
title.body:
> ![1000617815.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/1000617815.png) *** *** *** Tonight my husband and I went out for a walk and wanted to have dinner, because I didn't cook at home, so my husband invited us to enjoy culinary delights at a restaurant, called the Atariki restaurant, (Atariki Japan) this restaurant has an authentic Japanese restaurant concept, also the atmosphere inside is very typical of Japan, this restaurant is the first in Aceh, I heard that the owner is a young man from Aceh |![1000617577.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23vsE8STdXpHfLRUBvvozzoH15pKickZ2B3wtWBENkGcbptLC47ysm56bgCWsfNpAEADs.jpg)|![1000617578.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiTqZeWeVTTXmBsAn9PYw6AJ6Moft5aDyUupgCJX1LG5Gb9RFoTxcyUs1owo2UzNMs.jpg) |-|-| Entering the restaurant, the waiters greeted us very friendly, they greeted the guests in Japanese with a friendly smile, I could only smile back, because actually I didn't know what they were saying hehehe.. but I thought they were saying good evening ma'am/sir, please come and have a look at the menu list, ![1000617668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpNoTVKjLn5cG1pzm347uRq76uYwRUP6gmQmqHuF7Zxh6AHrmKuqif9gvo2qDUvukSm.jpg) and after I looked at the menu list I was interested in the original ramen noodles, to be honest I have never enjoyed original ramen noodles in this place, while my husband ordered Beef teriyaki and my son also ordered Doraemon cake which is Dorayaki, that's all we ordered oh yeah for drinks only green tea and lemon tea |![1000617656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EokdfHa7gq3WEXJojdzkfzvFTgnAj8xgAmz7XNVe7m4oVg1KZpDnEVXbzW5Wvf12eV2.jpg)|![1000617657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoeFKY6QXeVx5vBmTZgLquAHYWHWUf9HNZDijy4Dx7Zb7AvtSkvTX1JGbzHQ2yp17as.jpg)|![1000617655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpCAuAqCLUMs2mUZFtPyJrjWi77iXCxmGxyrA1v4SzgQame5gAr63vXrBZuy8mGKe9m.jpg) |-|-|-| The atmosphere in the cafe is quite busy, I think this restaurant has many fans, because maybe there has never been a Japanese restaurant here before,The favorite menu in this restaurant is ramen noodles with various variations, there are original, Beef Ramen, Tantan Ramen, Curry Ramen, Mazesoba Ramen and the most special Tori Ramen Atariki here. And I chose the original ramen noodles only because before I had tried the special Tori Ramen Atariki ![1000617628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23uFYMbeXFG98bjbURhYiyHbfL2yU5PMrWh9E2abhBLoHtP8YLHSwgKWHpmw2YUagc5EU.jpg) After waiting for a while, our order arrived. Wow, we couldn't wait to enjoy it because we were probably hungry, hehe. Okay, first I tried the original ramen noodles. *** ###
Original Ramen Noodles
### *** ![1000617629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eou9jG5pgHnfEkqXVKkayY7rBmAN9fZUkPTdirF76HCokcdBmSbm35tPV8X4ATuschg.jpg) Original ramen noodles are ramen noodles made from chewy Japanese wheat, and served with broth, usually made from beef bones and given various toppings such as their signature boiled egg, seaweed and abundant pieces of chicken and some are also sprinkled with boiled sweet. |![1000617631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc8uMBhw1NX3qD8H7Sp68WFkZotRYk3xk5FaU1oAtVF7VVza1Mi5mwZy4XL1FUkGxi.jpg)|![1000617630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiXDZkg65nnTdZ9VSwAip5PGxPvZPG1HN66CRRBGA2fEsqqsD6vWfm4V2oTJjkHG84.jpg) |-|-| |![1000617634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoeFMuZYjBT4JEkbqjUfGzYdF37qgo3VMxyZ3c944hDkAPZcVAkDU4KkyT9pzJwpD88.jpg)|![1000617632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoyR2uDdeGBdkgmg8BiKxakY32m2fJc1AMEAhyQvafXSfSJfyTH7hpGrVoYQetnWCte.jpg) |-|-| *** The taste of the noodles is chewy with a very savory texture of the broth, plus the sweet corn topping adds to the freshness of the noodles and the large chicken meat is cut into large, thin slices like this, I sip the broth and enjoy the chewy noodles, I like this ramen noodle, it turns out the original is no less delicious than the special one, not only me, my child also wants it hehe |![1000617659.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoK7HRKRrJsj5QwH2kNdCRwkAANpWc2Eo1yhspTduXnb1LGMZzBwkFKS5ERq4zjARZr.jpg)|![1000617644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoEruQ6RXyt47CiCMgFMNzyLyRv87mGcgxtHQyTGaEv4vNMdAwgub5dXrfF9etcvj8V.jpg) |-|-| I inhaled the very fresh broth and if it is not salty enough you can add Japanese soy sauce, if it is not spicy enough you can also add chili oil and there is also Japanese salt available, basically all the spices are from Japan, you can mix the flavor of the broth yourself ![1000617600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eos3DhokbiX7sb6V8bhV4JvwTax6JSnxNSF9LQPTJiR44ge2Y9TSnRqgNxJd99Fve4g.jpg) After tasting the ramen noodles, I also tasted a little of my husband's food, namely Beef Teriyaki with a different taste from ramen. *** ###
Beef Teriyaki
### *** ![1000617827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/48WCv7MngQsV7aTaeLFnjV9LXUr29iJTAGS5oB6Daby4g4uBXnzUiijNHsSLVJYrHA.jpg) *** *** *** Beef Teriyaki is a beef dish cooked in Japanese teriyaki sauce and mixed with onions and other ingredients for topping. Eggs are also added and served with rice underneath which is also very soft and fluffy. |![1000617610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc8SuFTthCff8svRUZDu8Yg5iNwLZiHetRZdLk6qSBakUuQcCDxUsFJLTugXjfFmiT.jpg)|![1000617608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoErXmkNypcz8Qy5GLCpvX34hXpwgek41QeyhYA5u9mMaJaczg1Um36ics4vDpdwvYj.jpg) |-|-| |![1000617611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eou9jFh133m5XJZwhtmpVHdgCK6jZ1i1ERwMSPHid5GCZZMmdAWmdM8dGfggzPrMtLy.jpg)|![1000617626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EokeWsKCZ6y63UvSvy6GWFvf12ZTdV7qfRcpb9caeRP14JPYBrF2Guwrm2VZLwjAB7T.jpg) |-|-| The beef is very tasty, sweet with an aromatic taste of ginger and onions, this menu is also a very popular menu here, many customers also order this beef teriyaki menu, the beef is also quite a lot, the rice is also full in one bowl plus very complete egg protein ![1000617604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiXEZ4exPjShc3istU8kdeM8dSuqAKJCr76tL7fEU9yS7MBK2xZRyRqfULPYSkQfF6.jpg) Basically, eating this one bowl will make you very full, perfect for hungry couples. At 35,000 rupiah per portion, it's quite cheap for such a large and delicious menu, right? We didn't forget to drink the drinks, fresh drinks that were only available in 2 types, green tea and lemon tea, after our heavy meal we enjoyed these fresh drinks. ![1000617606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep1YraQ62HjwUvAkYhUQKzCaEhRK7MncRQ1fCHDK5ieLmCJY6p3Eue54yX7a4p8Ek27.jpg) Next, we will enjoy the snacks that my child ordered, namely Dorayaki with melted chocolate jam. *** ###
Dorayaki
### *** ![1000618126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wCLJWLbgR98HbEc2hnAJPmy6bSDphsfyNnqyZWdqR5B3SEHkn2reU4No1Yj5fimXoiG.jpg) Dorayaki is a traditional round Japanese cake filled with various kinds of jam inside, the most popular are red bean jam, chocolate jam, and tiramisu jam, but my son chose melted chocolate jam. |![1000618129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wX3ggutHNW9rPH6zrAadf1V2LxHMH2yEFjb5qkVQtagPbKsdEzjFyJjdyZLKb1mVRnq.jpg)|![1000617622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpVBcyLhsg5LgLHxZSZzQ3wQi8Q1chtm2BDDrG9QRog58uBmwVsYkavLeL6D5qRuVoz.jpg)|![1000617625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EopuQ4arb9TxfPbpvHSphH5b666gB8twEj7Q4K8RC8tDJebP2AZYE24jKo3nH8ksCnS.jpg) |-|-|-| |![1000617624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep5o8cTPLf4puqtvMH5MD4hDMpaRxXpR4E185Js7k4qWQvqHX1E4DiVN8hx1gF1qkmn.jpg)|![1000617636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc8XcEbVuahbcnkvPG9VpJRTTQtnBPEMKZDp7JG7HZnc6UcLw5tzk42ibS8rMU1GrB.jpg)|![1000617636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eoc8XcEbVuahbcnkvPG9VpJRTTQtnBPEMKZDp7JG7HZnc6UcLw5tzk42ibS8rMU1GrB.jpg) |-|-|-| Dorayaki cake with a soft, sweet taste and is also very fluffy, sandwiching a filling of perfectly melted sweet chocolate inside. |![1000617619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23x1DnAfFDum7jXadGST9QdErLS1UocNxUXPhQ99BvrxLaoNMo8ZNwbqukLCVkzAVZDiP.jpg)|![1000617599.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23ywsP8xPMscJHTt1uEaLohY3v31hmV1UXYJCG8GAhpcGWTQqhpqFQorQ584ucGV2KkLx.jpg)|![1000617621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wCBw6dMDTfXYofM3ECLqDpsRRbVwtrrH1v7KQVFrpHEQhqAzqZvhJTsQBFrnJrvT6D9.jpg)|![1000617618.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep1YS6oJDTPU894Rh8D1HAWznbrfr4yJ4NTJBeNP6hLizYcudP4uDtwSG293pJj8zdW.jpg) |-|-|-|-| Enjoying the food menu at this cafe really makes us feel as if we have gone to Japan because the cafe atmosphere is very authentic, like cafes in Japan, right? ![1000617596.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wMaSk7mutUSyhvNURVqRVnUeZoZu4v7wou229bVXRpiFGGGcC8iSeo17hPp59osoHbm.jpg) In short, I highly recommend this cafe. For those of you who are going to Lhokseumawe, Aceh and who like to eat typical Japanese food, you don't need to worry anymore. Here, there are various kinds of Japanese food available that suit your taste and the prices are also safe. ![1000617732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpxroAzw66yMrBerbebQGzjqbbVH5zBMS5s1Wa5NejGBkYmLXjryAFWPZkJyyV3anKs.jpg) *** *** *** ###
Thank you 🙂🤗
### *** *** ***

I am usually called Ryana, I come from Indonesia, my daily activities are working, cooking, taking care of the household, and also traveling, I really enjoy traveling with my husband and children. I also like enjoying culinary delights with my little family,Thank you very much for those who have taken the time to read my post this time, I hope this post is a little useful for the readers, and see you in my next post and I also really hope for the support of all friends, so that what we want while we are here we can make it happen</sub>

title.title: Nasi Liwet with Anchovies
title.body:
> ![20260501_124529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EowJ7FF3yb4zoT3HcrFGsXNK1s6LpFE9aGjDqPVME1SJDqYGx5BFisL86CjzEJn2a23.jpg)
Nasi liwet is a traditional rice dish that’s quite popular in Indonesia. It’s usually served with a variety of side dishes, and interestingly, it’s often eaten together during special occasions. This time, I decided to try making it myself at home—a simple version, of course. The process is very easy and quick using a rice cooker. ![20260501_124353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wWw3dMtZxXXmFvbjudg4KFoZeeB3TCMVFYfnBRM326zhdBJXhAu3LpJpP5EcDdqtFZ8.jpg) The ingredients are also quite simple, relying mainly on trri medan and a few other complementary ingredients. As someone who loves cooking, this certainly isn’t the first time I’ve made this liwet rice. I’ve often made it at home before to enjoy with my family. The portion I made is enough for 2 or more servings. The result is quite a lot, but I intentionally made two servings because there are only two of us at home—my husband and me. So we want to enjoy the nasi liwet together for dinner later.
Ingredients
![20260501_112755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/Ep7wTC3THauofWegMwPLcWQiNrdqviGtaxX5uzNprjkm83kVVUwVMYYiJ6QVQnoDUSa.jpg)
200 grams of rice 50 grams of Medan anchovies 3 red chili peppers 6 bird’s eye chili peppers 2 cloves of red onion 3 cloves of garlic 300 ml of water ½ teaspoon of salt
Cooking Procedure
Rinse the rice until clean, add the water that has been brought to a boil, and add the kaffir lime leaves, bay leaves, and lemongrass.
| ![20260501_112849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wC7vms5Fwg5zwcPFnF4Qg55qeSXwa1azBZMCGpPz3rprVAdoEMYjDVvej8oCn6RbyHw.jpg) | ![20260501_113324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wMY18kQFD3yr6xaQq6WnPEqkqXk2VKok3EPJG49VPvZ8AUVGCVZEKFEvgBna6FjVJeV.jpg) | ![20260501_113329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wMU9TNuHEk4Wc2YpiRq2VwNLZpqiqG2s1eAhSudsDSWy86UGCrNUaQW2qL5V3A7DnoM.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Chop the onions and chili peppers, then fry them until golden brown.
| ![20260501_113135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vhyisTDvDars31yvUNsPNXHwEs8s5uarcEpdrKQUmzhaLn94ag3hkpWGMgTfnozXtSX.jpg) | ![20260501_113314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23y8qVij6JiaXsnqMVzDcZWhyi6gwNNJagnjErDrB44XRWdRxGuDmARkrNTGfxrvy3yX7.jpg) | ![20260501_113218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23tbricW1uukjQtaBNuyhAoEUsDQBGpELD4KyMPvCqs4xirSpjAMgFufMJHPjmAo4Sd1F.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Once the onions and chili peppers are cooked, add them to the rice you prepared earlier.
| ![20260501_113418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wCE1b6i5GKkazdQVRjuuQSCDR2mxPU3ArGcCxeHXPwEeDVbydUtAYFbg8zjiXEXih1m.jpg)| ![20260501_113421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xp4FFcHiqPJEdCe59qozEuSKU15X7Us9CDhQDQAvUR5jDy8mzvRdTQ8H5LYgkbdNhbA.jpg) | ![20260501_113922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yJEgxH7QUvipjbehWnfTcVxBo71f8hqWdLRpiiMNC6t8Vwkv6SZ5pGHUYEE6g8e7ifb.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Then fry the anchovies until they’re crispy and turn a golden brown. Add them to the rice, and don’t forget to add salt.

> ![20260501_113905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23uFVhm3cFg2NjXFKTZMAXgEBRTif6YNFjrttWknpcbmPMtLqDtZJ31gCFsiSdKDW2JEP.jpg) ![20260501_113926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xVJpXMJGHzuSTxSkGWzL6xRNsQpX1Pvy9KvA3HKUcbG1fGGVciegr1HHcRmtXzou3de.jpg)
Next, cook in a rice cooker until done. Just imagine how fragrant it will be—the aroma will surely fill the kitchen.

> ![20260501_120107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23w2gpitE9Kn7Zk97esuGjhByFqzMzN4C7Ujx3W1KwAkRBS5Xn7G93m1SpJvYwCro1Zwx.jpg)
Result
![20260501_124228.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EoK7DBCXPu5btvBP8j6q1b8rqFZumS78otxxoeH8QLDGSq4ACqrSniWPddStnh4eXVX.jpg) Serve it with a fried egg or any kind of fish, add some crackers and sambal—it’s absolutely amazing. A classic dish with an extraordinary flavor—such an authentic taste. The savory blend with the unique flavor of Medan anchovies makes this rice dish a perfect match for my palate.
|![20260501_124400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yx1Z3pVX8HTSgPcePhZtJUAkAN9RYCKPnvpXwCdQDJPimWsCgUdPgc4LtSQgxypNPf9.jpg)|![20260501_124631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wXDw71eGr7HhuLEE5B9RKYY7NELy9cUPUUUX2mpfpYo5kRuAiJCJhmjg9xosz7gVUbP.jpg)|![20260501_124721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23z7SJuKqs9nbcVZSudUFyaX9MxAfuy3MuPmTQMc3zRCVqTiDypyQF5QWHf5mW4Gws7fX.jpg)| |-|-|-|
I highly recommend this liwet rice as a signature dish—it’s a truly unique option for entertaining guests. Even served simply with fish or fried eggs, it’s already fantastic; enjoy it with other delicious dishes, and the result is sure to be just as delicious. ![20260501_124348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wqbfuNMFcHr1xSEj5AvC5C688jhwRDQBcYLiQxDDZFAPTc8KRkT1Psq2DBiNX4RMQR5.jpg)
![20230506_212938_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTv75jgyP5CSod1jCZoAPbPAnA7mSYtNJUa33KmuA4GgtmxGNNUyyxR9bq8gsiGS8qF.png)
**Hi Readers and Hivers, Thank you for reading and visiting my posts which are 100% copyrighted by myself, my own content, writings and photos, taken with the Samsung Galaxy A72 Smartphone.**

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23ywu7wxoiHaR6iFfqmt51kte5iJSyQjURLhDmkUrEDCc2saFSzeKzRUXCStKFpZhTmMn.jpg
About The Author
Welcome to this blog, I have a real name \

, who comes from Indonesia. I have several hobbies, reading, writing, gardening, I also love food and cooking, even art related.  And the most interesting one is spending the whole day traveling. From those hobbies, I will  some inspiring content for all of you, I hope you like my blog, please and reblog this post if you like it!.</sub>

title.title: The smile of golden harvest versus the fear of rain: A busy time for our farmers.
title.body:
> https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ9W4VYdg7vG5hRVkZX22ckNjjqXUdWpiaiMcPjyUj7AB/IMG20260426131515~2.jpg The fields of our rural Bengal are now adorned with golden colors. The fragrant smell of ripe rice is all around and the busyness of the farmers. This is perhaps the eternal form of Bengal. This excitement of harvesting rice reminds us that agriculture is the lifeblood of our economy. However, behind this festive atmosphere lies a hidden anxiety. Currently, the rice harvesting festival is going on in every field in our area. From morning to evening, farmers are busy in the field with sickles in hand. Cutting rice, tying it in bundles and bringing it home, and then threshing it is all a divine act. Preparations for the Nabanna festival with new rice are also going on in some places. This activity of village life is really worth seeing. Unfortunately, nature is in a bit of a hostile mood this time. For the past few days, the sky has been cloudy and there have been sudden rains. When ripe paddy is lying in the field, a single rain means a huge loss for the farmer. If rainwater accumulates, the paddy plant can rot, and if the paddy is threshed while wet, its quality is lost. The market does not get a fair price for that paddy. The farmer spends his entire year's hard work and the last of his savings on this crop. At this last moment of harvesting, the fear of rain has robbed them of sleep. Therefore, everyone is trying their best to quickly cut the paddy and bring it home due to the fear of rain. Everyone, young and old, in the neighborhood is helping the farmers so that the crops can be taken to a safe place before the rain. Just as nature gives us abundant gifts, it also tests us sometimes. We pray that the weather will improve soon and the farmers can bring home their hard-earned crops with a smile. A smile on the farmer's face means a smile on the face of the entire country. Thank you all for reading the post. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

title.title: Three Random Photos of New Caledonia
title.body:
I was in New Caledonia for just over a week in Sept-October last year, somehow I'm only now managing to get through the last of the photos and we have come to that point we are a left with just random shots here and there that didn't fit into another post. 

Soo here we go. 

![View1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/harveyword/245Sa3sZUQ23CXifffcPjZTP5YwkFDWgmMeRrwrxH578mAGs25NWmTovkAFobYrxKJzBr.jpg)

Heinghene is on the North East coast of the main island of New Caledonia (which is called Grand Terre) and it is picture postcard perfect, blue shies, the south pacific ocean in the background, or is that the coral sea? Either way it was a view worth stopping the care for. 


![Trees.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/harveyword/Eo6DiHu67v88nxhsdaXAJiXtSzqrtz5oyxUHb1ozVKMPB9BT5MMgJUKG8DyTM8nKJfw.jpg)

We are in Blue River Park, about a hours drive outside of the capital Noumea, and it's green, very green and peaceful, is it a great photo not really. 


![The View.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/harveyword/AJUdw1gxLQ1ByAG37mX283MYq8UFns9SnBsnCHHiTeKi4pvMe1Cf9VbFQfegwjt.jpg)


Farino, right in the middle of the main island, which means it way up in the hills, we were there for other reason but we took a short detour up a dirt road to get to 'the grand palms' national park, unfortunately it was closed, but the view from the vistors centre was truly amazing, that forest, that greenery, wow. 

So that's it's New Caledonia is all done now, off to the next adventure, which is Japan, and if you think New Cal was drawn out in this Hive world, that one could take a long long time.

title.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Modern Business Transformation
title.body:
>




I've been in business a long time, and have seen it expand, shrink, and recover, and undergo some of the most dramatic transformations ever. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one technology today that brings to mind the early days of the internet. I mean this with all my heart: AI is not a tool. It is altering our thinking, our working and our business models.

Artificial Intelligence is when machines learn to think, learn and reason. However, what makes it so powerful is it doesn't only think, it thinks fast, it thinks accurately and it thinks with a lot of data. I have seen companies that have been floundering for years find answers simply through using AI to understand their customers.

A key application of AI in business is making decisions. Before, I made decisions based on experience, intuition and luck. Now, AI can crunch numbers in a blink of the eye and reveal insights that humans might take months to discover. I have applied AI to understand the behavior of customers, forecast sales, and even foresee risks. It's like having a smart, never-tiring mentor.



![Screenshot_2026-05-01-10-10-04-816_com.android.chrome-edit.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/Eq37U2vRyAheiu1KFnHBuKB3LBb1NWzwu9uZKuHrhrnmeWqJgvKWy5K3gxv2iqDwaHs.jpg)

[Image Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/global-business-business-9062781/)

Another transformative power of AI is automation. It can perform tasks previously done by humans in hours (if not days) in minutes. These tasks can include replying to emails or chat messages, managing stock and data entry. I used to employ lots of people to do mundane tasks. But with AI, companies can be more productive and use human resources for innovation and planning. That's not to say humans are redundant. It means we can concentrate on what is important.

AI has also revolutionised the way customers are treated. Customers want quick, tailored and seamless experiences. AI helps businesses meet these expectations. I have seen small businesses use AI chatbots to offer round-the-clock service, which used to be a luxury for large businesses. AI can also predict what customers will want, making them feel special. And a loyal customer is a happy customer.

AI makes marketing more intelligent. I used to pay for ads and not know if they will work. Now, AI knows who to reach, what to say, and when to say it. It analyses actions, interests and trends. This has allowed me to cut out waste and improve my outcome. It's not about screaming at the vague crowd; it's about speaking to your audience.

But I have to tell you, AI is not a magic. It is strong but not wise. I have seen business owners rely too much on technology. That is a mistake. AI should be an assistance, not a substitute. Humans don't need to lose their judgement, ethics or vision. I keep in mind that \

But there is fear of AI. There is the concern about unemployment. But in my view, with every change comes opportunity. The invention of the machine age created new jobs. The same is happening now. AI is bringing new jobs, new skills, new income. It is important to be flexible, to be a lifelong learner, and to be open to change. The most exciting thing about AI is that it democratises. You don't have to be big to dream big. A small business can compete with the best using AI. I know young founders who have built strong brands with AI. That is something truly special. If I could give anybody advice today it would be: don't be scared of AI, learn it. Start small. Apply it to your business needs. Let it help you grow, but don't forget your humanity. Because ultimately business is human, it's about relationships, trust and value. Finally, AI is not changing business; it is reinventing it. I have seen a lot of things in my time, but this is different. It is quick, it is strong and it is irreversible. The ones who adapt well will not only survive but they will thrive. And I firmly believe that with the right frame of mind, anyone can use the power of AI to create something important, something valuable and something enduring.

title.body:
Biblical anthropology studies what Scripture says about humanity and our relationship with God. What strikes me is how covenant and understanding people connect the Bible shows us in four states (created, fallen, redeemed, glorified), and in every state, God initiates covenant with us.
There are two main covenants: the covenant of works (our first relationship with God before sin) and the covenant of grace (God's response after we failed). Biblical covenants mirror ancient king-vassal treaties with three elements: the king's kindness, required loyalty, and consequences for obedience or disobedience.
 God is always the initiator. When we failed the first covenant, He didn't abandon us He gave the covenant of grace. That's relentless love, not a backup plan. In counseling, this anchors everything: people's deepest identity isn't their mess it's God's covenant commitment to them. He pursued them in creation, pursues them in redemption, and will finish the work in glory. That's where real change comes from.

title.title: Why Himalayan Roads Work Better Than Meditation Apps?
title.body:
![image](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/aff626590c6d898b457be1785f3f509c283abc0b69f3edfb5cac5dd6bd684a2f)

There's a specific quality to Himalayan adventure motorbike rides that makes them uniquely effective as a mental reset and it comes down to the right level of cognitive demand. Good roads let your mind wander too freely. That's not always useful when your mind is already cluttered.

Himalayan roads- especially the kind you encounter on a Kinnaur Spiti Zanskar motorcycle expedition demand just enough of your attention to anchor you to the present without overwhelming you. You're reading the road surface constantly. Adjusting your throttle for loose gravel. Watching for a sudden drop in the shoulder. Calculating whether that shadow across the road is a dry stream or a water crossing.

This is not stressful. It is, in psychological terms, a flow state- a condition where your attention is fully engaged but not strained. The challenge matches your capability. And in that state, the background noise of daily life simply has nowhere to enter.

Riders who have completed a Spiti Valley bike expedition consistently describe the experience as \

rather than exhausting- even after 8-hour riding days. That's not despite the difficulty. That's because of it. And this is why [Motorcycle touring is a therapy for riders](https://www.brahmandtour.com/blog_detail/69/motorcycle-touring-a-rejuvenating-therapy).

\#motorcycletouring #indiamotorbiketour #motorcycletravel #riderstherapy #ridersinindia #brahmandtour #himalayantrip

```markdown
# 自然的奇蹟

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分，它不僅提供了生存所需的資源，還以其壯麗的景觀和多樣的生物吸引著我們。這篇文章將探索自然的美麗與重要性。

## 自然的美麗

### 山脈

山脈是自然界中最壯觀的景觀之一。它們不僅是地球的脊樑，還是許多生物的棲息地。高聳的山峰和綠意盎然的山谷，讓人感受到大自然的雄偉。

### 河流

河流是生命的源泉。它們滋養著附近的生態系統，並為人類提供了飲用水和灌溉用水。河流的曲折流淌，帶給我們無限的靈感與平靜。

### 森林

森林是地球上最重要的生態系統之一。它們是多種動植物的棲息地，並且在調節氣候方面扮演著關鍵角色。漫步在森林中，能夠感受到大自然的氣息，聆聽到鳥兒的歌唱。

## 自然的重要性

1. **生態平衡**  
   自然界的每一個元素都是相互依賴的。植物、動物和微生物之間的關係維持著生態平衡，確保生物多樣性。

2. **資源供應**  
   自然提供了我們生活所需的資源，如食物、水和空氣。我們必須珍惜這些資源，並以可持續的方式使用它們。

3. **心理健康**  
   研究顯示，與自然接觸可以減少壓力、焦慮和抑鬱。大自然的美景能夠讓我們感受到內心的平靜與放鬆。

## 結論

自然是一個充滿奇蹟的世界，它不僅滋養著我們的身體，還滋潤著我們的心靈。我們應該珍惜和保護這片美麗的土地，讓未來的世代也能享受到自然的恩賜。

---

- [世界自然基金會](https://www.worldwildlife.org)
```

📖 Introduction
Here is my Season 181 report covering battle performance, earnings, rewards, tournaments and market activity. Feel free to leave a comment, upvote, or share if you find this useful! #
Season Wrap Up and New Experiments
There we have it again… another season wrapped up and logged in the books. And honestly, it feels good to see the reporting blog evolving along with it. The latest additions, especially the new earning tables, are starting to give a much clearer picture of what is actually going on behind the scenes. This season lined up nicely with HPUD again, so the monthly Hive deposit is locked in as well. Always a satisfying moment to tick that box and keep the long term plan moving forward. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23xedt7jNAWgZtZUQPM9Cdmb5beEsBfkFCDMupB2sP4bpqhTF7Fxi4FA8tqGtdHvvRVTn.png) As usual, both accounts have been grinding along. Beaker007 and Shinoumonk each doing their thing with their own sets of stats and earning flows. I will drop all the visuals below so you can dig into the details yourself. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/Eo6BD8pih8xTmYnfXEbYcdPzKsQcj32bLpZ1XHBXUjVNwdsKNA8LGbbuCcEkcRA5xUS.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23swg56bQ5s7jXMhpVWRpGCuKkn57z3CUrHDKJ2aAfBWpgR6HN6qgHPGyZBBS1goJw4qN.png) For the rest, it was a fairly calm season overall. Frontier is starting to feel a bit stale for me. I still play it, but the motivation is fading a bit. Hitting that fourth complete set milestone was nice though, and it is now sitting in the guild library ready for a new player to pick up. After that… the question becomes what is next. Sure, I am still missing a lot of gold cards on the alt, but there is no real urgency there. One highlight was jumping back into a tournament for glint. Results were not great, but it was fun to actually play one again instead of skipping them. Definitely something I might want to do a bit more often. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beaker007/23tknNPP2Jh4Zd1Yfx5aFgFaURMpwLEr1SNHmMrN1EpKne57oKWD3HP2izcceuGp8dYHw.png) The biggest switch next season though is survival mode. With the 99% cooldown reduction, it suddenly becomes way more interesting. A max legendary sitting at around 30 minutes cooldown actually makes it playable. I even considered going into a higher bracket, but with only 20 archons that might have been a stretch. For now this feels like the safer call, we will see how that plays out over the next two weeks. It also reminded me pretty quickly that manual play is a different beast. Against bots things go fine, but real players… yeah, that is a different story 😄 probably also because I am sitting in bronze right now, but still, plenty to improve there. Anyway, enough talking… let’s dive into the raw stats 👇 ##

title.title: [ENG/ESP] LOH #286 Lessons from the film \
title.body:
> I love romantic movies, especially those that focus on women. That's why today I want to talk about a film that captivated me.

\n\n\

(2019), directed by Celine Sciamma, is a work that combines visual beauty and emotional depth to explore love, freedom, and memory. Its greatest lesson is that true love may be fleeting, but it leaves indelible marks on identity and art. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSXVwLge2HrUALDdebMRoTEUFxMZDTeL5RQnvBD8VX3SX/520424013_754521237091253_3011823202125726349_n.jpg)[source](https://www.facebook.com/100076001514352/posts/retrato-de-una-mujer-en-llamas-2019marianne-es-una-pintora-que-recibe-un-encargo/754521267091250/) Set in late 18th-century France, the story follows Marianne (Noemie Merlant), a painter commissioned to paint the wedding portrait of Heloise (Adele Haenel), a young woman An aristocrat who has just left the convent and is reluctant to marry. The assignment must be carried out in secret, observing her without her knowledge. In this process of glances and silences, an intense and forbidden romance blossoms, marking them both forever. Key Lessons The Power of the Gaze: The film teaches that looking is an act of love and knowledge. Marianne and Heloise discover each other through mutual observation, questioning who possesses and who is possessed in a relationship. Love as a Transformative Experience: Although brief, their relationship redefines both of their identities. Love is not measured by its duration, but by its intensity and the lasting impact it has. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzQRaUSDEWR2gms33TjLnN5mQWSB71zLd8EemAQwWRcQ/633957504_1441539097341506_6504665573044783691_n.jpg)[source](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1462865528542196&set=a.758240629004693&type=3) Freedom versus social norms: Heloise symbolizes the struggle against an imposed destiny. The film reminds us that female autonomy has historically been limited, but also that resistance is possible. Art as memory: The portrait is not just a commission, but a testament to a bond. Art becomes a refuge and a way to immortalize what society forbids. Silence and absence: History shows that the unspoken and the lost are also part of love. The final scene, with Heloise listening to music, is a reminder that memory can be both painful and sublime. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR38GQhnHhVwUyBNoW3rZMPEmTZmrb7RJQeAoawDF1w1t/193149933_3426742054094764_3554488835369025343_n.jpg)[source](https://www.facebook.com/100064844404640/posts/retrato-de-una-mujer-en-llamas-c%C3%A9line-sciamma-2019-/3426747377427565/) Conclusion “Portrait of a Lady on Fire” is more than a historical romance: it is a reflection on how love, art, and memory challenge social structures. Its lessons invite us to consider that the ephemeral It can be eternal in memory, and freedom is won even in the most intimate spaces. Credits: I used Google Translate. ESPAÑOL Me gustan las películas románticas y que tengan que ver con la mujer. Es por ello que hoy quiero hablar sobre un filme que me cautivó. “Retrato de una mujer en llamas” (2019), dirigida por Celine Sciamma, es una obra que combina belleza visual y hondura emocional para explorar el amor, la libertad y la memoria. Su mayor lección es que el amor verdadero puede ser efímero, pero deja huellas imborrables en la identidad y en el arte. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSXVwLge2HrUALDdebMRoTEUFxMZDTeL5RQnvBD8VX3SX/520424013_754521237091253_3011823202125726349_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/100076001514352/posts/retrato-de-una-mujer-en-llamas-2019marianne-es-una-pintora-que-recibe-un-encargo/754521267091250/) Ambientada en Francia a finales del siglo XVIII, la historia sigue a Marianne (Noemie Merlant), una pintora contratada para realizar el retrato de bodas de Heloise (Adele Haenel), una joven aristócrata que acaba de salir del convento y se resiste a su matrimonio. El encargo debe hacerse en secreto, observándola sin que ella lo sepa. En ese proceso de miradas y silencios, surge un romance intenso y prohibido que marcará a ambas para siempre. Lecciones principales El poder de la mirada: La película enseña que mirar es un acto de amor y de conocimiento. Marianne y Heloise se descubren a través de la observación mutua, cuestionando quién posee y quién es poseído en una relación. El amor como experiencia transformadora: Aunque breve, su relación redefine la identidad de ambas. El amor no se mide por su duración, sino por la intensidad y la huella que deja. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzQRaUSDEWR2gms33TjLnN5mQWSB71zLd8EemAQwWRcQ/633957504_1441539097341506_6504665573044783691_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1462865528542196&set=a.758240629004693&type=3) La libertad frente a la norma social: Heloise simboliza la lucha contra un destino impuesto. La película recuerda que la autonomía femenina ha sido históricamente limitada, pero también que la resistencia es posible. El arte como memoria: El retrato no es solo un encargo, sino un testimonio de un vínculo. El arte se convierte en refugio y en forma de inmortalizar lo que la sociedad no permite. El silencio y la ausencia: La historia muestra que lo no dicho y lo perdido también forman parte del amor. La última escena, con Heloise escuchando música, es un recordatorio de que la memoria puede ser dolorosa y sublime a la vez. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR38GQhnHhVwUyBNoW3rZMPEmTZmrb7RJQeAoawDF1w1t/193149933_3426742054094764_3554488835369025343_n.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/100064844404640/posts/retrato-de-una-mujer-en-llamas-c%C3%A9line-sciamma-2019-/3426747377427565/) Conclusión Retrato de una mujer en llamas” es más que un romance histórico: es una reflexión sobre cómo el amor, el arte y la memoria desafían las estructuras sociales. Sus lecciones invitan a pensar que lo efímero puede ser eterno en la memoria, y que la libertad se conquista incluso en los espacios más íntimos. Créditos: Utilicé el traductor de Google.

title.title: A New Perspective ❤️ Amonet (EN-ES)
title.body:
> --- ![Nueva Visión.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ydEATFJXMCGsP8BCEmLW7oryAEp3HxsKW4YtMwGNeZBoUhjPuCX4aYkjWsCH2CcbZzm.jpg) ![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png) Often, something happens in life that gives us a different perspective; it might be something physical or spiritual, a lesson learnt, or a specific event. This design is dedicated to my mother, who recently had cataract surgery on one eye. She’s been short-sighted since she was a child, and back then it was frowned upon for someone to have poor eyesight; she never wore glasses, she just made do as best she could. It wasn’t until she was 32 that she got her first pair of glasses. I can’t imagine what it was like all that time, but she saw as best she could. It wasn’t severe short-sightedness, but she certainly didn’t see clearly. Now, three days after her operation, she is happy; she can see with that eye like never before in her life, different shades of colour, sharp outlines. A new lease of life at 72, and that makes me very happy. Sight is one of the most precious of the senses, and symbolically, visión, a change in vision or perspective, often changes one’s life as well. I like to make that comparison. With the cataract, she could see less and less; she couldn’t even see my face, and now her life is completely different, much better. It’s worth it; no matter what age you are, the change for the better is always worth it, both physically and spiritually.
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Muchas veces pasa algo en la vida que nos da una perspectiva diferente, puede ser algo físico como algo espiritual, un aprendizaje o un hecho puntual. Este diseño va dedicado a mi madre, que recientemente se ha operado de un ojo, de cataratas. Desde niña tiene miopía y en aquellos tiempos se veía mal que alguien viera menos, nunca usó gafas, veía como podía. Recién luego de los 32 años tuvo sus primeras gafas. No imagino como fue todo ese tiempo, pero ella veía como podía. No era extrema miopía, pero seguramente no veía nítido. Ahora luego de tres días de ser operada está feliz, ve con ese ojo como nunca en su vida, distintas gamas de colores, contornos nítidos. Una nueva vida a sus 72 años y me alegra mucho eso. La vista es de los sentidos más valiosos y simbólicamente la visión, el cambio de visión, perspectiva muchas veces también cambia la vida. Me gusta hacer esa comparación. Con la catarata cada vez veía menos, ni si quiera mi rostro y ahora su vida es otra, mucho mejor. Vale la pena, no importa a que edad sea, siempre vale la pena el cambio a mejor tanto en el sentido físico como el espiritual.

![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png)
Process in pictures - Proceso en imágenes
|![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi3smGLjTyPD31A7wu9Ajc9NZoYk7TnS7FbYKqv1vQfYmAngXT39U7i3RM9c8Xx4iaD.jpg)|![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1HXzDmAmbXvQLLnSi1zJyMcR6EX8WU9WWT6hxWAHXehh5ot8FwAMRUfY8zhWHQEpqr.jpg)| |-|-| |![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1Dn8bqfh3vxtGEG8wFkEW4YnmCRXCL4X12Vn9DoXm6xpn7PMXMqgS6LLsEDmP4fkGH.jpg)|![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1FBAnzeds2bh9SCgx4wTc5pYkYUnYeskn4bqcmNdZs1mAfL977tgTBaNVuEmM8s95T.jpg)| ||| |![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGiiemm2QEirPmjyc12EfEJ54xmy1eqjqCRj8iJfBSe3xUqynhogQHXLcnYi91zdagD.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yd7r1jkCvLiHLgtZWHxd3QsUXfccGxZooXDs8EPiuLGqHKreJcGMUPvdNN3bDwfCxtK.jpg)| ||| |![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqnnniRyPHMU9vjKsCGhEMQ3mtwKceQvonSZASxfqHJRMXecYbAmVLhgv4HNHf7XCZR.jpg)|![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCJSVqUPgD9rrzZ1D3X4trVh3QKMyf3nAwaHDcAo2Pq1FFaC7Vv9uEALv4x8XkxnRsm.jpg)| ![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png) # Design process The design was created entirely in Photoshop CS6 without the use of AI, using 11 royalty-free images distributed across 31 layers. First, I created a grey layer onto which I placed the abstract image; I duplicated it and rotated it horizontally, creating a mirror image; I merged them and continued working with that merged image, from which I created several layers, using various blending modes such as luminosity, soft light and normal. I then selected several parts, those with relief, cut them out and pasted them, thus generating six more layers, and to these parts I added the drop shadow layer style to separate them from the overall image. Beneath these layers containing the parts, I placed the textured image and used the soft light blending mode; I then added the silhouette and two of the flowers, the latter using the hard light blending mode, and in one corner I placed the image of the camera using the darker colour blending mode. On top of the four circles in the abstract design I placed an eye, and on top of each eye a ring using the spot light blending mode. I worked on the image of the woman, after erasing the background, across four layers using Darker Colour, Spot Light, Normal, and Darker Colour again, placing this final layer on top of the entire design. Finally, between the layers containing the individual parts, I placed the flower petals, and on top of all the design layers, the butterfly. The animation is done completely in After Effects, working on the opacity of each layer and adding lights in the form of clouds for better contrast. I send you all a big hello and see you next time. Thanks for watching and reading this far. Amonet - AV Design
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

# Proceso del diseño El diseño está realizado completamente en el programa Photoshop CS6 sin uso de IA con 11 imágenes sin derechos de autor distribuidas en 31 capas. Primero cree una capa color gris sobre la que coloqué la imagen del abstracto, la duplique y giré horizontalmente, creando un espejo, las combiné y seguí trabajando con esa imagen combinada de la cual hice varias capas, con diversas fusiones como luminosidad, luz suave, normal y luego seleccioné varias partes, las que tenían relieve, las corté y pegué, generando así seis capas más y a estas partes le agregué el estilo de capa de sombra paralela para separarla de la imagen general. Debajo de estas capas con partes, coloqué la imagen con la textura y usé la fusión de luz suave y luego puse la silueta y dos de las flores, éstas últimas con fusión de luz fuerte y en una esquina puse la imagen de la cámara con la fusión de color más oscuro. Sobre los cuatro círculos del diseño abstracto coloqué un ojo, y encima de cada ojo un anillo con la fusión de luz focal. Trabajé la imagen de la mujer, previo borrado del fondo, en cuatro capas con fusiones de color más oscuro, luz focal, normal y color más oscuro nuevamente, poniendo esta última capa encima de todo el diseño. Finalmente, entre las capas con partes puse los pétalos de flores y sobre todas las capas del diseño la mariposa. La animación está realizada completamente en After Effects, trabajando la opacidad de cada capa y agregando luces en forma de nubes para un mejor contraste. Les envío un gran saludo a todos y hasta la próxima. Gracias por ver y leer hasta aquí. Amonet - AV Design

info.title: A New Perspective ❤️ Amonet (EN-ES)
info.author: avdesing

content.description: <div class=\

> --- ![Nueva Visión.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ydEATFJXMCGsP8BCEmLW7oryAEp3HxsKW4YtMwGNeZBoUhjPuCX4aYkjWsCH2CcbZzm.jpg) ![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png) Often, something happens in life that gives us a different perspective; it might be something physical or spiritual, a lesson learnt, or a specific event. This design is dedicated to my mother, who recently had cataract surgery on one eye. She’s been short-sighted since she was a child, and back then it was frowned upon for someone to have poor eyesight; she never wore glasses, she just made do as best she could. It wasn’t until she was 32 that she got her first pair of glasses. I can’t imagine what it was like all that time, but she saw as best she could. It wasn’t severe short-sightedness, but she certainly didn’t see clearly. Now, three days after her operation, she is happy; she can see with that eye like never before in her life, different shades of colour, sharp outlines. A new lease of life at 72, and that makes me very happy. Sight is one of the most precious of the senses, and symbolically, visión, a change in vision or perspective, often changes one’s life as well. I like to make that comparison. With the cataract, she could see less and less; she couldn’t even see my face, and now her life is completely different, much better. It’s worth it; no matter what age you are, the change for the better is always worth it, both physically and spiritually.
SPANISH VERSION (click here!)

Muchas veces pasa algo en la vida que nos da una perspectiva diferente, puede ser algo físico como algo espiritual, un aprendizaje o un hecho puntual. Este diseño va dedicado a mi madre, que recientemente se ha operado de un ojo, de cataratas. Desde niña tiene miopía y en aquellos tiempos se veía mal que alguien viera menos, nunca usó gafas, veía como podía. Recién luego de los 32 años tuvo sus primeras gafas. No imagino como fue todo ese tiempo, pero ella veía como podía. No era extrema miopía, pero seguramente no veía nítido. Ahora luego de tres días de ser operada está feliz, ve con ese ojo como nunca en su vida, distintas gamas de colores, contornos nítidos. Una nueva vida a sus 72 años y me alegra mucho eso. La vista es de los sentidos más valiosos y simbólicamente la visión, el cambio de visión, perspectiva muchas veces también cambia la vida. Me gusta hacer esa comparación. Con la catarata cada vez veía menos, ni si quiera mi rostro y ahora su vida es otra, mucho mejor. Vale la pena, no importa a que edad sea, siempre vale la pena el cambio a mejor tanto en el sentido físico como el espiritual.

![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png)
Process in pictures - Proceso en imágenes
|![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi3smGLjTyPD31A7wu9Ajc9NZoYk7TnS7FbYKqv1vQfYmAngXT39U7i3RM9c8Xx4iaD.jpg)|![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1HXzDmAmbXvQLLnSi1zJyMcR6EX8WU9WWT6hxWAHXehh5ot8FwAMRUfY8zhWHQEpqr.jpg)| |-|-| |![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1Dn8bqfh3vxtGEG8wFkEW4YnmCRXCL4X12Vn9DoXm6xpn7PMXMqgS6LLsEDmP4fkGH.jpg)|![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x1FBAnzeds2bh9SCgx4wTc5pYkYUnYeskn4bqcmNdZs1mAfL977tgTBaNVuEmM8s95T.jpg)| ||| |![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGiiemm2QEirPmjyc12EfEJ54xmy1eqjqCRj8iJfBSe3xUqynhogQHXLcnYi91zdagD.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yd7r1jkCvLiHLgtZWHxd3QsUXfccGxZooXDs8EPiuLGqHKreJcGMUPvdNN3bDwfCxtK.jpg)| ||| |![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqnnniRyPHMU9vjKsCGhEMQ3mtwKceQvonSZASxfqHJRMXecYbAmVLhgv4HNHf7XCZR.jpg)|![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wCJSVqUPgD9rrzZ1D3X4trVh3QKMyf3nAwaHDcAo2Pq1FFaC7Vv9uEALv4x8XkxnRsm.jpg)| ![separador sencillo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/Eo8UGAXUZoPxi8Ny3bWhw7vRVQywdynrHRhAwwZtRqW9jnyK7CZ42782EyeJ1UKHQuv.png) # Design process The design was created entirely in Photoshop CS6 without the use of AI, using 11 royalty-free images distributed across 31 layers. First, I created a grey layer onto which I placed the abstract image; I duplicated it and rotated it horizontally, creating a mirror image; I merged them and continued working with that merged image, from which I created several layers, using various blending modes such as luminosity, soft light and normal. I then selected several parts, those with relief, cut them out and pasted them, thus generating six more layers, and to these parts I added the drop shadow layer style to separate them from the overall image. Beneath these layers containing the parts, I placed the textured image and used the soft light blending mode; I then added the silhouette and two of the flowers, the latter using the hard light blending mode, and in one corner I placed the image of the camera using the darker colour blending mode. On top of the four circles in the abstract design I placed an eye, and on top of each eye a ring using the spot light blending mode. I worked on the image of the woman, after erasing the background, across four layers using Darker Colour, Spot Light, Normal, and Darker Colour again, placing this final layer on top of the entire design. Finally, between the layers containing the individual parts, I placed the flower petals, and on top of all the design layers, the butterfly. The animation is done completely in After Effects, working on the opacity of each layer and adding lights in the form of clouds for better contrast. I send you all a big hello and see you next time. Thanks for watching and reading this far. Amonet - AV Design

title.title: Commercial Elevators vs Residential Lifts: What’s the Difference?
title.body:
###

![Commercial Elevators vs Residential Lifts What’s the Difference.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/25591d1bc3b4f8bd3b355752fe9db52c53495d07a220336a2284f71ac5601213)



Understanding the difference between commercial elevators and residential lifts is important when choosing the right solution for your building. In the comparison of [commercial elevators vs residential lifts](https://www.organesh.com/blog/commercial-elevators-vs-residential-lifts-what-s-the-difference), commercial elevators are designed for high-traffic environments such as offices, malls, hospitals, and hotels. They are built to handle heavy loads, frequent usage, and larger capacities. These elevators come with advanced safety systems, faster speeds, and compliance with strict industry regulations to ensure smooth operation in busy environments.

On the other hand, residential lifts are specifically designed for homes, villas, and small buildings. They focus more on comfort, compact design, and aesthetic appeal. Residential lifts require less space, consume less power, and often do not need a separate machine room. They are ideal for elderly users and individuals with mobility challenges, offering convenience and improved accessibility within the home.

Another key difference lies in cost and installation. Commercial elevators are more expensive due to their size, durability, and technical complexity. Residential lifts, however, are more affordable and easier to install with minimal structural modifications.

Choosing between the two depends on your usage needs, building type, and budget. For customized and high-quality solutions, Attico Elevators offers both commercial and residential lift options designed for safety, efficiency, and long-term performance.

title.body:

![Z5srAe3P4teFv2NE_image_1777609764924.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/Z5srAe3P4teFv2NE_image_1777609764924/Z5srAe3P4teFv2NE_image_1777609764924.webp)
![7b1ywUL9JXoKyWk3_image_1777609768813.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/7b1ywUL9JXoKyWk3_image_1777609768813/7b1ywUL9JXoKyWk3_image_1777609768813.webp)
![M2Z0IzCaSBBklEn3_image_1777609762699.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/carolin77/images/M2Z0IzCaSBBklEn3_image_1777609762699/M2Z0IzCaSBBklEn3_image_1777609762699.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

大家劳动节快乐呀，旅游的旅游 聚会的聚会，肯定开心呀 小长假的意义就在于此啦，暂时放下班味，迎来短暂的属于自己的生活。

今天娃的同学请客生日宴，我11点就给送过去了 同学家长很客气啊，一定要求留下来一起吃，西提牛排不错的餐厅，但是我肯定不能留啊，百般推辞才溜出来，都是一群小孩子，家长在那多少有些不自在，家长不自在，孩子也放不开玩的不尽兴。

然后我就走了，回家里追剧，他们在那吃好喝好，我在家里吃了药好困好困，睡了三个多小时，好长时间没有睡这么沉了，应该是真的累了，也或许是真的感冒严重了。

醒来看到小群，说是他们玩好了要去生日同学家里再聚，我心想去吧去吧，反正也不想写作业，回来我还得伺候着，去玩吧 我正好得个清闲。让我这个365天连轴转的劳动人民也休息休息。

无聊就上游戏玩了两把，没想到五一节假日还有加星卡，两把游戏给我加了六颗星。哎哟什么运气，也太好了吧。下线了快递送到，是我儿子给同学买的生日礼物，才送到，我又赶紧给娃打电话。

之前空手去就不好意思了，怕人家家长心理不得劲，现在到了喊他回来拿，正好我们两家住一个小区，回来拿了礼物又急匆匆跑了。这放假了，娃大了真是家里一秒都留不住。我看我还是继续睡觉吧，多休息病好的快。

---

title.title: A Healer's Touch.
title.body: >\n\nWhile seeking undiscovered quests, I defeated a bear that had just slain a Mongol. Guided by a golden bird, I met a healer and began the quest \

After fending off more bandits robbing peasants, I learned of a curse plaguing their camp.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXJ2HMybeThtaVKJxkjJXdhaiw3pDz1ki1HPReMuHrRo/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXkMdJkkmB9snxBm4hjfnQzfJ4EvnYk83Nkf4pnVANEhw/screenshot_2_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdfpx8eEjFBZZeSbTQJS99u4djKDVQsgKcG3reCWHBD7/screenshot_3_.png)

This time I decided to discover some undiscovered side quests, ignoring bandits or Mongols on the way to stay focused on exploration. However, I couldn't help but taking down a group of bandits on the way on my way.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVA5sEsve7CnViqkouQqt23WQ8KNtsXT69SSvbJJs7TYy/screenshot_4_.png)

I was heading towards a question mark on the map, which was an undiscovered location, and suddenly I noticed a Mongol was fighting a wild bear in the woods. I stopped for a moment, watching the primal struggle between man and beast.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3pyGFZSUe3y412nTfXKz7bpzupZLSmydLSxpU6zpXyr/screenshot_5_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZtu1nKc1H3VcBgA8BwupURrNkANRNpLAr6pD9o3jSUxf/screenshot_6_.png)

After the Mongol got killed by the bear, I went for the beast myself without hesitation. I still had a rage against a bear who took me down last time during my travels, and I wasn't about to let this one escape.

I dodged its heavy paws and struck back with my katana, finally putting the creature down.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxnorWyqjtdm3aymqBnoeMC1q26AX8f9bgac3tX4bLrB/screenshot_7_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbQgqRebF9Wp42LQwXtR7jwsZ4u8NEUPxL5y6L8fFgS9R/screenshot_8_.png)

After taking down the bear, I noticed there was this golden bird who was trying to get my attention by circling low. I started following it knowing these birds often lead to secret shrines or people in need. It chirped loudly, guiding me deeper into a part of the forest I had never visited before.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfBUVG25YFepQNgEbQ8Qsc1Vw9f8EfNaGpUrfSm4zPLq/screenshot_9_.png)

The bird took me to this undiscovered location where a healer asked for my help to escort him to a remote camp. He explained the camp was occupied by people who are seriously ill and in desperate need of his medicine. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFq2LuMo8qseH4jBz79SStuFLg1gEQycYiYr3Zi8txaC/screenshot_10_.png)

오늘 산책을 하면서 친구인 민수와 만났어요. 우리가 자주 가는 공원에서 만나기로 했는데, 민수가 새로운 카메라를 가지고 와서 서로 사진도 찍어보았죠. 산책 중에 가장 흥미로웠던 건, 공원 한쪽에 핑크색 꽃이 만개해 있는 걸 발견한 거예요. 그 꽃들이 너무 예뻐서 저도 모르게 사진을 많이 찍게 됐어요. 그리고 나무 위에서 뾰족한 부리의 청설모가 놀고 있는 모습도 봤는데, 정말 귀여웠답니다. 이렇게 작은 일상 속에서도 즐거운 순간들이 가득하다는 걸 느끼게 되었어요! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). title.title: Hive Power Up Day.
title.body:
## WARM GREETINGS 

It's Hive Power-Up Day, and after years on and off, I am officially back! 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmetVUz9M1Uv6zvHm3s95KFcWRx3k4fP9rzQSbGRWfKvL5/1777624322701.png)
> Image Generated Using Google Gemini. 

* I joined the Hive platform back in March 2023, full of enthusiasm, and things started strong. 

However, I made some mistakes along the way, fell into some bad company, and eventually hit the radar of the HiveWatchers, who blacklisted me because of my mistakes. 

* For those new here, Hive is an open-source, decentralized blockchain that's really all about community and user-powered content. Think of it like Reddit but built on blockchain, where users earn rewards through crypto for creating and curating content. 

After being disheartened and taking a break, I’ve returned to the platform with a new mentality. Now, I understand how things work much better, including curation rewards and voting power, and I’m focused on growing my influence the right way. My goal now is to consistently power up—starting with 20 HIVE—stick to the rules, and get fully involved again by engaging with posts, commenting, and bringing new people on board. It's good to be back!

It is first Hive Power-Up in which I am getting myself for Power-up, and adding 20 Hive into my HP, I will try my best to increase the value by next Month's Power-Up Day. 

An Important lesson I have learned here is
### A Blessing In Unity.

This means that when you work together with others, even the most difficult task will be completed easily and quickly due to your greater intelligence.

__________________________________
__________________________________

## اسلام علیکم!

یہ Hive Power-Up کا دن ہے، اور کئی سالوں کے بعد، میں باضابطہ طور پر واپس آیا ہوں! میں نے مارچ 2023 میں Hive کے پلیٹ فارم میں شمولیت اختیار کی، جوش و خروش سے بھرا ہوا، اور چیزیں مضبوط ہونے لگیں۔
 تاہم، میں نے میں کچھ غلطیاں کیں، کسی بُری صحبت میں پڑ گیا، اور آخر کار Hive Watchers کے ریڈار کو نشانہ بنایا، جس نے مجھے میری غلطیوں کی وجہ سے بلیک لسٹ کر دیا۔

* یہاں نئے لوگوں کے لیے، Hive ایک اوپن سورس، decenterlized بلاکچین ہے جو واقعی کمیونٹی اور صارف کی طاقت سے چلنے والے مواد کے بارے میں ہے۔ اسے Reddit کی طرح سوچیں لیکن بلاکچین پر بنایا گیا ہے، جہاں صارفین مواد بنانے اور کیوریٹنگ کے لیے کرپٹو کے ذریعے انعامات حاصل کرتے ہیں۔

مایوس ہونے اور وقفہ لینے کے بعد، میں ایک نئی ذہنیت کے ساتھ پلیٹ فارم پر واپس آیا ہوں۔ اب، میں سمجھتا ہوں کہ چیزیں کس طرح بہتر کام کرتی ہیں، بشمول کیوریشن انعامات اور ووٹنگ کی طاقت، اور میں اپنے اثر و رسوخ کو صحیح طریقے سے بڑھانے پر توجہ مرکوز کر رہا ہوں۔ میرا مقصد اب مستقل طور پر پاور اپ کرنا ہے — 20 HIVE سے شروع کرتے ہوئے — قوانین پر قائم رہنا، اور پوسٹس کے ساتھ مشغول ہو کر، تبصرہ کر کے، اور نئے لوگوں کو بورڈ میں لا کر پوری طرح سے دوبارہ شامل ہوں۔ واپس آنا اچھا ہے!

یہ پہلا Hive پاور اپ ہے جس میں میں خود کو پاور اپ کے لیے حاصل کر رہا ہوں، اور اپنے HP میں 20 Hive شامل کر رہا ہوں، میں اگلے مہینے کے پاور اپ ڈے تک قدر بڑھانے کی پوری کوشش کروں گا۔

 ایک اہم سبق جو میں نے یہاں سیکھا ہے۔

 ### اتحاد ایک نعمت۔

مطلب جب آپ دوسروں کے ساتھ مل کر کوئی کام کریں گے تو زیادہ دماغ ہونے کی وجہ سے آپکا مشکل سے مشکل کام بھی آسانی سے اور جلدی سے ہو جائے گا۔ 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3UUygStACc7KmxkE2F5R62gjiCe8ef2N1fSqJ4CkTph/1709406530011.png)


# NOTE

* English isn't my First even Second Language, sometime I use Google Translator.
* Photos have their source links..
* Don't hesitate to give your feedback , It will encourage my confidence.
* Thank you very much for reading and spending your Time.

>


Good morning! Blessings to everyone reading this on this beautiful morning of May 1st. I hope you are enjoying a nice hot coffee—or perhaps some hot chocolate—whichever you prefer! XD. Well, I’m here today to show you the new drawing I’ve created. As always, it is inspired by one of the lovely cards from the game *Rising Star*. This time around, I chose the \

card. As you can see, it features a very pretty blue microphone.

I should mention that this drawing is part of a series I’m working on, dedicated to illustrations of the microphones found in the game. That means if you haven't seen the previous entries, you can check them out on my blog once you’ve finished reading this post. I also want to invite you to keep an eye out for my upcoming drawings if you’re interested; I’ll be uploading new pieces over the next few days, and it’s always fun to share—and for you to see—the entire creative process from start to finish. Alright, let’s get started with the drawing! The first thing I did was create the classic inner frame for the card—veteran readers of my blog will surely recognize it well. Take a look at how it turned out:


![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo2BTut2oCymiUgdMdQ2m4urvmdQFuiE9cvmsrLYwiF2LSBCyPYnV8jczCjSH7htN3P.jpg)


After creating the frame using Adobe Illustrator, I moved on to drawing the microphone itself. I started with the handle—the largest and longest section—and then completed the body's silhouette by drawing the spherical head that sits atop the handle. You can see both parts in the photos below:


![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxa23wNtiSmBXUK9XEAPhnmi6ZCCmkS8jeGj8zACukHpuqGTSseZDMLrih3D8.jpg)

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S9Q1ShsR7zk9F4sYZScuSm29cfd2tdpJhq7Jxo3rucfwnLBCU9c942dnFypN7jS1.jpg)


Once the body was finished, I drew several internal lines within it to divide the microphone into distinct zones, as each zone requires a different color. Here’s how it looked after I added those lines:


![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S9Q1ShsR7zkC1iQxStmRNYPqQcvTeQ5Gh3yNKPjFBd6RvoJpyCookp4Br15d6smo.jpg)


Now comes the most enjoyable part: the coloring! For the outer background, I used a light purple shade to help the microphone stand out visually. As for the frame, the inner background, and various sections of the microphone itself, I colored them using different shades of blue. For the microphone's head, I applied various shades of gray to achieve the desired effect; incidentally, I also used a \

effect on the head, which adds a unique visual touch. You can view screenshots of the entire process below. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoiYgfoEmJxRhRdybkBCjBofjRMxcwdQCzSZ3mocdHP43Y38Cj1WKgYttqjDGeqiDrf.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpV9gHfYVmw8Ak2CkD5V1kCEU8jVpZ3wS3UVd29ye6YfggqeqKrVzXhcYEYwDcS5bnn.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EpzvKWF4JGyeE8pvUFAxahmL3PZHmKqJEs2khr8AKTuXGXissa4ruaE37GYVMd5NMj8.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eq7Ej3grKZdHV9WrTsS44X96qAMHx6jcn2LwpSDUdD2uUsX5xXfu1z4DnpnJQBqeaVY.jpg) And to wrap things up for today, here is the final result. In this step, I added the name of the game and the card. With that, it was complete. See you for the next drawing—blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoyN3N9RHjZBocoWgj6AeEeMRfChHabibJ91igECXeWPwz7iaT1i6nQi6Sp5mr5yy8Y.jpg)

title.title: 尝试在zed下使用DeepSeek
title.body:
昨天提到说我用DeepSeek V4的时候，发现速度奇慢无比，后来@lemooljiang  留言说，

>不要走openrouter，直接用官网的API就行，能快不少！

我昨晚试了下，用国内API 直连，发现果然是。

这真是“听人劝 吃饱饭”。

今早在家，试了下DeepSeek V4的效果。

我在本地电脑安装了个 zed 软件，


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwBuaYeWpaEXVToG6g65PYZSGmF74iLJ1PESYPkDmxJr/image.png)

这玩意比较冷僻，估计很多人都不一定听过。我之前有篇帖子介绍过这个软件，当初是把它当记事本来用，效果比一般的记事本文件要多很多，其中最大的优点，就是适合打开超大文件比如几百M甚至上G的文件，同时打开后浏览内容时，非常丝毫，不会有其它软件那种明显卡顿的感觉。

偶然间，发现这家伙竟然也有AI的功能，而且看起来，AI是它今后主攻的重点方向。

zed下接入大模型很简单，打开界面后，直接输入API key即可，


![11d58c0486327eaab24985c742401323.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVyF3ebo3CHDKKUUEoez9Ltnk8Jqzvq52PBU8Dp9Ru7NE/11d58c0486327eaab24985c742401323.png)

至于使用，也很简单，Ctrl+Enter 键，弹出个输入框，直接在里边输入即可，


![d929e6531f43d9b704e56518963119f2.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtNoZqAi9gcBaRisUEYAPd4jufo29iFhVbzvmRGWHbPL/d929e6531f43d9b704e56518963119f2.png)


我用Deep Seek V4 测试写了个简易计算器，发现通过直连速度果然快很多，而且生成后的界面还挺好看，


![3a5986df9eda6167c57647959658d78c.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV1FHXm1RGskrkFcKBK9DrgMjZbxT8oAX6Nn52pNgcTE1/3a5986df9eda6167c57647959658d78c.png)

孩子在边上，说让我帮他生成个变形金刚。

我试了下，生成后如下图，


![f797e52cc23d3aa29f7e20debaea62ff.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYiK2euDhRQ3sF34NqRchUC94v2tiXeyiGXDo7KPaACKb/f797e52cc23d3aa29f7e20debaea62ff.png)

发现生成的效果不好，很丑，而且还有乱码。

孩子一看这效果，顿时没了兴趣，转身就走开了。

哦，可能是我描述的不够清晰吧。囧

不过话说回来，zed的界面，做的真是极简到极致，很有种追求极客精神的味道。

title.title: PUD: Fast 6 Jahre Hive – ein Weg, den ich so nicht geplant hatte  🔸  PUD:  Almost 6 years with Hive – a path I never planned (de/en)
title.body:
>
🔽 You can find an English translation below
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23zGijeyuNpuPpbJdsx38Du2grMwRW6YMLX2QH7YBMZ2QyLz79bCiYAARZuGBR3BKmQnA.png) Seit ich mich mit Kryptowährungen beschäftige, hat sich einiges verändert. Im Sommer 2017 habe ich meinen ersten Bitcoin gekauft – für etwa 800 Euro. Das genaue Datum weiß ich heute nicht mehr. Es war eher ein Ausprobieren als ein Plan. Vieles fühlte sich neu an, ein bisschen unsicher, aber gleichzeitig spannend. Ich wusste damals nicht, wohin mich das führen würde. Nicht, wie oft ich Dinge wieder verwerfen würde. Und auch nicht, dass es irgendwann weniger um den Preis gehen würde – sondern um das, was man unterwegs lernt. Vor fast 6 Jahren, am 09.07.2020, bin ich dann mit etwa einem halben Bitcoin in das Hive-Ökosystem eingestiegen. Eigentlich bin ich gerade über ein ganz anderes Thema darauf gekommen. Ich habe mich zuletzt intensiver mit meinen Steuerunterlagen beschäftigt und wollte einmal wissen, wie sich mein Portfolio entwickelt hätte, wenn ich meine Gewinne anders investiert hätte. Daraus entstand die Idee für eine Gegenüberstellung: Was wäre passiert, wenn ich alles in BTC gelassen hätte – und wie sieht es im Vergleich zu Hive aus? Wichtig dabei: Ein großer Teil meines Hive-Bestands entstand nicht durch viele kleine Käufe, sondern durch eine einmalige Entscheidung im Jahr 2021. Ich bin damals relativ günstig an etwa 55k Hive gekommen und habe im Laufe der Zeit immer wieder etwas ergänzt. **Mit meinem heutigen Power-up bin ich bei 100k HP angekommen.** Die Grafik zeigt daher kein exaktes Abbild meiner Historie, sondern ein vereinfachtes Modell, um die Entwicklung vergleichbar zu machen. Und trotzdem sagt sie etwas aus. Ich habe versucht, die Entwicklung möglichst einfach darzustellen. Kein perfektes Modell, sondern eine Annäherung: gleiche Ausgangsbasis, gleiche Zeiträume – nur unterschiedliche Wege. Auf der einen Seite Bitcoin, als reines Halten. Auf der anderen Seite Hive, mit Umschichtungen und den zusätzlichen Rewards über die Zeit. Die Unterschiede werden dabei recht schnell sichtbar. Es ist keine exakte Rechnung – aber eine, die mir zumindest ein Gefühl dafür gegeben hat. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23tcLUdF6YPwbsEK2jCxSpX4LSdSLMeSyQAUcne4AyLafC6Mf1CLC7Fr7vT4E23tT1eS6.png) 👉 „Modellrechnung / Vergleichsszenario“ erstellt 27.04.2026 @vanje Bitcoin macht genau das, was man erwartet. Wenn der Markt läuft, wächst der Wert. Wenn er fällt, geht er runter. Klassisch. Hive fühlt sich anders an. Der Preis ist schwächer, keine Frage. Aber der Bestand wächst weiter. Jeden Tag ein bisschen durch Aktivität. Curation. Posts. Teilnahme. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23swaALWs9wp8xSyMToVJUwG7TRhT6kHYjCuut53ShTr35W4nCTz6PWDEYb2a88Q2jaUw.png)
Quelle: https://beebalanced.streamlit.app/balance_history_page Am Ende stehen heute: - Hive: ~100k HP Token - davon über 33k durch Rewards - Splinterlands: ~100k SPS Token - dazu laufende Rewards aus NFTs, Staking und Node-Lizenz Und das ist der Unterschied. Bitcoin wächst durch den Markt. Hive wächst auch ohne ihn. Aktuell ist BTC mehr wert. Aber Hive hat mir etwas anderes aufgebaut: einen Bestand, der nicht nur vom Preis abhängt. Und was man nicht unterschätzen sollte: der Lerneffekt. Der Umgang mit zentralen und dezentralen Börsen. Wie man Fiat in Krypto bringt – und wieder zurück. Welche Wege günstig sind und wo Abhängigkeiten entstehen. Aber nicht nur das. Hive war für mich auch ein Ort, an dem ich angefangen habe, Dinge festzuhalten. Gedanken aufzuschreiben. Erlebnisse zu reflektieren. Nicht geplant. Nicht perfekt. Einfach so, wie sie entstanden sind. Und mit der Zeit kommt noch etwas dazu: Der Austausch. Kommentare, Diskussionen, unterschiedliche Sichtweisen. Manchmal Bestätigung, manchmal Widerspruch. Und oft die Erkenntnis, dass viele Dinge gar nicht so weit auseinanderliegen, wie man zuerst denkt. Dass man Ansichten teilt – oder zumindest beginnt, sie gegeneinander abzuwägen. Das verändert den Blick. Natürlich lief nicht alles glatt. Es gab Fehlentscheidungen. Investitionen, bei denen ich am Ende mehr Hive verbrannt habe als gut war. Aber ehrlich gesagt: Das gehört dazu. Ähnliche Momente gab es auch bei Bitcoin – Projekte, in die ich BTC gesteckt habe und die sich am Ende nicht getragen haben. Es gab auch Phasen, in denen ich einfach Dinge ausprobiert habe – verschiedene Wege erkundet habe, manchmal über mehrere Konten hinweg. Nicht, weil ich einen festen Plan hatte, sondern weil sich Gelegenheiten ergaben und ich verstehen wollte, wie das System funktioniert. Mit der Zeit hat sich das geändert. Heute fühlt sich „weniger“ natürlicher an. Klarer, ruhiger, nachvollziehbarer. Ich werde mich mehr auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren und die Dinge vereinfachen, anstatt sie weiter auszubauen. Und vielleicht ist genau das der eigentliche Wert: Nicht nur das, was geblieben ist – sondern das, was man unterwegs gelernt hat. Und genau das sind mit Gründe, warum ich nach 6 Jahren immer noch hier bin. Nicht nur wegen der Zahlen. 🙂 **Was ist langfristig stabiler – Preis oder Beteiligung?**
Und was meine Steuern betrifft: Da bin ich optimistisch. 2026 wird vermutlich schlechter als 2025, aber dafür besser als 2027. 😉
![Banner3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/242hURFz7ojc1THu6XhrApRDc3FLR4zcwnpQtgrAFQnH6am273ixWoc32cwHByESscuZq.png)
🔽 Englisch Translation
# 6 years of Hive – a path I never planned ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23zGijeyuNpuPpbJdsx38Du2grMwRW6YMLX2QH7YBMZ2QyLz79bCiYAARZuGBR3BKmQnA.png) Since I got involved with cryptocurrencies, quite a few things have changed. In the summer of 2017, I bought my first Bitcoin – for around 800 euros. I don’t remember the exact date anymore. It was more of an experiment than a plan. Everything felt new, a bit uncertain, but at the same time exciting. Back then, I had no idea where this would lead me. Not how often I would rethink things. And not that at some point it would become less about price – and more about what you learn along the way. Almost 6 years ago, on July 9th, 2020, I entered the Hive ecosystem with roughly half a Bitcoin. Actually, I came back to this through a completely different topic. Recently, I’ve been going through my tax records and started wondering how my portfolio would have developed if I had invested my gains differently. That led to a simple comparison: What would have happened if I had kept everything in BTC – and how does it compare to Hive? One important note: A large part of my Hive holdings didn’t come from many small purchases, but from a single decision in 2021. Back then, I was able to acquire around 55k Hive at a relatively low price and added to it over time. **With today's power-up, I've reached 100k HP.** So the chart doesn’t represent my exact history, but rather a simplified model to make the development comparable. And still, it says something. I tried to keep the model as simple as possible. Not perfect, just an approximation: same starting point, same timeframes – but different paths. On one side Bitcoin, simply held. On the other side Hive, with reallocations and additional rewards over time. The differences become visible quite quickly. It’s not an exact calculation – but it gave me a sense of how things evolved. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23tcLUdF6YPwbsEK2jCxSpX4LSdSLMeSyQAUcne4AyLafC6Mf1CLC7Fr7vT4E23tT1eS6.png)
👉 “Model / comparison scenario” created 27.04.2026 @vanje Bitcoin behaves exactly as expected. When the market runs, the value goes up. When it drops, it goes down. Classic. Hive feels different. The price is weaker, no question. But the balance keeps growing. A little bit every day through activity. Curation. Posts. Participation. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vanje/23swaALWs9wp8xSyMToVJUwG7TRhT6kHYjCuut53ShTr35W4nCTz6PWDEYb2a88Q2jaUw.png)
Source: https://beebalanced.streamlit.app/balance_history_page Today, this is where I stand: Hive: ~100k HP more than 33k of that from rewards Splinterlands: ~100k SPS plus ongoing rewards from NFTs, staking, and node license And that’s the difference. Bitcoin grows through the market. Hive grows even without it. Right now, BTC is worth more. But Hive has built something different for me: a position that doesn’t rely solely on price. And there’s something else that shouldn’t be underestimated: the learning process. Understanding centralized and decentralized exchanges. How to move fiat into crypto – and back again. Which routes are efficient, and where dependencies exist. But it’s not just that. Hive also became a place where I started to write things down. To capture thoughts. To reflect on experiences. Not planned. Not perfect. Just as they came. And over time, something else developed: interaction. Comments, discussions, different perspectives. Sometimes confirmation, sometimes disagreement. And often the realization that many views aren’t that far apart after all. That you share perspectives – or at least begin to weigh them against your own. It changes how you see things. Of course, not everything worked out. There were wrong decisions. Investments where I ended up burning more Hive than I should have. But honestly: that’s part of it. I had similar moments with Bitcoin – putting BTC into projects that didn’t work out in the end. There were also phases of simply trying things out – exploring different paths, sometimes across multiple accounts. Not because of a fixed plan, but because opportunities appeared and I wanted to understand how the system works. Over time, that shifted. These days, less feels more natural. Clearer, calmer, easier to follow. I’ll be focusing more on what matters and simplifying things, rather than continuing to expand them. And maybe that’s the real value: Not just what remains – but what you’ve learned along the way. And that’s one of the reasons why I’m still here after 6 years. Not just because of the numbers. 🙂 **What is more stable in the long run – price or participation?**
And regarding my taxes: I’m optimistic. 2026 will probably be worse than 2025, but better than 2027. 😉

title.title: Tokenized RWAs are up by 420% since 2025
title.body:
![HI How to tokenize your business equity RWA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/23xp4XcJFmAf2TsqY7hXoFcrkko4JdmhRn6mSLCacG6U3swsJ9oPoxU3soWtuM7RecBCv.jpg)

>The size of the tokenized real-world asset (RWA) market has increased by more than 420% since the start of 2025, as investors were treated to easier market access and regulatory clarity, according to analysts.

>The RWA market cap was about $5.8 billion on Jan. 1, 2025, but has since risen to more than $30.2 billion as of Wednesday, according to analytics platform RWA.xyz. Tokenized US Treasurys experienced the largest increase, from $3.9 billion at the start of 2025 to more than $15 billion, followed by commodities. — [Cointelegraph report](https://cointelegraph.com/news/tokenized-rwa-market-cap-spiked-in-the-last-15-months)

### Impressive

The tokenized real world assets market added 4.2x its value in less than 1.5 years. This 420% growth is impressive and it gives us a picture of just how fast things are moving.

BlackRock's BUIDL would rank #33 in the list of most valuable crypto assets and it's worth noting that there's a whole different tokenized asset class called the represented tokenized RWAs by RWA.xyz and that is worth over $413 billion today.

Clearly, things are moving along quickly.

### TradFi recognizes the opportunity 

One misconceptions crypto natives hold is that TradFi players don't understand the inherent value of on-chain finance.

A lot of people think that the investment firms don't know the appeal, the efficiency and the valuation generation opportunities is something these entities understand quite well.

In most cases, regulatory clarity limits actions from these firms. 

That said, it is also worth realizing the approach taken by TradFi when it comes to on-chain finance.

It is evident that fighting the decentralized finance market is a losing game, so instead of doing that, tokenizing real world assets is the smart first move choice.

Global market participants may have reasons to want to invest in tokenized US Treasuries despite the centralized factor.

Traditional finance rails limits the global market from accessing these investment products, but tokenization can fix this. This gives TradFi an opportunity to tap into new markets as where they've held monopoly for years becomes threatened by DeFi.

This is adaptation, this is survival and there's sufficient opportunities to make this move worth it.
