title.title: Diy//HOW I MADE THIS ELEGANT BUBU ANKARA GOWN WITH FRINGE
title.body:
Hello hive 




![Collage 2026-05-01 09-33-57.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AKPkENpDGFkToJ24FSvrEHiy23e12eSMgbkaSXfqWrJPX1J4vSb8YqiSwyiB43w.png)



Happy new month, DIY Hub family! 🎉
May this month bring fresh ideas, creativity, and success to all our hands. Let’s keep creating and inspiring! ✨
Today I’m excited to share detail on how I made this simple, classy, and free-bubu Ankara gown with a fringe underneath—perfect for comfort and style!




![IMG_5491~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/242DG1QLBcmZ51SAxRoMii2sbLtR9fZkypjNkrdkZxZA4LdSKo5bLRgHtcqWvXxdyKJR2.jpg)




For this outfit, I used 2 yards of Ankara fabric and 2 yards of black fringe, along with my basic tools like tape rule, chalk, and matching thread.

I started by folding my Ankara fabric into four to cut both the front and back together. This makes the process faster and ensures neatness. From the top edge, I marked my shoulder measurement (15 inches) and added my sleeve length (12 inches) to achieve that loose bubu sleeve style.


![IMG_20260403_142758_704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23xKtYYCMfZQ1Rq5D5eKB24kRhTiVR4x2T1iyFht8379yM7rtCT5JBBBq7p8631QcGppx.jpg)



Next, on that shoulder line, I measured 11 inches downward to create the sleeve opening. This is very important so the outfit doesn’t feel tight around the arm area.

For the neckline, I kept it simple and elegant Neck width: 4 inches Front depth: 7 inches (V-shape) Back depth: 1.5 inches (round)

After cutting the neckline, I moved to shaping the gown. Since bubu gowns are free-sized, I used the hip measurement (40 inches) as the widest part of the body and added 6 inches allowance for comfort. I marked this across and connected it straight down to the full length of 39 inches (shoulder to knee).

To make it more functional, I marked 17 inches from the shoulder for the pocket placement. This adds both style and convenience to the outfit.




![IMG_20260403_152821_382.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23uQiCBapbz1sBpxyjDxe8ZaKTuBvgr7ybHozpXoQGVXgq6S2ufdZzgNUUKZWY1RnoHtL.jpg)




![IMG_20260403_153637_770.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23tvVWvBEveVsUmCupvQSjbr3ZpxnCV5DDAWAaGpf8H6xTVipVmUbJMQcF6fYD8JRDssP.jpg)




After cutting everything out neatly, I began sewing by joining the sides from the sleeve down, making sure to leave the 11-inch space for the arm opening. I then attached the pockets and neatly finished the neckline using a clean  bias.



![IMG_20260403_145010_303.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23uFKd2rMU7BJr1mwUdR1quCFHe1sMo6nCPVBEetFL6WQG5n7gP8DNG9MvoCuNFCndLn4.jpg)




![IMG_20260403_150731_171.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23tvW4E8hs3Tbud3WzNGyxrdWLtZUNTRjUZEZy3jxBxf2rHBwnGXmqyrFViTdhkXbAJus.jpg)


Now to the highlight of the outfit  — the fringe!I carefully attached the black fringe to the hem of the Ankara, ensuring it was evenly distributed. This gave the gown that beautiful layered effect and extra movement when worn.



![IMG_20260403_160142_895.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23uQhpvwHCJymR6Aqnk4vrquYFoYCsn7AszyV8Z3f6XGw6CQKp81pq1Vg5bPcvtmsfSDi.jpg)

title.title: Unlock the True Beauty of Your Home’s Hard Surfaces
title.body:
Natural stone just gives an effortless elegance to a space. From marble flooring in a corridor to granite countertops in a kitchen, stones are solid surfaces which add durability and aesthetics to interiors. However, even the toughest of materials sometimes start to lose their glimmer over time. It is something that grows unnoticed when scratches, scuffs and stains proliferate, bonding with the surface even before they are visible.

 

This is where professional [stone polishing in Sydney](https://g.page/sydney-stone-polishing?share) as well as stone restoration Sydney services come into play to revive these tired surfaces instead of simply replacing them.

 

Stone is not only strong but also has great longevity and resilience, as it even replicates those characteristics of stone in this elegant finish: the lovely harshness of stone makes it flawless for daily use. The foot traffic grinds in finely powdered dust that serves as sandpaper. Stains: Spills penetrate porous surfaces. Cleaning with the wrong product can also take off the finish gradually over time, and even with regular cleaning.

 

An unground marble floor may only need tidying up for one year before the whole surface starts looking patchy in a busy office lobby with poor ongoing maintenance. Which unevenly loses its sheen, resulting in an engaging downtrodden look while the corners remain glossy.

 

**What Stone Polishing Actually Does**

 

Being a professional stone polisher in Sydney is not only all about giving an old and dull surface shine again. Essentially, it’s a multi-step process that helps to remove the blemishes and brings back the natural finish of the stone.

 

**This often includes:**

 

Sanding away minor flaws in the wood

 

Smoothing the surface to attain an even, uniform texture

 

Polishing to restore the original degree of shine

 

Sealing to prevent future damage

 

Therefore, you have got a surface that not only looks more appealing but also leaves a safe and low-maintenance surface.

 

**When Polishing Isn’t Enough**

 

Polishing the stone countertop is sometimes not enough. Worn-out, in-depth marks, cracks, or structural wear require a lot more to treat. That's where Stone Restoration Sydney comes in.

 

**Restoration can include:**

 

Repairing chips and cracks

 

Replacing damaged sections

 

Deep cleaning to get those stains out

 

Re-leveling uneven tiles or slabs

 

Consider an original stone floor in a historic home. After decades, the surface may have developed some cracks and discoloration. As an alternative to getting a new floor—something costly and which risks diluting the character of the residence—a restoration retains that classic look, although it’s more tough.

 

**Residential vs Commercial Needs**

 

How (and why) you use stone in a home is far different than how it is done in trade spaces.

 

For homes, it is mostly about the look—you want your kitchen countertops and bathrooms as well as living areas to appear good.

 

Durability and safety is important on commercial settings just as much as appearance, especially in busy areas like hotel lobbies or retail spaces.

 

For example, a restaurant can require buffing frequently for a neat and clean look while maintaining non-slippery floors.

 

**Restoration: Creating Long-Term Value over Short-Term Replacement**

 

Stonnee Restoration Sydney gives you a tonne of advantages; one of them is the cost efficiency. The cost and time it takes to eventually replace stone surfaces is costly and disruptive. In contrast, restoration offers the opportunity to prolong the use of existing materials with a much lower capital outlay.

 

It also has environmental benefits. By recycling stone, less is wasted, and there is no need for new materials to be sourced, making it a sustainable option.

 

Things to remember day by day: maintenance To simply recall

 

With the bulk of the work being done in professional services, there are a few everyday practices that can help maintain the results:

 

Clean with pH-neutral cleansers formulated for stone

 

Promptly wipe up spills to avoid staining

 

Be careful with acid cleaning agents and abrasive tools that may scratch surfaces

 

Get periodic professional polishing of high-use areas

 

Those small efforts can drastically slow the wear on stone and help to keep it looking its best in between professional cleaning services.

 

**Final Thoughts**

 

Steel surfaces are a piece of design, performance and part investment — but they require taking care of to maintain their purpose. Expert stone polishing in Sydney brings back the dull and worn areas to their original glory. When damage does go deeper, [Stone Restoration Sydney](https://g.page/sydney-stone-polishing?share) provides a repair and restore alternative to a complete new one.

 

So it’s not a matter of merely returning a very hard, solid mineral to its former glory—it’s about keeping some personality and quality in your food that made it worth choosing the stone to begin with.

title.title: Personal experiences from life Journey And Rising Star Game Progress
title.body:
I have been disconnected from the outside world. I havent been able to travel anywhere to take photos for my blog because the current situation in Myanmar is still unstable. 

I have been working as a basic construction worker for the past few days. Staying indoors means I dont know whats going on in the outside world. My job is to help with construction. We have to build a fence around a yard. There are two types of workers: skilled construction workers and helpers. One of the helpers shared her experiences during her working hours. What she said covered a wide range of topics. She shared her experience of being possessed by a spirit. Our science has not yet found a practical answer to the question of faith and the spirit. After many years of struggle and technology continues to advance, I think that science will eventually find answers to our mental and spiritual problems.

Construction workers in Myanmar have to work hard due to the demands of technology.  The need for technology and equipment is a testament to the importance of the countrys economy and jobs. One of the experiences the woman shared involved a restaurant employee. The restaurant employee was monitored by CCTV cameras all the time. The employees were feeling insecure and under pressure. Due to the political instability in Myanmar, workers are losing their labor rights. Without having to look hard for evidence to prove this, you can find articles on the internet about the loss of labor rights in Myanmar. 

These are the current events happening in the real world. Everyone is on their own journey. Thanks to the Hive Platform, which allows you to share these stories freely. You can earn rewards by sharing your experiences on Hive. Today, I spent the day at home. My cats are my companions. Now, my cats are growing up well. They are also characters who have accompanied me on my journey.  We don't know when we will part ways, but let's move forward with love for each other...

title.title: Dhaka Did Not Lack Potential. It Lacked Stewardship.
title.body:
/>

Hero image: Aerial drone photo taken on Sept. 5, 2025, showing a city view along the Buriganga River in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Photo by Habibur Rahman/Xinhua.

Look at this view properly.

This is not a city without potential. This is a city betrayed by the people who were supposed to build it.

A river like this should have changed the fate of Dhaka. This should have been one of the most beautiful urban corridors in South Asia. Clean water. Planned expansion. Proper roads. Walkable waterfronts. Public spaces. Transport logic. Civic pride. A real capital city.

Instead, we got chaos, decay, greed, syndicates, broken rules, and people in power who knew how to take from the city but not build for it.

That is what hurts.

Because Dhaka did not lack land.
It did not lack people.
It did not lack energy.
It did not lack opportunity.

It lacked stewardship.

Other nations had problems too. Some were poor. Some were broken by crisis. Some were rebuilding after war, instability, or collapse. But they still made hard decisions. Singapore cleaned its river and built a system. Malaysia grew through discipline and direction. Vietnam kept moving. Rwanda rose from horror and still pushed urban order and national rebuilding. Even countries that suffered deeply found ways to stand back up and create cities that feel like they belong to people who care.

And then there is us.

A city like this could have expanded properly across the river. It could have become a source of pride. It could have been our own version of a world-class waterfront capital. Not a copy of London, but a Dhaka that made people feel something other than exhaustion.

/> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ophibious/243zXGtxn5bRZCUm4YrkgYgXfkZisDkMzz16f9ZBiXr5LvFFTWJWXYW4Wd7vt1YQP8cS9.png)

Concept image: Created by Mohammad Ismail using ChatGPT, showing what this riverfront could have been with proper vision, planning, and civic stewardship.

Mohammad Ismail: “Was bored (chatgpt)”

Mahtab Mashuq Tonmoy: “you just created what I pictured”

Instead, this city feels like a place everyone uses and nobody truly loves.

People want to make their next buck.
Leaders want to fill their pockets.
Rules are optional.
Public space gets stolen.
Footpaths disappear.
Traffic steals years from people’s lives.
The river gets treated like a dump.
And everything turns into a syndicate.

Then we call it normal.

It is not normal.
It is failure.

And yes, what we have built is a failed version of democracy too. Because democracy without education, without civic culture, without rule enforcement, without consequences, becomes manipulation. It becomes noise. It becomes a system where the public is managed, not served.

That is where Dhaka stands today.

Not as a city without promise.
But as a city with enormous promise that was squandered by greed, weak institutions, no discipline, and a complete lack of long-term thinking.

That is why this view is heartbreaking.

Because you can still see the possibility.

You can still see what this city could have been.
You can still imagine the roads, the waterfront, the skyline, the order, the dignity.
You can still imagine a Dhaka that was built with love instead of exploited for profit.

But imagination is all we have had for too long.

And that is not enough anymore.

From now on, I am going to speak more about the things we are lacking, the things we keep normalizing, and the things that are silently destroying this country.

Stay connected.

body.title: NEVER SETTLE FOR LESS
body.body:
Hello everyone your welcome to my blog

Settling for less in life starts when we make mistakes and don't learn from them. Someone who was once careless may become serious after making mistakes. Someone who used to be proud may become humble after being broken. Someone who was always angry may soften after being loved the right way. These things don’t happen because the person was fake before, but because life forced growth. Still, even when people change, something familiar usually remains. The person who becomes calm may have always wanted peace. The one who becomes disciplined may have always wanted stability.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWwWrUwrCw6zwb9g89J9DxZscY5cW6KnKErZgNd7EV141/160472.jpg 


Let's come down to those who  allow life hold them back are the ones that will be like \

and then do you hold on to that ideology and refuse to do anything about life you continue blaming somebody else about what's happening in their life and that stage is very dangerous I used to be there, but I didn't remain there. 


Everyday people try to prove themselves to be an extraordinary person but being an extraordinary person, they need to bear the responsibility for it and bearing the responsibility is not so easy all the time. So, most people feel that being average is the most important thing in life and what’s the thought behind people want to be average or ordinary. 


There will always be people who get into the spotlight, people always observe them and every step of them. As a human having flaws is natural but it’s necessary to hide the flaws otherwise people can take advantage of the weakness. Even with extraordinary ability, one person can have weaknesses. When people can reveal their weakness, they can target it and attack regularly.


Thank you for stopping by my blog

body.title: The Beautiful Street in Lekki Phase One
body.body:
It is another day, a very good one in deed to be alive and healthy. This is my entry to this week's #wednesdaywalk by @tattoodjay. This week walk is within the axis of Lekki Phase 1. This is on the Island part of Lagos state, the financial economics state of the country. One thing that I love about this part of the state is its calmness and the tree planting process of the area. It is very rare to see a street without a tree in Lekki Phase one. In fact there is no such street. This make the area calm and very sane for living. And the trees being planted are also medicinal trees for anyone's use.

Basically the whole of Lagos is divided into three parts, and this division is not contestable. We have the Island, which comprises of the wealthy people of the state. I can state this unapologetically that most people that reside in this part of Lagos State are millionaires. Then we have the mainland, which in itself divided into two. The part very much closer to the Island have much more wealthy people than those who live far away. Exception include Maryland, Some part of Ikeja, Magodo, Omole Phase one and two.

It’s incredible how well your neighbours know you; they know that if there’s fog, you’ll be there without fail to take photos. And what’s just as incredible is how characteristic that fog has become,  they actually miss it. Where I used to live in Argentina, it’s known as the ‘City of Wind’; there’s always wind, and when there isn’t… something strange is going on.

But it’s true that the fog sparks all sorts of things in the imagination; in my case, it would be plenty of suspense and mystery stories, because it stops you seeing properly, so whatever’s hidden within it—in our imagination, is unknown, and that… is scary. Your photographs are wonderful, and my favourites are the ones of the dog and the cat; they’re used to those days too. Always spectacular work. Thank you very much and a big hug!🤗

>Es increíble lo bien que te conocen los vecinos, saben que si hay niebla estarás allí sin falta para tomar fotografías y lo también increíble es como ya es tan característica esa niebla que la extrañan. Donde vivía en Argentina se la conoce como la ciudad del viento, siempre hay viento y cuando no hay... algo raro pasa.

>Pero es verdad que la niebla genera muchas cosas que provienen de la imaginación, en mi caso serían muchas historias de suspenso y misterio, porque ella no permite ver bien, por lo que, lo que se esconde en ella, en nuestra imaginación, es desconocido y eso... da miedo. Tus fotografías son maravillosas y mis favoritas son la del pero y el gato, ellos también estan acostumbrados a esos días. Siempre un espectacular trabajo. Muchas gracias y un gran abrazo!🤗

body.title: For My Little Lion
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>




![cd4758e8-adc1-41e4-842a-2148826cc11c.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23vsNB8vdWi26NyawyUubaV9wx4PweowWGhRSKH4wRZr1VxaXyn845T5TQsAhRRUkMu79.jpeg)

Today started as a weary thing, dull and dragging its feet through my hours, until your image found me.

There you were, curled in a kingdom of leaves with morning sunlight filtering through. Such a blessing. Your small body is at ease with the world again as you lift one paw, mid-story, that’s just you pausing between mischief and rest, a little sovereign in repose.

My dearest Tiger, you have grown. Not just in size, but in spirit, your once fragile form now restored, your wound no longer making me worry, it’s now a memory your furry body has outlived.

![94ffcc16-73b2-4dc5-97ac-3edc4af7e2c7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23u63AjjBWVEfjpFPSE8aAMFT4mAo4uKL48hWJ3BDEkAEXRfDjimGYgRPNZ8axhmM2UPr.jpeg)

And I, although miles away from you, held together by just photographs, I feel so much warmth in my heart. I feel light. Because there you are in the photo, alive in your simple, untroubled way, stretching into the day like nothing had ever dared to harm you.

My little lion, they said, and they were right. For what is a lion, if not a creature that survives, heals, and returns to the sun like it had always belonged there?

I thought of you in my wake, I miss you each passing day, and getting photos of you today healed something in me and made my day which started rough, bearable. 


</diva>

H_ A_ P_ P_ Y BIRTHDAY KESSY!
My daughter

![20260501_014028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anzaya26/23u67FWMUA9Z6tenLGTr3hUQUjtZkSZ5A1P6J2qfb6ksmtUDreuFDQe3VN2og5bJ2gLFK.jpg)

Today is a very special day in my life as a Mother. My heart is full of joy and gratitude to God as I celebrate my beautiful daughter, Kessy, on her birthday. Watching her grow over the years has been one of the greatest blessings I could ever ask for. From a little girl full of curiosity to a strong and intelligent young woman, her journey has been nothing short of amazing.

Kessy is my fourth child, and she holds a unique place in my heart. Every child is special, but there is something about her calm nature, her smile, and the way she carries herself that always stands out. She has this quiet strength and kindness that draws people close to her. As a father, I feel proud seeing the woman she is becoming.

![IMG-20260430-WA0037.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anzaya26/242NqqZcC3GpL5gb4xLnotYAgjG82JuGh1N5NZzUK8Up4hQgGdP7xx9n1GrYJMRqqdcH6.jpg)

She is currently schooling at Nasarawa State University, Keffi (NSUK), and even though she is away from home, the bond we share remains strong. Distance has never reduced the love I have for her. In fact, moments like this remind me how much she means to me. I plan to visit her, bring her back home to Lafia, and spend quality time together. The journey is not too far, just about 1 hour and 30 minutes, but the joy of bringing her home makes it feel even shorter.

![IMG-20260430-WA0035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anzaya26/243BiCiiMW11YCCEUqtnW2tsyQ19Ucie6HKoCctdSynu9JqfWyqy1LXaHwcNKsyfBvR2b.jpg)

She recently sent me her studio pictures, and honestly, I was overwhelmed with joy. Seeing her looking so confident, beautiful, and grown made me reflect on how far she has come. Time truly flies. Just yesterday she was a little girl running around the house, and now she is blossoming into a responsible young woman with dreams and purpose.

![IMG-20260430-WA0034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anzaya26/23ywuYUe6kXCu4pMVHoheBao1NsaujNpYCSFukm4jY3PyNTb2QSq11MSqcqjTunHZwJPb.jpg)

To celebrate her special day, I am planning to take her out for a nice outing here in Lafia. We have a few lovely places in mind, like City Mall or Chicken Republic, where we can relax, eat good food, and just enjoy the moment together. It may seem simple, but sometimes the best memories come from these little moments shared with loved ones.

Kessy, as you add another year today, I want you to know that you are deeply loved and cherished. Keep being yourself, stay focused on your goals, and never forget where you come from. Life will bring challenges, but I believe in your strength and ability to overcome them. Continue to shine, continue to grow, and continue to make us proud.

I pray that this new age brings you happiness, good health, success in your studies, and fulfillment in all areas of your life. May God guide your steps and protect you wherever you go.

![IMG-20260430-WA0031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anzaya26/23zRw9mjmNS3ogpj1vkV3d27poY9aboV4Fv8JHaP8DAFCvemMCwR2gy4TsjhDFzDTwnzh.jpg)

**Paid Premium Platforms**

Not as a shortcut, but as part of a bigger strategy. And once you see your first release ranking on Google… You'll get why people are quietly investing in this space.

body.title: SPS Governance Proposal — Whitelist SPL Market as an Approved Third-Party Market
body.body:
![logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/AJithMy81PCNY1qJAKEbjmJuG5aa6zNRXYKrXqJCXjVTtHjHmMHzaG8jAgXoonC.png)

## Proposal

This proposal asks the SPS DAO to whitelist SPL Market ([spl.market](https://spl.market/)) as an approved third-party marketplace, allowing it to retain the standard 4% market fee on transactions processed through the platform.

If approved, SPL Market will continue operating as it has for the past 2 years: discounted card sales, a bid system, DEC staking, and high cashback rates to Splinterlands players. The 4% market fee that sustains these services stays in place.

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

## Who I Am

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23vhMwcxrGvgqR34GuVs1wMdk4VYkRAjBmmfLn5HNWszDrYim1YHQJKVxoR7sQsd9TUxL.png)

I am Altryx. I've been playing and building in this ecosystem for over 5 years.

My stake in this game (and this proposal) is real:

- 1,000,000+ staked SPS
- 7,000,000+ DEC (most of it staked on [spltrader.com](https://spltrader.com/) for the DEC staking pool)
- 5,000+ staked HIVE

I'm a solo developer. I built and run two services, [SPL Market](https://spl.market/) and [SplTrader](https://spltrader.com/), and they depend on each other. SplTrader handles the trading infrastructure (bids, P2P deals, DEC staking). SPL Market is the marketplace where players actually buy and sell.

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

## What SPL Market does

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tGViEAiuixXVZDewDwKrWi6486Pso4h8bevZA9Sk638XAg8zmQbecLPJEKsMTwrZGSb.png)


SPL Market is a Splinterlands marketplace where you can buy and rent cards. Also, you can buy land and items. The core draw: **75%+ cashback on every purchase** (3% of the total amount spent, returned to you).

That's the baseline for free users. The full membership structure:

| Plan | Cost | Cashback | Bid Cashbacks |
|------|------|----------|------------|
| Free | $0 | 75% (3% of spend) | 0% |
| Monthly | $0.99/mo | 85% (3.4% of spend) | 25% |
| Yearly | $9.99/yr | 95% (3.8% of spend) | 50% |
| Lifetime | $99.99 | 99% (3.95% of spend) | 75% |

None of this is locked behind a paywall. Free users get a solid deal. Paid members get more, but the best value in the market is available to everyone.

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

### What makes SPL Market different

**P2P card sales:** We buy cards through the SplTrader service and resell them peer-to-peer with discounts. Buyers get cards cheaper than market price. Sellers get exit liquidity without tanking prices. Zero marketplace fees on P2P deals.

**Bid system:** Players set target prices on specific cards they want. When someone lists that card at or below the bid price, it auto-fills. Powered by SplTrader, and one of only two bid systems in the ecosystem (the other being PeakMonsters).

**DEC staking on SplTrader:** Players stake their DEC in the SplTrader pool and earn passive returns. Withdraw anytime with a 24-hour delay. The pool is funded by market activity, not by printing tokens.

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

## Why this matters to the ecosystem

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23wLv3rWZX2J9W8EWDKiozXFH5TK1Zoh45pu7TfJwcLDkxRVeHbPjbKYPg8YvcJwyTdKr.png)

SPL Market and SplTrader are not passive participants in the Splinterlands economy.

**DEC burning.** Roughly 20,000 DEC per day goes up in smoke through normal market activity. Over 2 years, that's millions of DEC permanently removed from circulation. We post daily burn updates on our [X account](https://x.com/spltrader).

**Exit liquidity without price crashes.** SplTrader buys cards from players who want out, then resells them gradually at fair prices. Players can cash out without dumping on the order book and dragging prices down for everyone.

**Passive DEC income.** Stakers on SplTrader earn real returns funded by actual market activity.

On top of that: $10,000–$20,000 in monthly market activity, and ~128,000 cards sold over the lifetime of these services.

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

## Security and trust

People trust me with their assets. I take that seriously.

No private keys required. All transactions go through standard Splinterlands APIs and Hive Blockchain.

2+ years of operation with no security incidents. Many users trust the platform with thousands of dollars worth of assets and tokens.

Reserves are transparent. We keep 20%+ of all staked DEC in reserve at all times. Right now the reserve ratio is over 50%. 

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

## How the fees are used

SPL Market runs on thin margins. The 4% market fee isn't profit. It's what makes everything sustainable:

- Cashback payments to users (the majority of the fee flows straight back to buyers)
- Server costs and infrastructure for two platforms
- DEC staking pool yields for stakers
- Reserve maintenance so everyone can withdraw when they want

I didn't build SPL Market to extract maximum value. The goal was to give players a better deal than they'd get elsewhere, build something useful, and let SplTrader's value proposition reach more people.

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

## What happens if this proposal fails

If SPL Market isn't whitelisted, the 4% fee goes away. And with it: the cashback, the bid system's economics, the DEC staking pool yields, and the P2P discount model. None of these are sustainable without that fee.

Two years of building. 127,000+ card sales. Daily DEC burning. A growing user base. All of it would effectively shut down. Players lose a marketplace that gives them better deals. The ecosystem loses a working DEC sink.

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

## What I'm committing to

If this passes, I commit to:

- Continuing transparent operations as described above
- Maintaining the 20%+ DEC reserve ratio at all times
- Posting regular updates on market activity and DEC burning
- Operating in good faith with the DAO and the Splinterlands community

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

## Summary

SPL Market has been running for 2 years. Nearly 128,000 cards sold. Consistent monthly transaction volume. Millions of DEC burned. Players getting better prices on card purchases than they'd find elsewhere. No private keys required, no security incidents.

I'm asking the DAO to recognize that track record and whitelist SPL Market as an approved third-party marketplace, keeping the standard 4% market fee that makes these services possible.

Vote **For** if you think the ecosystem benefits from competitive, high-cashback marketplaces that burn DEC and provide exit liquidity.

Either way, thanks for reading.

— Altryx

![devider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spltrader/23tbwHGyBbHdEqtyLjA85WdvChBS3XKGag52CWb38QJconf6QooiJCLu5Xnc2cFVrwQXp.png)

🔗 [SPL Market](https://spl.market/) | [SplTrader](https://spltrader.com/) | [Twitter/X](https://x.com/spltrader) | [Hive Blog](https://peakd.com/@spltrader)

body.title: El abrumador peso de la individualidad... [ESP]
body.body:
>20 minutos. Es la cantidad de tiempo que le he dedicado, diariamente, a lo que me ocurre. En esos minutos soy solo yo. No soy mi trabajo, no soy loa ceros en mi cuenta bancaria, no sólo la madre de nadie ni la novia; hija, tía, hermana de absolutamente nadie. He elegido este hábito de sólo enfocarme en mí misma por esa cantidad finita de tiempo, porque es lo que me puedo permitir... Dicen que somos muchas versiones de una misma personas en varios momentos... Bueno, yo no pudo ser ni elegir ser lo que sé que soy porque eso pondría en riesgo varias cosas de las que depende pero sí pued ser mi yo más auténtico en esos preciados 20 minutos.

* \n\n*

>Por mí misma. He decidido hacer varias treguas. Es un verdadero incomoda y muy pocas veces debatida, pero difícilmente hay espacio para todos en las cosas que anhelamos en la vida. Entonces, tarde o temprano tenemos que desarrollar la capacidad de poder ser audaces. Con el jefe que no soportamos, o incluso con algún familiar que por compartir la misma sangre qje nosotros, se cree con derecho a pisotearte en perpetuidad. De ahí viene lo de poseer varias versiones de ti mismo...

* https://youtu.be/S_roMeig-YQ?si=eY57IePwLz0WlBIV *

>En algún punto de nuestra temprana niñez o adolescencia, nos enseñan que si por algún motivo acabamos solos, automáticamente hemos alcanzado el fin de la existencia e nuestras vidas... Nos programan para tenerle a mansalva al mero concepto de la soledad. Obviando, que ni siquiera es un debate. Tarde o temprano acabaremos en soledad de algún tipo. No se trata de si sucederá o no, si no de cuándo y en sí estaremos verdaderamente preparados para ello... Dentro de la filosofía minimalista, está intrínseco el valor de uno mismo.

*\n\n*

>No se puede compartir algo si no se parte del hecho de que comenzamos con nosotros mismos, no a parte del otro. Dicho esto, desmitificar un poco el terror colectivo hacia la idea de la soledad, es una muy valiosa y apreciada idea; al menos para mí. Yo no deseo vivir en un mundo donde ls dependencia y el interés que esa dependencia enseña une todas la relaciones... Durante el trayecto de cada uno de los 20 minutos, realmente pienso, vivo, respiro y actúo siendo absolutamente yo... Y eso es algo que, aunque parece extraño de entender, realmente es todo lo contrario.

* ![IMG_20230411_210755587~3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wqfyZJ1j14jxATsmvjtYKWH2z8aD5xUS2mJeC9gbcYGg1qe33BDxDJnHiNo6pGNbDQL.jpg) ![LRM_20230801_193803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23u5Sru7Fx7A18bv4ySrfKBeprgsaMLrkxZLxdM72DUDCMzW7acN4gCvDMe2YsvVPVPRn.jpg) ![IMG_20230524_190358746~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xKL9DeQQYEd9113bhmUm15SDqTD4qudgDfN8GFZZgNiKmMGD17LHRNRjpqJMeGQD2U3.jpg) *

>O, ¿es que acaso tú podrías ser tu mismo en tod contexto/situación o momento? Mmm, no ll sé, permíteme dudar un poco... No es personal hacia ti, es sentido común. Auyentaríamos a todo y a todos si realmente mostráramos nuestra total autenticidad. Tal vez, hemos inventado un poco el temor a la soledad para reemplazar lo que ocultamos.... Sin importar cómo sucedan las cosas, yo vengo a confesar ante ustedes y a usar esa ventanamininalista, como contexto para drenar mi pequeño secreto... Y así, modestamente, ayudarte a combatir ese miedo a quedarte sólo. Quizá es tiempo de observar el vaso medio lleno, en lugar de medio vacío, ¿no te parece?

* https://youtu.be/GPYG4MQkU2s?si=zUHPI62PhkzcX5Bb

body.body:
This lecture completely shifts how I see biblical counseling. Instead of jumping straight to how people change, it pushes me to ask why first. Why did Adam die after eating the fruit? Why did Jesus have to die on the cross? Why does the Father give people to the Son (John 17:6)? These aren't just theology questions—they're the foundation for understanding real transformation.

The Westminster Confession puts it plainly: we're worlds apart from God. The gap between Creator and creature is so huge that we could never reach Him or enjoy Him on our own. But here's the beautiful part—God didn't leave us stranded. He reached down and made a covenant with us. That's pure grace. We didn't earn it, didn't deserve it, couldn't manufacture it. He bridged the impossible gap Himself.

This changes everything about counseling. I can't rely on self-help tricks or worldly psychology to fix people's deepest problems. Only God's Word and His Spirit bring genuine, lasting change.

body.title: FAITH AT THE EDGE OF THE BORDER
body.body:
![Kopia – Beyond the route.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23x1PvHA6pXsZwAj9tWrJJxhaVD5MKwu6qoXacQfqxsFvjy8YMde7uK3348ffafqpYsRf.jpg)

Today I return to my home country, more precisely to my trip with a friend, during which we had the opportunity to admire several churches. If you haven’t seen my first post on this topic yet, I’m leaving the link here:

https://peakd.com/hive-142159/@ladytruckview/monochrome-spirituality-monomad-challenge

Each of these churches has a different character and a different story, and today I would like to show you the ORTHODOX CHURCH OF SAINT BASIL THE GREAT.


>Dzisiaj powracam do mojego rodzinnego kraju, a dokładniej do mojej wycieczki z koleżanką, podczas której miałyśmy okazję podziwiać kilka cerkwi. Kto nie widział jeszcze mojego pierwszego posta w tym temacie, zostawiam tutaj linka:
>
>https://peakd.com/hive-142159/@ladytruckview/monochrome-spirituality-monomad-challenge
>
>Każda z tych cerkwi ma inny charakter i historię, a dzisiaj chciałabym Wam przybliżyć CERKIEW PRAWOSŁAWNĄ ŚWIĘTEGO BAZYLEGO WIELKIEGO.


![20260320_111613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243Ly5q6fuf5wGUwXMteH45YLd4StLosMSHFbNBUfEPhWbaFATMQMMaX2nek2KZbktELk.jpg)


This was the first church I saw during this short trip. It is located right by the main road leading to Slovakia, so it’s impossible to miss. It is situated in the village of Konieczna, just before the border with our neighbors. We stopped there on our way to the Slovak town of Bardejov, whose photos you can also see on my profile.

>To była pierwsza cerkiew, którą zobaczyłam podczas tej krótkiej wycieczki. Mieści się ona tuż przy głównej drodze prowadzącej na Słowację, także nie można jej przeoczyć. Położona jest ona w miejscowości Konieczna, tuż przed granicą z naszymi sąsiadami. Zatrzymaliśmy się tam w drodze do słowackiego Bardejova, z którego zdjęcia można również zobaczyć na moim profilu.


![20260320_111902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/Eq7Lrcjoj9gYiFrAhJYPjHmhmpuZv8JKQupKNJmu4hzGjKeSyoQ5GPdxsyr1irjhDbL.jpg)

![20260320_111741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242hS8CfLx5D3d3o5THG752rUeWazAxVjgPSybWNpw6T41Zmh7txZtohr1omn8WJvQX9P.jpg)

Just like most churches in that area, it is built of wood and has three characteristic towers topped with domes.

>Tak jak większość cerkwi w tamtych okolicach, zbudowana jest ona z drewna i posiada trzy charakterystyczne wieżyczki zakończone kopułami.


![20260320_111920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/245wDDKxeddxDj7pXz3R9sHfQR64CK45SYRpHf6cfDgxAzoTvgjoHg2buaCAhoBgm36k5.jpg)

![20260320_112139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ywnssqSnfgEty6meKbc7TqrVK4eTVqNY8Mfw5BX4Jn2JVTjwAiMxS5kQ8Huu8DjBr9H.jpg)

![20260320_111648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/245HcrYkjJeUwro6mUAkr8NaBoDSNR5edCZSXLBoXMdC6gBRtAeQrYq7JAjLTfzg5c6Pi.jpg)


Right next to the church there is a small cemetery. In Eastern tradition, cemeteries are very often located directly next to places of worship. This symbolically connects life and death in one place and shows the continuity of the community. The gravestones are rather simple, sometimes even slightly neglected, but that only adds to the authenticity of this place. You can see that it has a really long history. The gravestones feature characteristic Orthodox crosses. Cemeteries in this region are often the only trace of former inhabitants. They remind us of the history of the Lemkos and their presence in these mountains. At the same time, they make such places encourage reflection and taking a moment to pause.

>Tuż obok cerkwi znajduje się mały cmentarz. W tradycji wschodniej bowiem cmentarze bardzo często są położone tuż przy świątyniach. Ma to symbolicznie łączyć życie i śmierć w jednym miejscu i pokazuje ciągłość wspólnoty. Nagrobki są raczej proste, czasami nawet lekko zaniedbane, ale to wszystko tylko dodaje autentyczności tego miejsca. Widać, że to miejsce ma swoją naprawdę długą historię. Nagrobki posiadają charakterystyczne, prawosławne krzyże. Cmentarze w tym regionie to chyba jedyny ślad po dawnych mieszkańcach. Przypominają o historii Łemków i ich obecności w tych górach. Sprawiają jednocześnie, że takie miejsca skłaniają do refleksji i zatrzymania się choć na chwilę.


![20260320_112015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/244KLppiLX4DBf2c8NeabovXemUt8EoAbQf3cei2eSCoD2Z4bNU5NR9a8cKguLggtFgfT.jpg)

The church in Konieczna was built in 1903, which makes it older than many other churches in this region. It is also worth noting that despite its age, it has preserved its original architectural character over the years. After World War II, it changed its function and became a Roman Catholic church, but over time it returned to the Eastern rite.

>Sama cerkiew w Koniecznej została zbudowana w 1903 roku i tym sposobem jest starsza, aniżeli wiele innych cerkwi w tym regionie. Warto również dodać, że pomimo swojego wieku zachowała swój pierwotny charakter architektoniczny przez wszystkie lata. Po II wojnie światowej zmieniła swoją funkcję i stała się kościołem rzymskokatolickim, jednakże z biegiem czasu wróciła do obrządku wschodniego.


![20260320_111705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23vsSp6deGeJtJKCHp1o9BVNQBiZBjadfSYQfvzVUo6aLTPc7hTGJAt63B3ZwaJnXxxr8.jpg)

body.title: One Of Those Exhausting Days As A Mother
body.body:
Yesterday was one of those days that reminded me just how real and raw motherhood can be. I woke up feeling completely off, and after checking in, I was told it was stress catching up with me. The advice was simple, rest, take my medication, eat well, and give my body a chance to recover. It sounded easy enough… in theory.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd6L1CpSfQbWp8pgC8H5CqmA1qASohNCjHojmVUjpWq63/1000195301.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSNkakpDJMPXv9wgN83ityVn2RDNzdCrcGZiBmUFSix6X/1000209000.jpg 


So I tried. I really did.
I ate, took the medicine I was given, and made up my mind to lie down and restore my energy. But honestly, who was I kidding? Resting with kids around sometimes feels like trying to sleep in the middle of a carnival.

The moment I closed my eyes, it was “Mummy!” from one corner. Just as I tried to settle again, another call followed. It’s almost like they have a built-in sensor that alerts them the second I try to rest. And then there was the fighting, endless, dramatic, loud fighting. At some point, I even wondered if I had more than two kids because the noise level didn’t match the number!

And let’s not forget my little climber. My daughter decided that yesterday was the perfect day to practice her mountain-climbing skills, on furniture clearly taller than she is. I lost count of how many times I had to shout her name and tell her to get down. Hundreds might actually be an accurate number. The funny (and slightly frustrating) part? The moment she noticed I was trying to close my eyes again, she went right back to climbing like it was her life’s mission.
I kept thinking, “Just a few minutes of quiet. That’s all I need.” But those few minutes never really came.

By the end of the day, I realized something,  motherhood doesn’t pause when you’re sick, tired, or overwhelmed. There are no sick days, no clocking out, no “do not disturb” sign that truly works. It’s a full-time role that demands your energy even when your tank is completely empty.

But in the middle of all the chaos, there is also something else, love, responsibility, and a kind of strength you don’t even realize you have until moments like this. Because even though I was exhausted and just wanted silence, I still showed up. I still cared, still watched, still protected.
Motherhood is not a joke. It’s challenging, unpredictable, exhausting… but also deeply powerful.

Today, I’m reminding myself to take it slow, to breathe, and to find small moments of rest where I can. And to every mom out there who has ever tried to “rest” with kids at home you are not alone. We are all just doing our best, one chaotic day at a time.


**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@leemah1/one-of-those-exhausting-days-as-a-mother-e4u)

body.title: How do we overcome our doubts and anxieties
body.body:
https://youtu.be/3J4EEXHfIMo?si=rZFerJzEQCklViSw
Believing that God is with us is a good key step to overcome doubts and anxieties. Even those who strongly believe in God sometimes suffer from doubts and anxieties. When we pray sincerely and open our hearts, we receive peace that calms our minds. Prayer helps us release our burdens and depend on God instead of carrying everything alone.

Full your mind with the words of God everyday of your life and accept Jesus Christ that he is your personal lord and saviour. Doubt often grows when we focus too much on our problems instead of God’s truth. By reading and meditating on Scripture daily, our faith becomes stronger and our fears begin to fade. The stories in the Bible remind us of God’s faithfulness and help us trust that He is always in control.

We overcome anxiety by trusting God’s plan and not relying only on our own understanding. The Bible teaches us to walk by faith, even when things are not clear. When we surrender our worries and choose to trust God, we gain inner peace and confidence. With patience, prayer, and faith, doubts lose their power, and we grow stronger in our relationship with God.

body.body: https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNjJQnbKSEiehfpb7MjEvbUV7UN6spfQMgzVjcc48WrX7/1777623785019290990434773296305.png [source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/bucolic-sad-art-box-painting-oil-8379893/) Don't hide poetry in silken robes, don't load it with glittering ornaments Let it be just that like a lazy dawn which even without adornment captivates the heart Don't bind it in Sanskritic patterns, grammar, and definitions Don't shackle its body with the rules of rhyme and non-rhyme. Let it cry in the helplessness of the helpless, let it laugh in the laughter of a child Poetry is neither the applause of the stage, nor a glittering commodity of the market. It is beautiful in its rawness like the rhythm of rain falling on tiles, the sweetness of a shepherd's flute, or the silence of a farmer gazing at the clouds Poetry breaks down walls, opens windows from where anyone can peek into the sky within themselves It sprouts suddenly like a neem sprout on the doorstep of a house. Let it flow in its own rhythm Let it thunder from the sky on the earth's body Let it pulsate to the rhythm of an unheard rhyme and whenever its sensitivity stops, its pulse becomes silent then don't pay it a tribute in words just write its letters on some old paper, on the bark of a tree, on a child's palm Watch from there how sensitivity blossoms, how a new greenery grows, how the next poem is born Thank you so much for reading. body.title: 🌿 The Bamboo Effect: Invisible Roots,Explosive Growth 🌿 .
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRJDAiJ3puC55KNPvzHW898TrKZzYZkXigfXEgdF4sHSP/1777622473868.jpg)
[Image Edited with Genspark](https://www.genspark.ai/api/files/s/JFQ7u2TK?cache_control=3600)


Good morning hiveans! Today is another brand new day and a New Month at that.I would love to share this with us.Lest I forgot remember to power up,it is HPUD(Hive Power Up Day)! Sorry for the digression.

Look at the powerful image above.
For the first 5 years,the bamboo looks like it’s doing absolutely nothing, solid five years.Just a tiny shoot above ground while its roots spread deep and wide underground,building a foundation that almost no one can see.
Then,in the next 6 weeks,it explodes upward at an unbelievable speed,shooting several feet high with strong,vibrant leaves.


This is not just a plant story.
This is **our story**.
Many of us are currently in our first 5 years season.
* Posting consistently but engagement feels slow.
*Building skills,habits,or a brand that still looks small from the outside.
* Putting in the work when no one is clapping yet.
* Watering seeds that haven’t broken the surface

It can feel discouraging.It can feel like nothing is happening.But here’s the truth the bamboo teaches us:
All that invisible work is not wasted.
It is root work.It is foundation work.It is the silent preparation for explosive, unstoppable growth.
Your consistency right now is expanding your root system, your knowledge, your character, your network, your resilience, your audience, your expertise.
And when the season shifts (and it always does),you won’t grow slowly.You will surge.



This new month is your reminder,keep showing up even when results are hidden.Keep building depth before you chase height.Keep trusting the process when progress feels invisible.Your 6-week explosion like the bamboo 🎍 is coming.Your breakthrough season is closer than you think.

The question is: Will you still be here,roots deep, when the rapid growth begins?
To everyone in their quiet season right now,this month, let’s commit to deeper roots.Drop a 🌱 in the comments if you are  in your root-building phase and you’re not giving up.Tag someone who needs this reminder today.New month.Same dedication. Different level of faith.Let us grow.Let us rise.Let us trust the unseen work.

body.title: How I achieved the popular V-neckline Aso-Oke on bubu
body.body: Hello everyone, I welcome you to my blog with delight and to share with you how I achieved this popular V- neckline Aso-Oke, one lovely thing about bubu is that irrespective of your stature, it gives you this free, chic and big madam vibes. **Measurement** Gown length -56 Bust - 42 Waist -28 Hip - 48 Back- 9 Sleeve length 16, Note that this is in addition to the back plus the joining allowance at the sleeve.

> I cut the bodice first, the bust, waist and hip, I added 3 inches respectively, since it will be on a straight line, no need to shape it. Then I cut the neck, the back first in a round form, then the front, I have to make use of the Aso-Oke, one piece is enough and you fold into two, making the down part closed and the upper part opened, then placed your ruler on it to slant it out diagonically. I chalked it to have a standard of 15 inches, if you want it longer or shorter, you can add or deduct few inches, then I pin it down, top stitch, I opened it up, cut off the excess, you will notice it's looking like the V already, afterwards I placed the V part on the cloth to cut it out on the neck as shown in the picture, you might want to weave the joining, but mine I didn't weave, I just added 1/2 inch
> Then I began to join the body from the shoulder to the arm side, bust and hip straight

>

body.title: Prohibition 2.0: UK introducing smoking ban for Gen Z/Alpha and future generations, people born after 2008 won't be able to buy tobacco any more. Do you think this will work?
body.body:
UK hat ein Tabak-Kaufverbot für Gen Z/Alpha und zukünftige Generationen beschlossen, alle Bürger die nach 2008 geboren sind, dürfen in Zukunft keine Zigaretten, Vaping- und Tabak-Produkte kaufen, das soll verboten werden, das Rauchen an sich bleibt aber weiterhin legal.

Damit erhofft sich UK eine raucherfreie Generation zu schaffen. Eine Art Prohibition 2.0, aber diesmal auf Rauchen, nicht auf Alkohol bezogen. Alkohol-Verbote wurden in den letzten 100 Jahren bereits von vielen Ländern probiert unter anderem von den USA und der Soviet-Union, haben aber niemals wirklich funktioniert und wurden schnell wieder aufgegeben.

Bin skeptisch, ob das wirklich durchsetzbar ist, kann als Nicht-Raucher die Gesundheitsargumente verstehen, dass man das Rauchen einschränken möchte, denke aber nicht, dass man leichte Drogen generell verbieten kann.

Menschen werden dann auf andere Drogen ausweichen, die mitunter noch gefährlicher sein können und man schafft mit der Prohibition wiederum neue Probleme wie einen Schwarzmarkt und Beschaffungskriminalität.

Denke nicht die Drogen an sich sind das Problem, sondern die wahren Probleme sind vielschichtiger und tiefgründiger. Gesellschaftliche und Mental Health Krise. Rauchverbote werden diese Probleme nicht lösen, sondern bekämpfen nur die Symptome.

Was meint ihr? Denkt ihr, dass das Rauchverbot / Tabak-Kaufverbot Sinn macht, oder wird das ähnlich wie die Prohibition in den USA schnell scheitern?

## Smoking ban for people born after 2008 in the UK agreed

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/ALD9v4CeHTYXRYVUDomHNHCbjdJi9VU7raUVhvKU6VdajtM31eHXsQpsjz726ps.png)

https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cn08jy6w0l5o

https://x.com/BBCNews/status/2046527683731828847

https://x.com/visegrad24/status/2046632982643974295

https://x.com/Polymarket/status/2046598106804781117

## English

The UK parliament has agreed on a ban on tobacco sales for Gen Z / Alpha, and future generations, all citizens born after 2008 will be prohibited from purchasing cigarettes, vaping products, and other tobacco products in the future, though smoking itself will remain legal.

With this, the UK hopes to create a smoke-free generation. A sort of Prohibition 2.0, but this time focused on smoking, not alcohol. Alcohol bans have already been tried by many countries over the past 100 years, including the US and the Soviet Union, but they never really worked and were quickly abandoned.

I’m skeptical about whether this is truly enforceable. As a non-smoker, I understand the health arguments for wanting to restrict smoking, but I don’t think you can generally ban soft drugs.

People will then turn to other drugs, which can be even more dangerous, and prohibition will in turn create new problems, such as black markets and drug-related crime.

I don’t think drugs themselves are the problem, rather, the real issues are more nuanced and profound. Social and mental health crisis. Smoking bans won’t solve these problems, they’ll only treat the symptoms.

What do you guys think? Do you think the UK smoking ban / tobacco sales ban makes sense, or will it fail miserably, just like Prohibition in the U.S.?

body.body:
**Tienes una base muy buena aquí.** Lo más fuerte no es solo el poema, sino la **idea editorial** detrás: convertir apuntes breves y frases sueltas en una pieza con identidad propia. Eso tiene algo raro y valioso.

Lo que mejor funciona es el contraste entre **archivo íntimo + experimentación formal**. También suma mucho que expliques el puente entre las ilustraciones de Salvador Jaramillo y esta nueva etapa con IA; ahí no se siente capricho, se siente evolución del proyecto.

Donde apretaría un poco es en la **introducción**. Tiene contexto interesante, pero ahora mismo compite con el poema en lugar de abrirle camino. Si la recortas un 25-30%, el texto entra con más fuerza y el lector llega antes al corazón de *Trompa-bulario*.

**Mi lectura rápida del post:**
- **Lo más atractivo:** la mezcla de memoria, juego verbal y sabor cultural mexicano.
- **Lo más original:** el dilema de cómo publicar fragmentos pequeños sin que pierdan ritmo.
- **Lo que conviene mejorar:** compactar la parte explicativa para que el poema respire antes.
- **Lo visual:** la imagen tiene un aire artesanal y simbólico que encaja bastante bien con la idea de “alquimia”. No está nada mal; tiene ese punto extraño que el poema probablemente necesita.

**Mi veredicto:** buen post, con intención real y una voz propia. No parece contenido armado por cumplir; parece trabajo cuidado. Y eso, en Hive, ya le saca varios cuerpos de ventaja a mucha cosa publicada a la carrera.

Si quisieras dejarlo más filoso, esta sería la jugada:
- abrir con **2-3 líneas menos de contexto**
- mantener la referencia a Salvador
- entrar antes en el conflicto formal de *Trompa-bulario*
- cerrar la intro con una frase más tajante, algo que anuncie juego, rareza o desvío

Una versión más limpia de ese arranque podría ir así:

**“Poem #17 continues this long personal archive of texts born from memory, emotion, and passing moments. After the first poems accompanied by Salvador Jaramillo’s illustrations, this piece opens another path: an experiment in visual and verbal transformation. ‘Trompa-bulario’ plays with brief phrases, cultural texture, and the unstable music of language.”**

Está bastante bien, @aljif7. **Hay proyecto, hay criterio y hay voz.** Eso no se finge.

body.title: The Real Test Of Charity.
body.body:
Talking of charity, personally I am of the opinion that it is what you do either things are going well with you or not, yes. You don't just show love to people when things are convenient for you. And most importantly, considering the topic it is worthy of note that the real test of charity is when things are not convenient for you, when things are tight and even you yourself is just managing yourself, and with all of that, you still choose to help, to care and to show love to someone else... That is the real test of charity.


![1000216857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23w2oQTooJXcTZZRQYUw9TfjZJApLSdpQFneG8gUCwf4UzMtnWQ69b11L5kDg5aDD2CUG.jpg)



There's this adage that we Yoruba do say, *\

* Meaning, you saying it's not enough makes you stingy. So, waiting until you think you have enough is just an excuse, one that will never end. Because you can never have enough, there will always be bills, responsibilities and all of that to sort, and no matter what it is you're in, you can still give something out.


While I was just getting better, even though I was still bedridden, there's little I could do, even still, I try as much as possible to give others a listening ear, to advise some, to share my story with some just so to encourage them and the likes, that's a good deed too, and it counts, not everything is about giving financially...





And when I got better later, I continued with it, just that I stepped up a bit, I began to focus mostly on kids and school children around me. Not as if I have much, but I just the do the little I can. Sometimes it's a school bag, or sandals, at times I go for books, other times I switch to writing materials like pens and such, at times it's lunchbox.... These things may look little, and we often overlook it, but it means everything to a child who does not have/own it. 


The smile on their face is just everything, always grateful. Recently a child was jumping up when I gave him a sandal, even though it was a little bigger then him, he collected it with joy while saying that his teacher won't have any reason to beat him again. That joy, that happiness... it's one that money can't buy.




![1000866689.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xVMJcn2Xhi47yiFpsRm52wByyDARpQ9Wy9iAPKaHyomr1oFVuX96GxnaSX7bXqn2K7B.jpg)




And in all honesty, there are times I sit down to think too, I have my own struggles, it's not really as if I have a stable work for myself, the amount I spend on drugs in a month alone is enough for me, not to talk of other needs. Even still, I don't stop reminding myself that I shouldn't stop doing what I do because things are hard, even if it's little, I make sure I do. And at a time like this, with the way the economy is, it's just best to be wise with your spendings and the things you do, so I try to give what I can, I don't over do, I plan, I calculate and do only what I can afford. Even if it's small like I said earlier... I do.




Charity is a thing of the heart, ones intention matters. No matter how little it is, do it, because it can change someones whole day.





🌹

**Images are mine.**

Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.

Alchemy of poetic words. Poem # 17/ Alquimia de palabras poéticas. Poema # 17

Apr 30, 2026
AREA: Poetry
Poem # 17/ Poema # 17
Título original / Original title:
Trompa-bulario / Trunk-bulary
Introduction

(Feel free to skip Introduction if you've read previous poems in the series).
As I've mentioned before, this series - Alchemy of Poetic Words / Alquimia de Palabras Poéticas - is a project I began in 2013. It's a quiet collection of poems born from memory, emotion, and fleeting moments, carefully gathered over the years in my notebooks. Back then, I dreamed of turning them into a book, each paired with original illustrations by Salvador Jaramillo, a gifted designer and colleague from Mexico. Salvador illustrated works by Indigenous writers, and his art carries a deep, poetic connection to Mexican culture.
Here we are with another poem

If you feel curiosity to read the Poem #16 you can read it here: https://inleo.io/@aljif7/poem-16-palabras-and-mnkd3o2xbef4b12e?referral=aljif7

Salvador design's are ended after 7 Poems. Then, I am doing the experiment this time with the help of AI to generate an image for this poem number 17. In this one I wanted to play with words and …..
Here we are with poem #17. It took me several weeks to figure out how best to present it in this format. The challenge lay in a section I've titled \

in Spanish), which consists of mini-sentences and fleeting phrases I captured in the moment. I wanted to rework them with a distinct Mexican cultural flavor.\nI faced a dilemma: sharing them one by one would feel too slight for a post, but posting all ten at once might overwhelm the rhythm and dilute the playful intent of the words.\nSo, for example, I grouped a set of \
words around the moment people enjoy something sugary. What better context than a birthday cake, evoked by just a fragment of the familiar chant: \

To me, the sweetness doesn't lie in the words themselves, but in the cultural celebration they summon.
Rather than overexplain, here are the first three of ten mini-expressions from the series:

ella.

The Experiment

As I have mentioned before - I am surprised with the result from AI for the illustration, I was expecting to get something not related with the idea of these mini-poems, as I was after no more illustrations. 
In this specific post, I didn't need the creation of images by AI. For the Mexican reader it is almost no need of image. Anyway I screenshot a couple of images.
The challenge in this post was how to organise my 10 mini-expressions grouped in a section. It recalls the moments when I did the compilation of them from different notebooks . Now, out of Mexico it sound as a fresh way to be there.
I am still thinking about the experiment of selling a version with no images. I am getting the idea to sell my +50 poems in Spanish without illustrations. I have adavanced in a review with AI and it gives me a good organisation of the content. That helped me to decide how to group the mini-expressions for this post.

body.body:
Buenos dias a todos, referente a esta comida amigos la misma es tipica del pais de PARAGUAY y consiste en preparar la masa para la elaboracion de chipa que es de la siguiente manera, lo primero es el almidon de mandioca, luego le agregamos el huevo, sal a gusto, leche y un poco de grasa de cerdo, se amasa bien hasta que la misma tome consistencia, luego la dejamos descansar un poco y preparamos el relleno, que seria de carne picada o molida, la que agregamos en una olla, luego sal a gusto, perejil, cebolla de verdeo y huevo, como si fuera un relleno de empanada, cuando esta todo cocinado, mientras se enfria dicho relleno.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eo8UoV8KYfEwut6s7rEYkwRTnXhaTm9YGZY7uGrexSfJDnJHhz6NbZNbPenHfLPVLaW.png)

Vamos cortando la masa en trozos pequeños, la estiramos un poco y en el medio agregamos el relleno antes mencionado, tapando en su totalidad la carne, dejando como un bollo relleno, para despues tomar un molde agregarle un poco de mantequilla, y vamos agregando dicha chippa soo, para luego llevarla al horno y una ves cocinado, queda como lo vemos en esta fotografia.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning everyone, regarding this food, friends, it is typical of the country of PARAGUAY and consists of preparing the dough for making chipa as follows: first, we use cassava starch, then we add the egg, salt to taste, milk, and a bit of pork fat. We knead it well until it reaches the right consistency, then let it rest a bit and prepare the filling, which would be minced or ground meat. We add it to a pot, then salt to taste, parsley, green onion, and egg, as if it were an empanada filling. When everything is cooked, while the filling cools down.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eo8UoV8KYfEwut6s7rEYkwRTnXhaTm9YGZY7uGrexSfJDnJHhz6NbZNbPen

We cut the dough into small pieces, stretch it a bit, and in the middle, we add the aforementioned filling, completely covering the meat, leaving it as a stuffed bun. Then, we take a mold, add a bit of butter, and start adding the chippa soo, then we put it in the oven, and once cooked, it looks like what we see in this photograph.

Thank you very much for reading and following me.

body.title: Time for Yaezakura =/= Zeit für Yaezakura 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body: ![IMG_8367.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoyQ3M5coHJh5uDEjvL8ZjjiSEHWy4yMpDxfmHua4eHf9nMVu8ztwThhMw3kUM945Dy.JPG) For some, the cherry blossom season may be over and Queen Sakura may have already moved on. But if you look closely, you’ll quickly discover that she’s brought us another wonderful treat. Actually we should have known this would happen—after all, it’s been exactly the same in previous years, when we didn’t have time to mope either. Now that the actual cherry trees have finished blooming, it’s time for the Yaezakura, a type of sakura whose blossoms are sometimes much more striking. From a distance, the Yaezakura trees glow in a deep shade of pink, and when you get up close, you suddenly find yourself standing before a luminous sea of fluffy blossoms that you just want to touch right away. This year we discovered a few new trees, which of course I had to take some photos of. Cherry blossom season is peak season for every photographer, and that goes for me, too. But why not? It’s fun, it makes my heart beat faster, and it always puts a big smile on my face. ![IMG_8366.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23xei28q7utr2UESnrrHzzMTzu6u6nFFYzAVQvQhNh7ttdLCYEifi5RWgGnsdfnphMX8b.JPG) DEUTSCH _Für die einen mag die Kirschblüte nun vorbei sein und Königin Sakura bereits weitergezogen sein. Aber wenn man sich richtig umschaut, wird man schnell entdecken, dass sie uns noch einmal ein wundervollen Nachschlag mitgebracht hat. Und eigentlich hätte man es ja auch wissen können, war es doch in den Jahren zuvor ganz genau so gewesen, als wir zum Trübsalblasen auch keine Zeit hatten._ _Jetzt, wo die eigentlich Kirschbäume abgeblüht sind, ist es nun Zeit für die Yaezakura, eine Sakuraart, deren Blüten viel auffälliger sind. Von weiten leuchten die Yaezakurabäume in einem tiefen Rosaton, und wenn man dann ganz nah rankommt, steht man plötzlich vor einem leuchtenden Meer aus puscheligen Blüten, die man am liebsten sofort anfassen will._ _Wir hatten in diesem Jahr ein paar ganz neue Bäume entdeckt, von welchen ich natürlich ein paar Fotos machen musste. Sakurazeit ist für jeden Fotografen Hochsaison, und das gilt dann eben auch für mich. Doch warum auch nicht, es macht Spaß und lässt mein Herz schneller schlagen und bringt damit immer wieder ein großes Lächeln auf mein Gesicht._ ![IMG_8368.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EogNkFKBdbaGf1yDk32ioxVh4n2pVVUCTt1eXtiSDx6LwTcZzyGhavfKZGedkKb7JHd.JPG) But I know that even this spectacle will be over in a few days. And that’s why I take pleasure in every blossoming tree I see, and I love to stop and admire all the beautiful blossoms up close. This time of year is something special, and once again I’m right in the thick of it. And that’s where I’d love to stay forever... _Aber ich weiß, dass auch dieses Schauspiel in ein paar Tagen vorbei sein wird. Und deshalb erfreue ich mich einfach an jeden blühenden Baum, den ich sehe und bleibe dabei immer wieder gerne stehen und schaue mir all die herrlichen Blüten aus den Nähe an. Diese Zeit des Jahr ist was Besonderes, und ich bin mal wieder ganz nah dran und mittendrin. Und dort würde ich am liebsten für immer bleiben..._ ![IMG_8379.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EogPM6gW1XBjYqaZxTn9zbpvzsrAgiUnBPXv8n4jSsAwP9EH4yDLnJWuCxTurAke4xk.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: Brawl Rewards & The Big Proposal: Who Really Owns Splinterlands?
body.body:
<center> 

## Hello all [Hive](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-what-is-hive) People & @splinterlands lovers,
   
![hive blockchain](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUj5MG8G11mq3erqqJVMjiaFoC6h8XyhrtBGhMMxaN77i/1777622713865.jpg)
 
[Made with Gemin](https://g.co/gemini/share/86f08907642e)
 
I was listing to the latest Town Hall and find some very interesting news, which may be not new for many of you who already gone through the Town Hall, but still it worth to share again with community and share thoughts on same. Hive is decentralised and Splinterlands took one more step towards the same. The SPS token is the governing token in the game and means for giving the power in the hands of community. To make it fully decentralised the Splinterlands team has come up with a proposal which suggests a Sale Agreement between the DAO and the Splinterlands i.e. Steem Monster Inc. if the agreement got signed that means the DAO will purchase the Intellectual Property i.e. IP of Splinterlands form the agreement give the Steam Monsters Inc. that means the main control will be in DAO hands and DAO will be the Owner or Boss. The Steam Monsters Inc will be a contractor for the DAO, hired to maintain the serve, develop new sets and provide the customer support. Their will not be any restriction that the Steam Monsters Inc will be the only contractor as it's very clear that in the future if the DAO will not be happy with the performance they can hire other developers for all those activities. 


![blockchain gaming](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRR8wiGFHrW1gYMewjrihY4P86FiomRy8DQemK4MzbFSC/untitled_design.png)


## The Cost:  Roughly $2 million per year ($4 million over two years)

body.title: Wat Ton Kok, Chiang Mai, Thailand, A small temple in the countryside that is 124 years old.
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNczwV9iS63NhdR81UqiHjVuRWnPQ6PSAwZYYnVife9Ct/1777620503931.jpg)

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. In this post, I'll take you to another temple in the countryside of Chiang Mai province. This is a temple in Phrao District. It was a trip in early February. On this trip, my wife and I visited the temples in Phrao District. One of those temples is Wat Ton Kok. Before I take you to see Wat Ton Kok. I'd like to share some brief information about this temple. Wat Ton Kok is an ancient temple that is more than 100 years old in a local rural village. This temple was built in AD 1902 or 124 years ago. But there is no information about royal granting of the land to a particular temple by announcing in royal decree.

Then I'll take you to see the atmosphere of Wat Ton Kok. Wat Ton Kok is a small temple. And this temple has two temple signs. The first sign is located in a community area before reaching the temple.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW2McYz2waBkbDrCG47NttwS1zEMeyXYprPcQrZqu19Cs/1777620503977.jpg)

The second sign is next to the entrance arch of the temple.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUQCdLR8YxZc5p42uVVfNQJny2bM5BdtmrRTrjd7h7HSB/1777620504115.jpg)

There are only two highlights of this temple. The first highlight is the large entrance arch. This arch is made of bricks and spread cement on bricks with painted gold color. There are three pagodas on top of the arch. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8SZ2xfmMxYMoUnJ6Jip7ZdpHVpxFETfYj6WN1aiQ6xY/1777621438300.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbcSTM7JghBrSzZaVjDD5otm3ma5LaP3DHzZzqWJVd6S/1777621438438.jpg)

The second highlight is the buddha image hall (viharn). This buddha image hall (viharn) is made of bricks and spread cement on bricks with painted white, decorated with patterns in the Lanna art style (original Thai art from Northern Thailand). There are two gold color serpent statues on the railing of the staircase leading to the buddha image hall (viharn).
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSx53TBdqHRAPWbTryJjgk2iTtxz1zTN9VZa9qhkLPCbR/1777621438579.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfKYFTcbX9bnZALtgFVCV8K3asJ4cVfU3DYiZkxyfT2rX/1777621438732.jpg)

Other atmosphere in the temple. The temple courtyard has trees, a bell tower, a small pavilion with the buddha images, a large building for monks and section containing the monks' living quarters.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQEmsW2xfGo46Dqae3JJaFS6jem1RYCbzXaA9ZNjxWoh4/1777622178135.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVndPLQ212aiWe9si7bjTCxPpuhCjc7sifoUtwungZq3z/1777622178271.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5GzaRUqN7etkGXFVA7GTkvDdiUsAi5qyM2t18qxuXSQ/1777622178405.jpg)

Although this is a small temple, my wife and I enjoyed our visit. And I want to share this with everyone. These are the stories and photos I want to share for this post. Invite everyone to see and enjoy my stories and photos. Please forgive any errors/mistakes. Have a great day. See you next time. Thank you for your support and visiting my post. Bye 🤗

🌏 Wat Ton Kok is located in Ton Kok Village, on the Phrao – Wiang Pa Pao Road, Pa Tum Subdistrict, Phrao District, Chiang Mai Province, Thailand.

📷 Take photo By Smartphone Vivo V30.

body.body:
Hola a todos, bueno haciendo referencia de las carnes, blancas y de las carnes rojas, bueno la verdad que hacia mucho que no degustava carne roja, bueno esta ves prepare para el almuerzo un estofado de carne de res con verduras, el cual se prepara de la siguiente manera, agregamos la olla en la hornalla de la cocina, le verti un poco de aceite luego la cebolla cortada en julianas, ajo y la carne de res cortada en trozos pequeños, luego de dejarla cocinarce un poco le agregue agua y las siguientes verduras, zapallo, papa, batata, zanahoria y un poco de apio,  luego le agrego mas agua y dejo que comiense su hervor, cuando notamos que la verdura esta blanda es cuando dicho estofado se puede degustar, el detalle amigos es que no le agregue ninguna salsa de tomate tampoco tomates maduros, esa es la razon por la que me salio dicho estofado bien blanco, pero sabroso.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/EonmR861NAiLkCpuHYTTCaCUmEBq6aUaorQLSSyJP7twVSopjofvepvMRr6GBL6Su4a.png)

Solamente para acompañar el mismo, lo hice con ensalada, la cual contiene lechuga, aguacate o palta, tomate y pepino, cortado todo en trozos pequeños, luego agregue sal a gusto tambien aceite de oliva, para despues mesclar bien todo y listo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/EogNMdAuyUuGBZNcxkuDNA8x2GW9gmnzBJDdoaNEhV2k42f4NP1fyMzhzdmhMeV8CSv.png)

La verdad amigos para un dia viernes y mas cuando es el dia internacional del trabajador, bueno sabemos que un asado tambien es importante para degustar en un dia asi.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SEGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE TENGAS UN EXCELENTE DIA.

ENGLISH

Hello everyone, well, referring to white meats and red meats, well, the truth is that it had been a long time since I tasted red meat, well this time I prepared a beef stew with vegetables for lunch, which is made as follows: we put the pot on the stove, poured a little oil, then added the onion cut into julienne strips, garlic, and the beef cut into small pieces. After letting it cook a bit, I added water and the following vegetables: pumpkin, potato, sweet potato, carrot, and a bit of celery. Then I added more water and let it start to boil. body.title: Film Review of Abigail
body.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcNJK665Nay7Pxj4ANBMy4H6XUCvDz2jrVu3opuCDJAxA/image.png)source Netflix\n\nAbigail (2024) is a horror comedy that starts as a kidnapping turned to supernatural terror. It was made by the same film makers who did \

, another movie that blended horror and comedy. 

**<center>Plot Summary</center>**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvEdeRYFFdmgV5v2NM25RWfLJ4yRLGNir2uon6CG68YE/image.png)

The story started with a group of six criminals who were hired to kidnap a young 12 year old girl named Abigail. She is the daughter of a powerful crime lord. Their task was to hold her in a secluded Wilhelm Manor for 24 hours in exchange for a share of $50m ransom. However, things change when the criminals realizes they are trapped inside and that Abigail is no ordinary child. One by one, the kidnappers are hunted down as the truth emerges: Abigail is a centuries old vampire and the entire kidnapping was part of a deadly setup.

**<center>Analysis</center>**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSyuqT2jRsU3wYTpr9VmYLaABikztdPKzKEUUr3ebJR14/image.png)

I like movies that change plots like \
, a crime move turned horror or movies that reverse expectations from hunter to hunted. Where the criminals become the victims similar to \
. Abigail blends its tone between horror and dark comedy with exaggerated violence and character interactions. I have seen the same theme in Quentin Tarantino's \

where the blood and violence are exaggerated. The casts have some recognizable names like Melissa Barrera, Kevin Durand and Gian Carlo Esposito that lend their talent to the movie. The child actor who played the vampire, Alisha Weir (Matilda, the Musical) performed her part well. She is both scary and charismatic making her character memorable. The film’s mix of gore and humor is also entertaining for fans of genre mashups. It delivered plenty of shocking and absurd moments.

<center>**Conclusion & Recommendation**</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhy4P6JWv2td9DZQtepLJ317PMvfiY5tqbM1ahBFTsxC/image.png)

Abigail is an entertaining horror comedy that succeeds in its concept of blending genres and turning hunters into hunted. It offers a fun, bloody film with a standout villain and a clever plot. If you enjoy horror films with  comedy, gore and a bit of absurdity, Abigail is worth watching.
