body.title: ¿Cómo garantiza la asistencia a domicilio para personas mayores la seguridad en el hogar?\n
body.body:
En este blog, analizaremos cómo la asistencia a domicilio para personas mayores contribuye a crear un entorno de vida más seguro, brindando apoyo en las rutinas diarias, reduciendo riesgos y ofreciendo una atención oportuna.



![compo-1.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/257a7f4a1e51f526e9103f105507ebfcd31a3d24ff0e0fe5441e75b9e5818fd2)



Introducción

Las necesidades de las personas comienzan a cambiar de formas sutiles, pero significativas, a medida que envejecen. Las tareas sencillas pueden requerir más tiempo, el equilibrio puede no sentirse tan firme y los pequeños riesgos en el hogar pueden convertirse en preocupaciones reales. A menudo, las familias se enfrentan a una pregunta difícil: cómo mantener a sus seres queridos a salvo sin privarlos de su independencia. Es aquí donde [Asistencia a domicilio para mayores en Sabadell](https://www.homepersonalservices.com/serveis/assistencia-geriatrica/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi) se convierte en una solución reflexiva y práctica, ofreciendo apoyo al tiempo que permite a los mayores permanecer en un lugar que conocen y aman.

Por qué la seguridad en el hogar se convierte en una preocupación

El hogar está destinado a ser un lugar de confort; sin embargo, para las personas mayores, también puede presentar desafíos ocultos. Los suelos resbaladizos del baño, los escalones irregulares o incluso una iluminación deficiente pueden aumentar el riesgo de caídas. Estos problemas no siempre resultan evidentes hasta que ocurre algún percance.

Además, afecciones de salud como la visión debilitada, el dolor articular o los problemas de memoria pueden dificultar las rutinas diarias. Sin el apoyo adecuado, estas pequeñas dificultades pueden derivar en accidentes o complicaciones de salud a largo plazo.

Qué significa realmente la asistencia a domicilio

La asistencia a domicilio para las personas mayores no consiste únicamente en ayudar con las tareas domésticas; se trata de crear una rutina segura y manejable que se adapte al estilo de vida de cada persona. Los cuidadores intervienen para brindar apoyo en las actividades de la vida diaria, respetando en todo momento el confort y las decisiones del individuo.

En lugar de tener que trasladarse, este tipo de [Cuidados a domicilio Sabadell](https://www.homepersonalservices.com/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi) permite a las personas mayores permanecer en su entorno confortable. Ese mismo sentido de familiaridad ayuda a reducir el estrés y la confusión, especialmente en aquellos que pueden tener dificultades con la memoria.

Ayuda cotidiana que marca la diferencia

Las tareas diarias a veces pueden conllevar el mayor riesgo. Actividades como bañarse, cocinar o incluso levantarse de la cama requieren movimientos cuidadosos y atención. Contar con alguien cerca para brindar asistencia puede prevenir accidentes antes de que ocurran.

Los cuidadores suelen ayudar con:

*   El desplazamiento seguro por la casa

*   Las rutinas de higiene personal

*   La preparación de comidas y la seguridad en la cocina

Estas pequeñas acciones pueden parecer rutinarias, pero son fundamentales para mantener un entorno seguro.

Seguimiento de la salud y la medicación

Otra parte importante de la seguridad es gestionar la salud de manera adecuada. Las personas mayores a menudo toman múltiples medicamentos, y llevar un control de ellos puede resultar confuso. Pueden surgir problemas rápidamente si se omite una dosis o si esta se toma de forma incorrecta.

Con un servicio de cuidado a domicilio adecuado, hay alguien presente para recordar, observar y asegurar que todo se administre correctamente. Los cuidadores también pueden detectar pequeños cambios en la salud —como la falta de apetito o un cansancio inusual— e informar a los familiares con antelación.

El valor del personal doméstico interno

Para las familias que necesitan apoyo constante, [Empleadas de hogar internas en Sabadell](https://www.homepersonalservices.com/es/buscas-trabajo/?utm_source=Organic\&utm_medium=Post\&utm_campaign=Omefyi) ofrecen una opción fiable. Su presencia significa que hay ayuda disponible a cualquier hora, ya sea a primera hora de la mañana o a altas horas de la noche.

Esta atención continua resulta especialmente beneficiosa para las personas mayores que:

*   Tienen dificultades de movilidad.

*   Necesitan asistencia frecuente.

*   Pueden sentirse ansiosas al estar solas.

Saber que siempre hay alguien presente puede aportar una sensación de calma y estabilidad, tanto a la persona mayor como a su familia.

La seguridad emocional también es importante

La seguridad no consiste únicamente en prevenir caídas o lesiones; el bienestar emocional desempeña un papel igualmente importante. Las personas mayores que pasan largas horas a solas pueden sentirse aisladas, lo cual puede afectar su salud mental.

La interacción regular, la conversación y la compañía crean un ambiente positivo. Las personas mayores son más propensas a mantenerse involucradas y activas cuando se sienten valoradas y respetadas, lo cual, a su vez, favorece su seguridad física.

Respuesta rápida ante emergencias

Incluso tomando todas las precauciones, las emergencias pueden ocurrir. La diferencia radica en la rapidez con la que se recibe ayuda. La asistencia a domicilio garantiza que haya alguien presente para actuar de inmediato en caso de ser necesario.

Los cuidadores suelen estar preparados para:

*   Reconocer las señales de alerta de posibles problemas de salud.

*   Brindar apoyo básico durante situaciones de emergencia.

*   Contactar a los servicios médicos sin demora.

Esta actuación rápida puede evitar que una situación se agrave.

Adaptación a las necesidades cambiantes

Con el paso del tiempo, las necesidades de una persona pueden variar. Lo que comienza como una ayuda ocasional puede convertirse en una asistencia regular. La ventaja de la atención a domicilio reside precisamente en su flexibilidad.

Los planes de atención pueden ajustarse en función de:

*   Las condiciones de salud.

*   Los niveles de movilidad.

*   Los cambios en la rutina diaria.

Esto garantiza que la seguridad se mantenga en cada etapa, sin causar interrupciones innecesarias.

body.title: running to/from
body.body:
you spend the first part of your life longing to leave, and the rest of it trying to get back.

we’re designed to leave — every chick leaves the nest, every gangly legged foal leaves the shadowy underside of her mother’s teat, every child becomes something new, forming new families, keeping gene pools sufficiently spread, a biological imperative dictating when and how we leave the safety of our parents’ home.

unlike my own boy, who left at 18 and went to the city and never came back, I came back, over and over. my parents were a harbour in a confusing world, their home a place I felt safe and comfortable in. how lucky was I.

in my teenage way, of course I screamed internally that I hated them, that I hated being told what to do, that I wanted to live my own life —


![b384e77d-7665-4142-bdf7-633989d2a67d-1_all_4664.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/23tbiE2UasSiSNDRZjGf18SBT1xKxurWwftHPWsvRHrkXKWaXw2Xw5AUviuEaUxapFBXp.jpg)


— but then, when it was time to go, I always came back. “you’re messing up the loungeroom,” my Dad would jest, or perhaps not, as he liked the place neat, which appealed to my own sensibilities and contrasted the houses with vinyl records out of their sleeves and wooden bowls of dope and running out of toilet paper and the one guy who used to piss the bed and put his mattress out to dry every morning or staying up all night with a group of friends talking shit under the stars. 

yep, the family home was a place I could rest my head.

I never ran away so much as used to sneak out when the house was quiet, sliding one leg through the window, then the other, quietly, quietly, into the adult world with men who probably shouldn’t have accepted teenagers who left their parents’ houses in such a way, and sent me back.

“girl, you’re far too young for this, go home, go home.” you want them to say, not just the ones who wanted you in their bed, but the ones who chopped green with tiny scissors and showed you how to exhale smoke in rings, gandalfian

the temptation of the *antithesis* of my parents’ home was such a tug.

falling asleep on beaches under the moonlight, joints rolled on CD cases, listening to records, boys with skinny legs and tasting of surfboard resin and salt water, recording cassettes for me when I brought them blank.

me being taped over with a different music to my father’s house.

little chick, feathers growing, longing to launch from the nest, running home and hoping not to be caught, under the stars, the dawn birds chastising

and still — you spend the first part of your life longing to leave, and the rest of it trying to go back.

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrFwjHc8XYuT4ejvLF3j77vYHxsx3M1fF6wMmYuYW771/whatsapp_image_2026_04_18_at_13.57.06.jpeg)
*** Los cementerios esconden ciudades para ocultar el dolor. Bóvedas, mármol, fotos; palabras que nunca se dijeron estando vivos, adornan obituarios en periódicos de alguna época. No lees periódicos, pero un día me regalaste una máscara de Papier mâché con forma de Luna, sin conocer que sus cristales perforan mi rostro cuando intento escuchar los latidos en la tierra. En tu pueblo el cementerio tiene un espacio donde mis heridas laten sin rituales, donde continúo haciéndole barcos de papel a tu hijo pequeño y escucho canciones que erizan la piel. Lo demás, es polvo en mi rostro con forma de Luna. *** ###

>¡Muchas gracias por tu visita!

*** Cemeteries hide cities to conceal the pain. Vaults, marble, photos; words never spoken while alive, adorn obituaries in newspapers of some era. You don't read newspapers, but one day you gave me a papier-mâché mask in the shape of the moon, without knowing that its crystals pierce my face when I try to listen to the heartbeats in the earth. In your town, the cemetery has a space where my wounds throb without rituals, where I continue making paper boats for your little boy and listen to songs that raise goosebumps. The rest, is dust on my face shaped like the moon.

I was astonished in their landscaping and very  cool green surroundings. For all the resorts here in the city , Shangri-la has the most cool canopy of trees and have a very clean and green ground with different plants . Its ground is too wide that covered around 13 hectares .

body.title: HIVE OPEN DAYS part VI - The beginning [GER/ENG]
body.body:
Nun sitze ich hier in Alicante im Café Ripoll, habe meine Morgenroutine beendet und starte gemütlich in den Tag.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23u6BKghCgc1x4GnRFt8fmDWqdcY6oMgKrvEGVSZXu583ttk6gyvyVr4rjBDyNbhHcHMe.png)

Gestern war es endlich so weit: Die @buzzparty, die HIVE OPEN DAYS, wurden offiziell eröffnet. Das Ulab in Alicante ist der perfekte Ort für solch eine Veranstaltung – Hut ab, was hier auf die Beine gestellt wurde! Das Kurioseste und Lustigste an der ganzen Sache war wohl das „Human Bingo“. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23uQrMYgT1x1qqZVb1KRNeLuDD5jkq4UE2ETSwhgqBUtiTtuUwHkbbhzxUotQGYNmAScz.png)


Ein Spiel, bei dem man verschiedene Typen von Hive-Usern finden muss, um seine Karte vollzubekommen. Bingo! Das kurze Briefing und das Buffet haben dem Ganzen die Krone aufgesetzt. Unglaublich – und das alles für nur 20 HBD. Ein Besuch lohnt sich definitiv, denn in erster Linie geht es darum, Interessenten über Hive aufzuklären und vor allem international neue Leute kennenzulernen.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wCFsYfHWpAucZJXAV21xPgXUz1U8n87k6LUBuHdnezFR1zDJf9rxH53qtuNXXZua7ih.png)


Mit den Usernamen habe ich es noch nicht ganz so, aber es war mir eine Ehre, @tibfox, @livinguktaiwan, @ninaeatshere und @haastrecht (und viele mehr!) ein wenig näher kennenlernen zu dürfen. Eins vorweg: Da folgt noch einiges! Der große After-Report mit vielen Fotos kommt nach dem Wochenende.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wgRueH4Z8KEvE7vyHJgymvtPJj15qJLX4xEpuVQaK32tATwnbw3gJVS6HmkKkgYtj27.png)

Nach dem Abendessen ging es für mich dann noch in den Club JalaJala Disco, um ein bisschen Salsa zu genießen.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23u5vfL7spzyq5QwjyYp9faEFHUbAv3m3DYw8AReZkZGVxCdcMTXXbQa7iEdQ3vLzmnwQ.png)


Die HIVE OPEN DAYS sind eröffnet, @schmidi ist mittendrin und es kann eigentlich nur legendär werden. ;-) Wir sehen uns auf der Straße, bei den Vorträgen oder in den Bars und Clubs!

Wann auch immer diese Zeilen heute online gehen: Sie kommen von Herzen. Das Leben darf Spaß machen!

# English Translation 👍


Now I’m sitting here in Alicante at Café Ripoll, finished my morning routine, and I'm starting the day at a relaxed pace.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23wgSMYYwhETpHpxNLs8cZZ7AigYsK1u1Nq5K6wbDBBzPdvxULkyViCvcy6qShSro7ZTc.png)


Yesterday was finally the day: @buzzparty and the HIVE OPEN DAYS were officially kicked off. The Ulab in Alicante is the perfect venue for an event like this – hats off to the organizers for what they’ve put together here! Probably the most curious and fun part of the story was the \

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/EoiYBAJkdS2njkXaLLnLLvJKDxPhUbGFTcXA6j1q2kMwanLaWhMzfknzXDptaMkTX9p.png)


It’s a game where you have to find different types of Hive users to complete your card. Bingo! The quick briefing and the buffet topped it all off. Unbelievable, and all that for just 20 HBD. It’s definitely worth a visit, especially since the main goal is to introduce newcomers to Hive, educate them, and, above all, connect with people from all over the world.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23x1HY43RqPkZMTdPT6SUTMzMsVhzMkhCdbxPd9pc8miLfMcZxXozYH5Qk1tCj7z5rYJc.png)


I’m still struggling a bit with all the usernames, but it was an honor to get to know @tibfox, @livinguktaiwan, @ninaeatshere, @haastrecht, and many others a little better. Just a heads-up: there’s more to come! My big after-action report with plenty of photos will be posted after the weekend.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23zm3ErMaYpcm2MDm2Mcs7UtnCNGZ656aQUCRZ5fKfKbVTsvK3Frwa5oaZKrqBPnk4Uxg.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/schmidi/23xe9eduPsm9Xr5FKM398G47sGJ4ri8fynoD2GHb9BDeG9umssMEgBCgcCwxmT3yvCvny.png)





Last night, I headed to the JalaJala Disco club to enjoy some Salsa.

The HIVE OPEN DAYS are officially open, @schmidi is right in the thick of it, and it’s bound to be legendary. ;-) See you on the streets, at the talks, or in the bars and clubs!



Whenever these lines go live today: they come from the heart. Life is meant to be enjoyed!

Greets from Alicante

body.title: Tag der Arbeit, oder wie geht das heute?
body.body:
**Heute feiern wir den Tag der Arbeit.**
Aber wie sieht Arbeit eigentlich noch aus?


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSJrjqHQXWA8VoJcVcRbX3fuVcgmGJp5HZNK8fNgh1oBf/img_4740.jpg)


Vor ein paar Jahren war die Antwort klar: Büro, 9–17 Uhr, Schreibtisch, Kaffeeküche.

Heute? Manche sind im Zug. Manche zuhause. Manche im Büro – und alle gleichzeitig im selben Meeting.

Hybrid Work ist nicht mehr Ausnahme. Es ist die neue Normalität.

Und das bringt eine ehrliche Frage mit sich:

> 👉 Haben wir unsere Arbeitsumgebungen wirklich darauf vorbereitet – oder tun wir nur so?

**Was ich in der Praxis sehe:**

❌ Remote-Teilnehmer hören die Hälfte nicht → weil der Raum keine ordentliche Audiotechnik hat
❌ Meetings laufen über, weil niemand die Agenda im Blick behält
❌ Ergebnisse gehen verloren → weil kein Protokoll, keine klaren Action Items
❌ Teams-KI könnte das alles lösen → aber niemand hat sie richtig eingerichtet

Hybrid Work funktioniert – wenn die Technik stimmt und die Kultur mitspielt.

Microsoft Teams, Copilot und moderne Raumtechnik sind dabei keine Nice-to-haves mehr. Sie sind Voraussetzung für echte Gleichberechtigung zwischen Remote und Präsenz.

Am Tag der Arbeit denke ich deshalb nicht nur an Errungenschaften der Vergangenheit.
Ich denke an die Frage: **Welche Arbeitsbedingungen wollen wir schaffen – für 2026 und darüber hinaus?**

-----

Ihr wollt sehen, wie gutes Hybrid Work in der Praxis aussieht? Wir haben einen Showroom in Berlin – kommt einfach vorbei. Kein Pitch, einfach ausprobieren. 🙌

#TagDerArbeit #HybridWork #MicrosoftTeams #ModernWork #Copilot #TeamsRooms #Berlin #NewWork #ZukunftDerArbeit #4green

body.body: Tax season doesn’t just knock—it barges in with tight deadlines, mounting client expectations, and a never-ending pile of returns. If you’ve ever found yourself buried under spreadsheets while the clock ticks louder, you’re not alone. Here’s the good news: there’s a smarter way to handle the pressure without burning out your team or compromising quality—outsourcing. In fact, many U.S.-based CPA firms are now turning to one strategic solution: **outsourcing tax preparation to India**. But what makes this approach so effective? And how can it work seamlessly for your firm? Let’s break it down in simple, practical terms. **What Does It Mean to Outsource Tax Preparation?** At its core, outsourcing tax preparation means delegating tax-related tasks—like preparing returns, reviewing documents, and ensuring compliance—to a qualified external team. When you [**outsource tax preparation India**](https://kmkassociatesllp.com/what-we-do/u-s-a-based-cpa-firms/tax-returns-preparation/), you’re partnering with skilled professionals who specialize in U.S. tax laws, but operate from India. These teams work as an extension of your firm, handling time-consuming tasks while you focus on client relationships and strategic growth. **Why India? The Real Advantages Explained** 1. Access to Skilled Talent Without Hiring Headaches India has a vast pool of accounting professionals trained in international taxation, including U.S. tax regulations. When you outsource tax preparation India, you tap into this expertise without the long hiring process. *

>Significant Cost Savings

Let’s be honest—staffing costs in the U.S. can be high. Outsourcing allows you to reduce overhead expenses while maintaining quality. That’s why many firms consistently outsource tax preparation India to stay competitive. *

>Faster Turnaround with Time Zone Advantage

Think of it this way: while your team sleeps, your offshore team works. This time difference helps speed up turnaround times, especially during peak tax season. Firms that outsource tax preparation India often notice improved efficiency almost immediately. *

>Scalability Without Stress

Busy season? No problem. Slow months? No wasted resources. When you outsource tax preparation India, you can scale your operations up or down as needed—without the burden of permanent staffing. How the Process Works (Step-by-Step) If you’re new to outsourcing, the process might seem complex—but it’s actually quite straightforward. Step 1: Initial Consultation You discuss your firm’s needs, workload, and expectations. Step 2: Data Sharing Secure systems are used to transfer client data safely. Step 3: Tax Preparation The offshore team prepares returns based on your guidelines. Step 4: Review & Quality Check You review the work, request changes if needed, and finalize. Step 5: Submission Returns are filed accurately and on time. Firms that outsource tax preparation India often find this workflow smooth and easy to integrate into their existing systems. **Is Data Security a Concern?** Short answer: it doesn’t have to be. Reputable outsourcing firms use advanced data protection measures like: Secure file transfer protocols (SFTP) Encrypted communication channels Strict confidentiality agreements Controlled access systems When you choose the right partner to outsource tax preparation India, your data remains safe and compliant with global standards. **Common Misconceptions (Let’s Clear Them Up)** “Will I Lose Control Over My Work?” Not at all. You remain in charge. Outsourcing simply gives you support—not replacement. “Is the Quality Reliable?” Yes—if you partner with experienced professionals. Many firms that outsource tax preparation India report equal or even better accuracy rates. “Is Communication Difficult?” Modern tools like Zoom, Slack, and email make communication seamless. Time zone differences often become an advantage rather than a hurdle. **When Should You Consider Outsourcing?** You might benefit from outsourcing if: Your team struggles during peak tax season You’re turning away clients due to capacity limits You want to reduce operational costs You need faster turnaround times In these cases, it makes sense to outsource tax preparation India and free up your internal resources. **Why Choose KMK & Associates LLP?** At KMK & Associates LLP, we understand the challenges CPA firms face. Our team is trained in U.S. tax regulations and committed to delivering accurate, timely, and secure services. If you’re looking for a reliable partner to outsource tax preparation India, explore our services here: 👉 outsource tax preparation india **Key Benefits at a Glance** Reduced operational costs Access to experienced tax professionals Faster turnaround times Scalable solutions Improved work-life balance for your team It’s no surprise that more firms continue to outsource tax preparation India year after year. **FAQs: Quick Answers to Common Questions** *

>Is outsourcing tax preparation legal for U.S. CPA firms?

Yes, it is completely legal as long as you follow IRS guidelines and maintain client confidentiality. *

>How do I ensure quality when I outsource?

Work with experienced providers, set clear expectations, and implement a review process. *

>What types of tax returns can be outsourced?

Individual, corporate, partnership, and more—most firms that outsource tax preparation India handle a wide range of returns. *

>Will outsourcing affect my client relationships?

Not at all. In fact, it can improve them by allowing you to focus more on client communication and advisory services. *

>How quickly can I get started?

With the right partner, onboarding can be completed in just a few days. **Final Thoughts: Is It Time to Make the Shift?** Outsourcing isn’t just about cutting costs—it’s about working smarter. When you [**outsource tax preparation India**](https://kmkassociatesllp.com/what-we-do/u-s-a-based-cpa-firms/tax-returns-preparation/), you gain time, flexibility, and peace of mind. You empower your firm to grow without overextending your team. If tax season feels overwhelming every year, maybe it’s not about working harder—it’s about choosing a better system. body.title: The first mountain hike of the year. Bitlis Mountains.
body.body: As we're in the first days of May, I did my first mountain hike of the season a few days ago. It was a month late compared to previous years. In previous years, I would start my mountain hikes in early April. The heavy snowfall and precipitation caused the delay. I took a lot of photos, so it will be difficult to fit them all in one post. I will publish them in two parts. _Mayıs ayının ilk günlerini yaşadığımız bugünlerde sezonun ilk dağ yürüyüşünü bir kaç gün önce yaptım. Önceki yıllara oranla bir aylık bir gecikme oldu. Önceki yıllar nisan ayının başlarında dağ yürüyüşlerine başlardım. Yoğun derecede yağan kar ve yağış sonrası gecikme oldu. Çok fazla foğoğraf çektim, bu yüzden hepsini tek gönderiye sığdırmam zor olacak. İki part şekilde yayınlayacağım._

/> The small stream in the image almost dries up during the summer months. Melting snow and rainwater that accumulates underground form the source of this stream. _Görseldeki küçük dere yaz aylarında kuruyacak seviyeye geliyor. Eriyen kar suları ve yer altında biriken yağmur suları bu derenin kaynağını oluşturuyor._

/> Early-maturing flowers have begun to grow. Because it's still early, the variety of flowers is limited at the moment. Most of the road is hilly, with short stretches of flat ground. In nearby areas, most of the snow has melted. The snow can't withstand the heat of the sun and starts melting quickly. _Erkenden olgunlaşan çiçekler büyümeye başlamış. Henüz erken olduğu için çiçek çeşitliliği şu an az. Yolun çoğu eğimli bazen kısa mesafeli düzlük alanlar var. Yakın bölgelerde karların çoğu erimiş. Kar güneş ısısına dayanamayıp hemen erimeye başlıyor._

/> There are many springs and fountains in the area where I'm walking. Even on the hottest days of summer, the water is ice-cold. I vividly remember the effort I put into reaching this ice-cold water and drinking it to my heart's content during the summer heat. I continue walking, leaving the city behind. _Yürüdüğüm bölgede çok fazla kaynak suyu, çeşme var. Yaz mevsiminin en sıcak günlerinde su buz gibi oluyor. Yaz sıcağında bu buz gibi suya ulaşmak ve sudan doya doya içmek ne kadar çabaladığımı iyice hatırlarım. Şehri gerimde bırakarak yürümeye devam ediyorum._

/> A mulberry tree on a mountaintop in the valley. It was planted there years ago by a nature lover, and it has grown enormous. Eating mulberries on a mountaintop must be a great privilege. _Vadide dağ başında dut ağacı. Geçmiş yıllarda doğasever biri tarafından ekildi oraya ve kocaman oldular. Dağ başında dut yemek büyük bir ayrıcalık olmalı._

/>

A baby turtle... about the size of a walnut. Animals like turtles grow up alone, not needing any help from their mothers. However, survival against wild animals is difficult for them when they are still hatchlings. Both the number of attackers increases because of their small size, and because their shells aren't very hard, they become easy prey.

_Yavru bir kaplumbağa.. Bir ceviz büyüklüğünde. Kaplumbağa gibi hayvanlar tek başlarına büyüyor, annenin herhangi bir yardımına ihtiyaç duyulmuyor. Henüz yavru iken vahşi hayvanlar karşısında hayatta kalmaları zor oluyor. Hem saldırganların sayısı artıyor küçük oldukları için hem kabukları çok sert olmadığı için kolayca av oluyorlar._

body.title: Bitcoin Price Got 2 Successive Monthly Green Candles
body.body:
We have seen 5 successive monthly red candles on Bitcoin price chart. It was one the longest red candles series on monthly chart. After this monthly red candle series, Bitcoin price got 2 successive monthly green candles. 

Here you can see monthly chart of Bitcoin price. Yesterday was the last day of the last monht. Bitcoin price closed the month with huge monthly green candle. Bitcoin started the new month with green candle. It may be possible to see monthly green candle in this month. If we see Bitcoin price will get 3 successive monthly green candles. We have seen monthly green candles series as this.

I pointed the same move on Bitcoin price chart. When Bitcoin price reversed down from all time high level from 69K, Bitcoin price got 2 monthly red candles. After this price dump, Bitcoin price got 2 monthly green candles. You can see what happened after these green candles. We may see the same scenario.


![e1.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23t76y3g7nj3QnBrsmjkR4asVhbHpaWYvwX4XhfgsiF1ZzVbNvoBAinnfka4SrFmxpdzZ.PNG)

Here you can see the indicators on monthly chart of Bitcoin price. Fisher Indicators is on the bottom and trying to reverse up. MACD Indicator is going down. It will reverse up If we see more monthly green candles. So, these major indicators are trying to find the bottom and reverse up. If we see more monhly green candles, Bitcoin price will be reversed up and enter bullish trend.

![e2.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chorock/23swib2v1iSXADohgrZWKFc4V74wzoJC7ZcV3E5vwAy7Uma254utUHHW3E5AagEX5ZPLG.PNG)

If we dont see ''Sell in May, go Away'', Bitcoin price may complete reverse up until Summer. If it happens, we will enter the new bearish trend.

We will see...

body.title: Flight Through Landscape, Light, and Well-being at Orla Taumanan
body.body: >\n\nDetaching myself from the daily routine to leave my home in the city of Boa Vista is more than a simple walk; it is a ritual of renewal. Every time I decide to make my way toward Orla Taumanan, I do so with the conviction of someone going to meet an elusive treasure. Going out to enjoy the weekend in this emblematic corner of the state of Roraima becomes a wonderful personal event—an appointment where the main objective is to \

for a formidable landscape. But my fishing rod does not seek fish; my tool is the lens, and my prey is the light that fades over the horizon. This exercise is not merely aesthetic; it is a deeply healthy mental exercise. Observing the chromatism of the Rio Branco is a lesson in humility and living geography. Seeing it flow through its channel with such natural simplicity, ignoring human borders, only to pour its generous flow into the Rio Negro and finally join the torrential Amazon, invites me to reflect on our own trajectory. Like the river, we also flow toward broader channels, seeking immensity. As the afternoon progresses, the sky transforms into an immense curtain that spans the entire spectrum of the imaginable. The fantastic colors—burning oranges, deep violets, and golds that seem hand-carved—urge me to move along the walkways of the Orla. I enjoy the gardens with a lingering gaze, recognizing in each plant species the wisdom of the Amazonian flora. Fishing on the shore through photography acts as a simple but infallible therapy to clear the chapters of the mind. It is a process of cleansing: I let worries drift away along the healthy paths of the river as it passes through the city, freeing up space for contemplation. My true capture is the image; a hobby that not only occupies my time but dwells within the deepest beats of my heart. ---

> --- Upon reaching the heart of the park, where the healing chromatism expands like oil on the canvas of the evening landscape, life gifted me a chance encounter. A group of young medical students, representatives of the future and vitality, kindly stopped me. They invited me to use the community service offered by the Federal University of Roraima at their health station. We spoke in the Portuguese tongue—that language that sounds like music in these lands—and I responsibly assured them that, after finishing my visual flight through the walkways and gardens, I would return to have my blood pressure evaluated. There is a special beauty in this exchange: they care for the body, while the landscape cares for the spirit. This place possesses privileged topographical points for catching images. With phone in hand, I seek that angle that manages to capture the essence of the light. I take several shots, adjusting my gaze to the codes and forms that nature delivers to me. I always return grateful for these images, for they are not just digital files; they are readings and messages for the future of my life of prodigious adventures. I am convinced that my visual and spiritual contact with nature always rewards me with true internal events. My search for new images is bound by a deep respect for the discourse of visual arts, always honoring those paradisiacal sources that the Amazon lends us. ---

>

---

After appreciating the beauty of the afternoon alongside the Brazilian people of Boa Vista—a people who know how to coexist with their river—I begin my return. I receive the energy of the landscape in that mystical instant where the light surrenders to the night. At the end of my journey, I kept my word and stopped at the health station. There, the medical students performed their work with a kindness that deserves to be highlighted. As I sat before them to evaluate my pressure, I understood that self-care is another form of respect for life. At seventy-two years old, the results showed a minimal elevation, a small warning from my metabolism. I have understood that I must reduce my consumption of cinnamon, for even what is sweet and aromatic requires balance.

I said goodbye to those young people, thanking them for their attention and their appreciated kindness. I walked away under the eternal light of the landscape, enjoying this \

that combines the medicine of men with the medicine of the soul. Every weekend is an opportunity I have to spread my wings and fly through the delicious space of Orla Taumanan, celebrating that, despite the years, the horizon remains new every time I decide to go out and find it. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hiramdo/EowFCWZ665utq8RamW9y9CL7SuChDXnwAtvaBpXvWMXJC5tb54QoTN6K7oZacPYdGVr.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hiramdo/23w2zBfi3jVpJWeEZosHmTM2YnBz5GWW5QfydHsZb3n5itHWiuuMUvDkLtZoawDPuwTzu.png) ---

body.title: How the EB5 Visa Process Works: A Simple Guide for Beginners
body.body:
The EB-5 (employment-based, 5th preference) investment visa helps qualified investors become permanent citizens. They can receive a green card with their spouse and unmarried children under 21. This visa program commenced in 1990 and was established as an economic development strategy to stimulate job creation and capital investment in the United States.

This guide will cover the basic steps of the EB-5 visa process and the role of each step in the overall procedure.

**https://quantumglobalresidency.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/pexels-garrett-morrow-2322707.jpg**

**How to Get Started with the EB-5 Program**

If you invest in the U.S. economy, you can get legal residency in return. This is what the [**EB-5 visa process**](https://quantumglobalresidency.com/eb-5-visa-process-step-by-step-guide/) is all about. Any investor can join, but they must invest in a U.S. business and ensure it creates at least 10 full-time jobs for Americans.

New rules require a minimum investment of $800,000 in Targeted Employment Areas. These are rural or high-unemployment locations. Projects outside these kind of locations cost approximately $1,050,000.

**Choosing the Best Investment**

Picking the right investment is one of the most important steps in the EB-5 process. Most of the time, investors can either start their own business or invest through an area center. Direct investment gives you more power, but you also have to manage processes better and make sure you meet the job creation requirements.

Regional offices, on the other hand, are authorized to oversee EB-5 projects. They let buyers be less involved while still meeting the program's requirements. This alternative is gaining popularity because it simplifies paperwork and job tracking.

Prompt attention is required at this time. Investors are required to assess the project's progress and provide evidence that their funds originate from legitimate sources, such as inheritance, company earnings, or the sale of real estate.

**Putting in the First Petition**

The next step is to file Form I-526 or I-526E once the payment is complete. This letter serves as the foundation of the EB-5 application. It proves the investor meets all standards, including expenditure amount, project description, and funding source.

USCIS is carefully reviewing this case. Demand and the applicant's country affect processing delays, which might take months or years. At this point, obtaining approval is a big deal because it means the investment meets the EB-5 visa process's requirements.

**Making the switch to conditional permanent residency**

To get a conditional Green Card, the investor can file a petition that is granted. People who want to change their status usually file Form I-485 if they are already in the United States. The consulate process is used if they are outside the country.

Once accepted, the investor and a member of their immediate family receive a conditional Green Card valid for 2 years. In this phase, the investment should remain, and employment creation should continue as per the initial intentions.

This phase is highly crucial since it relates investment to permanent settlement in the country. It's not enough to keep the investment; it's also important to ensure the application's promises of economic impact are fulfilled.

**Getting permanent residency**

Investors need to file Form I-829 before the end of the two-year conditional term. The goal is to prove the investment worked. The investor must show that the business kept the required capital and generated or is creating 10 jobs.

USCIS carefully reviews this claim, and the process can often take more than 2 years. Once the investor is approved, the conditions are removed, and they can live in the country legally without any limits.

Many people think this is the best part of the EB-5 visa process** **because it means the process is over.

**What Will Happen in the Long Run**

Investors can petition for U.S. citizenship after five years of continuous legal residency if they meet all qualifications, including excellent moral character and continuous residency.

It takes time, money, and strategy to complete the EB-5 visa process**.** Many buyers see it as a unique opportunity to establish a future in the U.S. while growing the economy and creating jobs.

Investment, petition approval, conditional residency, and permanent residency comprise the EB-5 process. If they obtain advice and make sensible choices, even first-timers can feel confident.

body.title: It's May! Getting Warmer, Thinking Thoughts and the HPUD!
body.body: Dear Hivers! Yes, we know, once again, one month ends and another begins. Things are moving at a frantic pace, because almost without realizing it, we're heading towards the middle of the year. Time flies by... one more time. And things are getting heated, everything is warmer now, right? More sunny hours, more light and more time to do more things... well... too many things to do now! So we enjoy the weather, obviously but as I said, many things must be done too. Let's enjoy the spring season with almost summer feelings!

/> Thoughts After A Month ---------------------- I'm here, exactly one month later. The same thing. Well, again, the same thing, because the situation has not changed much, actually it's all a bit more complicated. But it's ok. However I barely have time to think! Today is a holiday because it's Labor Day, but I have to study a lot because this May is shaping up to be very intense. I can't think in anything else, no time really! With this new study plan, there are so many things to do, so many assignments, plus reading books and studying, not only for final exams but also for midterms that are just a few days away while classes continue. So yes, everything is getting complicated. I'll be just as little available as last month, that's for sure. I hope everything goes well despite the obvious lack of time, and then, in a hopefully liberating June, I can tell you how it all went, and in general, be a bit more present here on Hive, and continue sharing with all of you. In the meantime, let's enjoy the lovely spring weather, the bright sunshine, the colorful natural scenery, the life that's coming back to life, the world, and the fact that we're still alive.

/> Almost forgotten but no. So, and now, the HPUD as usual of course: Hive Power Up Day ----------------- Well I'd say that despite all I keep somehow my presence here, and now today, day 1st of the new month let's focus on the HPUD, it is therefore _my 41th Power Up Day_ in total. In my case it is the 5th of 2026 obviously now in May, after January, February, Mrch and April of course. At least I'm keeping my habit of be part of the HPUD. So let's go with this new **Hive Power Up Day,** hivers!💪

> Oh, this time, as the last month also I have done **a new POWER UP of 10 HIVE**, yes only 10 and not 100 because sadly I am not earning much, as I did it before. And I need to distribute and manage the amount of Hive along the next months because I don't think I will earn much truly and I want to power up more despite all. So the only thing I can do is to reduce the amount of my Power Ups and to wait better times will arrive or on the contrary no more Hive to power up them no more HPUD. But I hope that won't happen because I want to continue to join at least the HPUD and be part of all of it! Just hope all our plans will be good and Hive ecosystem too.

> And so we conclude this usual report, mission accomplished, despite almost I forgot it! I wish you all the best and also for Hive, that it may return to its former glory, that it may rise again and give us more motivation and hope to continue here, with more HPUD reports and much more to come. And as I always say... we'll see. For now, I keep focused on my (stressful) priorities right now, so I'll be keeping a low profile until I will be a bit free, hope on June! Finally! Wish me luck for this month!🤞 Thanks to all of you!

title.title: ¿Cambiamos o mejoramos? [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
_Saludos comunidad @holos.lotus._

_De las dinámicas sociales de la actualidad a nuestro alrededor, es poco probable que nos sea ajeno el fenómeno de los movimientos migratorios, bien hacia otros países, o dentro de los propios hacia ciudades más cosmopolitas y prósperas._

_Conocemos gente que empezó desde abajo, que paso a paso fueron escalando, consiguiendo ese trabajo, automóvil, vivienda que antes parecía un sueño lejano. Como también es posible ver cómo ese alguien, sin quererlo del todo, empezó a hablar distinto, a vestirse de otra manera, a frecuentar lugares donde antes no entraban ni sus pensamientos._

>Greetings community @holos.lotus

>Regarding the social dynamics around us today, it's unlikely that the phenomenon of migratory movements—whether to other countries or within countries toward more cosmopolitan and prosperous cities—is unknown to us.

>We know people who started from the bottom, who step by step climbed up, landing that job, that car, that home which once seemed like a distant dream. But it's also possible to see how that same person, without really meaning to, began to speak differently, to dress another way, to frequent places where even their thoughts hadn't entered before.
********
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/6029267/pexels-photo-6029267.jpeg</center>
********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/una-mano-con-pequenas-piedras-6029267/)</center>

_Nos movemos, la vida no es estática, pues no somos simples árboles; pasamos de ser dependientes a autónomos, de vivir en un barrio a otro, de tener un salario mínimo a uno que nos permite respirar más holgados. Algo que los libros llaman \

es la historia de casi todos nosotros, de nuestros padres, o de la humanidad en su conjunto. Cuando se cambia de posición y se entra a nuevos círculos, hay algo que empieza a empujar desde adentro; no es algo que se decide, sino más sutil. Llega el nuevo grupo, que tiene sus códigos, formas de opinar, de gastar... Y casi sin darte cuenta, empiezas a parecerte a ellos, cual frase vieja de \

; cuando se anda con gente que piensa distinto, que tiene otros hábitos e intereses, se termina siendo un poco de ellos._

_¿Es posible que esos cambios condenen a olvidar? Vamos a ver, el que hoy maneja un auto propio o asignado puede entender el infierno del transporte público, pero no lo vive; puede sentir empatía, claro que sí, pero la representación mental, la forma en que su cerebro procesa el problema, ya no es la misma, y eso es inevitable. La vida es transformadora, las condiciones materiales no son neutrales: van tejiendo pensamientos, miedos, deseos. He visto gente que al mejorar su economía se cree superior o mejor persona, pero mejorar económicamente no necesariamente es sinónimo de mejoramiento humano; a veces una cosa viene sola y la otra se queda atrás._

>We move; life is not static, for we are not mere trees. We go from being dependent to autonomous, from living in one neighborhood to another, from earning a minimum wage to one that allows us to breathe more freely. This is what books call \

—it's the story of almost all of us, of our parents, or of humanity as a whole. When you change your position and enter new circles, something begins to push from within. It's not something you decide; it's more subtle. The new group arrives, with its own codes, ways of expressing opinions, of spending money... And almost without realizing it, you start to resemble them, like the old saying goes, \

When you walk with people who think differently, who have other habits and interests, you end up becoming a little like them.

>Is it possible that these changes condemn us to forget? Let's see, someone who now drives their own or a company car can understand the hell of public transportation, but they don't live it. They can feel empathy, of course, but the mental representation, the way their brain processes the problem, is no longer the same—and that's inevitable. Life is transformative; material conditions are not neutral. They weave thoughts, fears, desires. I've seen people who, upon improving their financial situation, believe they are superior or better human beings. But improving economically is not necessarily synonymous with human improvement. Sometimes one thing comes alone, and the other gets left behind.
*********
<center>https://images.pexels.com/photos/30227393/pexels-photo-30227393.jpeg</center>
***********
<center>[Fuente/Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/zapatillas-gastadas-colgadas-de-cables-electricos-en-sao-paulo-30227393/)</center>

_También he visto a los que subieron de posición, que cambiaron de grupo, pero que mantuvieron algo intacto, algo así como conciencia, valores, memoria. Saben de dónde vienen y no lo usan como un adorno o discurso; lo llevan por dentro. Siguen siendo esa persona humilde, laboriosa, compañera, solo que ahora tienen mejores zapatos; cosa que no se antoja fácil. Esas nuevas dinámicas y/o grupos sociales presionan, a veces sin mala intención, invitan a \

, pero no se trata de mirar atrás para quedarse, sino para no perderse._

_¿Estamos cambiando o estamos mejorando? Se puede cambiar sin mejorar; es posible ganar dinero y perder el alma, ascender en el trabajo y caer en la soberbia. Los buenos cambios no piden que renuncies a tu historia, sino que la cultives; ser distinto sin dejar de ser quien eres, que te muevas con las raíces a cuestas, y aprendas otros códigos sin quemar los tuyos. El lujo más grande no es un auto nuevo o una cuenta bancaria abultada, sino cambiar de vida sin cambiar de alma, y eso no lo da el dinero, sino una cabeza bien puesta y el corazón en su sitio._

I've also seen those who rose in status, who changed their social circle, but kept something intact—something like awareness, values, memory. They know where they come from, and they don't use it as decoration or a speech; they carry it within. They remain that humble, hardworking, supportive person, only now they have nicer shoes. That is no easy feat. Those new dynamics and social groups exert pressure, sometimes without bad intentions. They invite you to \

But it's not about looking back to stay there; it's about not losing yourself.

Are we changing, or are we improving? You can change without improving. It's possible to gain money and lose your soul, to climb the corporate ladder and fall into arrogance. Good changes don't ask you to renounce your history; rather, they ask you to cultivate it. To be different without ceasing to be who you are, to move with your roots in tow, to learn other codes without burning your own. The greatest luxury is not a new car or a fat bank account, but to change your life without changing your soul. And that isn't given by money—it comes from a well-placed mind and a heart in its rightful place.

title.title: The Pros and Cons of Self-Driving Cars: A Case Against Full Adoption
title.body: Over the past decade, the world has undergone a vast level of technological advancement in areas such as healthcare, food processing and general lifestyle aid, including mobility. Self-driving cars are one of these advancements. Although, they have not really been fully accepted by our society due to some technical limitations, automated cars like Tesla exist. With Tesla vehicles, the presence and attention of a driver is fully needed during every ride. In fact, the drivers are regarded as the savior behind the wheel, ready to take over in cases of emergencies. However, the automation in this car model makes it far easier and less stressful for any car owner, as it enables hands-free driving and carries out some operational instructions without the input of the driver.\n\n

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/car-dashboard-displaying-autonomous-driving-interface-dkEShdYwnZ0) Fully self-driving cars, on the other hand, mean that the car is designed to operate without a driver. There is no one behind the wheel, and every single function is fully automated in such a way that the presence of a driver is needless. The car is expected to handle driving exactly the way a human would, but with more logic and precision. These cars have inbuilt maps for different geographical areas, they are able to detect incoming traffic and bypass it using a different route. They are also programmed to obey traffic lights and make driving decisions that help avoid accidents involving pedestrians, contributing to more efficient transportation. All of these are made possible because of the inbuilt cameras, sensors, and AI systems that work. Self-driving cars are also believed to use less gas compared to cars driven by humans, and this is without doubt, beneficial to our environment undergoing rapid climate change. However, a direct disadvantage is that the technologies they rely on for accuracy, such as sensors and cameras, would require much more energy, which can contribute heavily to more environmental mishaps. Another disadvantage of society adopting self-driving cars is affordability. These cars will be highly expensive because of the effort, materials and advanced technology involved in their production. As a result, the average citizen of a country may not be able to access such services for convenience, which will only widen the gap in a capitalist society. Thirdly, just as we use artificial intelligence for academic research, high-end reports, and vibe coding and still observe some technical erors in the outputs, the AI systems used in self-driving cars are not immune to failures. Most AI driven systems still requires human contribution, but self-driving cars may not. So while they may function with more technical precision, they can never replace the need for human instinct on routes such as the highway. There are also situations where a human driver would know how to navigate better based on years of experience and good judgement. But a self-driving car will only be able to respond based on imputed logic. This limitation alone makes the adoption of self-driving cars fully debatable and subject to valid criticism.

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-futuristic-car-driving-on-a-bridge-over-a-body-of-water-urVaLM9mCrI) Lastly, this automated self-driving system can sometimes be unable to distinguish similar weather conditions such as mist, fog, and snow. But a human driver would be able to make more accurate driving decisions based on the clear interpretation of visual elements. And since AI systems are still being developed for more accurate functions, human input remains crucial in driving. Now, in the event of an accident involving a fully self-driving car, it is very possible that no one can be held responsible, and this can be dangerous because in our society, we all need some form of accountability to enable us tackle human carelessness and prevent persistent problems with law and order. Thankfully, the pushback on self-driving cars has been persistent and the only option available to consumers are automated cars with human supervision. This ensures that responsibility can be tied to accident or violation of traffic orders. With all these considerations on the pros and cons of self-driving cars, my stance is pretty much clear. The disadvantages of self-driving cars outweigh the advantages, and thus, I do not support the widespread adoption in our society. * * *

title.title: Lawnmower man: Actifit April 30th 2026
title.body:
Well, our dry spell is coming to an end today, so it’s lawnmower time at the home place. First up, the front… ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5DB2355D-E4C4-43EF-83C3-9D1A3B31A8681777618779.5811648) The big, heavy old petrol push mower does have a ‘self propelled’ function, which I’ve never used, though I know it burns a lot of fuel. If I engaged it, the front alone would have used a full tank, so I choose to burn calories with my internal engine instead. Next for a trim was the side… ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5DB2355D-E4C4-43EF-83C3-9D1A3B31A8681777618832.1924891) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5DB2355D-E4C4-43EF-83C3-9D1A3B31A8681777618849.9979029) Of course, as soon as you feel like you have a handle on one aspect of things, you notice more work to be done; that metal gate in the background is showing quite a lot of rust, so that’ll need sanding and painting soon. Not happening today though! Onwards, to the back! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5DB2355D-E4C4-43EF-83C3-9D1A3B31A8681777619077.316269) And the soon to be vegetable garden, where I mowed a roughly 12’ by 18’ (4m x 6m) patch and a path to get there. This was heavy going, and I even thought about engaging the propelled function on the mower, but stuck with the ‘this makes a good workout’ approach. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5DB2355D-E4C4-43EF-83C3-9D1A3B31A8681777619441.186516) All the grass cuttings from the back went onto the veg patch to-be; hopefully it’ll suppress the growth of grass and weeds for a week or 2 until I can get the beds made and some plants in the ground. Overall, I think my Fluffy overlord is satisfied with my mornings work. Or at least she’s happy that it’s time for some cuddles 😃🐈

title.title: A Plague Tale: Innocence.... first impressions
title.body:
We are going to enter territory that I rarely have any capability of talking about and that is a game that I actually purchased instead of getting it included as part of my membership. I didn't pay full price for this game but there was some sort of flash sale and it was so low that I couldn't say no. It may have been something like $5 but I honestly don't remember.
https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/752590/header.jpg?t=1727793332 [src](https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/752590/header.jpg?t=1727793332)
I only have about an hour and a half logged in this game and so far the game is pretty solid, but it has a very limited range of activities for you to actually do and after about 90 minutes I no longer wanted to play anymore. It was ok though because it was time for bed anyway.

Pro: Superb voice acting

Nothing ruins a story-driven game faster than bad voice acting and I will give APT this much, they put a lot of time into choosing just the right people for the voice acting. The people who are doing the characters are absolutely wonderful even the voice of the little kid who is kind of annoying yet is a central part of the game.
https://static0.thegamerimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/a-plague-tale-requiem-hugo-thinks-amicia-is-dead.jpg [src](https://static0.thegamerimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/a-plague-tale-requiem-hugo-thinks-amicia-is-dead.jpg)
Normally I am not a fan of children characters in games or movies and a lot of this has to do with the generally very poor voice actors that do the job for them. Huge is still by far the most annoying character in the game, but they did a good job with the casting to minimize the \

Pro: easy controls

Another sure-fire way of chasing me away from a game in record time is to have ultra-complicated controls that if you take so much as a single day off from playing the game you feel as though you need to go through a refresher course just to be able to play it.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23swa9LKfDbGmQavxmFmyGJzmHthjJUHeHPDbTwfCq7LLH2BTvekhmDwXtnDrZN6SeHwr.png) [src](https://i0.wp.com/caniplaythat.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/IMG_7178.jpg?w=1600&ssl=1)
Quite simply put, there isn't much to be done in this game and therefore the controls are very limited and intuitive. They also do a great job of incorporating the tutorial into the story in such a way that it teaches you everything but doesn't take ages to make it happen. I really liked the way they did this and am delighted that the controls are limited and easy to understand as is the menu to see them should you forget. But this limited number of move and therefore buttons brings me to my next point that was always going to happen in a game like this.

Con: There isn't a wide variety of things to do

With small number of buttons used comes small number of things that you will actually do was made famous by Uncle Ben from the Spiderman film if I remember correctly and for *A Plague Tale* it becomes evident really early on that you are going to be repeating the same tasks over and over again as the game goes on.
https://static0.gamerantimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/A-Plague-Tale-Innocence-Chapter-4-The-Apprentice-First-Tool.jpg?q=50&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1.5 [src](https://static0.gamerantimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/A-Plague-Tale-Innocence-Chapter-4-The-Apprentice-First-Tool.jpg?q=50&fit=crop&w=825&dpr=1.5)
When sneaking is introduced to us in the first 15 minutes or so. I saw the ubiquitous high grass and thought to myself \

. Unfortunately I was correct in this assessment. You will find yourself over and over standing in the tall grass with Hugo waiting for a guard to do their very predictable square loop while you get in just behind him and then go to another patch of tall grass on the other side. In some situations you will repeat this half a dozen times and if you make a tiny mistake and are spotted you have to start the whole gruelingly slow process over from the start. The auto checkpoints are frequent and I like how it is done mostly, but I have already encountered a few instances where I didn't see a guard that was around the corner and you are not meant to see him, you are supposed to learn about his presence by not seeing him and when he insta-kills you (you have zero defenses) you have this *sigh* moment where you contemplate turning the game off. But I guess I am kind of glad that I did not because things get a lot more interesting once you progress a bit and end up underground.

Pro: Story is great

https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Ztiaf_xs2Ec/maxresdefault.jpg [src](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/Ztiaf_xs2Ec/maxresdefault.jpg)
Often with \
games, the story is so overbearing and such a massive part of the game that I am generally turned off by any game that is described as being \

Not all stories are the same and there is something I truly hate about a lot of games and that is when control is taken away from you for cutscene after cutscene. Thankfully the story in *A Plague Tale* is often told while you are moving and participating rather than completely taking control away from you and I truly appreciate this. I think some games really take the cinematics too far and then I don't feel like I am playing a game at all but rather watching a movie that I get to push a button from time-to-time. The story as I know it so far is quite the mystery in *A Plague Tale* and I believe that this is probably why the game has such high marks on basically all review sites. While some people will dock it a point or two for the repetitive nature of the game, they will admit that it is worth it because the story is so unique and wonderful. I have avoided looking at a lot of these because I think that major part of this game that makes it so great is that you are not supposed to know certain things yet and when they do happen it is meant to be one of the most important aspects of the game.

Pro: Loading times are very quick

This will vary depending on what console or PC power-level you are playing the game on, but on the PS5 the loading is so fast that I haven't even really had time to read the little bit of lore or tips that they pop on the screen while it is happening. This is another deal-breaker for me in games where it is expected you are going to frequently die: If the loading isn't optimized I will exit the game forever quite frequently. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H4FOb16Nenk Unfortunately I think this is one of those games that the studio is content with the amount of money that they have made on it already and are not really all that interested in slashing the price in order to get a few thousand extra sales. I got in on some sort of super-special that hasn't been repeated since as far as I know. At the moment this game is around $40 on the few platforms that I have bothered to look it up on (PS5 and PC) and while the game is lovely and has mostly good and very little bad, I still don't think it is worth this much money. I can't imagine it having much in the way of replay value either and once you know the story and have seen it, this will easily be a one and done sort of game. So if you have a friend that has this game maybe give it a try and borrow it if you are one of the few people out there that still seeks out physical media (seriously, why aren't people doing this?) I wouldn't pay $40 for really any game honestly, and while this one is good and an anomaly as far as story-driven games are concerned, I wouldn't pay any more than around $15 for a 7-year old game.

title.title: SOME COOL ASTEROID MINING MACHINERY IN DEAD SPACE 2023
title.body:
I played a bit of the Dead Space remake last night, just one short segment, a mission of sorts or part of a mission, something like that. Despite being in the mood for playing, I couldn't concentrate properly on the game. The weather outside was colder than usual, and the wind was pretty strong, so the atmosphere was too inviting for sleeping. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3rTwwSmvdbMrNiWucmL8Jy4J8xTYs7EhfVcawwgdsiC/screenshot_1389_.png)

Anyway, I played a bit, so I have a bunch of screenshots to show you today. For the most part, I was flying in zero gravity around the enormous halls of the spaceship's mining facility, fascinated by the details of the machinery.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbgE5PTnLX2SVE1aspMcFqvj2ZwrLG85iNFV75M83Tkbe/screenshot_1421_.png)

The last Dead Space-related post I published a few days ago had its fair share of monsters; in this one, you won't see any necromorphs. I encountered about a dozen of them, but I was too lazy to chase good compositions with moving monsters in the screenshot. Fighting them was hard enough.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbsSmHFPLHiVxfuZsZ8so8ELPahaH7xtwskZ8EhwgHGX/screenshot_1401_.png)

Here you can see an asteroid trapped in the grinding machine. The screenshot shows the scene from the ship's interior. In the following picture ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxvbEvB22NMvpARYE79rWDuFbtpmeVfV1fPusvPN6KzQ/screenshot_1458_.png)

... you can see the same thing from the outside.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcCFkKYyhJiJUsxewqrH743gwbbqvHJJCcsBhTLb25Pj/screenshot_1430_.png)

One of the things I had to do at that point in the game involved the lightning-like things shown in this screenshot. Those are some kinds of engines, and I had to shut them down. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZLmYmdydWXzZj56aTvxrh1zd8okvgeAUh1348awQ2R2h/screenshot_1411_.png)

These kinds of puzzles that involve the ship's infrastructure are a big part of the gameplay. Almost as big as fighting the necromorphs. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWWfYwL9TmtWmLkHVsoTiytrSPcNtSRvgXE9MJacTMG9n/screenshot_1439_.png)

In this outdoor scene, you can take a quick look at the star-sprinkled darkness of outer space.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWzGd8Xum2LFUo29QbMz4WyHtLYgKnWKhfUTKdfZCEUPT/screenshot_1495_.png)

Here you can see the interior without the lighting. The engines were down at this point.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmULhwgiQB6U2yZmSiNHAM8PtPFLPZJgtQDv6BWv14PkY6/screenshot_1489_.png)

This is the same thing, but seen from a slightly different angle. I don't know if the screenshots can convey it, but this scene looks very majestic when you play the game. It comes after a series of dark, narrow corridors, which definitely amplifies the grandeur of the hall, the asteroid, and then the space when you briefly exit the ship.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6qR82DRwwMEe1dQXtBiu6tWdwSDFaL7rZw4ZP2NqQUn/screenshot_1470_.png)

This is yet another outdoor shot ... I mean, screenshot.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZWVxc3Cvz6v4FnQZD5j5o3wBdaE6c1rMntdXKQPiV7dY/screenshot_1446_.png)

The exterior is gray and cold ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNziizKr5D1uLX8wqogPWA2wYqc3MnG75Zz7oyr7iGvGq/screenshot_1516_.png)

... the interior is golden. It's industrial and uncomfortable, sprinkled with blood, and infested with alien monstrosities, but it looks almost inviting in this golden light.

<a href=\

> (Enlargeable) This is the interior end of the grinding machine, a place where the asteroid enters in the form of small chunks and dust. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxgExxMVPq8XMCPFzfh8vRggmiaw5ppWHpNxokDVhGo5/screenshot_1521_.png) This last picture shows the main control panel of the mining operation. And that's all for today. Hope you enjoyed this tour through the mining section of the spaceship USG Ishimura. Have a great day, or night, depending on where on the planet you are - THE END.

## 2. Fortalezas de la Propuesta HCB

- **Alta Eficiencia de Capital:** A diferencia de las subvenciones de \

, HCB coloca 100,000 HBD en una Cuenta de Ahorros con rendimiento en nombre de la comunidad. Cada HBD recibido genera un 20% APR y nunca se gasta — solo los intereses y las comisiones de originación financian las operaciones.\n- **Presión Deflacionaria sobre HIVE:** Al bloquear HIVE como Hive Power (HP) como garantía y delegarlo a una cuenta de curación separada, HCB reduce activamente la oferta líquida del mercado y fortalece la seguridad de la red.\n- **El Principal \

:** El capital principal del DHF permanece de forma permanente en los Ahorros de HBD con bloqueo temporal. El fondo solo crece con el tiempo.
- **Demanda Mínima del DHF:** La solicitud de 1,000 HBD/día representa solo el 0.43% del presupuesto diario disponible actual del DHF.

## 4. Gestión de Riesgos y Controles de la Fase 1

### Límites Individuales y Totales

- **Límite por Prestatario Individual (5%):** Los préstamos individuales están limitados a 5,000 HBD — garantizando que un mínimo de 20 usuarios diferentes puedan acceder a la instalación y distribuyendo el riesgo entre el grupo de prestatarios.
- **Límite Conservador de Utilización (50%):** El volumen total de préstamos activos está limitado a 50,000 HBD durante la Fase 1, manteniendo en todo momento una reserva de liquidez del 50% en la bóveda.
#
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVpBhwiZoQhhd9Ds3hwWPLzB4hpvc32sePqJc9av3MRWG/Screenshot%202026-04-30%20at%206.52.18%E2%80%AFPM.png

### Condiciones de Préstamo

| Parámetro del Préstamo | Condiciones |
|---|---|

| Ratio LTV | 50% — Deposita valor de 100 HIVE, recibe el 50% en HBD |
| Comisión de Originación | Tarifa fija del 5% en HIVE — el único costo durante toda la vida del préstamo |
| Tasa de Interés | 0% — no se aplican cargos de interés continuos |
| Plazo del Préstamo | 1 año (365 días) |
| Proceso de Liquidación | Si no se paga, la garantía se vende al 10%/mes hasta recuperar el 100% — evitando desplomes del mercado |
#

- **Ingreso Principal:** Comisiones de originación del 5% pagadas en HIVE de la garantía depositada
- **Ingreso Secundario:** Recompensas de curación de Hive Power delegado (@hcb.curation)
- **Regla de Reinversión:** Todo el HBD ganado por intereses o curación vuelve al fondo de préstamos
#

## 5. Responsabilidad y el Objetivo de los 60 Días

### Compromiso de Integridad — @shortsegments

Si esta propuesta no se renueva después de 60 días, o concluye anticipadamente por cualquier motivo, **todo el capital principal no utilizado y todos los intereses ganados serán devueltos manualmente a @hive.fund**. No se retendrá ningún capital comunitario. Este compromiso quedará registrado permanentemente en la cadena como un memo en el momento de la presentación de la propuesta.

### Hoja de Ruta Multi-Firma

El éxito en la Fase 1 conduce a una propuesta de renovación en la que @hivecomunitybank transiciona a una billetera Multi-firma gobernada por partes interesadas comunitarias de confianza. Ninguna parte — incluyendo a @shortsegments — conservará el control unilateral.

### Transparencia

- Cada transacción registrada en la cadena con memos permanentes
- Informes trimestrales etiquetados con **#hcb-report** que cubren el capital desplegado, tasas de reembolso, estadísticas de incumplimiento, balance de HBD y HIVE bloqueado
- Historial de la cuenta @hivecomunitybank auditable públicamente las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana
