body.title: Pasta in Tomato Sauce with Cheese\\Pasta in Tomatensoße mit Käse
body.body: Hello,my friends!\nToday we'll cook a simple pasta dish. Pasta with onions and carrots will be cooked in tomato paste and then generously seasoned with grated cheese. There's no meat in the recipe, and it's not needed; pasta is already quite filling. I used two types of pasta because I often have very little left in a pack and need something to \

So I mixed the spirals with spelt horns. Let's  go, it's pasta time!


![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRU4UK4Tzn1DCa9GK94JUTJPYyFaqzNpZZR1fbFjbbk3H/1.jpg)


Ingredients:

● Whole wheat pasta - 400 g
● Carrots - 1 pc
● Onion - 1 pc
● Grated cheese - 100 g or more
● Tomato paste - 4 tbsp
● Water - 1.5 cups
● Apple cider vinegar 6% - 2 tbsp
● Khmeli-suneli - 1 tsp (to taste)
● Soy sauce - 3 tbsp
● Sugar - 2 tbsp
● Hot and black pepper - a pinch to taste
● Vegetable oil for frying, salt, cumin, green onions, and herbs - to taste

1.Fry the carrot and onion pieces in vegetable oil. Fry until the onions and carrots are golden. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in salted water until al dente, which usually takes about 8 minutes. Drain the boiling water and sprinkle the pasta with oil. Let the pasta sit in the pan, covered.



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcAYLk6nzgjSHKno24BFcpcvUTrTXTJWnho3isMXFoXv3/2.jpg)


2.Dilute the tomato paste with water (you can use tomato juice, in which case you don't need the water). Add a couple of tablespoons of apple sauce, a pinch of khmeli-suneli or/and cumin, 3 tablespoons of soy sauce, a couple of tablespoons of sugar, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of hot and black pepper. Stir the tomato sauce.



![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWAVqmd9zdj7ZNjst6PDW1kMguiu85HpGRqi3DRxPa7gX/3.jpg)


3.Pour the tomato sauce into the pan with the carrots and onions. Stir and cook for 5 minutes.




![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP4xxXVXX3eMq9gGoi5M42szN6q8bX7E5sqfhh1tWmhtv/4.jpg)


4.Grate the cheese.



![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX6ANcL35QSi72WeXqFDZLqxZbbNL8cBQw75GovA2bneF/5.jpg)


5.Add the pasta to the pan. Stir.



![6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXHxo18V9BbHuwPfhhGcU7zJfEPjqiZVQryyXQbVLoBKe/6.jpg)


6.Cover the pan and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, allowing the tomato sauce to melt. Sprinkle the pasta with grated cheese and serve.



![7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSNp9Rn6VNZtWjvFFrkWpzRg9gnxuu1npM7P5Mghojntm/7.jpg)


Pasta and tomato sauce are a perfect pair! Pasta has never let us down! It's delicious!




![9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNpArhuyMVtMhT4ZurmcR9zVw85qQAD18WNpbREPJit6w/9.jpg)


Shall we cook?



![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute bereiten wir ein einfaches Pastagericht zu. Nudeln mit Zwiebeln und Karotten werden in Tomatenmark gekocht und anschließend großzügig mit geriebenem Käse bestreut. Das Rezept enthält kein Fleisch, und das ist auch nicht nötig; Pasta macht schon satt. Ich habe zwei verschiedene Nudelsorten verwendet, da ich oft nur noch wenig in einer Packung habe und etwas brauche, um sie aufzufüllen. Deshalb habe ich Spiralnudeln mit Dinkelhörnchen gemischt. Los geht's, es gibt Pasta!

Zutaten:

● Vollkornnudeln – 400 g
● Karotte – 1 Stück
● Zwiebel – 1 Stück
● Geriebener Käse – 100 g oder mehr
● Tomatenmark – 4 EL
● Wasser – 1,5 Tassen
● Apfelessig (6 %) – 2 EL
● Khmeli-Suneli – 1 TL (nach Geschmack)
● Sojasauce – 3 EL
● Zucker – 2 EL
● Scharfer und schwarzer Pfeffer – eine Prise nach Geschmack
● Pflanzenöl zum Braten, Salz, Kreuzkümmel, Frühlingszwiebeln und Kräuter – nach Geschmack

1.Karotten- und Zwiebelstücke in Pflanzenöl anbraten, bis sie goldbraun sind. In der Zwischenzeit die Nudeln in Salzwasser al dente kochen (ca. 8 Minuten). Abgießen und die Nudeln mit Öl beträufeln. Die Nudeln zugedeckt in der Pfanne ziehen lassen.

2.Das Tomatenmark mit Wasser verdünnen (alternativ Tomatensaft verwenden, dann ist kein Wasser nötig). Ein paar Esslöffel Apfelmus, eine Prise Khmeli-Suneli und/oder Kreuzkümmel, 3 Esslöffel Sojasauce, ein paar Esslöffel Zucker, eine Prise Salz und je eine Prise Chili- und schwarzen Pfeffer hinzufügen. Die Tomatensauce verrühren.

3.Die Tomatensauce zu den Karotten und Zwiebeln in die Pfanne geben. Umrühren und 5 Minuten köcheln lassen.

4.Den Käse reiben.

5.Die Nudeln in die Pfanne geben und umrühren.

6.Die Pfanne abdecken und bei schwacher Hitze 10 Minuten köcheln lassen, bis die Tomatensauce geschmolzen ist. Die Nudeln mit geriebenem Käse bestreuen und servieren.

Nudeln und Tomatensauce passen perfekt zusammen! Nudeln sind einfach köstlich!

Wollen wir kochen?



![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

body.title: I did so much last month!
body.body:
Hi, guys!

I'd like to take a day off today, but it looks like I'll have to film what I've read this month anyway, so it won't happen. I have a ton of work to do, and it's just not going anywhere. Plus, I have a ton of advertising to do for the shoot, and they can't seem to send me all the briefs, so the shoot is running late this time.

But that's okay. Today I want to slowly start getting my life back on track and getting back to normal, and I also need to make the final preparations for my husband's birthday, which is tomorrow. I've prepared a ton of surprises for him, and today I need to go shopping for something sweet, so I can have a cake with a candle in it. In the morning, I'll bring him gifts, a cake with a candle, and his first fresh strawberries for breakfast.

I'm really excited because I've never taken his birthday celebration so seriously before, and right now I'm just super excited about how it's all going to go. I think everything is going to be absolutely amazing.

And the gifts I ordered for myself are supposed to arrive today, because I was absolutely amazing last month. I've done so many new things, and I've done them successfully.

I'm also starting to think about returning to teaching oriental dance. I want to go to the company where I used to teach it and offer my services. I think it will be a great addition to my life and will help me stay in shape. Of course, it's a lot of extra work, but overall, I think it's a great idea.

## Enhanced Curation Flow with Author Support Checks

When opening a post for curation, the system now performs four key checks on the author:

- Do they vote @sagarkothari88 as a witness?
- Do they follow the curation trail?
- Do they have ≥ 2,000 HP?
- Did they include promotional content in at least 10 of their last 20 posts?


If any check fails:
- A red blinking list is displayed above action buttons.
- Curators can quickly assess the author's level of support.

Author Support Check UI with Red Indicators
![Author Support Check UI with Red Indicators](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23swgSFnZEUaByef61e2R5UbbgFQM6NGdBNsqjp5iGvpWiruxPUADMYDdRnWsJXDyBK5r.png)


---

## Curator Confirmation for Weak Support
- If 2 or more checks fail:
  - Curators must enter a reason (minimum 20 characters).
  - Actions like Reply & Vote / Reply / Upvote remain locked until input is provided.


- The system does not block curation but captures intent.
- Reasons and failed checks are stored on the backend.

Reason Input Modal Before Voting
![Reason Input Modal Before Voting](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/Eo1vsBmypUVw8SoRDcSg4GVcjoSDHtCWkoKXM5joZUftydxUJPFFq6EiQZb42yiHpbK.png)

---

## New Admin Page: Unsupported Support

- Added a dedicated admin section listing:
  - Author  
  - Permlink  
  - Curator  
  - Reason provided  


- Features:
  - Sorted by newest first  
  - Infinite scroll support  


---

## Leaderboard Upgrade: Top Supporters

- Introduced a new \

widget above Top Curators.
- Eligibility:
  - Must vote @sagarkothari88 as a witness  
  - Plus at least one of:
    - Following curation trail  
    - ≥ 2,000 HP  
    - Promotional content usage  


- Sorting logic:
  - HP → Trail Weight → Promo Count  


- Toggle options:
  - Top 5 / 10 / 20 / 50  


- Example display:
  - @username is supporting with witness vote and 5,000 HP  
  - Also follows trail and includes promo content  

Top Supporters Leaderboard UI
![Top Supporters Leaderboard UI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/48Fi7uTqdt3aatqbRB9A6XeDSf4Q89QW9ucdN8z23A9CzVdsoX2AVeZUp8wRGh3gj5.png)

---

## Top Curators Selector Enhancement

- Added toggle for:
  - Top 5 / 10 / 20 / 50  


Top Curators Toggle UI

---

## Quick Access to Grow Community Support

- Drawer:
  - Blinking \

link  
  - Redirects to hive.vote subscription page  


- Dashboard:
  - New \

card  


Drawer CTA Link
![Drawer CTA Link](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23t79KuQFb7c8CQAhKGFUTRLxD9Q4arkSbjGBW1UkJ1RqCgq5QzfUqwrx1ADHhAPK8qQ8.png)

---

## Multilanguage Support

- Added support for:
  - English  
  - Spanish  
  - Hindi  


- Features:
  - Auto-detect system language  
  - Manual override in Settings  


- Note:
  - Spanish and Hindi are machine-generated  
  - Community contributions for corrections are encouraged  

Language Selection UI
![Language Selection UI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/Enyo6MnL7ydmU4z9Ex6Dbo5tHw3U4dJqaPcXTFtu3aq6SXYEUFHCd82ogg24ULEonDE.png)


---

## Content Cleanup: Liketu Trim

- Removed trailing Liketu footers from rendered post bodies.
- Cleaner reading experience for curators.

---

## Behind-the-Scenes Improvements

- Adjusted app-usage curation weight to 0.75.

- Fixed login and re-login issues.
- Resolved Docker data directory issues.
- Added pre-vote warning banner for better decision-making.

body.title: A Day in the Life of a Creative ESL Teacher
body.body:
>


![White Scrapbook Happy Birthday Photo Collage Landscape.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/48RPz9u8uCFV3FURQK4dNBPEDSzbfczMkBi8VJMf7HP51Cyo4ozarGMusr4qaPt1b5.png)

Hello, everyone.

Let me begin with a question: How far are you willing to lower yourself—set aside pride, step out of your comfort zone—just to connect with and engage your students?

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23u64kS56iJ1omkE9eQWg52n86QpPNjkgCbY8Qog3CdGLAVKoAS8dQWwfv41XaNjUfigm.png For those of you who are teachers, I believe this question resonates deeply. I can relate to it as well. Having grown up with a mother who is a teacher, I never imagined that I would gradually find myself walking a similar path, teaching a foreign language. Teaching, as many of you know, is far from easy, even in a work-from-home setup. It requires constant adjustment, patience, and understanding, especially when working with students from diverse backgrounds. Over time, I have encountered many lively and cheerful learners, and in response, I have learned to adapt and sometimes even becoming a performer of sorts just to keep them engaged. It may sound amusing, but it is part of what makes teaching both challenging and fulfilling. Of course, discipline plays a crucial role. Like any profession, success in teaching demands consistency and effort. Yet, when there is genuine passion and willingness, the challenges become lighter and the journey more meaningful. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rufajane/23wCWzqJYjYDRJotD1FqVkeH4Yf9YTpuQDPtk2GcgbxKuCrwudR8f33j8dz3g2YB3EewX.png) Personally, I faced several difficulties when I first entered this field. I was accustomed to using complex vocabulary and technical expressions. However, teaching foreign students required me to simplify my language and to communicate clearly and effectively without losing meaning. This adjustment was not easy, but it taught me an essential lesson: true communication is not about sounding sophisticated, but about being understood. What made the experience even more demanding was my situation at the time. I was only 17 years old, a Grade 11 STEM student, trying to balance academic responsibilities with professional work. Time management became a necessity rather than a choice. I understand that it may seem unusual for someone my age to take on such a role, but during the interview, my communication skills were assessed positively, and I was given the opportunity. For that, I remain deeply grateful. I truly believe that it was a blessing from God.

body.title: Do Not Feel Comfortable With The Average
body.body:
>

I remember when I was doing my internship some years back. One of my colleagues then said that he was not really interested in the internship but was just doing it because it was necessary. At the end of every week, we normally had a test, so he just prepared enough to pass the test to feel comfortable. He did not put in extra effort, he did not push himself to improve; just average. Over time, his results remained average, but he was not really bothered until the end of the internship programme. By the end, the management said that they will reward the top interns with a lot of things, including opportunities, but he missed out of them, because he just settled for the average. Average is an enemy of success, and you should not settle for it.

<center>![pexels-ds-stories-6005026.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmaGMKWe3sMKvAexcQRYCcTdJg6jvx3yLXZC9PWiqNA8MT/pexels-ds-stories-6005026.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-phrase-and-a-measuring-tape-on-a-purple-background-6005026)</sub></center>

There is nothing as limiting as becoming comfortable with the average. It may feel harmless at the beginning, and it may even make you feel safe. This is because it makes you to avoid pressure, it reduces your expectations, and makes you to settle for the routines that require just minimal efforts. But what you also need to understand is that this comfort can become a trap in the long run. It can also quietly hold you back from reaching your full potentials. It makes you not to take risks, and without taking risks, you may not achieve your desired success and goals.

It is not actually bad to be average, but what is bad is accepting the average as your permanent standard. If you become comfortable with average, you will stop pushing yourself forward. It will also mean that you will stop improving, stop growing, and stop learning. It will also make you to do just enough, without taking any step at improvement. It is this mindset that slowly reduces someone's ambition and weakens their drive. You have to understand that it is not settling for the average that makes you outstanding, but by putting in the extra efforts to create extraordinary results.

It is worthy to note that growth will require discomfort at some points. Every new level that you want to attain will demand discipline, efforts, sacrifices, and the willingness to stretch yourself beyond where you are and beyond your current abilities. But if you choose comfort over growth, then you will cut yourself off from the challenges and the opportunities that should have triggered growth. You may feel relaxed at the initial, but what you may not realise is that you are standing still when you should be making progress. Do not settle and feel too comfortable in the place you currently are when you can move forward.

Settling for average also makes someone to lose opportunities and potentials. Everyone has the ability and the potential to achieve more than they currently are. But the potential will become a reality only when it is developed. If you have never challenged yourself, how will you know what you are capable of? Imagine living your life without knowing what you are capable of, and without realising your full potentials. In order to attain your full potentials, you should not settle for the average; always push yourself forward and upwards.

<center>![pexels-mikhail-nilov-9304682.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTGPSMQnx2zWAC8kgp2hyTVmAFMbNyCFCQkyKNcFjuYzx/pexels-mikhail-nilov-9304682.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/accomplished-business-woman-in-beige-blazer-9304682)</sub></center>

Being too comfortable with the average affects your mindset in ways you may never even expect. It makes you to just do the bare minimum. Over time, this will become the standard in everything you do; in your work, in tasks, in your personal life, in your personal goals, and even in your relationship. It will make you to stop aiming high because you are used to doing what is \

You have to remove this kind of mentality, so that it will not limit your opportunities, and so that it will not reduce the quality of your result. Always try to strive for excellence in all you do. Understand that striving for excellence does not mean that you are perfect, rather it means that you are intentional about your growth. That is, you are constantly and consistently asking yourself how you would get better, and how to move ahead from where you are, instead of settling for what you think is enough at the moment. Excellence is built through small, consistent improvements, not sudden perfection. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: Happy Labor Day
body.body: > It doesn't have to be a day like today to recognize something we sometimes take for granted: the work that sustains our lives and the lives of others. It doesn't matter if it's visible or silent, if it happens in an office, at home, on the street, or behind a screen… there is effort, discipline, and often sacrifice. I know that not every day is easy, that there is tiredness, doubt, and moments when we want to give up, but we still keep going. And that says a lot about us. To all the hard-working people in this community, I want to say that what you do matters. Every small step forward, every goal achieved, every failed attempt that becomes a learning experience… it all adds up. Sometimes we don't see immediate results, but the commitment we put in every day builds something bigger than we imagine. Today is not just a day to celebrate work, but also perseverance, resilience, and the courage to keep going even when it's difficult.

> No es necesario que sea un día como hoy solo para reconocer algo que a veces damos por hecho: el trabajo que sostiene nuestras vidas y las de los demás. No importa si es visible o silencioso, si ocurre en una oficina, en casa, en la calle o detrás de una pantalla… hay esfuerzo, disciplina y muchas veces sacrificio. Sé que no todos los días son fáciles, que hay cansancio, dudas y momentos en los que uno quisiera rendirse, pero aún así seguimos. Y eso ya dice mucho de nosotros. A toda la gente trabajadora de esta comunidad, quiero decirles que lo que hacen importa. Cada pequeño avance, cada meta cumplida, cada intento fallido que se vuelve aprendizaje… todo suma. A veces no vemos resultados inmediatos, pero el compromiso que ponemos día a día construye algo más grande de lo que imaginamos. Hoy no es solo un día para celebrar el trabajo, sino también la constancia, la resiliencia y el valor de seguir adelante incluso cuando cuesta.

body.title: How to Find Low-Cost Balcony Repair Without Cutting on Quality
body.body:
Balcony repairs are an important element to maintain both the security and value of the home. In time exposure to moisture, weather and structural stress may result in cracks and corrosion as well as weakening of the balcony's components. [Affordable balcony repair services](https://unitedtradelinks.com.au/terrace-balcony-sealing/) are becoming increasingly sought-after as homeowners search for efficient ways to deal with the issues without sacrificing the durability or security. Finding cost-effective and affordable repair solutions will help homeowners and building managers make educated choices.

 

One of the initial steps in determining the most cost-effective way to repair your balcony is to identify the source of the damage. The most frequent causes are concrete spalling as well as rusting reinforcement bars water seepage and tile degradation. According to data from structural engineering water infiltration is the reason for more than 70% of balcony-related damage particularly for strengthened concrete constructions. If moisture gets into the structure and the steel reinforcements are affected, they begin to corrode, which leads to expanding and eventually cracking the concrete. The early detection of problems can cut down repair costs by a significant amount, since small fixes are much less costly than complete structural reconstruction.

 

The choice of materials plays an important aspect in balancing the cost and quality. Modern repair techniques typically employ the polymer modified mortars and epoxy injectors and waterproof membranes that provide long-term durability at comparatively affordable cost. For instance, polymer-modified repairs mortars can improve bonding strength by around 40% when compared to conventional cement mixes, which reduces the possibility of repeated damage. Selecting the best materials will ensure repair time is longer and are less expensive, thus reducing the need for maintenance, ultimately reducing costs.

 

Costs for labor are a major element in the repair of a balcony. A skilled labor force is crucial to the proper use of repair materials and the adherence to safety guidelines. But, being affordable does not necessarily mean that you should hire the most affordable contractor. Instead, it is about the evaluation of experience, qualifications and the quality of work done in the past. Technicians who have been trained in techniques for structural repair will be more likely identify issues with precision and develop efficient solutions. This lowers the chance of mistakes that could cause additional expenses later.

 

The timing of repairs also affects repairs cost. Planning repairs for off-peak periods will result in lower labor costs and a greater availability of skilled experts. In several regions the demand for construction fluctuates throughout the year. Contractors might offer lower prices in slower times. Also, fixing minor issues quickly can prevent them from growing into structural issues that can become expensive to repair.

 

Another consideration is the conformity with building and safety standards as well as codes. Balconies are structural structures that support loads and any work to repair them should meet the specific requirements of engineering. For instance, building codes typically require balconies to bear an average live load of 3 - 5kN/m2 based on the local laws. The need to ensure that repairs comply with these requirements is essential to ensure safety and legal conformity. The most reliable service providers will conduct load tests and structural assessments prior to beginning any work to repair.

 

Within the process of making decisions the majority of property owners start looking at [affordable balcony repair services](https://unitedtradelinks.com.au/terrace-balcony-sealing/) to determine the most effective combination of price and performance. This requires requesting specific estimates, analyzing what the work will entail and comparing specifications for materials. Clear pricing and transparent communication are a sign of a reliable service supplier. It is also beneficial to look over previous projects or ask for references to evaluate the high-quality of the work.

 

Technology advancements have made repairs to the balcony more cost-effective and efficient. Non-destructive methods of testing like Ultrasonic pulse velocity testing, as well as rebound hammer tests enable engineers to examine how concrete is performing without causing any damage. These tests provide precise data about structural integrity, allowing specific repairs instead of unnecessary replacements. In the end, homeowners will save time and money while still ensuring top-quality results.

 

The practice of preventive maintenance is another option that can help save money. Regular inspections, well-designed drainage systems and timely sealing of cracks can increase the life span of a balcony considerably. Studies show that regular maintenance can cut down on long-term repair expenses by 30 percent. Simple steps like applying waterproof coatings, or ensuring the proper slope for drainage can help prevent structural problems from arising.

 

Environmental factors should be considered when making repairs. In areas of excessive humidity or excessive rainfall, balconies can be more susceptible to damage caused by water. Utilizing weather-resistant materials and coatings can improve durability and help reduce maintenance. Similar to coastal regions salt exposure could accelerate corrosion, which is why it necessary to employ corrosion-resistant sealants and reinforcements.

 

While cost is a significant factor, the quality of work should never be sacrificed. Quality repairs can appear inexpensive initially, but they often result in frequent problems and increased costs in the end. By investing in quality materials and skilled work will ensure that repairs are efficient and durable. A balancing approach that takes into account quality and cost is crucial to get the best outcomes.

 

In the end finding cost-effective and reliable solutions for repair of your balcony involves careful analysis of the material work, time, along with technical requirements. By understanding the root reasons for damage, using the latest repair technology and prioritizing preventative maintenance, property owners will obtain lasting results with no overspending. Expert advice from reputable providers like [United Trade Links](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GPqvC11FXs3dEogx8), can simplify the process, and provide the highest quality results. In the end, selecting low-cost repairs to your balcony that will ensure the structural integrity and safety of your property is the most effective option to safeguard both your investment and your home.

body.title: What Cannot Be Taken from Myself
body.body:
![1000138630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/EoeENaVZq6BYhXsnofeiYfYTvbcgm3moq4a3vSHhFQYecJZKQvuyyaGbtiqvQmGxNE7.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)









<center>I wake carrying fragments that fade in the moment, I move too quickly and begin performing the day again,
I wake carrying scenes that feel truer than some memories, though they arrive dressed in maybe impossible images,
I wake carrying emotions with no clear owner, yet they cling to me like blankets when asleep,
I wake carrying too much, do I honor what visited me or dismiss it instantly because it speaks strangely,
I wake carrying then lose half of it whenever I rush into my thoughts…





<center>I remember differently, and still the softened version reveals needs the facts themselves once failed to show me what’s underneath,
I remember differently, because the heart retells events according to what is remained unfinished inside every memory of the past,
I remember differently, yet even distortion can contain a signal if I meet it without gratitude,
I remember differently, am I defending accuracy because tenderness would ask more of me,
I remember differently, and notice wisdom gathering where precision once fell away…







<center>I ask quietly, through symbols chance seems to scatter though something in me recognizes the answer instantly,
I ask quietly, when logic has become a closed room where the same furniture keeps changing places but nothing changes,
I ask quietly, because surrender sometimes reaches places and even effort cannot force open by strength alone,
I ask quietly, am I rejecting help because it cannot be controlled, and choosing struggle simply because it feels more familiar,
I ask quietly, and feel the smaller room beyond the larger one where possibility has been waiting in silence…





<center>I choose now, the inner riches that remain after praise fades and possessions reveal their temporary language,
I choose now, the steadier strengths no one can hand me and no institution can guarantee,
I choose now, what builds my character even when it asks me for patience before any reward appears,
I choose now, can I stay loyal to this path when louder roads keep promising quicker rewards,
I choose now, and become less available to anything that would pull me away from myself, because once I know my value, cheap offers lose their power…





<center>Watchwords:
Lose half of it rushing
Meaning hiding inside blur
Larger room behind smaller
Temporary language of possession
Harder to buy away










![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>



![tikatarot sign.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/cUPh7Abd-tikatarot20sign.png)

body.title: : DOROFEEVA та гопак
body.body: Українська мегапопулярна поп-зірка DOROFEEVA переосмислила гопак і запросила хореографа, яка працювала з Lady Gaga, для створення нового кліпу. Як говорить сама Надя, вона свідомо обрала мову міжнародної поп-музики, щоб показати світу Україну.\nDOROFEEVA - людина зі своєю позицією, яка давно вийшла за межі просто \
. Кожен реліз співачки це підтверджує. Але новий трек \

— це щось інше. Це заява про те, що українська поп-культура готова розмовляти зі світом на рівних, на мові українськості, притому що виконується пісня англійською.
Ідея вставити мелодію гопаку в поп-трек прийшла просто під час роботи в студії. DOROFEEVA пригадала і наспівала мелодію, яку пам'ятала з дитинства.  Міша Кацурін одразу ж підхопив тему і перетворив це на звук — і обоє зрозуміли, що знайшли саме те, що шукали. Тоді музиканти переглянули архівні відео легендарного ансамблю Вірського — і зрозуміла, що без них кліп буде неповним.
Хореографію для кліпу створила Марина Кущова. Ця мисткиня має потужне резюме: в своїй кар'єрі вона співпрацювала з Rosalia, Lenny Kravitz, Sevdaliza, Florence and the Machine і Lady Gaga. І для нового треку Наді Дорофеєвої це не просто ім'я для преслисту, а свідчення того, на якому рівні артистка будує свій міжнародний проєкт.

Those April showers give way to May flowers and construction! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777612222.204076) So many places around this small town are lined with cones, signs, equipment and plenty of guys leaning on shovels. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777612316.834426) You would think the work would have started a bit earlier so it was a distant memory by the time visitors started to arrive to visit the theatre. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777612461.463224) I must admit I would rather be working in the moderate spring temps compared to winter or blazing summer. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777612508.021754) Still, having a Main Street blocked right off right around the entrance to the downtown theatre which is welcome out of town visitors to previews and debut performances doesn’t seem optimal. They do seem to be working quickly though. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777612630.330811) The good news is some of the work is also going into building the expanded patios in front of a dozen restaurants. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777612706.67939) Back to the regular Thursday adventure. A little cloudy to start the day and a high of only 9 Celsius (less than 50 freedom units) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777612844.600591) News delivery was interrupted by a coffee networking meeting with a bunch of other downtown business owners. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777612908.830944) I made a check on Mater and he seems much happier in his green field than he did wrapped in snow. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777613019.315464) The early blooms are poking out to celebrate the spring. Tulips and daffodils among the nice big ones. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777613147.868626) From the steps of city hall looking north, the sky looks warmer than it did a month ago and the flowers are starting to pop in the beds. Streets are just a little busier but nothing like they will be in another month or 2. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/74D50CD4-9F8A-4430-B7A4-4FA6EDD9FD901777613261.187911) All in all, a nice spring day to spend out doors stepping over 10k brisk steps toward summer and slowly toward the top 200 @actifit users of all time! Thanks for stepping with me.

body.title: A Safe Space for the Imperfect: What I Learned About Soul Care
body.body:
This is my reading response about the topic of  ***Counseling and the Sinfulness of Humanity***. Mr. Raymond and Ms. Jen tackle this topic for us to discuss in the counselling class. This discussion made me realize that every person carries struggles, weaknesses, and imperfections. As a person, we are not perfect. We make mistakes, hurt others, disappoint ourselves, and sometimes we can choose wrong actions or decisions even when we know what is right. Why is that? Because this is part of the reality of life. In this context, counseling becomes very important because it helps people face their problems, heal even their emotional struggles, and find their direction again.

<center>![SafeSpace.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lengaj-6/23zbTytFKjXHgGbTz3cgw98b9b8KnK9ZeSmtc2dW7bvckBiQpWHbptbrah171Dbrup4Yx.png)</center>

<center>[Source](https://gemini.google.com/app/b31ac76aa4d01000)</center>

As a student, I can also relate to this topic. There have been times when I feel overwhelmed, insecure, or feel guilty about the things I have done or failed to do. But sometimes I can compare myself to others, become jealous, lose motivation, or make a decision later that I regret. This reminds me that sinfulness is not only about big wrongdoings, but it is also about our everyday attitudes, such as pride, anger, selfishness, and dishonesty. What touched me the most was the idea that counseling is not about judging people for their mistakes, but also about helping them to understand themselves and guiding them toward change. Many students silently carry their stress, family problems, pressure in school, or emotional pain, especially me right now. I can feel that way, but I can be silent to finish and to accept that issue. Sometimes, people only need someone who will listen without condemning them. And I think counseling gives that safe space for me.

This reading response also reminds me that no one should experience shame in asking for help. We often pretend to be okay because we do not want others to think that we are weak. But in reality, we need to seek guidance to show courage and maturity. And everyone needs support at some point in their life. As a future professional teacher someday and as a person, I learned a lot that I should be more understanding of others because everyone is fighting their silent battles, even if I may not see them. Instead of quickly judging their mistakes, I should show empathy and patience. At the same time, I must also be honest with my own flaws and continue to improve myself.

Analyn Capuli 
3rd year BSCED-VE 
Intro. To Guidance Counseling 
Reading Response 1

body.title: Dodgers vs Marlins proves that money doesn't necessarily guarantee victory
body.body:
I dug into the salaries or payroll of MLB teams in the recent past and was stunned to find out the absolutely massive payrolls that some teams have and how some other teams spend just a fraction of what other teams do.  As you would expect, the teams with the massive expenditures on their players tend to be the better teams, this is basically guaranteed.  But what you don't expect to see is the sort of thing that we witnessed earlier this week where the LA Dodgers lost 2 out of 3 games vs a team that has such a small payroll that one would presume that these games would simply be a total blowout.

<center> https://a.espncdn.com/media/motion/wsc/2026/0429/ad05caa2-2ff4-46f2-aafb-74216fa7164f/ad05caa2-2ff4-46f2-aafb-74216fa7164f.jpg
[src](https://www.docsports.com/images/lib/orig/xmlb-picks-xavier-edwards-miami-marlins-predictions-best-bet-odds-7.jpeg.pagespeed.ic.0tP7SJ4Jz7.jpg)</center>

There's a lot of people that will say excuses such as \

but let's be real here guys:  The difference in payroll between these two teams in particular are absolutely absurd.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/23tmcqeG8JVDvEt8ZAmD2AUo7QMHqBXGKYYvyoGyZgAeZPafJDh7PirWEEQQCGaeSrULu.png)
[src](https://www.reddit.com/r/baseball/comments/1qe5ebn/per_fangraphs_the_payroll_of_every_team_in_the/#lightbox)</center> 

I definitely don’t expect anyone to read all of that but just pay attention to the top and the bottom entries.  LA is the most expensive team in MLB and Miami is the cheapest.  Things get even more scary for the Dodgers when we dig further and see how they have deferred some of their salaries for future years in order to dodge as much of the luxury tax as possible.   They are referred to as a number of things including “commitments” and the Dodgers have around $300 million over the next three years and a lot of this is just estimated and can of course grow larger over time.   For the next three years Miami has $5 million deferred until next year and then ZERO for the next two years after that.  

I dug into the numbers even more and discovered that Shohei Ohtani, a single player for the Dodgers, gets paid roughly $127 million for just this season and this is nearly double the salary of the ENTIRE Miami Marlins roster.   

So when people start making all the excuses about how LA isn't trying as hard and they can or Miami is giving it their all I have to call BS on that.   If you are spending 6 times the amount of money as the team you are playing against, you really shouldn't *have to try* all that hard in order to defeat them.   The fact that Miami didn't get absolutely trounced in every single one of these games says a lot about how baseball, unlike a lot of other team sports, can't really be bought completely.  

I don't generally watch entire baseball games but I did for a couple of these and I was just kind of awestruck about how the David vs Goliath situation was playing out with Miami winning twice and even when they lost the first one I was thinking \

I would imagine that this gave Miami a much needed boost to their fans and players because you just defeated the most expensive team in baseball and one of the most expensive teams in any sport, with 1/6 of  their budget.  

Miami has no hopes of winning the league and would probably be pleased as punch to make the playoffs, which for them is probably pretty unlikely especially if they have any injuries in the season.  They do not have the talent depth that LA does (obviously) and if a couple key players throw their arms out, they have no backups.  

<center> https://mapi.associatedpress.com/v2/items/3324a6326f344bf486746161d8a0942b.0/preview/preview.jpg?nfe=true&s=512&wm=false&app=MPK&tag=iid~3324a6326f344bf486746161d8a0942b!rsn~0!cid~53918a0ac0e848729eb1b61ddaa9bc1f!orgId~46611!qt~e4NiqA1iqWeI!orgNm~Daily%20Independent%20News%20-%20Sun%20(API%20Production%20Key)!role~Preview!mt~photo!fmt~JPEG%20Baseline
[src](https://mapi.associatedpress.com/v2/items/3324a6326f344bf486746161d8a0942b.0/preview/preview.jpg?nfe=true&s=512&wm=false&app=MPK&tag=iid~3324a6326f344bf486746161d8a0942b!rsn~0!cid~53918a0ac0e848729eb1b61ddaa9bc1f!orgId~46611!qt~e4NiqA1iqWeI!orgNm~Daily%20Independent%20News%20-%20Sun%20(API%20Production%20Key)!role~Preview!mt~photo!fmt~JPEG%20Baseline)</center>

There are certain rather whack things in baseball that will draw my attention and one of them is the above guy whose name is Jansen Junk.  Tell me you are not going to follow someone with such an awesome name.   My buddy was telling me that \

But now I am following this guy.  Jansen Junk gets paid 1.25 million dollars in his current contract, which is 1/100 of what Ohtani gets paid.  One of these two players got a win this week though and it wasn't the guy getting paid 100x the salary!  

LA is probably going to go far in the playoffs, which are still a long ways away from now.  We have about 100 games to go until then.   I will be watching Miami though out of the corner of my eye because it would be truly amazing if a team with the lowest salaries in the entire MLB were to do the impossible.

body.title: GIVE LOVE 💕 A SIT AFTER BECOMING
body.body:
Happy New month to you all my lovelies...one love 💕 keep us together. Let love leads on.

Love is not meant to feel like a negotiation where you keep offering pieces of yourself just to remain chosen.

![IMG_20260427_161538_164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23wMgpYa4L7Wq2eWzrnr72cRWHw5G2Q1AtayyLZaocsbaGC7P3GL8t9HpH3dthuvCPmkA.jpg)


This is something life keeps revealing in quiet, uncomfortable ways. We see it in relationships that look fine on the surface but are held together by silent compromise.

We notice it in women who start out confident and whole, but slowly begin to shrink, adjusting, bending and overextending until they no longer recognize who they used to be.

It often doesn’t happen all at once. It begins subtly.
A little more effort here.
A little more tolerance there.

A willingness to ignore what doesn’t sit right, just to keep things from falling apart all because the heart wants something real and lasting, but here is what many people learn too late:

![IMG_20260426_152319_115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/243zkFqvYyaRFre3nAP6rc3CeTtkx5hTEsbn6L5NmttBCTkg7TPwxc82vAygD91xf5nVi.jpg)


If keeping someone requires you to keep abandoning yourself, then what you have is not love but maintenance because anything built on pressure will always demand performance and the moment your peace starts slipping, your values start shaking, or your identity begins to blur, that connection is already asking for more than it deserves.

To the woman doing life on her own, and to the one holding onto faith for a partner.

Your desire is not misplaced, wanting love, support, and companionship is human. It is natural to want someone to share your life with, to build with, to rest with but desperation should never be the foundation.

You are not here to audition for love.You are not here to outdo others just to be noticed.
You are not here to drain yourself emotionally or physically just to secure someone’s presence.

The kind of love that is right will not demand constant proof of your worth and if your faith means anything to you, then you already know this, what is truly aligned with God will never require you to compromise His standards just to obtain it.

Akwa remember that there is a difference between effort and struggle and what is right may require patience, but it will not rob you of your dignity. It will not leave you confused or constantly anxious. It will not feel like you are losing yourself in the process.

So instead of pouring all your energy into being chosen, redirect it.Pour into your own life.
Strengthen your mind.
Work on your healing.

Build something meaningful for yourself.
Surround yourself with spaces that reflect the kind of life you want.
Grow spiritually, not just emotionally.

Let your life stand full, not half-waiting because when you become grounded and complete within yourself, your choices change. You no longer entertain what is draining or unclear. You begin to recognize what is steady, intentional, and genuine.

And let this be clear;
Your past does not cancel or determine your future and raising a child alone does not reduce your value.
Your life is still unfolding, there is still room for joy, for partnership and for something real.

Maybe the answer is not in trying harder, but in moving differently.
Not chasing. Not forcing. Not proving but becoming.

Trusting that when things align the right way, you won’t have to struggle to hold onto it and most importantly, you won’t have to trade pieces of yourself just to experience love.

You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@johnpetra/give-love-a-sit-after-becoming--2yn)

body.title: La mugre y su globo / The Dirt and His Balloon
body.body:
<center>

Una maraña de mugre marrón
que va en un globo de amarillo color,
cae sin premeditación
y por suerte no se lastimó.

Deja el globo a un lado
y se va arrastrando,
quiere pasear un rato
y conocer la ciudad donde ha llegado.

>A tangle of brown grime
floating in a yellow balloon,
falls without warning
and, luckily, isn’t hurt.

>It sets the balloon aside
and crawls away,
wanting to wander for a while
and get to know the city it has arrived in.

![37942.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23wgec6mEg3ReKZFL283RiSBnBgqUEjBmjdhTnynyybz6zkcwFbpve1gJnfupcox8Z1Qn.gif)

Por el lugar pasa una gota de agua
y encuentra el globo, que solo estaba,
lo revisa para ver qué pasa,
quiere arreglar su estructura dañada.

Comienza a soplar y soplar
para el globo inflar
y de repente, comienza a volar
y el agua al cielo se va. 

>A drop of water passes by
and finds the balloon, all alone,
it takes a look to see what’s going on,
it wants to fix its damaged structure.

>It starts blowing and blowing
to inflate the balloon,
and suddenly, it begins to fly,
and the water goes up into the sky.

![37943.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xexojtAtoVLKuMc1wh5hHQmMG7gtf6kN7XgnNDvBzqhWVJMAxUb7dWsNy8c6xMYQA8P.gif)

Tras un rato la mugre regresa,
ya recorrió la ciudad con cautela,
pero, el globo no encuentra
y se asusta, no lo ve cerca. 

La mugre trepa una pared con afanes,
para ver si el globo lo tiene el aire
pero, la pared encima le cae
y queda atrapada, no puede liberarse. 

>After a while, the dirt returns,
having already cautiously explored the city,
but it can’t find the balloon
and gets scared—it doesn’t see it nearby.

>The dirt climbs a wall eagerly,
to see if the balloon is floating in the air,
but the wall collapses on top of it
and it gets trapped, unable to free itself.

![37944.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23wXDwARN52hHMHFKwAwLACTcV99uWtycufDXseKYTZ9hPsRGCRvogBJTopyJwWhKfSCL.gif)

Y cuando pensó que de ahí no saldría 
algo levantó la pared que tenía encima,
era el globo, a su rescate venía 
y la dejó libre y tranquila. 

La mugre el lazo del globo tomó 
y los dos se marcharon sin rencor,
son amigos y se apoyan en toda ocasión 
aunque a veces se alejen por alguna situación.

>And just when she thought she’d never get out of there,
something lifted the wall that was pressing down on her,
it was the balloon, coming to her rescue,
and it set her free, leaving her calm and at ease.

>The balloon grabbed the rope,
and the two of them walked away without a trace of resentment;
they’re friends and support each other through thick and thin,
even though sometimes they drift apart because of certain situations.


![37945.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23wMsamFZhoSuTeJmmabvcSKyPwG2fthfgB3d7AvX7pJZJNpT3bxhJyC4xyrqv21c1aRr.gif)






</center>

Nachtrag 07:07 01.05.2026 

Ja die Demutskrankheit ist kein Witz, aber auch keine Katastrophe, sobald man sich ihrer Bewusst wird. 

Die besonders intensive Zeit ist um, das waren Monate insgesammt, ohne das ich genau wusste, was los war. Wochen, als ich es wusste, und nur wenige Tage, in diesem Zustand da Oben, Nuechtern 24/7 in dem Zustand nur mit mir selber Beschaeftigt, also so Richtig.

Massagen. Bewegung und entsprechendes mitarbeiten am Prozess den ich da im Kopf beschrieben habe, waren der Tag.

Zum Glueck sind die so vorbei, weil ja sehr Zeitintensiv, war das wohl eine Art natuerliche Reaktion, deren ich mich schlicht hingegeben habe.

Also nix Besonderes, kann das wohl jeder Mensch.

Dabei habe ich einen Arsch voll Informationen gefarmt und ja auch versucht zu teilen. 

Die Verschluesselungsmechanismen zum Beispiel gegen die Ausenwelt vom Fasziennetz.^^ Die liegen oben beim Ohr an die Nase vor. :-)

Oder, das man sich mit seinen Beinen sehr Gut an den Beinen masieren kann, die sind wie gemacht dafuer, einfach mal ausprobieren, das geht wie von selbst, wenn man das Begriffen hat.

An sich am besten. :-)

Ich mache natuerlich einfach weiter, was ich da die Tage auch Gepredigt habe. Die Schmerzen, sind Weg.

Also jetzt habe ich keine Tiefen Zahn und Kieferschmerzen mehr und die Schwellungen gehen langsam zurueck, auch die großen Beulen. :-)

Aber die werden genauso Jahre dauern, wie sie viele gebraucht haben zu entstehen.

Das man hinten am Kopf mit seinen Haenden den Kopf a auch sehr geil natuerlich massieren kann, wenn man sich mal durchprobiert, und eben dort merkt, wo vorne im Kiefer die Probleme spiegelverkehrt liegen, indem man die Beulen, welche einen in die Demutshaltung zwingen soll untersucht.

Das ist also alles bisher auch so richtig geblieben wie ich das hier selber im zweifel auskorriegiert und verbessert habe zu der zeit.

Was noch? 

Ja der ganze Koerper ist davon betroffen, so wird sich das dann auch Verhalten, man lernt dann, warum man in entsprechender haltung war.


Zum Beispiel, beil laufen wenn die Beine und Knie kaputt sind. 

Aber das richtet sich dann neu aus, wenn man drin bleibt in der gesunden Haltung.

Die Zehen nicht vergessen, muessen gut durchblutet sein gelle. Masiert wenigstens dann die.

Ich denke auch das die großen anderen Sachen bei mir irgendwie wie gestoppt sind, aber das bleibt abzuwarten.

Mein Bauch, war unerwartet auch hart das Problem, da musste sich auch viel Neuausrichten.

Und richtet sich noch aus. Das ich meine Haltung beim Schlaf auch so beibehalte, ist klaro.

Ich steht schlimmer auf als ein Urwerk wieder. Was auch ein gutes Zeichen ist und allgemein hab ich mehr Energie. Aber ich merk auch wann Schluss mit Lustig ist Gleichzeitig schneller.

Soweit so Gut, Demutskrankheit wird von mir ueber die Jahre schoen aufgearbeitet niedergeschrieben und serviert. 


Salve

Alucian

body.title: The Map III - A DragonQuest ttrpg adventure
body.body: /> (... or **The Curse, Part 2**) **Introduction** \[Read aloud\] _On your quest to find word of Bran, for Jeppie, your new benefactor, you have encountered two Elves. Elowen and Eiran, Elves of the Forest of Karshabak (as Humans, Dwarves and Hobbits know it, but is Daesheare to the Elves)._ _Elowen and Eirian have been observing a group of Orcs and Ogres and are of the opinion that they are taking prisoners to a nearby mountain, at the base of which are two lakes. Indeed, they are convinced that they have taken a number of their Elven brethren there, but need to confirm this before retreating back to their forest to gather larger numbers so as to launch a rescue._ Elowen and Eirian believe there is a strong likelihood that Bran has fallen victim to the same Orcs as their fellows. Elowen shares that the mountain rises to the west of the East Fort to South Summit road. This seems to be the same location as Fane's Mountain, noted in the parchment carried by Nabbi.

/> Half way up Fane’s Mountain, as depicted in the above image, is a secret entrance to a long-forgotten Dwarven mine, and hidden within that is Fane’s Stronghold. Some way down the mountain from the mine entrance is a series of caverns in which a clan of orcs and their ogre slaves have taken up residence. The Orcs use the caverns as a base for their mining operations further down the mountain on its southern side. The orcs regularly supplement their ogre slave workers with any humanoids they can capture travelling the inland road between Eastrock and Landfall. **Encounter 1 - Prisoner’s March** Travelling west, having left the East Fort - South Summit Road, the party is still some distance from Fane’s Mountain, when fresh tracks are discovered which a successful Ranger roll will identify as a mixture of Orc, Ogre, Human and Dwarf. The human and dwarven tracks are single file, suggesting chained prisoners marching under guard. **The approach to Fane's Mountain -** **see also The Map I** **The Orc Stronghold** **Approaching the stronghold by following the Dwarven trail**

/> As the Party proceeds, the Dwarven path is crossed by a trail heading to the eastern side of Khaz Dorum. This path is regularly used, with fresh prints in the mud, and is not at all disguised. A Ranger (of any speciality) will instantly make out the tracks of many humanoids, perhaps of different races. If a ranger successfully rolls against their tracking skill they will feel confident that there are human, dwarf, orc and ogre tracks present. There is also evidence of large wolves and of chains having smoothed portions of the trail. The leaders of the Orcs are Gharsh and his sister Shargh (see notes). **Approaching the Caverns by following the Orc trail** \[**Roll perception**: 3x or less the characters will see 3 Orcs around a fire and 1 Dire Wolf in the cavern. On a roll of 2x perception or less the character(s) will see the Dire Wolf is closely guarding 2 Elves manacled to the Far Eastern side of the cavern wall.\] _One - The Cavern Entrance_ The cavern entrance is some 20’ wide, looking north from the mountain. It is about 200’ up the mountain’s side, although the path never has more than a 20 degree radiant. The cavern is a natural cable structure and only small changes have been made over the years (some smoothing of walls, floors etc). Roughly cut fire wood has been dragged to the eastern end of the space. Bones litter the area around the fire, including what look like humanoid leg and arm bones. They look well chewed, but whether by Wolf, Orc or Ogre it is impossible to tell. The Orcs and Dire Wolf will engage in (or move to evade in) battle as soon as they see, smell or hear the Party. Any battle at the cavern entrance will draw in all Orcs, unchained Ogres and Dire Wolves to the melee. Turn 1 - * 3 Orcs * 1 Dire Wolf Turn 3 * 1 Dire Wolf Turn 4 * 2 Ogres * 2 Orcs (Gharsh and his sister Shargh) Turn 6 * 3 Orcs At the time of the attack there are a total of 8 Orcs, 2 unchained Ogres and 2 Dire Wolves in the cavern. There is a 5% chance further reinforcements may arrive from outside (3 Orcs and 1 Ogre) during the melee (turn 6) with d-6 prisoners in tow. _Two - Orc quarters_ **General note**: The caverns seem well ‘lived in’ , with various nooks and crannies being used for storage, areas for relaxation, natural guard posts etc. This large space (70’x90’ at its largest) is where all but Gharsh and Shargh have their cots. The space is filled with filthy rags, clothes and cushions, as well as broken and/well worn armour, weapons and shields. A close inspection will reveal nothing of real value. _Two A - Orc quarters_ This is where Gharsh and Shargh have their bunks. Fine blankets and cushions, no doubt stolen from carriages, litter the space. In the eastern end of the space a rusty but sturdy looking chain is fixed to a spike driven into the rock wall. The chain is tied at the other end to an eagle’s left claw. The eagle is obviously distressed and injured, its feathers missing in places and skin rubbed raw. On the cavern floor below the spike is a fine looking wooden chest. It contains: * silk material \[worth 160 SP\] * A jade inlaid silver necklace \[120 SP\] * A set of silver drink coasters \[80 SP\] * Silver cutlery \[80 SP\] * An (obviously) Elven made silver(?) dagger - (unknown) * 3 silver rings (60, 40, 120 SP) and one finely crafted gold ring \[16 GS\] * 8 uncut emeralds of various size \[54 GS\] * Sack with 86 CF, 16 GS, 49 SP and 6 TSG _Three - Food & weapons_ This space is obviously a store room for natures food and spare serviceable weapons. Beneath a net, which a roll of 8 x perception or less will show to be affixed to the cavern roof in such a way as to fall on anyone tampering with the stores, lies: * 7 barrels \[2 wine, 2 ale, 2 water, 1 oats\] * At least 3 short swords \[serviceable, smith-made\] * A number of daggers \[3 serviceable\] * Many mostly unused arrows \[68\] A large key ring with 6 keys hangs from a hook near the space’s entrance. _Four - Guards_ This is a room with some rocks dragged over to a relatively flat surface extending from the far wall. 26 CF sit on the flat space in 3 stacks. Littering the cave floor, in amongst a number of well-chewed bones there are discarded sticks of various lengths less than 12 cm. _Five - Ogres_ A very sturdy chain tethers an Ogre to the wall. It has an obviously injured arm and is malnourished. When it sees the party it frantically waves and takes off its right boot. Within is a very beautiful emerald and silver necklace. The necklace is magic, giving the wearer the ability to see invisible objects or people and see through illusions. _Six - Prisoners_ There are six chained prisoners in this area of the cavern. Each is chained separately and there is a distance of at least 30’ between each prisoner. There is a coarse mat and water bucket beside each emaciated looking prisoner. A small, haggard but determined looking Halfling identifies himself as Bran. Two Elves, known to Elowen and Eirian are there, as well as three humans. They are all _very_ glad to see you. Through good timing, they tell you that you attacked the Orcs when all the prisoners were in the caverns. With special thanks to ryivhnn
/>  \n@ryivhnn for my wonderful and ever joyful Wombats!

body.title: Beautiful environment and care on the natural plants roof.
body.body:
>I hope everyone is doing well. Welcome everyone to this unique and beautiful journey of nature. A beautiful garden on the roof. This garden was created by my uncle. He is a very religious and hardworking person. You can see beautiful mangoes on the trees and here he planted tomatoes in tubs. With his feelings, I went up to the roof and went there and plucked the tomatoes from the tree. However, from the roof, beautiful natural views can be seen from afar.
‎
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNkt6EQ2MpErHb8YrQ7xpi2eux29c5D1rkT5J2PhrFtf9/1776700201461.jpg)

These mangoes are usually called banana mangoes because they are delicious to eat and turn very red when ripe. I have tried to show you the view of this mango tree before. The colors of these mangoes are quite sweet and beautiful.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfKadabaTsiWMxJFSKpkegYNd1fGV9MJYYRJJMHvwQNTi/1776700170255.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNrpr9m35rDn5hcteopzmjNpPCrauLHeg3Knc8R3jRCBL/1776700170297.jpg)

Tomatoes are a healthy vegetable, especially my uncle planted some tomato plants in a tub, but the plant died. Later, I picked the tomatoes and gave them to my aunt for cooking. However, we really like to eat tomato paste. It is also very tasty with fish.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVKXpFQwaHL2qWNrU1JewBvjG617fF5PzDdr6VgHj62iu/1776700170362.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSX77JZ2CVqtu63pqGh4QRU1UADFTaR5Ska5fMsbbbr8U/1776700170410.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXygcaR9cAcR7cA39pKDJebi3vfSPoi2x9K1zd2WV4Ad/1776700170455.jpg)

There are pomegranate trees and dragon fruit trees along with guava trees. My uncle takes care of these trees. Even though he is on duty during the day, he takes care of these trees in the morning and then goes to duty. However, I really like the care he takes for the trees. I want us to plant trees together in different places, including in the yard or on the roof.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX7LYJx6NiajyBxnpGhCQ3SzgfywVjfFPnZg7mK8dKRyP/1776700201362.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTgwaTJKkq2wL8iMfziTXDK8bURVqPErPSdLZdep27wG7/1776700201420.jpg)



This particular mango tree has banana mangoes. Anyone can tell by looking at the design and shape of the mango that it is a banana mango. But we need to be familiar with everything. This mango is very delicious to eat and is yellow inside. But the outside is mostly mixed with red and yellow. I have eaten this mango but it is a very delicious and tasty mango. I have decided that I will make a grafting plant from this tree.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYPDKq15EigCXTRx9sd5m7EcgabAUSut1mTeN9mPaLVVU/1776700201491.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNb5cjqT1xRt3mKTt4TJiagJoBHrUiBjqKoQwaaY1uJwR/1776700201536.jpg)


The beautiful green landscape and the beauty of the sky soothe the heart. It was very nice to climb up to the roof and see the surrounding view. But it was even better to see mangoes in these small trees. I always tell you all to plant trees, and planting trees is very important to keep our next generation alive. Thank you all very much. I am very grateful. Do you plant trees?


![18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mdakash62/EoAUXZjGAPyY3oMMK4f3oHgNhH1gR25mTMmu7pBuiWx6a2eAfCbUiUbmkLz3qgzSuJv.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYH7g5td7TFYfVNmCcnCQArAAiER1da6iZk4LRfG46Tiu/1762630356965.gif)

body.title: Every human being, when born, must taste death, no matter how strong a fortress he may be in.
body.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQCpjSJATkWYANEsmWFn8ZRqevkewQixEVdmgs3ss2TEE/80836c87c9b35e54375f11549a5a3b39)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dmann/79877a29)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=dmann/79877a29)


---

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope that by the grace of Allah, you are all well and healthy. May you always be well and healthy with all your family, relatives and neighbors. Best wishes to you. I am also well with your prayers. I am healthy with all my family. For this, I am offering a million thanks to the royal court of Allah. Alhamdulillah.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdxuosD37bjEPiXfR7oER48qNQdyZi4PjwkxWAkVYmGfv/1777557735136.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTkxwmmt2GioJyjAiDCQhbuWAtXfcGC1CK1sSwuvTaqF1/1777557735324.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQBZmMiyvTv9avPXVHNwreDt4XscwmorxdsaFWmm79dK6/1777557735469.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCFNmNQpoAZ1vNc3JqThgXuMQmBcnWPjg7XMmXub4idZ/1777557735607.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcJHFmxPL7GsvWNYwV16cXaXAHnPn9MkJbJn5NnPbpgFd/1777557735698.jpg)

Friends, today I have come to you with such a video that I am getting wet while showing the video or talking about myself because today's video is a video of a cemetery. When I went to make a video here, the central cemetery of our district, my chest was heaving because I must come here one day at the call of Allah. The day you call us, we must return to Him, that is, you must taste death. There is a saying that every person, every person must taste death, no matter how hard he is in a fortress.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRBfSLr9WaskQgWmeLr8zGiNTHFwJnf2n69r1RUCibAwT/1777557769287.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNn8mJYkJ9yZjfM14v7WmBkSfoauNsTh2Q7fR29QEAHT/1777557769442.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPUgUExo2ZrVRpky2BBdez3ghDAi8pFjwhbQQAi7fj6om/1777557769590.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmey24MY7mZxye4LZ4rfJFdsTrQRwwnwjtdAapZ4vP8Qa3/1777557769725.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUfKKJNjrjeYN5GMGM9hE16qD92g3NunPQLjTHh42FtN/1777557769866.jpg)

So friends, today I have come to this cemetery and I will show you a few videos of this cemetery. Since centuries ago, people have been buried here. 1239 lakhs of people are lying in that unknown land where no one wants to go, but they have to go here. They are lying just three and a half feet under the ground. But we cannot say anything about their condition, what they are doing, how they are doing. However, we can get information about people thousands of miles away, see them, talk to them, know how they are doing, and what is happening just three and a half feet under the ground. But no one can say anything.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYATH6V9czUXWTkhEjdVpKqdqzS8EU2SXr78ZU3SjBDaa/1777557822879.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiExpXCpCvRZJu6jrrwxfGNo6rduiHYQ46kXjhhzcSzv/1777557823037.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmciNUrEvds7YELCF8e7D4z31zz9JUbdQzrM86H7pEPNrX/1777557823175.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqtobNMtwBtCqqhqDTCw1CKMBgsAL7T7K65JfqmTHWNm/1777557823306.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwtHd8MeRw9N6cz2earFQaoGaphUjGHFAFnsTN8tAdiy/1777557823444.jpg)

I made this video with a very heavy heart today because for a moment I felt that I will have to come here one day or another. There is a series of human births, like my father was born before me, my father before me, but for my grandfather. But in the case of death, it is the opposite. No one can say when someone will leave. There are cases where the grandfather is alive but the grandson is not alive. There are cases where the father carries the body of his son on his shoulders. The grave is our permanent address. We have to accept the taste of death. This is an eternal truth. Therefore, we should prepare for death. We should prepare for the afterlife.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQgBvzNRVdxZ3uiAUsSjUWFTgCGwfGpQsse4hu1eW79cz/1777557855102.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUy34u2r5GNKd6triMgynwUB1RWMDxXkX55TWkDucHAQe/1777557855282.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc8RBwwS7rmCYghbxP5AENgMjEoEnXaZiTZrdAWHUDMaJ/1777557855414.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTbEEcnVaq5uumPyb4jQFDr2TLv8rGwFsBrFw7WvSCQ1m/1777557855548.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme31e2QoQh3CoN6p95b49xV6Y6p5DayJH6LyPVcr2jVSF/1777557855671.jpg)

And this preparation is that we can get closer to Allah through worship, through good deeds, through always speaking the truth, through helping others. In other words, only by doing good to people can we get closer to Allah, and only by singing the songs of Allah can we get closer to Allah. We can get closer to Allah through five daily prayers. Therefore, we must do good deeds above all and stay away from bad deeds. This is the real education and that is why Allah created us. The only purpose of Allah's creation is for us to worship Him. To prepare ourselves for the hereafter, Allah gave us the image of knowledge, conscience and intelligence, so we must act accordingly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcJHFmxPL7GsvWNYwV16cXaXAHnPn9MkJbJn5NnPbpgFd/1777557887154.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRyViZhbd1jQtTTvQRtkARMCKKkrCsv6dtT8aDhVwhwc/1777557887303.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV1TB1VTymjaCLoSHGFmdaBQEJiJFPKmB7RhwqmvgCCod/1777557887478.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9RwQYefazz8aZSdDUBExXQSevWuTgMJAAnB54xHSGPg/1777557887585.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxYuPhPc39jyq8BHzWevPwM6SzbATuyBZAP2fNUS88G4/1777557887742.jpg)

Today, when I come to the cemetery, I wonder why I keep thinking about death. When do I know that Allah Almighty calls us to come to me, your time is up. But no matter how big and strong the fortress on earth is, no one can stop us. That is, we have to respond to Allah's call and leave. This is the reality. Therefore, we should try to get closer to Allah Almighty and continue to judge between good and evil, since Allah Almighty has given us the image of knowledge, conscience and intelligence.

Assalamu Alaikum friends, how are you all? I hope that by the grace of Allah, you are all well and healthy. May you always be well and healthy with all your family, relatives and neighbors. Best wishes to you. I am also well with your prayers. I am healthy with all my family. For this, I am offering a million thanks to the royal court of Allah. Alhamdulillah.

Friends, today I have come to you with such a video that I am getting wet while showing the video or talking about myself because today's video is a video of a cemetery. When I went to make a video here, the central cemetery of our district, my chest was heaving because I must come here one day at the call of Allah. The day you call us, we must return to Him, that is, you must taste death. There is a saying that every person, every person must taste death, no matter how hard he is in a fortress.

So friends, today I have come to this cemetery and I will show you a few videos of this cemetery. Since centuries ago, people have been buried here. 1239 lakhs of people are lying in that unknown land where no one wants to go, but they have to go here. They are lying just three and a half feet under the ground. But we cannot say anything about their condition, what they are doing, how they are doing. However, we can get information about people thousands of miles away, see them, talk to them, know how they are doing, and what is happening just three and a half feet under the ground. But no one can say anything.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYATH6V9czUXWTkhEjdVpKqdqzS8EU2SXr78ZU3SjBDaa/1777557822879.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiExpXCpCvRZJu6jrrwxfGNo6rduiHYQ46kXjhhzcSzv/1777557823037.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwtHd8MeRw9N6cz2earFQaoGaphUjGHFAFnsTN8tAdiy/1777557823444.jpg)

I made this video with a very heavy heart today because for a moment I felt that I will have to come here one day or another. There is a series of human births, like my father was born before me, my father before me, but for my grandfather. But in the case of death, it is the opposite. No one can say when someone will leave. There are cases where the grandfather is alive but the grandson is not alive. There are cases where the father carries the body of his son on his shoulders. The grave is our permanent address. We have to accept the taste of death. This is an eternal truth. Therefore, we should prepare for death. We should prepare for the afterlife.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQgBvzNRVdxZ3uiAUsSjUWFTgCGwfGpQsse4hu1eW79cz/1777557855102.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme31e2QoQh3CoN6p95b49xV6Y6p5DayJH6LyPVcr2jVSF/1777557855671.jpg)

And this preparation is that we can get closer to Allah through worship, through good deeds, through always speaking the truth, through helping others. In other words, only by doing good to people can we get closer to Allah, and only by singing the songs of Allah can we get closer to Allah. We can get closer to Allah through five daily prayers. Therefore, we must do good deeds above all and stay away from bad deeds. This is the real education and that is why Allah created us. The only purpose of Allah's creation is for us to worship Him. To prepare ourselves for the hereafter, Allah gave us the image of knowledge, conscience and intelligence, so we must act accordingly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcJHFmxPL7GsvWNYwV16cXaXAHnPn9MkJbJn5NnPbpgFd/1777557887154.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxYuPhPc39jyq8BHzWevPwM6SzbATuyBZAP2fNUS88G4/1777557887742.jpg)

Today, when I come to the cemetery, I wonder why I keep thinking about death. When do I know that Allah Almighty calls us to come to me, your time is up.
