body.title: [ENG/ESP] A Thursday of teamwork and goals achieved
body.body: > **I hope you all have a happy Friday. Today is May 1st, Labor Day, and I’m sure many of you are at home enjoying a well-deserved rest. We’ve decided not to work either; we want to take a stroll along one of Margarita’s beautiful beaches. In my next post, I’ll tell you how it went, because today I want to share with you how my Thursday unfolded—a day that began like any other but ended leaving us with a deep sense of satisfaction. When we left home, it looked like it would be a quiet day, one of those where the routine flows smoothly. The weather was excellent; the sky was clear, with a light breeze, and those urban and natural landscapes that always accompany us on the way to the Sunsol Unik Hotel. Every time we take that route, I feel like the island gives us a different postcard view, and that makes even workdays have their own charm.**

> *Les deseo un feliz viernes a todos. Hoy es primero de mayo, Día del Trabajador, y seguramente muchos estarán en casa disfrutando un merecido descanso. Nosotros también decidimos no trabajar; queremos darnos un paseo por una de las hermosas playas de Margarita. En mi próxima publicación les contaré cómo nos fue, porque en esta ocasión quiero compartirles cómo transcurrió mi día jueves, un día que comenzó como cualquier otro, pero terminó dejándonos una sensación profunda de satisfacción. Cuando salimos de casa parecía que sería una jornada tranquila, de esas en las que la rutina fluye sin contratiempos. El clima estaba excelente; el cielo claro, con un poco de brisa y esos paisajes urbanos y naturales que siempre nos acompañan en el camino hacia el Hotel Sunsol Unik. Cada vez que hacemos ese recorrido, siento que la isla nos regala una postal distinta, y eso hace que incluso los días de trabajo tengan su propio encanto.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wqgbhNjsg434cnJFbtEqE3Yk19gR2e6RAjP83sgNenLLYFuB9AC1oCR6mcaL3YmixgQ.jpg) ![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoyP615MD1YN6GkoyGu5hH7SR7nMSevGmyH8nQtkt5oo7ko7bdQWUfN9rj1J2pQSeaJ.jpg) ![w.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpvhNUJn5i1qm93YYxjgTPikVSyCu9Z3MhZv7BnKEXAR3tLegbyUVWndFZj4aNSxFG1.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-44-33.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5D6uVaTKddbRACoY2UVRNFVSNB6Sb68bYHf8n3MwAC6sc9qL2fJH1KQzufTHj2DLY.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpxqNWupjjNYZXEr2siLS46cw6jGgfJpmy2LwHXUwG6FKgx85PrLVdHc62sDnkMWgbV.jpg)

> **When we arrived at the hotel, the first thing we did was check the water in the tank so we could carry out our routine chlorination and disinfection of the main tank. Everything went perfectly. The parameters were within the correct range, which always gives us peace of mind and a sense of a job well done.**

> *Al llegar al hotel, lo primero que hicimos fue verificar el agua del tanque para realizar nuestra rutina de clorado y desinfección del tanque principal. Todo salió perfecto. Los parámetros quedaron dentro de los valores correctos, lo que siempre nos da tranquilidad y una sensación de trabajo bien hecho.*
![photo_2026-05-01_00-43-58.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoeEuhkndSj67ch9HUvUyhKYWLosn8ju9cVB3m41iL1yS4Bm9GKARbzajSNCbCkYt3k.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-43-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eoc9PjNpeFDU3nea2Cw4R3JieqvvbwvV8NGwdMpz9BiDiVRUJuMp6RX6LfwTriTpwpW.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-43-54.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eopspsym3z9XJzY56HsEk6Vbh4q7wcwTK4T1HNYviJ9jVBofPrbBsVjCWdxmstib7QL.jpg)

> **As soon as we finished, the maintenance manager arrived to let us know that the bolts for the damaged filter cover had arrived—a task that had been pending at the hotel for days. It looked like we’d finally be able to take care of it that Thursday. We went down to the area known as La Trinchera, where the filters are located. The work would be limited to filter number 1, where we had to replace all the studs with new stainless steel ones. It was necessary because, as I mentioned in another post, one of the old studs had broken due to pressure, causing the filter to start leaking water. And since there’s always a risk that others might be compromised, we decided to replace them all to prevent future problems.**

> *Apenas terminamos, llegó el jefe de mantenimiento para informarnos que habían llegado los espárragos para la tapa del filtro dañado, un trabajo pendiente que teníamos en el hotel desde hacía días. Al parecer, ese jueves por fin podríamos resolverlo. Bajamos al área conocida como La Trinchera, donde se encuentran los filtros. El trabajo sería únicamente en el filtro número 1, al que debíamos cambiarle todos los espárragos por unos nuevos de acero inoxidable. Era algo necesario, porque como les conté en otra publicación, uno de los espárragos anteriores se había quebrado por la presión, lo que provocó que el filtro comenzara a botar agua. Y como siempre existe el riesgo de que otros estén resentidos, preferimos cambiarlos todos para evitar futuros problemas.*
![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eoc6Yx6tePNfGfZqzBaoCvaMDDfeyAMXTMRvY6Fe9vYocpbAbMaFtdquXwmRWhA8G2c.jpg) ![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoeERXV6JevZBnBxhi5ZevxZQXRmVvE6dz4PCr3E5Qf7HZrWCQU7Pu768K7gwfS8tX3.jpg) ![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpGQGT5XWj1Sf4DRrjrVM6Jw1AABB9gHdAqHPfHWQTqkR1BCTWtdP7QufvDBtEVPwVv.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-49.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpC9RLjPcH2HJhrotqbs5u7huzTKZqaqUUutFJAY2Dd8v7E7qazSSt9cpc7AJL6sqCx.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xyZf2DnemBYAWShD1Ktmz9trLmXtecgRANGUpF6qdLvhLrGHUzA8JLY5ywYKouW1WxC.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-47.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/2423uvVmEUcaAdXZYYu4ENWcEyCWVyHeBsnACtZNMaiwd8Nc5kYQb5u2xX4CusE42B6HX.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoyP39NrqPFp82nNR71oX8F4pw19cca3Fqcy1WjuoUcFF1ZJakj4aJtvkkwCM8BccBA.jpg)

> **The job took some time. We had to make sure there were no leaks, because any water leak affects the pressure and compromises the system’s operation. My husband and Luis handled the heavy lifting, since it was a job that required both strength and precision. I focused on assisting them, handing them the necessary tools and materials so that everything would run smoothly. It was true teamwork—the kind that reminds you that every role, no matter how small it may seem, is important to achieving a good result.**

> *El trabajo tomó su tiempo. Había que asegurarse de que no quedara ninguna fuga, porque cualquier escape de agua afecta la presión y compromete el funcionamiento del sistema. Mi esposo y Luis se encargaron de la parte más fuerte, porque era un trabajo de fuerza y precisión. Yo me dediqué a asistirlos, alcanzándoles las herramientas y materiales necesarios para que todo fluyera sin interrupciones. Fue un verdadero trabajo en equipo, de esos que te recuerdan que cada rol, por pequeño que parezca, es importante para lograr un buen resultado.*
![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eoc52uxae4jmJDicv3CFNHoLgnn2ifie2xkwCbPHNTujAYCTuVBa1Fb46oh6eoQXvEk.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoCg8QdVcA6fQhJjE8bbxA5EguxJX6H182YaVdFVv7dsU9jPtb348puCYHTaMQueuYe.jpg)

> **When we finished installing all the struts and made sure the filter was properly assembled, we felt a huge sense of relief. Not only because the job had been a bit complicated, but also because everything turned out perfectly. We left the hotel with that sense of satisfaction you only feel when you know you’ve fulfilled your responsibility and left everything working as it should.**

> *Cuando terminamos de colocar todos los espárragos y dejamos el filtro armado correctamente, sentimos un gran alivio. No solo porque el trabajo había sido un poco complicado, sino porque todo salió muy bien. Nos retiramos del hotel con esa satisfacción que solo se siente cuando sabes que cumpliste con tu responsabilidad y dejaste todo funcionando como debe ser.*
![photo_2026-05-01_00-43-57.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep3dP1bopcRb8uR1bs1Fb2TQZzMXyLWGpezbiZ4eYHWUSKDVEoZXcKcVoZ1GKJpiM7M.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-01_00-41-36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23wMYEchQECTBwt6FETuARMcVpuhs7oq7nHoh6FQGWHsRA8KPCrTzGnMt7djn1a7ipt5y.jpg)

body.title: Challenge #04870-M121: The Right Fulcrum
body.body:
- Which do you choose? -- Prompey

[AN: Very sorely tempted to do _so_ many Leverage riffs]

The right to reign is often accepted to mean: anyone who reigns has all the rights. And when anyone is both rich _and_ powerful, they can take what they want and make consequences happen to others. Naturally, the people on the wrong end of that exchange tend to get irritated by that attitude.

So rebellions rise in odd corners.

Five rogues gathered in an undisclosed location, each with their particular area of expertise. They didn't _dress_ like rogues, which was the point. If anyone in authority found them, that authority would mistake them for Adventurers up to some nonsense.

To a casual observer, they appeared to be: a Fighter, a Wizard, a Cleric, a Bard, and a Thief. They looked _too_ much like the textbook model, but the casual observer would have moved on. Because everyone has seen a group _just_ like them. They're everywhere.

What stood out was things like the accurate portraits on the pinboard, or the copies of official documents in the same place. Or, perhaps, the eerily accurate maps and plans of buildings. Things that regular Adventurers didn't bother with. Things that regular Adventurers ended up causing a low-level apocalypse to acquire. Things they get either during or after their strike on their target.

This group gets that stuff _before_ they start.

\
began the apparent Cleric. What anyone outside this group missed was that he was a cleric of Wothyn, the god of knowledge. \
supplied the Wizard, drawing a line across his neck as further illustration. \
said the Bard. _Her_ line across the throat indicated the traditional plan.\n\n\
Reluctantly, and with some aggression, she re-sheathed her numerous daggers.\n\n\
said the Fighter, radiating menace in his favourite corner - one where he could watch the doors. \

body.body:
Appreciate these comments and feedback! Yes, the cold start problem is legit for sure.  I hope we can raise a lot of support from whales in the eco system to vote for Signal Scouts / Signal Miners who are really adding great value signal to the web2 content. It is an opportunity to direct resources to create great content consumers, rather than only focusing on bloggers as we have done traditionally. 

The idea here is that the signal inbox is one of the main products.  each inbox has a feed of creators that the user follows and we can anonomise it and keep track of how often that inbox feed is visited by the user.  

this means we can clearly see demand for creators, and then we can inform the Signal Scouts / Signal Miners that that is where they can go to add signal and thereby optimise their rewards, system credits and reputation.  So the system may be able to self bootstrap this way.  

But i do agree, at the moment we are starting with youtube, twitter, tick tok and instagram who all have their own nuances for bringing in data.  but we ahve done some work to enable import of wiki articles and scientific journals and publications to the eco system.  i think this is where a great focus should be.  however, im more inclined to let the community direct us primarily based off of signal inbox usage, follows and visits.

body.title: Finished the Season in Gold III
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmboLux4vVPAriuCnk5MbzUiA4Pfyuwazy4DvX7qZBGnhP/image.png)

Greetings to all Splinterlands players and hive gaming community! I was improving my cards last season and it looks like my efforts paid off. I reached Gold III at the end of the season and earned many glint tokens along the way. Now it's time to spend them in rewards shop. By the way, I also got rewards for advancement when I reached Gold.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZz4zg3HYo2nLgQVCg9pyHeuPJ5BTCispTGQyQ8rNzuKL/image.png)

The best reward I got was two copies of an epic card. It pays to try and advance to higher leagues in Splinterlands and it can be done by improving the cards you have. I have been working throughout the season to make my cards stronger and it helped me reached Gold.

I now have two epic cards in my deck. I got Wailworn Specter earlier also from advancing leagues and the Saltwraith Pirate. It's a neutral tank good for low mana games. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXw3FTusgiLJYzFTEiuk4WT1zX2wRKRme2zi51H2jEnHQ/image.png)

I think I would like more epic cards. So for this season, I will be buying five epic reward chests from Gwen's Glint Shop for seventy five thousand glints.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZeJEKd8oFU8umiYutrdrDC7bcL8rJZRmNhJNS5P7VXMW/image.png)

When I opened the chests, I got one more copy each of Wailworn Specter and Saltwraith Pirate. One more and I can upgrade them to level two.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzgaedG27fo3ypDzLXsP6pB3q9g6Jn5NdPPvNKBscgf6/image.png)

Aside from the two cards I already had, I also got three new epic cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUh1A5zczAsjH74VJqGj5fS2Pi445FxzU5B8ycsaztSh4/image.png)

This one is a flying dragon. It's a good card to play in poison modifiers because it has Immunity skill. The problem is I don't have a dragon archon. I hope a guild member will lend one in the library so that I can use my dragon cards. Or else, I will have to buy or rent one soon. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVgrLURVsC3GGs7ZchkXsNPxDRcc2t53HR3byXRhff9DF/image.png)

This one is a Death card with three attack. It's an archer that will have to play in the back. It has Painforged skill that can play in poison or burning modifiers. It increases its attacking power when poisoned or burned. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSkjiPZbzYWzMuuP2a9kSoi4kzmRJSxMbf91pvfka6o2u/image.png)

This card is a melee but it has a skill that targets flying units. I think it can attack from any position to target the opponent's flying units. This could be a good card to play in Earthquake modifier games. 

So now I have five epic cards with two cards missing one copy to level up. I think I will buy more epic chests after next season. It's a goal I'm looking up to and after I got the epic cards I will buy the expensive gold chests. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaLFEEEpDZ7Gbf7yobKGZCFfS4bYkHfpSxpy2VzjBjvYE/image.png)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

If this post interests you and you are not playing Splinterlands yet, please consider joining this wonderful game using my referral.

Be active. Walk or run and earn afit tokens! Join me at actifit.io

body.title: Наш новий знайомий
body.body:
Ранкові прогулянки з собачкою цієї весни трохи одноманітні через холод та небажання ходити полями, щоб не назбирати кліщів. Ми знайшли для себе оптимальний маршрут, де цих кровопивць не так багато. А це - стежина між ставом та маленькою річечкою. Тут і травичка невисока, і немає бур'янів, де би могли зграями сидіти кліщі. Зате краєвиди прекрасні, та ще й птахів багато. Джес то качку під берегом підніме, сама злякавшись свисту її крил на зльоті, то якусь синичку злякає. А то раптом задивиться на величних лебедів, які злітають з поверхні води із дуже потужним звуком, який в порівнянні з качиними крилами звучить наче реактивний літак. І ось ьтак завмерши на місці і стоїмо з нею, захоплено дивлячись на цю неймовірну красу.

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/Ep1XKaJy25acBcXhjxmxQbj6pPLArMuf34jSvSpyqqy4yvQCUoqtwycFVNDXuajbRFT.jpg)

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EpxqDtQntxNHBK5wexM3tzCLYAEJtc2BDth7swkDgQhsoKyozfW7nEDGGyWy5aG6X4h.jpg)

А ще по дорозі додому ми познайомилися з красивим котом. Він сам до нас прибіг одного разу, не боячись собачки. Тоді я не змогла її стримати від руху в бік котика, і він побіг назад, до свого магазину. Там він живе, тільки вночі мусить спати де попало, бо у приміщенні його залишати не можна.
І з того дня я стала брати з собою для котика смаколики. Тепер ми із Джес спокійно приходимо до самого магазину, я собачку стримую і вона вже знає, що котика чіпати не можна. І годую красеня, за що він ніжно муркотить і треться об руку. 
Нове завдання прогулянок сподобалося і мені, і собачці. Тепер їй навіть нагадувати не треба про чемність: сама зупиняється біля котика і чекає, коли ми підемо додому. Бо теж хоче отримати заслуженого смаколика.😁

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23vi47FKmMFjUVMwtHyADZCQx7vybHotSQKNUq41K3GPkWuFBXDsGfKDf46gaMgBBT8fU.jpg)

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EopuLNUo1xLJ5whfwSEWHE6PAsx5voCQyZ5Nkyn6kExSov7nUEhSQJXgmYSGEybtPwD.jpg)

body.title: ‎“970 and Counting: Can Cristiano Ronaldo Truly Reach 1000 Goals?” ‎
body.body:
‎There are moments in football that make you want to pause and reflect, and for me, Cristiano Ronaldo reaching 970 career goals is one of those moments. His recent goal against Al Ahli in the Saudi Pro League wasn’t just another goal but it felt like a step closer to something historic and something almost mythical, 1000 career goals.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb8YYGFxbiQ8vU1KAttVFLA22QYJq2JMssp8atksX2HEM/images%2017.jpeg 

‎[source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.si.com/soccer/cristiano-ronaldo-breaks-silence-ending-al-nassr-strike&ved=2ahUKEwjUsaGop5eUAxUF_7sIHWjzEzkQtaYDegQIChAA&usg=AOvVaw21krSaPLbYj7b3VyXA4hqo)
‎
‎970 goals is already beyond extraordinary when you think about it. Most players don’t even come close to half of that number in their entire careers. But Ronaldo has never been “most players and he has been on another level.” His career has always been defined by pushing limits, breaking records, and setting new standards that once seemed impossible. Now, with just 30 goals separating him from the 1000 mark, the question on my mind and maybe probably on the minds of millions of people too, that can he actually do it?
‎
‎Personally, I want to believe he can because he always achieve anything he set hi mind on unless something came up. While watching Ronaldo over the years, one thing has always stood out, and thos me things are his obsession with improvement and longevity. Even now, playing in Saudi Arabia, he still carries that same hunger and ambitious lifestyle. His movement, positioning, and finishing still remain sharp, and more importantly, his mentality hasn’t for once faded. If anything, milestones like this seem to fuel him even more and more.
‎
‎But realistically, 30 goals is not a small number, especially at this stage of his career. Because age is no longer on his side, and the physical demands of the game don’t get easier. But if there’s one player who has consistently defied age and expectations, then it’s him \

. With the kind of service he gets at Al Nassr and his role as the focal point of the attack, those goals are never not out of reach.
‎
‎What makes this chase even more worthwhile is what it represents. It’s not just about numbers but it’s about legacy. Because reaching 1000 goals would place Ronaldo in a category of his own, a milestone that may stand untouched for generations to come. It would be the ultimate proof of consistency, discipline, and greatness over time.
‎
‎As a fan and football lover, I actually hope to witness that moment. Seeing him score goal number 1000 would feel like watching history unfold in real time. And knowing Ronaldo, he won’t just chase it but he’ll believe in it until the last minute.
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy-sports/970-and-counting-can-cristiano-ronaldo-truly-reach-1000-goals--9p)

body.title: La noche
body.body:
Buenas hermosa comunidad dios los bendiga, aqui esta la continuación de mi vida como maestro,descrita en modo de novela espero les siga gustando.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmatW8CR2Exhiy5JgLKTY4kcDQ16oeoH2a9s3tNYCHbefF/1777550407779.jpg)

Capítulo 2: La primera noche
‎
‎Yane Adrian no durmió.
‎
‎No por el frío —aunque la sierra de Holguín se filtraba por las rendijas de madera como un animal sigiloso—, sino por el rumor. Esa guitarra que había escuchado al llegar no dejó de sonar hasta pasadas las tres de la madrugada, pero nunca la misma canción. Cada vez que creía identificar la melodía, la música cambiaba de tono, como si alguien estuviera aprendiendo a tocar en reversa.
‎
‎Amaneció con los ojos abiertos y las manos agarrotadas alrededor de la vela ya consumida. El cartón con la inscripción seguía en el bolsillo de su camisa. Lo sacó.
‎
‎«¿Seguro que sigues?»
‎
‎Lo puso sobre la mesa y, por un momento, le pareció que la letra se había vuelto más oscura. O más reciente.
‎
‎—No estoy loco —murmuró, y la palabra sonó a mentira.
‎
‎Afuera lo esperaba el mismo niño de la piedra. Se llamaba Ramón y tenía ocho años, aunque sus ojos aparentaban más. Llevaba una libreta a cuadros sujeta con un cordel y un lápiz sin punta.
‎
‎—¿Ya desayunó, maestro? —preguntó.
‎
‎—Todavía no.
‎
‎—Doña Carmen dijo que si no desayunaba, ella le daba yuca con mojo.
‎
‎Doña Carmen, supo después, era la abuela de Ramón y la única persona en La Esperanza que tenía una cocina con chimenea. Los demás cocinaban afuera, bajo techo de palma, como si el humo fuera otro vecino.
‎
‎La escuela resultó ser un galerón de tablas caídas, con un pizarrón de madera pintado de negro que alguien había clavado a un árbol de guásima. Dentro no había bancos, sino pedazos de tronco cortados a la misma altura. Seis pedazos. Seis alumnos.
‎
‎—Faltan dos —dijo Yane Adrian.
‎
‎Ramón negó con la cabeza.
‎
‎—No faltan. Es que Leidy y Yordanis vienen más tarde. Viven en la loma de atrás, bajan cuando el río no se crece.
‎
‎—¿Y si el río se crece?
‎
‎El niño lo miró como si la pregunta fuera ingenua.
‎
‎—Entonces no bajan.
‎
‎Yane Adrian pasó los dedos por la superficie del pizarrón. En la esquina inferior derecha, alguien había rayado una fecha: 1994. Y debajo, una palabra borrosa que terminaba con la misma letra que el cartón.
‎
‎Maestro.
‎
‎No quiso pensar en eso. Sacó una tiza del bolsillo y escribió con pulso firme:
‎
‎Bienvenidos a un año nuevo.
‎
‎Debajo, sin saber por qué, dibujó la misma estrella que había garabateado esa noche en su libreta de bitácora. La que sus alumnos algún día recordarían como el primer misterio.
‎
‎Adentro del galerón, el silencio era tan denso que se podía oler.
‎
‎Yane Adrian dio media vuelta y miró hacia la loma. Allá arriba, entre los pinos y la niebla que no se iba ni al mediodía, una figura oscura lo observaba. No se movía. No saludaba.
‎
‎Solo estaba.
‎
‎—¿Quién es? —preguntó Yane Adrian, señalando.
‎
‎Ramón arrugó la nariz.
‎
‎—Ahí no hay nadie, maestro.
‎
‎Él volvió a mirar. La figura seguía allí. Y entonces, lentamente, levantó una mano.
‎
‎No para saludar.
‎
‎Para señalar el suelo.
‎
‎Yane Adrian bajó la mirada. A sus pies, sobre la tierra roja, alguien había rayado una flecha. No apuntaba hacia la escuela ni hacia las casas.
‎
‎Apuntaba hacia adentro de la montaña.
‎
‎Esa noche, por segunda vez, Yane Adrian no durmió.
‎
‎Pero esta vez no fue por la guitarra. Fue porque, cuando revisó el bolsillo de su camisa, el cartón ya no estaba.
‎
‎Y en su lugar encontró una tiza. Gastada.
‎
‎Del mismo color de la flecha.
‎

body.title: Finding Texture in the Unexpected
body.body:
Today I’m sharing something a little different from what I usually post. Most of the time, I enjoy taking photos of nature, flowers, and insects whenever I get the chance. There is something comforting and peaceful about capturing the beauty of living things. But today, my attention was drawn elsewhere. ![1000138622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EpEFTnPtBeMnGhii3REqUqHttaC1vKT6pEFPB5gpmdbx1Wrs8oWM9UQwoDqT9uifcFa.jpg) Instead of flowers and leaves, I found myself focusing on textures, metal, rust, and grunge. These close-up shots may seem simple at first glance, but when seen through black and white photography, they reveal a different kind of beauty. The contrast becomes sharper, the details become more defined, and the worn surfaces begin to tell their own quiet story. Even the roughness and imperfections seem artistic in their own way. What I really like about black and white photos is how they strip away distraction and allow the subject’s texture and character to stand out. The scratches, rust, faded surfaces, and patterns all become more noticeable. It reminds me that beauty is not always found in bright colors or perfect forms. Sometimes, it is hidden in the old, the weathered, and the overlooked. I think this also reflects life in some way. There are times when we need to step away from our usual routine and try something different. Not because what we normally do is wrong, but because a different route can help us see things from a fresh perspective. Sometimes, change is exactly what we need to feel inspired again. Today’s photos may be different from my usual subjects, but I enjoyed taking them just the same. They reminded me that inspiration can be found almost anywhere if we take the time to look closely. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000138625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eoc1DKczDBeo7yaC9chCQgZvWPb5tWEwcg5vyP65tcFymNyyFC1T4gZcLtUD6fYGHDb.jpg) ![1000138622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EpEFTnPtBeMnGhii3REqUqHttaC1vKT6pEFPB5gpmdbx1Wrs8oWM9UQwoDqT9uifcFa.jpg) ![1000138623.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoATyf8VCby5TC1rDTsLU4nh3CSTgPAbYHjS3BBaGtihqDp6vp17afPbYfAPExEzq6k.jpg) ![1000138626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoAYps3XsUHGUPWzjKR99HvfsPrWQ2YMCLwVFeH3PkBX68qNhSni1z3b4yTSrgPmxdW.jpg) ![1000138624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Ep3cp7bZR1P24ktdyLJeK9hJpUuPwVs8v7uhbNo9nG4jKuTD1Avx8wkgNS1grV7Fj3E.jpg) ***

body.title: Breewayy Freestyle
body.body: /> March 13th of this year made six years since LMPD killed Breonna Taylor in her own home. Normally there's something planned to mark the occasion, but this year there wasn't nary a mention of anything in the media, social or otherwise. Didn't really matter, during the protests in 2020 we learned to just head for 'the square', Injustice Square Park in downtown, if there was anything going on it was likely starting there.

/> _Six years hadn't changed that._ Got down there and found a small crowd of familiar faces. Nothing much happening, nothing formal other than a moment of silence before my arrival, just that old reflex flaring up and folks filtering in. _That old feeling of needing to be here, without knowing quite why or what for._

/> Some were there deliberately, others simply passing through when they spotted old comrades. Filtering in in dribs and drabs, hanging out, catching up, reminiscing before drifting away again. By late afternoon it was down to a double handful of folks hanging round when someone put some music on.

/> Somebody took a liking to a beat, and the next thing you knew, there was an impromptu freestyle session going on. Was regretting not bringing my 24-70mm lens, but wasn't going to let that stop me from shooting it.
/> Taking turns freestyling about Breonna and Breewayy (the square), it was such a real and genuine ~~moment~~ hour or two that just brought back memories of a certain long, hot summer.

/>

_Breewayy lives another day_

_Which is just to say_

_No justice, no peace_

_Fuck these racist ass police!_

body.title: Self Driving Cars And Environmental Factors
body.body:
# Hello learners and community 🥰💕.

What an innovations the world 🌎 keeps experiencing when we it cones to self - driving cars 🚘. I could say this is one big huge step to innovation and the extent human mind has gotten to in development. But with this kinds of innovations, many things are supposed to be put into consideration like the environmental factor, centered on where and where these kinds of cars can function properly.

The first time I had of self -driving cars 🚗 I was so fascinated, wondering how lovely 🥰 cars like this can help humans relieve the stress of being on the wheel for almost all the whole day of week, especially with work on the field. And knowing that even those who built this model of cars must have taking out their time to truly build a car that will be so safe, programmed without complications and reliable, so the company will thrive with such an innovative development. 

# But How Safe :

I know with work, research, updates and changes, a computerized car can not easily go into an accident because it has been programmed to function in a away it will not come in contact with other cars. I mean, maybe because its self -driving, it has been programmed in a way to not come in contact with other cars 🚘. This means  that the sensor will monitor the distance of the car and other cars and slow down in the case of traffic and check points since its working on also on speed limit according to program. 

Here I could say that these cars has been programmed to drive safely and will always maintain their speed limit unlike human beings who most times over speed on the road without knowing what can happen the next minute as the cars 🚘 we have everywhere does not have sensors nor programmed. So I feel that the human factor is the cause of most accidents on the roads . Some drivers are drunk while driving, others are tied and sleepy but will not stay off the wheel because they want to make money. All these keep resulting to accidents apart from other unforeseen circumstances like tire removal or break damage.

# Environmental Issues:

However, the only concern I have here is how these cars might not be able to function properly in some certain environments due to bad rounds, check points and traffics. Like in Nigeria 🇳🇬 here, I doubt if sell-driving cars can function very well due to pot -holes, police check points and the overwhelming traffic congestion. And unless these cars should only be used in some certain roads where they will not encounter bad roads . On roads that are specifically and specially made for it. 

It can also be made available for long distance journeys with good roads, and without constantly stoping like other cars driving by humans. This means, those who will purchase them knows where to channel them for operation to avoid environmental problems. 

# Who Is To Be Blamed?

Both the producers and those that purchased the car should be blamed in the case of an accident depending the kind of accident that occurred. The owner if the car was not properly controlled as regards to instructions from the manufacturer. It could be due to bad road , pot holes or floods .

The manufacturer should be blamed if what caused the accident is a technological factor which shows that the programming is not properly coordinated to help the car dictate problems that can lead to accident. 

This is my response to #hiveleaners featured content for week 215, edition 02.

# Thanks for visiting and reading friends 🥰💕.

body.title: Increasing opportunities for primary school students.
body.body: > https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUWoBfZD2NF5g5PLyJCxp1e9XsFx9hqrqnzFAJ4q2jjrE/1000068166.jpg Hello friends, I hope you are doing well. Welcome to my new post. Compared to other countries, the education situation in our country is quite bad. In our country, the previous government encouraged everyone to study in primary school. The government made education compulsory up to class five. In our country, students study up to class five and then they go to different sectors. Many are seen dropping out of school. They do this mainly because of the economic condition of their home. We know that if we want to move forward in the education system of any country, we definitely need a good budget for that education system. There are many families in our country who send their young children to do different kinds of work. Those young children work in small workplaces. They cannot do their studies well, but since primary education has been made compulsory, many people send their children to school and books were free at that time. However, the current government is adding many more things to it. A few days ago, I saw in the newspaper that the current government in our country is giving free bags to primary school students. Which are basically made of jute. The value of jute products in our country is decreasing day by day. Earlier, jute products were highly valued due to which they could be exported abroad. But the current government has taken this step that now bags will be made from this jute fiber and will be given completely free to school students. As a result, the expenses of ordinary families will be reduced to some extent. Those who have children from poor families will be saved a lot from buying their bags. However, in my opinion, many more things need to be corrected to improve primary education. In our country, primary school teachers cannot conduct good classes for students due to lack of good training. They cannot provide quality education. They still do not know how to teach primary school students well. However, there are many exceptions in this regard. Basically, private school teachers are quite educated. I think the opportunities of students need to be increased further. They should arrange mid-day meals for them so that they can return to class. I have seen that India has done this process well and they have been quite successful. As a result, many students will return to class, even if only for food. I hope you will like my post, thank you all. ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) --- Divce | realmi c67 -|-| [source]( https://pixabay.com/photos/children-orphan-child-people-73476/ ) ### Kind Regards @nahid43 ![1000019308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRW9rHroSFBSAKdERxzaNWNAnWKCXRUdrHF4LbDABXrT6/1000019308.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@nahid43/increasing-opportunities-for-primary-school-students-fvw)

Але добре, що не в період цвітіння, бо пам'ятаю, як в дитинстві любила зривати такого роду різні квіти, тягнути їх до рота або плести всілякі віночки.

На знімку - Пшінка весняна, типова паркова рослина-килим, яка квітне однією з перших весною. А на питання доньки, якщо вона отруйна, чому такі квіти ростуть в парку - я відповідаю, що скоріш за все, її спеціально не садили і вона тут могла рости ще задовго до того, коли на цьому місці з'явився парк.

title.title: SPS DAO Proposal - MonsterMarket as  a 3rd Party Market
title.body:
![cover.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVB4mw7NmdAW8J5kF5v4JsgUcVbr6m5ShzgrxcZSAjmdF/cover.png)

For years, MonsterMarket has been a dedicated pillar of the Splinterlands ecosystem. Our core mission has always been to give back to the community—whether by providing instant cashback on asset purchases, maintaining critical backend infrastructure, or developing reliable cross-chain bridges. 

Below is a summary of our ongoing contributions to the ecosystem:

## Our Contributions to the Community

### The Marketplace
What began as a simple Discord bot just months after the launch of Splinterlands has evolved into a comprehensive, community-trusted platform. Initially created to manually process cashbacks for a small group of players, MonsterMarket grew rapidly as community demand increased. Listening closely to player feedback, we developed a fully automated web interface designed to deliver a seamless, fast, and user-friendly experience, ensuring players can effortlessly maximize their value with every transaction.

### Validator & Infrastructure Support
To support the decentralized future of Splinterlands, we operate a robust archival full node API (`validator.monstermarket.io`). Additionally, we run an SPS Validator as a Service (SVaaS), providing enterprise-grade infrastructure and technical support for prominent Splinterlands players, guilds, and investors.

To assist the broader network, we also maintain a geographically distributed, high-availability snapshot service that helps other validators sync efficiently:
*   **Full Node Snapshot:** `https://snapshots.monstermarket.io/snapshot-full.zip`
*   **Light Node Snapshot:** `https://snapshots.monstermarket.io/snapshot-light.zip`

Furthermore, our team actively monitors, reviews, and contributes to the open-source validator codebase to help ensure ongoing network stability and security.

### Cross-Chain Solutions (The Bridge)
During a period when the community required a more cost-effective and reliable cross-chain solution, we developed and deployed a dedicated DEC and SPS bridge to the BNB Chain, fully funded by our investors. This initiative provided critical liquidity and reduced friction for players when they needed it most. We have recently paused this service, as we proudly recognize and utilize the excellent native bridge now offered directly by the SPS DAO.

### Technical Consulting & Open-Source Contributions
Beyond Splinterlands-specific infrastructure, we operate the ecosystem's most widely utilized Hive-Engine RPC (`enginerpc.com`), which facilitates the daily transactions of countless Splinterlands players. Our commitment to the broader Web3 gaming space is reflected in our ongoing creation of, and contributions to, numerous open-source projects that form the backbone of the community's daily experience.

## Let’s Keep Building Together

The Splinterlands community is the backbone of everything we do at MonsterMarket. We aren't just developers; we are players, investors, and massive fans of this ecosystem. 

To continue providing high-tier infrastructure, SVaaS, and marketplace features, we need the community's backing. By voting for this proposal, you are allowing us to keep earning market fees, which directly fund the maintenance and expansion of the tools you use every single day. 

**Ready to help us level up?**
Please visit the **[Splinterlands Proposals](https://splinterlands.com/dashboard/proposals)** page and cast your vote. Every single vote counts, no matter the size of your staked SPS. 

Thank you for being part of our journey.

title.body:
The MSCI reclassification deserves more attention than it typically gets in coverage like this. The May 2027 effective date is the critical detail -- this isn't a passive price event, it's a forced rebalancing trigger for every fund that benchmarks to MSCI Developed Markets.

The interesting window is the 12-18 months before the effective date. Index funds can't add Greek equities until reclassification completes, but active managers who front-run index inclusions typically start building positions well ahead of the deadline. The MSCI announcement is effectively the starting gun for that positioning.

There's also a simultaneous buyer/seller dynamic worth tracking: EM-dedicated funds will need to exit (Greek equities fall out of their mandate), while DM funds will need to add. That transition can create counterintuitive volatility around the actual reclassification date even when the directional trend is clear. Portugal's 1997 MSCI upgrade had some of this dynamic.

Worth watching whether the drachma-era debt overhang narrative finally gets repriced alongside the structural improvements you're describing.

title.body: The Powell angle here reframes what \

actually means. Central banks have always had to negotiate with political reality -- the Fed's dual mandate itself is a political construct -- but staying on as governor signals that Powell sees these legal attacks as an institutional threat worth defending against, not just a personal one.\n\nThe \
language is the tell. A Fed Chair publicly describing coordinated legal pressure as institutional damage is an unusual break from the traditional \

posture. That posture has been the foundation of central bank credibility for decades.

There's a longer-term signal here that doesn't get discussed enough: every time a major central bank has to publicly defend its independence, it weakens the reference point for everything priced in that currency. The Fed's authority rests on perceived independence. If that perception erodes -- even slowly -- the implicit argument for non-sovereign monetary alternatives picks up a quiet data point.

Not sure this moves markets in the short term. But the trend matters more than any single event.

title.title: Garden Update: The Colorful Roses on My Front Porch
title.body:
/>

Welcome to my front porch 😊

For a long time, I only shared my orchids with you. I love my orchids very much. But things are changing now. My roses are taking over the porch. They are getting healthier and healthier every day. It is so nice to see them every morning. We have many colors like red, bright pink, and soft pink.

<table style=\

>

* * * * * * We grow our roses in plastic pots and containers. This makes it easy to move them around. For the soil, we use a special mix. We combine garden soil with compost. This helps the plants stay strong. We also have a special way to water them. We use rice water. This is the water we use to wash the rice before we cook it. We do not throw it away. We give it to the roses and the orchids instead. They seem to like it a lot. My mom also has a secret fertilizer. You might not believe it, but she uses urine 😅. It sounds funny, but it really works. During the summer, the heat was very strong. The sun was too hot for the plants to bear. The leaves started to fall one by one. The plants looked very sad. Then, my mom used her secret fertilizer. After she watered them with it, the roses became healthy again. They grew new leaves and many beautiful flowers. 👍 * * * * * * We have a few types of roses on our porch. Let me tell you about them 😉 First are the red roses. We actually have two kinds of red. One is a very dark red and the flowers are bigger. The other one is a blood red color. Right now, only the blood red ones are blooming. These flowers are very interesting. When the flower gets old and withers, it turns into a purple color. The leaves on this plant are small. When the leaves are new, they look reddish. Then they turn light green. When they are fully grown or mature, they are dark green.

/> * * * * * * Next are the bright pink roses. These are a bit smaller than the blood red roses. But here is a surprise, the leaves are actually bigger. The new leaves are light green. As they get mature, they turn into a nice dark green color.

/> * * * * * * Lastly, are the light pink roses. These roses are my favorite because they are the biggest of all. The flowers are very large and soft. The leaves are also different. They are a bit rounded. They have little grooves on the edges. Just like the others, the new leaves are light green and the mature leaves are dark green.
/> * * * * * * I am so happy with our little rose garden. It makes our house look so bright and happy. Seeing the new leaves and buds grow makes all the hard work worth it!

>Texts and Images by @vvodjiu
The lead photo was edited on Canva
All photos were edited on Lightroom for minimal enhancements

title.title: ¡Feliz día internacional de la danza! 💖 [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos!! ¿Como han estado?? Espero que muy bien, por mi parte estoy bien gracias a Dios, un poco cansada demás por la llegada adelantada de mi amiga la que viene mensual y sin falta jajaja, justo cuando es el día de la danza, pero eso no me freno!! Pues tenía un compromiso muy importante, no solo rodearme de todos aquellos que aman y hacen danza en Margarita, sino también con Bianca, quien este día sería homenajeada como la mejor alumna del año en la academia, quien no falto a ensayos, cumplió con las reglas de la academia y se esforzó tanto que su cambio fue notorio, estamos felices de haberla escogido, pues aunque le falta mucho por recorrer, se ha esforzado mucho para mejorar y eso hay que reconocerlo. El evento en sí comenzó a las 3 de la tarde, los asientos estaban asignados y el teatro estaba recién “ayudado”, es decir, cambio la directiva, por ende se vio un cambio positivo en la estética del sitio, decoración, iluminación y una pantalla de fondo, la cual no estaba antes, eso es muy bueno, se dieron reconocimientos a profesores, hubo mensajes hermosos de aquellos que no están en el país, pero que fueron pioneros de la danza en la isla, se bailaron muchos géneros y disfrutamos cada momento, una tarde muy bonita y memorable para celebrar este día tan importante, felicidades a todos mis colegas, siempre amaré verlos brillar y hacer arte, sigamos haciendo del mundo uno más divertido, apasionado y expresivo con cada movimiento!!.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hello friends!! How have you been?? I hope you're all doing well. I'm doing well, thank God, though a little tired because my friend, who comes every month without fail, arrived early, right on Dance Day! But that didn't stop me!! I had a very important commitment, not only to be surrounded by all those who love and practice dance in Margarita, but also to honor Bianca, who was being recognized as the best student of the year at the academy. She didn't miss a single rehearsal, followed the academy's rules, and worked so hard that her improvement was remarkable. We're so happy we chose her, because even though she still has a long way to go, she's worked incredibly hard to improve, and that deserves recognition. The event itself began at 3 p.m. Seating was assigned, and the theater had recently been \

—that is, the management had changed. Consequently, there was a positive change in the venue's aesthetics, decor, lighting, and a new backdrop screen, which wasn't there before. This was wonderful. Teachers were recognized, and there were beautiful messages from those who are no longer in the country but were pioneers of dance on the island. Many genres were danced, and we enjoyed every moment. It was a beautiful and memorable afternoon to celebrate this important day. Congratulations to all my colleagues; I will always love seeing you shine and create art. Let's continue making the world a more fun, passionate, and expressive place with every movement!

title.title: Як штучний інтелект вчиться думати як хімік: нова ера синтезу молекул
title.body: >Знаєте, що мене завжди вражало в роботі хіміків? Це не просто змішування речовин у колбі. Це справжнє стратегічне мистецтво, де один неправильний крок — і вся схема йде під три чорти. Ти сидиш над молекулою, яка має врятувати життя, і думаєш: як її зібрати з простіших шматків, не зруйнувавши при цьому все чутливе? Раніше на це йшли роки досвіду. Тепер з’являється інструмент, який дозволяє говорити з комп’ютером як з колегою-хіміком.

>Дослідники з Федеральної політєхнічної школи Лозанни (EPFL) під керівництвом Філіпа Шваллера зробили те, що ще кілька років тому звучало як наукова фантастика. Вони створили платформу Synthegy — систему, де великі мовні моделі (LLM) не намагаються самі генерувати молекули, а розумно керують перевіреними хімічними алгоритмами. Це як досвідчений наставник, який стоїть за плечима молодого лаборанта і підказує: «Тут краще зробити кільце раніше» або «Уникай зайвого захисту цієї групи, бо втратиш вихід».

\n\n

>Я розмовляв з друзями-хіміками, і вони всі сходяться в одному: ретросинтез — це пекло. Ти починаєш з готової складної молекули і йдеш назад, намагаючись розібрати її на простіші будівельні блоки. Кожне рішення — вибір реакції, момент утворення кільця, захист чутливих груп — може зруйнувати весь план. Комп’ютери добре перебирають мільйони варіантів, але їм бракує тієї самої «хімічної інтуїції», яку набуваєш за роки біля лабораторного столу.

>Synthegy вирішує це елегантно. Хімік просто пише інструкцію звичайними словами: «Хочу, щоб кільце утворилося на ранньому етапі» або «Мінімум захисних груп, бо вони дорогі». Система генерує купу можливих маршрутів за допомогою традиційних алгоритмів, перетворює їх у текст і дає LLM оцінити, наскільки добре кожен варіант відповідає твоїм побажанням. Потім — ранжування, пояснення і фільтрація. Ніяких складних фільтрів і правил, про які згадував перший автор роботи Андрес М. Бран. Просто говориш — і отримуєш розумні варіанти.

\n\n

>Але це тільки одна частина. Друга — механізми реакцій. Кожна реакція — це рух електронів, маленькі кроки, які визначають, чи спрацює все на практиці. Тут Synthegy теж розкладає все на елементарні етапи, а модель оцінює правдоподібність. Можна додавати умови реакції або гіпотези експерта — усе текстом.

>Мені особливо сподобалося, як вони перевірили систему. У подвійному сліпому тесті 36 хіміків дали 368 оцінок, і в середньому їхні думки співпадали з висновками Synthegy у 71,2% випадків. Це дуже солідний результат. Система вміє знаходити зайві етапи захисту, оцінювати, чи реальна реакція, і віддавати пріоритет ефективним шляхам.

>Уявіть собі практичне застосування. Розробка нового ліки — це часто роки і мільйони доларів на проби та помилки. З таким інструментом хімік може швидко ітерувати ідеї, тестувати стратегії і концентруватися на творчій частині, а не на рутинному перебиранні варіантів. Це особливо важливо для складних природних сполук або матеріалів для сонячних панелей, батарей, нових полімерів.

>Звичайно, не все ідеально. Автори чесно зазначають, що більші моделі працюють краще, а менші ще мають обмеження. LLM не замінять хіміка — вони стають потужним помічником, який розуміє мову стратегії. Це важливо, бо раніше штучний інтелект у хімії часто страждав від «чорного ящика»: видавав відповідь, але не міг пояснити чому.

>Synthegy переосмислює роль AI. Замість того, щоб намагатися бути генератором всього і вся, він стає розумним суддею і навігатором. Це робить передові обчислювальні інструменти доступними для ширшого кола дослідників, а не тільки для тих, хто досконало володіє програмуванням і специфічним софтом.

>Бран у коментарі підкреслив ключову річ: зв’язок між плануванням синтезу і механізмами реакцій завжди був цікавим. Зазвичай механізми допомагають відкривати нові реакції, які потім дозволяють синтезувати нові молекули. Тепер є єдиний інтерфейс на природній мові, який закриває цей розрив.

>Я думаю, ми стоїмо на порозі справжньої революції. Уявіть лабораторію майбутнього, де молодий науковець без двадцятирічного досвіду може конкурувати з ветеранами завдяки розумному AI-помічнику. Це не заміна людини, а розширення її можливостей. І це, мабуть, найкраще, що може дати технологія.
>Звісно, попереду ще багато роботи — покращення точності, інтеграція з роботизованими системами синтезу, етичні питання доступу до таких інструментів. Але перший крок зроблено, і він вражає.

title.title: The Cross Is Foolish...
title.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfBo1qny7WHz185XGMi3WkmLLxmtjBBKqhiayKhPAnfy3/7bbb735272a139040de1df9ee231dea1)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=jongolson/02253ed7)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=jongolson/02253ed7)


---

I have some big plans for this verse by verse look into Scripture.

So here's how we will prayerfully go through this adventure.

**The Book(s)** - 1 & 2 Corinthians

**The Method** - Grab a 'big messge' from each chapter of these two books, and discuss it.  I will also be writing this down within my journal, which I described in yesterday's post.

**The Plan** - There are a total of 29 chapters in these two books.  I won't be going had each day because the idea behind this is to take our time with each chapter, and prayerfully look into what God is telling us in each one.  So while the journey won't be 29 consecutive daays, it will have 29 'episodes'.

I pray this is a blessing to everyone that follows along with our little journey through Scripture.  And by God's grace, it helps us all get closer to God.

---

title.title: [ESP-ING] Visiting Daka
title.body:
>



Nos fuimos a ver precios en Daka  esta tienda la cambiaron de lugar, es decir la mudaron e hicieron una más grande, me gusta esta tienda pues hay de todo, y fuimos fue a buscar un precio para una persona peeo aprovechamos para ver algunos precios para nosotros, este Daka es un lugar de compras que está a novel nacional y tiene buenos precios.


Una decepción fue el entrar ybque no hubiera aire, el calor era bastanta, luego pense que al irme que era por la luz quizás en ese lugar no había luz en ese momento, con tanto racionamiento que estamos teniendo , pero luego me pregunté ¿como es posible que una tienda tan grande no tuviera una buena planta donde prendieron un aire, pero todos los electrodomésticos de exhibición estaban encendidos, como televisores, radios, eso no se si influirá 🤔.


 Aproveche de tomar una foto a la fachada y desde ese lugar donde estaba se puede ver la redoma del Avión de Maracay, un lugar bastante reconocido por ser la entrada a la ciudad de Maracay o la ciudad Jardín, pronto traeré algo de esto, la fachada de Daka es imponente me encanta su estructura moderna y lo alto que se ve,  tener vidrios lo hace ver muy elegante.


Cuando uno va a este tipo de lugares quisiera ir con mucho dinero en el bolsillo ya que uno quiere llevarse todo, en este caso me gusto un proyector que alli habia, y quiero un teléfono nuevo ya que el mio esta presentando fallas, por lo que esa es una nueva meta, aproveche de ver algunos y asi ver los precios, me gusta comparar precios con varias tiendas, aunque igual esto no sería de inmediato sino a largo plazo.

Y ustedes ya han visitado Daka??

title.title: ¿Éxito o sacrificio? La trampa de creer que una mujer tiene que elegir [Esp/Eng]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUDLkHiag1kbhkTynhKqwDrcGWCsZrqs7C6AbyjXzGqpQ/1777608773118.jpg)



***
***
Hace unos días, el amigo @emiliorios publicó una reflexión que me quedó dando vueltas en la cabeza. Hablaba de esas veces en que las mujeres debemos \

partes de nuestra vida para volvernos empoderadas o profesionalmente exitosas.\n\nSi miramos bien, ¿quién no sacrifica algo al perseguir un sueño? Sea hombre o mujer, dedicarse a algo grande implica dejar ir otras cosas, pero el problema no es ese. El problema es que, cuando se trata de nosotras, el relato suele venir con un añadido: \

. Esto se aborda como si existiera una balanza donde un triunfo académico o profesional solo pudiera subir si del otro lado baja algo esencial de lo que supuestamente deberíamos ser.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaywtfR18UPdPJ3RPKgXZFUfoTddu1CA62M4KLjk5qL5f/1777608903398.jpg)


***
Yo soy médico, neuróloga, escritora y madre, y podría hablar de mí, pero prefiero hacer lo que más me inspira: hablar de las mujeres extraordinarias que me rodean.

Tengo una amiga que hace poco más de un año se convirtió en Doctora en Ciencias Lingüísticas. Ella es madre, es hija. ¿Habrá sacrificado mucho para lograr ese grado? A lo mejor sí, probablemente madrugadas, fines de semana, momentos de ocio, pero cuando la veo explicarle a su hija por qué estudiar el origen de las palabras es tan hermoso como plantar un árbol, no veo sacrificio, veo coherencia.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvpRW7ivDD5qY7FkHpNXqfDvFxqhziGibugweW6YDJvB/1777608903553.jpg)



***
Tengo otra amiga que es madre, escritora, artesana y, además, tiene una discapacidad físico-motora importante que no le ha impedido brillar en eventos nacionales, ser aplaudida y dejar huella donde va. ¿Habrá tenido que sacrificar mucho? Sin dudas que sí, pero cada vez que la veo reír mientras trabaja con sus manos, pensando en su nieta, sé que esa palabra le queda pequeña, pues lo que ella hace no es sacrificarse, es redefinir lo posible.

Y luego están mis amigas neurocirujanas, psicólogas haciendo su doctorado, escritoras laureadas internacionalmente, abogadas que son madres y varias son cabezas de familia que sostienen economías, crían hijos, escriben tesis, operan vidas, viajan por el mundo. ¿Habrán sacrificado tanto? Por supuesto que han dejado cosas atrás porque todos lo hacemos, pero insinuar que para que una mujer sea exitosa tiene que renunciar a ser madre o esposa o hija... eso ya no es realismo.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS7T75qhmnMFJX2Zi959pfK7zi5GDXfFY6m4CkttNyV6F/1777609128624.jpg)



***
La verdadera igualdad por la que tanto hemos luchado no consiste en que las mujeres podamos \
a costa de nuestra felicidad, consiste en que nadie dé por sentado lo que tenemos que perder para ganar.\n\nNo quiero que nadie me pregunte \

y que la respuesta, sea la que sea, no venga con un pero.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTwQgtePTxJ9jwUQcw4iaEXXz1rJAtgWCYpFMXLdRMDp/1777609128813.jpg)


***
En fin, prefiero que cambiemos el foco, pues no se trata de cuánto sacrificamos nosotras, se trata de por qué todavía hay quien espera que lo hagamos.

<center>🌼</center>
<center>🌼</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1776476176416.jpg)

## <center>Success or Sacrifice? The Trap of Believing a Woman Has to Choose </center>



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyAqP9PjYL1ECHN83n3q18qAvrv9qY4Ur7tbiJF2Qcmh/1777608773231.jpg)




***
***



A few days ago, my friend @emiliorios shared a reflection that stayed on my mind. He talked about those times when women are expected to \

parts of our lives in order to become empowered or professionally successful.\n\nIf we look closely, who doesn't sacrifice something when pursuing a dream? Whether a man or a woman, dedicating yourself to something big means letting go of other things. But that is not the problem. The problem is that, when it comes to us women, the narrative often comes with an extra twist: \

This is presented as if there were a scale where an academic or professional achievement could only go up if something essential to what we are supposedly meant to be goes down.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaywtfR18UPdPJ3RPKgXZFUfoTddu1CA62M4KLjk5qL5f/1777608903398.jpg)



***
I am a physician, a neurologist, a writer, and a mother, and I could talk about myself, but I prefer to do what inspires me most: talk about the extraordinary women around me.

I have a friend who just over a year ago became a Doctor in Linguistic Sciences. She is a mother, and she is a daughter. Did she sacrifice a lot to earn that degree? Maybe yes, probably early mornings, weekends, moments of leisure. But when I see her explaining to her daughter why studying the origin of words is as beautiful as planting a tree, I do not see sacrifice. I see coherence.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvpRW7ivDD5qY7FkHpNXqfDvFxqhziGibugweW6YDJvB/1777608903553.jpg)


***
I have another friend who is a mother, a writer, an artisan, and also has a significant physical motor disability that has not stopped her from shining at national events, being applauded, and leaving her mark wherever she goes. Did she have to sacrifice a lot? Without a doubt, yes. But every time I see her laugh while working with her hands, thinking about her granddaughter, I know that word falls short, because what she does is not sacrificing herself. It is redefining what is possible.

And then there are my friends who are neurosurgeons, psychologists working on their doctorates, internationally acclaimed writers, lawyers who are also mothers, and several are heads of their households who support economies, raise children, write theses, operate on lives, and travel the world. Have they sacrificed so much? Of course they have left things behind, because we all do. But suggesting that for a woman to be successful she must give up being a mother or a wife or a daughter... that is no longer realism.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS7T75qhmnMFJX2Zi959pfK7zi5GDXfFY6m4CkttNyV6F/1777609128624.jpg)


***
The true equality that we have fought so hard for is not about women being able to \
at the cost of our happiness. It is about no one taking for granted what we have to lose in order to win.\n\nI do not want anyone to ask me, \
I want them to ask me, \
and for the answer, whatever it is, not to come with a \

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTwQgtePTxJ9jwUQcw4iaEXXz1rJAtgWCYpFMXLdRMDp/1777609128813.jpg)


***
In short, I prefer that we shift the focus, because it is not about how much we sacrifice. It is about why there are still those who expect us to do so.

I have the same exact controller. The Akai MPKmini. My 2nd-gen 2i4 has actual MIDI ports, but I haven't had the chance to use them yet because the MPKmini does MIDI over USB. I've not done much recording of guitar. When I make music on Linux I usually use LMMS, and digital instruments. I used to only use my own music in my videos, but it's not everyone's cup of tea lol. So I started using Youtube's music mostly, but I still manage to slip some of my own into the videos.

I also have a Korg Monologue with MIDI in/out's, but I haven't had a chance to try them out. It also has MIDI over USB, and if I was controlling digital instruments I'd reach for the Akai usually since it doesn't need to plug into the wall.
I think the actual MIDI ports might be most useful when going from synthesizer to synthesizer, but it was more important in the 80's and early 90's because MIDI over USb didn't exist yet. 
So the in/out on the back of my Scarlet I assume is for older synthesizers if you wanted to attach them as a controller you'd have to use the Scarlet if they didn't have a USB.

title.title: Pokhara Must-Visit! Phewa Lake and the International Mountain Museum
title.body:
>Finally arrived in Pokhara after a 7-hour journey! All the tiredness of the day melted away at the sight of Phewa Lake's night view. I guess I traveled all that way just for this beautiful moment. ^^

* * * Hello, this is rara❤️. I’m so happy to share my story with you! Finally, I've arrived in Pokhara! First, I had some delicious wood-fired pizza, and then I headed out for a stroll by the nearby lake. It's actually one of the main reasons people fall in love with traveling to Pokhara. Let me tell you all about my first day here!

/> Whenever I come to Phewa Lake, I usually go for walks or morning jogs, but being here in the evening for the first time made me even more excited. Watching so many people dining, exercising, and relaxing by the lakeside reminded me of the Han River in Korea. After a 7-hour drive over bumpy roads, being here makes all that effort feel worth it.

/>\n\nA local friend who traveled with us recommended this place, mentioning that they sell pizzas baked in a wood-fired oven. From the moment I entered, I was amazed by the huge oven and the large number of people making pizzas in front of it. I secretly thought, \

but I was shocked by the price once again. Despite being handmade in a wood-fired oven, each pizza was only about 4,000 KRW. I was so surprised by how affordable it was! Our group ended up ordering and eating almost more than 10 pizzas.\n\n
/> The restaurant tables were open toward the street, so it was wonderful to be able to watch the view outside. The weather was also perfect—neither too cold nor too hot—which made me feel so happy.

/> The toppings and visual appearance seemed quite ordinary, but they were actually incredibly delicious. I think we tried so many different kinds. Even though I was full, I just couldn't stop eating.
/> After a delicious meal, we walked for about 20 minutes to reach the lake.
/> It wasn't a display of flashy lights, but the night view with Nepal's unique atmosphere was so incredibly beautiful.

/>\n\nActually, I really wanted to ride the Ferris wheel, but the speed was incredible. I've seen people on YouTube who go trekking in the Himalayas riding it, and it seemed about 3 to 4 times faster than the ones in Korea. They even call it the \
I was so scared that I couldn't even dream of trying it.\n\n
/> On my way back from the walk, I spotted a butcher shop and was startled to see a pig's head just sitting there.

/> When I go to Nepal, this is the brand where I always buy gifts. I found these handmade bags from WSDO, a social enterprise that supports the independence of Nepalese women, which is why I love this brand so much. The natural textures and unique patterns created through traditional weaving are truly charming, and every time I see these bags, I can feel the warm touch of Nepal. In fact, I have many small wallet-bags from this brand that I’ve been using for over 5 years, and they are incredibly durable, high-quality, and beautiful. My friends who received them as gifts even ask me when I’m going back and request that I buy more for them next time!

/> I just took this photo myself. I'm still using it today; in fact, I use it every single day. Out of all the bags and wallets I own, I think this is by far the most durable. It’s so good that I already want to go on my 9th trip to Nepal just to buy more of these!

/> The next morning, I woke up early to go for a run around Phewa Lake. I went up to the rooftop hoping to catch a glimpse of the snowy mountains, but instead of the snow-capped peaks, a blazing sun greeted me.
/> The next morning, I woke up early again and went for a run around Phewa Lake.

/> I visited the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara. It’s a fascinating place where you can see everything from the history of Himalayan mountaineering to the diverse cultures of Nepal's ethnic groups.

/> The museum was incredibly spacious, featuring everything from the gear used for mountain climbing to stunning photographs of the Himalayas. I truly believe it’s a must-visit place if you go to Pokhara. While it's impossible to know everything about the Himalayas, I was able to see and learn so much during my visit.

/> After exploring the museum, I had a delicious cup of coffee at the café in the outside park and truly healed. It was so nice to see students filming shorts in the park—it added such a lively and wonderful vibe to the atmosphere.

/> On this 8th trip, I visited so many places—from Kathmandu and Pokhara to Hetauda, Raniganj, and Sauraha—spending nearly a month there. Among them, I think I stayed in Pokhara the longest and enjoyed the trip to the fullest. I'll write more about Pokhara later, so I'll stop here for today! Writing this brings back all those memories, and I feel a strong urge to go on my 9th trip soon. Nepal is love and truly my second home.

/>\n\nThe story of Pokhara, my second home, is just beginning! In the next post, I’ll share more about the hidden gems of Pokhara that I discovered while staying there for the longest part of my month-long journey. From the peaceful lake early in the morning to the local life I encountered in Hetauda and Sauraha, please look forward to more of my vivid travel records!

title.title: Retaliation is never the best way to address school bullying | Loh #286
title.body: > School Bullying is something to be severely frowned at. Bullying is basically aggressive behaviour towards somebody especially when there's a power imbalance and it can be repetitive. It's something that is common in schools. School bullying can take several forms. It can be physical where physical harm is inflicted on the victim.

/> [Image Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/child-is-sitting-jeans-in-the-door-1816400/) It could be verbal where the bully says hurtful and bad things to the victim. There's also an indirect version of this where the bully verbally spreads fake or terrible information about the victim. Then there's cyber bullying. School bullying, no matter the form, is capable of leaving a lasting effect on the person being bullied. It can greatly diminish their self esteem, they can suffer physical injuries, and mental health could take a hit. Sometimes, they become suicidal. In fact, the child's academic performance could decline drastically because of the emotional and mental effect of bullying. This is why I think there should be a zero tolerance policy for bullying in schools. If I had a child who is being bullied in school, I would want that child to have the courage and feel safe enough to report it to me. When they report to me, I would advise that child not to retaliate. Rather, the child should always have the courage to speak up, tell someone older, perhaps a teacher or a parent. I know some people would advise their child to fight back, but that can lead to more violence. It can lead to something worse. It could escalate the entire situation. I believe that one shouldn't correct one wrong with more wrong. I want to be the kind of parent whose child would be very free to tell anything, including when they are being bullied at school. I would build that courage in my kid to speak up always about bullying even if my child isn't the bully. Also, I would make sure that the bully faces consequences for such an act. This is to ensure that the child changes their ways so they don't take such behaviour to the larger society and because a menace both to themselves and the members of society. I recommend that teachers should be well trained to spot and deal with cases of school bullying. The effect it can have on a kid can be very damaging even for the long term. In summary, bullying can take different forms. How I handle a case of bullying is important. I'm not an advocate of retaliation when it comes to school bullying. It can cause more harm. The best option for me is always to speak out and report to someone.

title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g550c36c7f8757958b8b6206d406dc11baa84359b51876daa7b3adbcadde393a7ba631bf5a81ba4a9b6dc87fbd03e715942adcfef13324e22e92dc47bdbd84326_640.jpg)</center>

***

当然可以！以下是一个关于自然的博客主题建议，使用Markdown格式书写：

```markdown
# 四季的魅力：自然的变换与生命的轮回

## 引言
自然界的四季变化不仅是气候的转变，更是生命的轮回。每一个季节都有其独特的魅力和生态特征，影响着动植物的生长和人类的生活方式。

## 春天：万物复苏
春天是生命重生的季节。随着温度的回升，花朵开始绽放，树木抽出新芽。春雨滋润大地，给生物带来新的希望。

- **植物**：樱花、郁金香等花卉盛开，绿草如茵。
- **动物**：鸟类归来，昆虫活跃，生态系统开始复苏。

## 夏天：生机勃勃
夏天是阳光最为强烈的季节，也是生物生长最为旺盛的时期。大自然展现出其最为繁茂的一面。

- **植物**：稻田金黄，果树丰收，绿意盎然。
- **动物**：昆虫鸣叫，动物繁殖，生态活力四射。

## 秋天：丰收与沉淀
秋天是收获的季节，树叶变色，果实成熟。大自然开始为冬季做准备。

- **植物**：果实累累，树叶由绿转黄、红，形成美丽的秋景。
- **动物**：部分动物开始储存食物，准备过冬。

## 冬天：宁静与反思
冬天是自然界的沉寂期，虽然寒冷，却也有其独特的美丽。白雪覆盖大地，万物似乎进入了沉睡。

- **植物**：树木光秃，草木凋零，但根系依然在地下生长。
- **动物**：一些动物进入冬眠状态，生态系统进入休整期。

## 结语
四季的变化不仅塑造了自然的面貌，也影响了人类的文化与习俗。通过观察四季的变迁，我们可以更好地理解生命的意义与自然的奥秘。

---

希望这个主题能激发你的灵感，写出一篇关于四季与自然的精彩博客文章！
```
