title.title: Entre los colores mágicos: El Morado | One of the magical colours: Purple. 💜🪄 [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
### Entre los colores mágicos: El Morado. 


![1000183978.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tbKPKtoMLUyqPRQTEc9j5EJavQwCVQDJfKFnVgVgxtku8bjTaYR1uRYovoUWtotJbCL.jpg)


<center><sub>[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/v%c3%ada-l%c3%a1ctea-cielo-estrellas-cosmos-4526277/)</sub></center>

Hola queridos amigos de Holos & Lotus, espero que se encuentren teniendo un bonito día lleno de bienestar. Las iniciativas de @emiliorios siempre me llaman la atención, el desde su punto de vista profesional tiene la forma de traernos temas que realmente van con la armonía de la comunidad y, que nos permiten aprender más acerca de nosotros como también de los que forman parte de la comunidad de Hive. Es por esto, que me resultó interesante participar en la iniciativa de [**la importancia del color**](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/cromoterapia-o-la-importancia-del-color-elige-una-imagen-y-comparte-tus-ideas-conociendo-al-usuario-esen), pudiendo así seleccionar la imagen del color violeta o morado. 

No recuerdo muy bien desde cuándo el color morado me empezó a gustar, creo que fue desde muy pequeña, recuerdo que cuando tenía unos diez años me gustaba la ropa de ese color y también, los accesorios de niñas como las pulseras o incluso cosas para el cabello como pinzas que venían de muchos colores pero recuerdo que mi favorita era la del color morado. Luego fui creciendo y gracias a mi cantante favorito *Justin Bieber*, se me asentó más la fascinación por este color, ya que representaba al club de fans como tal. Pero siempre fue uno de los colores que me encantaba, estando en la escuela y ya siendo adolescente. 


![1000184013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23x1DmdTW3rhWPFJKUwCoWvoAdkLGEcivQG3s69jEXMX7rGHGVRWiYBgjrQmxqhKFFp2B.jpg)


Después fui teniendo más gusto por la fotografía y me gustaba muchísimo cuando veía el atardecer y también el amanecer. Ver los colores que se iban tornando en un azul y después yéndose a un púrpura hermosa, era increíble para mi verlo siempre. Creo que uno nunca se cansa de ver las cosas que le resultan bonitas o mágicas. Así me sucede todavía cuando despierto muy temprano o cuando ya estoy por cenar y veo desde la ventana de mi casa el cielo. Son esas pequeñas cosas que hacen que valga la pena volver a vivir y a sentir nuevas cosas día a día. 


![1000184017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vhyN4prorF3paKXToUmBvinN1LdauC9wdY3cRtsvasHKSEgUdpBaN8D8ggKC3bKvYdz.jpg)

![1000184018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uQvaPiUhaqqSmyMixZjr3X7pGwgE5KvDPXSJWi63uvyDDzUXd3F8n784DTezBAqLhhX.jpg)


Incluso después de adulta me empezó a gustar *Kuromi* una figura que es más para niños, pero que yo siendo adulta adoro y tengo varias cosas que algunas personas me han regalado. Creo que además de gustarme la figura de esta muñeca y de la expresión de su cara, me encanta los colores que escogieron para hacerla: entre morados, blancos y negros. Tres colores que combinan muy bien, tal vez se vea como algo un poco infantil para otras personas, pero yo disfruto de tener todas esas cosas como una colección y me conecta de nuevo con mi niña interior. El año pasado mi mamá y hermanos me regalaron varias cosas, dejare una foto para que quede evidencia 🤭💜.

Siempre me ha atraído este color, además de que se ha vuelto aún más especial ya que con el tiempo pienso que me ha hecho reconectar con versiones de mi que creía ya inexistentes, volver a conectar con aquello que me encantaba de adolescente, con aquello que me hacía sentir feliz y a la vez muy libre. En los dibujos que veo que realiza mi hermana, cuando utiliza el color morado me parecen aún más llamativos y me dan ganas de intentar dibujar algo todos los días, pero soy un poco terca y perfeccionista y al final lo termino dejando de lado, aunque el dibujo es una excelente manera de drenar emociones y de sentirnos mejor. 


![1000183994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/2423uux5QDzmgmiB5eKVMJYYXrqj5kdU6J1urexUwRVPuLYo5aeNiwLiGJ6oLHdiK9ayG.jpg)


Hay varios colores que me gustan entre ellos el verde, el azul y también el morado. Tal vez porque creo mucho en el horóscopo me gustan esos dos primeros colores que menciono, porque soy de signo tierra y pues tienen mucha relación. En cuanto al morado, me encanta como se ve en el cielo como en la imagen de referencia de la iniciativa, también como se ve en la ropa, en el arte y en el maquillaje también es un color muy bonito y que se puede combinar con muchos otros. Me da la sensación de regresarme a momentos de felicidad y de pura inocencia. Adoro el morado 💜. 


![1000077102.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uFRgtQmQscydboypCDH12XGCwqAsjrqHxLAmpKsx3q5d9B3ApSvCocs5EuvE13Bc6XB.png)


### One of the magical colours: Purple. 

![1000183978.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tbKPKtoMLUyqPRQTEc9j5EJavQwCVQDJfKFnVgVgxtku8bjTaYR1uRYovoUWtotJbCL.jpg)


<center><sub>[source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/v%c3%ada-l%c3%a1ctea-cielo-estrellas-cosmos-4526277/)</sub></center>

Hello dear friends of Holos & Lotus, I hope you are having a beautiful day full of well-being. The initiatives by @emiliorios always catch my attention; from his professional point of view, he has a way of bringing us topics that truly resonate with the harmony of the community, allowing us to learn more about ourselves as well as those who are part of the Hive community. This is why I found it interesting to participate in the initiative [**The Importance of Color**](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/cromoterapia-o-la-importancia-del-color-elige-una-imagen-y-comparte-tus-ideas-conociendo-al-usuario-esen), choosing the image of the color violet or purple.

I don’t remember exactly when I started liking the color purple; I think it was since I was very little. I remember that when I was about ten years old, I liked clothes in that color, as well as girls' accessories like bracelets or even hair clips that came in many colors—but I remember my favorite was the purple one. As I grew up, and thanks to my favorite singer *Justin Bieber*, my fascination with this color became even more established, as it represented the fan club itself. But it was always one of the colors I loved, both in school and as a teenager.

![1000184013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23x1DmdTW3rhWPFJKUwCoWvoAdkLGEcivQG3s69jEXMX7rGHGVRWiYBgjrQmxqhKFFp2B.jpg)

Later on, I developed a deeper taste for photography, and I loved it when I saw the sunset and the sunrise. Seeing the colors turn into blue and then transition into a beautiful purple was always incredible for me to witness. I believe one never tires of seeing things that they find beautiful or magical. It still happens to me when I wake up very early or when I am about to have dinner and I look at the sky from my window. It’s those little things that make it worth living and feeling new things day by day.

![1000184017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vhyN4prorF3paKXToUmBvinN1LdauC9wdY3cRtsvasHKSEgUdpBaN8D8ggKC3bKvYdz.jpg)

![1000184018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uQvaPiUhaqqSmyMixZjr3X7pGwgE5KvDPXSJWi63uvyDDzUXd3F8n784DTezBAqLhhX.jpg)

Even as an adult, I started to like *Kuromi*, a character that is more for children, but as an adult, I adore her and have several items that people have given me. I think that besides liking the character's design and her facial expression, I love the colors they chose for her: purples, whites, and blacks. These three colors combine very well; perhaps it looks a bit childish to others, but I enjoy having all those things as a collection, and it reconnects me with my inner child. Last year, my mother and siblings gave me several items; I’ll leave a photo here as evidence 🤭💜.

I have always been attracted to this color, and it has become even more special because, over time, I feel it has helped me reconnect with versions of myself that I thought no longer existed—reconnecting with what I loved as a teenager, with what made me feel happy and, at the same time, very free. In the drawings I see my sister create, when she uses the color purple, they seem even more striking to me, and they make me want to try drawing something every day. However, I am a bit stubborn and a perfectionist, and I end up putting it aside, even though drawing is an excellent way to drain emotions and feel better.

![1000183994.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/2423uux5QDzmgmiB5eKVMJYYXrqj5kdU6J1urexUwRVPuLYo5aeNiwLiGJ6oLHdiK9ayG.jpg)

There are several colors I like, including green, blue, and also purple. Perhaps because I believe a lot in horoscopes, I like those first two colors I mentioned, as I am an earth sign and they are closely related. As for purple, I love how it looks in the sky—like in the reference image for the initiative—and also how it looks in clothing, art, and makeup; it is a very beautiful color that can be combined with many others. It gives me the feeling of returning to moments of happiness and pure innocence. I love purple 💜.


![1000077102.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23uFRgtQmQscydboypCDH12XGCwqAsjrqHxLAmpKsx3q5d9B3ApSvCocs5EuvE13Bc6XB.png)

Having a lot of RAM is a game-changer for video-editing.
I've also used Flowblade, and there was a time when it seemed to outperform Kdenlive when actually editing on the timeline. I haven't used newest versions of it so that could have improved a lot I don't know. But during the pandemic Kdenlive had a great-leap forward with people seeming to dedicate a lot of time to it.
I'm using an old Intel Xeon 6-core/12 threads & a Nvidia Quadro GPU(2GB VRAM) and I have 32GB of DDR3. Old hardware that was decent when it was new. 
Years ago I did probably 6 or 7 of my videos with Flowblade, but I would honestly feel held back by it if I had to use it now.
Granted video editing styles are very different for everyone.

title.title: Growing tomatoes for vegetables
title.body:
![c0318b8e-0b68-42b2-bfe8-1f84bfa3b314.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXeZKn6QkRiJb2NY3U64tMANGpPGw2ujjTCbjmS5M7Di7/c0318b8e-0b68-42b2-bfe8-1f84bfa3b314.jpg)


Friends, how are you? I hope everyone is well, and I am well too, Alhamdulillah. Today I will introduce you to some crops in our village, especially vegetables. Today, I will introduce you to the tomatoes that have been planted in our village house.

![f3eec424-4c32-4cc5-85bc-fd40b10b4a45.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVd9RgYTdGS3phdtSUyjSmcgCCHhGCGv6jwqRooZDPrRY/f3eec424-4c32-4cc5-85bc-fd40b10b4a45.jpg)

![e66f9a7f-e95e-44c3-9c3f-0c8b81f12806.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdYBcQRStxpibDpn8rmjrTMXJeFnDNbempktppVFtrM6t/e66f9a7f-e95e-44c3-9c3f-0c8b81f12806.jpg)

In Bangladesh, a large number of adulterated and formalin-laced vegetables are available day by day, which is why the number of diseases and ailments has increased here. Therefore, we should all prepare vegetables on our own basis and on our own initiative and produce and eat them on our own land, but that is not possible for everyone, especially those who live in cities, who do not have land to plant any crops.

![ce5c98a8-6e40-455a-99e5-d725f3858e8b.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme8jhMdTJmmtiVMhcS9ZyqkS6Z9fEwmZ6RZRthPQBdnLH/ce5c98a8-6e40-455a-99e5-d725f3858e8b.jpg)

![7097023a-1ab4-4b31-be2b-cd9b1f8d438f.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQLfcgytAPUEeQngfeSCoVXwgeWfqp3g8iSZ4ffXmy7pJ/7097023a-1ab4-4b31-be2b-cd9b1f8d438f.jpg)

Also, nowadays there are roof gardens, but the vegetables are not as plentiful as the plants planted in the ground. However, today we planted tomato plants in the land we have at our country house, and there are green and yellow tomatoes. You can see how fresh and healthy the tomatoes are here, and also, the same tomatoes are much more fun to eat.

![5318c57c-88f5-4957-835e-44568eb058f4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS9otKTzpsUE8ZHqTi9ZinRdf6hMkg8TVETLdCGHwQhTD/5318c57c-88f5-4957-835e-44568eb058f4.jpg)

![62a3845f-523c-4676-9f1c-67c17eaab498.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTYTKZ1HmRhsmqsqjJgmd4Dzb2qw9Mqpvfb6Tc6e5LwAm/62a3845f-523c-4676-9f1c-67c17eaab498.jpg)

But here, there are a lot of weeds in the tomato garden, and we have to clean them. We also have two people assigned to take care of the tomato plants, and they have to be paid every month. They also have to work hard and put in a lot of effort until they get a plant and the fruit of that plant, which is really very difficult, and many people cannot afford these hardships.

![55c30bd3-1702-47d1-848c-217297b52c4d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVo9HaxEgKPwiXJZ5D86fWKEpdLzvZ1XQWBM1dX9apBPH/55c30bd3-1702-47d1-848c-217297b52c4d.jpg)

![7e4bd77f-f1bd-411f-a863-e8632a35e023.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVSujCVnsyHQ9zgikq7CTo6Z3RP2FvFHkJZZoL9BapFpm/7e4bd77f-f1bd-411f-a863-e8632a35e023.jpg)

But finally, I will say this, especially in rural areas, many vegetables are available fresh, and even though they cost a little more, we should eat fresh vegetables and eat vegetables that do not contain formalin. Especially for children and the elderly, we must check whether the vegetables are frozen or not, as they will be more likely to get sick. We all have to monitor this and make sure that we can eat vegetables fresh and do not have any problems. I am saying goodbye today.

title.title: Splinterlands | The SALTWRAITH CORSAIR is a Little Useful Ranger
title.body:
![Kaylia Silverleaf (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23xeV9xKDbNNDHBznjogQrLCgEropPnqVMHz9StVtNaFvEEZRmhA7EsBLdiitDWe8utcf.jpg)


 --- 


### Hello Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another fresh and juicy Splinterlands post, and I hope all of you are doing pretty well in your lives and enjoying a great and energetic day with your loved ones. Now, for those of you who are actively and tirelessly playing this web3 card-based strategy game and working your ass off on building your NFT card and asset collection in splinterlands, I believe all of you have already started grinding this fresh new ranked season that was launched just today and trying to climb your way up the ranked trophy ladder to reach your goal. If we take a look at the current ranked season timer, there are still around 14 days and 10 hours left before the season reset happens. So there is plenty of time to build momentum, increase your trophy count and reach your destination, and later aim for better rewards by capturing a leaderboard position if you are feeling strong and confident. Just keep this in mind and make sure to manage your battle energy meter properly throughout the season, so that you don't end up missing them when needed the most.



 --- 


![Screenshot 2026-04-30 at 9.09.26 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/Eoc5e4gLmzWnNsYS7JT8w9eV9ygugrdFvcMpDuc8mTmP3yHBLwnuqg9ViP1j6HABqAA.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-30 at 9.11.28 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vrro8QagTgCYCfDztrTRjUVATzx1mwK39EBhgc5bsr4Loxowt5FrTvosyLdYDqUKVik.png)


 --- 



Now, talking about my own progress in the Frontier mode of this game, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league tier with a trophy count of around 2,500 after the recent season reset. My goal will be sane this time as well, which is to reach the 4,200 trophy mark first and then try to push further if possible. Since the season has just begun, there is still enough time to grind consistently.


 --- 



![Screenshot 2026-04-30 at 12.25.08 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wBxxCycFf38832wYQ5hwHegXkdWUSBPGwJkUuiwHxPCjSreziU42CfpZBFvML5EKAnF.png)


![Screenshot 2026-04-30 at 12.25.21 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wBfzMoDNG3q7nQX5tZBJ3N8hiAerFwYa7YRdC8KXMeiihBz8yf6pJFqiabpEDtjasvu.png)



 --- 



On the other hand, if we take a look at the weekly Frontier raffle, so far, I have only collected a total of 21 entries. With around 3 days and 21 hours left before the raffle draw, I will try to increase this number to somewhere between 54 and 57 entries. Let’s see how things go this time. I have also opened 3 foundation packs, which I won from yesterday's daily missions and as you can see from the screenshots above, I got myself 1 legendary, 1 epic, 1 gold foil rare archon, 1 rare, and the rest common cards. Not to mention that I am really excited and happy about this pull.



 --- 


![image-removebg-preview (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AJiuxwcrXGmS9yrFcA2y3g94hN59NmVVEuFBQK4QSP5LfegvkmvM25UkWEfTyEL.png)


 --- 



### Saltwraith Corsair

Now moving forward, let us come to the main topic of this post, as today I will be taking a closer look at another interesting monster from the Escalation edition. As you have already seen in the title and thumbnail above, today I will be talking about the Saltwraith Corsair. So if you are interested in learning more about this monster card, let us dive deeper without any further delay.

The Saltwraith Corsair is a monster type card that belongs to the Water element and it comes from the Tideborn bloodline. By rarity, this card is an Epic monster, so you will require a total of 46 CC cards in order to upgrade it to its maximum level. Now, if you want to use this monster in battles, you only need to spend 3 mana, which makes it a very flexible option for almost all types of matches, including low mana limit and Little League rulesets. The attack type of this monster is Ranged, and even though it starts with modest stats, it becomes quite useful thanks to its ability combinations. At its maximum level, this monster gains a total of three abilities that work really well together. Let us now take a closer look at its league-wise stats and abilities below to know more about this card.


 --- 



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wLx8t5g1hgTyoEmGc7YQVyv7eqR15BcU6uYDrL6umpUVJ98qkCRW7EyM4oaS5vwmfvj.png)



 --- 


#### BRONZE

At level 2, this monster holds basic stats that consist of 1 ranged attack power at 2 speed with 4 health. Even at this level, it gains a unique ability called Kindred Spirit: Stun. This ability becomes very useful when paired with other Kindred-based monsters.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AKLoFXLgq6xjqnCxrhYfr7ysL5DGNspdwvLZBW2oWLNmoBiSTxcBNaR5THWePEH.png)


`KINDRED SPIRIT: STUN` – At the start of battle, adjacent units with Kindred will gain Stun.



#### SILVER

When you upgrade this monster further to level 3, its stats remain the same, but it unlocks another important ability called Reprisal. This ability forces high-damage enemies into the spotlight, making them easier targets.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AK3dd2P98viS1KvX4W1hpytdUVeHSNVhT5Vkk67q5eH5Q1U7JTo5ftXE6w1jiLJ.png)


`REPRISAL` – If an enemy unit deals more than 5 damage in a single round, it gains Taunt and if camouflaged, is revealed.



#### GOLD

As this monster gets upgraded further and reaches level 5, its stats improve and it now carries 2 ranged attack power at 3 speed with 5 health. At this level, it also gains another strong ability called Fury. This ability works perfectly with Reprisal, creating a powerful combo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23uQiCBFNtVAuHBouXQpw876UjjsrSXqWsSUhprhkjMKA4hC3sTVhANKvNMBpji98Gmgd.png)

`FURY` – Deals double damage if the target has Taunt.



#### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

Finally, when you upgrade this monster to its maximum level of 6, its stats improve further and it now holds 3 ranged attack power at 3 speed with 5 health. Even though it does not gain a new ability at this level, the increased attack power makes it much more effective in battles.

Last but not least, I think this monster is a very underrated low-cost card. First of all, it costs only 3 mana, which means it can be used in almost any match type. For such a low cost, it offers a decent attack and solid stats. Another strong point is its Reprisal ability, which is very useful against high-damage enemy monsters. It forces them to gain Taunt and become the main target, which can shift the flow of battle. On top of that, Fury works perfectly with Reprisal, as it deals double damage to those Taunt targets, making this combo extremely effective. Finally, the Kindred Spirit ability adds another layer of strategy. If you place other Kindred monsters next to this card, they can gain Stun, which can give you even more control over the battle. Overall, I think the Saltwraith Corsair is a smart and flexible ranged monster that can bring great value for just 3 mana. What do you think?

#### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about SALTWRAITH CORSAIR. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjRvqqj6rjKZp9xk5H54AZMoSXGU8oqRBJVvWjmVq53f/image.png)</center>

### <center>Thanks for visiting my post, hope we meet again!</center>

##### <center>Stay well and keep playing Splinterlands!</center>

title.title: ✨ Quietly Creating the Life I Want
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZg3wquGUkx9aprYqVvXdMjb1oxQNjS5HJZEGWNfxzgtj/IMG_0613.jpg 

I think one of the best feelings is realizing that you’re no longer the same person you were a year ago.

Not because life suddenly became perfect…  
but because you became stronger, smarter, and more focused.

Selling online has pushed me out of my comfort zone in so many ways. I’ve had to learn patience, discipline, confidence, and how to keep going even when results take time.

And honestly?  
I’m proud of that.

Every product I upload, every customer I help, every small idea I turn into action… it’s helping me build something bigger than I imagined.

A future where I have freedom.  
Freedom with my time.  
Freedom with my money.  
Freedom to choose.

I’m still on the journey, but I can finally see the direction clearly now.

title.title: Film Review: The Desert Fox: The Story of Rommel (1951)
title.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/lwUJ6YkkfEbnjNLQuTMjts9z5by.jpg)



In contemporary Western discourse, a cynical observation often surfaces: that our collective historical memory has been relentlessly narrowed to the narrative of the Second World War. This conflict, stripped of its profound complexity, is reduced to a stark, morally unambiguous template of absolute Good versus absolute Evil—a conveniently simplistic framework that, when required, can be wielded as a potent propaganda tool for contemporary political aims. This perception is, of course, a myth. Like all potent myths, it did not emerge spontaneously but was carefully constructed, and its primary architect in the post-war decades was the dream factory of Hollywood. Few artefacts of this cinematic myth-making were as successful, influential, and intellectually insidious as the 1951 biographical drama *The Desert Fox: The Story of Rommel*. The film stands as a foundational text in the post-war rehabilitation of the Wehrmacht and a deliberate reshaping of public memory to suit the exigencies of the nascent Cold War.

The film’s origins are crucial to understanding its perspective. It is adapted from Brigadier Desmond Young’s 1950 bestseller, *Rommel: The Desert Fox*. Young, a British officer captured at the Battle of Gazala in June 1942, had a brief, personal encounter with the then-ascendant Field Marshal Erwin Rommel. Like many of his contemporaries, Young was captivated by Rommel’s reputation for military brilliance and, more importantly, by an aura of chivalric conduct that contrasted sharply with the barbarism associated with the Nazi regime. After the war, Young embarked on what might charitably be called a sympathetic investigation, interviewing Rommel’s widow, Lucie, his son Manfred, and various associates. The resulting book, a sensation in Britain, presented Rommel as the noble, professional soldier, tragically ensnared by a regime he did not wholly endorse. This narrative was catnip to Hollywood producer Nunnally Johnson, who saw in it the potential for a compelling—and commercially viable—human drama, resulting in Henry Hathaway’s 1951 film.

*The Desert Fox* opens with a bravura, almost proto-action movie sequence: a November 1941 British commando raid on Rommel’s supposed Libyan headquarters. The sequence is taut, violent, and filmed with a gritty immediacy that feels years ahead of its time. Its conclusion, where a wounded commando anxiously asks his captor if they “got him,” sets up Rommel as a mythic figure so pivotal that his mere elimination could alter the war’s course. This thrilling ‘cold open,’ however, proves to be a tonal feint. The film immediately jumps to June 1942, revealing the raid’s failure, and settles into a far drier, more didactic pace. We are shown the dramatised meeting between Rommel (James Mason) and Brigadier Young (played by Young himself, with Michael Rennie’s voiceover narration), a scene that functions less as drama and more as a framing device to legitimise the film’s forthcoming hagiography.

What follows is a selective chronicle of Rommel’s later war. The pivotal Battle of El Alamein is depicted largely through grainy stock footage, emphasising Allied material superiority. Rommel’s frustration is portrayed not as a failure of his own strategy, but as the result of Hitler’s (Luther Adler) fanatical, irrational orders to stand fast and die. Rommel’s decision to retreat against these orders is framed as an act of humane leadership, saving his men for another day. By the time the African campaign collapses in May 1943, the film has established its core dichotomy: the professional, pragmatic soldier versus the ideologically crazed dictator. This theme intensifies in the film’s second half, which focuses on the lead-up to the 20 July plot. Recalled to Europe, Rommel is visited at home by Dr. Karl Strölin (Cedric Hardwicke), who draws him into the nascent conspiracy. The film carefully deals with Rommel’s reluctance, painting him as apolitical and loyal to his oath, yet gradually awakening to the moral necessity of removing Hitler.

The D-Day landings are presented as another failure stemming from Hitler’s delusion (here, bizarrely, attributed to the advice of astrologers) rather than Allied skill or Rommel’s own strategic miscalculations. Following his injury in an Allied air attack, Rommel is convalescing when the assassination attempt fails. The film’s climax is its most powerful sequence: General Burgdorff (Everett Sloane) offers the wounded hero a grim choice—a quiet suicide with honours preserved, or a show trial and disgrace for his family. James Mason’s performance here is masterfully stoic, conveying resigned dignity as he chooses the cyanide capsule. The film concludes with the words of Winston Churchill, praising Rommel’s chivalry and genius, thus providing the ultimate British imprimatur for the myth it has just spent two hours constructing.

And it is a myth, one the film did not create but powerfully codified for a mass audience. The “Rommel myth” was spawned during the war itself, first by Nazi propaganda needing a heroic Aryan commander, and then, ironically, by the British. For figures like Churchill, a supernaturally competent Rommel served as a convenient alibi for British military incompetence in North Africa and his own strategic blunders. Post-1945, this myth was repurposed for a new geopolitical reality. The emerging Cold War required a rehabilitated West Germany as a bulwark against the Soviet Union. To facilitate this, the concept of the “clean Wehrmacht”—the idea that the regular German army was largely separate from the crimes of the SS and the Nazi party—needed promotion. *The Desert Fox* provided the perfect vehicle: Rommel was not only a genius but also noble, chivalric, and ultimately a martyr who chose the “right side of history.” His portrayed involvement with the 20 July plotters, however tenuous in reality, transformed him from a Nazi general into a proto-anti-Nazi resistance figure, thereby laundering the reputation of the entire German officer corps in the public imagination.

On a purely technical level, the film is competent. Henry Hathaway directs with the same semi-documentary flair he used in *[The House on 92nd Street](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-the-house-on-dbcb9f2c812f3)*, blending staged drama with newsreel footage. James Mason, who actively sought the role, delivers a nuanced and charismatic performance that lends credibility to the whitewashing project. Yet, the film suffers from a profound tonal schizophrenia. Its gripping opening promises a tense war film, but it swiftly devolves into a talky, stage-bound drama that prioritises argument over action. The extensive use of stock footage often feels like a cost-saving measure that distances the viewer from the drama, creating a pedagogical, even propagandistic, feel. It is a film made for an audience that lived through the war, presupposing a familiarity with names, dates, and events that would leave later generations adrift.

The reception at the time was tellingly divided. In Britain, where the public had been steeped in the Rommel legend since the desert war, the film was a success. In the United States, it performed modestly. Critics were polarised. Some praised its bravery in humanising a former enemy, seeing it as a gesture of post-war reconciliation. Others were rightly aghast at its historical revisionism. The author C.S. Forrester, in a famously scathing review, wrote that he wished he could throw grenades at the screen—a visceral rejection of the film’s sanitising agenda. This criticism hits at the film’s core dishonesty: it airbrushes Rommel’s enthusiastic support for the Nazi regime during its victorious years, his closeness to Hitler (who awarded him his field marshal’s baton), and his silence in the face of the Commando Order and other criminal directives. It reduces his late-war disillusionment to a purely military pragmatism, carefully avoiding any serious engagement with the moral catastrophe of the regime he served so effectively.

Nevertheless, *The Desert Fox* was deemed a moderate commercial success, cementing James Mason’s Hollywood stardom and leading to a reprisal of the role in 1953’s *The Desert Rats*. Its true legacy, however, is far more consequential than its box office. The film provided a compelling, emotionally resonant blueprint for the rehabilitation of German militarism. By transforming Erwin Rommel into a tragic hero, *The Desert Fox* actively shaped a politically useful narrative for the future, proving that in Hollywood’s hands, even history’s darkest chapters could be recut into a morally comforting—and deeply misleading—fable.

Ultimately, *The Desert Fox* is a well-crafted piece of propaganda, arguably more effective for its subtlety than any crude polemic. It exemplifies how cinema, under the guise of biography, can perform profound ideological work, simplifying complex historical figures and laundering uncomfortable truths to suit the needs of the present. In forging the myth of the “good German,” it contributed to a historical amnesia that continues to obscure the full, complicit nature of the Wehrmacht in the horrors of the Third Reich. 


RATING: 6/10 (++)

title.title: Enfocada en dar a conocer mi emprendimiento.🍰🍫✨💕 [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
![Enfocada en dar a conocer mi emprendimiento_20260430_230843_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSy2CjMAXAghWtZcKLRqfoPWXpdz9f9DefJfvayLWfup8/Enfocada%20en%20dar%20a%20conocer%20mi%20emprendimiento_20260430_230843_0000.jpg)

**Mi mamá murió hace casi 3 meses y luego de su fallecimiento yo decidí enfocarme en mi emprendimiento, que siempre fue nuestro porque ella me ayudaba tanto y siempre creyó que íbamos a llegar muy lejos. Y supongo que yo quedé aquí para cumplir esa promesa. Algo que ella siempre quiso hacer era vender tortas por porciones, pero yo siempre buscaba alguna excusa para no hacerlo. Luego de su muerte yo decidí hacer esto en su honor y debo decir que me ha ido muy bien y tengo mucho apoyo de mi familia y amigos. Esto me llena de orgullo y a la vez de tanta nostalgia, aún con el corazón roto aquí sigo dando lo mejor de mi pero sobre todo apostando a mi emprendimiento.**

>My mom passed away almost three months ago, and after her death, I decided to focus on my business, which was always ours because she helped me so much and always believed we would go far. And I suppose I'm here to fulfill that promise. Something she always wanted to do was sell cakes by the slice, but I always found some excuse not to. After her death, I decided to do this in her honor, and I must say it's been going very well, and I have a lot of support from my family and friends. This fills me with pride and, at the same time, with so much nostalgia. Even with a broken heart, I'm still here giving it my all, but above all, I'm committed to my business.



![IMG-20260430-WA0037.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZqXqvvZ7bjR3MRb4vKDZAGR7wKMMTQMeaS9yB7gRGrRw/IMG-20260430-WA0037.jpg)

**Siempre he amado hornear, pero hoy debo decir que hornear me está salvando la vida, pues me ayuda a estar ocupada. Haciendo la lista de cosas que debo comprar para sacar las porciones, y sinceramente espero que más personas conozcan mi emprendimiento y sobre todo me apoyen.**

>I've always loved baking, but today I have to say that baking is saving my life, as it helps keep me busy. I'm busy making lists of things I need to buy to make cakes, and I sincerely hope that more people will learn about my business and, above all, support me.



![IMG-20260430-WA0034.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd9aUHnvnWXYyewkHUZEh6b9zZ4g7i9X1DBybLKbfWAqn/IMG-20260430-WA0034.jpg)

![IMG-20260430-WA0026.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRj2hPJbGh6GEFWwyw2AhAMP1wVNck7JaVFGMZ8Q4NAVm/IMG-20260430-WA0026.jpg)

**He sacado porciones de torta marmoleada, torta volteada de piña, torta tres leches y la que más de ha vendido es la torta de chocolate decorada con Chantilly de chocolate. El Chantilly se me acabó y tuve que decorar la última porción que tenía hoy con arequipe.**

title.body:
Yes Kdenlive is the editor I use. 90% of my videos were done with Kdenlive. 
There's a few where I used Flowblade, but Kdenlive is the top for me hands down. Flowblade's stand-out feature is it has a GUI for G'MIC(a graphics library for applying effects to images). And it actually allows you to apply them to videos which is really cool. But that's not even something I actually need.

I see a lot of people who are new to Linux choosing Cachy.
They offer so many desktops I think because by casting that wide net they can appeal to anyone. 
Debian & Arch both have basically every desktop/window-manager available, but what's unique about this is you can install any of them with a few clicks.
You don't have to customize anything really. In fact, you're getting the most vanilla version of Gnome, KDE, Cinnamon, Mate what have you. The only custom things they ship are the icon pack, themes(for KDE at least, not sure about the others), and Cachy wallpapers. Plus the couple of Cachy tools/apps that are mostly about kernels, schedulers, daemons.
  They do include Fish/ZSH shells, and ZSH has Oh-My-ZSH already installed which is like a customized ZSH environment.
For people who want to game I think Cachy has a lot to offer.
It's definitely tailored towards modern hardware.
But also surprising is the amount of Vulkan graphics-drivers there are available which you are prompted for when you install the gaming packages.
I didn't recognize most of them so I had to look them up, and they're drivers for ARM GPU's, and lots of surprising older/less common chipsets that you don't necessarily find on dekstops/laptops/PC's.

Linux is definitely growing, and I don't think there's ever been a time when more people were interested in using Linux to be honest. For multiple reasons.
Chief among them is Windows 11 & Windows Copilot.

title.title: Spring reflections by the pond
title.body:
I remember this walk At the city park. The air was crisp, and the sun was just starting to warm everything up after a long winter. I loved how the clouds were playing with the light, creating such a dramatic sky. It always felt like a fresh start, you know? Seeing the new green grass and the little yellow flowers popping up made me feel so optimistic. That little duck house in the water was such a cute detail, I remember thinking how cozy it looked. I always find myself drawn to water, especially when it reflects the sky like this. It's like looking into another world, a mirror to the one above. It makes you pause and just appreciate the present.

title.title: Life's Flaming Curveballs of Doom
title.body:
This month has been absolute garbage in terms of trying to plan anything. In March I received a jury summons notifying me I've been selected to possibly serve the entire last week of this month. The only problem is the curveballs didn't stop there.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbqhSagpySrqer7Q6GUD42pJ1Gc4BUnjcTg8URzxpt21J/1777602076737.png) (Created with ChatGPT)

In addition to the jury summons, I have a team of seven people to manage. I'm required to complete three evaluations with them each month. Normally that's not a big deal at all, but in addition to jury duty I was required to attend three straight days of leadership meetings in the middle of the month.

What I'm supposed to normally take four weeks to accomplish I had to cram into two weeks. That also includes check-ins, training modules, time cards, cramming in the the last two weeks of a leadership course that overlapped with leadership meetings, and creating a succession plan for my position. To say I felt like I was burning the candle at both ends would be a laughable understatement.

Despite the odds, I got it all done. And in the end of course I was excused from jury duty, but only one day at a time, which means I couldn't plan or count on being able to do anything. This will likely go down in my memory as one of the most obnoxious moments in my life, ever. And now that it's done, it's time to pour a cold one and relax.

Despite all of the deadlines and the time crunch, everything went according to plan. It was hectic, but it worked out. The saying, \

couldn't be more true. I'm not dead. I'm alive and kicking, and going forward I'll be stronger for it. I've made it through the fire and come out of it more refined, more resilient, and better for it.\n\nWould I do it all again? Heck no! When you have no choice, though, and the flaming curveballs start coming, you either \

as Shawshank Redemption so aptly put it. To all my fellow stressed-out people trying to dodge the flaming curveballs of life, here's to you. title.title: My visit to the Carúpano amphitheater; a cultural and recreational space by the sea, with enchanting scenery (Eng - Esp)
title.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Hello fellow travelers, it's a pleasure to greet you. I hope you have an excellent and blessed weekend. I'm happy to share my visit to the Carúpano Acoustic Shell. I definitely enjoyed my trip to this beautiful city. I was able to see several charming and eye-catching places. The acoustic shell is located on the coastal strip in the El Boquete sector, along Rómulo Gallegos Avenue. This area boasts some of the city's most prominent landmarks, distinguished by the beautiful seascapes. The acoustic shell is white and serves as a stage for various cultural, recreational, and sporting activities. Its design is semicircular, and the ends rest on rectangular columns. In the photograph, you can see the main columns at the ends; they are wider and larger than the others. These columns consist of several tubes that are joined together and support this large structure. The floor is concrete, and its location offers a beautiful view of the sea and the mountains. Around the shell is a walkway lined with several sea grape trees. Along the way, I saw several specimens. In the other photograph, we see the shell's structure with the exterior support beams extending to the roof. These beams rise from the rectangular base, converge in the center, and from there, the panels that form the structure are inserted. The support beams have small sections in their centers that create several triangles or a zigzag pattern. In total, there are six exterior support beams, and the roof is located between the spaces between them. While walking through this area, I took several photographs of the beach, and I loved the view: a path of grass and rocks, with the sea lapping against the ground. This image is relaxing and one of my favorites.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hola amigos viajeros, es un placer saludarles, es deseo que tengan un excelente y bendecido fin de semana, me siento feliz de compartir mi visita a la Concha acústica Carúpano, definitivamente el viaje a esta hermosa ciudad gustó mucho, pude conocer varios lugares que por cierto son encantadores y llamativos, la concha acústica se encuentra ubicada en la cinta costera del sector El Boquete y la avenida Rómulo Gallegos, en esta franja se encuentran destacados lugares de la ciudad, que resaltan por los hermosos paisajes que ofrece el mar. La concha acústica es de color blanco y sirve de escenario para la realización de diferentes actividades culturales, recreativas y deportivas, el diseño es semicircular y las terminaciones descansan en columnas rectangulares, en la fotografía observamos las columnas principales ubicadas en los extremos, son más anchas y grandes que las otras, estas constan de varios tubos que se unen y sirven como soporte a esta gran estructura, el piso es de concreto y su ubicación ofrece una hermosa vista del mar y la montaña; alrededor de la concha se ubica una caminería con varios árboles de uvero de playa, durante el trayecto pude ver varios ejemplares, en la otra fotografía vemos la estructura de la concha con las vigas de soporte exterior hacia el techo, esta se extienden desde la base rectangular se unen en el centro y desde allí, se insertan las láminas que forman la estructura, las vigas de soporte tienen en el centro pequeños que forman varios triángulos o camino en zigzag. En total tiene seis vigas de soporte exterior y entre los espacios que forman cada una de estas se encuentra el techo, mientras caminaba por esta zona tomé varias fotografías de la playa y la vista me encantó, un camino de grama, rocas y al lado el agua del mar golpeando el terreno, esta imagen es relajante y una de mis favoritas. ![concha acústica Carúpano (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/241tUggCDgHjKPue6KuuGfneapebEv3S4G5oTwcTVDStNyWdSskbqqCiQUaHWnuzsscQt.jpeg) ![concha acústica Carúpano (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpC8znBMrLptb1Jgvcr74ciEdUnhJ7MhMHXPazX4CJyop3qWo1o3dSVigschwWnY3H9.jpeg) ![concha acústica Carúpano (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/243WPWvmPGaZ3jjG2R5HcnpCRKYGQKvdWjRH1AQLJV1WrSqEDYgLth3xezUsgLG1nYxWq.jpeg) ![concha acústica Carúpano (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpQvPobtwHTbMpicPJW1iKZeJ1vz8heLbMdGnGP7HTfoYzQta7YA6F2yrKKJAeuMAfP.jpeg) ![concha acústica Carúpano (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/243LzmkFCTwz47E7mqCwJLK2KJfGvcjufcPrpLKU9oA3tAUguK9MD5bDXG9TUbmhnZU3g.jpeg)

title.title: Pan hecho en casa | Homemade bread
title.body:
Reciban un cordial saludo amigos. Hoy les traigo una receta que no puedo dejar de preparar porque queda deliciosa. El pan cuando es hecho en casa y es hecho con amor y dedicación queda divinamente esponjoso, crujiente y con una miga espectacular. Les puedo asegurar que está receta tiene las medidas justas para lograr un pan exquisito. >Warm greetings, friends. Today I’m sharing a recipe that I simply can’t resist making because it’s absolutely delicious. > >When bread is made at home with love and care, it turns out wonderfully light and fluffy, with a lovely crust and a spectacular crumb. I can assure you that this recipe has just the right proportions to create a truly exquisite loaf. ![IMG-20260430-WA0020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EpQzaTBU2SC97Q93NjM1kFvG2jekfSbnkjBkCuEAVfc2zofbXCB3ucATtoMYejhsDvw.jpg)
**Ingredientes:** - 500 grs de Harina de Trigo - 300 ml de Agua tibia - 16 gr de Levadura - 1 cucharadita de Sal - 1 cucharada de Azúcar - 4 cucharadas de Aceite
**Ingredients:** - 500 g plain flour - 300 ml lukewarm water - 16 g yeast - 1 teaspoon salt - 1 tablespoon sugar - 4 tablespoons oil
![IMG_20260424_104859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/Eonm1fB28pfmkzv18KsEAcARHqNSBTMwtfS22vTCPBzkhUvXERNj7WPx4w4ZgJLLPMH.jpg) **Preparación:** Se vierte el agua tibia en un bol, se agrega una cucharada de harina, una cucharada de azúcar y los 16 gr de la levadura. Se mezcla todo muy bien, dejando reposar por 30 minutos para que leude. >**Preparation:** Pour the lukewarm water into a bowl, add a tablespoon of flour, a tablespoon of sugar and the 16 g of yeast. Mix everything together thoroughly, then leave to rest for 30 minutes to allow the yeast to activate. ![IMG_20260424_101104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23vi4AFkD6VHgMtbmgjMq2V6meVQdTQ2xD9834eS6pSmGR6Ff7WuoGJtTZx3A1gqqZqte.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_101141.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23vsX3PK34RgpCvRVwZrkAPxhJx4jcoyohJhXwtY6uSq8yDiGcyGE4CtoWwPkLbB7jcPU.jpg) Aparte, en un bol se coloca la harina, se agrega el aceite, la levadura, uniendo bien todos los ingredientes. Se esparce harina en un mesón ligada con la sal y se amasa hasta que la masa este suave, se desprenda del mesón y de las manos. Se aceita un bol para colocar la masa bien tapada para que leude por una hora. >Separately, place the flour in a bowl, add the oil and yeast, and mix all the ingredients together thoroughly. Sprinkle flour mixed with salt onto a work surface and knead until the dough is smooth and no longer sticks to the surface or your hands. Grease a bowl, place the dough inside, cover it well, and leave it to rise for an hour. ![IMG_20260424_105658.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23uFZw53mDsfd9aNkWyrC7Bn1nPf7oWiHNGGbkp85VaCPuDSSyjKEENGUEzKnCpj1aFaP.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_105905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EoEryLwb9CAqqYGhNbdyZeDzqgnz97tzKMsrxkgKDYKVW9p2jhcqLucuFd66SH9Z6QC.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_110120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23u6Dr8qpLEWtSAst2iPK9teVo25LmM6wWzwZ6V2ax1XBqJaniPMXPrXTyX8r9vyYCKfm.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_110859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/Eo8Tr1AJR17qqDb4akQf1xBnhPRZKHNTketYPodek8xDFojZzFrZXukMZ84hn6e1kio.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_111105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23u69hf5s76GQiboS2jFpwSQDAkQ2a2JieeWJVsDXxgpTNhrcgMMRQ1x1VECrX9Z7EKAz.jpg) Luego, se coloca la masa en el mesón para dividirla en 8 partes iguales para formar las 8 bolas. Se colocan separadas en una bandeja en mantequillada y enharinada, haciéndoles una marca en el centro con un cuchillo y dejándolas nuevamente bien tapadas con un paño por 30 minutos para que terminen de leudar. Se precalienta 10 minutos el horno a 180°C. Luego, se lleva la bandeja al horno durante 30 o 40 minutos hasta que doren. Se sacan del horno y se dejan enfriar. >Next, place the dough on the work surface and divide it into 8 equal portions to form 8 balls. Place them separately on a buttered and floured baking tray, make a mark in the centre of each with a knife, and leave them covered with a cloth for 30 minutes to finish proving. Preheat the oven to 180°C for 10 minutes. Then, place the tray in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown. Remove from the oven and leave to cool. ![IMG_20260424_121437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23uFVqy2Aik44fG6UCsC3BHdZfuvWbkP2Mt9Ap2neZ2X82iqePwPVqa2mQsgC6J7nETvt.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_121528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/Eo8Ts1rLE9mwYY2TodncgpceyXDimUT8fVvxRj2ykVN2bSGJG3TjbgXFZxQmpwRb4oJ.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_122329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EoAbcPPzEuYfjiEuixPXbnif1dfXdTrkxDs712nJcfMsFKV7aKrRJeqpdHQJeCnHSTC.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_122717.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EoCj4rxJjBA861QCVgbK8UpM41ijN6pQHJP5sRaoxjpTf1mQDEghx5c6n39gQ9X3dHP.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_130349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EoK7jdKTsKN1wP7n25D1tLUfBVnZojkiWgc58TU7Gj7Hcz7hr85zQD44iEgcwRubgZN.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_131811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/Eo8SukP4soSuyrLNXeNbA7GuPgQocih6J2mwW6d61qSTFo3jUHdgycMz6QQnb8MSG4L.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_143622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EoAbBNsXtigwuZryfGKPZ7yLK7UBaNasYuoMuDRw5eAo2cpe3nTZAca7EcDP3cRfJPr.jpg) ![IMG-20260430-WA0019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/243qReZyAiHyHYHm7Cp6xjKQdCrfwhErzGMHunaFQSSQU8tNN6dPg4Dx6wgURYNVpWHre.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado esta maravillosa receta de pan hecho en casa. Los volveré a ver en otra oportunidad, cuando les traiga otra de mis recetas favoritas. >I hope you’ve enjoyed this wonderful recipe for homemade bread. I’ll see you again soon, when I’ll be sharing another of my favourite recipes. ![IMG-20260316-WA0032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EoCmQBGHdzuUJjfpdZArj42YxMLZHDxgtgVN7w3BNpWLzCkqBsYmXRaU13S2a7XpEjd.jpg) - Fotografías tomadas desde mi celular Redmi 9. - Banner realizado en https://www.canva.com/ - Footer realizado en https://www.canva.com/

title.title: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
title.body: >\n\nHello, anime fans. We’re back with more action-packed anime, but this time with a special and highly entertaining pick that might just bring back some nostalgia for some of you. A fun story about fans becoming their favorite childhood heroes. Based on the manga series of the same name written and illustrated by Yokusaru Shibata, Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider is a spin-off of the famous Japanese franchise known as
>Kamen Rider. This animated adaptation was produced by
>Linden Films. Check out the anime about the man who wanted to become a Kamen Rider.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Volvemos con más animes de acción, pero esta vez con una elección especial y muy entretenida que, posiblemente, a algún fanático le cause algo de nostalgia al verla. Una divertida historia de fanáticos convirtiéndose en sus héroes favoritos de su infancia. Basada en la serie de manga homónima escrita e ilustrada por Yokusaru Shibata, Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider es un spin-off de la famosa franquicia japonesa conocida como Kamen Rider. Esta adaptación animada fue producida por el estudio Linden Films. Conoce el anime del señor que quiso convertirse en Kamen Rider.

>

Plot

The anime begins by introducing us to Tojima Tanzaburo, a huge fan of the superhero series Kamen Rider since he was a child. But he’s not just a fan of the series and its protagonist; he also has a strong desire to ACTUALLY become Kamen Rider. Despite acknowledging that it’s just a TV show and that in real life there are no villains who transform into monsters or soldiers who claim to work for Shocker, Tojima decides to undergo rigorous training from a very young age in order to become the hero he so aspires to be. However, our fan grows up, turns 40, and never managed to become Kamen Rider… or at least not until that moment.

>

Trama

El anime inicia presentándonos a Tojima Tanzaburo, un gran fan de la serie de superhéroes Kamen Rider desde pequeño. Pero no solo es un fan de la serie y del protagonista como tal, sino que también tiene un fuerte deseo de convertirse REALMENTE en Kamen Rider. A pesar de reconocer que es solo un programa de televisión y que en la vida real no existen villanos que se transforman en monstruos o soldados que dicen trabajar para Shoker, Tojima decide someterse a un arduo entrenamiento desde muy joven para así convertirse en el héroe que tanto aspira ser. Sin embargo, nuestro fan crece, cumple 40 años y nunca consiguió convertirse en Kamen Rider… o al menos hasta ese momento.

> I don't think it comes as a surprise to any of you reading this that I'm a huge anime fan—and I'm not just saying that because half of everything I share on my Hive Blog consists of reviews of anime series I'm currently watching. Last year I watched over a hundred anime series currently airing; I’ve watched anime from almost every genre, some truly fascinating ones, and many others that are pretty generic. But I’ve also discovered anime gems that almost always go unnoticed, whether due to their stories, genres, or production values. This is the case with the anime I’m bringing you today, which aired from late last year through early this year. Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider isn’t just any run-of-the-mill action and hero anime—no, it’s a masterpiece for fans of Kamen Rider, one of Japan’s oldest and biggest franchises. That alone should be more than enough for true fans or self-proclaimed “otakus”, even. But if that still doesn’t convince you, I’ll also tell you that this anime has everything you need in an animated series to make you laugh and have a great time amid nonstop fights, scenes, and absurd characters. It’s a work that managed to revive everything that was popular several decades ago.

>
Creo que no es sorpresa para ninguno de los que ahora me leen que soy un gran fan del anime y no solo lo digo porque la mitad de todo lo que comparto en mi Blog de Hive son solo reseñas de animes que veo en emisión. El año pasado he visto más de cien animes en emisión, he visto animes de casi todo tipo de géneros, he visto algunos animes fascinantes y muchos otros que son bastante genéricos. Pero también he visto joyas de animes que casi siempre pasan muy desapercibidos ya sea por sus historias, géneros o producción. Este es el caso del anime que les traigo hoy que fue emitido desde finales del año pasado y principios de este año. Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider no solo es un anime de acción y héroes cualquiera, no, es una obra maestra para los que son fans de Kamen Rider, una de las franquicias más antiguas y grandes de Japón. Esto por sí solo ya debería de ser más que suficiente para los que son verdaderos fanáticos o dicen ser “otakus\

body.title: Mi jardín: Un lugar lleno de amor  y  color [Esp-Eng-Pt]
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta comunidad de @amazingnature. Es un placer saludarlos y desearles un día feliz y lleno de bendiciones. Que Dios los colme de bendiciones. Hoy les comparto mi visita a un jardín lleno de color donde encontré una flor de [Hibiscus rosa-sinensis] (https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hibiscus_rosa-sinensis), muy diferente de las que suelo ver. Esta es rosa, mientras que las que siempre veo son rojas. Es la primera vez que veo este tipo de flor de hibisco, y un capullo en forma de copa de vino a punto de abrirse y revelar su hermosa y colorida flor de color rojo vino o rosa oscuro.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this @amazingnature community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed day. May God's blessings flood your lives. Today I'm sharing my visit to a colorful garden where I found a [Hibiscus rosa-sinensis](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hibiscus_rosa-sinensis) flower, very different from the ones I usually see. This one is pink, while the ones I always see are red. It's the first time I've seen this type of *Hibiscus* flower, and a wine-cup bud about to open and reveal its beautiful, colorful, wine-red or dark pink blossom. ![AN (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wgHqVEu7thgtuhfsdqXTYu4D9LtUhujqXRkVn5WXN2Vzmuz2BuSTDyMqoyUEEuMh4v8.jpeg) ![AN (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EopsyPWEMzmgsWCemhZ5tTSi3iTLuJkX1SAYv3sY9qA5uh7hrXsS2KZf9dWJF4tXhzQ.jpeg) ![AN (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EonmvHcN5CqMnmHqXQa4WwU1R8tvXTZwF4YhDtCgeXQXR7LXmVtPebQiv2YqrckEWhu.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Otra flor que me llamó la atención en este jardín es el conocido *Capacho*. Es amarillo y destaca por las manchas en sus pétalos. Los pétalos son de los más grandes que he visto, y las hojas son puntiagudas y largas, con un tallo cilíndrico. Los capachos se distinguen por sus llamativas manchas, que los convierten en una de las flores más bellas y utilizadas para decorar espacios exteriores. Siguiendo el camino, me encontré con otras flores de capacho, bastante diferentes de las que había visto antes. En estas, las manchas o marcas se ubican en la parte central, en la base del pétalo, y hacia arriba hay una mancha roja que cubre gran parte del pétalo. No había visto este tipo de marca antes y me llamó la atención. Sin embargo, la marca solo es visible en algunos pétalos. En la fotografía, vemos el pétalo inferior completamente cubierto por la mancha roja, y el pétalo superior solo tiene bordes amarillos. Los demás pétalos tienen pequeñas manchas rojas. La otra flor tiene una parte amarilla y un área completamente roja. También se observa una banda roja, junto con las manchas amarillas, y uno de los pétalos tiene solo dos manchas rojas. Desconozco si este patrón de marcas se debe a la edad de la planta o a una subespecie dentro de esta familia.

> Another flower that caught my attention in this garden is the well-known *Capacho*. It is yellow and stands out for the spots on its petals. The petals are some of the largest I have ever seen, and the leaves are pointed and long, with a cylindrical stem. Capachos are distinguished by their striking spots, which make them one of the most beautiful and widely used flowers for decorating outdoor spaces. Continuing along the path, I came across other capacho flowers, quite different from those I had seen before. In these, the spots or markings are located in the central part, at the bottom of the petal, and upwards there is a red patch that covers a large part of the petal. I hadn't seen this type of marking before, and it caught my attention. However, the marking is only visible on some petals. In the photograph, we see the bottom petal completely covered by the red patch, and the top petal only has yellow edges. The other petals have small red spots. The other flower has a yellow part and a completely red area. A red band is also visible, along with the yellow spots, and one of the petals has only two red spots. I don't know if this pattern of markings is due to the age of the plant or a subspecies within this family. ![AN (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpC8y7deokss1Tmnx5oKCJhmuggA9VdiB47PgaN34esuPNiW5q3bAJeJF3CJn4LEqaa.jpeg) ![AN (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EonkXUkgfWG6EZFT6kLXTL9UeK78vFyyNNGRRWP9Q7brPYpM83835VkCjc9mU4MvpCc.jpeg) ![AN (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpA219pa3aMWbCN8fY4Fnxt4yekzpv2DjBZQao8wx5Rc1i6orCTPaiYroX8XEm3UZfq.jpeg)

> **Portugués** Bênçãos abundantes e eternas para todos os membros desta comunidade @amazingnature. É um prazer cumprimentá-los e desejar-lhes um dia feliz e repleto de bênçãos. Que Deus os encha de bênçãos. Hoje partilho convosco a minha visita a um jardim cheio de cor, onde encontrei uma flor de [Hibiscus rosa-sinensis] (https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hibiscus_rosa-sinensis), muito diferente das que costumo ver. Esta é rosa, enquanto as que vejo sempre são vermelhas. É a primeira vez que vejo este tipo de flor de hibisco, e um botão em forma de taça de vinho prestes a abrir-se e a revelar a sua bela e colorida flor de cor vermelho-vinho ou rosa escuro. Outra flor que me chamou a atenção neste jardim é a conhecida *Capacho*. É amarela e destaca-se pelas manchas nos seus pétalos. Os pétalos são dos maiores que já vi, e as folhas são pontiagudas e compridas, com um caule cilíndrico. As capachos distinguem-se pelas suas manchas chamativas, o que as torna uma das flores mais bonitas e utilizadas para decorar espaços exteriores. Ao seguir o caminho, deparei-me com outras flores de capacho, bastante diferentes das que tinha visto anteriormente. Nestas, as manchas ou marcas situam-se na parte central, na base do pétalo, e, mais acima, há uma mancha vermelha que cobre grande parte do pétalo. Nunca tinha visto este tipo de marca antes e chamou-me a atenção. No entanto, a marca só é visível em alguns pétalos. Na fotografia, vemos o pétalo inferior completamente coberto pela mancha vermelha, e o pétalo superior tem apenas bordas amarelas. Os restantes pétalos têm pequenas manchas vermelhas. A outra flor tem uma parte amarela e uma área completamente vermelha. Observa-se também uma faixa vermelha, juntamente com as manchas amarelas, e um dos pétalos tem apenas duas manchas vermelhas. Desconheço se este padrão de marcas se deve à idade da planta ou a uma subespécie dentro desta família. ![AN (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23xAY344aCHEbx4YXjMVHV9s4Zxzt2iYk4FSZzVoveZEz7tSKMDiDvGXk3irKvHqweHdd.jpeg) ![AN (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EokdYdcAwgppSHeByhAhdvPq5U68y1oWhJQTNUVmAZWvJUNnCc7s5q8MvjGzCiATruv.jpeg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

body.title: 🥤🥤 PASSION FRUIT JUICE WITH BANANA - JUGO DE PARCHITA CON CAMBUR🍌🍌🥛🥛
body.body:
>

Hi friends, since returning from Colombia, I'm currently missing something that had become a daily routine. There (at least where I was) there are many juice vendors with carts and their convenient appliances to serve you right in front of you, and you can freely choose how you prefer it. And now, after more than 15 days in Barquisimeto, I've taken the liberty of making my own juice at home so my stomach doesn't forget about it.

>***Hola amigos, con mi regreso de Colombia actualmente extraño algo que se había vuelto una rutina diaria. Allá (por lo menos en el sitio donde estaba) hay muchos vendedores de jugos en puestos con carritos y sus oportunos electrodomésticos para atenderte enfrente y puedes decidir libremente como lo prefieres. Y ya con más de 15 días en Barquisimeto, me tomé la libertad de hacer mi propio jugo en casa para que no pierda la costumbre mi estómago.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

>

These little fruits you see here come from a pation fruit I planted myself when we moved north of Barquisimeto. It's been in My garden for a little over two years now, and I've been eagerly waiting for it to bear fruits. For the last six months, it's been flowering actively and producing more and more fruits. I used one for my juice (it was the last one that fell a few days ago), and you can see it has plenty of pulp, and they've all been like that. Since I made a double juice, I blended it with a little less than half a liter of water.

>***Estas pequeñas que pueden ver aquí, vienen de una plata que yo mismo planté cuando nos mudamos al norte de Barquisimeto, esta ya tiene un poco más de dos años conmigo y en una ardua espera de que diera fruto, desde hace 6 meses esta ha estado muy activa en floración y dando cada vez más frutas. Para mi jugo utilicé una (fue la última que cayó hace días), y pueden ver que tiene suficiente pulpa, y así han sido así todas. Y este como lo hice un jugo doble, lo licué con un poco menos de medio litro de agua.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

>

Obviously, we need to blend the passion fruit first and strain it separately; this prevents us from ingesting the seeds. I must confess that this is my favorite fruit in juice, and I first tried it in milk in Colombia, and it was truly delicious. This inspired me to make this version.

>***Obviamente, debemos licuar primero la parchita y colarlo por aparte, esto nos evita tomar las semillas. Debo confesar que esta es mi fruta en jugo favorita, y en Colombia lo tomé por primera vez en leche, y de verdad fue un verdadero gusto, esto me motivo a hacer este.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/23uQrDEJ85d1tPxE8HL9QberB67xSaJ9awCEhf5aVrWWDokfV14nJaTLStHtFzLRhowp3.png)

<div class=\

>

I took 6 bananas and added them to the blender, along with the juice. And here's a completely optional step: I added powdered milk, but this juice is very good without it. You can use almond milk, or any milk you like, and it's also very good with just water. Even the sugar is optional, and that's something I loved about Magangué and is that they always cater to my preferences, and they treat my partner very well with healthy juices.

>***Tomé 6 cambures y los agregué en la licuadora, junto al jugo. Y aquí vamos con un paso totalmente opcional, yo agregué leche en polvo, pero este jugo promete ser muy bueno sin él, pudiendo usar leche de almendra, o alguna que les guste, y muy bueno queda con solo con agua, pero aquí hasta la azúcar es al gusto, y fue algo que me fascinó de Magangué, aquí siempre me atienden a mí a mi gusto y a mi pareja, lo atienden muy bien con jugos sanos.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

>

I blended the juice long enough to achieve the perfect texture with the well-processed banana. Combining fruits is a bit new to me, so I did a lot of research beforehand. Every recipe showed me different varieties, and everything was explained to me before starting. I learned here that this combination is very Caribbean and has been very well received by those who have tried it.

>***Licué el tiempo suficiente el jugo, para que quedara perfecta su textura con el cambur bien procesado. Es un poco nuevo para mí el combinar frutas, y esto me llevó a investigar muy bien antes de hacerlo: En toda receta se me mostraba variedades, y se me explicó todo antes de empezar, y me enteré desde acá que esta combinación es muy caribeña, con una gran aprobación desde quienes lo han probado.***

This juice is excellent because of its great combination of vitamins and potassium with natural sugars, obviously without milk or added sugar, making it a great option for those looking for healthy choices. It can provide energy and is believed to improve mood, which I think is good information, especially for those of us who enjoy this type of diet. Personally, I really enjoy refreshing myself with natural juices.

>***Este jugo es excelente por una buena combinación de vitaminas y potasio con azúcares naturales, obviamente sin leche ni azúcar, para quienes buscan opciones sanas. Este puede dar energía y se tiene la creencia de que mejora el ánimo, esto me parece una buena información, y más para los que gustamos de este tipo de alimentación, por mi parte, me gusta mucho refrescarme con jugos naturales.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class\

> Among other things, but still relevant, some of the juices I've most enjoyed and discovered in Colombia are: Carrot Extract + Orange Juice, Soursop + Blackberry (in Milk), Loquat (in Milk), Passion Fruit (in Milk), Coconut Water, and Sapote. These are some of the things I miss most about Colombia, but we'll soon be back there drinking some of the best juices I've ever tasted. >***Entre otro tipo de información, pero referente; entre los jugos que más he disfrutado y he conocido en Colombia están: Extracto de Zanahoria + Zumo de Naranja, Guanábana + Mora (en Leche), Níspero (en Leche), Parchita (en Leche), Agua de coco y Zapote. Estas es de las cosas que extraño mucho de Colombia, pero pronto volveremos a estar en esos lares bebiendo de los mejores jugos que he probado.***
![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

body.title: Sri Lankan-style street mango pickle .
body.body:
Dear friends, wishing you all a very wonderful day. Sri Lankan-style street mango pickle made with ripe mangoes is a delightful blend of sweet, sour, and spicy flavors that truly captures its essence. The natural sweetness of ripe mangoes pairs beautifully with aromatic spices and a hint of tanginess, creating a rich and flavorful condiment. This type of pickle, often prepared with a special spice mix, adds an irresistible touch to both festive occasions and everyday meals.

Let’s see how we can prepare it easily. 🥭
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-29 at 18.57.53.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranwala/23ywyJL8hPAo2Jy5vYdcREazq3VaYQt1ion7WSEWozi3N78kkdzvnik6X4JtSvcyWDKkn.jpeg)

# <u>Materials Used.</u>
About 4 ripe mangoes.
A pinch of salt.
2 Tablespoon of sugar.
1 Teaspoon of crushed chill powder.
A little vinegar.
1 Teaspoon of Pepper powder.





![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-30 at 14.59.46.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranwala/Ep5nCK2VrQQhSiNwpVudzZTP2btzdKAkRprteQ9v9w9NyvcqYEBxmMDq1yk6DXeChKz.jpeg)

# <u>The cooking process as follows.</u>

First, wash the ripe mangoes thoroughly and peel off the skin. Then cut them into small pieces as shown below.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-30 at 15.00.11.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranwala/23wgTtnoQXd2Qi18QYMGb8rHwaFLwFAREtSZwKfvJH4hoK3ZQv9scxwzL9G424jKXNDAL.jpeg)
Next, add salt, chili powder, pepper, a little vinegar, and sugar. Mix everything well until combined.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-30 at 15.00.53.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranwala/AK57Tpd66v4QAAnDbYg9cWbnPN7nFDJ2Vn7xpkisMdmBcV8RfoofNkvGGniW4L3.jpeg)


![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-29 at 18.57.42.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pranwala/23wCJ1u18nL8eZrtZAGgBDKiiUQMi7V2LwWWnHYuCFUkbVSWvVV3DN3LXrWAM3tn5QfPi.jpeg)
This ripe mango pickle is a wonderful example of how simple ingredients can be transformed into something deeply flavorful and memorable. With its perfect balance of taste and traditional charm, it enhances any meal it accompanies. Enjoy this classic Sri Lankan preparation with your loved ones and savor the authentic taste of homemade goodness.

body.title: Recurring dream elements:  Abusive authority and things growing out of my arms
body.body:
So I've kind of figured out how it is that I can force myself to have very vivid dreams in the past year and why it was happening to me so much whereas when I talk to other people, including a great many people right here on this platform, that they do not dream or at least do not remember it.

According to information that I have read, people that regularly drink alcohol are more likely to dream because of a negative impact that alcohol has on the quality of sleep that you end up getting.  Something about alcohol inhibiting the ability to obtain the really good REM sleep but excels at putting you in the state just below it that is less beneficial.   That level below REM is apparently where a great deal of dreaming takes place.  

In the past year I have curbed my drinking a LOT after close to 30 years of borderline alcoholic-style drinking on a regular basis.  I have noticed on the days that I do not drink - which is most of them these days - that I do not dream but on Thursday nights, the nights after our bowling parties, that I dream very vividly.   So it seems as though there is a great deal of credibility to this claim about booze leading to vivid dreaming.

<center> https://static.wixstatic.com/media/f386a0_a95c9fa784a64b79b7e0561e75208dbb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_568,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/f386a0_a95c9fa784a64b79b7e0561e75208dbb~mv2.png
[src](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/f386a0_a95c9fa784a64b79b7e0561e75208dbb~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_568,h_416,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/f386a0_a95c9fa784a64b79b7e0561e75208dbb~mv2.png)</center>

So last night after about 8 hours of continual drinking but at a reasonable pace of only 1-2 drinks per hour.  I did my usual food that is mostly pretty bad for you along with non alcoholic drinks and some movies / video games with a bunch of water to try to minimize the \

and then ended up having *incredibly vivid* dreams that I remember most of. There were two elements that are frequently in my dreams though and I will discuss them now.

People abusing their non-existent authority

https://cdn.kpbs.org/dims4/default/7d07895/2147483647/strip/true/crop/500x308+0+13/resize/880x542!/quality/90/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fkpbs-brightspot.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fimg%2Fphotos%2F2009%2F05%2F04%2FObserve01.jpg [src](https://cdn.kpbs.org/dims4/default/7d07895/2147483647/strip/true/crop/500x308+0+13/resize/880x542!/quality/90/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fkpbs-brightspot.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Fimg%2Fphotos%2F2009%2F05%2F04%2FObserve01.jpg)
There's a pretty funny movie called *Observe and Report* that stars Seth Rogan that did poorly but has a wonderful representation of how shopping mall security dream of being actual police officers and therefore abuse their \

as often as they can.  \n\nI have had a problem with this type of security and authority all of my life.  My earliest memory of this was when I was a teenager and accidentally passed on a fake $2 bill that was a promotional item from a car lot.  I kept it because it was so silly and looked just like real money.  I was at a Dairy Queen in a mall and I pulled the fake $2 bill back as soon as I saw it in the clerk's hand.  I even said \

and paid for my Chipwich with some singles that I had.  Well this early-stage Karen pointed me out to a mall cop who went into Delta-force mode to track me down, and then strong arm me until real police turned up.   What did they think was going on there?  That I, a 16 year old kid, was running some sort of huge counterfeit $2 bill organization?  

I will save that for another post because I have a lot of feeling about this.   In the dream I was in some sort of Wal-Mart sort of environment where it was quite difficult to figure out what was the entrance and what was the exit.  A ton of people were going the wrong way and activating these shoplifting sensors and the security was going ape-shit on them.   I had paid for my whatever it was that I bought and intentionally made sure the mall cops saw me pay, then I intentionally walked the wrong way through the sensors that didn't go off and gave them the finger.  

According to the \

dreaming about authority figures can mean the following.

* You may be subconsciously seeking wisdom or reassurance regarding a difficult decision or moral dilemma. 
* These scenarios frequently indicate feelings of guilt, fear of judgment, or anxiety about consequences for your actions
* Witnessing police activity often points to a longing for justice or stability in chaotic areas of your life, whereas direct involvement reflects personal accountability.

Notice how they often use the words \

in their descriptions of the interpretation because I think that even the people with the PhD's that do this sort of work realize that there is no real meaning behind this stuff for the most part and that their jobs are BS. This is the horoscope of the medical world. Just prescribe some pills and say you have no idea, because that is what the truth is. lets move on to the next, more disturbing recurring dream element that I have

Things growing out of my skin

https://glorypagez.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Skin.webp [src](https://glorypagez.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Skin.webp)
You probably find this image disturbing, and you should because it is gross. In my dreams I don't have worms coming out of my skin but it almost like some sort of tube or \

that i can see the top of and when I pull on it is easily comes out of my skin often leaving a rather large hollowed out area where the object once was.  The things I pull out are never alive, thank goodness, and I am not stressed out about these things being in my arms (it's almost always my arms or hands) and in the dream this is just something that happens to me often.  Last night I was pouring some sort of antiseptic into the areas and I can't recall ever doing that before.   Last night there was only two of them, about the width of a coin that left rather large holes in my palm after they were removed.  

Of course the experts have figured this one out as well because apparently/thankfully, this is a quite common dream element as well.

* Pulling worms out of your skin can indicate removing harmful influences, distancing yourself from people who drain your energy, or overcoming internal stress and worries.
* This dream may indicate a process of renewal—letting go of what is spiritually unhealthy and seeking a clean and restored life.
*  negative karma, impurities, or unresolved issues. Pulling them out may represent cleansing, karmic release, and spiritual purification.

A bunch of relative nonsense again, at least this time the person who compiled the list was up front about how most of these interpretations are based on religious texts and how the people from thousands of years ago saw this sort of dream as a message from God.   Fair enough.  

I don't have any deeply rooted psychological issues that I am aware of.  I don't wander around depressed and am probably one of the more happy people in most of the places that I go.   I have a pretty fantastic life so I don't think my dreams are actually telling me anything.  Perhaps I just don't like authority being abused (this is VERY true) and have a fear or something impaling me.   I don't think everything needs to be so complicated and these psychologists make up these grand reasons for dreams in order to justify their rather silly income levels and the fact that they went to school for a  very long time to study almost entirely subjective information.   

<hr>

If you have had any dreams recently lets discuss them.  I know that most of you are going to say that you don't dream, which probably isn't  true.  But if you do ever party with excessive booze, take note of whether or not you are more likely to dream during those times, just like I do.
