title.title: Ground beef with chayote  [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
<center> 

### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Hoy les presento otra receta de carne molida, esta vez con chayote. Es deliciosa y fácil de preparar, y lo mejor es que puedes usarla para crear varios platos diferentes. No solo es una excelente fuente de proteínas, sino que también tiene un sabor fantástico que encantará a toda la familia. Espero que disfrutes de esta receta y la pruebes. Aquí tienes el paso a paso.

> ``` Today I’m sharing another ground beef recipe with you, this time featuring chayote. It’s delicious and easy to make, and the best part is that you can use it to create several different dishes. Not only is it a great source of protein, but it also has a fantastic flavor that the whole family loves. I hope you enjoy this recipe and give it a try. Here are the step-by-step instructions. ```
![Delicious rice with chicken and smoked bacon (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23yx1vD35sTKfmqrYM5RzTXCi8ZJofLu8Bb7toLsqxRoUdJLUSMhd8i1roRDm3ySB51BK.jpg)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48a5mJrfDHAmwWoz38hgptfiWQnXDZdBjC7FvrycEqcnHCJdmNi4EnNSReLZSLbmQr.png)

> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eoke7PMyqyQopWexXCy22ZMb4E1M5TfxxQsUwPMJSqo1hETr29qDTC5hFjKVVaHnAwF.png) 300 gr de carne molida, 01 chayote, 01 cebolla, 01 pimiento rojo, 01 tomate, 03 dientes de ajo, 01 cucharada de salsa de soja, 01 cucharada de cúrcuma, 01 cucharada de orégano, sal y pimienta al gusto. >300 g ground beef, 1 chayote, 1 onion, 1 red bell pepper, 1 tomato, 3 cloves of garlic, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon turmeric, 1 tablespoon oregano, salt and pepper to taste.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/48YA3dVucGUQ3j5STqMX3enFGLhvzgymiszf9aqeZzxzyW8oooVgCVPH9wwS7LPMkv.png)

>
Lo primero que hay que hacer es lavar las verduras; pelar y cortar el chayote en dados, y luego cocerlo hasta que esté tierno. A continuación, cortar la cebolla, el pimiento rojo y el tomate en trozos y picarlos con un picatodo; machacar el ajo.

> ``` The first thing to do is wash the vegetables; peel and dice the chayote, then cook it until tender. Next, cut the onion, red bell pepper, and tomato into pieces and chop them using a food processor; crush the garlic. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eo6KPSxrEwQT7n8b646sJgnpfyVo7pt7foa6P7jUS9pAfZg99JYArSJSW2ihKkSZrLF.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoAbE6n6wRRmfsquWBX24vrjnLPwNgNzfaJpvQuSoKmu9d4yMXvVi62XYpQMK2NJT3n.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGyKhiFFpsD35YpM8ye8fghCEhDxa2rNsQgtvGpBRtEzkdvheU9U57ncwpSCrnVu97.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGxV6HEJ6V5eC1msumBd2DxFKy56Bqjn68pK9MwR8XKP8FvUmM3EKumPGX9LnWSHVA.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoGxQHYrJ2HPVKcNAUqosQNBgekScPi3zN3AXc4qHPCpqqKRFUTYTkJEBFL3vVfhAaQ.png) -|-

>
Echa dos cucharadas de aceite en una olla y, cuando esté caliente, añade el ajo, rehógalo unos segundos y, a continuación, añade la carne y rehógala removiendo constantemente durante unos minutos.

> ``` Put two tablespoons of oil in a pot, and when it’s hot, add the garlic, sauté for a few seconds, and then add the meat to sauté, stirring constantly for a few minutes. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoiP3VMPVXBsGXcSL2sEM3tohsDxLwN1mnjXfZKyuJXzG5azTtxkpxUsbcgA8HUjUbu.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoeESHxAyNgDuY2MLoQsZGGqfZgKP8NyfpfFmgbKLube62uvjTATCqug51mXQVbzJfU.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoiYaSeSbfPipLN6cFkkT6BP2esLVXAtSqFVifphWdi64EiQWe9kKwDSJunwS41iUvG.png) -|-|-

>
Luego añade las verduras troceadas y sazona con sal, pimienta, cúrcuma, salsa de soja y orégano.

> ``` Then add the chopped vegetables and season with salt, pepper, turmeric, soy sauce, and oregano. ```
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EokfXRaa5aFR3eCMXWuf8ThdFEaLnTivSLi5mqxPCPGq1ACWWJPc663AUQ7TZ1Qsm9c.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EopuMLFmLXrBB2FaYmsNtA76fBiK4FzfwdGdBuH8pkAgwK2wDuS6RBum3kASx1Tak5x.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EoeHFZuYYrcpenyMesDUkansh9zYd3sC35PxGvNLLwruqEMbPQwBmep56hL7fKkqhMW.png) -|-|- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/Eou9k9ePFAdpAo75ojo6GYoDmd6P5bW9CFgrBkffAVL2ojA8BGjJbufSW8xkJhfUVhC.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/EonkUD9nxmQqXCsVBZoZDaUy1W9CGgqX2ENqBfwbxzQBSFaibvPKBQCanpMMACN6wes.png) -|-

>
Deja que siga cocinándose a fuego lento durante unos minutos y, a continuación, añade los chayotes cocidos. Déjalo cocer unos minutos más para que los sabores se mezclen y, después, retíralo del fuego.

> ``` Continue simmering for a few minutes, then add the cooked chayotes. Let it cook for a few more minutes to allow the flavors to blend, then remove from the heat. ```

title.body: >Unsplash 有件事我提過了幾次，就是父親在思考退休的事情，他想把資金投在股市之中，做為將來養老的來源，但這種投資他總是希望我幫他操作，我其實不太想做這種事，要說我不想負這個責任，其實也不太算錯。 首先我並不是什麼股市好手，雖然我有我實行的方式，但總歸來說也是一般的普通人，並沒有相關的學習經驗，其實也就是看看書籍，看看網路上的資訊，自己去琢磨的粗淺方式。 但父親經常找我談這件事，我也直接了當的說方式很簡單，我們這種沒專業基礎的人，買入代表市場的市場指數基金就可以，但需要一定程度的心理建設，不然貿然一次投入，很可能在熊市拿不住，造成一定程度的虧損。 父親總是無法在這個點轉過來，總想著那一天要一次把資金全部投入，而那一天也遲遲沒有到來，又或著想叫我幫他操作，其實給我操作意思也是一樣，錢的所有權還是他的，拿不住的時候，還不是會叫我把股票給賣了。 所以我一直沒有幫他做這件事情，而是告訴他應該多自己多去了解一下股票，不然一聽到別人講另一種方式賺錢，又會跑來問我是不是要換方法，這樣的劇碼也已經在這幾年重複無數次，有時候真想錄音給下一次來問的他聽😓 我這次用一段話回應了他，既然你信任我，想把資金交給我處理，那你應該要信任我說的話，需要自己去了解這種投資，否則連一段勸告都不相信，又怎麼能信任我代管養老金，所以不管怎麼說他都應該自己去了解股票。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/79wvhi)

title.title: Aprendiendo sobre Claude Code con Lucas
title.body:
<center>![1000939642.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23vsDdddWB9TaWrX9J6aBeS776K9rbxZqXxPDbhs5UNDvBp2d3kiRaJbrkvLxq3HRrhvT.png)</center>

---

<div class=text-justify>

Una de las cosas que más me gusta de ser Contributor en @mkt.community, es que tienes la oportunidad de seguir aprendiendo y creciendo dentro del ecosistema. 

En estos días a través de un reto mensual, me gané una capacitación de Claude Code con nada más y nada menos que un pro, conocido como \

. Esta fue una capacitación privada para los Contributors de MKT Community que ganaron algún reto.

Realmente no esperaba este premio, tampoco sabía de qué iba la capacitación hasta que ya estaba por comenzar jajaja, pero me alegra mucho no haberla perdido, porque la tecnología avanza y con ello debemos avanzar nosotros. Hoy en día la IA y su buen uso, han logrado alcanzar cosas y hacer los trabajos mucho menos complicado y con menos errores. 

Es importante saber que no siempre vamos a usar IA o no la vamos a usar para todo, también que hay formas de uso: el modo \

(terminos by Eli). Si la usas sin conocimiento y solo por estar en la moda u onda tecnológica, déjame decirte que estas perdiéndote de mucho y poniendo en riesgo posiblemente cosas que luego puedes lamentar. ![1000939411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23uFKKEAY21eEVKRpbVSaxDmc5WgZxq1DXn9Qi6AcUo6btgYv5mJ3iyaGdFEgLHzpUu8A.jpg) Hoy, Lucas que me hizo ver sin darse cuenta, que no estoy tan mal en cómo hago mis Prompt para que la IA me ayude con algún trabajo. También nos permitió conocer Claude Code y nos dió tips interesantes sobre este agente IA, que realmente me parecen valiosos y me llevan a pesar en un futuro cercano sobre la facilidad del hombre al realizar cualquier tarea. Hubieron preguntas, no solamente de mi parte, si no también de otros miembros del Team. ![1000939500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/EoAU3NgqpTpeZMVYfbjMXvspgpiLdWejdL2LNMZdF9W34R2kC3MwSKWnm6zVXfay72P.jpg) Claude Code funciona en modo gratuito o free, pero también tiene una versión paga, se consumen tokens que funcionan como monedas o recursos, con la versión paga tienes más de ellos para realizar tareas, y puede ayudarte con tus rutinas diarias, decirte el clima, y otras cosas, como hasta crear un vídeo con ella. ¿Existen riesgos al usar este agente IA? Si, como en todos lados, existen datos que debemos cuidar y no solo los personales, si no también los de los clientes que puedas tener. Existen permisos que debes darle para poder realizar tareas, accesos que debes permitir y todo esto conlleva una gran responsabilidad. ![1000939422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/EoJye8uXJbPvdnV1PEpXgxaRx7cmC5kWc6MJcHCuwMuM5jkW66jVzTD21fN8hTxMETi.jpg) La IA no es solo para crear imágenes en caricatura o realizar sesiones de fotos que nunca existieron. Es mucho más que eso, sobretodo si hablamos de agentes IA y dependiendo de cómo la uses, obtendrás los resultados esperados. Y no, no estoy recomendando usar IA para crear contenido en Hive, pero si es importante aprender de ello, sus funciones, sus avances, y sacarle provecho para muchas tareas y trabajos que realizamos a diario. En la actualidad no necesitas ser un programador para crear un videojuego o desarrollar alguna otra idea, la IA está haciendo que todo eso y más sea posible. ---
![17776038610473094447176006882124.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xATp9nePqX8jz3YfCuR2CVbaaH3HRctoG4Q72iG7HfLmhD4YJZrgB672kJ4z43pfVgC.gif) Imagen creada por Lucas para la clase. Demás imágenes capturadas por mí durante la clase.

Hace dos años escribimos [este](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@josemalavem/esa-mezcla-de-cuerpo-y-alma-llamada-jazz-en-su-dia-internacional-or-this-mixture-of-body-and-soul-called-jazz-on-its-internat) texto. Hoy lo hacemos con un ejercicio poético prosístico, inspirado en aquella inolvidable escena de Casablanca.
![Fotograma de Casablanca.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23xAZh1f5Gmff9VZvm7xpSDV9wvXUWbNud1bPh7GMP5uzB7zVAhFgED6rbYc59hHAeRfF.jpg)
Fotograma de Casablanca - [Fuente](https://x.com/la2_tve/status/1270394584250626055)

Con su cadencia acompasada o sincopada sigue sonando en nuestras noches de luna y sereno, de licor con sabor a placer o a soledad, como si el pianista, el trompetista, el saxofonista o el percusionista, siguieran replicando el ritmo que corre en la sangre de aquellos pioneros negros de Nueva Orleans. Recomienza en su rítmico fluir, armónico o disonante, en el alma anhelante o afligida, como si Sam la volviera a tocar para nosotros, expectantes y deseosos del amor que se guarda entre sus blancas y negras, o en la voz ruda o sutil de Louis o Simone.


Escena de Casablanca

![5QI3tk1fZnqM1d8y_7950e6cf55fbfa0e14a0225ff82c6f.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/5QI3tk1fZnqM1d8y_7950e6cf55fbfa0e14a0225ff82c6f/5QI3tk1fZnqM1d8y_7950e6cf55fbfa0e14a0225ff82c6f.webp)

![KUKvZdgNPs6uQ7cz_b4063d496766f1b6fbe81abd9fce4a.jpeg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/KUKvZdgNPs6uQ7cz_b4063d496766f1b6fbe81abd9fce4a/KUKvZdgNPs6uQ7cz_b4063d496766f1b6fbe81abd9fce4a.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

前段时间，我去上瑜伽课的次数越来越多，就特别想趁着周末加练。可我现在报的这家瑜伽馆，周末居然不开课，这点我一直挺不能理解。上班族平时本来就没什么空闲时间，全靠周末有空来锻炼，哪怕周六周日只开一上午课程也好。但他们一直都是双休，就连周六上午也没有小班课，只安排了一节大班课。

刚好新家附近新开了一家瑜伽馆，正在做优惠活动，而且周末正常排课上课。我一开始先团购了两节课，特别划算，只要九块九一节，能分别上一节小班课和一节大班课。体验过后整体感觉还不错，就是那边的课程强度稍微偏大。

后来我就寻思着，干脆在这儿办个次卡。当时馆里有活动，230元可以买五节团精品课。我心里盘算着，把这五节课都安排在周末来上就行。工作人员告知课程有效期一个月内上完。我当时想着，平时抽空去上一节，剩下四节课都放在周末，应该完全没问题。

于是我兴致勃勃立马下了单，紧接着就开始约课。原本还暗自觉得捡了便宜、特别划算，结果万万没想到，最后课程根本没上完，还剩两节课浪费了。平摊下来反倒亏了，正常单节课也就四五十块钱，这样折算下来，一节课居然要划到80块。

我完全没考虑到周末总会有各种临时安排，上个月不巧感冒，生理期也刚好碰上，身体双重不适，根本没法去上课。我试着和瑜伽馆沟通，想把有效期顺延一个星期，可就算延长了一周，又遇上五一假期场馆放假休息，这样的延期也就毫无意义了。说到底，自己当初规划得再好，终究还是计划赶不上变化。

其实还有一个很关键的原因，就是那边课程强度实在太大。暂且不说老师专业度如何，单论训练强度，和我现在上课的瑜伽馆根本没法比。我常去的这家属于中阶难度，而那家直接就是高阶水准，强度拉满，全程几乎没有多余休息时间。

上课的时候心率都能飙到140，就算说暂停休息，也只给两个呼吸的时间，数完三二一马上就继续开课，上完课整个人又累又疲惫。

那家瑜伽馆虽说离新家很近，但离我现在住的地方就有点远了，来回通勤差不多要耗费半个小时。综合下来我真切觉得，健身锻炼还是就近选择最好，选一家贴合自己节奏、强度适配的场馆，远比贪图优惠更重要。

body.title: Arepas 🫓 with chicken, salad, and eggplant 🍆
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hoy preparé un menú súper rápido, sencillo pero muy delicioso y además balanceado; hice para mi almuerzo unas arepas asada, las cuales serví con pechuga de pollo, ensalada y unas tajadas de berenjena

> **
ENGLISH
** Today I made a super quick, simple, yet delicious and balanced meal; for lunch, I had grilled arepas, which I served with chicken breast, salad, and some eggplant slices ![IMG_20260430_131945_188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Eos2GGDWrvKjSsUj9YxCetsNmCZvhrhW2Keezyvsbjre1dQ5qWhFbYJ5tNxSZVyNaDD.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** harina de maíz precocida, pechuga de pollo, ajo, tomate, cebolla, berenjena

> **
INGREDIENTS
** pre-cooked cornmeal, chicken breast, garlic, tomato, onion, eggplant ![IMG_20260430_124725_256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wgUWX38gqUMzsdCU8c6UcEPnetwhxBLyu7wpTqzqvaszMejuChjHvVaSpbKwVFLWCUP.jpg) ![IMG_20260430_124440_952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wqiMTCx4MEXuyrvU3EM2DsGm1N58b8nwJEKB4yi1P1mS3ZtVgPQmLbGT4TB9c2dAEUz.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Lo primero que hice fue amasar la harina con agua y un poco de sal y llevar a cocinar las arepas; al mismo tiempo sazoné la pechuga con salsa de soya, adobo, ajo, sal, un poco de aceite y llevé a cocinar volteando constantemente hasta que estuvo completamente cocida, la berenjena la corte en tajadas, la dejé remojar en agua con sal para extraer el amargor, luego las sofreí en una sartén engrasada con un poco de aceite caliente y para la ensalada corte unas rebanadas de tomate y cebolla

> **
PROCEDURE
** The first thing I did was mix the flour with water and a little salt and start cooking the arepas; at the same time, I seasoned the chicken breast with soy sauce, adobo, garlic, salt, and a little oil, and cooked it, turning it constantly, until it was fully cooked. I sliced the eggplant, soaked it in salted water to remove the bitterness, then I sautéed them in a pan greased with a little hot oil, and for the salad, I sliced some tomatoes and onions. ![Collage_2026-04-30_23_01_44.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EppPzMcgE3C2qFhMihBLiGd6KzwFFoCqxpLbShg7z8G9sEmW8tgdT1nL1fRKfusuFNw.jpg) ![Collage_2026-04-30_23_02_25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23w2uMfNzgr77nuYF3Hi5cMcG134YsfWex5rQ6PFhjmaBgT8zo6gwupTg9uUNDstyHAVx.jpg)
> Cuando todo estuvo listo servimos y disfrutamos en familia este delicioso almuerzo. Gracias por visitarme ! Dios te bendiga🙏

> Once everything was ready, we served the meal and enjoyed this delicious lunch as a family. Thank you for visiting! God bless you🙏 ![IMG_20260430_131933_910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vi6JzsznLsoo2CVwYxG4RATSzhCrc8n2g8Q3jzkCTjra6LEkcTmtKNHwG6UZFKTz5RW.jpg)

body.body:

![LgW48iKtQzoaf0Tg_IMG_20260426_162805.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/LgW48iKtQzoaf0Tg_IMG_20260426_162805/LgW48iKtQzoaf0Tg_IMG_20260426_162805.webp)
![1XR79XPnLaDOvgNt_Screenshot_20260426_155725.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/1XR79XPnLaDOvgNt_Screenshot_20260426_155725/1XR79XPnLaDOvgNt_Screenshot_20260426_155725.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

结果出来的第二天我就去复诊了，去到已经错过就诊时间了，然后只能多等一会，等待的过程发现有人拿着报告单，询问过后发现可以去自助打印。

走到那个打印机那里，三台打印机，程序也很简单，几分钟就出结果了，全部13张一下子就打完了。报告单很多，有问题的就有好几张。打完之后整理好继续排队。

排到之后进去，医生就说我血脂高，血糖也高，属于糖尿病前期了。叫我以后不要吃甜的东西了，与甜食无缘了。

胰岛素初始空腹是18，一小时飙到200多，她说正常是5-10倍，18是初始值，十倍也就180，我超了，然后餐后两小时还是200多，三小时也是100多没有回落，她说这就属于胰岛素抵抗了。

说我得吃药了，给我开了二甲双胍，叫我第一周每天一片，如果没有胃肠道反应再一天两片，吃完之后去药店买，然后三个月再回来复查。

前面提到血脂高，我就问她不用吃药吗？她说我这么年轻，先自己调节一下，不行再说。然后我问复查还要喝糖水吗？她就说不用了，但是具体的检查到时候再说。然后几分钟就开好药叫我去缴费了。还嘱咐我说叫我多喝水，一天喝两升。之前在家的N多个疑问，突然几分钟被打发走了🤣

我都没有想起来问，从诊室出来，手机就没电了，好在上次看到自助充电的窗口，我边充电边想着医生说的，然后赶紧在线上自助缴费，发现开了60片二甲双胍，一块钱一片，一共60+，比我预想中便宜一点。🤣我真怕她又给我开出好几百。

但是她说后面吃完还要去药店买药，不懂外面会不会变贵，医保的钱能不能报销哦。

body.title: Corocoros, arepas, and cucumber salad (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> The corocoro is one of the most popular fish in Cumana thanks to its flavor and affordable price. Its mouthwatering aroma when fried is unmistakable, so I treated myself to a lunch of fried corocoro served with arepas and a salad of cucumber, potatoes, and grated carrots.
![1000112697.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMh6UGoxFeZreJbWiL1eXjCZ32LqnfXFeq5XDVHC1bPFP1ZmSqiWZBtQfvu7Yp2Mxd2.png)
## Ingredients: - 4 fish (corocoros) - 150 grams of cornmeal - 1 cucumber - 3 potatoes - 1 carrot - 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise - Salt to taste - 3 cups of water - Oil
![1000112668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX5gwkyPfXtGX16FuQzcGMJshttJgpD3HnHnJs37WE56dATcTaHB7ob3qj51xZDzB7C.jpg)
![1000112672.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xerGMGT96jb5UwU8FZWusrDjfzYG9maaSPD21rToSRwmhN8c85cLazY2xcmR6hJT3RV.jpg)
## Preparation: I prepared the fish—that is, I removed the scales, guts, and gills—and made two slits on each side to season with salt. This task is a bit tedious, but with some nice music playing in the background, it becomes more bearable. Then I rinsed them and let them drain before rubbing them with salt, and from there they went straight into a skillet with plenty of hot oil. Personally, I like them crispy, so I cooked them for about eight minutes on each side.
![1000112675.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ynYcPo5dWg9itKMD9YFpmAx26Gd2KMj7zWrz4nJ45xu165SDW7h8WqAGKxCkDH2CuWD.jpg)
While this was going on, I decided to make the arepas by mixing water, salt, and cornmeal in a bowl, then kneading it until it reached the right consistency. Finally, I oiled the surface of the budare and placed my three arepas on it. They were ready in twenty minutes over medium heat.
![1000112686.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMaX6rPxxR9gTAYjJGcuRUN36XYCUL1m4UdNwbnrGxwKhFGgYQLPKdMLytqRQmGTUwS.jpg)
Once the potatoes were tender, I drained off the excess water and added them to the grated carrot and cucumber slices, then added a pinch of salt, a tablespoon of oil, and a tablespoon of mayonnaise, stirring well to blend the flavors. The final step was to enjoy this delicious Asian-style lunch. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> El corocoro es uno de los pescados más populares en Cumaná por su sabor y precio accesible. Su apetitoso aroma cuando se prepara frito es inconfundible, así que complací mi gusto en el almuerzo con una combinación de corocoro frito acompañado con arepas y ensalada de pepino, papas y zanahoria rallada.
![1000112697.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMh6UGoxFeZreJbWiL1eXjCZ32LqnfXFeq5XDVHC1bPFP1ZmSqiWZBtQfvu7Yp2Mxd2.png)
## Ingredientes: - 4 pescados (corocoros) - 150 gramos de harina de maíz - 1 pepino - 3 papas - 1 zanahoria - 2 cucharadas de mayonesa - Sal al gusto - 3 tazas de agua - Aceite
![1000112668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX5gwkyPfXtGX16FuQzcGMJshttJgpD3HnHnJs37WE56dATcTaHB7ob3qj51xZDzB7C.jpg)
![1000112672.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xerGMGT96jb5UwU8FZWusrDjfzYG9maaSPD21rToSRwmhN8c85cLazY2xcmR6hJT3RV.jpg)
## Preparación: Arreglé el pescado, es decir le quité las escamas, las vísceras y las agallas, además le hice dos hendiduras laterales para salar. Este trabajo es un poco tedioso, pero con unas agradables canciones de fondo se hace más llevadero. Luego los limpié y dejé escurrir para untarles sal y de allí van directo a un sartén con suficiente aceite caliente, en lo particular me gustan crujientes, así que los dejé unos ocho minutos de cada lado.
![1000112675.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23ynYcPo5dWg9itKMD9YFpmAx26Gd2KMj7zWrz4nJ45xu165SDW7h8WqAGKxCkDH2CuWD.jpg)
Mientras este proceso avanzaba, decidí preparar las arepas, mezclando agua, sal y harina de maíz en un envase, después amasé hasta lograr un buena consistencia. Finalmente aceité la superficie del budare y coloque mis tres arepas. Estuvieron listas en veinte minutos a fuego medio.
![1000112686.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wMaX6rPxxR9gTAYjJGcuRUN36XYCUL1m4UdNwbnrGxwKhFGgYQLPKdMLytqRQmGTUwS.jpg)
Por último, hice la ensalada. Lavé las papas, retiré las conchas, volví a lavar, dividí en cuadritos y las puse a sancochar, tapé para que se cocinaran más rápido. Luego pelé y rallé la zanahoria en tanto el pepino lo desconché también y lo corté en rodajas. Cuando las papas estuvieron blandas, quité el exceso de agua y las puse junto a la zanahoria rallada y las ruedas de pepino, luego agregué un punto de sal, una cucharada de aceite y una de mayonesa, removí muy bien para integrar los sabores. El paso final fue disfrutar de este delicioso almuerzo oriental. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.
💖💕💖💕💖

Is global depopulation good for the development of AI?
The relationship between global depopulation and AI development is a subject of intense debate among economists, technologists, and policymakers. While some argue that shrinking populations create a \

that accelerates AI innovation, others warn that a smaller population could lead to a stagnation in the very human creativity and talent required to build advanced AI systems.
## Arguments for Depopulation Driving AI Development
Many experts believe that demographic decline acts as a powerful catalyst for AI adoption and innovation:

* The \

Driver: Countries facing severe labor shortages, such as [South Korea](https://www.rieti.go.jp/en/rieti_report/365.html) and [Japan](https://www.scmp.com/economy/china-economy/article/3346475/chinas-ai-adoption-may-limit-economic-fallout-its-rapidly-ageing-population-analysts), have become world leaders in robotics and AI integration. Without a growing young workforce, these nations use AI as a \

to maintain productivity and sustain their economies.\n* Economic Substitution: As the working-age population shrinks, the relative cost of human labor increases, making capital investments in AI and automation more attractive for businesses. This shift can generate an \
that helps offset the loss of a traditional \
.\n* Mitigating Job Displacement Fears: Some argue that a declining birth rate is actually a \

in the age of AI, as it reduces the potential for [mass technological unemployment](https://www.reddit.com/r/AskEconomics/comments/1oiljq6/if_the_coming_ai_explosion_is_going_to_eliminate/). If there are fewer people, the social and economic shock of AI replacing human roles may be less severe.

## Arguments Against Depopulation for AI Development
Conversely, there are significant concerns that a shrinking global population could undermine the future of AI:

* Loss of Innovation Talent: A smaller global population means a smaller pool of researchers, engineers, and creative thinkers. Some experts worry that science and [innovation could slow](https://hsph.harvard.edu/news/is-declining-world-population-a-problem/) with fewer young people entering technical fields.
* Sustainability of AI Infrastructure: Population collapse can lead to [unsustainable public budgets](https://papers.academic-conferences.org/index.php/icair/article/view/4243), making it difficult for governments to fund the massive infrastructure and energy requirements needed for cutting-edge AI development.

---
_Feliz y bendecido día_ >_Happy and blessed day_

![Delicioso almuerzo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vsUyNonvKNMZKabLLraiJEDPHDiVfrtvWc12sptUNPTrjSZuaUYRk1fiA68fETMzQsk.jpg)

> Hola, amigo, nuevamente les traigo otra receta; se trata de una carne de res guisada con chayote. Esta carne queda deliciosa y les aseguro que a toda la familia le va a encantar; la pueden combinar con arroz o con pasta. Este plato es muy nutritivo y tiene ese poder especial de estirar la proteína para que rinda para toda la familia, especialmente si la preparamos con el chayote. Así que espero que les guste. Aquí el paso a paso. >Hi there, friends! I’m back with another recipe: beef stew with chayote. This dish is delicious, and I promise the whole family will love it; you can serve it with rice or pasta. This dish is very nutritious and has that special ability to stretch the protein so it’s enough for the whole family, especially when prepared with chayote. So I hope you like it. Here are the step-by-step instructions.
![1000450045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wCE1dBaaKHeygH6QxmU8PeTbTBeR1pP5gaZjGdZRK8sja6XZphZqV62XZsuUNttr3f9.jpg)
--- ![El texto del párrafo (32).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/EouEzXFRam7Qu5Er4T5yaxbebYHDJJvGYKKJedtHFWxqE5sXNxmydEWFdjp6DLSkUTF.jpg)
> - 600 g de carne para guisar - 2 chayotes - 1 zanahoria - 2 cebollas - 1 pimenton - 6 ajíes dulces - 1 tallo de cebollin - 1 cucharadita de curcuma - 1 cucharadita de pimienta - Aceite - Sal

> - 600 g stewing meat - 2 chayotes - 1 carrot - 2 onions - 1 bell pepper - 6 sweet peppers - 1 stalk of green onion - 1 teaspoon turmeric - 1 teaspoon pepper - Oil - Salt

![1000449841.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xAc4L1oukeCYN5zqAKzLqvhbuDYu5xGwf3vk3kJGxnsacKRu31VfyiE4Hrfkq1jcs3d.jpg)

Once the water is boiling, add the meat and let it cook.
|![1000449846.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/243BaR4Gfh21FMykZPXEgkJkHFfWUXoK98LEoVzCRNwmrWkGKKBrrGb3PCuWyWKxPFD8m.jpg)|![1000449848.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23y8ufBhqeingJAWc9FLwfpJXnnhxsjNBZUqU1vDqSVXfMuRUqxq2Dsppc2R2uRfzwFLo.jpg)| |-|-|
- Ahora añadimos el tallo de cebollín previamente lavado, cortado por la mitad, sal y la zanahoria sin piel, bien lavada y en 4 pedazos, y dejamos cocinar hasta que se ablanden. >- Now add the washed green onion, cut in half, along with salt and the peeled, well-washed carrot (cut into 4 pieces), and let them cook until tender.
|![1000449921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23vi8Fon9dTQjctdPw1gK9p8TKSPFH28E4oBNEs1ntawfdUbQ6Uw7DZXWRdNhoZf8JehQ.jpg)|![1000449923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23yd3TVvZoYu2Aaed5wzmvCH4pShKgrgaxNSi9ebjC7hNx6MNaSEjRQScoUdQqw1NKa9W.jpg)|![1000449926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23uQtad34y9GztPFS86QyfC8T6Km5zcfxBptfPD3MQvKE9NRsZYH77mbvnnTi6eGq5R29.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Mientras se cocina la carne, lavamos y cortamos con el picatodo la cebolla, el pimentón, los ajíes dulces y las hojas de cebollín y reservamos. > - While the meat is cooking, wash and chop the onion, bell pepper, sweet peppers, and chives in a food processor, then set aside.
![1000449989.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23tmMvox5maYtj8XNXxoX5aDu5Fnj7pbaDiSXf3eZ427LmTwDz6q63kVECfeJoJh445fV.jpg)
- Una vez blanda la zanahoria y el cebollín lo retiramos y lo colocamos en el vaso de la licuadora, licuamos hasta formar una crema y reservamos. >- Once the carrot and scallion are tender, remove them and place them in the blender jar; blend until smooth, then set aside.
|![1000449991.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23xyXRQXdZNraZuxk9z4PQ2HuznBH3izo45xXe3FVy9j4127yJCjuZ6D24mh9VdjmDTSt.jpg)|![1000449993.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23zbRuVh7pvEY5CLZk9HFTvXpkG9Lvtaqr45V1fnviwTwVWHPdeN6NkCJpXWc4yBj9KTh.jpg)| |-|-|

|![1000449995.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wMaern1HMVMQx4wdTCvMyar8f6PynufikNeqmXVqJCajjF7ZQM2fnuK439APWrE7QGZ.jpg)|![1000449996.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23wX13TdbQP2c1MGdYL7ppc9gwRg8cyJo4CXoJkvtXaq9V7qqS6Xv2qwTETdhzW2tsVyz.jpg)|![1000449997.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daysiselena/23w2oGnfQskaJGoVvSa7RkVbNHxPUedcPxgqXFi4BkroR6qSj6v32v1Ab7V7K1BDcr82f.jpg)| |-|-|-|
- Luego añadimos el pimentón, el cebollín y seguidamente la chayote lavada y cortada en cubos medianos; revolvemos y dejamos cocinar por unos minutos. > - Next, add the paprika and green onions, followed by the chayote (washed and cut into medium-sized cubes); stir and let it cook for a few minutes.

links.body:
<center>
![17776040521433689469372365370867.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVK44pJSbR45agKvHNJFuCNfnKLS8fW7fD6Z6br82Rfop/17776040521433689469372365370867.jpg)
[fuente](https://depositphotos.com/es/photos/amor-de-oto%C3%B1o.html)

#

NUESTRO AMOR AUTUMNAL 


Si el tisú de tu cielo 
en la desnuda noche
y tú sol de oro Araguaney 
en el frescor del día 
se vuelve un pasatiempos 
en preservar nuestros lazos
así como el mar
se abraza con el cielo 
y la claridad del plenilunio 
en la noche
pose su belleza
mientras tus manos
se enlazan con las mías. 

Que en el parpadear
de nuestras miradas 
se vuelvan como batidas olas
que terminan besando 
las orillas arenosas 
y tu boca en mi boca
de inicio al fuego
que emana del sol
cuando la pasión 
actúe con frenesí.

Tu piel junto a mi piel
es como ver hundirse el ocaso
en la vespertina despedida
con el ósculo sagrado
que deja el sol
cuando se va a ocultar.

#

![IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531 (2) (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcAMnp8rXxSwGJ2UfAxwEZZ95N8qY1vTvdx9fKjqrsCy/IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531%20(2)%20(1).png)

#


OUR AUTUMN LOVE

If the fabric of your sky
in the naked night
and your golden Araguaney sun
in the coolness of the day
become a pastime
in preserving our bonds
just as the sea
embraces the sky
and the clarity of the full moon
in the night
possesses its beauty
while your hands
intertwine with mine.

May the blinking
of our glances
become like crashing waves
that end up kissing
the sandy shores
and may your mouth on my mouth
ignite the fire
that emanates from the sun
when passion
acts with frenzy.

Your skin next to my skin
is like watching the sunset sink
in the evening farewell
with the sacred kiss
that the sun leaves
as it sets.

#


![IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531 (4) (2).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR4DSjEWNtm9S72maUQTvxDdKtLm3NSiuo2utWBUPWPVe/IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531%20(4)%20(2).png)

links.title: An adventure to San Luis Beach (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> A new adventure takes us to the crystal-clear waters of San Luis Beach, the longest beach in Cumaná. This paradise is located on Avenida Universidad and stretches from the Los Bordones neighborhood to the El Águila gas station and City Hall, a distance of about two kilometers. It’s very easy to get here by public transportation, especially since the city has expanded in this direction. San Luis offers beautiful scenery, perfect for admiring the views, relaxing, and enjoying the sun and sand. It’s a premier tourist destination, featuring restaurants, inns, and shops selling food and drinks along the entire shoreline, plus there’s a developed area nearby.
![1000107564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep3dsPQFVEzvHpiusDr7gSHNZ4B6EdjUMrEm17tPmsBhQh4a9Xjf2AkWyLG3hySsPD9.jpg)
![1000107518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpnBmbiMVxqMv9THk1wuToYAhnCe2kZMZGdf3ngATtn2gUcUypLtg7vDB5KkN9H44jF.jpg)
This beach is a favorite among tourists and locals alike, which is why it’s always crowded. However, keep in mind that the water can get deep right from the shore, and conditions can become unpleasant if there are strong waves or rough seas, so it’s not recommended for young children. The atmosphere is usually pleasant; you can relax in the shade of coconut, sugarcane, and palm trees lining the entire beach. There are also huts run by various businesses that offer full service, including chairs and tables. The length of the beach offers a variety of ways to enjoy yourself, from the areas associated with the large Venetur and Los Bordones hotels to the Military Casino, the Medical Association, and the Civil Protection area—there’s something for everyone.
![1000107524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep3eKqdsygYTrbjh1vKgTXi1nL63G6CB9SUK35yT7cfpsxdo1gWuogs56rWZTJonPAC.jpg)
![1000107522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Epxoufo7Dg2Mo9qbMqWzoBLX5v6CxX4BvppSXsbUNUSgawu8TozYovzvSqUdYn13XbT.jpg)
![1000107560.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpGQj7ALmu5sKCn4sKcYqKbV1Azay1pTySTsQ8DHunXox781uAt73Z5tX1xQ2JCxqSY.jpg)
One of the most striking features of this beach is that there is plenty of space to walk, allowing visitors to explore several kilometers and enjoy different spots. There is a concrete walkway that runs from one end to the other, accessible on foot or by bicycle. Also noteworthy is the constant security provided by military personnel and police officers from the tourist patrol. San Luis offers a view not found on other beaches in Sucre State: the open sea. Here, the vista extends beyond the Gulf of Paria, with partial views of Manicuare and Araya. As such, San Luis is a perfect spot for various sports and has hosted many beach festivals and other events for the enjoyment of vacationers.
![1000107561.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpzycWWjnEYrNPpf2Jz6cXExGtKjRtAeSzhpsmsQMvBX1LesDCU1qJZuMHi57EQxDkY.jpg)
![1000107535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep1XpHjCMWRQjtXAEvLUBT6jcQuPTCU1JmyMBBBn7bm72QqvenQ1ZkNtorFvQTK9Utg.jpg)
![1000107554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpLfwpX35cmeUHBJZPfM1e1DgJGfntwiRKXXp9r2qqkjuWGRwNmyCp3b4KepSAnUNyn.jpg)
Over the course of a weekend in San Luis, I was able to experience beach volleyball tournaments, triathlons, concerts, religious ceremonies, and mini-bar wars, which gives a sense of the town’s size. Since my visit was on a Friday, the only places bustling with activity were the areas where beer is sold. It’s also interesting to observe the urban landscape; the houses look modest compared to those found in coastal areas like Marigüitar. Similarly, the damage caused by salt air to metal structures—and, of course, to the vegetation, since most of the plants here are xerophytes—is evident. I have visited San Luis on many occasions and have found it to be a suitable place for healthy recreation, ideal for watching the sunset and then returning to the daily life that surrounds the city. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Una nueva aventura nos lleva a las aguas cristalinas de playa San Luis, la más extensa de Cumaná. Este paraíso queda ubicado en la Avenida Universidad y tiene acceso desde el sector Los Bordones hasta la bomba El Águila y la Alcaldia, alrededor de unos dos kilómetros de distancia. Es muy sencillo llegar a este lugar a través del transporte público y más porque la ciudad ha crecido hacia esta parte. San Luis tiene paisajes hermosos, dignos para admirar, relajarse y disfrutar del sol y la arena. Es un sitio turístico por excelencia, acá encontramos restaurantes, posadas y negocios que venden comida y bebidas en toda la orilla, además existe un urbanismo alrededor.
![1000107564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep3dsPQFVEzvHpiusDr7gSHNZ4B6EdjUMrEm17tPmsBhQh4a9Xjf2AkWyLG3hySsPD9.jpg)
![1000107518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpnBmbiMVxqMv9THk1wuToYAhnCe2kZMZGdf3ngATtn2gUcUypLtg7vDB5KkN9H44jF.jpg)
Esta playa es una de las preferidas de turistas y habitantes de la ciudad, por tal razón es muy concurrida. Sin embargo, hay que tomar en consideración que desde la orilla puede ser honda y la sensación puede llegar a ser desagradable si se presenta un fuerte oleaje o el mar se muestra iracundo, así que no es muy recomendable para niños pequeños. Por lo regular el ambiente es agradable, nos podemos arropar debajo de la sombra de cocoteros, uveros y palmeras ubicadas a lo largo de toda la playa. También hay chozas de distintos emprendimientos que ofrecen el servicio completo, incluyendo sillas y mesa. La extensión de la playa ofrece distintas posibilidades de disfrute, desde las zonas asociadas a los grandes hoteles Venetur y Los Bordones hasta el Casino Militar, el Colegio de Médicos y el área se Protección Civil, hay espacio para todos los gustos.
![1000107524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep3eKqdsygYTrbjh1vKgTXi1nL63G6CB9SUK35yT7cfpsxdo1gWuogs56rWZTJonPAC.jpg)
![1000107522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Epxoufo7Dg2Mo9qbMqWzoBLX5v6CxX4BvppSXsbUNUSgawu8TozYovzvSqUdYn13XbT.jpg)
![1000107560.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpGQj7ALmu5sKCn4sKcYqKbV1Azay1pTySTsQ8DHunXox781uAt73Z5tX1xQ2JCxqSY.jpg)
Uno de los aspectos más llamativos de esta playa es que hay suficiente espacio para caminar, así se puede recorrer varios kilómetros y disfrutar de diferentes lugares. Hay una caminería de cemento por donde transitar de punta a punta ya sea a pie o en bicicleta. También es de destacar la permanente seguridad con efectivos militares y policiales de la patrulla turística. En San Luis se presenta una imagen que no se aprecia en otras playas del estado Sucre y es el paisaje de mar abierto, acá la visión abarca más allá del Golfo de Paria, Manicuare y Araya se aprecian de manera parcial. Siendo así, San Luis es un lugar perfecto para practicar diferentes deportes, incluso ha sido sede de muchos festivales playeros y otros eventos para el disfrute de los temporadistas.
![1000107561.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpzycWWjnEYrNPpf2Jz6cXExGtKjRtAeSzhpsmsQMvBX1LesDCU1qJZuMHi57EQxDkY.jpg)
![1000107535.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Ep1XpHjCMWRQjtXAEvLUBT6jcQuPTCU1JmyMBBBn7bm72QqvenQ1ZkNtorFvQTK9Utg.jpg)
![1000107554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EpLfwpX35cmeUHBJZPfM1e1DgJGfntwiRKXXp9r2qqkjuWGRwNmyCp3b4KepSAnUNyn.jpg)
En un fin de semana he podido apreciar en San Luis competencias de voleibol de playa, triatlones, conciertos, ritos religiosos y guerras de minitecas, lo que concede una idea de la extensión del lugar. Como esta visita fue un día viernes, solamente había movimiento en los sectores donde venden cerveza. También es interesante apreciar el urbanismo, las casas lucen modestas en comparación con las que se aprecian en zonas costeras vía Marigüitar. De igual forma, es evidente los estragos que causa el salitre en estructuras metálicas y por supuesto en la vegetación ya que la mayoría de las plantas que están acá son xerófilas. He visitado San Luis en muchas oportunidades y me ha parecido un lugar adecuado para el sano esparcimiento, ideal para contemplar el atardecer y luego retornar a la cotidianidad que envuelve a la ciudad.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: Dont Call out my name!!
links.body:
/>

It’s another midnight here, and yes, this sounds like the middle of a horror film, where the people start  
If I hear my name being called at midnight, the first thing I’m not doing is answering immediately, funny enough ive actually herd my name being called like that but ever so faintly, in my religion we believe sometimes it is the djinn that may be calling your name and you do not answer, always make sure you are absolutely sure before answering your name. That’s rule number one.  
What will i first do, id freeze, my heart starts racing of course. I’d pause whatever I’m doing and just listen carefully. Was it clear? Because i feel at that time, your mind starts playing tricks on you, especially late at night when everywhere is quiet and your thoughts are louder than usual. Especially for some of us that stay alone, where do you even run to.  
But !!!!......If I hear it again, that’s when things get serious. Yeah… I’m jetting out, no investigation needed, no nothing, but what if thats what the voice that called out wants me to do, since im sure i always lock my doors before heading to bed anything past 8pm, it might be a trap  
At that point, on the flip side I’d probably stay still, maybe even move quietly to check my surroundings without making noise(heart racing of course). I’m not opening any doors. I’m not stepping outside. I’m staying right where I am and waiting for morning to come.  
But one thing is certain after that kind of experience, sleep is definitely cancelled for the night. Lights on, ears sharp 😅

links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![gDtAkzI0FAqEIDLe_IMG_20260501_100433.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/gDtAkzI0FAqEIDLe_IMG_20260501_100433/gDtAkzI0FAqEIDLe_IMG_20260501_100433.webp)
![oxpRq9nxXorKPGD1_IMG_20260501_100521.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/oxpRq9nxXorKPGD1_IMG_20260501_100521/oxpRq9nxXorKPGD1_IMG_20260501_100521.webp)

今年的五一是最近几年以来温度稍微算低一点的。往年五一回老家，我记得都是已经睡觉开空调了，而今年还要穿着长袖，甚至早上还要穿一个外套。低温是12度左右，高温是20~23度左右，所以还有一点微微凉。
 
今年的温度变化不知道是怎么回事，就是比往常会异常一些。不过这依然阻止不了大家回家的热情，或者出去外出旅游的热情。
 
今天开车回老家，路上高速公路都堵瘫了，我们就没有走高速，走的其他的道路，然后两个小时不到就可以到家了。
 
在开车两个小时左右的路上，娃爸说开着开着要打瞌睡了，于是他就和我儿子讨论起来了军事问题，就讨论导弹发射阻击的问题和概率问题，百分之七十百分之几十，然后又和孩子讨论这个数学概率论的问题。边讨论边给孩子出题，娃有时候答错了，他就会及时提醒他纠正过来，然后或者启发他让他自己发现错误。然后又把这个导弹发射问题和数学问题结合到电脑他玩的一款生存模拟游戏上去。这父子俩一路上聊的嗨爆了，把我笑死。
 
放假的感觉总是那么好，可以痛痛快快玩几天，再考虑工作和学习的事。也是很美好的事情。

---

links.body:
The Web2 annotation layer concept has been attempted multiple times -- Hypothesis, Genius, early Disqus, Annotote -- but never achieved critical mass. The core reason wasn't technical; it was distribution. You need readers on the same URL at the same time who've all opted into the annotation layer, which is a brutal cold start problem.

What's different here is the Hive backing gives you native monetization that previous attempts lacked. A reader who leaves a genuinely useful annotation on a high-traffic article can now capture some of that value rather than giving it away. That's a real behavior-change incentive that Hypothesis never had.

I'm not sure whether that's enough to crack the distribution problem, but it's the most interesting new variable. Curious how you're thinking about the bootstrap strategy -- starting with a specific content vertical where the annotation density is already high (academic papers, tech docs, longform journalism), or going broad from day one?
links.author: bitmoving

links.body:
Worldmappin occupies a niche that's genuinely hard to replicate: it's one of the few Hive apps that could bring non-crypto users onto the chain without them immediately realizing they're using a blockchain. Travel content is also naturally resistant to AI-replacement -- authentic location context, real photos, first-person experience -- which matters more as curators get more selective about what they fund.

The timing is interesting too. Ecency mobile, Ecency web, and now Worldmappin V2 -- there's a quiet convergence of front-end quality happening across the Hive ecosystem that doesn't get talked about much outside of Hive itself. The infrastructure layer has improved significantly; the question is always whether user acquisition can catch up.

One thing I'm watching: whether V2 keeps map-first navigation as the primary discovery model or moves toward a feed-first approach. The geographic entry point is what differentiates Worldmappin from everything else here. If that gets de-emphasized in favor of a more standard feed, it loses the edge.

What drove the biggest changes in this version?
links.author: bitmoving

links.body:
Analytics tooling is chronically underbuilt across most blockchain ecosystems, and Hive is no exception -- so this fills a genuine gap. The top holders list is useful for understanding governance concentration: who actually controls stake-weighted decisions, and how that distribution has shifted over time.

A few things I'd find valuable as additions: holder movement velocity (not just current balance but accumulation/distribution rate over rolling 30-day windows), and a split between 'passive stake' vs. 'active VP usage.' A wallet with 5M HP that hasn't voted in six months has very different ecosystem impact than one actively curating -- the raw balance hides that.

Also curious whether you're pulling from direct RPC or indexer data. HP values can diverge meaningfully between sources depending on sync frequency, especially during delegation changes.

What's the current refresh rate on the holder data?

links.body:
Privacy tooling on Hive is underexplored territory. Most privacy infrastructure in crypto clusters around L1s (Zcash, Monero) or L2 mixers (Tornado, Aztec) -- but Hive's account model creates different constraints. Everything is pseudonymous by default and fully traceable on-chain, so a privacy layer would have to work around that transparency rather than with it.

I'm curious about the architecture. Is this routing transactions through a proxy layer that batches and obscures origin addresses? Or something closer to stealth address schemes? The LEO deployment surface makes sense as a first use case -- users who actually care about financial privacy tend to self-select on DeFi-adjacent platforms -- but the UX friction is the real test. Most privacy tools fail not on cryptography but on adoption: people won't use them unless the default flow is smooth.

One thing worth flagging: privacy features attract regulatory attention fast. Tornado Cash's OFAC designation changed the risk calculus for similar tooling overnight, and that decision has been partially reversed but the uncertainty is still there. Would be interesting to hear how you're thinking about the compliance surface before launch rather than after.

Watching this one closely.

links.title: A curious cat on the street [Eng/Esp]
links.body:
>

It’s funny when I think about how cats have become my favorite animals lately; dogs used to be my favorites, since I had two growing up, but then I had a sweet cat for almost 10 years, and that’s how I came to love felines. Today I’m sharing a pretty interesting cat with you; I hope you enjoy the photos.

Es curioso cuando pienso que los gatos últimamente son mis animales favoritos; antes lo eran los perros, ya que había tenido dos mientras crecía, pero luego tuve a una linda gata por casi 10 años y esto me hizo adoptar este amor por los felinos y hoy les comparto un gato bastante curioso; espero que disfruten las fotografías.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23w2uMYrUgdLkaAbU4jkqmCKAC52xgNQLdRxovzDhJGfzEeds8orHhNwXnBv58FHftqFW.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wMqe14khuhjgfc9ggFGiwrLxE8uVzCFDzv9xPLrLJjVyKMU62f29gyvHtUnP3pD8grR.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xyfjy1RUGNfHoTLvBgNmTDwXvyqjNC1nyrdfunfoSnFjbKVAXy2dCLPwUtw9H74GadX.jpg

>

I usually like to go out on the streets and take pictures; while doing so, I almost always ended up coming across a kitten on the street some that seemed to be homeless and others that were cared for by people at various businesses. On this occasion, the cat belonged to the house where it was, but since it was so curious, it would peek out to watch people pass by.

Normalmente, me gusta salir a las calles y hacer fotografías; en este proceso, en la gran mayoría de ocasiones me terminaba cruzando con algún gatito en la calle, algunos que parecían no tener hogar y otros que eran cuidados por las personas de los diferentes negocios y, en esta oportunidad, este gato era de la casa donde se encontraba, pero al ser tan curioso, se terminaba asomando para ver las personas pasar.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xp8vD37QpzkMek1XPRgD9hyYq8ynB1sAJoRXjWRWXUzBJQm6eG26DBzPzdQqRktFsub.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xAcSYAEN4TVraeTEvqC4y6QiuGQtucjCp7iAVimpsfgLVjtaQkH9RaoVEGXT3emig5v.jpg

>

These are some of the last photos I took with my camera before my lens broke. I tried to keep the cat’s attention by making noises and hoping to catch its eye; at one point I thought it was going to go hide, but it peeked out again to look at me and let me take these pictures.

Estas fotos son de las últimas que hice con mi cámara antes de que se dañara mi lente. Intenté mantener la atención del gato haciendo sonidos y esperando capturar su atención; en un momento pensé que se iría a esconder, pero nuevamente se asomó para verme y me permitió hacer estas fotografías.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23x1Q5QbKaKuBhgi1uy7i4QbG7qMWiCvnrnJcm8GKDgMfZpR1eGRrCQaYgerZ5meoGBsd.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xpAnDyeRJp31LZVDU9N7vVQuzbu82mQevisW4BpCiPj3tKxQxBP4acmJCDUxatien5q.jpg

>

That's all for today. Thank you so much for taking the time to look at my photos; I hope you enjoyed them as much as I enjoyed taking them. I hope you all have a wonderful day. See you next time, dear friends in the community and photography lovers!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy. Muchas gracias por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías; espero que las disfrutaran tanto como yo el haberlas hecho. Deseo que todos tengan un estupendo día. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía!

/>

links.title: Power Up Match  April 2026 -Input wanted about new experiment
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaBWLdSBGvZGmBhgCCqJpdujg3ToKNxWkMhfhpP2SsBdS/unicorn_power.png)

Image created using Canva

I am going with the data on Hivestats.io  At the time of this post it showed 30 day curation earnings of 19.2 HP. So I am matching that amount and powering up.

I did make a change in curation the past month or two. I may make a full post on it(along with more general updates) but basically this account is now following the @tribefairy and BBH trails for curation.

I have some ideas of things to do on this account for  the future/ the rest of the year. I may make a proposal post of sorts to see what the community thinks.

 If I increase outgoing ecency delegations   then I could run some comparison in terms of earnings if I matched the effective HP and can compare earnings  From where I am at now it looks about the same earnings wise . This could be a fun experiment.




Outgoing delegations
Ecency -930

If I wanted to compare ecency earnings to curation That could be done by increasing delegations which would mean increasing HP on this account. I have about 550 HP not delegated. If I delegate all or most of that it would decrease the effective HP to about 2200-2300, while increasing the outgoing delegation  to ecency to 1400-1500.  But If I were to say balance them so that the effective HP is around 2000 for each, that's  more easily doable and would only require about a 500 HP increase on this account.  I do have some swap.hive on this account and also some on @tribefairy combined that would cover about 250-300 of that 500 number.  This is a very achievable goal.

**The unicoin.market account already has enough swap.hive for the next scheduled buybacks in addition to this.**

I want to hear from folks first. Would doing such a comparison curation vs ecency earnings be valuable or should I just focus on other things? If I do the comparison I will likely doing it weekly or bi-weekly over  a couple of months to get a good average. 

I also expect even if delegating to ecency is at a slight loss I will be blogging about the results and those earnings should compensate for any losses. I am not expecting any major losses.  I would also make a couple of posts before the experiment starts about the increase in HP and delegations and other stats. I am not concerned about loses.

Even if the balances aren't exactly matched I can still get a feel for the  earning percentage. I don't expect the balances to be exactly equal, that would be damn near impossible considering incoming delegations are something beyond my control. But I can keep the balances close enough that they are in the same ballpark.

Depending on how that experiment goes I can then choose to un delegate to ecency (at least partially)and increase my delegation to EDSI  after if that makes sense. I am considering setting a goal of 2500 HP outgoing delegation to EDSI as an end of year goal for this account.

links.title: Success Is the Loudest Explanation
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfZeMBsgJLRjrj1g9m1VbVpyoVmK5ussEE4oFMYFfjaix/1000686615.png 


There was a time when I felt the need to explain everything.

Why I joined this platform.

Why I believed in building online.

Why consistency matters.

Why opportunities often look strange in the beginning.

I wanted people to understand.

I wanted them to believe.

I wanted them to support the journey before results appeared.

But over time, I learned something important:

You don’t need to explain yourself to everyone.

Some people will misunderstand no matter how clearly you speak.

Some people will doubt no matter how honest you are.

Some people only believe what they can see.

That’s why success is powerful.

Results speak a language excuses never can.

Progress answers questions words cannot.

Consistency proves what motivation only promises.

You don’t need revenge.

You don’t need arguments.

You don’t need to convince every critic.

Sometimes the best response is growth.

The best explanation is progress.

The loudest statement is results.

So if people doubt you today, stay calm.

Keep building.

Keep learning.

Keep improving quietly.

One day, your progress will explain everything for you.

#inleo #leo #hive #growth #motivation #mindset #community

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@yordan96/success-is-the-loudest-explanation-4vh)

links.body:
> Gente bella de Hive, es un placer saludarles, les doy la bienvenida a este espacio donde suelo compartir canciones que han dejando una huella en mis recuerdos. Si hay algo que he aprendido en la música es a ser versátil, tratar de aprender un poco de cada cosa para defenderme en momentos en los que las cosas no salen como yo espero. En esta oportunidad tuve que usar la guitarra eléctrica de mi esposo porque se me rompió una cuerda de mi guitarra acústica y no creo poder reponerla aún, aunque al principio parecía ser muy fácil, la realidad es que fué un poco incómodo acostumbrarme a su sonoridad y a su mastil que es más pequeño que mi guitarra, creo que es la tercera vez que toco la guitarra de mi esposo y les confieso que me gustó mucho en esta oportunidad porque me sentí más suelta y cómoda. En casa tenemos varios instrumentos y puedo decir que de todos sé lo básico para defenderme y créanme que en estos casos lo agradezco mucho porque además de resolver, voy acumulando experiencia. Hoy les regalo mi versión de este tema tan espectacular de la Quinta estación, sin querer el ritmo se prestó para tocarlo en la guitarra eléctrica. Gracias por escucharme y llegar al final de esta publicación. ☺️
*
English
*
Dear friends at Hive, it’s a pleasure to greet you. Welcome to this space where I usually share songs that have left a lasting impression on me. If there’s one thing I’ve learned in music, it’s to be versatile—to try to learn a little bit of everything so I can manage when things don’t go as planned. This time, I had to use my husband’s electric guitar because a string on my acoustic guitar broke, and I don’t think I can replace it just yet. Although it seemed very easy at first, the reality is that it was a bit awkward getting used to its sound and its neck, which is smaller than my guitar’s. I think this is the third time I’ve played my husband’s guitar, and I’ll admit that I really liked it this time because I felt more relaxed and comfortable. We have several instruments at home, and I can say that I know the basics of all of them well enough to get by. Believe me, I’m really grateful for that because, in addition to getting the job done, I’m gaining experience. Today I’m sharing my version of this spectacular song by La Quinta Estación; without even meaning to, the rhythm lent itself to playing it on the electric guitar. Thank you for listening and making it to the end of this post. ☺️Hi friend, y

**“Tierra” funciona muy bien aquí** porque enseñas la palabra en su sentido más universal y además la aterrizas —sí, pun inevitable— con imagen, oración y contexto visual.

La frase **“Hay mucha gente en la Tierra”** está correcta y natural. Si quieres afinar un detalle didáctico, podrías añadir que **“tierra”** en español tiene **dos usos principales**:  
- **Tierra** = el planeta  
- **tierra** = suelo, arena o terreno  

Eso le da más jugo al post para estudiantes, porque esa doble función suele confundir bastante.

La referencia visual también suma. La imagen **“Hello, World”** fue publicada en **abril de 2026** como una fotografía de la Tierra tomada durante **Artemis II**; encaja muy bien con tu explicación del planeta [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hello,_World_(photograph)) y [NASA](https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/earthset/). Buena elección: no es una imagen puesta porque sí, refuerza el vocabulario.

Tu serie ya tiene una estructura muy clara y eso vale oro en contenido educativo. El post anterior, **#388 “Desierto”**, mantiene esa misma línea de explicación breve, imagen y traducción, lo que hace la serie fácil de seguir para lectores habituales [@aljif7](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-3...).

Si quieres hacerlo todavía más fuerte, una mejora simple sería agregar **una mini comparación final**, algo como: **“La Tierra gira alrededor del Sol”** vs **“La tierra del jardín está seca.”** Ese contraste enseña vocabulario real, no solo diccionario.

links.title: Dealing with humans. My Actifit Diary: April 30 2026
links.body:
Another holiday! Why? Because the president said so. To stimulate the national tourism. It’s a recuperable holiday, meaning that it’s not a paid holiday – at least that. And nobody really cares about that, anyway. Usually it’s just the bigger companies and those that have chosen the complicated SA structure that comply with that. Most businesses are open, and so are we. We’ll still make bread, no matter what. And I’ll make some experiments. The Olive bread was quite good, tomorrow I’ll work on getting the 100% Whole Wheat bread right. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a8d6c8a4-8395-471d-9479-46237c5b363e.jpg) It was market day today, and after that great Tang So Doo (finally learning the name of what I’m doing there…) lesson and a great and inspiring meeting afterwards, I had turned off my alarm. And I still woke up hyper energized at 6am, 15 minutes before the alarm usually goes off. Got up, made coffee, had a few thoughts that I’ll try to put into an more interactive post on the main account, sent a few stock updates to my brother considering the movements of big tech yesterday, and went to work. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ab4e1094-863b-497c-b038-245c6c1f72a2.jpg) The market was amazing, weather amazing, everyone in a good mood. Just one aggressive “ambulant salesman” and one crazy woman that threatened me and others with being killed by the Islamic state. Yeah. We have that here. The ambulant salespeople are generally cool, I always tell them that they can just stand outside at the entrance, that’s public space, but that they can’t be inside the market which is private property (for which everyone selling pays a contribution/rent). But from time to time there are those who tell me that this is Ecuador or South America and since they’re from here and I’m from Europe, they can do whatever they want and I can’t. But being 1,80m, quite pumped after 3 years of gym and on top quite versatile in my martial arts, I just smile and repeat. Smile and repeat. And I follow them. And smile, and repeat. Only 2 times I had to call the police because they were threatening me, but since it’s a small town, I do know the police very well and they show up quickly – by then, the threatener usually left already. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8c30a9c9-12f7-4f01-9447-b74948bb98cf.jpg) Ellie had free today, so she dropped by after her gym session for some coffee. Both types. That makes the day even better, every time. We went to Ibarra together. Her daughter is in a modelling course, learning how to walk and present and speak and do all that modelling stuff. I’m not a fan, but there are some positives to it. Meanwhile, I was shopping hardcore. 80$ worth of spices and stuff, and 240$ worth of bags of all kinds for the bakery. That should last for a while. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/dddc6d19-7668-43f1-84df-d099786105f2.jpg) And then another Tang So Doo class in the evening. I was a little late, as the modelling course went on for longer than expected, and I went by myself this time. Since I’m more advanced than Kami, we went into other stuff this time, more technical, more nitty gritty corrections, and it was as awesome. And since it’s a holiday, today is basically Friday, so I’m allowing myself a beer. But I’m also tired, and tomorrow will be a kind-of-work day for me, so I’ll leave it at one. But it tastes really good after a long day, especially in the hot sun in Ibarra. Wow, long one today. And not many pictures. Sorry! Have a good night!

links.title: Roast Chicken with Salad and Chinese Rice (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> Celebrating life is extraordinary, especially when your family gets together and goes out of their way to prepare a special meal in honor of your birth—that’s how we celebrated my nephew’s 15th birthday. We wanted to treat him to his favorite dish; his mother was the perfect hostess, and I just helped her with a few minor details.
![GridArt_20260430_163402631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8xEE8URHPZCoPoKvuWPjRjaHAJ3jCUSAZGXNqgFDz6BKGyqhqM8Co6JCE7CG2GSdMN.jpg)
Although there were slight variations in the dishes, the star of the show was the roasted chicken with potatoes—tender on the inside and with that light, crispy crust on the outside, seasoned with salt and turmeric. It turned out delicious because we used yellow potatoes, which are the softest and have the best flavor.
![GridArt_20260430_163430855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xKziCkdH8DytiMAgQDwuPpMQmYRFV6pbZkyoFfe15V4dLsifiq2bcJGDb4a2iuZ7HyQ.jpg)
We also enjoyed a chicken salad with just the right amount of creaminess from the mayonnaise, boiled potatoes, diced carrots, and shredded chicken. The cherry on top was small pieces of apple, a touch of sweetness for the palate. I really liked the result.
![GridArt_20260430_163500688.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vsUYJE9QCB58xoznVaatfxXbZmuKEPuzNAgwWTKLYg1jyVDYKH4PtYpsQiHQdazjGSp.jpg)
The side dish was a delicious Chinese-style rice, fluffy and with a balanced flavor of soy sauce, English sauce, and sweet-and-sour sauce. It also had pieces of ham, another ingredient that enhanced the culinary experience. This was the part the birthday boy liked best; in fact, he ate it all in a matter of seconds.
![GridArt_20260430_163134736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yJM4cqqx18NLq8NftuNqjbCcrRunB1QxEX2PK11ttFLjcfAweFxebo2H8wEphUhX4vy.jpg)
This dish was the highlight of the night; it lived up to expectations, and we were all satisfied with the result. The chef in charge received congratulations from the guests, and best of all, the birthday boy was happy. The best way to celebrate is with a delicious home-cooked meal, especially if it’s prepared as a family—I can attest to that. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Celebrar la vida es extraordinario, sobre todo cuando tu familia se reúne y hace el esfuerzo para preparar una comida especial en honor a tu nacimiento, así fue como festejamos el cumpleaños número 15 de mi sobrino. Quisimos complacerlo con su plato favorito, su madre fue la gran anfitriona, solo la ayudé en algunos detalles mínimos.
![GridArt_20260430_163402631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23y8xEE8URHPZCoPoKvuWPjRjaHAJ3jCUSAZGXNqgFDz6BKGyqhqM8Co6JCE7CG2GSdMN.jpg)
Aunque hubo pequeñas variaciones en los platillos, la estrella principal fue el pollo al horno con papas, suave por dentro y con esa ligera capa crujiente por fuera, condimentado con sal y cúrcuma, quedó delicioso porque se hizo con las papas amarillas, las más blandas y de mejor sabor.
![GridArt_20260430_163430855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xKziCkdH8DytiMAgQDwuPpMQmYRFV6pbZkyoFfe15V4dLsifiq2bcJGDb4a2iuZ7HyQ.jpg)
También disfrutamos de una ensalada de pollo con la cremosidad perfecta que aporta la mayonesa, papas cocidas, zanahoria picada en cuadritos y pedazos de pollo desmenuzado. El plus fueron pequeños trozos de manzana, un toque para endulzar el paladar. Me gustó mucho el resultado.
![GridArt_20260430_163500688.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vsUYJE9QCB58xoznVaatfxXbZmuKEPuzNAgwWTKLYg1jyVDYKH4PtYpsQiHQdazjGSp.jpg)
El acompañante fue un delicioso arroz chino, sueltecido y con un sabor equilibrado de salsa de soya, inglesa y agridulce. También tenía pedazos de jamón, otro ingrediente que mejoró la experiencia culinaria. La parte que más le agradó al cumpleañero, de hecho se comió todo en cuestión de segundos.
![GridArt_20260430_163134736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yJM4cqqx18NLq8NftuNqjbCcrRunB1QxEX2PK11ttFLjcfAweFxebo2H8wEphUhX4vy.jpg)
Este platillo fue la sensación de la noche, cumplió con las expectativas, todos quedamos satisfechos con el resultado. La chef encargada recibió la felicitación de los invitados y lo mejor es que el cumpleañero estaba feliz. La mejor forma de celebrar es con una comida casera deliciosa y más si se prepara en familia, lo certifico.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 30 2026
links.body:
>

Un saludo a todos; espero estén bien. En el día de hoy les vengo a comentar todo lo que fue mi reporte, un día que se me haría bastante largo, comenzando desde muy temprano, ya que, como de costumbre (aunque realmente no lo había mencionado), me fui a cumplir con mis pasantías en la farmacia. Llevo aproximadamente 5 semanas culminadas y siento que he aprendido mucho, desde medicamentos hasta experiencia con atención al cliente, aunque sin duda hoy sería un desafío, ya que habría una jornada que no solo haría la diferencia en el día, sino que me ayudaría a aprender muchas cosas nuevas.

Toda la mañana estuve trabajando, medicamento por aquí y por allá, revisando productos y moviendo medicamentos. Debo admitir que, pese a lo movida que fue, me divertí bastante. Logré aprender varias cosas sobre masajes, medicamentos y muchas más cosas muy útiles para un trabajo en este tipo de campos, además de conocer a muchas personas en el área de la salud que me gusta tener como contacto para algún futuro. También logré alimentar mi conocimiento con el sistema de trabajo en donde se maneja todo. Trabajé atendiendo clientes vía WhatsApp, aprendiendo más de todo el sistema, y aprendí muy rápido cómo funcionaba.

Luego de todo el trabajo y demás, me fui directamente a mi casa para poder almorzar e irme a entrenar, ya que no podemos olvidar fortalecer el cuerpo aparte de la mente. En el gimnasio tuve una rutina de Victorian Level muy específica que la verdad fue bastante pesada; sí me sentí algo cansado, pero nada del otro mundo. Siento que fue muy entretenido y me acompañó mi pareja, así que no sentí tan pesado todo el entrenamiento gracias a eso. De igual forma, las series de básicos y las de intensidad fueron muy efectivas con 0 fallos y muchas cosas que aumentar en torno al volumen.

Y parece que acaba aquí, pero luego del gimnasio, directo a mi emprendimiento. Los perros calientes y las hamburguesas últimamente me han ido bastante bien; ya muchas más personas me conocen y consigo atraer a más personas con una buena forma de hablar y mi carisma. Mi pareja y yo le hemos dedicado mucho tiempo a nuestro emprendimiento y esto nos ha dado mucha diversión conjunta, aprendizajes para el futuro y, más que nada, conocimiento laboral propio. Claro, aún nos falta aprender montones, pero realmente todo lo que se quiere se puede hacer si tienes un enfoque claro.

Al final, sí me fui a mi casa a descansar de un día bastante común en mi vida; suelo tener 5 días así a la semana y debo admitir que son días pesados, pero que me alimentan mucho en conocimiento y fuerza. Como siempre, muchas gracias por leer toda mi publicación. Soy Omar Zambrano y nos veremos luego.

Greetings to all; I hope you are well. Today, I'm here to tell you all about my report. It was a pretty long day for me, starting very early, because, as usual (although I hadn't really mentioned it), I went to do my internship at the pharmacy. I have completed about 5 weeks, and I feel like I have learned a lot, from medications to customer service experience, although today would certainly be a challenge, as it would be a shift that would not only make a difference during the day but would also help me learn many new things.

I spent the entire morning working, dispensing medications here and there, checking products, and moving medications. I have to admit, even though it was a busy day, I had a lot of fun. I was able to learn a lot about massages, medications, and many other things that are very useful for a job in this type of field, as well as meet many people in the healthcare sector whom I would like to keep in touch with for the future. I also managed to expand my knowledge of the work system used to manage everything. I worked serving customers via WhatsApp, learning more about the entire system, and I picked up how it worked very quickly.

After all the work and everything else, I went straight home so I could have lunch and then go to the gym, because we can't forget to strengthen the body as well as the mind. At the gym, I did a very specific Victorian Level routine, which was actually quite tough; I did feel a bit tired, but nothing out of the ordinary. I felt like it was really enjoyable, and my partner came with me, so thanks to that, the whole workout didn't feel quite as tough. Similarly, the basic and intensity sets were very effective, with 0 failures and a lot to improve in terms of volume.

And it might seem like it ends here, but after the gym, I head straight to my business. My hot dogs and hamburgers have been doing pretty well lately; a lot more people know me now, and I'm able to attract more customers with my engaging manner of speaking and my charisma. My partner and I have put a lot of time into our business, and this has brought us a lot of fun together, lessons for the future, and, most importantly, knowledge about our own work. Of course, we still have a lot to learn, but really, anything you want to do can be done if you have a clear focus.

In the end, I did go home to rest after a fairly typical day in my life; I usually have 5 days like this per week, and I have to admit that they are tough days, but they provide me with a lot of knowledge and strength. As always, thank you very much for reading my entire post. I'm Omar Zambrano, and I'll see you later.

links.title: 离高考还有最后一个月，坚持！
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![4mZLEMJ9h1xswHV6_82527c3703322dec5bc74955d6898e.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/4mZLEMJ9h1xswHV6_82527c3703322dec5bc74955d6898e/4mZLEMJ9h1xswHV6_82527c3703322dec5bc74955d6898e.webp)
![3bPeqxrZxxEWL2w0_4563acbf72f5ad4b2a4f0da27492e4.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/3bPeqxrZxxEWL2w0_4563acbf72f5ad4b2a4f0da27492e4/3bPeqxrZxxEWL2w0_4563acbf72f5ad4b2a4f0da27492e4.webp)
![iqdQhwOwMS1MF9m8_022232aad282ea77bf71c2a2fd6b95.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/iqdQhwOwMS1MF9m8_022232aad282ea77bf71c2a2fd6b95/iqdQhwOwMS1MF9m8_022232aad282ea77bf71c2a2fd6b95.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>



今天是4月的最后一天，距离高考只剩下最后一个月了。算下来，真正的在校教学时间其实少之又少，扣掉周末休息日和考前自主复习和正式考试的天数，真正上班的时间不多了。

身处这段紧绷到极致的工作时光，说实在的，我早就迫不及待想要逃离这种高压的“地狱模式”了，地狱是领导设置的，我们就是被看管的犯人，没有尊严的牛马，就说我今天受的罪，轮到我守完最后一节课，学生就放假，我只是中途去了一趟洗手间，短短一分钟不在岗位，就被巡视的恶毒女领导抓了个正着，她二话不说直接打电话给我的组长，要求我解释离岗原因。

那一刻心里真是气得原地爆炸，诅咒了女领导全家，学生尚且有课间如厕的自由，难道身为老师，连正常的生理需求都要被苛责吗？我实在无法认同这种斤斤计较、毫无格局的做法，总感觉对方是刻意盯着人，揪着小事不放，这份压抑又狭隘的职场氛围，实在让人喘不过气，只盼着能早日摆脱。

原本计划中午回家继续吃减脂餐，结果班科联系会结束后，合作三年的班主任执意要请客吃饭，连搭班的怀孕老师都答应赴约，我也实在不好推辞。我们去了重新装修后的功夫厨房，到场的还有另外两位科任老师，一桌子人围坐在一起闲聊打趣、听大家吹牛谈天，氛围轻松又热闹，不知不觉就聊到了下午一点多。

难得迎来放假第一天，本想开开心心打场麻将放松心情，偏偏今天手气差到了极点，一下午就输了两千五！

原本期待的假期开端，就被这几件微不足道却又格外搅乱心情的小事打乱，好好的放假氛围，也跟着打了折扣。

算鸟，再多的委屈和不顺心，也只剩下最后一个月要熬了。不管眼下有多难、多压抑，都咬咬牙撑过去吧。等熬过这三十天，就是整整三个月无人管束彻底自由的假期，光是想想这份无拘无束的快乐，就觉得所有的坚持都有了意义。


---
